Best Airbnb experience I’ve ever had! Dawn has a beautiful, clean, well stocked, and centrally located place. Everything you could want right there and train was just a few steps away. It was a hot October weekend, but she had air conditioning set perfectly so we walked into a cool comfortable environment. Everything in the house worked and I had a couple of questions and she responded within moments so we got settled in easily and quickly. I would highly recommend this host and this place! If you are lucky enough to find it available, get it for your family trip!
great host love staying here I definitely recommend

Five friends thoroughly enjoyed a weekend in Little Italy at Brian's stylish place. its location was great, we felt safe walking in this quiet neighborhood day and night, and parking was not a problem.  The flat was very comfortable and suited us well during our stay. Little Italy is a lovely peaceful oasis within the larger city, with  wonderful restaurants, a 121-year old bakery and great parks and churches - highly recommended!

100% would recommend Russell j’s place to anyone out there. let start with the location. it wasn’t too far or very close but just right, a grocery store (walmart) up the street. The home itself was comforting , spacious and well kept. The instructions were pretty clear on how to check in. Hard to find parking at night which was a bummer. I traveled to chicago for my spouse boot camp graduation, one of the best experiences i’ve had. The 3 bedrooms are great and very comfortable beds. russell and his wife are great i recommend to anyone second guessing! great pricing as well. thank you again!.

I stayed here on a solo trip and felt very comfortable at Joseph’s place. The location was good (I had a car) and was able to find street parking easily. Apartment was cute and had everything I needed. Joseph reached out to check on how my stay was, which I thought was nice.  Overall a great value.
Amazing place. Private and peaceful.

I had an amazing stay at Claire’s place! She was incredibly proactive and welcoming, reaching out ahead of time to make sure everything went smoothly and making me feel right at home when I arrived. The apartment itself is beautiful, spacious, thoughtfully furnished, and very comfortable. The location couldn’t be better, right in the heart of Ukrainian Village, just a block or two from great shops, cafés, and restaurants. I would absolutely stay here again next time I’m in Chicago!

The host was very responsive with communication.
This was a downtown Chicago hotel, making Airbnb a kind of third party booking agent. (RoomPicks?) We love using Airbnb, and will continue in the future, but will not stay in a place with this process. We had a leak in bathroom during the night, but with third party booking, it’s difficult to solve a problem like that adequately.
The kind and helpful hotel staff offered to move us at 0300, but with the other family members sleeping - we were participating in a sporting event the next day - it was not the best solution for us.

First night we walked in ac was on. It was stuck on 49 degrees inside. Cool fixed next day.  But the problem was BUGS!!  COCKROACHS on the counter in the bathroom in our luggage super gross.  When we got home to put our dirty laundry into the washer there were cockroaches in our luggage bags. Great. I would recommend not staying at any of this person’s places.
the place was in a nice area, the host was very nice and it has everything you could need for someone who is traveling
We loved our stay at the Beach House. The location was great. We were close to some great restaurants and coffee shops.

Place was beautiful and the location was great. The only complaint is that we were sweating all night both nights. We contacted the host, who responded quickly and had maintenance check it out, but there was seemingly nothing they could do to make it comfortable. I requested a partial refund for the inconvenience and that request was not acknowledged. I would not recommend staying here during the summer months.
Nice place! Accurately reflected in the description. Comfy beds, cute places to walk to!
Very lovely and simple stay.

Hosts were great and let us coordinate a late checkout, neighborhood was nice and had plenty of good food options, next door to us was a park. Only downside was construction outside the building but not really something the hosts are in control of. Was bigger in person than in pictures, enjoyed our stay!

We really enjoyed the ease of Thomas & Cynthia’s Airbnb— it felt like a home away from home! The gated parking space for the rental was perfect for our trip (we had a car). They were communicative hosts, and upon entering the studio, we were impressed with the layout and cleanliness of the rental. I personally favorited this listing for the deep bathtub, which I used several times throughout our stay! It was such a nice way to unwind on our little getaway. I would like to personally note that their was a rainbow mat in the entryway that reads “all are welcome here”, so for all LGBTQIA+ guests, allies, and folks who support marginalized communities, this is a safe space listing! I will be rebooking this listing in the future, and recommending it to all of my flight attendant friends who are planning on spending time in Chicago!
It was great. The host was super sweet. It’s a nice cozy spacious house.
All you need.
Great clean apartment

Had a great stay at Jason’s!
The house was even more spacious than the photos made it seem. It was steps from the blue line and everything in wicker park. Laundry in the unit was a big help.
Jason was really kind and he had two adorable pups that came to say hello. Also he had great recommendations for things to do in Chicago.
Wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again.
The caring nature of Evelyn is the best part! She is an artist and her home is full of character. The MOST comfortable bed, pillows and linens ever. Definitely will stay here again when in Chicago
Kay Lynn had a lovely home and a friendly host. Would definitely recommend them to others.

Great communication ahead of our stay - really appreciated the heads up to avoid locking ourselves out. Easy to access the house and good parking space. It was a really hot weekend and took some time for the house to cool down, but once it did, we were very comfortable!
Would highly recommend
Great host, everything as described. The street can get a little noisy at times and upstairs room a little hot during the afternoon but got what was agreed upon and it’s a safe, chill place

Cute little apartment in a nice neighborhood. Plenty of restaurants in walking distance. Hosts were responsive and provided great recommendations on good places to eat. Would absolutely stay at one of their places again!

Home was beautiful & had all the necessities that me & my friends needed. It’s surrounded by all the great restaurants & tourist parks. 10/10!! Would definitely recommend. Host answered all my questions in a timely manner. This is a great BNB to book if you’re visiting Chicago.

Elizabeth went above and beyond . She made us feel right at home and was extremely accommodating with our baby rental supplier which made it much easier to check in and have our crib and high chair already set up. The location was extremely walkable and convenient. We walked everywhere. Thank you for having us!
Clean place, nice location between Bucktown and wicker, owner was communicative

We really enjoyed staying at Amelia's place, it was perfect for checking out the site and restaurants, it was a great spot to be in. Walking around the neighborhood was really cool, the murals are awesome and we really enjoyed experiencing some of the local culture with all the festivals going on.
her place was perfect for getting a good night's sleep for all your walking days ahead. she had a nice selection of snacks, and was very willing to help if needed. We will definitely stay here again.

We stayed at this Airbnb the first weekend of October and couldn’t have asked for a better experience! From the moment we arrived, everything was exactly as described — clean, cozy, and thoughtfully prepared. The space had such a warm and welcoming vibe, perfect for a relaxing fall weekend.
The location was ideal — peaceful and quiet, but still close enough to local attractions and restaurants.
Our host was incredibly responsive and made sure we had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. You can tell they truly care about their guests’ experience.
Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for a relaxing and memorable stay. We’d absolutely love to come back!
Great Space , Everything was updated and home was Clean upon arrival

The spot was great. Amazing location. Train is loud at first but surprisingly easy to sleep through. Would stay here again
Overall it was great place but restroom where not getting locked from inside and there was some communication about neighbours not behaving professionally.
Beautiful home in a quaint tree lined neighborhood. Very kind host.

Kareem was a fine host. The room was nice and the bathroom was clean. The place is literally a couple minutes off the Red Line, which means you can easily access all of the North Side and downtown.
At first, I was under the impression that this would be a private stay with a private room and bathroom. In fact, Kareem lives in the unit. He wasn’t around when I checked in but he might be sitting on the couch working or watching TV as you come and go.
I warned him about the long code for the bedroom and almost locked myself out a couple times, so beware.
All in all, despite the misunderstanding about the privacy level, this was an enjoyable stay. A little pricey considering the shared situation but the supreme accessibility to public transportation made it all worth it.
If you want a treat, take the Red Line to Belmont and have the best dinner of your life at Coup de Thai (it’s BYOB!). Then, enjoy a brisk 10 min walk to Kingston Mines for a world-famous Blues experience!
Lourdes's property looked exactly as the published photos. She was extremely responsive and accommodating. Would highly recommend!

Not the best stay.. at all, but we made it work. I know it was a cheaper option but the bed was hard, kitchen had ants all over it, and bathroom had mold. If those things get fixed this becomes a pretty nice budget stay!

We really enjoyed our stay here! Very clean, nice set up, and while it is a "garden apartment" it didn't feel like it. Sometimes they feel like you are in a hole in the basement, yet this one was very bright and welcoming. Lots of space, nice beds. Being right in the heart of Andersonville, it was so easy to walk everywhere. While we didn't have problems finding street parking, we didn't have to move our car the whole weekend.

Amazing space!
Esmirna was very helpful and responsive, and the cats were so nice, if you are a cat lover this is the place for you!

Parking was in the title of the listing but the parking permit wasn't there when we arrived. Ann stated I could park at the dry cleaners instead. When I got to the dry cleaners, they told me this was not the case. She then stated she would drop off the parking permit within an hour and never showed. When I messaged her about it the next day, she read the message and didn't respond for many hours. Finally over 24 hours after check-in, the parking permit was delivered. The door code didn't work when we arrived and we had to request a new one. Only two wash clothes were provided for 5 people and there weren't enough towels. The bathroom had no exhaust fan so mold quickly grows on the walls and ceilings. The place generally needs a little maintenance. On the positive side, the location is good and the beds were very comfortable.

This place is clean, quiet, and comfortable. The most challenging issue I had was that there is no thermostat in the space, and it can get a little warm. One evening, I messaged the hosts three times requesting for them to cool down the Airbnb, and I didn't get a response until around midnight. The lock on the door can also be tricky-- sometimes it sticks even after you've punched in the code correctly repeatedly. Overall, I think it's a good place to stay, but these are just a couple of things to be aware of.
Great place to stay if you are visiting Chicago!

This apartment is in a convenient location, walkable to coffee and restaurants. Parking was easy to find nearby on side streets with the provided passes. The playground around the corner was great for the little one.
It is located on a main road with another rental above and street commotion, which is good to know if you are traveling with young ones. The other renters weren’t excessively noisy but the floors creek and you can hear others coming and going from the building.
The hosts were accommodating when we needed to use the washing machine and when needing the high chair that was included with the property. We appreciated the quick response times.
Overall a nice time in a fun city.
Amazing place in Logan Square!! Definitely staying again when I’m in Chicago.
The host was flexible , reliable and responsive there were alot of pros for their place and I don’t have much to complain about ! I would book again

The place is really nice. Got there very late from the airport and finding a clean place to sleep was the best! It is nice that the train stop is close, I must say tho, that it gets very dark at night and that made it a little unsafe. Overall, the place is same as pictures, clean and has the doors with good locks.
Hatice very responsive and the place was great.

Great stay, great host.  The place has a lot of rooms and places to sleep without feeling like beds have just been crammed in willy-nilly all over the place.  The house was clean and comfortable, in a good location.  The immediate neighborhood is just okay, but it is right between and within walking distance of a lot of really great neighborhoods.  Would definitely stay here again.
Amazing place to stay. The house was just beautiful.  Easy to get to and in great walking distance  to the L, Restaurants, and the lake.
A lot of things needed maintenance and the WiFi was horrible
The host was very welcoming and detailed.
The stay was great, but because of work I couldn’t stay the entire stay. Nothing wrong with the place itself but wish there had been an accommodation in that regard.
Great stay, Aiste was responsive, I just wasn’t fond of the location. Close to downtown but not very safe all the time.

This apartment was great for a weekend in which we needed to be walking distance from UIC campus. The host provided helpful photos to aid in the check-in process which was appreciated. Jasmine also was very responsive to messages and proactive in reaching out to ensure we got into the apartment.

It was perfect for what we needed. The location and the atmosphere were on point. I would say the only negative was the fact there was no blinds or curtains in the kitchen to the back patio. Just felt a little revealing. Too many people walking by the sliding glass door looking in to see exactly what we have. Didn’t feel comfortable leaving our personal items on the counter or table.  Might have a reason for it but just not used to something like that. Other than that the place and location were perfect. Very likely we would use again if the feeling is mutual.
Joe made my stay very easy!

We absolutely loved our stay! The home was beautifully designed with lots of high-end touches — from the heated floors to the Nespresso machine, everything felt thoughtfully done. The location was perfect, within walking distance to quaint restaurants and shops. The attention to detail made it feel extra special. We’d definitely stay here again!

A wonderful experience, Tom and his manager Beth made the visit very comfortable and stress free. Visiting family in the area and the space was so in the perfect location. Coffee shop and yoga studio just around the corner, both highly recommended. Bed was comfortable, everything spotless and cozy. Thanks Tom, I hope to visit again soon!

This big, beautiful house is lovely! It’s a peaceful sanctuary after the busyness of the city. The bus and train stations are nearby as were the grocery and restaurants. The garage is a true bonus! The train in the back was no bother, it was more like a pleasant reminder that we were in Chicago!!!
Fast internet, good location, unbeatable price. If you are okay with shared living space and picking up after yourself this is the place for you.

Comfortable stay. We were able to easily find street parking each day we stayed. Plenty of coffee shops within walking distance and a neighborhood bar just blocks away. Our son is a student at DePaul and we’ve enjoyed staying in different neighborhoods. While it was a 15 minute drive to DePaul, this apartment is mere blocks from Fullerton, so it was a straight shot to campus. We enjoyed our time at the apartment and in Logan Square.
really don't want too ..I made the best of a bad situation. cleaned what I could and went home ...after our stay ...
A great place to be right in the Boystown neighborhood- really enjoyed the place and location.
Very great host! Responsive and friendly

Pros:
• Quiet suburban neighborhood with easy access to both bus and train stations to the city.
• Private bathroom — a big plus since other rooms in the house are also rented.
• Fully equipped kitchen and in-unit washer/dryer (great for longer stays).
• Extremely comfortable bed, nicely laid-out room with a TV.
• Beautifully renovated bathroom.
Cons:
• The AC unit in the room is quite loud.
• The commute to downtown Chicago takes about an hour each way, so staying closer to the city might be better if that’s your main destination.
• The house is older, and the floors creak. Noise from other guests (especially late at night) can be disruptive.
• Limited bathroom counter space.
• When removing the sheets at checkout, we noticed the pillows were stained underneath which was extremely off putting — pillow protectors would make a big difference.
This is a great airbnb!  It's well kept up for an airbnb, the only issues being the AC and some of the doors being rather loud.  The back patio is great!
Great host

Nice spacious unit.
Great host!!
Our stay was very nice, rooms were clean and spacious and secure…. Would definitely recommend it and stay there again….

This was easily one of the best AirBNB experiences I’ve ever had, and I’ve had some good ones. The place is amazing. It’s spacious, clean, and has a lot of amenities. Jonathan, the host, was incredibly attentive. He met me at check-in to do a tour. We had six people for our stay and everyone was extremely complimentary of this home. If you’re considering booking. This location, think no more. Do it!
Amazing stay! Anthony was very responsive with clear instructions.
It’s not bad at all I just don’t like how u can hear everything upstairs ! And how it’s just a whole in middle of the block

It was a great stay! A little far from the downtown but not too bad. Upstairs person was very loud early in the morning. There were some spider webs, and dishes inside of the dishwasher were all full of mold. Overall the stay was amazing! Beds comfortable! We loved it!
Tara’s place met expectations and was the perfect place to stay for a trip to Chicago. Highly recommend!

This place is vibrantly and modernly decorated with plenty of cozy spots to relax and hang out with our guests. The location was super convenient and close to the city and all of our plans, which made getting around simple.
We had everything we needed during our stay, from sugar and syrup to other thoughtful kitchen staples that made cooking or making tea so easy. The outdoor patio areas were another highlight.
Owners were incredibly responsive and made sure our stay went smoothly. You can tell they care about maintaining this space, everything was clean, well-kept, and beautifully designed. We did hear the neighbors occasionally, but it didn’t take away from how much we enjoyed our stay.
I’d definitely book this place again. It’s even more beautiful and spacious than the pictures show!
Great location near MI Ave and the lake.
We loved Allen’s place. It was extremely nice and convenient . Allen was very accommodating. We hope to stay there again when we’re in Chicago.

This is not a private garden unit. It is the basement to a home and you enter through their living room/kitchen area. The basement has no door separating it from the rest of the house so it’s not private. There’s WiFi but it sucks. The host set the air conditioning to 78 so it was ridiculously hot in the bedroom. Anytime the host was home their sounds echoed into the basement. The blinds in the bedroom are made of paper so it didn’t block any light from coming in.
Neighborhood was nice.
Great location, great living space
Great place in the best neighborhood! Parking is easy unless you come home late ;) but then there’s always a spot within a block or two.

This apartment was perfect for our girls trip to Chicago! We felt close enough to the city but still in a quiet area. The apartment was cleaning and beautifully decorated. The hosts provided detailed instructions and everything we needed to know for our stay. Overall, we had a great time!

We really enjoyed our stay here! Nat was very accommodating and quick to respond to any questions we had, which weren’t many because everything went so smoothly! Checking in/out was very easy as Nat’s instructions are clear and straightforward, we had no issues with anything at all. The location was great for everything we wanted to do. There are a few things that might be worth considering. Firstly, the bed situation was very uncomfortable as the place comes with hard college dorm beds. Secondly, although the place was neat/clean, I wouldn’t say it was pristine but I didn’t mind it. Lastly, if you’re a light sleeper the neighbors may wake you up during random times of the night lol. This Airbnb is the first apartment as soon as you walk in, so you hear people entering/leaving. There was a moment I thought someone was walking around inside our place because the noises were so vivid but my partner didn’t mind. Overall, we had a good experience and wouldn’t mind staying here again. Thx!
Alicia was prompt with responding and provided clear instructions on checking in/out. It’s on a decent block as well, I recommend the stay.
Great stay!

Our stay was cozy and comfortable, and we had a great time! Lots of nearby restaurants/transit, and we particularly enjoyed the Muse Coffee Bar and Ferrara Bakery. The neighborhood was quiet and cute, and we had no trouble walking safely to and from the property, even late at night. Highly recommend & would stay here again!
We had a great stay at Patrizia’s place! Very peaceful place- we loved that breakfast was included! Would highly recommend.

just a totally awesome experience. everything was perfect. check in, parking, beautiful house. I could go on, but don't have the words. it was just perfect, we'll stay again next time we're in Chicago

Absolutely loved this Airbnb! Tram was an amazing host. We stayed there for a few days with my family, super close to a concert we wanted to go. everything was just as she described, super clean,parking was easy to find and it just felt like home. absolutely recommend!!!!!

This location was exactly as advertised and perfect to bring our family to Chicago for a wedding. Daniel was extremely responsive. The location was fantastic and there was free parking on the street which is almost unheard of in Chicago. The entire apartment was extremely clean and well stocked. I'd recommend this to anyone!
Sena was a great host - thank you.
Lovely, cozy and comfortable place

Ana is an amazing host that goes above and beyond to make her guests comfortable and satisfied. For me personally, she went out and ordered a new fan for the room I was in just because I was getting hot. The place is clean, quiet, and close to many restuarants and stores. I highly recommend to any traveler!

Marco’s room #3 was just what I was looking for on my trip to Chicago. Quiet neighborhood while still convenient to groceries, buses and different restaurants, and the common spaces in the house were clean and comfortable. Would certainly be happy to stay here again on a future trip!

This apartment was just what we needed for our month stay. The place was cute, spacious, and in a nice neighborhood. Ag dealt with the few minor issues that came up swiftly and was very communicative.
Super easy to check in, the place is exactly as it’s described. Location isn’t bad but it is on the south side of Chicago, the neighboring towns are also sick too! It’s worth my stay.
The apartment is modern, updated and very well equipped
Hands on and very quiet liked the room I was in wish I could have stayed longer
10/10 Airbnb experience. Would absolutely stay here again.

it was a nice place and we had a great host who was very resposive. The beds were comfortable and there was plenty of space. The kitchen did not have a lot of extra things other than what was specifically list. Hot pads, more paper towels and some cleaning spray to wipe down counters after meals would have been nice. It was a little expensive compared to other places we have stayed but the area was great. very walkable with lots to do near by.

I stayed here for two months and really enjoyed my time. The place is just as described in the listing. The neighborhood is so peaceful with easy access as the brown line station is right around the corner. Multiple parks within walking distance and there always seems to be something going on, especially in the summer months.
Lincoln Square is also nearby which has a lot of restaurants.
Don and Mary are great hosts and are very welcoming! They were easily accessible if I had any questions.
Things to note:
If you are sensitive to noise, the train does pass by behind the house.
The living area of your space is accessed via an open staircase that leads to the main floor where the host stays, meaning that you will hear him and the TV. Other reviews mentioned this, and it didn't bother me while I was there. Just something to note if you wanted complete privacy. You do have the door for the bedroom, too.

Phill was a great host and his family was very supportive and kind to us throughout the entire time. We really appreciated their contact with us to see how we were doing and if we needed anything they responded right away. If are looking for a comfortable and quiet place to visit in Chicago this is definitely a great home to book.

What an excellent stay during our first (but hopefully not last) visit to Chicago! The apartment was located within walking distance to the train, so getting to all the downtown Loop area sites (& beyond) was exceptional easy (even for seniors like us!). Plus, the neighborhood has a wide variety of restaurants & cafes nearby -- there's no need to use your car (you can leave it safely parked on-site).
Mike's place was exactly what we needed after long days of sightseeing -- a warm & inviting "home away from home" ... visually appealing & comfortable with many thoughtful touches throughout.
Thank you, Mike, for always being available & concerned about our well-being while allowing us our privacy.
An owner is friendly, she guided me everything in a house. I’ll rent again when comeback Chicago!
very generous and very communicative. Thank you
Best view ever! Had a wonderful stay here — everything was perfect, and the host was just the sweetest

Stayed here over a month while waiting for a lease to start after moving to the city. It had everything I needed - even for working from home. Short walk to lake, Aldi next door, very walkable. Sena was really kind, helpful, and made checking in and out really easy.
Whittfield was very pleasant host, Everything was smooth and went well. I definitely recommend staying here.

The flat is spacious with a stunning view. We stayed a month in Oct. Lucky enough to have all sunny days. With sunshine goes all the way the the entrance corridor.The location is golden. Within minutes of walk we were in Magnificent Mile. A lot of supermarkets, restaurants n shopping near by. Most importantly it’s a safe area. Our major concern is no parking in the premises. Carparks nearby are very expensive. $400 a month if you don’t mind. If you r not going to drive it is a perfect place to stay.

Room and private bathroom in a beautiful home in a great neighborhood. Spotlessly clean, must remove your shoes once inside. Felt very safe both inside the home and the location. Double entrance doors are locked at all times with keypads, as was our room. Walkable to train, restaurants, shops and Michigan Lake.
Was unable to check in early, so luggage is allowed to be kept in common use hallway. I was nervous to leave laptop, etc at first, so we took it with us. Soon realized it would be safe, so at checkout we left the room and put our luggage including laptop/devices in the hall until time to leave for the airport.
Only complaint was our room was freezing as the ac was set low and there is no way to adjust for individual tastes. Also, we were on the third floor with many stairs to climb. I had a bad knee and was unable to change rooms after I realized that, when I received our instructions. That was not necessarily Kanan's fault, she said there was nothing else available.

I knew I was going to be super tired after flying all night, and Rudia helped me to feel like I wasn't all alone and " on my own" in a new city. He communicated with me in a super- timely fashion, and was creative and flexible in helping me get situated, even though I was " running on fumes".  I really appreciated his willingness to be helpful and kind to someone who is not an experienced traveler.

Ci siamo trovati molto bene. L host ci è venuto incontro su tutte le domande e problematiche che avevamo in merito a zona, abitazione, check-in. Lo consiglio. Zona molto tranquilla, la metro è a 10 min a piedi così come il supermercato. Il posto auto lo si trova sempre.
Loved the location, in a nice walkable neighborhood. Always found a parking spot out front.  Responsive host & enjoyed the large tv and kitchen we could cook in!

As other reviewers have pointed out, it’s a great walkable location close to Andersonville and Argyle station with a free parking spot. The hosts are kind. It was quieter than expected.
Check-in directions are confusing. Guests should know you enter an exterior door on the right before you enter the interior door on the left.
The apt is run down. The bathroom is outdated with a small sink, old bathtub shower (not shown in photos) crack in tile floor (not shown in photos), broken blind in main bedroom, black sheets (can’t tell if they were clean), cheap kitchen faucet, outdated appliances, loud HVAC in second bedroom closet, cheap furniture and decor, card chairs(!) in the family room as seating, terrible lighting/lamps, and an old Brita water pitcher in fridge filled with 1/3 of water.
I didn’t expect luxury but based on the 5 star reviews, I had higher expectations for the space itself.

We stayed here for a family weekend trip with my in-laws, wife, and our two little daughters, and it was a great experience. The location was perfect — only about 15 minutes from downtown when there’s no traffic, and even with traffic, it was never more than a 25-minute drive.
The house was very clean, comfortable, and well maintained. Although the bathroom is on the smaller side, it was spotless and served its purpose just fine. Overall, it was the perfect place for a family stay in Chicago, and we’d definitely come back again!

University a couple feet away from unit with blue line nearby and can use bike or scooter (Lyft) to get to downtown. The zone was not noisy at night, may get louder in the morning. The unit is clean in general just the floor kind of dusty. Parking is outside in the street just see signs to park in right place.
Ms Sonia was very helpful and responsive.  Close to where we needed to be and good price.
Beautiful accommodations and lovely neighborhood in Chicago. Awesome hosts!

This space worked great for our team retreat. Each person had their own bedroom and the common space was conducive to group discussions and working at the big table. Milan was super responsive when I had questions about parking and we were thankful to be able to use the indoor parking. The whole place was nicely clean and it was in a great location to get anywhere we needed to in downtown.

This was a good place to stay for a few months while we searched for and moved into an apartment. There’s lots of space, the air conditioner worked great, ceiling  fans, a spacious kitchen, a big TV, and a desk for working.
The unit was very nice clean I love the kitchen very spacious it was a home away from home.
Fantastic stay and great accommodation in the city!
The space was adequate to fit our large group. Very accepted and walkable neighborhood.
Very good! Clean! Comfortable!

A top teir AirBnb can be found here in any of the available rooms. Expect to find the kitchen extremely well furnished with cutlery, dishes, pots/pans, and high quality appliances. We found the bedding to also be a big positive for us, we were so comfortable we're considering buying the same for our own home. As a host G is extremely responsive and attentive to the needs of his guests and takes impeccable care of the home. I would recommend this listing to anyone, the only thing to be aware of is the distance from downtown Chicago. Using public transit expect travel time to be an hour minimum. However parking in the neighborhood is plentiful and with a car everything you might need is 5 minutes away at a large shopping center.
Amazing view, great amenities with gym and swimming pool, convenient location

From the bugs to the broken dishwasher to the unauthorized access by cleaners who then half washed the bathroom, left all the lights on and left - what didn't go wrong during this stay? La cocina no está muy equipada, solamente lo necesario. No teníamos acceso a controlar la temperatura del aire acondicionado. Al estar en un sótano, se escuchaban las pisadas constantes del propietario en el piso superior.
Lo que más nos agradó es que al quedar en el sótano el lugar al apagar las luces era oscuro, se descansa y se duerme muy bien. La cama muy cómoda. En general, una experiencia positiva y recomendable.
Good location, street parking, host was responsive with communication. Decent internet speeds (50-60 mbps down).
Great location, lovely beautiful house and a nice room. Anny is super responsive as well. I visit Chicago often and this was one of my best (if not the best) Airbnb stays.
My stay here was amazing. Beautiful space and close to UChicago. Highly recommend!

Great place to stay as a visiting student! Bill and Cristina were incredibly responsive and helpful. Generous inclusion of toiletries and laundry and dishwasher supplies and bottled water in the fridge when I arrived.
Excelente lugar, excelente ubicación,  fácil acceso a transporte, tiendas y otros

I enjoyed the clean apartment. Everything you need in a kitchen is provided, including snacks. Washer and Dryer.
The street was quiet and friendly.
It is very close to a large beautiful park, shopping, etc.
Super nice apartment. Clean, easy to find, and would stay again. Thanks Art!
Great host and apartment! Very nice place, just like the photos, clean, detailed instructions, and the host was very friendly and helpful all the time.
This was the perfect spot for Pilsen, it felt safe and private even though it’s a shared space. Great location on a quiet street, close to all the best coffee shops!
Nice place in a great location! Mary is very responsive.

We enjoyed it here so much last year (our annual visit to Chicago to visit family & friends) that we booked again to stay here again this year.
I think that says it all.
Enjoyed my stay. Manuel & team were very responsive (quick) & accommodating. Very clear with communications.
It was a very convenient location for our stay as it was near my brother's house. It was also a very quiet location near a park, which was great for my kids to play at.

I stayed at Brandon's place for a month plus. I appreciated the nice kitchen, outdoor area, free laundry, and being able to bring our dog. The apartment is close to all that is happening on Milwaukee and parking was easy for Chicago.
That said, there was room for improvement. The apartment reminded me of that of recent college graduates (just a few wire hangers, no closet doors, mismatched decor, kitchen cabinets with a variety of orphaned items left from prior guests (coffee filters for the wrong coffee maker, cooking appliances missing the rest of the parts, etc.). Would have appreciated front entrance lights (outside & inside 1st fl).
The amenities list was not fully accurate at the time of my stay (e.g., no fireplace or firepit).
The guests in the attic apt. above were vocal during their "quality time" and the noise travelled. Prior to their move-in, I would just hear occasional music, nothing out of the ordinary.
Brandon did respond to any maintenance requests quickly.
Good for living

These few days at Prema’s place where really great. We loved Jefferson park, a really nice neighborhood, really quiet and nice. We really want to thank Prema for her kindness and communication that help us through this vacation.
I’de recommend this place any time.
Calvin was very very helpful and accommodating. Friendly host, and the location is great right here in the middle of Chinatown.
Great place in a great spot in the city. Really walkable to everything but also very peaceful. The place itself is in great condition.
Evan is a wonderful host, very responsive and respectful. I highly recommend the place!
Amazing location and great stay would come back again

I was very satisfied with my stay. The room was clean and tidy, the neighborhood was quiet and safe, and José was very responsible and always available. I highly recommend staying in this house and neighborhood
. ✅
Great location. Responsive host. Overall amazing experience. 10/10
Overall, great stay. It was very clean and inviting and Patt kept the place very clean. She was very responsive and went out of her way to make the stay nice.
Birthday Trip with my Aunt. Great stay

Ewa was friendly, hospitable, and very welcoming. She made me feel right at home and offered advice, recommendations, food, coffee…basically everything I could need. Her house is very nice too with thoughtful touches throughout. The bedroom had plenty of closet space, a dresser, a comfortable bed, and a locking door (though I never felt the need to lock it). And of course Bruno the dog is amazing.

Great location is quiet neighborhood. Very close to CTA station and only a 10 min ride to the loop. Host is very responsive and offered lots of local recommendations for food and local made treasures!
Would stay here again.

We stayed 4 days at Carina’s Airbnb and overall the location and space met our needs. Our biggest complaint was the noise. It’s a basement unit and the sound from upstairs resonates a LOT. It’s not the host’s fault, it’s just how the house is built.
Carina did make an effort to keep the noise to a minimum, but it was tough because we wanted to sleep in. Last thing I will say is the AC Unit is not hooked up correctly! It needs to be airtight so it *actually cools* the space.
Easy check-in. We had no problems. Was close to everything. Had a good time & stay was great!
Charles was an amazing host ,very friendly ,responsive at all times and so helpful with any questions we had

I had a great stay at Mark’s place! I had lived in Chicago so am familiar with parts of the city already - not Andersonville, though. The location was nice - quiet, yet close to public transit, shops, and dining. And Mark was incredibly responsive and friendly!
I was torn between giving this 4 or 5 stars. I chose 5 because I have no problem recommending his place to travelers to Chicago, and I’d rather be generous with stars than overly frugal. What would put it over the top for me - and give it an edge - would be little extras, which should not be hard to include… Maybe bottled water in the fridge and newer, crisper bed linens would raise the luxe quotient, but overall, a great option for a clean, convenient place to stay with a host who is easy to reach. Thank you!
Great location, would stay again
We will definitely be back.  Dede was amazing and we loved the comfortable beds and the shower was great.  Our family lives close so we have our new favorite place while in Chicago.

The house is very spacious and the woodwork is beautiful. It’s a great place for a group of friends or a family. The location is great and for us it was perfect. We were having a family event at our daughter’s house which was two blocks away. If you have kids, there are toys for them to play with.  Quite frankly it’s like being at home!

Everything nice, Patricia is really a great host with a very cool compact loft.
Can’t wait my next trip in Chicago!
Noel’s home was clean, comfortable, and in a great location. Check-in was easy, and Noel was a thoughtful host. Would definitely stay here again!
Loved this spot!
I really enjoy the place love it will be returning very very nice person hosting it wonderful lay out I had such a good time

This is a nicely decorated basement apartment in a quiet, tree-shaded, residential neighborhood.  Local restaurants are nearby and a station for the train to and from the airport (O'Hare) is conveniently walking distance away. Amanda Jean was friendly and responsive.

We had a wonderful stay with Kristen! The location is great (but not super walkable or accessible via public transportation-we had a car and it was perfect). Easy to park and easy to get around. Definitely recommend having a car! The apartment is private and comfortable. Kristen was always responsive and very helpful with local recommendations! Would recommend her place to anyone looking to stay with a local in Chicago!

Nikkole was a wonderful host. Very responsive. Accommodated us with checking in a little earlier which we very much appreciated. The neighborhood felt safe walking around to the local restaurants. On street parking was also very easy which was a huge plus for us.
love the tiki theme

Loved my stay! So accommodating, we asked for extra towels and had them within a few hours. There was one problem with the sink and they came and fixed it immediately. Beautiful, clean homes! & comfortable beds
Great stay. Very easy to communicate with!
Very friendly and responsive! Just super nice people who rent out the bottom apartment of their building!
Great location nice neighborhood easy to get around

Our stay at Ishin’s home was fantastic. The apartment was impeccable clean and well stocked with everything we needed for our stay and the decor is modern and chic. Ishin responded within minutes. The apartment is within walking distance to many restaurants, coffee shops, grocery etc. The garage parking was a plus and street parking was also available.  I will definitely stay at Ishin’s place the next time I am visiting Wicker Park area.

Andre’s place is is just as described. It’s in a great location, lots in walking distance and close to the train so it was very easy to get around. It was comfortable for 4 people, would definitely stay here again!

We had a wonderful stay here with our four young kids and felt right at home. The neighborhood is safe and welcoming, and we loved being so close to Jackson Park! Derek provided everything we needed for a comfortable stay and we would love to return again in the future. Would definitely recommend to others!

The condo is conveniently located just steps from a train station, making it easy to get around Chicago and explore its main attractions. Milan was very attentive and responsive throughout our stay, which we really appreciated. While the location and host were great, the condo itself could benefit from some improvements to enhance comfort and overall experience.
Michael's place was so cozy and very nicely decorated.  Check-in, check out and communication with Michael was super easy.  The apt. is very spacious, it was perfect for my family's Chicago weekend.
We enjoyed our stay at this duplex unit! Everything was clean and check-in/checkout was straightforward.
We rented Pratik's Cozy Lincoln Park Condo to live like locals.  Pratik was a great host.  Super responsive and really accommodating!  Would highly recommend Pratik as a host and his condo!
Host asked me $30 for just one hour early checking and $30 for just one hour late check out, which was not fair.
Perfect spot close to Wrigley and a ton of other walkable destinations. Loved it!
Thank you for a great stay! Apartment is in a safe area with lots of restaurants and things to do. Communication was great and instructions were clear.

We enjoyed staying in Ahmed’s appartment in Wicker Park. Spacious and fully equiped with all amenities it is located at a perfect location close to restaurants, shops and public transport. There was some noise from the construction nearby, however the appartment itself was residential and quiet.
The neighborhood is sweet and easy to get around. The apartment was cozy and quiet. Jen was very helpful. I would stay here again.

Cozy Pilsen Depa is aptly named - truly a cozy and comfortable place.  So clean and bright with top notch furnishings and amenities.  Access to the garage for our car was a big plus. Sylvia provided clear info about check in and responded quickly and helpfully to all inquiries.
Loveddd the house. There was even an outside area to sit. House was very clean  and big. Loved everything about it. Tonija was very responsive too so 10/10.
Overall, a pleasant stay at Bella’s place. The building was conveniently located and neighbors were kind. Great spots and transportation within walking distance.

What a beautiful place to stay! 💕
Things are within walking distance, it’s very easy to find, food is close, and it’s very close to the Allstate Arena.
Thanks again, Mary!

Always a wonderful visit. Couldn’t recommend this space more, Brian is a very accommodating host and is highly communicative to make sure guests are comfortable and have what they need to enjoy their stay. We love the walkable area, short walk to the CTA train lines to get around Chicago beyond the Wrigleyville area (although 9 plenty there to keep you entertained l), and very safe area in general. We find ourselves really only in the Airbnb to sleep, we’re mostly out and about.
See you next year!
All the best,
Skylor & Rob

We had a great time at Ashton's place! Walking distance to Wrigley (we went to a Cubs game) with a dedicated parking space and a cozy, cool rooftop patio - totally enjoyed our stay. The living room is also comfy so we also watched some football games in there with pizza delivered. While it's close to a bar with loud music which you can hear from the patio (not too loud though, kinda background level), you can't hear the music inside at all so easy to get a good night's sleep. Definitely recommend this place.
The place is not suited for seniors who have difficulty with steps. Did not realize the unit was multi-storied.

Friendly hosts, very responsive. Lovely home. Nice quiet neighborhood, within walking distance of blue line.
Would stay again.
Bella and Ben were very quick to respond to any questions we had.  The apartment was in a great neighborhood and close to a nice selection of restaurants.

Michael was very responsive to my questions before we arrived and while we werer there. The house was just perfect for us - very comfortable , plenty of room, kitchen was well stocked, beds and pillows were great, I could go on....
The location was great - close to the red and brown lines , close enough to Wrigley to walk to the game, plus plenty of restaurants, bars etc. But tucked away enough that it was quiet.
We will definitely rent again when we return to Chicago.
Very cozy place to stay. Very quiet neighborhood and they take great care of their lawn/outside of the Airbnb. Would def stay here again :)

This was a mostly quiet, very comfortable and large space for a group of 4 friends for several days. Walkable area and it had everything we needed. The cabinets were a bit haphazard, so check if you plan on  seriously cooking. One of the toilets clogs easily but there’s a plunger- seems like some overall plumbing quirks but nothing terrible. The rooftop deck space was so lovely!

Overall - good location, comfortable space and beds, well equipped, good communication. A couple of issues with the bathroom, the dehumidifier and getting the front door to lock, but they may all just have been bad luck rather than problems that will repeat for future guests.

My stay at Inka’s Bronzeville quaint VIP studio was nothing short of an rememberable and a splendid
experience.
My highlights were 1st and foremost the host Inka.
Professional, polite and readily available.
The building was safe, tech-secure and the neighbors were friendly.
I’d stay again and recommend this place to any and everyone.

Felice was very pleasant to meet and chat with.
The location was very convenient to Loyola University.
Thank you for your hospitality!
The space inside was great. Ample room for all of us to feel comfortable. Beds were comfortable. The space was very clean.
We enjoyed our stay at this cute and cozy, 3 step entryway place which worked well for my husband. Most of the places in the area have 1-3 flights of stairs to enter and exit in the area.

Though the key number pads are modern were at times, time consuming with catch across in entering, I also realize that I may have entered them in wrong but still when I did they were at times stubborn delaying my entrance.
12/10 would stay again!

This is an Air BNB that is a shared space with other guests/tenants in an area that is extremely close to U of Chicago. For the location & at this price point, it would be hard to find something nicer. For our 4-day stay, it was perfect.
Some of your Air BNB experience will depend on the habits of other tenants. Ours were very considerate and quiet.
The Air BNB is safe, but room mates must remember to lock doors, too. Appliances worked well, and were easily available. Living room area was easy to relax in. The shared areas were fairly clean. The kitchen had some dishes left in the sink, and trash overflowed some.
Bathrooms were fairly clean, and always available.
Our bedroom was clean, but linens for the bed were pretty damp. We had to take them off and dry them.
The bed is a size Full. Furniture provided was useful, and closet had hangers.
The temp was set to 82d F. The apartment was pretty stuffy, especially at night. Parking easy. Location outstanding. Would recommend!
The airbnb was very clean and the host is quick with responses!
I enjoyed my stay, felt right at home. It was so spacious & I loved the way its furnished. I’d definitely book this Airbnb the next time in Chicago!
Host was always responsive and helpful when I had questions about parking. Very clean place and easily accessible and safe.

Lu took the time to make his place feel truly like a home away from home. From the moment we stepped into the building, the small details customized to greet us were so sweet. And speaking of sweets, look for the treats that are hidden throughout the place! How fun and thoughtful! The neighborhood felt safe and quiet, and it was just a lovely stay near the heart of the city without all the bustle. We will look forward to staying there again probably next year if he’ll have us!

The house is huge.
Tarek was very responsive and helpful.
Thanks 😊

Hidden gem. Price was good for the Chicago area and the neighborhood felt safe. The host put lots of thought into this place. The bed is a bit uncomfortable and you may be awakened if you are a light sleeper. Other than that, very clean and cute spot for longer stays and nice amenities.
Very nice, newly remodeled space. Clean and comfortable, easy communication.
The location was convenient because it was close to the subway station. The condition of the accommodation was also reasonable for the price.
Abacus was a wonderful host! I would recommend staying at one of their BnB's!!

This airbnb was higher priced than others I looked at in the neighborhood but the location of this unit was worth it.  It's just a short walk to the train station and there are plenty of restaurants and shops within walking distance.  There is a small grocery store near the entrance of the building that was very handy and reasonably priced.  The building is very secure.  The unit was as pictured in the photos, clean and well supplied.  It was advertised as having a washer and dryer but my unit did not have them.  It did not impact my stay, but other travelers might want to double check with the owner before booking a unit in this building.  I would stay here again.
always a pleasure to stay here! Betty is so helpful and her place is conveniently located to public transportation and lots of restaurants and stores to explore
Had a wonderful stay! I loved the location — so convenient and made everything easy to get to.

This is our third time staying at Oscar's place and we hope to return for many years. Always friendly and helpful. Neighborhood is quiet and conveniently located near restaurants, groceries and public transit. If you're lucky you'll get to see their adorable Frenchies. 😊
房子很新，房東很熱心，有機會還會回訪。
So walkable to Wrigley, right in the heart of the action. Great spot. Easy to get into and find.

I really enjoyed my stay here. Place was spacious, clean and just as pictured. I rode the train most of my stay and the location was about a 5 min walk from my blue line.
Scott was quick to response and helpful too! I would love to stay here again when I come back to Chicago.
The place was very comfortable and very clean. The location was great. I had everything I needed. Joe and his team were great at communication and I would use them again.

I had a fantastic experience @Patricia’s place! The home was exactly how it was described. The location was perfect, short walk to blue line. Check in was really simple. Overall I would definitely recommend & myself would book again ◡̈!

The place was lovely and felt like home! Joseph gave specific instructions that made it incredibly easy to find the place and get inside. Everything was easy to find inside as well! The neighborhood was quiet and beautiful and anyone we ran into was very friendly! The only issue we had was the light in the entrance of our apartment didn’t work which made it hard getting up and down the stairs. I messaged them about it but got no response. 😢 since we were only there a few days, it wasn’t too bad!

Michelle’s listing was exactly as described. The space was clean, functional, peaceful, and overall perfect for my short weekend in the city. Michelle was a great host with clear communication. I will keep a lookout for this listing the next time I am in Chicago!

Kymi's place is in a great location and we had a phenomenal time in Chicago! We appreciated that our host was extremely proactive and communicative. We had a last minute change of plans and had an extra guest with us when we checked in at 1am and by 3am, Kymi had already charged us, saving us the trouble of reaching out the following morning. Most of us also appreciated the thermostat setting at 75 degrees, although other folks may find it a bit hot for sleeping and the thermostat is password protected, so make plans to arrange any adjustments to the temperature with the host directly.

James place was in a perfect location and the views alone made his place completely worth the price. Check in and Check out was super simple and he was very communicative. Also, the amenities in the building were awesome. Having a grocery store directly below and adjacent to the apartment was a life saver! I would definitely book again.

Place was clean and nice . Bed was decent. Host was accommodating.. biggest con was this Airbnb was located in. Me and my husband were scared to walk from station to Airbnb even though it was just 3 minutes walk. Wish I had done more research about the area .
We loved our time in the unit, it was in a great location within easy walking distance to the CTA. Would definitely come back and stay again!

My stay was quite interesting, while the host is very nice and responsive this stay wasn’t what I was expecting. For starters they don’t want you to put TOILET PAPER in the TOILET and don’t make this known beforehand. The bedroom pictures aren’t accurate (different bed, bedding & there’s no decor.) Almost immediately walking in we both noticed a smell, my friend pointed out it smelled like mold so we did a little looking and the air conditioner unit is completely covered in what I think is black mold or if not some type of black residue. It says that it is a private entrance, yet the outside area you walk through is a common area for over 4 other apartments. The bed blanket felt slightly moist but might be from the overall air in the room. The upstairs neighbors are heavy steppers but that’s obviously not the hosts fault. We also found a used bonnet tucked on the side of the bed, lots of dirt/grim in the window seals.

Host was flexible with checkout, which was nice, and the bnb was very spacious.
Note however that the second bathroom is in the master bedroom so if a couple takes that room it might be difficult to access it for everyone else

My overall rating: 4.5/5.
Please read about the location and details of the room. I had zero issues at this stay, and enjoyed my time. I felt very fine being in the neighborhood, and the subway was about a 10 minute walk away. The instructions were clear from check-in and check out, and the room and photos are as pictured! I was looking for a very affordable, last minute stay, and this AirBnB met my needs. My only two words of caution are that the walls are a little then and the bathroom could have some more care (this is mostly in regards to other guests). I felt very fine during this stay, and would certainly come back again!
Enjoyed staying there, would use again.

Had a great stay at Wynter's place! She was attentive and helpful with smalls needs as they arose. The jacuzzi tub was a treat espeically after running a half marathon!
I would definitely stay again.
We had a wonderful stay. The house was clean and cozy with all the amenities. The neighborhood was quiet and felt safe. Would certainly recommend to anyone unsure of where to stay in Chicago.

El lugar es de fácil acceso, el anfitrión atento a las necesidades de los huéspedes, coincide con las fotos, sin embargo la casa tenía mucho polvo que se podía sentir en las sábanas durante la estancia.
Great central location. 2 mile bus ride to lake/Ohio St. Beach.

We had a wonderful time during our stay at Noelle's home. Our friend group traveled from NC to visit Chicago to take in the food, Cubs game, and the amazing downtown sites.
Noelle was extremely friendly and met us on our initial check-in to answer any questions we had about her home, as well as to offer advice on the neighborhood and suggestions for activities for our group.
It was great for each couple to have their own bathroom. Note: all 3 bedrooms are located on the 2nd floor, with 2 full bathrooms. The 3rd bathroom is located on the 2nd floor, which was not an issue, since the 1 early riser was able to head downstairs to start the coffee before jumping in the shower every morning.
Parking was NOT an issue at all. We were able to find parking every time we left the home.
There were many areas of the home where our group congregated. All spaces were very comfortable!
This is an excellent home to enjoy Chicago, and you will be in Good Hands with Noelle.
Thanks for the hospitality. We will be back!
The Airbnb was beautiful and spotless. Yadi was very helpful & quick to respond. The street was quiet and in a nice neighborhood.
Lovely spot to stay for a weekend in Chicago. Location was ideal, communication was easy and quick, and the space was as described.
Very close to Logan Square station. Exceptionally convenient and quiet at night.

We liked that the house was clean and ready for guests. Beds were very comfortable. The location was initially a little tricky to find because it is behind another house and we had to walk through a little alley. After that it was fine.  The neighborhood was quiet and wonderfully close to a park, many shops, restaurants, and coffee shops.
The apartment was very nice and the location to Wrigley field was perfect for our family with 2 small kids.
Excellent stay! Leonides was super friendly and responsive, and the home was wonderful, with great themed decor, spotless, and comfortable.  Highly recommended!!
super responsive and helpful!

Great warm feeling home for our family gathering of 6 adults and 3 small children. Nicely furnished throughout with great artwork. Spacious interior living area/kitchen with a cute back yard as well as porch area just off the upstairs primary bedroom. Home has everything we could think of ranging from soaps and hair drier to fully stocked kitchen and light blanket for the living room. The host was responsive to all questions and worked to have a repair person fix a railing that was loose during our stay. Location of the home was great being situated in Lincoln Park with short walk to the “L” station and quaint local restaurant at the end of the street along with a playground across the street for small kids.
We loved the space, and it was the perfect location for us -- close to our family members.

First time to Chicago, IL and this place was awesome! Very responsive and clean. The hosts were also flexible and worked with our schedule since we arrived late. Loved that it was close and walkable to Wrigley Field. Can’t wait to stay again! Five stars all the way!
Exactly what we were looking for. Visiting our daughter in Edgewater and this was a great find for us.  Walkable to the lake and to her place.
We would definitely stay here again in a heartbeat. Everything was clean and nice and just what we needed. 10/10

The neighborhood was walkable and safe. Walked to local Mexican restaurant for “Cafe de Olla” at 17th and Ashland, and dinner at La Mejikana. Plenty of neighborhood finds. 😍
It was my first trip to Chicago but will not be my last.
The only thing I did not like was the parking meters, but Noel had nothing to do with that 😉
unit was spacious, clean, and comfortable! had everything you needed with a beautiful view of the chicago skyline! he was great at communication!

Larissa’s apartment is in a great location and is very comfortable. We enjoyed being walking distance to Wicker Park, West Town, and Damen Station. There’s great food in the area, and the apartment is spacious and had all the amenities we needed. Thanks for a great stay!
Beautiful home! Great host. She answered in a timely matter and made us feel secure in our stay. 10/10 recommend if you want to be close to downtown!
Great place if you want to stay in Chicago, everything was clean, and we all felt home for our trip
I had a great stay at Tamiz's place. Close to the metro station, and bus stop around the corner. Tamiz was a great host but also gave me a lot of privacy as well. Will stay again.
Jay's place was in a great location.  The place was comfortable and had all the amenities needed.

This was my second time staying here and it was exactly what I needed. Quiet, easy, and food within walking. It’d be nice to add some rugs and blackout curtains but those are more minor desires. The kitchen is pretty awesome btw. Edward is a solid host and I’d recommend this place to others.

This place was perfect for our stay! It was SUPER clean, like pristine. Felt like we were the first people to ever stay in the place!
The location was super convenient! So close to the L station so we got around so easy even as first timers to the city.
The parking was also a massive plus. We did not drive around the city much and utilized the public transit, so it was great to have a spot to leave our car and not worry about it!
This is not a negative, but info for future renters - this is on street level, so there is some noise. This didn’t bother us as the bedroom was far back enough, and we expected it as part of staying in the city. But if you are particular about noise, that is something to consider.
Overall we loved the place and would be happy to stay again if we return! Highly recommend.

Enjoyed my stay here in Chicago for the first time. Location was decent. Walking distance from the train station so you can really get around conveniently. Beds are very comfortable. Clean and tidy place. Had no issues. Good location if you plan on exploring the city and not gonna be home a lot.
Super clean and comfortable room .
Just to note, a fee of $100 per room is asked for on arrival , will be refunded but will take up to 3 weeks, also local taxes.
Loved it!
My sister and I were in Chicago visiting relatives. This was close to where my brother lived.  So it worked out well.
Great place to stay, beautiful home, very roomy. Be sure to ask about parking if you have a car.

Super ideal for family- close to Humbult park and West Town
Clean and well set up

Très beau séjour. AirBNB parfait pour ce que nous recherchions. Nous étions 5 personnes. Seul petit inconvénient que nous avons trouvé c’est le confort des lits simples étaient moyen et la longueur des lits est un peu petite. Mais sinon, tout le reste était excellent !
We were in Chicago for the half marathon it was a great location because it was close to the race. The place was spacious and very clean.

Caitlin could not have been more gracious or thoughtful.  She communicated with us in advance of our stay and was responsive to our requests for information.  She also made the apartment available for early check-in without our even having to ask.  The apartment itself was spotless and very comfortable.  We especially appreciated having a modern washer and dryer in the unit because we had been traveling before our stay and needed to do laundry.  We frequently visit Chicago and will absolutely stay with Caitlin again.

La casa està bien. Decidimos coger esta casa por estar cerca de la salida y llegada de la Media Maratón de Chicago. Pero lo peor fue llegar. Si eres de fuera no conoces dónde estàn los barrios peligrosos. Decidimos ir en metro, nos dejó en la peor zona la ciudad, fuimos andando toda la 61st, que es mucha distancia pero como nos importa caminar. Cada vez se ponía más peligroso , realmente sentimos miedo. Menos mal que íbamos tres amigos.
Jim debiera de informar como ir a Chicago o desde Chicago. Hay un tren ( Metra) que te lleva y luego metro (Ventra). Y NO coger para ir a la casa la línea Roja y luego caminar.
Cuando llegas el barrio es seguro y hay mucha seguridad sobre todo de la Univerdad.
The host was very accommodating and flexible based on our needs! We had a great time staying at the place!

We were a group of five...stayed in this home last year.  The pictures in the listing are pretty accurate to what we experienced.  The owners did allow us to use the fourth bedroom in the basement level, which made sleeping arrangements easier.  The second bathroom is also located in the basement, as well as the washer/dryer.  Very easy self check-in/check-out process.  Minh/Tru also responded quickly to our inquiries and were accomodating.  We greatly appreciated this!  The entire place was spacious and had all basic amenities.  We felt right at home.  Our group was attending a weekend dance event at the Irish American Heritage Center and the home was within walking distance (approx. 15 min). Great place to stay, quiet and nice neighborhood close to many amenities and public transportation. It is clean and well organized place. Hakim and Fatza are fantastic, always friendly and available to help.
This was a perfect place for a group of 8 friends to enjoy Chicago.

Tuan's house was great. It was in a peaceful neighborhood with a really great Italian restaurant within walking distance. It was also great to be within walking distance of the bus, as we did mostly public transportation during our stay.
Inside the house, things were great. There were window AC units in both of the bedrooms, which kept us nice and cool throughout the night. The only downside was that things were a little small, like my head almost hit the ceiling of the shower (I'm 6'2") but it wasn't a huge deal.

I have stayed at the Hamlin House numerous times in the last several years and have always had a lovely experience.  Each of the rooms (I've stayed in 4 out of the 5) are comfortable, extremely clean, well-furnished and beautifully decorated.  Caryl is a delight to interact with; her breakfasts are delicous and satisfying and the company is always excellent.  I will be sad when my daughter graduates next year and I have less of a reason to visit with her!
We were visiting family so we didn't spend much time in the apartment.  The spaces were large and the kitchen was well appointed and Afsha was a great communicator!

Teddy was really communicative and made sure everything was on point during my stay. The place was so nice, and so relaxing. The area itself was pretty quiet. The view and privacy from the front balcony, and the skylights in every room were like the cherry on top for the whole experience. I would definitely recommend, and 100 percent stay again.  🤩😎

I had to end my stay early due to another candidate stating we had the police called on me. Which wasn’t true. Yet, the host still believed the candidate. The Host tried to unlock my door while I was still sleeping, didn’t knock or anything which made me very uncomfortable. I wouldn’t recommend staying here!!
Didn’t realize it was two separate units until I arrived. Worked out fine.
The location is the best possible ever!!!! Right in the heart of Wicker Park and all the festivities!!!! Lots of room in the apt as well for multiple guestssts...
Sean was a great host. The place was as advertised & the neighborhood great. Definitely stay again.

Less than a block away from numerous restaurants and cafes, Anne's home was a great stepping stone for our adventure in the city. Highly recommend for large groups looking to explore the neighborhood!
Extremely responsive and helpful instructions on entering the building . Fairly well priced.

We enjoyed our stay! Our host was very responsive, infomative and friendly. It was comfy and place was quite roomy. Easy keypad access was excellent for entry/exits.
Will definitely reserve again!
Beautiful home, spotless, and so comfortable! The host was incredibly thoughtful and responsive, making everything easy and stress-free. Would book again!

GREAT location!!! Description & photos matched place perfectly. Beds were comfortable & plenty of extra pillows, linens, towels available if needed. Great communication & offered a complimentary cleaning after 1st day if location was not up to par.

Allyn was a wonderful host.
I understand that when you share a space with another guest, there can sometimes be unforeseen issues beyond anyone’s control. I mention this because I encountered a bathroom that wasn’t quite up to standard, so to speak. That said, Allyn was very responsive and quick to address the issue, consistently checking in to make sure everything was resolved — which I truly appreciated.
Kudos to her for staying on top of a changing situation!
Clean and convenient

Arleth is wonderful host , he has accommodated us the best.he
love him and his place.

Absolutely loved staying here! Richard was really nice and made me feel really welcome whilst also giving me lots of space.  As a female travelling on my own I felt really comfortable.  The location was fantastic and the room and bathroom were both really clean.  Overall great experience!
Perfect place for those who plan on being out and about in the city and looking for a home base. The bed was very comfortable.

Brenda was a gracious and generous host! She was warm and responsive. The check-in process was seamless. Her home is clean, spacious, tastefully decorated, and adorned with beautiful plants and flowers. Very cozy, inviting and comfortable. The sweet kitties were an added bonus!  A wonderful stay for our Chicago weekend. Would definitely stay here again!

Carrie has a beautiful home and we really enjoyed our stay. She was very responsive and welcoming- I even got to meet the cutest kitties on my walk in. Loved the privacy/security of a personal lock on the room I was staying in while having access to shared space. Would absolutely stay again!
All in all a great, cozy place and a great stay.  Bella was great.  Very responsive.
We stayed her for a month and the place was everything we needed, best part was how easy the street parking was
Comfortable, clean apartment in a quaint and quiet neighborhood. The hosts communicated promptly and politely to any of our questions. We had a fantastic trip!
Great location and Patricia was an amazing host!

Quiet and clean, a great place to stay to explore Chicago. Near Blue Line mass transit stops and the freeway but it doesn't feel like it, the neighborhood feels small and friendly. The apartment is easy to find and Juan is very responsive. Perfect for a couple spending a weekend in the city.
It was the perfect place to stay for a weekend trip to Chicago!
Overall excellent experience

Great all around!
The space was lovely and Monica was a fantastic host
Very nice area and the airbnb itself was also very nice. Perfect for a short stay!

This is an excellent location for a large group. It’s in a great area with a lot of walkable options for food, entertainment, and shopping. It was very clean and there were even complimentary drinks for our group. This place is a lock for future trips.

Gerard & Ernie are absolutely fantastic.  They go above & beyond to make sure you have everything you need and more. Not only did we feel right at home, it was like entering a peaceful oasis. The neighborhood is nice & quiet, but walking distance to just about everything you might need. We really enjoyed our stay & would definitely go back.
Great and easy weekend! Exactly what was described.

We liked the setup for guests in the house,  which affords privacy in a shared house. Andreea left snacks, breakfast food, and fruit in the  room and more than we needed in mini fridge, and she brewed coffee at 6 am every day.  Plenty of food for a quick breakfast before getting out the door.  If you want to go out, the nearby Alps, a short walk away, is a great diner. The neighborhood is safe and less crowded than northside neighborhoods farther east.  The bedroom is cozy, but well organized, and the enclosed porch has plenty of room for sitting. The bathroom was super clean.
Great place. A ten minute walk to Logan square subway station, where you'll find some good restaurants/cafes. place was just as described and Kelly was a 10/10 host.
Nice accommodations with Everything needed for a short stay. Private and plenty of space. Clean and organized.
I had a great stay with my friends. We were walking distance to great restaurants and bars. The amenities were great. I will definitely stay here again when visiting Chicago.

I stayed at Charlie’s place for five nights. The setup feels more like a hostel with a shared kitchen and bathroom, but everything was clean and my room (#1) was bland but comfortable, with AC and a window that opened. The location is convenient to Broadway, though as a woman traveling alone I felt a bit uneasy walking after dark. Inside, the building felt safe, and Charlie was very responsive and easy to communicate with. Overall, it was a comfortable and affordable stay.
Accommodating and super responsive! Great stay and would definitely recommend this place!
Thank you so mush. We had an amazing time! This space was perfect! Perfect location. And a safe location. We had no issues. Will definitely stay again.

A bit of a Monet/budget stay. If you’re looking for something affordable with some privacy (as the king room is up a back stairwell with private bath) then this is your place. It was clean. The host communicated well/were accommodating to our needs.
Upon staying for a bit you see some wear and tear/DIY fails. The kitchen is not fully stocked for cooking, missing many essentials like a can opener, strainer, and baking sheet. The towels were rough, pilled, well used, and small. The mattresses were hard. Parking in the back did exist but was very cramped and hard to maneuver into.
I wouldn’t say it was a bad stay, just not five stars. If you’re looking for a budget spot for a group then go for it. If you’re looking for upscale then move on.
This is a beautiful historic building! It was perfect for our family while we were in town for a wedding. It was clean and comfortable, we felt right at home. I highly recommend!

Armando was a great host. He answered when I called him to confirm check in and was helpful with getting inside. His home was clean and spacious and my family slept safe and comfortable during our stay in Chicago.
Great host would stay here again
I would recommend this place and I will definitely be back!! Clean, convenient and felt like home

Jeannie and Ceasar were so accommodating! Ceasar had done a walk through of the unit I booked and found some issues that needed to be addressed. They offered to move me to one of their other available units next door to where I was supposed to stay. It was definitely an upgraded space and I'm thankful they were willing to move me
Thanks for the comfortable stay & super clean bathrooms!

The house looks exactly like the pictures and the neighborhood felt genuinely safe. The host clearly states the unit is upstairs, but be aware that getting to the unit at night was challenging due to lighting. We did encounter small spiders inside the house, though the host was quick to arrange exterior pest control, which helped significantly. In terms of location, it felt much more remote and cabin-like than the downtown area we expected. Communication was mixed: the host was unresponsive leading up to the trip but was quick and helpful once we were actually in Chicago. Despite the lighting and bug issues, we thoroughly enjoyed our overall stay. 4/5!
Completely enjoyable stay, peaceful neighborhood with friendly people!
These apartments were perfect for our Chicago stay.

I was the first guest in this unit so there were a couple of minor bumps initially but they were immediately resolved by Gabriel and Diana. Everything you need is within walking distance and the building and neighborhood feel very safe. I would still be staying in the unit but it was already booked after my stay. I like the hosts so much, I am actually staying in another one of Gabriel's units right now because of the great experience in this one. Highly recommend!!
The place was super clean and very accessible to public transportation. My boyfriend proposed to me on this trip so it will definitely always have a special place in my heart!!!
Great place and set up with everything we would need! Great option for a large group.

We had a wonderful stay at Samantha’s place!
