The location is also fantastic, in a very walkable area that made it easy to explore the neighborhood.
Samantha was a perfect host: friendly, welcoming, and very responsive whenever we had a question. We even had the chance to chat about gardening, real estate, and our shared ties to the Boston area, which made the stay feel extra personal.
Highly recommend booking here — thank you, Samantha, for helping make my parents’ visit so enjoyable!
Great place and very friendly hosts! We stayed for a month and really enjoyed it. The neighborhood is quiet and the house is spacious and comfortable. Definitely recommend!
Such a cute and charming place with anything you could possibly need plus a great location
This location was a great space for a weekend away in Chicago! Very short drive to get into the city and the unit was well maintained and looked as advertised. Would recommend

Tammy & Scott are friendly, wonderful hosts that made me feel right at home. The place is sunny and inviting, and the location near the lake was perfect for morning walks. I’ve already booked my next stay!

It literally feels like home away from home for me. I’ll definitely be coming back.
Great stay, super interesting place. Responsive & accommodating host went above & beyond!
Would stay again
Mary and Jim were great hosts. We very much appreciated them welcoming us in their apartment. The space was excellent. The garden was beautiful - a refuge. Highly recommend!
Holy amazeballs. This is the Airbnb I will judge all future urban listings against. Beyond top tier.
Great location and beautiful place.  Close to amazing restaurants.

We had a great time here. Super clean kitchen and bathrooms. Beds have excellent mattresses. A bunch of eateries are within walking distance and the walk to Wrigley field is close too. The description of the place is accurate….there is no elevator & the space is on the 3rd floor so you need to be in great shape to make the hike up and down! The L train is right outside the master bedroom so you will need to wear ear plugs and use a sleep mask. We felt safe in the building and in the neighborhood.
Wanda was a great host and was super communicative. Would recommend.
Great location! We appreciated Ron’s responsiveness and commitment to making our stay as great as possible!
It is a beautiful home and the hosting couple are very kind and friendly. I recommend it highly.
The place was just as described. The neighborhood is walkable and quiet. Rosa was responsive and helpful. Highly recommend!
Thank you so much for hosting me! Great place and location.
Exactly as pictured and spotless in a quiet neighborhood. My brother and I enjoyed staying here and would stay again!

Everything was great, clear instructions & clean home. No complaints.
good stay, perfect for family
Highly recommend. Great location and exactly what we needed!
5 stars:)

Excellent accommodations and location!

The front desk service was also exceptional which helped with a smooth check in and check out process.
We will absolutely stay again the next time we are in Chicago.

We had a wonderful stay here! The location couldn’t be better — it was just a short, easy walk to Wrigley Field, which made getting to the game stress-free. We also loved being surrounded by so many restaurants, bars, and coffee shops all within walking distance. It made exploring the neighborhood super convenient. The space was clean, comfortable, and a perfect home base for our trip. We’d definitely stay again when visiting Chicago!

Evelyn is a kind and loving spirit. Her home is absolutely lovely. Super easy check in, clean space, comfy bed, and cozy environment. Rogers Park is great, and she’s close to many amenities. And her place is cost effective! Great stay overall.

Mixed review on this stay.
Pros: Close location to CTA, large space, new beds/frames, lots of couches, two big TVs, close to Kroger grocery store
Cons: Back porch was not really in good shape to use, strong weed smell in shared hallway/front porch, pool table leans so balls roll, bathroom doesn't lock; no body wash, soap, or shampoo (listing stated body soap provided) - that was a late night trip to the store on arrival; only 2 dishwasher pods for 7 ppl for 3 days, only a 1/3 paper towel roll left, no oven mitts or kitchen towels found - Extremely inconvenient to use my shirt to get hot pans out and washing dishes, outlets on new bed frames don't work, lots of plug-ins makes house too perfumed, upstairs window doesn't lock and opens onto a flat roof.

We would stay again if price was lower OR the little inconveniences can be fixed (dishwasher pods, oven mitts, shampoo/body wash).
A great place with excellent views. The apartment was super clean and well appointed, also the concierge in the lobby was always super helpful and friendly.

Jie's apartment was a great place to stay in Chicago. The location is fairly central to multiple areas of the city, so most things are just a short Uber ride away.
The apartment itself was very clean, organized, and exactly as listed. Check in was easy and pictures were provided to show where the door and the key were located. Check out was even easier than check in - all we had to do was return the key to the box - that's it!
Jie was friendly and was quick to respond to any questions I had. I would definitely stay at her apartment again on a future trip to Chicago!

John was very helpful.
The house was great and meet our needs.
Enjoyed the back deck.
Jacob made our stay in Chicago easy and we had a blast. Thank you for accommodating us!
Rodica responded quickly to questions. Plenty of street parking. Place was clean. I enjoyed my stay

Location is great and apartment was as described. Otherwise host was responsive, even allowing for a slightly delayed checkout when we were running behind.
Great stay with my friend for a long weekend in Chicago seeing friends and family. Place was perfect for us.

This was a quick weekend stay for a family get together.  Ajibade's place was clean and spacious and just as pictured on the Airbnb website.  My daughter did some cooking for the family and really enjoyed the kitchen.  Ajibade was extremely responsive.  We had a problem with the dishwasher door.   He immediately sent someone to repair it.  Location was great and was close (within 15 minutes) to many restaurants and a great grocery store.  The outdoor patio area outside of the main bedroom was amazing for ejoying the outside.  We also felt very safe walking in the neighborhood.   If you are looking for a comfortable and pleasant family friendly environment, I highly recommend this home.   We will definitely look for Ajibade's place on our return visit.

We had a great stay here! Bus stops close by and a pretty easy walk to Red Line. Everything was as described in the listing and Elaine was incredibly accommodating with an early check in on the day of our arrival. I would definitely recommend this spot to others & would stay again if we return to Chicago. Thanks so much Elaine!!
Wondering place in a great location! Spacious, comfortable and functional! Thoroughly enjoyed our stay!
Phenomenal location in a beautiful home in Lincoln Park. Gorgeous street and VERY responsive hosts!

From booking to checking out, my stay was super carefree. Everything in the description was accurate and any questions I had as a new Airbnb user were answered quickly by our host. I don't know how this place has such good reviews. It was dirty and there was so much mildew in the bedroom and bathroom that I woke up with a severe allergic reaction and had to go stay in a hotel. We couldn't find the source of the smell so I'm assuming its in the walls. The host sent a cleaner out to address the mildew and they just gave us some cans of air freshener and poured some bleach down the drain. Airbnb needed photo evidence to refund our stay and we looked everywhere for the source of the mold. There was a dehumidifier in the bathroom since there was no ventilation so the host must have known about the issue. They gaslit me about having never known about the mold and using professional cleaners, even though they bought a dehumidifier to try and deal with it. Luckily there was enough visible dust and grime to submit photos of that Airbnb refunded part of our stay and we were able to put that towards a hotel. The first day of my vacation was spent sick because of this place.

WiFi worked great, access was easy and the instructions were clear. The trains do run pretty frequently 23/7 at the height level of the apartment and they're a little noisy but none of us found it so noisy that we couldn't sleep. If you're sensitive to noise you're probably already travelling with ear plugs but if not keep that in mind. We would definitely stay here again!
The place was beautiful and perfect for a weekend getaway. 10/10 would book and stay again!
We had a great time! The kitchen was big and clean, including everything we needed. Lots of space for our group to spread out for the weekend. Would definitely recommend to stay here!
Very cozy place.
It was a great place. My cousins and I really loved it!

The place is clean enough, but there was dirt build-up in corners and around drains, for example. The toilet was hard to flush, but it does work. There are bottom sheets but no top ones. The a/c was amazing,we all slept well and the neighborhood was quiet . Only thing is I did wish the bathtub had a mat or something like it,as it does become slippery when you shower .Other than that it was a lovely home.

Host was awesome , super responsive, supportive and welcoming. Nice smart beautiful home. I will give this place 10 stars.

We had an awesome stay here! There were 8 of us and the house more than accommodated our group. It looked just like the pictures and was a perfect place to stay for our Chicago experience. We would definitely look at staying here again if we are traveling to the area! Thank you!
We had a wonderful weekend at The Beach House! It is a wonderful location! In the scenery was great! Close to everything that we needed! I would highly recommend Isa’s place! Thank you so much!!

nice house would for sure stay again.

You can tell the host puts a lot of effort into making a home away from home. Our host was super responsive and helpful throughout our trip. I very much so enjoyed our stay at Luisa's place. Great location. Very clean.

Nice space for 2. It is one of 3 units for rent in the building, which is attached to the back of a salon. Close to transit stations and a 25-45 minute drive to downtown, depending on traffic. Friendly neighbors and an easy-to-reach host.

I’d definitely recommend this spot to others visiting Chicago.
Great location, host was great. Check in and out was very smooth.

the Kasa folks were exhaustive in their instructions and had a home that looked and felt great to be in. Great location. Quiet neighborhood, close to the blue line. Everything we needed for a family trip.

Would highly recommend. Peaceful home and clean place to stay. Water pressure is a little low in the showers and parking can be a hassle at night. Those were not a dealbreaker for me still had a great experience!

Jordan’s place was the perfect spot for us to stay. Right around the corner from some great restaurants and bars and walkable to the nearest light rail into downtown. Stayed for 3 nights at Ying's place while I was at a conference. Listing/photos met expectations well, and Ying was very responsive to messages. Some neighbor noise, but not much from outside. I did struggle with the beds and the linens. I like a heavy blanket, and I toss and turn in my sleep. The thicker blankets slip right off the sheets. I also slipped and nearly fell getting in and out of the shower twice, once because the small plastic bar in the shower came loose. That and the stairs would make me discourage someone who has balance issues from staying here.
All told, this is a solid choice if what you need is a crash pad!

Kyle was great. Very responsive to my questions and I was greeted with warmth and hospitality that made me feel right at home.

Excelente ubicación para moverte en transporte público, el vecindario es muy tranquilo, estás cerca de estaciones de metro así como paradas de autobús, el lugar cuenta con todo lo necesario e indispensable, desde lavadora, secadora, ropa para cama y toallas, insumos para darte un baño, lavar y hacer limpieza, solo falta poner un poco de atención en cuanto a limpieza profunda, ya que había muchas zonas que tienen tiempo que no se limpian, no había el suficiente papel higiénico y nuestro último día desde las 5:00 am la persona que vive arriba hizo mucho ruido y ya no pudimos continuar durmiendo. Pero en general fue muy buena la estancia.

I would stay again.
The biggest issue was the getting in. I may have missed it, but the check in instructions should include a note to enter at the rear from the alley. I never could figure out how to get in from the front. I am slow so took me awhile to try the alley.
The unit would easily sleep 4+, every thing inside was serviceable, but it is an updated walk in basement apartment. The plumbing is loud, not just ours also the upstairs because, well ... gravity. It was not too bad, but our first morning it did wake me up.
Beds were good, but the front room had LOTS of glowing things, lights, flashing power supplies, I was able to turn off the biggest one, but others just had to try to hide from line of sight.
Parking was great once I found it. We did not have the nicest car so felt very safe in that regard :)
Again, would be delighted to use this unit in the future.

This was the perfect spot for a quick stay in Chicago. Great location in a quiet neighborhood where it was much easier to find parking than many other parts of the city. The apartment matched my expectations and seemed to have every amenity I could need. I also enjoyed being able to wash and dry my clothes before departing - great feature! I'd stay again in the future.
Jason had an immaculate and great unit. Would stay with him again anytime.

We had a good stay at the property which is closely located near the university as we wanted. There were few issues with the curtain rod and towel hook breaking during our stay. It was looked into by the host by sending the handyman. The handyman left the repaired area dirty .
The place overall was lovely and I would choose this again in the future.
me & my sister came got a weekend get away. the house was beautiful, the other guest were very nice. We enjoyed our stay & would definitely stay again! Thank you guys so much☺️

We had several issues which caused us to have to check out earlier than anticipated and find alternate accommodations. Victor and Cody did communicate quickly with us, however the multitude of issues at the property simply could not be resolved while we were there, forcing us to end our stay. With the maintenance required to bring the property back to reasonable standards, this would be a great place to stay. It is spacious and in the heart of Wrigleyville making it very walkable and a great location to explore the best neighborhoods in Chicago. Before booking I would recommend verifying that necessary furniture replacements have occurred and repairs have been made and verified by the owners or a qualified property manager. I wish this had happened before our stay because we would have loved it here.
Vairrun’s place is huge—4 bedrooms over two floors, so a large family won’t be cramped. Easy walk around the neighborhood and close to the L
Great place.

My third stay at this property, it is perfect for the price you pay for what it is. An attentive and respectful host, Josh was flexible with my check in times and ensuring we had everything we need. A better budget bed and breakfast would be hard to find!
部屋は広く、バスルームも含め綺麗に整えられていて、シーツなどのリネンもとても清潔で快適な滞在でした。
If you're taking in  Cubs game this is a great spot. Definitely being coming back.
El sitio excelente igual que la habitación cocina baño y todo en general, Guillermo muy amable y atento cuando vuelva hay llegare quedó muy agradecido

Ce logement est l’endroit idéal pour rester à Chicago.
Le quartier de Wicker Park est tellement vivant et agréable !
Tout proche du loop (15 minutes en métro).
Tout est à proximité (cafés, restaurants etc etc)
Le garage pour laisser sa voiture est un vrai luxe !
Nous reviendrons !
Cinq étoiles !
Great stay and excellent support

The space had everything we needed, clean and so many tea choices! It was close proximity to the green line rail station which made a quick commute to navy pier/millennium park. It was also an easy walk to field museum and the Shedd.

Leslee is an amazing host and we had a great stay! The apartment was exactly what we were looking for  during our long stay in Chicago. It is close to the Uni and a 20 min walk to the lake. Leslee made us very comfortable and also provided a well stocked pantry which was such a lovely gesture! Thank you for hosting us Leslee! We shall be back during our next visit to Chicago!
I personally wouldn’t go back. Felt like I wasn’t going to make it out!!

Great stay for a working trip in a beautiful
Neighborhood
Would recommend highly for some e who want to be by the park and lake

We did not have a pleasant stay here. There were several maintenance issues that should have addressed prior to our stay. The apartment is beautiful and looks just like the photos, but the things that can't be seen in photos and need to be addressed are a broken toilet seat in the guest bedroom, a slow draining shower, loose shower door handle, a very squeaky primary bed frame and windows without handles for closing. When we arrived multiple windows were open and none of them had handles for closing. We struggled to get the windows closed and some we could not.
There were no hand towels for the bathrooms and barely enough silverware/dishes for a family.
The host was slow to respond. It took 18+ hours for a response when we had wi-fi issues and the primary fan control was missing. They offered to bring an extra remote, but it never happened and there is still no response to my last message 2 days before check-out, asking when the remote would be dropped off.

This was an extremely comfortable place to stay. It was clean with well thought out attention to detail. It is a wonderful older home that has been well cared for. The kitchen has been remodeled and updated with new appliances, cabinets and everything you would ever need. It has a wash machine and dryer and the wonderful parking space! It is walkable to restaurants and grocery stores. Best of all were the hosts. Mary Beth and Thomas were quick to respond to all my questions. They have super host status for a reason. Definitely 5 stars.

I really liked this Airbnb. 10/10. You don’t need to bring anything except toothpaste and your toothbrush.
Everything is here. Lots of pillows, clean, comfortable bed, safe neighborhood, easy to get in, host was very friendly. Would definitely stay here again and would recommend to friends.
This was the second time I stayed here.Once again I enjoyed my accommodations.Alvenna was a wonderful host and very people friendly.The overall location was centrally to numerous attractions

PROs: The bathroom in this place was nice and the kitchen was also solid/functional. There is also a good amount of living space. The host was very responsive and polite, and provided recommendations. Overall the place was clean, and it was convenient that we didn’t have to do much work for checkout.
CONs: The place does look a bit nicer/polished in the photos than in real life. We had some issues with the doors/handles with this place as well as they are older and require you to hold the handle in a specific position to lock. One of the kitchen windows near back door doesn’t actually lock. The floors are really squeaky, which didn’t go well keeping a baby asleep. The back bedroom (towards kitchen) had a considerable amount of AC condenser noise. The front bedroom obviously has street noise from montrose. It looked like you couldn’t control the thermostat past 11:30pm.
Location was what we needed overall but I think this place is more suited for adults due to the noise/doors/locks
Nice place. As described. No issues at all. Would recommend.
thanks Anny!

Great accommodation for groups in a vibrant neighborhood of Chicago! We hosted a work offsite here, and there was lots of room for collaboration and hanging out! The apartments were also clean and well furnished.
Very clean, and had everything I needed.
Very good location with beautiful views of the city! I would definitely recommend it to anyone.

For a 2 bedroom 2 bathroom apt it’s worth the price 2x over. The patio is 420 friendly so that’s a plus (great vibe too). 5 min walk from a corner store, Ubers are inexpensive due to Michigan Ave shooting straight up though the city
Yanko accommodated my very early arrival. Pleasant, quiet apartment. I ate and drank like a king while walking everywhere.
Fantastic space for the price, super comfortable, and a great location with tons of fun spots within walking distance.

Our stay at Jim’s condominium on the University of Chicago campus was absolutely perfect. The location couldn’t have been better—everything was just steps away, including our son’s dorm, which made move-in so convenient. The condo itself was spotless, very comfortable, and ideal for a family stay.
Jim was an outstanding host—always communicative, friendly, and made us feel as if we had known him for years. His warm hospitality truly elevated our experience.
We highly recommend this place to any family visiting UChicago. Thank you, Jim, for making such an important moment for our family feel so smooth and welcoming!

Spacious and fun Airbnb for large groups! The basement provided ample entertainment, and there was enough space for everyone to hangout and sleep comfortably. The area is also vibrant and offers easy access to Wrigley!

Great location, clean and comfortable. Really nice kitchen! Communication with the host was great.  Minor things to point out were the beautiful ceiling lamp didn’t work, the smoke alarm was hanging from the ceiling which was kind of scary and the AC was very laud. Other than that all great!
Fantastic customer service. Contact immediately resolved a miscommunication about check-in. I truly appreciate their responsiveness, flexibility and high level of customer service.
Tejal's place was perfect! Close to everything in Chicago and very walkable. Easy instructions to enter and very homie.  Great bed, open kitchen and comfy couch. oh and the big beautiful window!
Everything exactly as described.  I was provided very clear directions on accessing the home and everything was just perfect

This was exactly what we needed. Very convenient location to lots of areas within Chicago, close walking distance to restaurants and attraction. Jonathan was very proactive in his communication and instructions were easy to follow.

Great house! Uber drivers had some trouble with the drop off (and multiple Uber drivers had an issue) so be aware of that. Once we oriented ourselves, we found the Stadium Suite off Google Maps walking GPS. The front gate did not completely close, but the front door lock code worked great. Great neighborhood, directly across from Wrigley Stadium. Lots of things to see and do within walking distance. The rooftop information was misleading to us. We thought we had access to the rooftop bar to watch the game. That is a separate purchase price, not associated with the rental. Ownership was very responsive, and the house was stocked with the basics we needed. Overall - great rental and enjoyed Chicago very much!

When I originally booked I did read some reviews about the area being “unsafe”. There was not a single moment where I felt unsafe. The neighbors were very friendly and it was a beautiful area with convenient parking on the street ANY time of day. The area was super accessible and near highways. Aside from Kirsten being an amazing host and leaving very clear instructions with recommendations of what to check out in Chicago. The apt. was very clean and the space was so warm and inviting. It made me and my friend feel at home. One of the light bulbs went out in the bedroom and Kirsten was so responsive and got bulbs delivered ASAP. Overall I would absolutely recommend this place to anyone and if this space is available when I come back to Chicago I plan on staying here again.

Perfect in every way. Caryl is a superstar host and her house is gorgeous inside and out. This was our second stay and the room was clean, well stocked and beautiful. I can't recommend highly enough!!
Everything was clean, comfortable and other guests were polite
extremely comfortable place! he was so helpful and the neighborhood was so lively on the weekend!

Great stay! The location near Wrigley Field is perfect, steps from public transit, grocery stores, bars, and restaurants. The host was super responsive and helpful, and the price is excellent for the area. Highly recommend!
Great stay! The house was comfortable and beautiful, and the host was very responsive.
Heel fijn verblijf gehad, appartement is precies zoals omschreven!

OK. I lied.
George's place wasn't great. It was absolutely beyond expectations. It was better than home. Such a cozy and gorgeous home. Makes me wish ours was as clean and lovely - with enough items to make it personable and inspire improvements at home (like adding such an amazing faucet to our kitchen)! Despite being in a major city it was quiet and the bedding so comfortable!
Having extra touches - like Starbucks coffee pods, tea, Mrs. Myers hand and dish soaps, as well as epsom salt for the bath really makes a huge difference. We're now sitting in a smaller unit (1 of us had to leave early) and it feels crappy and cheap compared to what we just left!
So many great places were in walking distance - Whole Foods, the Post Office, great roof top bars and a drug store. Everything else seemed to be within a 15 minute Uber.
I'm not sure we will ever need 3 rooms again, but if we do and come back to Chicago - we are going to book again.

A cute but dilapidated apartment in need of major renovations. Awesome neighborhood, very walkable. Guessing it may not be suitable to be rented as a regular unit?
Host (Ainana) NEVER responded to any message (simple questions like where is the plunger of if early check-in would be at-all possible).
She would leave us on read and ignore the questions. Found that very rude and in contrast to past reviews. Maybe something happened to the person hired to handle customer service?? Very strange and unprofessional
I would not recommend booking this for any reason other than it was a more affordable option + nice neighborhood. The host needs to be more responsive and not leave guests on read every time.
Great spot. Great host. Whole process was super easy! Would definitely stay again.

location so close to the pink line was perfect.  here for the weekend of Riot Fest and was a 12-minute walk to the entrance, so no crowded trains paying a fortune for Uber or a a pedicab.  for those that love their coffee, there's one nearby coffee shop.   Walking distance restaurants are predominantly Mexican, but very good.  The only caution I would give is that the very old stairs to the second floor are kind of wonky.
Great location near the blue line and great setup with games for my 5 and 10 year old to enjoy when we weren’t out exploring the city!
Great location & was exactly as listed

This place was PERFECT!!! If you are going to a Cubs game, this is the spot!!! We were literally steps from Wrigley. No trains, Ubers, taxis or buses to get there. The house was super clean and smelled good. Restaurants all around us and everything in walking distance. The host was super responsive and communicated very quickly. I have zero complainants we will definitely be back.
I loved this place I will recommend it to anyone I know, traveling to Chicago soon! Made me feel just like I was at home !

We had a fantastic stay at Shimmy & Dvora’s place! The apartment was spotless, comfortable, and had everything we needed, from the Pack ’n Play to kids’ toys and books, which made traveling with little ones so much easier. Communication was quick and friendly, and check in was simple with the smart lock. Parking was free and easy right outside, and the location was perfect for getting around Chicago. We truly felt at home and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!

I had a great stay at Victor’s place. The apartment is in a great location, easily walkable into the city and main attractions.
The apartment is exactly as described, clean and has amazing views. The building also has great amenities.
As a host, Victor is brilliant. Always responsive and he even sent some supplies to the apartment after some feedback, which was above and beyond what I expected. I would definitely stay at one of Victor’s properties again.
It’s been a quiet and comfortable stay at this apartment and it’s super convenient to go to the university as the bus station is very close.

Rosemary's listening was wonderful. The bed is an actual bed and not just a cheap frame: I slept so well! The porch was perfect for relaxing with my coffee and book in the morning. The house was clean and comfortable.

Had a great time and nice atmosphere, and good shower. Asked for one additional item and it was there in less than 3 minutes. Parking was on the street and had no problem parking. Unique bathroom item, got a good laugh like they did. Will keep on list the next time in Chicago.

I had a truly comfortable stay at Rebecca’s place. Beyond the space itself, I was deeply touched by a conversation we had about raising children—it gave me a lot to think about and learn from. Rebecca is a thoughtful and wise host.
Thank you for the hospitality.
great location , friendly hosts. recommended, ill be back
It’s cozy and comfy. She was very accommodating and included/ prepared for other amenities.
Larry was super responsive to my questions. It’s a great Chicago neighborhood setting and I would highly recommend it.

We were lucky enough to be staying the day that they were handing out free glizzies at the Weiners Circle so it was so fun sitting at the windows sipping coffee and people watching. That big bedroom was AMAZING! Would def recommend and hope to stay here again one day!
Laura was a great host!
I had a great stay. Peter and Lin are amazing hosts. The room is pretty comfortable and in a great neighborhood. Easy to reach public transportation too. Would recommend the room to everyone.

Nice location and great firm bed/mattress. Very spacious. Fits about 5-6 people, but with no expectation of sound privacy from anybody else in the apartment, as the walls don't go all the way up.
Noise comes easily from the street because the windows have large gaps that let in draft/noise; it's just lucky this exact street is pretty quiet after 9 PM (no trains)
Bathrooms aren't clean at all: disgusting old moldy shower curtain, dirty(probably moldy)seams, mold in a toilet bowl. Cleanliness and proper hygiene are not optional-they are the minimum standard any guest should be able to rely on. The host did apologize and responded to all our messages. Hopefully, they will hire a better cleaning crew and will fix all the issues that were mentioned.

close to public transit, stores, restaurants etc

Stayed for a couple days and host was very responsive and helpful the space was very clean and parking was very easy to locate.

Excellent budget option for visiting Chicago. The bed is very comfortable, the kitchen is fully equipped and has everything you need. The Pink Line metro is a 20-minute walk away, and buses stop nearby. Good air conditioning and communication with the owner. The Airbnb is located in a safe area, a neighborhood where the majority are Latinos. Supermarket nearby.

My stay at Charla's place was lovely. The appartement was clean and tidy, exactly like the photos. The area itself is very nice and walkable, 15 minutes away from the University of Chicago, on foot. The kitchen is fully equipped, making it ideal for longer stays. Charla was extremely helpful and friendly, helping me figure out everything I needed to get around and stay for the month. Overall, I give her my warmest recommendations and will definitely stay here when I am back in Chicago.
Hermosa casa
Great stay. We were moving our daughter into UChicago and it was a perfect landing place for us.  Beautiful home, super kitchen and quiet neighborhood. Would definitely stay again.

The parking however is kind of obnoxious. That's what really would kill this experience. Usually had to park 3+ blocks away. Walking is fine, but the listing said it had a parking garage, which is does not.
Otherwise, the unit itself was well worth it. I was not a fan of the black couch though lol just small, and not comfy. And I could've used some oven mits! Lol.
Thanks Chicago Homestay and special thanks to Linda for keeping communication smooth and being responsive!
Would not recommend a femme presenting person to walk around this neighborhood solo or especially at night. There definitely was some cat calling, sadly.
I would recommend this place.
Todo excelente, habían instrucciones para todo y de forma clara. Las fotos demuestran tal cual es el alojamiento y esta completamente equipada.

Very clean space and beautiful surrounding neighborhood. Had some soda, water, and treats for us which lasted us the entire stay. Juan was responsive when needed and had very clear instructions for check in/navigating the space. Overall, a great stay!
Peaceful place that was a 10-15min drive to downtown. Nicely decorated. Spacious kitchen and easy to use washer/dryer. Slight noise coming from upstairs but overall not an issue. Would recommend.

Looks exactly like the pictures. key's were in a lockbox, made coming and going easy. very responsive. and I can tell he's good to his other renters. early in the stay the downstairs apartment was leaking from this bathroom, he had it fixed within a couple hours. not remotely invasive, I was out when they fixed it. couldn't even tell someone was inside.
great location. pink line is within a 10 minute walk. there's an Aldi's in less distance. great coffee shop right next to the pink line.
I didn't get the chance to explore too much of the neighborhood. but walking home late at night from the train I felt totally safe.
other neighbors are also polite and considerate.
there is a unit above and below. I would hear the upstairs neighbor walking occasionally, but it's not super loud.
I would definitely recommend this spot and would 100% book it again.
oh there was coffee, tea, a coffee maker, air fryer, and kettle all in the apartment. as well as towels. well stocked.
Jose replied whenever I need. The room and bathroom were so clean. So quite. If I will visit Chicago again, I may consider to book again. Thank you Jose

Won’t stay here again. This is a whole apartment building, so basically a 92 apartment AirBnB, so it should be run like a hotel, but it’s not. It’s a cash-cow farce that smells like weed and air freshener.

Elevators were dirty and gross.

Linens were clean and nice. Beds were comfy. Felt safe. Communication was excellent.
Nice and simple stay.
Walter siempre estuvo en comunicación, el lugar está muy bien ubicado, en un vecindario tranquilo, nos gustó!

Place was really nice, felt like a home not a staged real estate open house.
Plenty of character, and anything you could need. The hosts are right there if I needed anything. Didn't get a chance to utilise the beautiful backyard space. Close to so many things. I would highly recommend.

Absolutely wonderful space. The house was clean with everything we needed, in an area with easy transportation and great food & drinks. We met Jean briefly and she was very sweet. Would definitely book here again.
Wicker Park is a great place to stay in Chicago, great nightlife and transit connections to the rest of Chicago.  Jason's place was clean and comfortable and the kitchen was well-appointed.

Evin konumu toplu taşıma araçlarına yürüme mesafesinde. Ayrıca ev sahibi, kahvaltı için olanak sağlıyor. Kendisi hemen cevap veriyor ancak 12am-8am arasında ulaşamazsınız. Basic, no frills room to sleep, shower and explore. Don't plan on spending a bunch of time in the apt, but if you just need a crash pad, this is it.
Fontanas, Joes are great.
Exactly as described, and worked perfectly for the concert we were in town for
Parking on the street. We found Parking right in front of the apartment every day. Trash can on the other side of the hallway outside the apartment.
An amazing spot near so many cute local restaurants/bars. Would definitely stay again!

Host was extremely kind and answered all of my questions promptly. Unit was mostly clean upon check-in, but the shower needs some extra cleaning/caulk because water damage was noticeable. I appreciate the extra security of the unit, it made myself and my guests feel safe. Overall decent stay.
Neighborhood was sketchy at best. Room was not up to code.
Very clean and comfortable - we will be back!
Great place and very good location. Genova was also very responsive to my questions. The area also has lots of good mexican places to eat. Bed and room was comfortable.

We had a lovely time staying with Roberto and Jim--Jim especially was very helpful in making us feel at home. Really recommend this Airbnb for anyone looking to stay in Chicago and especially in Andersonville. For larger groups, the second bed room is a little tight once the bed is pulled out (it slightly blocks the door), but we found it manageable and the Airbnb itself was clean, cozy, and very well situated.
It was such a beautiful place to stay for a girls trip, as well as a nice walking distance to the United Center!! We loved everything about the place and Nosq was so helpful with everything!

A quiet and comfortable basement apartment with all the luxuries of home! Darryl was a super helpful and responsive host and gave us lots of great local recommendations. We appreciate the hospitality and would love to return when back in the Hyde Park area. Thank you, Darryl!
Easy to find, nice area and close to transport. Rooms were neat and tidy.

Sheldon’s property was immaculate, spotless, and cozy. Communication was prompt, clear, and friendly throughout. Sheldon himself was warm, welcoming, and incredibly helpful.
The neighborhood is quiet, safe, and peaceful, perfect for relaxation. Very close to the university, very convenient for those who go & visit.
A truly wonderful stay, highly recommended for sure!

Good place for a short stay if you have a car. The area is walkable but a car is needed to get around more neighborhoods. The hosts were very kind and the space was well maintained. This is a basement unit so would keep in mind that the ceilings are rather low. Good stay overall!
Very clear directions.  Very attentive and flexible. Location was close and near a so much.

Bien en general, Joseph amable y pendiente.

Stayed a week in Chicago, and Melvin’s place was high quality, comfortable, and in a calm neighborhood. Melvin was a great host; he gave many recommendations, and was willing to accommodate our requests, which we greatly appreciated. We have decided that his place is our new spot for bnb stays in Chicago :)

This Airbnb was everything we had hoped for!, Close to everything, extremely clean, had all the bedrooms and privacy we wanted. Felt very secluded, and we loved the balconies, especially with the views of Lake, Michigan, and downtown! we will gladly stay here again, as it was such an amazing experience!
This stay was perfect! It was a very nice space and I had an amazing stay for my girlfriend birthday. Love this area of Chicago. Lobby and surrounding area very nice.
The place was very cleaned and worked well for what we needed.
For the price we paid for this unit, I have no complaints. The neighborhood it is in is fine, but it does become quite dead at night. Probably best for people with cars.

Leonid and his girlfriend were very helpful with my stay. Their place is well kept and the room is exactly how it was in the pictures. The bathrooms were very clean and the other guests were respectful and kind. The area is not the best, so be vigilant/don’t be stupid, but the accommodations were good for my needs.

I absolutely loved staying with Sharon and her fur babies! Sharon is a friendly and thoughtful host. The room is cozy and I had everything I needed for a weekend visit. The neighborhood felt safe and was very walkable. I'd happily stay again!
No problems checking in, place was as described in neat and orderly, recommend recommended host
Decent place for the price.
Great stay, very clean, we appreciated the snacks and kitchen items provided! Walkable to several restaurants, bars, and vintage shops, plus it was down the street from a bus stop.
We loved our stay, very nice area and very nice place to stay. We would love to stay again in the future! The hosts were are all so very pleasant as well

We stayed at this property while working in the area and it was an excellent choice. The location was very convenient, only a short distance from our work site, which made the commute easy and stress-free.
The property itself was clean, well-maintained, and equipped with everything needed for a comfortable stay.
The host was professional, responsive, and ensured check-in and check-out were smooth. Overall, this property provided a seamless and comfortable experience, and I would gladly stay here again for future work trips

Charles was a wonderful host. He was always responsive and quick to offer support when needed. The property is as described and exactly like the pictures. It’s clean and a walkable distance from the stadium and the train station.
Just a short trip, but the location was great!
Cozy little place to stay, great service from the owners. Parking is a little tricky at night but still worth it.
The apartment was exactly as described and close to anything we wanted or needed. Great location!
Great location and responsive host.
Very Clean and well stocked place. Had snacks which came in handy due to extreme flight delays.
Jaime was always there to help!

Very happy with our entire stay with Beth. Had contacted earlier to ask about possible early check in and she was very accommodating. The location is very convenient for Pilsen, very walkable for restaurants and early morning coffee.

All in all, would repeat without question.
The BEST! We are returning guests that absolutely adore this place, the art, the location and the host! Beautiful, clean and comfortable, you will LOVE it! ❤️
great location for our event with a fabulous breakfast/brunch Mexican restaurant within walking distance. already booked the other unit for next year.

Understanding and respectful help us out with our issues and overall the say was great the house was clean the kitchen was beautiful great for hangs outs etc ! Thank you again for letting us stay with you :)

Great stay for a weekend in Chicago. Area was fine and never felt unsafe or worried at all. The neighbor was hanging out out front listening to music one of the nights which wasn’t amazing but couldn’t hear it inside and nothing the host can do about that. Would stay here again for sure
place was as described, host was responsive
Straightforward self entry and exit hostel like shared space environment in a borderline neighborhood with cameras to help security.

Milan was a great host! So responsive and helpful. The apartment looked exactly as the pictures and was so spacious for my family of four. We were very comfortable and would love to come back!
I highly recommend that guests get parking through Milan because it can be really hard to find street parking if you are out during the day coming back at night.
Michele was a lovely host. I ended up leaving early because I wanted to be closer to the city center(I didn’t have a car). Bed was super comfy!

Joannes place was a great location and great space. Will keep Joanna's place in mind for future trips for sure!
Safe neighborhood, easy walk to Logan square, and very helpful and responsive host.

Loved our stay! It was so close to everything and super cute and spacious inside! Great little place!

We stayed for a music festival and TJ's place was incredibly comfortable to come back to. There were essentially 3 keypads to get through to the apartment so that made me feel safe as well. We had a great 4 night stay here. We loved this place! It felt like staying in the home of a (very tidy) friend. I'm a sucker for well-maintained older homes, and I loved the hardwood floors, claw foot tub, and beautiful windows. Apartment was as advertised, easy check in, and Martin was very helpful and friendly!

This is a great apartment to stay in. The place is bigger than what it looks in the pictures, and the location is near many bars and stores. Claire was very responsive and attentive, would definitely recommend this place, and would totally stay here again.

I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Chicago. The bedroom I stayed in, along with the living area, was extremely clean and well-kept, which made for a very comfortable experience. One of the things I appreciated most was how quiet it was, it made for a great place to relax and get a good night's sleep.
Although there were other tenants staying at the same time, I hardly ever saw them and often felt like I had the place to myself, which was a nice bonus.
Overall, I highly recommend staying here. It’s a peaceful, clean, and well-managed space. I would definitely stay here again on a future visit to Chicago.

Valerie was the best host! Very kind and helpful and went above and beyond to make my stay memorable. The home was amazing. Very clean and spacious and decorated nicely with all of the amenities needed for your stay. The beds were comfy and there’s air conditioning throughout the house. I plan on visiting Chicago again and will book this place anytime I visit.

Joanna's place was wonderful. Easy to get to transit lines. Couple good food spots close by. Safe neighborhood. The bed was comfortable. Kitchen had all the essential amenities. Bathroom was nice and clean. Place was quiet at night so sleep was easy. My wife and I had a great weekend here. 10/10

The location is fantastic. Walking distance to shops, restaurants, and the train. Jay was very communicative and quick to respond to any questions I had. Although the place itself was clean, it didn’t feel very cozy. There was only one extra blanket in the apartment (a throw blanket on the couch). We had 3 guests and another actual blanket would’ve been nice, especially when it’s stated in the listing. For the price, I expected more. Personally, I wouldn’t stay there again but overall, it was a okay and the location is unbeatable.
super cute neighborhood!
Absolutely incredible stay at Tony’s! So much within walking distance, and our large group had plenty to do together or separately. Would love to stay here again!!!
We loved the Airbnb! Great area would stay again
Excellent apartment with pretty much everything you could ever need for a group of 3-5.  I'll be looking to rent this place again if it's available during my next visit!
Bel appartement bien équipé dans un quartier tranquille et sécuritaire, près du train (ligne bleue). Tout est neuf et c'est joliment rénové. J'y retournerais. Merci!
Overall a great spot in a gem of a neighborhood
Exactly what it group needed. Host was very friendly, proactive, and accommodating. Very much above and beyond.

Gina  not only provided a great place to stay was very responsive as well as understanding. Was visiting Chicago for a basketball championship tournament. Arrived early and was allowed to check in early which made my day transition that much easier. Especially since we had just left prac sweaty. Even allowed more time to check out which gave my teammates and myself  time to explore downtown before heading to airport….

this location is great. it’s a very nice and walkable area with very easy access to public transit as well as activities and dining right there. 10/10 location in that regard. however the bar this appartment is right over started being loud around 6am, which being above a bar we were expecting noise at night till early morning, 100% agreeable to that, but not for it to start up again so early.
I was very comfortable and at home. The right bed makes a significant difference; and, I  always slept extremely well.

The Neighborhood Hotel is in a great neighborhood with lots of good food, shopping and grocery stores nearby. Jonathan was very communicative and proactive, and all of the instructions were helpful. The beds were very comfortable and the place was very clean. There can be a lot of city noises at night, but that is to be expected in any city location, so bring earplugs if you’re sensitive to that. And yes, as past reviews have said, there are a ton of stairs to get to the top floor, so only rent here if you’re comfortable with that.

We had a wonderful time during our stay at The Burgundy. The home was absolutely lovely- beautiful inside, easy to find, arm and cozy. Near to mass transit and easy to navigate the area. We had no issues so didn’t need to contact Mr Bentley directly but I’m sure he is as wonderful as his home is! 10/10 would recommend and would stay again. Thanks so much!
Great location and space. Thank you!
Very nice place, well managed.

My friends and I were so impressed with our stay! It’s a beautiful home right across from the CTA and had all of the amenities we were looking for. Our hosts checked in regularly to make sure we felt at home and had everything we needed. We’re already talking about booking it again for our trip next year!

The space was great! really well decorated and felt very home-y. lots of good dining options around too.

Everything was so nice! I had problem with locking the door sometimes and the AC could have been cooler. Other than that very nice place!
Easy check in, easy stay. Loved the cute little back yard!

We had a great time staying at Patricia’s place in Little Italy while in town for a local Music Festival. Great location to get around the city in all directions and a wonderful neighborhood to walk around for morning coffee or a night cap at a nearby bar. Mark was awesome and very attentive host. From the road, the place is incredible outside and well kept.

Great landing pad for a long weekend festival. Very easy to get to the bus and other transportation.  Friendly neighbors and a quiet area.

We had a relaxing, seamless, easv-breezy stay. The accommodations were exactly as described, and our hosts went above and beyond to offer recommendations and make us feel welcome. High-ly recommend!
We hope to make it back someday when we have more opportunity to explore.

We had a great stay and glad to have an attentive host like Amelia. The whole unit was very clean and offered nice amenities such as extra pillows, towels, some pantry items, and unique decor for a relaxing getaway.
Host was kind and responsive. Issue finding the door to get into building. Accidentally went to neighbor’s door instead of ours, no bath towels to clean after shower.
Beautiful home, very comfortable, felt very relaxing and like being at home.  The area was so quiet
Really nice spot in a quiet and walkable area. We enjoyed our stay and the host was incredibly responsive and proactive!
Very accommodating

We had such a wonderful 4 night stay here! Marcus and Cathy were absolutely amazing. They went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed and were so thoughtful. We stayed the weekend of Riot Fest and we couldn’t have had a better airbnb in a better location. It was wonderful meeting them both and meeting others staying at the property as well. Everything was clean and perfect and we had everything we could ever need or want. Awesome location. Awesome hosts. Just a great experience all around and we are hoping to do it again next year!

It wasn’t 100% perfect, but for a quick 3-day trip, it was a good place to lay your head down and get some rest. The host is very responsive and considerate and made the stay even better. It was in Little India, and it was easy enough to uber or DoorDash when we needed. It’s an older building, but it was still pleasant.

I had a good stay at Caitlin's apartment! The location in Logan Square is fantastic; a couple blocks from the main thoroughfare means it's incredibly walkable and close to great restaurants while also being quiet and peaceful. It's a basement apartment and they keep the AC going, so it's pretty chilly down there, but I overheat easily so for me that was perfect and the space was mostly very comfortable; my only complaint in that area is that I think the apartment could really use a change of sheets. The beds themselves were actually pretty comfortable, but the sheets felt plasticky and weren't really breathable at all. Other than that, you've got a great location, rooms that are kept nice and cool, and great amenities like a washer/dryer for longer stays. I'll be keeping this apartment on my list whenever I return to Chicago next!

We loved our stay at Sara's! The location is very walkable, and it is close to the 9 and the Blue Line if you want to travel elsewhere. Wicker Park has a really cute farmers' market on Sundays, it is worth checking out if you can. There are also lots of restaurants and shops close by.
The master bedroom was quite spacious and had a lovely view of a nearby side street. Bed was comfy. The bathrooms were huge overall (not just for Chicago) and clean, with good water pressure.
We really appreciated the provided parking spot.
Sara was a great host and quick to respond if I had questions. We hope to be back!
The place was very nice and in a nice area.

Had a great stay here for Riot Fest. Space was clean, neighborhood was quiet, walkable, easy to drive through/park in, and very close to a rental bike station. Juan was also very quick to answer my questions and provide helpful recommendations.
only minor thing I'll point out, one picture shows a deck with a hot tub, but the hot tub was recently taken out, so that's no longer part of the package at time of writing. outside of that, it was a fantastic stay and I'd absolutely consider staying here again while visiting Chicago. 5/5. 👍

The unit itself was tidy and sufficient. If you are not familiar with this area of Chicago, please make sure to do research for yourself. We enjoyed our time at the townhouse. Would rent again.
Great stay, cute apartment, very clean and quiet. Definitely recommend! 👍🏼

What a great stay.  The place was exactly as expected if not even better.  It’s well laid out with different living room areas to accommodate group.  Clean with great bedrooms and baths.  Even better was Niyati’s communication and care.  Without being bothersome, Niyati was always in touch checking in as well as super responsive when needed.  Will absolutely start here when the time comes for our next visit to Chicago.
We had an outstanding time! Had all amenities and great location for everything.
Nice location, well kept and the host was very responsive. We would definitely stay here again.
Very good place for reasonable price
The space was perfect for a weekend getaway. Listing was exactly as described and extremely clean. Tracy was very friendly and responsive. I would definitely recommend.

I think it is a cute Airbnb that is almost ready to be an Airbnb! Coty is super nice and responsive, took my suggestions, quick to try and resolve any issues!
I hope they continue to update the space but for me personally, it wasn’t ready.

Had a wonderful time in Chicago for riot fest thanks to a comfortable place to get ready and unwind after a long day of music. close to the metro and plenty of parking made for a perfect spot to stay.
Wonderful hosts! If I’m ever in the area Martha’s place will definitely be at the top of my list of places to stay.
Great host, very clean home, and easy communication / process.
Beautiful place, very responsive host. Would stay again.
Jordan’s place was so great. When my flight was changed, he allowed us to check in early. He was responsive and communicated clearly. I would definitely recommend staying here!
Good spot!
such a gem - the place is beautiful, spatious, and clean. I loved the minimalist aesthetic with a tasteful decor. close to public transportation and cafes. quiet and peaceful. felt very safe.

The rental was cozy, very clean, quiet, safe, and perfect for our needs. Julie was very responsive and provided clear information about the rental.
I highly recommend this rental.

Evgenii was an incredible host! The place was always clean and the guidelines for house rules were simple and clear. The rooms were private, comfortable, and stylish. I would recommend this place to anyone looking to explore Chicago!

Very clean and quiet place. I’d stay here again if I’m in Chicago
Very nice location and comfortable accommodations. Host was very responsive, rules were reasonable, and instructions were clear. Recommend.
Great location!
Very responsive host and great space for the price! We were able to utilize public transit easily from there too!

I stayed at Ronaldo’s place when I was in town for Riotfest 2025 and I absolutely loved it! The room was so cozy and such a fun set-up, I especially enjoyed watching a movie on the projector one morning as I relaxed prior to going to the festival.
The house was spotless and super clean and had such fun colors and cool items. I also enjoyed the local coffee shops, restaurants and shops in the area - all walkable and had great vibes.
Catching public transit to the festival everyday was super easy as well!
Ronaldo was also an awesome host - super friendly and helpful (gave me so many suggestions and tips) and I always enjoyed chatting with him as he is very personable and easy to talk to!
Building and area felt safe enough to be fine walking around by myself at night.
Definitely recommend 10/10 💯
Great place!  Nice host, clean, fun decor, comfortable beds, a few blocks from train station, highly recommend!

Lovely studio apartment in a great area very clean. Had a great stay : )

We had such a wonderful stay at Noelle and Rob's house! The house is beautiful, very clean, and very comfortable. We had plenty of room to spread out. The neighborhood is lovely, very walkable, and conveniently located to public transit if you don't want to drive. The kitchen was well-stocked and we cooked most meals there. This place is a gem, and I would absolutely stay here again!
Kate’s place was absolutely amazing. Lots of space for everyone. Very clean and a great location!

This air bnb was sensational. The whole space is clean and very modern. It was neat "living" on an urban garden for a few days.
The bathrooms are updated & gorgeous. Truly one of the best features of the space.
The area isnt the greatest if you are one to walk places. We had a hard time finding walkable food options for breakfast or dinner. Additionally, the road its on is very busy and my car was unfortunately side-swipped while it was parked.
Great place! Awesome location
We loved staying at this very cute condo! The beds were comfy, bathrooms clean, and the place was very quiet considering so close to the city! Marie was absolutely wonderful. Would stay again!
We had a great stay at Scott's place. Everything was clean and tidy, instructions were clear, host very responsive, and was a great area close to public transportation. Would recommend!
it was fine

Awesome time staying at Chris’ place! Apartment was exactly as described with everything we could need. Plenty of supplies and very clean and relaxing. Amazing location even though we weren’t even in town for the Cubs but I’d definitely stay here for that in the future. Street parking was easy and we appreciated the parking passes for the neighborhood. Would stay again for sure.
Clean and comfortable space, host is very nice
Great stay, great location!

Great place to stay, the spot is in a little town outside of downtown which was perfect! Had some great breweries in walking distance and loved that we could bring our dog with us. Would totally come back!
This was a wonderful experience and I enjoyed Gais’s location and would recommend to anyone coming to Chicago

Staying at Kelly’s place was great! It’s nearby a decent amount of restaurants and things to do. It’s a cozy place as well, and the bathroom is very nice. Thank you for being quick to respond and helping!
Nice apartment, very clean. Great location
10/10, we would stay here again! The home is beautiful and comfortable! We found ourselves wanting to stay and relax instead of going out. Thank you for a great stay!!
The place was clean and just as described! Check in and check out was seamless and they were great communicators.

very kind and responsive host!

I would love to stay here again. The location was perfect for what we needed and many stores around if you forgot something. We felt safe in the neighborhood and was able to walk to some events. I will be looking into this location next year.
This was a terrific place for us to stay while visiting a festival in Douglass Park. Comfy, spacious, nicely textured. A wonderful relaxing crash pad for our group of friends. Thank you!

Absolutely loved my stay there this past weekend. The community is very close knitted with families walking their kids to school.

The place was spacious and clean, with everything you may need for a quick or extended stay.
Looking forward to staying again in the winter time! Thank y'all so much 🙏🙏🙏

I really enjoyed my stay here! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was friendly and responsive, which made everything smooth and easy. Great location too—close to everything I needed. I’d definitely recommend staying here and would book again.
Great location and very clean and space condo.

The place is nice and clean. Very well connected to different parts of the city, and has a supermarket and restaurants walking distance. Definitely would stay again. Jose was very responsive and helpful
Great place! Clean and spacious. Bryan was very responsive and was gracious enough to allow us to check in early.

It was a great stay for our family.
Thank you!

This was my sister and my second time staying at Ming's, and both times were an absolute pleasure. Ming is an incredibly communicative host, which I really appreciate, as it left me certain that if there had been any troubles with our stay (which there weren't!) she would be responsive and do her best to amend them. The neighbourhood is lovely as well and there are many delicious restaurants to eat at within walking distance. Not only would I recommend staying here, but I would happily stay here again myself.
C’était un super moment ! Des super vacances, je reconnais le logement
Valeriy's place is great, and came out handy. Perfect spot for where I needed to be, comfy, clean, well taken care of. Fully recommend and will definitely stay there again.

We visited the town for the riot fest. The location and neighborhood were great. The bus stop was right around the block, and it took us directly to the fest. We also felt safe walking around the neighborhood at night. Being from Memphis, that’s saying a lot for us! Melissa was quick to respond, super friendly, and even offered us a later check out, which was most welcome after spending all weekend on our feet at a music festival. I also appreciated having free street parking just outside the house, and the privacy gate made us feel a lot safer too.
Nice location, plenty of local restaurants nearby. Has everything you need to enjoy a quick get away. Very clean unit and priced reasonable for that area. I have no complaints 10/10
Bethany was so helpful and gracious. The apartment was ideal for us dropping our son off at college.
Comfortable place to be close enough to the city, and avoid the hectic city atmosphere for any trip. Thanks!

This was very well described and was exactly as it appears in the listing. Steve was amazing and very attentive. He was available anytime and very pleasant.
I would definitely stay again. Great restaurants and very easy to use the Chicago transit System. Very walkable and nice neighborhood. Everything we needed in the Condo and more!

Long is a very gentle and well-spoken host, he and his family embraced my arrival patiently and with a brief exchange, making my visit a welcomed  journey. The location is super quiet by nature as it is located within a dispersed  residential area. Amenities inside the property suffices a need of short-stay. Glad to be here for two relaxing nights.
The place was beautiful. The little courtyard set up was a great place to unwind after a long day

Damani was a fantastic host, very responsive and helpful, and the location is amazing, lots of walkability to restaurants and nearby entertainment.  The house was clean and comfortable.  It’s worth noting that the hot tub isn’t available during “summer”, however I would absolutely stay again and recommend to others.  Great stay!
Absolutely perfect for a long weekend. Amazing Cafe near by, easy access to public transport and Uber/lyft. Cozy, clean, great parking and 10/10 would book again!
This was a beautiful and perfect home! I stayed the weekend for a relax getaway and everything was comfy, clean and helpful guest!
Beautiful place in a great neighborhood!

We had a great stay! Centrally located to travel to and from the northern suburbs while also heading into the city. Parking spot was a bit tight for a large SUV but perfect for a car and very convenient. Very Responsive when we had any issues. Great for multi generational family such as us. We look forward to using again!

We are so glad we stayed at Molly's wonderful home. She was very welcoming and thoughtful throughout our entire trip. I can't imagine a better place to stay when visting Chicago.
Also, very imprtant, her dogs and cats are the cutest and her banana bread is sensational.

Five stars for location, size and layout, but not the personal experience I want from an Airbnb. The place was clean, nice size rooms for the city, easy keypad access in and out in a nice building.  Great neighborhood with tons to do, but a few blocks from the loudest nightlife spots which is nice.  Minimally stocked kitchen-  can cook simple things but they really only expect 4 people and should get more than 4 sets of dishes.  Read the FINE print-  they request an additional security deposit and requested this outside of Airbnb.  I was not comfortable with this and was still unable to cancel, but was able to get it processed instead through the site and received it back in a short period of time after check out.  They make you upload your ID through their property management site and your communication is through an auto response system. Only upon asking the same question multiple times do you seem to get a human to read it and answer. I prefer renting from a single homeowner.
Lois is a wonderful host, and her apartment is immaculate. We had zero issues the four nights we were there.
Good spot for walking and a 10 minute walk to subway station. enjoyed it!

The place was fantastic. Great location that was walkable to great spots and easy access to the train. Aina was easy to communicate with. I would highly recommend staying here even if you’re not going to a Cubs game.

Freddy was a fantastic host and the apartment is beautiful!  Freddy was super responsive to my communications, the space was even nicer than advertised and well worth what I paid. I would love to stay there again!

We had a great stay.
The location was perfect in Wicker - West Town with plenty of walkable shops, bars and restaurants. Place was clean and comfortable for 2 guests. Thank you.
Great location, and great host! Would highly recommend!
I would 10/10 stay here again if I was rebooking for Chicago. It wasn’t far from downtown, the train or Douglass park. Loved it.

Bella is a great host! Our flight to Chicago was significantly delayed, so we didn’t get to the apartment until very late. Bella was able to accommodate a late check-in, and even stayed up to make sure we got inside. The apartment itself was great too. I’d highly recommend staying there!

Loved this cozy little RV! This is easily the nicest RV I have stayed in. Full shower and toilet! What more could you ask for? I even have curly hair and I had no hot water issues using the navy shower method that Mimi recommended. Everything was super clean and fresh. I would definitely stay here again when I'm in the area.
The only thing that could make this place a 5 star experience is wifi. I know its probably a hassle to set up and probably requires a hot spot but I think it would be well worth it. I ended up using all my data by the end of the trip.

Our stay at the hidden gem was perfect! Close to public transport and tons of food and beverage options. The large kitchen was great for breakfasts, and the closets helped keep us nice and organized. We will hopefully get a chance to stay here again in the future!
Lydia's place was comfortable and well worth the price. We also got lucky with the people we were paired with! Oven/stove worked well.
Great location and very peaceful street. Parking was easy. Host was very responsive and thoughtful. We came for a Bears game and they had a Bears tablecloth and football decor.
Bennett and Jolin were super friendly, very welcoming hosts. The room was very comfortable. I had a wonderful stay and I highly recommend it.

Overall, this Airbnb got the job done, but left a bit to be desired in A LOT of the details, especially for the price. The furniture wasn’t the most comfortable and there wasn’t nearly enough seating in the living rooms considering the number of people the house sleeps. One of the front steps was loose, no lamps in the bedrooms, almost nowhere to hang towels, just lots of little things that could be better. It feels like it was kind of slapped together quickly with whatever things were available to provide the bare minimum. Outside of that, Dario is a good host though, very communicative and proactive. Location is solid, neighborhood is quiet and walkable.

Our family truly loved our stay at John’s place. The house  was  comfortable, and we felt right at home. We would happily stay here again and highly recommend it!

Our stay at this Chicago home was absolutely fantastic! The location is great too, and easy uber ride to River north/downtown. The house is on a calm and cute street. Alison has been very responsive throughout the trip. It’s a luxury air bnb with great coffee machines, good quality linens, soaps etc.
thank for a great stay!

Really a great place to stay for a visit to Chicago! The apartment is private, spacious, well appointed and well equipped with the essentials and some extras such as bicycles, a blender and food scale. The neighborhood is very walkable and has many options for dining and some nice pubs.

I only met Juanita once when I was coming back to the room my last night there. She was very friendly, welcoming, caring, asked how everything was going, if I was enjoying my stay, and if I was comfortable.

This Airbnb was perfect for our group of 4. The hosts were very quick to respond to any requests or outreach. The place is spacious and feels like someone’s home (not the artificial Airbnb feel some places have). The decor was really beautiful, and I would absolutely stay here again!
We visit the area often, great place to stay, easy to walk around
Great location that is close to the city. Loved the massage chair. Great surroundings!

FILTHY doors, walls, surfaces. Looks like they have never been wiped down. Mold on ceiling in bathroom. Other reviews warned of the rough neighbourhood but said it was clean. Not when I was there. Would like to post pics. Towels musty, made me wonder what else wasn’t cleaned?There’s an illusion of seeming somewhat clean because the newer fixtures & floors. Kitchen, common space seemed fine. People hanging on the street asking “what’s in your bag?? Where you going”. There were maybe 10 guys & it was very threatening.
