Please invest in a cleaner to improve value. The host & price were PROS. I would suffer the location & stay again if only it was clean. Very disappointed

We stayed here during Riot Fest, this being our fifth trip and fifth airbnb we’ve used. This has to be the best location we’ve stayed in so far! Super walkable to any bus stops or train stations to get around the city, and walking distance from the after shows we went to at the Bottom Lounge and Cobra Lounge. On top of it, the place was nice, clean, and Ninoc was an excellent host. Would absolutely stay here again!
Liked the unit. Had a nice stay. Was close to every thing I needed to do.
Jonathan was very responsive and always helpful if I needed something. The place seemed newly renovated!

Mary's place was just as described with easy access to a range of buses. The restaurants and bars around the flat are wonderful, popular but not loud, and the flat was very peaceful.
I felt very safe as a solo traveller and the neighbours were also very nice and welcoming.
Mary was responsive and flexible and I would definitely recommend her place and her as a host.
Beautiful and safe inside. Great place to stay on a budget with easy access to the blue line.
Great safe location, very responsive and clear with instructions. I would say if you never visited north Chicago it’s a great place to stay clean and safe.
Beautiful and spacious home. Wonderful rooftop with a great view.  Precisely the kind of place we needed for the long weekend!

My wife and I stayed here for the Riot Fest.  The location is perfect for catching a quick Uber to the park.  Location has easy parking and is also a quick Uber trip from downtown.  This place is fantastic.
Milan was super responsive and would check in throughout our stay! Beautiful views and spacious space.

The stay was very welcoming and clean the cleanliness hit you soon as you walk in. The location was perfect 10 to 15 minutes tops to all destinations we had and that was with traffic.  The only downfall of the trip was having to be responsible for the house key during the stay but that was small to a giant I highly recommend you book this place if you’re looking ..
This place perfectly met our needs and was very comfortable. Oba was very responsive and helpful in letting us drop bags early. We'd definitely stay there again.
Jasmine was fantastic.Communicated with me frequently. Stayed 3 nights for festival and walked everywhere. Will definetly stay again when I am in Chicago.
The place worked out great for what we needed. We'd go back there again.

My brothers and I visit Chicago yearly for a race and this is by far the best stay we have had. The place was spacious, clean, and very comfortable. Great location. just a couple blocks from grocery stores and the bus line. Oscar was extremely nice and easily available for the key pick up and drop off. 100% recommend.

🚨 PUBLIC WARNING: This rental is filthy, unsafe, and a serious privacy risk — do NOT book. 🚨
ZERO STARS if possible. The photos are misleading—this unit is filthy and unsafe. The building and unit reek of must and mildew. Floors were damp, dirty, and uneven, with beetle-like bugs crawling in the basement. Bathrooms looked okay at first, but toilets had specks under the lid, the shower had soap scum and spider webs, and worst of all, a bathroom window with no curtain exposed the shower to the outside—a major privacy violation. Towels and washcloths were insufficient. The basement staircase was dangerously small and uneven, forcing you to duck and risking falls. Several doors inside the unit led to strange, unsafe areas. This unit is a safety nightmare and a firefighters worse nightmare. The host’s attitude matched the condition—unhelpful and unprofessional. Do not be fooled by the pictures. This place is unsanitary, unsafe, and not worth your money.
Great location! Very responsive and excellent communication!
The place was perfect for what I needed, plenty of space, plenty of parking, located perfect to where I was going while in Chicago

We had a fantastic stay! The location was perfect—just a 25 minute walk to our festival, which made everything super convenient. The house was spacious and comfortably fit our group. Parking was never an issue, with plenty of space for all of us. Fresh towels were provided, and the home was fully equipped with everything we needed for our stay. Overall, it was the ideal spot for our trip, and we’d definitely stay here again!
Everything was great except the door throughout the stay kept locking us out even though we were putting in the correct passcode

My stay here was really enjoyable, and I’d definitely recommend it. The neighborhood is quiet, but it’s just blocks from lots of nightlife and restaurants. There’s easy/convenient access to public transit. There’s lots of shops, a mini Target (which is really convenient), a full grocery store close by, and lots of gyms to choose from.
The apartment itself was nice. It has a full kitchen that’s fully stocked enough to cook most meals. There’s a blender and toaster oven, which made breakfast easy.
Andrew was a responsive and helpful host, and I wouldn’t hesitate booking here again.
Our family enjoyed staying here we will definitely be back when we are in the area. Thank you
Great spot and Patricia was a great host. Would recommend!
She was friendly in dealing and provided me with all possible facilities. The house is very quiet and I did not encounter any disturbance. Thank you Tracye

We absolutely loved your place, the location, and everything about it!!!
Thank you for letting us stay in your home!!

⸻
The whole place is cozy and homey. It’s clean and well-kept. The hosts are accommodating and addressed our concerns promptly. However, the shower heater tends to go on and off, so it’s difficult to use continuously. We were traveling as a group of four, which might have contributed to the heater issue.
adeline was amazing and communication was outstanding she made sure we had everything we needed
Amazing stay!
Alles super, genau wie beschrieben. Sehr hilfreich und schnelle Antworten  bei Fragen. Danke
Felt right at home. plenty of room. loved that it had a bags game there to play with. Thanks again for the lovely stay.

Our stay at Cilmars was exactly what we were looking for. We felt very relaxed in the living space and had all we needed .  The home was a convenient and comfortable place to sleep while we enjoying our time exploring the city.  We parked across the street and felt safe walking to the entrance. The host was very responsive before and during the stay even responding at late hours when we had trouble with our gps finding the correct location.  We would love to stay here again!
It was pretty great! Walter always stayed consistent in his response times, and I appreciate him giving a quick run down of the place and how everything works!

The Airbnb was absolutely beautiful and perfect for my family. It was spacious and big enough for everyone to sleep comfortably. Evan was extremely helpful and very responsive throughout our stay, which made everything so smooth. Highly recommend you’ll love your stay here.
We had a nice stay!
Wynter was extremely responsive and very helpful whenever we had questions. The area was quiet and easy to get around. Would *highly* recommend
Great place for one or two guests. The rooftop private deck is the best part. The apartment is clean, modern and comfortable.
Great place to stay at
Perfect base for exploring the city, close to subway. The place was clean, well-maintained, and made my stay enjoyable.
Very clean spacious and definitely priced what it’s worth, amazing host
My stay went so smoothly and I felt welcomed.

What a gem! Walkable to the Ashland orange line CTA stop. The place was very tidy and the room was cozy. The bed is one of the most comfortable beds I have slept on in an Airbnb. If you want a good coffee before starting your day in the city, walk to Control Z coffee a few blocks away. They offer Ube style pastries and great coffee. Plus, it supports local businesses. Can’t wait to stay again!
Easy, clean, and good location
great neighbor near the university and a reasonable walk to the lake.

Robert & Sue’s house was spacious, well appointed and perfect for the five of us. It’s walking distance from a great coffee joint (recommend by Myka), a bowling alley, brewery/distillery, and so many other things.
Their kitchen is well appointed if you’re into cooking—and there’s a great hang room on the bottom level.
Ten out of ten would recommend, and hope to be back again sometime! Thank you Robert, Sue, and Myka!
Todo bien con el alojamiento. Atentos y la llegada totalmente autónoma nos ayudó mucho porque llegamos de madrugada.

The unit is comfortable and met my basic needs during my stay. Guests should be aware that it is an older property, so there is some noise from thin walls, squeaky floors, and footsteps from the upstairs unit. The location is a bit removed from main attractions, which may require additional travel time. Overall, it’s a suitable option depending on your priorities.
Very nice spot in a good location with parking!  Recommend.

Everything was good no issues! There could be a spider infestation or maybe because no one visits the home often. We killed atleast 10 spiders I recommend getting house sprayed. Also the couch is broke, it stills pull out but left side is leaning just to be aware. The couch was like that before we got there. Other than that I loved it and the front yard is very cute. Thanks for having us, and we appreciate you letting us stay 2 hours after check out so we wouldn't be at airport all day!
This was a great Airbnb for me and my friends great area and was close by a lot of restaurants and bars!

We had a great stay at this rental! The place itself was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed for a relaxing visit. Check-in was smooth and the home was just as described. The only downsides were that the washcloths and towels felt a bit dingy, and the neighborhood looked a little sketchy at first impression—but we had no issues and felt safe the entire time. It would also be nice to have some balcony furniture to enjoy the outdoor space. Overall, a wonderful stay and we’d definitely recommend it with just a couple of small improvements!
Really nice host, super helpful and friendly.

Samoane was a wonderful host. She was communicative, responsive, and helpful. The apartment was spacious, clean, and well-appointed--the host clearly thought of everything, from the coffee station to the board games. I enjoyed relaxing on the back porch with a cup of coffee and a book, before taking a quick a drive into downtown Chicago to explore the sights. I will definitely book again!

We had a slight issue with the electricity going out but Oluwatosin responded immediately and called the building maintenance. The issue was fixed within the hour and it did not affect our stay as we were in and out doing things around the city. The provided parking spot was a plus in the decision to book this specific location. Would definitely stay here again.
Henok’s place is stunning, a true Gem with Bronzeville. He is a great host looking forward to staying again.

Outdoor patio is an amazing place to hangout especially at night. For our conference (McCormick Place) it was SUCH a great location to stay as it was only a couple of blocks away. Highly recommend this location. Easy to get in and out of. Can rent several rooms for overly large groups. And the host is quick to respond whenever there are questions and very patient when wanting to work through things.

I loved the place
Looked like the photos
Located in a beautiful area

This place was convenient for the price.  It was very clean and comfortable.  It was walking distance from the green line el train.  There are a lot of Divvy bike stations around.  This neighborhood is close to Hyde park and the Lakefront Trail, but there is not much in the immediate vicinity.  The only negative for me was the lack of a small kitchenette with a sink.

Great location! The rooms looked like the description and our host was responsive and helped make our stay seamless. Would recommend, especially for the good price.
We were on the fourth floor so just be aware there isn’t an elevator if needed

Daran’s place was perfect for our recent week in Chicago. It was spotless and exactly as described. We had everything we needed and Roscoe is a fantastic neighborhood. My favorite part was the balcony overlooking the stunning courtyard. Thank you for the hospitality!

Nice AirBNB in walking distance from numerous restaurants / coffee / desserts. Also walking distance from the National Museum of Mexican Art, which I highly recommend. No traffic noises or loud neighbors. It was pretty quiet. Love that there was a washer and dryer if needed. I would stay here again. We love the Pilsen district! Host gave us numerous recommendations for food, which we explored with no regrets.
Everything was excellent, good communication and the place was totally comfortable.
Great place to stay! It was clean, nice neighborhood, and had the necessary amenities. House rules were simple and easy to follow.

We had a great stay! This apartment is in a great location - super cool spot near some great restaurants and the lake. We thought it was going to be a little bigger based on the pictures and had to deal with some noise from a nearby apartment, but overall we had a good time :)

Started with the wrong foot as the host failed to send check in instructions. When initially attempting to establish contact, she was unresponsive, unfortunately. However, once we were able to connect, the host was nothing short of proactive and very responsive. Based on how well she recovered, it seems that she was just having an unfortunate emergency and thus was unable to respond at the time we were attempting to connect when checking in. Still, she was apologetic and made no excuses.
Other than the unexpected delay, the stay very easy and a great experience. Will definitely book again in our next trip to Chicago.

Our stay was a lost for words. How to describe our stay, and sum it up in just one word, would be more than Amazing!!! Charles was probably the best host I ever had. My significant other and I do many airbnbs when we travel it's either him or I booking and have had good service, but this one made us feel welcomed as if we were more than just a guest but as a friend coming to stay at his beautiful flat. He was welcoming, attentive, and gave great recommendations. This is a place I can see staying again if we have another family mini vacay. Thank you to Charles for making us feel right at home away from home. 🙂

Our stay was great! Jerome communicated with us a lot during our stay, and was helpful in giving us info about the place and area. Bed was comfortable and the place had a lot of space. Getting in + out was easy, too.
Great stay
This home was spotless, easy to find, and very spacious. I hope to stay again in the future.

"We had a wonderful stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-located. Connor was very responsive and helpful when we needed answers, which made check-in and communication easy.  We definitely would recommend and stay again and loved the ambiance of this home and area!"

Very cool place in a great neighborhood of Chicago.  Safe, walkable, with many great restaurants and bars around.  Loved that there's a secret door down to the lower level.  Kitchens were well-stocked and spotless.  The downstairs bathroom has a bidet, which was a nice surprise.  Would definitely stay here again.

Logan’s place was gorgeous! As a host, he was extremely flexible with our check in time, and very responsive to all of our questions. The neighborhood is adorable and very easy to walk to restaurants, etc.
Would love to stay again next time we are back in Chicago.
Awesome house and David was extremely communicative and helpful

If you’re looking for a local Chicago experience, this is the place. I see some comments that people say that it’s dirty is not dirty clean the only thing that kinda giving New York apartment vibes but  I love that.

We had a great stay. The view from the unit were spectacular. The location is in a walkable area with easy access to great restaurants and the aquarium, planetarium and museum. The staff were very very friendly and helpful. We asked for a replacement for a broken vacuum cleaner in the unit and that was done in the span of an hour!. Front desk staff were delightful. Joy was very pleasant and helpful. The amenities were nice and well maintained. It is certainly pricy, but it is worth it specially with the high floor, views, and the ability to use all building amenities. Would certainly go back again.
Neighborhood was great and walkable. Stayed for a Sox game and it was easy to get to the stadium.
Nice & clean apartment, good location, easy free parking.

Great place to stay. Easy to get a driving service to get around if you don't want to drive. Place looks like just the pictures and it is beautiful and welcoming inside. Beds are comfortable and welcoming. Just wish there were more towels. That is my only complaint lol. Great host and place to stay.

Stayed at this wonderful AirBnB for a Chicago Girls Trip and it was amazing! The location was quiet and usually only a 15-20 minute uber ride into the city. The space looked EXACTLY like the pictures…honestly they didn’t do it justice! The accommodation were great, clean, and made us feel right at home. The host was very responsive before and during the stay. I frequent Chicago a lot with family and friends and look forward to staying again!
Close to airport
Everything was perfect & my host made sure I needed for nothing 5* for everything will be back.
very clean, quiet, and with the CTA super close making it easy to get around
The place felt like home.  Very spacious and clean. Distance to downtown was manageable. The surrounding felt safe and clean.
Great place

Place is bright, spacious & as listed. Great spot for my adult kids and I to stay for my daughter's wedding celebration at Le Loft. The space was quiet, private, with plenty of room for us.
Nicky is a great host, and when we had a couple snafus (not enough towels for all guests, oven not functioning) she took care of things as quickly and well as possible. When oven didn't function during our stay, Nicky made things right for us and was a perfect host.

NOTES: TV requires ROKU app on phone. Few conveniences missing so be sure to ask for extra linens, paper towels, tp, etc if you have more than 2-4 ppl in your party.
Kitchen was big but missing some things for actual food prep (knives, cutting boards) but had lots of 'essentials' (plates, cups, bowls, etc).
Owner of the building lives across the hall and is a super cool guy! He stopped by and gave a little history of the building and his reno of it during covid. It is truly an awesome space with a great vibe and character.
Joseph ? More like brosef. Cause my man hooked it up

Asif made our trip to Chicago a breeze! The street is quiet and safe, the room and bathroom were clean and comfortable. Most importantly Asif was extremely helpful with parking, which can normally be very stressful after a long day of travel. Everything about this stay was perfect. Worth every single cent. If possible, I plan to stay with Asif again next time I visit Chicago.

The place was so clean!!! Spacious !!! The host was super sweet and responded greatly, even gave me a token for my birthday and I couldn’t have been more appreciative! I wish I had more time to just hang with my friends in the house
We had a great time staying at this place. Thanks Jake!
Anny was a great host and was very communicative during our stay.  This place accommodated our needs and was clean and comfortable.

The home was decent for what we needed it for. The beds were comfortable, very clean space and very responsive owners. There were a few issues though. The unit is underneath another apartment, & you hear EVERYTHING that upstairs does. On one night, it was just non-stop noise until about 2am. Hosts were helpful in their responses, but the unit above didn't seem to take the message. Getting in is a bit of a challenge if using the parking in back, as there is no way to get inside from the back entrance when the AirBnB is locked. We had to find our way in-betwee the houses in the dark in order to get to the front, or the other option was to walk to the end of the alley and come back up the street. Street parking is only by permit, and was not aware of this until arriving to AirBnb. Lastly, there was a rule about not leaving food on the counters and you can only leave it in the fridge, and this was a rule we were not made aware of until check in. A bit of a challenge when bringing own food.

Kate’s place is in a great location to nearby restaurants and is walking distance to the beach. It was extremely convenient staying here. Kate was responsive with all questions and had extra toiletries and water bottles readily available in the hallway area.
Heather's place was perfect for the 4 of us.  The interior is stylish and comfortable, the neighborhood is walkable, parking was easy, and she was easy to communicate with.

Don's house is in such a beautiful neighborhood and was clean and comfortable.   So many great places to walk within ten minutes.    We would definitely stay here again.    Don has taken very good care of the place!

Shamir
Great host, easy checking in. Great communication!
Jerry’s place was clean and much more spacious than it looks in the pictures. Jerry was polite and helpful. All in all a great place to stay
Very cozy home. Carol was very polite and responsive! Would definitely book again in the future!

We had a wonderful stay at Diana’s place! Diana is a great host and her charming apartment was perfect for our stay in Logan Square. The primary suite is quite impressive and the walk-in closet was a dream, perfect for a longer stay! We appreciated the space as it was two of us plus our pup, but it would be great for two couples or a family. There is a lot to discover in the neighborhood as far as restaurants, bars, and cafes but the proximity to the 606 trail can’t be beat. As coffee lovers, we also frequented the cafe/art space just a couple of blocks away. Having access to the garage was a bonus and we also found street parking - sometimes close by, sometimes on another block but within easy walking distance. We loved our time in Chicago and Diana’s place felt like a home away from home. Would happily stay there again!
Easy self check in and it's a 5 minute walk to the train which was easy to find. Host was very responsive and flexible with checking in and out

Estancia muy agradable.

Great location, clean place, very communicative host!

It was a blessing to stay at the retreat

It served the purpose

Clean, everything needed for our party of 5, good onsite gym with rack and bar, free weights, cardio machines.  Luggage storage available.  Bedrooms and bathrooms are internal with no external windows, aircon good although with some noise in operation.

I had a great stay at Jonas and Claire’s apartment! The hosts are very responsive.  The apartment is great for a short stay- comfortable bed and linens, ground level entry and has some expected noise level from the street. The location in Ukrainian Village is excellent, beautiful neighborhood with nearby restaurants and transit.

My stay at Michelle’s Airbnb was great. The neighborhood was safe, easy to commute to/from using the Blue Line, and had great food in the surrounding areas.
Michelle and her husband were also very responsive and accommodative when it came to providing extra things like towels and parking stickers for when a friend of mine stayed with me for a weekend. They were also great about reaching out to see how my stay was going generally.
The only drawback in my eyes was that I felt like the space wasn’t described entirely accurately in the listing. It explains that it is a “guesthouse” or “apartment” (which led me to believe it was a separate building or completely separate part of the house) when in reality it is a part of the house’s basement. I appreciated that I had my own door I could use to access the space (which was closed off from the rest of the house) and I wouldn’t have really minded if it wasn’t below a part of the home where it got a bit noisy at times.
Would recommend this place! Beautiful condo in a great location. Kay was very helpful and responsive!

Geeta was a lovely host! She was responsive, flexible, and always willing to provide recommendations. The location of the apartment was quite convenient — near the blue line and good handful of restaurants and shops.
It’s a garden unit, so be conscious of a lack of light and know that you’ll get some bugs. The space could’ve used brighter lighting in general for daytime use and needed a more thorough clean. Some TLC would also go a long way since it’s an aging unit.
However, it’s a solid space to crash in Logan Square if that’s where you want to be.

It was a cozy home! I would definitely recommend staying here. It’s driving distance from everything you could think of. The area was also good, you have a lot of fast food spots & grocery stores in the area. It’s a quiet neighborhood.
Great host she treats you like family

they responded really quick and fast to get me into the home on a last minute stay, I appreciate that the house did match the photos all the beds were clean towels were clean . It’s just an old house you hear yourself walk across the floor , the host was very responsive when I asked questions the neighborhood just threw me off .. but I took the safety precautions that I would anywhere else

The home was nice and in a great location for our family’s girls weekend. Very nice neighborhood with lots of people walking, etc.
The home is spacious but we were not able to use the basement room as it had a strong cat odor. I have severe allergies to cat dander, so I suffered while we were in the condo. I would not have booked the condo had I known about a cat living there. Some of my family was bummed to not be able to watch some tv in the evening since it was in the basement with the cat odor.
The instruction on how to get into the parking lot was confusing, as we didn’t know we needed a key that was in a lock box by the front door down a different street.
Great pad hosted by friendly folks! Close to the train, lake, and lots of delicious food. Would stay again!
very nice
Kai was a great host and very friendly. Felt very comfortable communicating and they were very responsive!
Hosts were very accommodating and apartment was perfect for my stay. Would happily rent there again!!
J&J's place was clean and spacious.  It was on a quiet street and close to parks.
Great host, very responsive. Location was great for us and we enjoyed our stay.
We loved the location during this wedding weekend and had everything we needed and then some. Mike offered a very flexible leave and more than a goody basket to accentuate our trip. Would book again!
We enjoyed this little oasis just south of downtown.

What a lovely apartment. The pictures do not do the size justice. It’s quite expansive of a space and very comfortable. We had quick 5min drive to Riot Fest however the bus route would have been super easy and direct. If we go to Riot Fest again we would absolutely stay here.

Isa was very responsive when I had an issue with checking in. Location is right on the beach, but has no beach access directly apartment was clean and was the perfect place to celebrate family birthday.

Don’t hesitate. Book now. Noel worked with us on a few date changes, updated check-in, and more all with super quick response times only making our stay that much better.
The space itself is great. We were in town for a music festival and it was the ideal quiet place to retreat to in the evenings to rest up. I was really impressed with how clean the space was, beds were very comfortable, and kitchen had everything we needed to have quick late night meals and morning tea and coffee.
My favorite part of the space was the artwork though. We spent time looking at every piece in each room. So many awesome works. It felt like a little pop-up gallery.
We didn’t get to explore the area too much since we spent our days at the festival but the area felt welcoming and walkable. Don’t sleep on the Jumping Bean for coffee and killer baked goods.
Looking forward to coming back to Noel’s in the future to see what else Pilsen has in store.
Terry was a great host.  We enjoyed the proximity to Wrigleyville and easy access to mass transit.  I would definitely stay here again on my next trip to Chicago.

Jefferson is a great host! This was my 3rd or 4th visit and I would stay there 30 or 40 times more! I visit family that live nearby his beautiful, well-kept, well-decor-ed home, Jefferson is warm, hospitable, friendly, and easy to work with. Jefferson is also an amazing artist, I am interested in and do some work in theater and film and appreciate his creativity. I can’t say enough great things. While there I asked him about a future stay-date, but he is already booked, darn-it! I’ve had great conservations with one of his guests! Stay there you will enjoy it.

This was one of the most well-stocked homes we have ever stayed in. We felt right at home. It was extremely comfortable, clean, easy to get to with pretty easy street parking right out front as well. John was very responsive and check in/check out was simple. We had a great stay!
This is a reliable listing - it is as described: a good place to sleep but you'll likely be hanging out elsewhere in the city. Building is secure. Managers respond quickly. I would stay again.
Andreea was responsive and showed us around when we arrived. The neighborhood is great and has tons to do. The parking pad was very convenient.
Richard is very kind and helpful.  The condo is very conveniently located.

Sean was incredibly friendly and helpful, and the home was lovely and comfortable! Parking was a bit of a hassle at times, but Sean provided parking passes to make things as easy as possible. We had a wonderful stay!
I enjoyed staying in the city at Juanita's place and being able to walk to Riot Fest from the air bnb.

We loved staying at Brian’s home! It was such a gorgeous space, and perfect for a weekend in Chicago with friends. The home is beautiful, and accommodated the 5 of us perfectly. It had everything we needed and was a very comfortable stay. Brian is super responsive and checked in daily to make sure all was good on our end, which was really appreciated. It was great to meet him in person too!

Enjoyed our stay, not far from the lake.
in an up and coming neighborhood. We felt very safe. Justin is very responsive.
It was not an inexpensive stay, but felt worth every bit of the money spent.
Location was amazing. Neighborhood was beautiful & safe.

I stayed at Teddy's for a weekend while visiting family. The unit was easily accessible with a keypad. Teddy responded to requests quickly and the apartment was very comfortable. I loved the balcony for morning tea!

We had such a wonderful stay! I booked this for a birthday getaway with my best friend and it was the perfect stay for us! Richard had timely responses and was very helpful when it came to instructions and recommendations. This place is such a unique stay with the perfect decorations to give it a homey feel. We will certainly be recommending this place to others for the future, as well as saving it for future reference if/when we return to the city. Just perfect!!
Great location in cute, safe neighborhood within walking distance to Wrigley, many restaurants, and public transit. Having two full baths was amazing!
Awesome host and Airbnb!
Great clean spot with lots of fun details and amenities. great location.
I and my friend enjoyed our stay here. Very nice place. It was so clean and it looked like the photos. It was also quiet and peaceful, will definitely book again.

I booked this Airbnb for a weekend trip with my friends and it was perfect! The house was spacious with plenty of rooms for everyone to have their own space, and everything was clean and well-kept when we arrived. The check-in process was smooth, communication with the host was easy. We felt comfortable and at home the entire stay. I’d definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a roomy, relaxing getaway and would happily book again.

My overall experience was great very clean lots of space couldn’t really use the outside area do to spiders everywhere and also the living room couch can use some cleaning was too dirty to sit on but other then that the bedrooms kitchen and bathrooms was very clean the host was excellent with communication and fast responding location was great 20 minute drive to downtown would stay again

A beautiful place with a wonderful host! We were a group of 6 and this was just what we needed! Not to mention how stunning the patio is. Very clean, modern, and aesthetic. PLENTY of room, and I really appreciated how responsive, kind, and flexible Cristian was. Would definitely stay again!
Loved Joseph’s place! Great neighborhood
The entire experience was lovely! The space was clean and welcoming. The location was perfect and Ashley was very open to questions I had! Would definitely recommend
Spacious room with good closet space. Daley’s is within walking distance. Parking was good even if just street parking. No complaints. I enjoyed my stay and other guests were friendly.
Brandon was a great host with clear instructions on location and rental. Prime central location to Southport and Wrigleyville neighborhoods!
We enjoyed our stay.  We look forward to coming back!

The location for Tara’s place was fantastic! Very walkable and public transit friendly! Spacious and not too loud inside the home.
Tara responded quickly and efficiently with questions we had.
The negatives: It could have been cleaner when we checked in and there aren’t actual mattresses to sleep on, there are only ikea futons for beds. So not the most comfortable place to rest.
I would stay here again, but would probably bring an air mattress to sleep on instead.

We thoroughly enjoyed this property, so much so that instead of going out to dinner on Sat, we cooked at home and relaxed.   Not every place gives you that sense of home and comfort that you want to stay there more.  This one did.  Everything was fantastic and suited our group of 4 perfectly.  Directions were clear and I never had a need to contact the host.   One of the best stays I’ve had.  Thank you Toby!

Some great cafes and food in the area, and Avondale, Logan Square, and Wicker Park are just a couple stops on the blue line and have plenty to do. The area is quiet but you’ll still see people walking around later at night.
If you enjoy running, it’s easy to run along Keeler Ave and into the Villa District. There’s beautiful architecture to behold.
Thank you again Grace, and I’d be happy to recommend this place to someone looking for a quieter stay with plenty of access to the rest of Chicago.

As fotos correspondem à realidade (na verdade o quarto foi melhorado possuindo também uma escrivaninha que não está nas fotos). O bairro é bem silencioso e seguro (voltei para casa depois das 22:00 quase todos os dias e não me senti em risco em nenhum momento). Você levará de 50 minutos a 1 hora para chegar no centro (considerando uma curta caminhada, ônibus e metrô). Se você vem a passeio sozinho (como eu fiz) recomendo sair cedo de casa com uma mochila com itens básicos, aproveitar o dia e voltar de noite para dormir. No geral o custo benefício compensou bastante e eu ficaria hospedado com Jaime novamente numa outra oportunidade, sem pensar duas vezes.

Even though there are fewer small shops immediately around the apartment (or maybe I just didn’t notice them) Lidl is a 15-minute walk away, and the Green Line station is just a 2 minutes walk.
The hosts are very accommodating, respond quickly, and help with anything you might need. It’s also no problem to leave your luggage there for the day after check-out.
Overall, a wonderful experience - 10/10!

I want to be clear about this review: Demitri is a great host with plenty of experience, and I have nothing negative to say about him or the property itself.
My only recommendation for future guests relates to parking. The listing notes free street parking nearby, but if you plan on bringing a car, be aware that parking in the area is extremely limited. It’s very crowded, and finding a spot close to the Airbnb is nearly impossible. Even paid parking options are scarce, so relying on them isn’t always a solution. In the worst case, it can take over an hour and force you to park more than a mile away.
Additionally, the place can get a bit noisy at times due to neighbors and activity from the floors above.
If you’re traveling without a car or plan to rely on public transportation, this place is a good choice. But if parking is a priority, I recommend taking this into account so it doesn’t affect your overall stay in Chicago.

Cute cute place, perfect for us and what we needed. Beds and pillows were comfy, tv great, host great, we figured out in our last day that there were lots of walkable places to eat in the opposite direction of the way we went haha I would definitely stay there again!! Cool little place!

We would 10000% stay here again! I am very particular about almost everything and never questioned this house and offerings.

A few minor downsides:
1) the shower did not have very good water pressure and we couldn't figure out how to switch the water from the handheld to the overhead shower.

Location location location! On top of probably the cleanest Airbnb I’ve ever stayed in. My family and I felt right at home.

Some blinds are missing, which make the bedrooms way too bright and without privacy from the street.

Scott’s place was perfect! Exactly as described and a perfect getaway after my long workdays. Scott himself was easy to reach and very helpful with anything we needed. Exactly what you want in a host! I would 10/10 recommend this place and look forward to staying again on my next trip to Chicago.

Everything was good. There was a little smell when we first got in. We opened the window and sprayed air freshener before we left to go to dinner and it smelled better when we returned. Thanks for making your place a home away from home.

I would definitely recommend staying here and I look forward to coming back.

Easy to find and convenient parking. Clean and neat.

Rob’s home was wonderful and right in the heart of the neighborhood. It was a great resting place, and still very close to the loop. Will stay again!
Great place and we enjoyed our stay. Host was great with communication.

5 stars all around! Geo was extremely responsive and a great host! Location was perfect - with everything we needed (Trader Joe’s, restaurants, bars, Wrigley Field, etc) all within walking distance. Roof top balcony has a beautiful view of the city and very relaxing, also small balcony off kitchen is perfect for enjoying your morning coffee. There are lots of stairs, which we were aware of, so we didn't mind. There is a garage for 1 vehicle. Street parking is available but several blocks away. Not always easy to find a space. Overall, highly recommend this space. Loved the sunken living room off dining area! Clean, plenty of towels, dishes, etc. Beautiful house!
Our weekend wedding was perfect! Thank you!

Liked the checkout list: quick, easy and not much different than what you would do if you stayed at a friend’s place. Highly recommend!

Incredible location near DePaul, Armitage and Fullerton train stations, and all the food/beauty/bars that Lincoln park has to offer. Great for a group of friends to stay.
Giving it 4 stars because the building is directly next to the train line, and the noise is definitely noticeable (especially when you’re outside in the backyard) and it was a bit hard to find the entrance to the unit.
We had a great stay in wicker park! The house was large and clean and well appointed! Highly recommend.

It was an ok place. It was very close to a red line train stop so getting to the Loop was quite easy. It was also a drawback because the train tracks were so close that we frequently had to stop a conversation in the apt until the train had passed.

Finding the bath towels and wash cloths took some hunting to locate the closest where they were stored. But they were clean and did the job.
Pre-visit communication with Tara was almost non-existent, except for the canned messages from her. I had never used the app & lock before & had some questions. They were never answered. Getting into the apartment took some time & guesswork.
If you are in town for a night or two and want a place conveniently located to a train stop & won't be spending much time in the apt, this place works. For a longer stay, I would consider a different location.
Muy acogedor y cómodo, muy buena comunicación de parte del anfitrión

I did notice some mold on the ceiling mainly in the bathroom that should be addressed but an easy fix.
The only time I felt uncomfortable in the home was on 2 occasions when I returned and the back door had been left wide open so addressed with Karen.
We had a wonderful stay! The place was darling and comfortable. We appreciated the welcome basket and Mike had great communication. My only suggestion is earplugs for sleeping.

We chose the Vachetta’s lovely second floor apartment in a historic building because we wanted a comfortable space for a group of six. Shaun was incredibly responsive and helpful during our stay. it was a nice cozy place in Avondale, very nearby to great restaurants and bars.

Charlie was an excellent host.

Great place to stay while in Chicago. It was very peaceful and has all the amenity of home, loved it. This was my second stay with Michelle and it was twice as nice. Enjoyed, looking forward to staying again on my next trip to Chicago. Two thumbs up.

We LOVED Christina’s coach house. It is beautifully designed and furnished, on a quiet street, utterly private, perfectly clean and welcoming. It had everything and contributed to a wonderful time in Chicago. Christina was very responsive and helpful—a top host! We will definitely return.
Very comfy bed and couch!

Patrizia is an amazing host who genuinely cares and anticipates her guests' needs. I absolutely recommend and would stay there again!
Wonderful place and Jeff was awesome to work with!

Really beautiful space in Bucktown, great location in Bucktown!! Centrally located, super walkable and very close to Western Blue Line stop. Lauren was awesome, sent over everything I needed beforehand and made the whole stay painless for me and my partner.
Awesome stay! We had our pup with us and it was perfect. Parking is a little tricky since on the street but we found a spot every night!
great place to stay. the space was a lot bigger than I anticipated.

The beds were comfy and everyone staying there was friendly! Love Chicago and had a wonderful time staying here :)

Really enjoyed my stay! Elizabeth was super responsive throughout and was super helpful. It was a very peaceful and private room.

Fantastic accommodations for a large group in Chicago!  Working with the host was a dream!  I booked this unit for my best friend's bachelorette weekend and the it was fantastic! The host was super responsive and wonderful to work with... would highly recommend this property.

This was my second stay at Mary's place, and this time I stayed for 5 weeks. I love the neighborhood, especially the location of this AirBnB. It's got everything I need and I may just stay a third time. Highly recommended.
A great stay in a wonderful neighborhood. Good base to explore the city. Highly recommend!
This a great place to stay with an amazing host! Parking is a little tricky, but the host is helpful in helping you figure it out.

Great place.

Wszystko byłoby idealnie, jeśli by inni goście też umieli zadbać o czystość. Polecam ten apartament bez obaw.
wonderful neighborhood and access to shopping, parks and restaurants.

The apartment is conveniently located, nicely decorated, clean, and has a great view from the window – definitely a plus. But the downsides turned out to be much more significant:
1. The main disappointment is the internet: speed is less than 0.2 mb/s, and often it doesn’t work at all, while mobile connection barely works inside.
2. The address in the listing does not match the actual one, and I had a hard time finding the key hidden in a different block.
3. The sofa is probably the cheapest one, old, dirty, broken, and uncomfortable.
4. Parking technically exists but is not available for guests.
5. The bathroom drain is clogged.
6. Towels are small and stained.
7. There is only bedding for one sleeping place.
8. The dryer filter was left dirty.
Overall, the impressions of the apartment were good, except for the time spent searching for the key and the huge discomfort caused by the lack of internet.
Also, a special thank you for the bottle of wine – a very pleasant gift.
Loved it!
Place was pristine and comfortable for an overnight stay.

Easy to find , queit neighborhood, easy parking close to the everything. Beds were very comfortable and spacious.
Host was very accomadating and the kids loved the games.
Great location quick and easy to get downtown. Host is very friendly and informative. This is the perfect spot to stay if you’re looking to come and experience Chicago
The apartment was comfortable and had easy access to public transport, making it easy to explore the city.

The place was a little smaller than the pictures but it was very clean and the staff was great during the day. Would stay here again. Just be aware it is downtown so you are in the middle of everything.
This was a perfect location for getting around Chicago and seeing some baseball games. Would rent again!

We really enjoyed our stay at Nardo’s place! The location is excellent, very convenient for exploring Chicago.
The apartment is well furnished and has everything you might need during your stay, definitely a great value for the money.
The bed is a closet-style pull-down bed, so you’ll need to set it up yourself, but it was comfortable once prepared.
The space was generally clean, though the bed area was a little dusty (I’m very sensitive to dust due to allergies, but my partner had no issues). Nardo was a great host: friendly, responsive, and made everything easy. Overall, a great spot that we would recommend!

The home was beautiful! We felt at home instantly, four of us stayed from California and the house was very close to downtown which was perfect for exploring the beauty of Chicago! Would definitely stay again!

Jonathan’s spot in little Italy is a gem! The modern look matches nicely with the hotel themed unit. The private balcony provides beautiful views of the downtown skyline, and the location overall is excellent. Many walkable restaurants and pubs. Highly recommend this cozy hotel for your next Chicago adventure!

Great location and Stewart was very helpful and responsive with any questions.

Wonderful little apartment in a fun and lively part of Chicago. The hosts were friendly, responsive, and accomodating.
For travelers with a car, there's a very convenient paid parking lot just down the alley. (At time of writing, Google maps directs you to enter from the main street, which you can't)
I'd love to book here again on a future visit!
Angie was great!!! Highly recommend
Great place, lots of small details that really made you feel welcomed.   The home has everything you could possibly need.   Felt safe walking around in the neighborhood.  Will stay there agaiin..

Gina’s place was perfect for my wife and I’s getaway. Gina has thought of everything and very responsive. Neighborhood was beautiful and a great walk every morning. Definitely look forward to staying with Gina again
Thanks very much! Awesome location!

Don was very responsive and helpful.  We did not have enough parking passes.  I reached out and let Don know.  He responded in minutes and bought us enough passes to cover the stay.  The home was clean and in a nice neighborhood.  Close to everything we needed... walking distance.  Was a great stay and I would book it again next time I am there.

I would definitely stay here again! A short drive downtown, great DoorDash food options and the home is cozy! We had 4 adults stay very comfortably and Lawrence was very responsive. The home does not have central air but the window units kept the home perfectly cool. The kitchen was stocked with everything we needed and check in and out was a breeze. We enjoyed our stay and getting to see another part of Chicago.

The pictures doesn’t capture the true space of the house. It’s three stories with a lot of space in every part of the house. The radio speaker and cable tv were bonuses. But the host were very accommodating and responsive. Highly recommend for larger groups looking to stay close to downtown.
Very clean place very friendly hosts 10/10
Great location and value. Junior is a responsive and professional host - who genuinely cares about the quality of your stay. Would stay at another one of Junior’s properties!

The apartment is in a safe neighborhood with plenty of parking, and the host was very responsive throughout my stay. When I arrived, my service animal could not manage the steep, slippery stairs. Andrei went above and beyond to quickly install safety treads, which was immensely helpful.
Unfortunately, cleanliness was a major concern. There was visible mold in the shower, and dust on the blinds and vents made the air quality uncomfortable, I developed a persistent cough and sore throat during my stay. The coffee maker never worked, and despite mentioning it, it wasn’t replaced. Additionally, the laundry facilities in the basement were unpleasant, with rat traps throughout and water leaking on the floor. Lastly, this unit is for long term stays and doesn't offer a vacuum cleaner, leaving me to buy one for the unit.
While the location and host communication were positives, the overall condition of the apartment made the stay less enjoyable than expected, and we ultimately left early.

This was the perfect spot for a couple in their early-mid twenties. Just enough room for the both of us to eat and sleep comfortably. We didn’t want an expensive space we’d feel guilty about not utilizing, and this place delivered. Perfect price/space ratio. We were constantly exploring the city and using the space as a rest point for the next day. Parking could’ve been better, but we had no problem with grabbing daily parking passes, definitely worth it. Overall, if I could give 6 stars, I would.

This place is perfect for a couple, like it said in the description. Its a private room, 2 other rooms for other AirBNB users. Bathroom's in each room, Perfect for introverts, if you don't want to communicate face to face you don't need to, plenty of space in the shared kitchen/dining room. Usable Washer and dryer aswell as plates, bowls, cups, pans and utensils. One of the only issues i came across privacy wise is the bathroom door doesn't close or lock. Which is why i said its perfect for a couple. Lots of storage space for anything you can think of. Good for longer stays. Roku TV for entertainment, another downside. The roku is very slow and seems to have issues connecting to the internet. Had to unplug the TV each time it lost connection. Quiet times are 9pm-9am, very reasonable in my book. Parking is on the street, One way street so parking is on both sides. Side note. Entirely my fault. There is an hard to see fire hydrant on the left side. $150 fine and tow after a couple hours.

Potential, but my stay was disappointing. The entrance gives a boutique hotel feel, and the unit is stylishly decorated - compliments of Ikea (with a standout orange chair providing a nice pop of color). It's also located conveniently. Unfortunately, the positives end there.
The secondary check-in process was unnecessarily complicated and provided late by the host - 40 minutes before the 4:00PM evening check-in. It required additional identification and a $500 deposit that felt excessive. Once inside, it was clear the unit had not been properly prepared for new guests. There were not enough towels for four people—not even one full set per guest. A light over the counter, mentioned in a previous review, was still out. The area rug had been left outside on the balcony, where we also found a cigarette butt despite the listing being for a non-smoking unit. Most concerning, there was a dirty black hand towel left in the ensuite bathroom, which raised questions about cleanliness overall.
Super responsive beautiful home located close to the expressway to get where needed
Such a quiet and cozy house! The hosts were so kind and friendly, and everything was super clean and well organized. I’d happily stay here again and definitely recommend it to anyone.
this was the PERFECT spot to stay!! near a grocery store + lots of fun spots if you're here for a while. hatice is very responsive and proactive <3 a wonderful host and a wonderful spot to stay
Had a great time staying there.  Close to the train so easy to get around town
beautiful home in a grest location host was welcoming and quick response times

Noelle and Rob‘s home is beautiful,charming and cozy. It was the perfect place to reunite with my college girlfriends for the weekend. The house is in a quaint neighborhood with friendly neighbors and within walking distance to several restaurants and shops. Noelle  has thought of every detail including having a bottle of wine, waiting for us when we arrived, and dropping off scones from a local bakery for our breakfast. The beds were extremely comfortable with quality sheets, and bedding. There were also extra pillows and blankets available. The kitchen was fully stocked and organized, making it easy to prepare meals. The weather was beautiful while we were there so we enjoyed sitting on the back porch in the evenings. I would definitely book this house again in the future.
Great little place for a weekend in Chicago! She was a very kind host and I’d recommend this place to anyone :) thank you again!
Amazing! Everything was clean and neat
Such a great location with soo much to do around the area.

Our stay in Chicago was great thanks to Evgenii. His home is close to the pink line that goes straight to Chicago downtown.
The house was clean and Evgenii's answers quickly. 😀

I can't say enough good things about this booking. It was close to a bunch of restaurants, sights, bars to visit and the host was super responsive. whether it be early in the morning or late at night, we had our questions answered immediately as we asked.
I would definitely book again, it was clean, affordable and centralized to a lot of things to see and do. Thank you again!
the place was kinda hard to find. but it was a good landing zone for a quick trip. most things are within walking distance too.

Great location, safe, quiet and as described.

Had a great stay during a very busy holiday. Price was great and host was very helpful.

Our stay was great, we loved the beautiful open living room and the backyard! As mentioned in other reviews, we were told by locals that the neighborhood is not the safest and not to walk around at night but we had no problems during our stay :) Otherwise, Mercedes was super responsive with anything we needed and a very kind host!

This was the perfect stay for me! It was super peaceful and exactly what I was looking for during my time exploring Chicago. I preferred not to be surrounded by the hustle and bustle of downtown and preferred to stay in a space that was more lowkey. I also enjoyed meeting other guests and having breakfast with everyone a couple of the days out of my stay. It was really lovely. I'd book again. :)
Place was amazing and located in an amazing area. Would definitely recommend it and stay again
Great place in a prime location

Menar is such a kind and thoughtful host! Even with his busy professional schedule, he’s always quick to respond and makes sure everything goes smoothly. The apartment is so nice. Perfect for long term stays. Walkable to bus/train station, to parks, museums, restaurants, and bars, a hidden gem in Chicago. Especially ideal for trainees or interns. I’d happily stay here again. Thanks, Menar for being such a wonderful host!

Leah was extremely responsive to questions before and during the stay. Kind, proactive. I would definitely recommend the area. The unit is impeccably done.
I would absolutely recommend this place for those who want to be in Chicago!

Ran was very, very awesome. He was fast to respond and help, and very kind in his messages. We were very happy with his service.
The Airbnb itself was a little bit disappointing. The place didn't match the photos, a lot of the decor was gone and the interior was subdued. The couch was stained, and there was some maintenance that would be nice to see. The master bath is a little rough (stained, we didn't use the tub), and the 2nd shower needed repairs (missing edging for waterproofing). The walls were dirty and could use a good scrub.
There is a reserved parking spot out back - we have a large SUV and it was a TIGHT fit (no one was parked straight, that didn't help).
Overall, value for the cost was fair, it was a safe place to sleep, but could use some TLC.
Everything was easy and well taken care of

We enjoyed our stay in a quiet and peaceful neighborhood. The 75 year old house has been updated beautifully. The wood floors must be original, and the will creak to let you know. We had a lovely stay in the house. Victor was a gracious host and worked to accommodate our early arrival.
Was amazing. Fully recommend!!
We stayed here for ARC, and it’s a 20-ish minute Uber ride to Union Park, which was perfect for how nice this place was and the price we paid.

Brian was very responsive and accommodating! The unit was exactly as described, really enjoyed the Alexa feature and 18 minutes from downtown ! Very spacious and equipped with everything you need for a short vacation stay!

John was very friendly from the start when we booked the place, so we had nothing but good vibes when we showed up. My friends and I felt right at home the minute we checked in. It was lovely having a washer and dryer in the unit for when it was needed. We especially loved the space in the living room area where we spent a lot of time binge watching shows, movies, and podcasts! Overall we had a great time.
Great place, great location, hosts were great
Wonderful place with easy access to a lot of great places. It was beautiful, clean and has everything you need. We'll taken care of! Highly recommend this place for a great stay!

This unit was in a great location close to everything we wanted to do. Brandon was always available in case we had any issues

This was my first time getting an Airbnb in Chicago for a vacation. I can say that this place was just what I needed for 10 people. Very spacious and had all the right amenities i needed. Had the needed things. The bed was too soft, maybe you can try a better mattress:)

This clean, cozy apartment was perfect for our trip to Chicago. We enjoyed being close to many local restaurants and the nearby trails in Lincoln Park. We left our car in the same spot for the duration of the stay, and just replaced the pass each morning. Very pleased with our stay and would definitely visit again!
Nice comfy bed. Very clean apartment. Not far from downtown. Recommend for future trips.

Jacob was such an amazing host; he made us feel very welcomed and comfortable. He was very responsive and helpful. Host was great. Condo was a little rough in areas and needed some repairs, but overall decent. There was no ac adjustments and the condo was pretty warm which made it difficult to sleep at times.
Location was excellent and close to public transport options which made it easy to explore downtown and get to soldier field on the bike paths.
Perfect space for touring Chicago. Shopping, dining, cloud 360 observation, and access to the bus stops all within a few blocks walk. 24 hour concierge at the front desk if you need anything.
Very accommodating/quick response to my request. I would definitely book to stay again in the future.
Great stay. Would book again.
Clean and friendly! Thank you!
great host,  clean, and all-around great location.

Loved our stay! Convenient location and living space is bigger than it looks in pictures. Right next to the train, so you’ll hear it going by, but didn’t bother any of us (windows/walls are well-insulated).

The apartment was absolutely beautiful and perfectly situated. Beds were super comfortable. Giant TV in the living room. Minutes away from Soldier Field and the downtown loop (We had come into town for a concert) as an added bonus the weather was perfect. 10 stars. Highly recommended. Next time we visit Chi-Town we’ll definitely be staying at Maria’s place.

Abacus's place was a great location yet the area is definitely mostly residential with a few fast food restaurants in the area.  Since we were in town for the ARC Music Festival the location was perfect for getting around to the event at Union Park and all the after hours. Also lots of city noises so if you aren't used to that bring ear plugs and an eye mask if you need to sleep during daylight hours.  The condo was clean and spacious and I would definitely recommend and stay there again if needed.  Thanks Abacus!

My partner and I loved our stay at Roberto’s place! He was incredibly helpful and friendly throughout the entire stay, and we were able to explore the city easily from our location. Overall, a great place to stay when in Chicago!!
The listing is exactly as it shows on the website. Great place and location. Easy to walk to the train.
We had a great stay and ubers/lyfts were close and cheap to where we needed to go! Jeremiah always responded quickly and was a great host we recommend staying here!

Excelente lugar! Mi esposa y yo disfrutamos mucho de la estancia, la ubicacion es magnifica con bastante que hacer en el area. Una buena ubicacion para moverse con transporte publico a cualquier parte de la cuidad.

This is not a luxury apartment, but it fit our needs very well. It was clean, comfortable and safe. It had off-street parking on a quiet, well-maintained street. It was very close to the people we were visiting. Be aware that the bed in the master bedroom is very low to the floor in case that's an issue for you. It was fine for us. Thanks for a nice stay.

We loved staying in this small studio! It was a cozy place and smooth check in process. Everything was clean and the space had everything we needed. We had a rental car and thought it would be difficult with street parking but were able to park on the street with no paid parking. We would definitely stay here again!
Great host, very good location

The condo is 100% exactly like the photos. Joseph is a highly responsive host that has great recommendations for the neighborhood. The area is quiet. The area has restaurants and a grocery store nearby.
Nice place. Unit was as pictured. Straight forward check in and instructions. Clean. Host is very responsive & polite. Will definitely book again. Thank you!

We had a great time at this place. The unique aesthetic was definitely a stand out feature. It was very interesting and cozy, was very clean and had plenty of entertainment. The neighborhood it is located in is very nice and close to plenty of shops and food options. The host had good communication and provided amazing service. I would definitely rent again when in Chicago.

Jay was a great host!  Very welcoming  and made sure that everything was great for our stay. Jay reached out several times before our stay with recommendations etc.  He also checked in on us during our stay to make sure everything is okay.   His place is a great location if you are going to a Cubs game and want to be in the Wrigleyville area.

It was a perfect place for us to stay for a long weekend with family. Close to trains with access to and from the airport and downtown Chicago. Walkable to Wrigleyville. Also close to several restaurants bars, coffee, shops, etc. Thanks! Awesome memories made!
Good place to stay, very close to metro and busses, close to Rate Field, it has everything was mentioned in description and Jose y very friendly and an excellent host.
Had an amazing time time. I would definitely stay there again really soon.
My boyfriend and I absolutely loved staying here! Perfect for our long weekend. Quiet, had everything we needed, and the neighborhood was awesome. We would definitely come back and stay here.

It was a pleasure to stay at Arleth’s place. The accommodations fully met our needs and everything was easy to use. We had one issue with the water in the shower being too hot, and I want to particularly thank Arleth for responding so quickly to fix that problem. Arleth is a pro, very responsive and accommodating. We would certainly stay at her place again.
Alexandra estuvo muy atenta siempre, la propiedad muy cómoda y limpia y con ubicación inmejorable!
Good location and responsive host.

Dustin was a fantastic host - always quick to respond and helpful when it came to check-in. The house was in a great location, with our very own outdoor area, and easily fit our large group comfortably! (The floor mattresses may be more comfy than my mattress at home!) Highly recommend.
Clean & quiet place for solo travel. Right by the bus. Host was responsive and helpful. I will be back!

Appreciated the size of this place and also the location. The host was very responsive and the house was clean.
The train sounds didn’t bother us. I do wish there was more seating in the living room. A 2 person couch and 1 chair doesn’t really cut it for 8 people. There were stools around and some dining room chairs, but wasn’t really comfortable.
Overall, a good stay and again, a great area!
Caroline is a great host, always looking out for her guests and doing whatever it takes to make them comfortable!
Wonderful was communicative and flexible to assist with our travel troubles. Clear communication was extremely helpful and I would happily stay in another property hosted by Wonderful

We had a good stay there. I don’t think it’s worth the $400 or so we spent. Everything was perfect besides 2 things. There’s no parking anywhere good in the neighborhood so the closest parking we got after being out late was by an abandoned factory. 2nd, our room didn’t have blinds or curtains that blocked the view of the outside. The owners were really cool and I understand they can’t fix the parking, I just wanted to add that in case anyone felt like driving, but definitely get some proper curtains in that room and it would be a 10/10
Great place to stay and the hosts were wonderful.

Beautiful, well-kept condo in a very walkable and pretty neighborhood!

Place was great for a large group! We really liked the common area and all the space in the living room and kitchen for us.
Comfortably fit six of us. Great living/dining room area for hanging out.
Geo’s place was perfect for our group of 6 in town to visit for a friend’s wedding. Beds were comfortable.

Carl is very friendly and is always trying to make sure that we are comfortable yet also giving us private space.

What an amazing Airbnb experience for my bachelorette! Garrett was so accommodating with all of our needs! Also it was so nice to have all the essentials available to us! Thank you Garrett for everything I would recommend this Airbnb to anyone hosting a large group!
Cyrus was very responsive to any questions we had. The check-in process was simple, and the house was clean. We had no issues during our 3-night stay, and Cyrus was very accommodating when needed.

Convenient, easy to access place in a great part of Logan Square! Great view of sunset from the floor to ceiling windows.

We had a great time and would definitely stay again if we come back to Chicago! Do yourself a favor and book!
Always stay at one of his places and things are always good my go to place all the time
We loved johns place, nice and roomy and walkable to the arc music festival we were attending!

Justin is an amazing host - responsive and very nice. The place was very clean when we checked in. Justin let us check in an hour early because we arrived in Chicago earlier than we initially planned. We loved our trip and can't wait to visit again!

This was an overall nice place to stay. It is located in a great location near all the sites and restaurants and very walkable. Fantastic place! Clean with multiple bedrooms and areas to hang out in. The pool table and patio seating were a nice touch and even with eight people it didn't feel cramped. Definitely marking for future stays <3
Beautiful place and Cristina was very responsive and friendly, very flexible check in times
nice place very clean with everything you could need to be comfortable! nice location very close to the train.
airbnb was great! it was very easy to check in and the description very much matched where i stayed. will be recommending to anyone that decides to take a trip over to chicago!

The place was wonderful! Vanessa was very helpful and quick to respond, so it made everything very quick and easy.
Really enjoyed this location!
Enjoyed the home, great value!

Very comfortable place in a tourist-friendly location. The place has everything you need; fresh towels, good AC, comfy beds, etc. Sara is friendly and provided very clear instructions! We had a blast in this area.
Fantastic stay! Made my trip, they went above and beyond! I’m disabled and they totally accommodated me!
Great place, really recommend

Great place and location would visit again

Spacious apartment in a great neighborhood. Walkable to transit, parks and beaches.

The only complaints I have is the m-bedroom power sockets needing some maintenance and the door handle to the master bedroom could lock someone out from the outside, it needs to be fixed. Otherwise, I would definitely book again in the future!
it was great I will repeat

Beautiful spot and nice area. Walkable to the red line station and a quick walk to the lakefront. Plenty of shops and food options just around the corner.
The unit is clean and tidy with everything you’d need.
Danielle provided a few local recommendations and was very responsive as well as flexible. Highly recommended!

Wow!! What a beautiful stay! Jamal’s home is truly such a gem! The street the unit is located on is peaceful and absolutely stunning! The neighborhood is truly a perfect little area. While I appreciated the views and the space the place offered, the stains on the bedroom walls were off putting and host claimed it was due to furnishing rubbing on wall. When we tried to sign into the WiFi on phones it said please set up WiFi in app, and on tv said connected but no internet. Not enough towels for 3 person stay, only 3 towels and no washer available.

We were extremely disappointed in our rental and would not recommend or rent again. It was not worth the price we paid. If anything, it should have been half the price. An Airbnb should feel like a home, and this felt like teenager's first apartment with all the mismatched furniture that was falling apart. Basic things like there are no lamps in the bedrooms. It sounds like they are coming through the ceiling when they walk around. I stepped on a piece of glass in the kitchen that wasn't cleaned up and the broken wine glass was left in the cabinet. Our stay was fantastic!
Everything was close by, dispo down the street and a target too very convenient.
Great place in a great spot, communicative host.
The place was very nice.  Perfect size for our daughters trip.  Very clean and great location.

It was nice home with a great host. The instructions were clear. The amenities provided were very helpful. The beds were comfy with fluffy pillows, felt like sleeping on a cloud. Would 100% book again!
Great location, walkable to Fulton market. Host was great and flexible with check in. Place was spacious and perfect for our small group. The unit was fairly warn and does need some TLC though
Beautiful home with tons of space. Matthew was very helpful in anything we needed and it made our stay that much better.
We had stayed here a couple of months ago and were happy to return.   The neighborhood is great and Gracjan is a wonderful host.  We enjoyed our stay.

Lovely place to stay to be close to solder field. Super clean and quiet place

Good place and great location if you're going to events at Soldier Field, 8 mins away. Very convenient.
we had a great stay

Garbage from previous stay was left, bathroom and kitchen were not cleaned.
There was no hot water in the shower and no clean towels. Furniture in the living area was old and needs updating.
We requested a partial refund and communication from the host was slow, after involving airbnb support we eventually received what we considered to be an unreasonable amount for the inconvenience.
Overall disappointed in the stay - Our first bad experience with an airbnb.
Tonija was a great host. This spot is a bit far from the city 🏙️ but is accessible via Uber etc. the place is very nice and was perfect for the number of people we needed to sleep there!

I really enjoyed the location, it’s across the street from the entrance/exit to the blue line train, there’s a bike parking station a street over, near the river walk etc. They lock the buildings doors after a certain time and you can only get in using your room key which felt super safe, even during regular hours they have someone stationed watching the doors. There’s a microwave and a fridge which was nice.
Very nice place and the owner was super helpful and Informative and kind to us
Great place to stay

Extremely clean. Host is very communicative and thoughtful. Beautiful space that feels like home. Note is the only shower is inside one of the bedrooms! Neighborhood is beautiful and quiet. Walkable to U Chicago campus.

Great host and I really had a great stay! The area is actually quiet and nothing dangerous happened. I’d say there’s not really that much to do around South Shore but there’s a really cheap grocery store nearby
Great area quiet and safe close to many things to do. Karen was very responsive as well.
Great place to stay for exploring Chicago. It’s close to bike rental areas and near the city transit station for Jefferson park making it super easy to hop on the L and take a ride into the city.

This is a great stay in a nice, safe, and peaceful neighborhood! Very spacious unit in a convenient location.
Also, Jeannie and Ceasar were friendly and responsive hosts when our family had asked for some accommodation requests.
Overall, the unit works for a large group, but could use some minor updates: the living room sofa could use a good cleaning and maintenance (there were food crumbs and old stains on the mattress, and a spring or two seemed to be off). We did end up using the sofa bed our entire trip.
Also, there were no condiments or food storage items (no salt/pepper/spices/oil coffee pods, ziplocks/foil) but the kitchen is nice and spacious.
This is a great space for a larger group and we loved the neighborhood. Very convenient.

The space is nice and roomy. The kitchen is stocked with utensils and cooking stuff. The bedroom is nice. Just not a lot of room on the sides of the bed to move around. Bathroom has plenty of room. Shower pressure not the greatest and the water is definitely hard. But it got the job done. There are extra towels, blankets and pillows available. That’s very nice. The outside area pictures are deceiving. Not as nice as the pictures are but it’s a nice peaceful area to sit if you want. The availability of parking passes is very nice and convenient. It would be nice if there were instructions or information papers/packets posted or left out in the actual space. Most places do that and it makes it easier to figure things out. We had to contact the host about the parking pass and the WiFi. She was quick to respond but if that info was out somewhere we wouldn’t have to bother her.

We had a great weekend stay at David’s place. The location is excellent just across the street from Lincoln Park, zoo etc and walkable to many restaurants and other areas. Terrific neighborhood, the space is comfortable and David is a great host, very responsive if you have any questions.
Great stay! Rahaf’s place was cute, cozy, and had everything we needed. Rahaf was super friendly and responsive. Would definitely stay again!
Solid home base for our trip to explore Chicago and attend a concert at Soldier field. Spacious and appreciated the well stocked kitchen.

Great place to stay if you are traveling solo!

Stayed at Alfonso’s place over the long weekend. It was a very cute Airbnb. He went through a great lot of detail in his home. Very cosy and very clean. It was about a 20 minute drive from downtown which was great. Felt like home. Thanks!

This wasy first time in Chicago and felt very safe and had a blast. Such a unique location, visited the bar below and had a great time. Matthew went above and beyond to accommodate us! Would absolutely 100% stay again!

We could walk to everything, but had a parking pass for our car when we needed it which was such a nice bonus. Thank you, Laura!

The place was very clean and just like what was described. Melissa helped with parking and had all the amenities you could need. Clear instructions. It was nice to have such a homey space for us and our dog. Would stay again

Absolutely loved Neal’s place, and would love to come back! I can’t say enough good things about our experience there - excellent location, spacious, well-decorated, with a lovely roof deck/patio. Allende's bungalow was cute and more spacious than expected. We drove right to it, loved the neighborhood, and felt safe the whole time. And the beds were so comfortable with nice linens, too.

Kenya's place was perfect for our family who came to town for a concert at soldier field.  It was central to all the things  (Historic Pullman, concert stadium, ckoud gate etc) Bacon and Jam and Calumet Fisheries are close and are a MUST for food! One mention is the second bathroom is downstairs in an empty basement, which was clean and functional,  just a little off the main path. Other than that the neighborhood was cute and well maintained with all different types of houses and architecture (the house itself looks like an old fire station!). The house itself looks like an old firehouse and the inside has new and old mixed and was great for a weekend exploring Chicago.
The place itself was VERY nice and Tejal was a lovely host :)

Kristen was great! She was so friendly and made us feel right at home! She gave us so many good food recs and there was a nice coffee shop you could walk too. The place was also very nice! Perfect for my short stay to see a concert!

4. The tap water flow was low, probably due to low water pressure.
Apart from these, the place was really nice to stay. The owners were very responsive and kind.

This is a very clean, comfortable and spacious apartment in a great neighborhood. Particularly good for visiting family or friends on the North Side.
Daniel communicated well and had helpful materials for visitors.
