The best part is that we were only 15 minutes away from downtown Chicago (20 min with lots traffic). I will 100 percent stay here again. Thank you so much Hanna and Mark for hosting us!

Certainly the best value of anywhere I've stayed this year. I so much appreciate how clean Genova keeps the place - it's by far my top priority. I also appreciated how respectful other guests were of the shared spaces and bathroom. I would stay here again in a heartbeat. Five stars!

Great place with a lot of accessible stores, restaurants and more!!!

Diana was quick to respond on any issues but we didn’t have much. At night its a real quiet neighborhood considering your in the city. I couldn’t hear any street noise at all.

Thank for hosting! Very convenient spot next to CTA pink train to get anywhere I needed to this Labor Day weekend.
Great, clean, and safe place to stay!

Nice place! lovely in the fall time
Place is as described and posted. All basic with essential needs.

The place was quiet, peaceful, and perfect for two people. Patricia is also super responsive and friendly. Five stars!
Simply an amazing space!
Place was just like the description and a very short walk to the Argyle Red Line stop. Easy to check in and quiet.

Anais was super responsive, the apartment was more than what we expected and we really enjoyed our stay there

Overall I felt safe, comfortable, taken care of, and I would recommend their air bnb to anyone. Thank you Edward!
The building and Airbnb felt safe and secure. We came to visit for a couple days for a music festival and it worked perfectly for our trip! We would stay here again!

A great spot to walk to amazing restaurants and the train! Clean and the owners are responsive. The neighborhood is my favorite in Chicago! If you want to feel at home, come here!!
Igual que en las fotos. Muy central y siempre con respuestas rápidas
David and Cathy were very responsive hosts and have such a beautiful home! This was perfect for a long weekend stay in Chicago.

This Airbnb is effectively a hostel. There are 5 different bedrooms that are rented out and 2 shared bathrooms. We knew this going in, and it was mostly fine. Other guests kept to themselves - except for the person who cooked a full meal in the kitchen at 1 am and woke us up. The house is in a nice neighborhood, close to buses, the train, and good restaurants. It was easy to come and go. The bathroom was well stocked with items, including a hair dryer. We never had an issue getting access to a bathroom. The downside was that the room was stuffy and smelled bad. The mattress is very firm. There was no blanket, just a thin duvet cover without a duvet in it. The walls throughout the property are dingy and scuffed, and some things had been remodeled badly. I only saw one smoke detector, and the batteries had been taken out. It wasn't super comfortable, but at least it was cheap?

We stayed here for 3 nights on Labor Day weekend. They did a fantastic job on rehabbing this basement apt. and Dora met us upon check in and showed us around. The back garden is an oasis. (she even invited us to pick from her garden!) The area is very walkable.  We walked to the Japanese Garden, around University of Chicago and Hyde Park. The U of Chicago is only a 10 min walk so this would be a good choice for visiting parents.  The home is set in a stunning neighborhood of brick mansions, each one different from the other.  We walked 1 block to the #14 bus and took that to downtown - super easy!  Street parking was plentiful. Dora met us and gave us a parking pass as well.  The noise barrier between the host's house upstairs and the basement apartment is not very good.  I would recommend one brings ear plugs if a light sleeper or want to sleep in. The hosts are up early and you can hear everything. Fans would be nice in the bedrooms - the temp is controlled but bedrooms are hot.
Sweet spot in Irving Park and close enough to walk to the Blue Line. Clean and welcoming environment. Silvia was super responsive to our questions when we were figuring out some booking details.
place was very cozy, clean and had great amenities. Melissa was also extremely helpful, and responsive!

We had a great time at Ayla’s spot! We really enjoyed the sunroom and back garden, and the decorations and vibe were amazing. Andersonville was beautiful and we enjoyed the local coffee shops and restaurants. Street parking was free and wasn’t an issue during our stay.
Would highly recommend this space if you’re looking for a calm but walkable neighborhood, we will definitely keep it in mind for future Chicago visits!

Stayed here for one month with my husband. Airbnb is very spacious! Location is excellent - close to lake/beach, CTA, etc. Very close to Loyola. Having the dedicated parking spot was awesome! Anko is responsive and very kind. One note: the laundry is located on the lobby floor and is paid (quarter only, $2.25 for washer and dryer).

Jose’s place was the closest available/cheapest AirBNB I could find by Bridgeview for North Coast and I think it’s definitely a “get what you pay for” situation—the basics were provided and I was able to communicate with the host very easily/quickly which I appreciated. The space was quiet and just large enough to fit my boyfriend and I. The room and bathroom were clean—my only gripe is the bedding being kind of run down (was hard to tell if they were clean or not) as some previous reviewers have mentioned, but they didn’t smell or have stains so we didn’t mind. Good for those trying to save a buck for a shorter stay!
Everything was great thank you!

Jeff’s place was a marvelous spot to gather together my husband’s large extended family. There was plenty of room to spread out including great outdoor space which is what we were looking for. Plenty of sleeping space, esp if you don’t mind sharing, and ample bathrooms too. It was exactly what I hoped it would be. My only caveat is that for a place that can accommodate many guests its kitchen needs to be better equipped with larger, durable pans. Finding things was a bit of a challenge as I am sure guests move things around. But I guess that means that kitchen needs to be periodically looked at. Feel we owe the owners a debt of gratitude for providing such a generous place.
Our host provided a great place for my friends and I to stay while visiting. She was very responsive and was always checking in to make sure things were okay.
The place was spotless and spacious and the neighborhood is really nice. No need for a car. I used Divvy bikes, the Metra and CTA to move around.
Nice place.  Very Near michigan ave & resto .
The place was just as advertised. Very accommodating and in a great location to be able to venture out into the city! I’ll be booking with them EVERY TIME I visit Chicago!!!
We loved our stay at Michelle's place! An incredible location, beautiful home, and she even proactively reached out offering to set up a pack n play for us before we arrived. Thanks, Michelle!
Really loved our stay, the place was clean and close to all of the activities we had planned without being right in all of the hullabaloo. Nice and quiet neighborhood.
Made me feel right at home. Amazing recommendations and great people!
We absolutely loved our stay here! The space was decorated so cute. It was very spacious and the host provided many complimentary items that made our stay feel like home.
Met my expectations and all around great experience.  People that shared the space with me were very friendly as well.  Id definitely return if I go back to Chicago.  Thank you!

Keith maintained constant communication throughout the stay. Check in instructions were clear and easy to understand. The house is very big and spacious! It is a shared house, as you only have the main and lower level but the upper level is through another separate entrance. The place was worth what was paid!

This was a great spot! Close to many restaurants & only 20 minutes to Downtown! So much to do with everything being a short distance away. The neighborhood was very quiet and peaceful with plenty of street parking. First time in Chicago IL & it was amazing!

Great place for the price! Andy was very good communicating, the room and common areas were clean, bed/pillows were comfy, and the other guests were nice and respectful :)
The neighbourhood is nice, just stay alert if you are moving around at night time, Chicago is a big city with all that implies.
Overall we had a great time and this airbnb worked great for us, thanks Andy!

Had a very good trip. My only complaints are the chairs/recliner don’t work and are a bit uncomfortable, and I wasn’t sure what to do with the garbage/couldn’t find a broom.
Very communicative host, cozy place, fun nightlife, good eats.

We stayed here for 4 nights and appreciated a few things about the property. Lots of beds, two kitchens and living rooms, and 3 bathrooms. Perfect for large groups. The price was also lower than other Airbnbs and the green line was walking distance.
However, the home did feel a bit worn and not the cleanest. And the neighborhood felt less safe than we expected, so that’s something that future guests may want to keep in mind.
Overall this airbnb worked for us because of the space and price, but with a little more upkeep if could be a better experience.
Le’Dia, the host, was very accommodating and let us check in early. She kept us updated and communicated very well.
Perfect spot.  Wrigley Field., Red Line, Broadway street.

This was the best stay I've had in Chicago! Jake's home is so close to so many cool spots and amazing food. Jake was extremely helpful and patient too and walked out through our check in even though we were sooo exhausted. I would love to stay again.

Our party of 5 stayed at the apartment for 4 nights we definitely enjoyed our stay and loved how close we were to everything the city had to offer.
Airbnb was spacious enough for 5 people and could definitely fit 3 more people comfortably. Place was secure with two locked entryways plus front desk staff was super nice and always available.
Kitchen/bathrooms had all the amenities for our stay no complaints there water pressure was adequate too!
Overall we would return here for our yearly trip!
This is a beautiful home in a great location.  We had NO complaints and would definitely stay there again when we visit our daughter

Ninocs home was in a fantastic location for what we were traveling to Chicago for! The neighborhood is so cute and we never felt unsafe walking around! We were a short uber ride to other great neighborhoods as well! The home has a full kitchen which was nice to have and the beds slept great! At night you could hear people walking around upstairs, but not loud enough to keep us up at night or anything. I would definitely recommend staying here!
Excellent spot near the 24/7 Red Line train.

I had a great stay at Rob's place in Andersonville. The unit is right next to the red line which made getting around super easy. Rob's place was clean and had everything I needed - especially as I wasn't around for most of the day. I would definitely stay here again next time I'm in Chicago.
Nice shared space south of downtown Chicago. Nearby public transportation that made heading downtown easy.

Perfect location! Lots of core memories were made during our stay. The master shower alone was a dream come true.  The house was so charming and the hosts not only communicated well (not overly communicative but just the right amount) & provided great detail, they were quickly accessible if needed. The space is so much larger than you can expect from the photos. You will hear the basement occupants but it was never a disturbance. In fact,  we enjoyed the smell of their cooking one evening so much it inspired us to order groceries & cook several meals together in the beautiful kitchen.  I plan on staying again in the future for our next visit to the Windy City! 💗

This was a lovely space in Logan Square. Easy to get to the CTA blue line, a lot of restaurants and nightlife in the area, and was very safe. The apartment itself is cozy, clean, and cute. We’ll definitely keep it in mind for future visits to the city!

Great place to stay! Clean, comfortable, and in a great area. Plenty of kitchen equipment and extra toiletries, which made our stay extra comfortable. Nardo is a great host and was very responsive whenever we had questions.
Patt is an amazing host. She is friendly, responsive, accommodating, flexible. The next time I go to Chicago, Patt’s Airbnb will be at the top of my list.
The stay was comfortable and convenient. The location worked well for our needs, and check-in/check-out was straightforward. Overall, it was a good experience

Tameka was such an amazing host! She was sure to communicate often to check in with us during our stay. We had one issue with the lock and she was able to provide more info and an alternative for us. The home was beautiful and provided more than enough space for us during our stay. We were not far from anything so the location was also a plus. Tameka provided clear check in and check out instructions for us during our stay, which made our stay easy and enjoyable. I would recommend others to stay here if ever visiting the city.
Excellent host and always responsive. The place was an ideal location for us and worked out great. Thank you!
Wonderful home very quiet neighborhood. Good for families!

We had a pleasant stay – the place was very clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. A few more kitchen basics would have made the experience even better. There was also a bit of noise from the upstairs unit, but overall we enjoyed our time here and appreciated the hospitality.

Great place, the apartment is lovely, very spacious and nicely decorated. the bed was very comfy too !
location is also A+, very close to lots of fun shops and delicious food, and a very short walk to the lake front.

I had a wonderful stay at this place! GuruNischan and the other occupant are very friendly people, always ready to help or give ideas for visiting the city. Access is easy and the room is as shown in the photos.
Be aware that there is no AC in the apartment. This is not usually a problem as it is well ventilated, but I happened to be there during the hottest few days of the summer, and it does get very hot. People who are very sensitive to this might want to take it into account when booking during the summer!
Convenient location and lower than expected value for the price.

We had a wonderful stay! The space was beautiful and came with stocked items we needed most (breakfast, water, towels, toiletries). Would absolutely stay again and recommend others as well. I had a private spot to leave my car all weekend. The house was clean and comfortable
We had a great stay here!! Felt like home, and we loved the area!
Was able to talk to her for 30-40 minutes in our short stay over the weekend. Extremely kind and great travel stories!
Always a wonderful stay! Roxanne is so attentive and so awesome! My first choice anytime I’m in Chicago!!
It's a lovely house - and we are so glad we decided to stay at Molly's. We really enjoyed the Hyde Park neighbourhood, too.  Plenty of restaurants. Walking distance from the nearest CTA bus stop.

The house was very clean, and the owner is very friendly and responsive. The location is a safe neighborhood. If your activities are only downtown — after 11pm, Ubers can get a little bit expensive, but overall, it’s a very nice place to stay with lots of privacy. No complaints on the home/owner’s end.
Charming apartment in an amazing location.  Communicative hosts.

I stayed at Mary’s for 3 months to be closer to my sister after a major loss in the family. I work remote and found the abundance of coffee shops and cafes nearby great options for working and the desk in the room was adequate. There surrounding area also had a lot of offer, although it is good to be cautious at night and use common sense. The amenities at Mary’s were as described and the space was kept clean by a friendly housekeeper. It is a shared accommodation and the two other flatmates were very respectful of the house rules, most notably quiet hours, and were overall considerate flatmates. Mary was very accommodating and responsive by text. The building manager, Mike was also friendly and helpful.

Terrys place was perfect.
From Terry himself greeting us and showing us around to the gift certificate for dinner at his restaurant and the bottle of wine in the fridge he left for us, the place was incredible.
The beautiful balcony, comfortable bed in spotless, kitchen and bath- we couldn’t have asked for more. Terri’s place is better than the pictures.
We will definitely be back.

The location of this Airbnb was excellent within walking distance of coffee shops and other local spots. We were in town for a concert at Wrigley, and it was just a short Lyft ride away. The space was roomy, clean, and exactly as pictured in the listing. The neighbors do have a dog and children, so you may hear some noise, but that was clearly noted in the listing ahead of time and not an issue for us. Overall, it was a great stay in a convenient location, and I would definitely book again.
It was the best Airbnb I’ve ever stayed at! The host was super nice and helpful! And the space was very clean and tidy!

Phebian was pleasant and always quick to respond. Unfortunately that is where anything pleasant stops.  This is perhaps the most outdated and dirty place I stayed. One of the steps leading up to unit was loose and needs fixing before someone takes a tumble. The place was very dusty and you can actually see layers of dust. Bathroom, main bedroom and dining room light flickered. They had non dimmable lights in dimmable light fixture, which damaged the dimmers. The bathroom was sad and dirty. There was no body soap.  We were promised washer and dryer but when we decided to do laundry there was a wet bathroom rug in there. We didn't want to touch it all.  We literally had to buy extra clothes as we had no W/D to use. Every time I reached out to the host, the blame was always put on "the cleaners".  We airbnb as well but always make sure our place is clean and safe.

The place was immaculate and I wish I could enjoyed every room in it but we were out and about every night. This felt right at home and definitely will be staying again every time I visit Chicago. This is the best AirBNB I have stayed at in Chicago! The host is outstanding and worked with us to get in a bit early since we had a concert. The place does have lots of upgraded amenities so I appreciated the walk through when we arrived.
Tetyana is an awesome host. The roommates are also very friendly. I definitely would go back again in my next visit.
Everything was great, very much like staying at a family members home with all the amenities. Nice space for our small group.
Good overall. Clean place. Check the location of the place before booking
The location was perfect. The apartment is clean and very cozy. It has everything you need. If it's your first time in Chicago, rent a car and stay here. You'll enjoy it.

Beautiful apartment with incredible views   Perfect set up for me and my family in town for a wedding. Great kitchen and very clean bathrooms. Only issue was the third bedroom doesn’t have access to its own shower
Jeannine was a generous, friendly, and accommodating host. Quiet and convenient location in Logan Square, with a comfy bed and very clean room. Would highly recommend a stay here!

I had a good experience during my stay. Everything was clean and stocked up and if there were any minor problems, Karla was great at solving them and being accommodating. Karla is a lovely person and overall everything was great!

My group really enjoyed our stay. The place was very clean and organized, and the rooftop balcony is beautiful! The place looks exactly like the photos. Vince was very friendly and responsive which was amazing. Highly recommend!

I loved my stay at Kelly's place! So convenient to cute restaurants, cafes, and bars. Very peaceful and safe neighborhood. The place itself is adorable and perfect for a solo traveler, couple, or small group of if you don't mind the small, cozy bed nooks. Kitchen and bathroom were lovely - everything you need.
Also, Kelly was wonderful! Super helpful, responsive, and friendly. She even brought us snacks to get us through the weekend. Thank you, Kelly!

not an entire unit... but felt like one. The hosts were very considerate and accommodating , respecting our privacy. Checking in and out was easy, there were a few dirty dishes were downstairs but that's probably the only complaint I could give.

Genesys place felt like home. I felt safe and was able to get a good nights rest after traveling. The food she cooked smelled so delicious. The house was only a few minutes away from major shopping plazas including a Starbucks so if I needed anything, I could quickly go out and grab it. I would definitely stay here again the next time I’m in Chicago.
Larry was a good host and very flexible and responded quickly.  I recommend and will look to see if his place is available when I return to Chicago.

Place was outstanding, very roomy,
up to date fixtures, modern amenities, plenty of space, 5 bathrooms. Highly recommended.
Would definitely want to stay again
Great stay! House is in a great neighborhood easily accessible to transit, bars and restaurants. Host was easy to communicate with and friendly responsive.

Kyle was a wonderful host. He was proactive in reaching out to me prior to my stay and checked in after my first day. I felt like he was the perfect balance of making himself available without being intrusive. The house is located in a lovely neighborhood with lots of shops, restaurants and a Whole Foods within easy walking distance. I walked around the neighborhood both in the day time and at night and never felt unsafe. The house is also very close to a Brown Line "L" stop which is very convenient for folks looking to use public transit. The coach house was spotlessly clean and the bed was large and comfortable. I definitely hope to stay with Kyle again when I'm next in Chicago.
Location was in a great spot, very easy to access, and had close access to parking and near by food and attractions. The hosts were easy to get ahold of and made the trip very pleasant.
Very great area, the host answered all the questions, so much in walking distance and a great view

Great spot! The place was easy to get to and made it really convenient to visit downtown and Chinatown. The host was super responsive with any questions I had, which made the stay smooth. Overall I had a great time and would definitely recommend.

What a charming place!   The house is spacious and comfortable.  The kitchen is well equipped and stocked with condiments and seasonings of a well travelled cook. There is a small delightful patio off the kitchen to enjoy coffee in the mornings.  Located on a tree lined street, the house is within walking distance to the the university. Trader Joe’s and Walgreens are only a three minute walk away.  We certainly enjoyed our stay.

Zenobia was very welcoming and walked us through the check-in process in person! We got recommendations for places nearby to grab delicious food as well as a walk-through of amenities and how everything functioned. Any time we had a question, it was quickly answered, and check-out was also a breeze. The location was close to transit, had good parking available, and there was plenty to do as well!

Me and a group of 4 friends had such an awesome time and can’t thank the hosts enough for their hospitality- the neighborhood is lovely and walkable and the home itself was spacious, clean and quiet. Will definitely book again if I have the chance!

Our first time staying in Chicago & Jennifer's place from the moment we walked in felt right at home! Her place was nice & clean, & in a great area! She was very communicative & ensured that things were going smoothly during our stay as well as gave us some lovely recommendations for places to eat! When my boyfriend & I revisit, we are most definitely coming back to stay with Jennifer! Thank you so much again for providing your space! 🫶🏾💖

We had a great stay here! The place was very clean, comfortable, and had all the amenities we needed. Michael was responsive and easy to communicate with, which made everything smooth from check-in to check-out. The location was convenient, and the space felt welcoming and well taken care of. I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable and comfortable stay.

I will start off and say that Phyllis was VERY responsive and friendly which I really appreciated. However, the place was incredibly small. We planned spending most of our trip out and about so it didn't matter too much but I was not expecting that, especially the living room. It felt crowded with 4 people. I also recommend bringing your own shower supplies / toiletries because all we had was toilet paper and a few towels / wash cloths. The area is not bad but the actual location of the house did confuse me because it is very tucked away and almost looks like a large shed. Overall, it was not bad for a quick and busy trip but I would not recommend if you are looking to stay inside most of your trip!
Very clean place and nice safe neighborhood. Easy access. Accommodating host.
Nice place to stay at for a quick trip. It is really small, smaller than I imagined but still a solid place to stay at!

This apartment is cozy indeed. It’s on a very nice street in a very nice neighborhood. It has a lovely front porch, comfortable furniture and beds, and a spacious kitchen. It’s quiet, and our host was very accommodating. We enjoyed our visit and will definitely return!
TJ and Hatice were great! Clear communication, great location, space had everything we needed.
No problems at all - Perfect host, highly recommended

Great experience! Jermaill was super friendly and responsive. The space was super clean, bedroom was stocked with snacks and robes, and bathroom had everything we needed. Bedroom also had blackout curtains, which was super nice in the mornings. Would definitely recommend!
Cate was very nice and super responsive! Great place and will reserve again when i come back out there

Small but mighty! Cozy and super comfortable for two definitely snug, but it had everything we needed. The view of the city was beautiful, and the location was super central to everything we needed. Great spot for a short, easy stay!
Great location. Easy access to the train and neighborhood restaurants/shops.
We had an amazing stay! 10/10
Thanks Bennett and family, we loved our stay at your place!

This place was perfect- had everything we could possibly need and then some. And this may sound weird, but the water pressure in the master bathroom was so good- I wish I could use that shower all the time!! Can’t wait to visit again!!
Wanda was a nice host and we appreciated the opportunity to stay with her.
The place was right in the city, close to everything, clean, and had a nice view. Drew was very helpful and quick to respond whenever I had questions. Would recommend!
great place and area to stay. we had to walk alot and felt a noticeable difference in the area this place was at when feeling "safe" while walking at night.

Stayed for the Labor Day long weekend with friends - we really enjoyed the stay!
Kimberly was very responsive - she provided very detailed instructions which made check in very easy!
Location is very safe and very quiet at night!
Def will come back if I ever visit Chicago again!

Tomasso is a responsive, helpful, kind host. He was great in allowing an early check in. Great location. The downside is around scents and windows. If ur sensitive to scents there are lots of scented candles and products all around the house. Windows cannot be opened so there is no fresh air circulation. There is a lovely outdoor patio so that is a plus. Thanks for a memorable stay!
Nice room in a nice neighborhood.  Rodica was  very sweet and so was her cat!
i enjoyed my stay. i was in a nice area. victoria communicated very well about any questions i had. definitely would stay again

The place was clean and exactly as described. Easy to access and easy to contact the host. very reasonable price for the location and how close it is to many attractions in Chicago, while still being a quiet and peaceful neighborhood. very cute porch, garden/yard, and outdoor kitties. would recommend for your stay

The location was fine, the apartment was tiny but clean, but the parking was difficult. I don’t really feel like the value was right for this spot, but it served its purpose as a safe and clean place to sleep.

Denise and her family were wonderful hosts!  They were communicative and left tons of toys for our son to play with—she even went through them and removed the obvious choking hazards—which was truly above and beyond.  We all loved it!

Michelle was the absolute best host. Had a long trip, had to double back but got there! This one bedroom apartment was so comfortable, very clean and surrounded  by everywhere possible to go during  our stay there. We felt right @ home very quiet & peaceful. The bed is to die for very comfortable. we enjoyed our stay to thefullest.. I would give 100 stars. Michelle was great communicating and quick response. Was  very comfy,  clean and the cutest decor.  We lived everything, thanks Michelle 😊
We had a pleasant four day stay here and a great time in Chicago!
Brenda was nice, over-communicative and attentive to details. Her place is beautiful and spotless!

We loved this place, it's decor was unique and homie. The neighborhood was calm & it is located at a nice distance from prime neighborhoods and the airport if you're traveling.  I would definitely recommend this place

Beautiful place, the space felt like our own, despite other guests being present, everyone was kind and respectful. The place was clean and quiet. Even while i sat outside it was fairly quiet, with the exception of a little bit of traffic that was loud on occasion (it also was a saturday night) overall it was a great expirence ;)

Stayed for about 40 days. This place is all about location. I would love to come back. Keep in mind this is an art studio, the place is on the 4th floor and expect to see people move in/out. But that in of itself is so cool because you get to meet people that are from all over. Also, myself am not artsy particularly but I grew fond about all the happenings in the place. There were performances that I had never thought of in my head that was incredibly cool. Over the summer this place got very hot in the shared spaces, but within the room it was perfectly fine. Definitely need to adapt to it if you are used to being a well kept place. Again, I genuinely did not care for these things over time because the people I was around were so cool and William as well. I had alot of eye opening interactions and I would not have changed a thing. As winter comes I am guessing the place will cool down. William is an awesome guy and will definitely help if needed.
Great airbnb in one of the best Chicago neighborhoods. Hosts were easy to communicate with.

Marcus was very warm, hospitable and even provided a fan to help me get through the peak of summer. Very friendly guy, great communicator and the home was very quiet. Just what I needed after a long day of work, thanks Marcus!

We had a good stay! We had everything we needed and the place was as described. There are multiple doors that lock to get inside the unit, which helped it feel secure. We found street parking pretty easily. We could hear the upstairs neighbors walking around at times but that’s to be expected and the noise wasn’t excessive. One of the bedrooms does not have its own AC unit, so just something to keep in mind if it’s very hot out. We would stay here again!
Older & quaint duplex behind another home. Peaceful older neighborhood right down the road from a sweet shop. Felt safe the entire time. Ikechi was very communicative through out the entire process.
It was great!
Emily's space was very cozy and perfect for our weekend. would recommend!
We had a great stay at Abigail’s place! She was flexible about check out time as well which we appreciated.
Great location but had a issue with the water not working while the restaurant was open below. Also the noise level is pretty high.
Charming, spacious, comfortable, and beautifully furnished! John's place was perfect for our group trip and it felt like we were hanging out at good friend's house.

This was a great place to stay, highly recommend! Damani was great and super responsive. The space was perfect for my best friend’s bachelor party and the space was perfectly arranged and comfortable. If your in Chicago, definitely check this place out!

Darren actively communicated with me and was responsive. Neighborhood is quiet and close to Logan Square. Place needs a deep clean.  Kitchen towels look dirty. Splattered food on the kitchen backsplash and walls, behind the stove, on the stove. Full load of dirty dishes was in the dishwasher. Darren apologized. Strong gas smell from pilot light. Darren said he'd never had any issues, we found the smell quite strong every time we entered. One kitchen chair is broken, forgot to tell Darren that. My husband cleaned the floor of the bathroom which had visible hair and dirt. I wiped out pink mildew from the shower and the liner was pink and black with mold and mildew. Darren apologized again and said he would order a liner and I could use the washer to clean current one. My husband bought a new one from the Dollar Store nearby.
Great place to stay. Nice neighborhood and very clean. Very helpful and responsive host.
Oscar’s place was clean, affordable, and in a fantastic location! It was the perfect place to stay

The apartment was exactly what we needed for our long weekend trip. The space itself was very clean and the bed was very comfortable. LOVED all the natural light in the space. The apartment and building have very nice amenities (we took advantage of the gym space), and the apartment is shockingly quiet for where it is located. The windows must have been sound proof and there were no noisy neighbors! It was also in a great location - very easy to walk to restaurants/bars/the sights of Chicago! We had some issues with the internet, but Yaharra was very responsive to this.

Great location and apartment. It had everything you needed for a short weekend stay with a few friends. However it was very utilitarian and did not have any additional supplies/homey additions; e.g. no extra blankets or pillows. But otherwise was exactly as described.
All around great spot. Great location, owner is very timely and helpful. Would definitely stay again
Just like the pictures! Host is very responsive too! Great place to stay!
Easy walkable quiet neighborhood. Convenient to buses and Metra.  Great park and restaurants within walking distance.  Place was clean, and bright for a garden apartment.

Our stay was great, no issues.  Check-out is 10am, earlier than most places.  We wanted to go to 8 am Mass on Sunday, and then come back to eat & check-out, but timing wouldn’t work to get back in time, Chicago traffic is no joke!  We had to go to later Mass, but it worked out & Lillian offered to hold our bags. Just a heads up about checkout time, I missed this when I first made my reservation.  (May want to extend your last day if possible). Shoes off / on can be annoying, but I respect that rule, Chicago streets are gross! So knowing that extra cleanliness rule is in place, keeps the place clean for all!

Pretty decent stay overall. my only real complaint was the walk from the parking garage. usually there are elevators in the garage but not here. Great stay minus that annoyance. it helped get my steps in.
We had a great time,  the apartment felt a little outdated, especially for the price, but it was in a great location and great amenities.

We came down for a birthday trip and the Airbnb was perfect, great location and super convenient! I accidentally booked a day short but the host was very understanding and made it easy to extend. Had an amazing time, highly recommend!
Perfect spot for our group. We’re able to find multiple spots for parking on the street. Spacious, clean spot. Very responsive host!

Tiffany's place was exactly what our family needed. It was in a nice neighborhood. The place had everything we needed and was so cute. We appreciated how clean it was. My kids loved the front sun room. My husband loved running to the park and we loved that we were so close to the train to take downtown. Tiffany was an excellent host and told us everything we needed to know and more. We all didn't want to leave.

Ming's place is perfect, very well connected and one can easily move around the city, the house is very nice and Ming was always attentive and very kind, I would definitely come back to stay with her again
La habitación era muy linda y cómoda, con mucho espacio. Los espacios comunes bien cuidados y ordenados. Estuvo todo muy bien y la atención de Jorge fue muy buena!
Great location and Hatice was very helpful

Location was nice and quiet and had a "right at home feel" which was relaxing.  Brad's place was realy close to the airport which was convenient coming in/out and also not too far from downtown.  Definitely recommend!
Beautiful place to stay. Plus free parking in front was consistent.
Great host!
Great space. My family was comfortable and happy. Great location! We will definitely come back here the next time we're in town!
10/10 I recommend and would absolutely stay again!

We couldn’t have asked for a better stay. The apartment is tucked into one of the best pockets of Logan — mostly residential and peaceful, yet with a great coffee shop and bakery right on the block and gyms and restaurants only a few minutes’ walk away.
The building itself has a boutique charm, and what really stood out was Julie greeting us in person — such a rarity these days, and a treat that made the place feel like home from the very start. The apartment is bright, airy, and thoughtfully minimal. We stayed for a few months while visiting family, and it had everything we needed: comfortable for day-to-day living, spacious enough for family to visit.
Julie and her family are wonderful hosts — personable, attentive, and genuinely thoughtful. We host ourselves back home in Lisbon and always try to bring a sense of connection and humanity to the experience. Julie does the same, and it makes all the difference.
This isn’t just a place to stay in Chicago — it’s a home.

Overall the location made everything easily accessible. Lot was decently private and space had nice updates. While responsive- the host and I had some miscommunication on our own standards of cleanliness and I felt like a bit of a burden when asking for assistance with what I believed to be stained sheets. The place could use some minor updating on furniture and bedding / a few handy man fixes. I did feel this was a bit over priced for the level of comfort and cleanliness. Washer dryer was a nice touch. However I did spot a mouse in the kitchen which the host has been made aware of to hopefully correct the issue. Unfortunately was denied partial refund after complaint was made to support team. This place is fine for a quick get away but likely would not stay again simply due to personal experience and preferences.
Great Stay!!

this place was an awesome place to have for our labor day weekend in Chicago! right in the middle of the hustle and bustle, so much to do and see all within walking distance of the Airbnb, if you’re driving in, park your car nearby on SpotHero, forget about your car for the week and just walk!

This cute space was exactly like the photos. The beds are super comfortable, and the place was very clean. Love the location very convenient. There is a train in the back of the property, but it's not loud and it's kind of cool to see it every day. It's not a busy area. It felt safe and I would stay again.
Great location and amazing hosts. Thank you Heidi, I’ll be back for sure!

Location was close to downtown, and the proximity is what makes this a great listing. The surrounding area is a bit intimidating if you’re not used to it.
Leonid was great, and there wasn’t too much noise at all.
The bathroom was beautiful upstairs, with a gorgeous skylight and updated features.
Overall an absolutely great place for 1 or 2 people to crash.
Super clean place and close to the train station. Lillian was responsive with some requests we made.

I enjoyed my stay, the room was comfortable, the bathroom were sometimes clean too. but it was dirty sometimes, but not all the time, the living and the space was big too, but just with a weird smell. and sometimes there were a bunch of noises from the other people in the different house rooms, and also sometimes a lot of yelling and fighting too. but after all it was alright.
So close to everything! Perfect location for exploring Chicago.

This apartment is in a great location and is spacious and well equipped. Despite being situated in a basement, it is light and airy - it also benefits from some outdoor space. There is some noise (heavy footsteps) from the apartment above, but that is unavoidable in an apartment building. Michael is a perfect host who responded quickly to all our requests, including replacing a twin bed with two singles for our daughters. We had a fabulous time in Chicago and fully intend to return in the future!

I went there for a weekend and it was okay! The location was great, just couple minutes walk for the pink line which takes you to the city center. I have to say the communication with the owner was really good, he helped with everything and came immediately to fix the light in the bathroom! Good place for a short stay!
Great location in Irving park - walkable to restaurants, grocery store, etc. Very responsive host and airbnb perfectly matched the description. Would recommend!
Great spot!
Near UIC, plenty of walkable places, and necessities. Access to expressways, and local bars as well.

Me and my girls thoroughly enjoyed our stay here! The hosts were extremely accommodating and communicated well. We even locked ourselves out of the unit and they arrived within minutes to unlock the door, with no problem. 10/10 recommend!
Would stay here again! Only critique I would have is that parking was a bit confusing along with the location of the apartment. but after figuring those out it was great!

The location is great, walkable distance to Oak Street Beach, Miracle Mile, shops and restaurants. If you need to go further down to Sears Tower, Millenium Park, Field Museum / Soldier Field area, there's public transportation around the area and it won't take much time to get to those places.
The place itself is clean and has plenty of room to host 6+ people. It's also on a not so busy street, so it feels quite and private even though you are just a couple of blocks from Michigan Ave. Only two things I can think of that will make it a better place are 1.) The apartment's door knob and locks are tricky to open/close, 2.) There's a closet in the main area with mirrors in which one of the door/mirror isn't aligned as it should be so we didn't use it to avoid breaking it.
Cozy and great location!

I had an absolutely wonderful stay! The place was spotless, beautifully decorated, and even better than the photos. Patrizia was incredibly welcoming and responsive, making check-in seamless and stress-free. Every little detail was thoughtfully provided—from the continental style breakfast to helpful recommendations about the local area. The location was perfect: close enough to everything I wanted to see, yet peaceful and quiet for relaxing evenings. I couldn’t have asked for a better experience and would 100% stay here again. Highly recommend to anyone considering a visit!
Perfect location for us seeing a show at Soldier Field. We walked a ton. Not a lot in the area for late night bars, but we took the train into better areas with ease (5 min walk).

Great spot. Really good location, close to public transportation which made it easy to get to and from the city. Place was super clean! Beware of the automated air fresheners… they work great but will scare you if you’re not expecting them to go off.
the place was awesome 👌 recommend it 💯

Great location with plenty to do in the area. The place feels secure, and the host is friendly and responsive, which is much appreciated. However, the actual space wasn’t as tidy or spacious as it appeared in the photos.
My suggestion to the host: please ensure all amenities and appliances are fully functional and that the listing details are accurate before guests check in. People choose rentals to relax and enjoy their stay—not to spend time dealing with maintenance or unexpected issues like ants in the kitchen, defective faucet, water leaks and not enough blankets for 7 expected guests.
Many thanks for refunding the parking fees after the cancellation — really appreciate your help in sorting that out!
We had a lovely stay in the quiet neighborhood. It was perfect landing pad for our family of 3.
The place is as advertised. A bit far from the city center if you don’t have a car
We had a great stay.

Had a great stay. Clean, quiet, safe, and easy to access public transportations. I don't have a cat allergy and it was no problem for me, but I think it would be good to let prospective guests know that a cat is on the premises (upstairs) and may sneak downstairs - in case guest may have a cat allergy. Otherwise, no issues at all.

Oscar's place was so clean and comfortable, felt right at home away from home. Beds were super comfy! Awesome neighborhood, close to transportation but it didnt disrupt sleep or tv watching. Oscar provided excellent instructions but could have been more timely as we had to wait a full day on wifi instructions, but minor considering all the other great things  about this place.

I stayed in Karen's place for 11 days and my stay there were great. The place was very clean and well organized. Whenever I had an issue or concern, it was easy to communicate with Karen. Overall, I really liked my stay there.
Perfect location. Great restaurants nearby. Close to park. Very comfortable space. Would definitely stay here again!
To say that this place was perfect would be an understatement!! Clean, spacious, had everything we needed and then some! I will definitely be coming back when I need a place in Chicago.

This Airbnb was perfect for our visit. It was located a less than a ten minute walk from Addison Station. The place is on a happening street, with lots of bars and places to eat nearby. However, the place itself retained a bit of privacy by being located farther back within the block rather than right up against the sidewalk. This also made space for a super cute private garden area out front to relax at. The breakfast was great too!
Todo muy bien. El lugar podría estar más limpio pero en términos generales bien. El problema era la ubicación, ya que nos comentaban los ubers que era un lugar bastante peligroso.
Debra was very polite and helpful in her instructions and provided many helpful local recommendations

Had a fantastic stay here and highly recommend. The space has all that you need and more, Bella and Andrea were responsive and kind. When my initial entry code didn’t work, I was immediately given an alternate and was in my apt within 5 minutes. The room was spotless, quiet, A/C worked and the kitchen was fully equipped. Walked to the lake daily, ate amazing Cambodian food, and easily took the red line. This is a great find!

Tenna was so kind, efficient and flexible! She made sure she was there to personally let us in, give us keys, and show us where everything was. She even went out of her way to find out what flavor of coffee creamer we wanted so that she could get some on her own grocery run. She had just about anything in the bathroom closet that you could forget. The kitchen had the supplies to make all kinds of meals. The place was adorable, quiet, and spacious. She was very responsive the entire time, too. I sincerely wished that we had a longer stay. I highly recommend!!

Third time staying here. The British room is so comfortable! The only problem we had was not realizing the parking pass was in a slip on the back of the door to the room. It was usually on the bed or nightstand so we ended up getting a parking ticket cause we didn’t understand the parking around the area. Easy access great directions getting to your rooms. Can’t ever hear anyone else in the home. It’s crazy it’s like no one is there but it’s sold out. I love this place and we will be back again!
Very clean space. Clear instructions and walkable to the bus stop for public transportation. I would definitely stay here again!

Jake has a fantastic spot and is super clear about instructions and expectations. He was extremely responsive and the place was beautiful. Perfect stay for something walkable to Soldier Field and right near the Red Line. Chinatown is a great place to visit! Very peaceful, clean, and private!
Accommodations were great! We have no complaints.
Very clean, it was a cute little place. Had a small issue, host was very fast to resolve it!
We had a wonderful stay in a very clean and beautiful home! We felt very comfortable here!!

John’s home was wonderful and very easily placed to walk or take public transit!
It was clean and John was proactive in sending the check in information!
The neighborhood is beautiful and definitely would be family friendly.
John’s cozy home was lovely and I’d absolutely stay again!
Good location, safe neighborhood, Joe and Alex are VERY professional and proactive. Always a good experience here.

We had a wonderful stay at Charles' rental. It was perfect for what we needed it for. Charles kept the lines of communication open and was very responsive. Had no issues during our stay. Would definitely recommend!

I spent a week at Bennett. Everything went according to expected! Nice room with private bathroom and Easy access to public transportation (right at the corner) Quiet area as well!! Bennett was very friendly as well! thank you!
My friends and I had a very nice time staying here. We ate great food at the nearby restaurants and had a very easy walk to the Blue Line.
Fantastic experience in a serene and safe neighbourhood.
ABSOLUTE PERFECT LOCATION if you’re going to Wrigley Field.  Close to the train for transportation and felt very safe.

This place was not an enjoyable stay. I came  because I was waiting for the start of my lease. I was met with an extremely dirty and dusty environment. The bathrooms were both filled with hair, there were stains on the shower curtain in the upstairs bathroom. The place looked like it hadn’t been clean in weeks. It was truly dusty and on every surface area. Not clean at all.
Maria's place was great!  Beautiful condo on a beautiful, quiet street. Ample street parking made it easy to come and go. Would definitely stay there again.

The price was a bit steep for the area and space but overall it was a fine stay. The gift basket they left in the room was INCREDIBLE and very much appreciated.
Remember its a shared space so internet isnt the quickest & when people are in the common areas sound Travels very easy.
There were stains and hair on the sheets and a pee stain on the matteess, the toilet paper holder was falling off the wall and the bathroom needed a wipe down. All seemingly minor but be prepared.

We had to arrive late than expected and Bryan was extremely accommodating and even extended our check out due to our late arrival.  He checked in everyday of our stay through the app messaging and responded when we had questions.  Overall we were very impressed and thankful for such a caring host!
10/10 recommended place to stay! The home looks just as pictured & Melvin was a great and attentive host! I would stay here again .
Very easy check in and looked just like the photos. We went to a concert at Wrigley Field and it was so close, perfect stay!!
Safe and convenient location, clean and homey apartment, great communication with the host.
Easy to get into. Steve checked in on us every day. Overall a nice stay!

Kymi's place is well worth the stay. The photos show a beautiful well maintained home and the property does not disappoint. The house is bigger and more spacious than it seems in the photos. Check-in is a breeze. The house was spotless when we arrived and had every amenity you would have in your own home. All bedrooms are spacious and the master bathroom is a real treat for relaxation with the steam and rain shower.
The neighborhood is beautiful with flowers right in the front of the house and tree line streets everywhere. A large park is just a few minutes walk away for enjoying the outdoors and there are many great local restaurants to choose from. Navy Pier and some wonderful museums are a short drive away for tourist and downtown is only 15 minuets away making the neighborhood a quiet get away from downtown for those on business.
Kymi was a wonderful and informative host and an absolute pleasure to meet.
I 100% recommend this place for a great stay in Chicago.
Perfect stay and nice location.

Everything was as described I had a great time there so that I also extended my stay for another week.
David was an awesome host. I like when the airbnb is owned by a private person and the host is living in the same place. So David was always available and gave good recommendations for the area.
The area was also really good and feels safe. There are a lot of good Mexican restaurants in this area. Easy access to the pink line and bus (both in 5 minutes walking distance). With the pink line you will be in the loop downtown) in around 25 minutes.
I would always book with him again when I am back in Chicago
We had a great stay! I loved the location and proximity to the lake, grocery stores and parks. We had everything we needed for a comfortable weeklong stay. Thank you!

Clara and Jennifer were a godsend! We previously booked another Chicago Airbnb which ended up being a total roach motel and quickly left and rebooked with these two who accepted us on the spot with open arms! We felt at ease and a sense of relief for their superior hospitality! The space looked modern and simple which is what you want. The shared living part wasn’t that bad either, everyone was cool! All the sweet welcome basket gifties were really special and displayed nice upon arrival to our room-the linens, toothbrushes, breakfast bars, etc! We’ll remember this spot for the next trip to Chicago in the future!

Ran was very responsive. Check in instructions were very easy. The location is great for what we need, which was close to the train station, and plus there was an available parking spot at the back. The place can use some dusting and a little cleaning though. The second bedroom has accumulated dusts in the bed and furniture which triggered my allergies bad. The pull out couch was broken- the other half was detached when you open. Otherwise, the place was in good condition, it had what we needed for a short stay.

Vladimir's home was beautiful and safe! I stayed with my 2 children. Good restaurants close by & only 15 -20 mins to downtown.
There were a few concerns like the overall cleanliness. The blankets had yellow and red stains in them. The main bathroom had long hairs on the floor, & urine on the toilet seats. There were dirty dishes in the dishwasher that smelled like food was rotting. I contacted Vladimir about a bee or wasp hive outside of the balcony door and somehow one came inside hours after we'd come in. - I got no response from him.

When I arrived the padlock did not work for the rear gate/ did not function. I specifically chose an Airbnb with no one else in the house only to find another person was upstairs. The house was clean but had a noticeable car urine smell. I understand pets were allowed but a leftover scent is unsanitary. I only stayed for about half an hour but left due to noise from someone upstairs and a crying baby. One of the main reasons I also left was due to the door lock in the back not locking. I did not receive a full refund for this or even half .
It beautiful quiet home! Was perfect formehat we needed for the week!
This bnb is in a nice quiet spot. It had many food options surrounding it (vegan included). Also not far from Union Station. We enjoyed our stay.

After an Airbnb Horror Story we stumbled upon Guillermo’s stay, and we’re so glad we did. He truly makes his house feel like a home. To the family pictures around, to the games and books in the living room, he truly created a space that my Boyfriend and I were comfortable staying in, even though it is a shared space with other guests.  We had a long stay here since we just moved from out of state and were apartment hunting and working simultaneously. However, once an apartment we were looking at opened up early and we requested an earlier checkout date, he did not hesitate to accommodate our needs.  When things came up, he was very professional and respectful as well as present to make sure that everything in the house ran smoothly.  The laundry accessibility was a breath of fresh air after running from laundromat to laundromat for a couple of weeks.  And for those who like to cook, the kitchen/dining area is such a cozy space to have a meal. If you are visiting the city, stay here!
Spacious one bedroom in a good area. Check-in instructions were a little confusing at first as there were two locks and only one worked. Place was clean and host responded to all questions.

Our stay was for 2 nights.
This was our first visit to Chicago, so we had many queries.
Hosts were very responsive and cooperative . They shared all necessary information and responding to all our queries. A Big Thank you for that.
Place was clean, safe, peaceful as described. Kitchen was well equipped to cook food. Will rebook next time as well !!!
I stayed here about a week, Bart and Rachel were very sweet and the space had everything I needed. I would also recommend Barts restaurant Chez Adele 🍔

We stayed for almost a month and had a very positive experience. The Internet connection was great and my wife and I had no issues using it at the same time for work the entire time we were there. Bucktown is a great neighborhood for eating/dining/public transportation. Argelia was an excellent host and even altered her plans to let us in after we (knuckleheadedly) locked ourselves out one night.

Jake’s place was great. Jake’s directions and communication were top notch. The place was perfect for 4 people. The beds were cozy. The apartment was close to the Red Line, restaurants and bars. It’s a great place to stay.

Keenan’s place worked out great for my stay. I’m a student at Loyola and needed a place for a few weeks during repairs at my apartment. Location was great and Keenan was responsive to the few times I had questions. Will recommend for out of town friends and family.
We enjoyed our stay.
A perfect place for our family getaway. I highly recommended.

Favorite Airbnb for us because we were 1/2 block from the concert venue. A little sorry we didn’t know it was a lower level (like a half basement). Such a wonderful neighborhood with row houses converted to apartments, lots of shade trees, all conducive to wonderful walks. Loved many of the restaurants within a 2-3 block range.
Otherwise, it was roomy, very well kept, lots of light through windows and lovely string lights, had multiple amenities that served us very well over our extended stay, and Gwen was a wonderful help on several occasions. Our sincere gratitude for making this family trip a highlight of our years of adventures!

We had a great stay at Chris' place. There was plenty of room for all 7 of us and the location was perfect. Good restaurants within walking distance and right next to a target. Would definitely recommend for a group.

Lisa is a living doll! She was extremely welcoming, gracious, and kind. Her main concern was our comfort. Lisa was the best host we've ever had! Her place was pristine, and filled with everything we needed. The location,  near Hyde Park was ideal for the activities we had planned. This included a White Sox/ Yankees game and a concert at Huntington Pavillion. We highly recommend Lisa's place!! We hope to back sometime. We would definitely rent Lisa's place again!
Beautiful place in a great area and the host was responsive and helpful! The bed was comfortable and it was great having a full kitchen.

We loved this home! I love staying in places that actually look like a vacation. The decor was so nice. The view was beautiful. The neighborhood was nice and quiet. I would definitely recommend staying here.

I have stayed at many Airbnb’s, in multiple states, and Nate’s place has been my favorite! Beautiful condo that felt like home. The bed was extremely comfy, the perfect place to relax after walking all day. It’s a 7 min walk from the green line and a quick walk from a great grocery story. Nate was also responsive, helpful and nice. Would stay again!
Excellent stay at Steve’s place! Everything was clean and as advertised. Neighborhood was excellent and everything was walkable and safe. Would definitely stay again.

The place is well located, in a quiet neighborhood and close to the metro, with many restaurants nearby. The room was tidy, although the pillowcase had a brown stain and the sheets didn’t feel very clean. On the positive side, the host provided us with clean towels and slippers, which was appreciated. If you are tall (like my husband), the bed can feel a bit uncomfortable. Bathrooms, kitchen, and dining area were clean and well maintained.
Unfortunately, on the second night we couldn’t sleep well because of noise from other guests. The sound isolation is not the best, so you can hear when people are loud, especially after quiet hours. Overall, it’s a convenient place to stay, with a great location.
Great stay. The hosts were very helpful.
Toy was a great communicator, providing instructions for entrance prior, etc.! We were in town for a concert at Soldier Field, this location worked perfectly!
Very safe, the host is extremely helpful. They have someone on schedule keepinf the apartment clean. Highly recommend!

had a great time staying here! the room and bathroom were very clean and the host was very helpful with our questions. free parking at this location and there was always a parking space open on the same block which is always great in big cities! would definitely stay here again 😊

La casa de Jason nos proporcionó una de las mejores experiencias en Airbnb en Estados Unidos:  ubicación muy buena, a un paso del trasporte público que te lleva al centro directamente, en una zona con muchas opciones de restaurantes. La casa incluye todas las comodidades e insumos que puedes ocupar y más diriamos nosotros. Jason es un super anfitrión. En resumen, nos sentimos como en nuestra casa y definitivamente lo recomendamos. Nosotros, cuando volvamos a Chicago vamos a buscar esta casa. Muchas gracias Jason. Nota especial: las mascotas son adorables !!
La luz no encendía, lo demás todo bien
Excellent place.  Can't wait to stay again.   My wife and I boyh highly recommend.  Everything we wanted and more.

Joe was great very responsive and easy to work with. Id recommend staying here if you visit chicago it is a bit far from the downtown area but there is plenty to do around the area anyway. Other guests weren’t messy and kind me and my friend enjoyed our stay. Photos dont do the Private room justice.

The place was very clean and about a 30-40 minute walk or less to Soldier Field, the Field museum, and other attractions in town. Right on the edge of Chinatown with extra paid parking for extra vehicles and lots of restaurants.

Great area, super walkable to the park and zoo and many restaurants. Could hear the neighbors a bit at night. Was great for what we needed and for the price, but could’ve been cozier. Needs some pillow and towel upgrades to feel more comfortable but overall was a good stay.

Nice studio apartment, first time being in Chicago I didn’t expect the parking fees to be so high and to be far from the parking areas. Could’ve had better parking but they did inform us on the best parking around. Gave us great recommendations for activities, plus good restaurants across the street that’s great. A fun art studio next door downstairs. Onsite they had a nice fitness area downstairs and pool table in the basement. Free coffee in the lobby during the week plus the host provides it, overall great stay and I’ll come back!

Tram's place was exactly as described in the listing. The place has been set up for hosting. I specially liked the king bed in the bigger room which is rare in an air bnb.
The place was spotless and kitchen had all the required accessories. Tram is an excellent and very responsive host. I will definitely love to stay again.
Ola’s place was a good location for our needs. Check-in was easy and the host was very communicative.

Great location in Chinatown. Tons of restaurants and shops. Close to the train and also very walkable. In town for an event at Soldier Field. Less than a 30 minute walk and was able to avoid a whole lot of traffic and parking issues.
The place itself was very clean and had just what we needed. Would definitely stay again. If for nothing else than to eat my way through Chinatown......
The location is amazing,  green line is less than half a block away! The place can use some maintenance on bathtooms and furniture updates to bedrooms. however overall it is a great place.
The place was very neat and clean and easy access to CTA transit. Victor guided everything well and in timely manner.
Great place - very helpful host - would recommend
it needs help. the pictures make it seem nice but once inside everything is small and the walls etc need some tlc

If you're looking for a squeaky clean place for quiet time and personal space, this place is for you. I was super impressed by the cleanliness, especially the bathroom, and even more so since this is an older building.
Josh was super friendly and professional from messaging to check in and this was exactly what I needed / wanted when I was looking at places. Definitely plan on staying here again when I visit next.
Nice place
Nice modern apartment with doorman. Central location that is safe and not too busy. Lots of cafes nearby and accessible parking nearby. I recommend it.
Perfect stay, excellent neighborhood, easy walk to multiple restaurants and shops. Clean and convenient, hosts were available and welcoming.  Would stay here anytime!
I was here for almost two weeks. The apartment was excellent, clean and organised. Charlie was supportive when it was needed.

I truly  enjoyed my time in Chicago… I was dropping my daughter off to DePaul and it was a bit emotional for me … Ms. Carol was AMAZING!!! She picked up on that energy and became the ultimate host !!! She invited me  to her yoga class , told us about a  local restaurant to frequent (and you could walk there )… did I forget to mention she greeted us at the house when we drove in—simply AMAZING !!! Our family will sincerely  use her space again…💚🩷💚… Fantastic home, delightful neighborhood , host with a  sincere and beautiful spirit !!! I’m thankful to have been in such a peaceful space when I was going through such a profound transition, dropping my only girl and last child off to college  .. 💚🩷💚10 out of 10 , would recommend ..Thank you Ms. Carol…Sincerely..
The location is convenient for enjoying downtown. The train is a very short walk,  and there is plenty of parking nearby (need to use parking apps).

It was a very comfortable stay, everything was in order and clean, I highly recommend the place and I would stay again. The host is very friendly and willing to help with anything or doubt you have, excellent stay!

Sunny is a wonderful host . She is very easy to communicate with and always helpful. The place is in a great location, and the managing staff are super friendly and welcoming. I really enjoyed my stay and will definitely come back!

Nate and Ty were perfect hosts. Location was near enough for affordable Uber, Lyft, Taxi service.
The shower was really good. Great water pressure.
We felt safe and snug the entire time.

We had an incredible stay at this beautifully renovated Chicago bungalow in South Shore! The home strikes the perfect balance between modern comfort and historic charm, with calming aesthetics, cozy organic textures, and even plants that made the space feel fresh and inviting. Everything was spotless and thoughtfully designed for relaxation.
Zen was warm, responsive, and made sure we had everything we needed. It truly felt like a home away from home, and the quiet neighborhood made it easy to unwind after busy days of sightseeing.
We would absolutely recommend this spot to anyone looking for a unique, comfortable, and culturally rich stay in Chicago. Five stars all the way!

Great experience usually I find it hard to get a place because I’m young but with great communication we were able to get a understanding and I can book my spiritual self care day. The place was absolutely beautiful matching the theme perfectly of what I was going for and very quiet besides hearing a dog for a little bit but didn’t bother me. Very clean and warm and I had a beautiful time 10/10🌺

Such a great Airbnb experience. Quiet neighborhood with good parking, right by all Milwaukee Ave has to offer. the bathroom really is spa like! I loved my stay here and would absolutely come back again next time I’m in Chicago!

I've really enjoyed my stay, the room is comfortable and quiet, the common spaces large enough for few people to hang around, the neighborhood is amazing, this is what I've enjoyed the most. And public transportation very close, just a short walk to the metro station and bus stop. Highly recommended.

We had a difficult start to our stay due to a misunderstanding with the upstairs tenants about parking, but our host was very responsive and quickly resolved the issue. Unfortunately, similar problems with the same neighbors continued throughout our visit.
We also encountered some problems with the apartment itself. The entire place had a strong sewer smell from a pump in one of the rooms, and a toilet in one of the bathrooms was frequently backed up. Although our host offered to send a plumber, we were able to fix the toilet ourselves and opted to handle it. The host was also quick to address and resolve other smaller issues that came up. We really appreciated how promptly they responded and provided solutions.
If you decide to stay here, a few things to keep in mind are that the provided pots & pans are worn out as so are some of the dishes, so you may want to bring your own. Also, be sure to pack house slippers or socks, as there's a no-shoes rule in the house that’s unlisted.
This was a great place.

L’alloggio si trova in una zona pericolosa della città, aspetto non segnalato nell’annuncio e riscontrato per le testimonianze di tutti gli autisti degli Uber presi in 4 gg di soggiorno. Nelle immediate vicinanze non c’è nessun servizio (ristoranti, market, bar), il market più vicino è a 15 minuti a piedi. L’annuncio della casa dichiara 12 posti letto, noi eravamo 3 famiglie tot 11 persone,in casa ci sono 6 posti letto regolari (3 camere) e 2 materassi gonfiabili + 2 divani NON letto. My family had an excellent stay. The place was extremely comfortable and spacious and truly felt like a home away from home. It worked perfectly for a family trip. The neighborhood was nice, charming, and very walkable, with fun spots like a nearby vintage shop to explore. Everything was seamless with clear instructions for check in, check out, and the stay itself. They did not need to contact anyone because it was all so easy.
One area for improvement would be the timing. Check in was at 4 PM and check out at 10 AM, which we made work since I live nearby, but it could have been inconvenient otherwise. It would be nicer if these times were more in line with hotel standards, which are typically a 12 PM (or at the minimum 11 AM) checkout and a 3 PM check in.
That said, the home itself was wonderful and made for a really comfortable and enjoyable family stay. We truly appreciated how nice it was and would happily recommend it.

I had high hopes with this booking, but after everything I’ve gone through, I would not recommend her place when staying in Chicago.
1. There was no central a/c the entire time we stayed here. Bosede claimed that the issue would be fixed, but now I feel as if it was just a lie to keep us there.
2. At 11pm at night, she had some man drop off fans to the location when she told me it would be here that was coming.
3. After dropping off the fans, she didn’t reach out to me until 6pm the next day to ask if the fans were cooling us off.
I think it is unacceptable as a host to know that you didn’t have the a/c working in your place and to only offer a refund for one night’s day. Only after filing a claim with Airbnb, she offered half of another night.
I will NEVER stay at this place again. For those looking to use her place while in Chicago, make sure the a/c is working before getting settled in. If it’s not working, leave immediately as she has no plans of fixing the issue.

Clean well kept great location!!

What a gem! Humboldt park was such a cool area to stay in, I enjoyed spending time in the park & being surrounded by the Puerto Rican culture. The space was clean, and Kristen was super responsive and accommodating. I would definitely stay again!

The host was right next door and very accommodating. Let us check in early, and stored our luggage after checkout so we could mosey the city for the afternoon. I left a pair of shoes and he was very responsive in finding them for me and sending them to me. Highly recommend!
good stay

We so enjoyed staying at Tiffany and William’s place! Our family of 4 was on vacation in Chicago for the first time but we wanted a cozy place to come back to every day. This hit the mark for sure. There were so many fun details in the unit and there was plenty of space for us. The location was close to public transportation, which was great, and close to several other fun neighborhoods. They even had beach towels available in case we headed to the lake, which we did! Would definitely recommend!

The apartment was clean and the building amenities were great. Loved the pool, pool deck, and hot tub. The building itself was very quiet and in a quiet neighborhood, that was an easy walk to lots of restaurants, bars, and the CTA. We use the suggested parking, which was reasonably priced and within a few blocks of the listing.
Wonderful unit, great communication from hosts, and overall worth the stay.
Shaena has a beautiful apartment and she was a great host to us. very helpful and super responsive
Surrounding area looks a little sketchy but I had no problems there. Very close to UofC

Great house, very spacious. Has everything you need and is in a good location.
Super nice and helpful host as well. Will definitely be returning
Súper recomendado 🥰 lindo sitio y Patricia muy amable
We really enjoyed our stay!
Amazing place n Amazing hosts

I needed a simple and clean room for a single night in Wicker Park and this delivered. Without question, I would book this again.  Especially this room with the porch overlooking the sitting garden. Very cool.

Rhett's home is lovely with beautiful art and furnishings, a relaxing back yard, and well stocked with essentials.  We hope to have an opportunity to stay here in the future.  It's one of the best Air B n B's that we've visited.

We stayed here for 3 months and had such a great experience. The house was lovely, clean, and had everything we needed for a long stay. The location was ideal, close to shops, restaurants, and easy transport to the downtown. The host was fantastic – always responsive, friendly, and made us feel so welcome. We’d highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Chicago.

My son had a summer internship in Chicago after his Junior year in college. I was in search of a safe neighborhood with walkable public transportation. Jennifer's townhouse location was perfect. The place is beautifully renovated with all the amenities he needed. She did a facetime video tour before even booking the place since we were not local. Jennifer is very friendly and always responds quickly to any questions. We would book her property again in a heartbeat! Thank you again for making our son's summer internship stay in Chicago very hospitable. Kind regards, Dipali & Ankit Sahasrabuddhe
Great place to stay.
The flat is much larger than it appears in the photos.

Positives about this place:
- Great location
- Communicative hosts
- Clear instructions for accessing the building/unit
- TV with streaming apps was nice to have
What I didn’t like:
- The bed was extremely uncomfortable - the mattress was hard
- Only two pillows on the bed, no other pillows or cushions anywhere in the apartment
- Hot water didn’t work in the shower the entire stay (2 nights), had to take freezing showers
- There is air conditioning, but no thermostat in the room and no fans provided - it was uncomfortably hot overnight
- Peeling lining in the bathtub, broken mirror in bathroom, upkeep of the furniture and fixtures wasn’t great
- Multiple messages from hosts requesting 5-star reviews and pushing promotions for their other (completely unrelated) businesses - I didn't appreciate this
Overall, the place was ok and got the job done - we needed somewhere to stay for a quick trip and didn't want to stay in a hotel downtown. But I don't think it was worth the price.
Dziękujemy i pozdrawiamy 😊😊😊

I didn’t stay here. Booked for families visiting us.
Clean. It’s an older property however well maintained. Exactly as per listing. Extra Parking is a great plus in this part of the city. Lisa was a great communicator.
This was a really great place close to Wrigley Field! Parking was very tricky on game day, but we managed. We would stay again!

I stayed here for a conference at McCormick Lakeside and it was perfectly walkable - about 10 minutes and very safe. The nearby market made picking Milan's space a "no brainer". The view of the City from the room was remarkable. The beds were SO COMFORTABLE and the space had everything I needed. Milan was very responsive leading up to and throughout my trip. Both check in and check out were very easy. It was nearby many transit options, adding to the walkability of the location. I highly recommend booking this space if you're at a conference or enjoying Chicago for multiple days, especially if you're doing so without a car.

Nice stay very close to UChicago (walking distance of 15 mins). The host was very friendly and responsive. The bathroom was clean, and the apartment very big.
The solution is cheap.
The only downside was the noise in the room due to air circulation during the night, which was a bit hard to control.
In any case, recommended
Overall a nice place to stay at and lots to do in the area
Great location, easy instructions, had a great time!

Beautiful, comfortable space in a quiet neighborhood. Ruth is a lovely host and made me feel right at home. The space was spotless and had everything one would need. I recommend anyone stay at Ruth’s Tiny Home! Fantastic!
