We stayed for a month in this apartment with 2 small children, the location was just perfect, the amenities were incredible and overall had an amazing time.
Jennifer was very responsive and sorted everything we needed within minutes of asking.
Highly recommend staying there

The beds are very comfortable.  The street is pretty and was quiet. Some of the electrical outlets looked unsafe to use. The pictures displayed on  Airbnb have no cracks on the walls, that is not the case. There was a hole in one of the bedroom floors dangerously around the vent. I chose the place partially because of the ability to enjoy the outdoor area, it was overgrown and had mosquitoes.   It would have been nice to have hand soap pumps in the bathrooms, we had to purchase some. We were a party of six. There was one roll of toilet paper in each bathroom, extra rolls would have also been nice. We had plenty of face towels and could have used more body towels. The owner said this property is 40 minutes from Downtown and it definitely was.   Heavy Downtown traffic only added about 15 minutes longer to our daily commute.

Great place to stay and is as advertised. Close to all the main Chicago attractions and close to public transportation. Highly recommend and much better than staying at a hotel. Felt at home. The gym is great and was able to keep up with my workouts in the evening.

Afsha was very responsive, and the unit was clean and a good size for my partner and I. It was close to everything that we were looking for, and the lower ceilings were not an issue for us. My partner is a bit taller, but we were prepared for the height, and the ceilings were clearly marked where appropriate. Overall a great place to stay in Chicago!

Mirela’s place was perfect for our family of 6. It’s in a great location in a super cute and safe neighborhood with easy access to downtown; she gave super easy to follow instructions for check in and out; the house was very clean with a well stocked kitchen & bathroom, and she was super responsive when we asked for restaurant recommendations!
all around top-notch

I stayed at 747 Lofts in Chicago and really enjoyed it. The space was clean, modern, and comfortable, with the high ceilings and open layout you’d expect from a true loft.
The best part was the location. West Town has a creative, neighborhood feel with great coffee shops, restaurants, and galleries, and it’s quieter than downtown while still being just a quick ride to the Loop. It felt like the right mix of local and convenient.
Overall, 747 Lofts is a great choice if you want a simple stylish place to stay in Chicago with the bonus of experiencing West Town’s local charm.

My wife and I stayed with Cathie and Marcus for about three months and it was great!
They are responsive and caring hosts and the apartment is well-equipped and comfortable.
I recommend them to anyone and everyone!
Lovely time at this BnB! Location and walkability were terrific. Steve was wonderfully responsive and helpful.

Absolutely awesome place, seeing the planes take off and land due to the proximity to the airport was a added bonus, it’s just a 25 minute drive to Chicago city. The rooms are spacious and cozy, basically had 2 living rooms. It was great definitely eyeing this place for future Chicago visits

This place has a great location and is overall pretty nice.  The kitchen is stocked VERY sparsely - there were only 2 water glasses when we arrived but Steve did send over more the next day.    It could have been cleaner.   There was definitely some debris on the floors and coffee mugs needed re-washing.   Steve did offer to do a touch up clean but that didn't really work for our schedule.    It would be great if there was a table and chairs on the balcony and  things like extension cords so that you could plug in chargers.     It's  a nice place just needs a few more amenities!
We had a great stay! The Airbnb was very clean and spacious. The back patio was beautiful! However, there was some leakage in the basement because there was heavy rainfall.
El departamento está en una ubicación perfecta y en unas condiciones excelentes. La comunicación ha sido increíble desde el principio! Sin duda me volvería a quedar ahí cuando vuelva a Chicago.

This place was amazing - wonderfully clean and well equipped and in the absolute perfect location, in the center of everything while still being quiet. We reached out to Randy and Steph in a bind when our first Airbnb didn’t work out and they responded quickly and got their place ready for us to check in just a few hours later. We are traveling with a baby so this was a huge huge gift! They were also proactive about checking in and making sure we were all set during some hot days. We hope to stay again!
Great place！Nice location. But the towels are not so clean and there’s a bug in the shampoo. Other than these, the place is great!
Nice place and comfortable

We loved our stay here! The condo was really clean, cozy, and had everything we needed. The location in Bronzeville was perfect—close enough to get around easily but still felt chill and safe. The host was super responsive and made check-in easy. Definitely would stay here again!
Great communication, and extremely friendly! Would definitely stay again!

Spectacular location! Just a few blocks from Wrigley one way & all the shops and life of Northalsted the other. The unit is cute, functional and well apportioned. Mo had ice in the freezer for us and a full pitcher of filtered water in the fridge; very thoughtful. She was responsive to my questions and provided detailed instructions. There is an M on the front door, which is not the unit # and confused us at first.
It's important to note that the listed rates are only for 1 person; she charges $35/night for a 2nd guest. I know that's allowed, but it surprised me as I didn't realize I accidentally booked just for just 1 person and don't see the reason for the extra charge.
I found the bed to be quite uncomfortable. There is an extremely soft mattress that slopes to the middle, which pushed me too close to my partner on a warm night. The bed squeaks a lot too, which is tough on your partner if you toss & turn. I would appreciate better pillow options, too. Mine was very thin and soft.

I absolutely loved the fact that there was a reserved parking space.  It was very nice inside but you had a lot of stairs to get there.  This was a great location if catching a Cubs game.  Great neighborhood.

After a 7 week stay, we must say this was THE BEST Airbb we’ve ever found. We were greeted with a bouquet of fresh flowers, a bowl of fruit and giant chocolate chip cookies! High end designer finishes drew us in the first place. The location was surrounded by great restaurants, grocery stores and shopping. Only needed to call Jeff once for a little help with the TV and he responded immediately. If you are lucky enough to find this large, beautiful condo available, rent it!
Great place for a quick night! Would stay here again!
Great place and area. For the price it’s the best in Chicago. Hands down

You're paying for location, not amenities, which is good because the location is fantastic and the amenities are pretty basic. Happy with choice and would stay again. Accessible to several bus routes and the lakefront, as well as Lincoln Park.
Great host and airbnb

LekBne’s place was great!  They were responsive to any requests or questions I had.  They provided very clear instructions to check-in including photos to avoid confusion.  The apartment was just as expected.  The best part is the location.  Just a block to the lake and a few blocks to L and a handful of restaurants.

Helen is awesome! Friendly, polite and helpful. Great to chat with, as well. She even bought me lunch from a local soul food restaurant because of a conversation we were having. It was a very kind gesture. Definitely be back the next time I'm in Chicago.

Apartamento espaçoso com 2 dormitórios e dois banheiros. Muito conveniente. Piso extremamente sujo e toalhas e roupas de cama de baixa qualidade com aspecto sujo. Muito próximo ao Centro McCormick place mas a região muito perigosa.
The place was great! It was super close to public transportation, restaurants, parks. Definitely would recommend
Sadia is a great host - helpful, friendly, and organized.  And her place is amazing!

This is a good place to stay for solo traveller. Safe location. Convenient by public transport. Close to supermarkets. 30mins to the Loop. This is a good place.
Be prepared for a small room that you will face difficulty opening your luggage...

Great location! Very peaceful and safe. The photos actually don’t do the condo justice! It is a very large space so it was a nice surprise having extra room. Very clean and the hosts were very responsive and helpful! Highly recommend!

Ewa’s place was outstanding, and I would not only recommend it based on the space itself - but the hospitality and attention / care from Ewa was second to none. She was super helpful, very friendly and a great person to stay with. This was my best Airbnb experience to date!
I highly recommend this place to anyone travelling to Chicago!

Check in was easy, Martha and Manolo were very friendly and explained everything clearly.
The place was very cozy and bright.
We missed a little a kitchenette and the ceiling, as a classic Chicago bungalow stile , was not so high.
The little porch was enjoyable.
Some lack of privacy for the bathroom.
In the end though was a pleasant place to stay.

Outstanding service! We stayed here during our cross-country trip with our two dogs, and the staff went above and beyond—whether it was helping hold the dogs while we checked in or assisting with loading our luggage into the carrier. The hotel is perfectly located, within walking distance of everything in this beautiful city. Housekeeping was excellent as well. This will definitely be our go-to choice whenever we return.
Very good!
As described and convenient location to get downtown! Shay was also very responsive and helpful!
Thank you so much Casper!!!

I so enjoyed my interaction with Felice!  If I lived in town, I would want to be her friend. Positive, sense of humor and wonderful artist. Her comfortable home is perfectly situated in Rogers Park- near to anything you could want. This will be the first place I will look to stay at when I next return!
Excellent location!  Great home base. Cozy. All you need.
Great hosts, great price

Great location ! Very close to alot of stores and food and a short walk to the blue line train which takes you to and from the airport. Garden/ basement unit but very spacious and comfortable beds.
Would stay again, Thanks Cassandra !

We were very happy with our stay! Everything was super clean, beds/pillows were comfortable, and had everything we needed. Having little kids I appreciate the bathtub stopper. Also the soaps were great, the kitchen had everything we could need, can’t recommend this place enough. I do wish we were a little closer to the L and the street it’s on is very noisy but everything inside the apartments is great!

Great place had everything we needed.
Would definitely be back. Thank you for having us
Always a pleasure to stay by Menachem. He’s a very responsive and helpful host. Thanks for hosting me again!

My daughter and I stayed here while apartment hunting.   The space was exactly what we needed and very clean. Loved the outdoor space!   Was very close to public transit making getting around the city a breeze.  Mary was friendly and  helpful making our stay a very pleasant one.

Malgré une arrivée compliquée car le ménage n'avait pas été fait, Helen a été réactive. Une fois le problème réglé, nous avons passé un agréable séjour. L'appartement est spacieux, confortable,  avec une jolie décoration et très bien équipé ; on s'y sent bien. A environ 30min en voiture du centre de Chicago, quartier calme et stationnement gratuit, ce qui est un vrai plus. Proche également des commerces, bars et restaurants. Idéal pour un séjour en famille, je recommande.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Lourdes’ Airbnb. It was spacious, clean and truly commodious. In particular, the beds, linen and comforters were super comfortable. The entire apartment was thoughtfully decorated with artful and interesting flourishes. Lourdes made sure that, when we arrived, she was available to guide us through the apt.’s security system so that our entry was unencumbered, and she generously offered her help for any other issues that might arise. There is no question that on our next trip back to Chicago, we’ll be sure to reach out to Lourdes to reserve her Airbnb.
-Lew
The place is a true Diamond in the rough, once inside you’re in a getaway from all that is around you!
Everything was cleaned and ready
perfect for us, great location
I would recommend people to stay here! The host was really kind and proactive. The surrounding seems pretty safe and quiet, but it might be hard to go around without a car
Rich has a very nice, convenient place.  He is cordial, and accommodating.  Shared common kitchen and dining areas are not for everyone,  but Rich was very good about providing reasonable privacy.

Our stay at Toy's residence was a pleasant experience. The room was exceptionally clean and well-organized and the quiet environment offered a sense of privacy. We appreciated the effort put into by the host in maintaining the space.

Absolutely responsive, willing and on top of all the positive comments already made in regards to place, location, transportation access and neighborhood feel, Josh was more than willing to help us out in a pinch. With a delayed piece of equipment sent to us during our stay, Josh kindly managed a solution to our problem. That is hosting at a 10 plus. Thank you for the home, the flexibility and your generosity.
Great spot and fantastic neighborhood. Would be happy to stay here again!
Ran was very helpful and responsive to our requests. We greatly appreciated his expediency! The stay had plenty of parking and was a great value.

We had a great stay! The apartment is right next to the beach! We loved to swim in Lake Michigan. The apartment was awesome! Diane is a very friendly host. Her instructions about how to get inside were very clear and accurate. We loved the apartment, the beach and the close distance to Loyola Station. It is about a 10 min walk away. From there you can get easily to Chicago downtown. We truly enjoyed our stay and highly recommend this apartment.

We stayed for more than a week and everything went very well. Leonid was very attentive and his girlfriend is very kind. The bathroom is shared but we never had any issues with availability. The room is spacious and perfect for two people. The AC didn’t cool as much as we expected, but overall it was fine. The metro station is just a few blocks away. The neighborhood doesn’t feel very safe, but we personally didn’t have any problems going to and from the station—you just need to take the usual precautions. We would definitely stay here again.
A great spot for my 3 day trip. We loved the location and had everything we needed!
This was one of my favorite Airbnb experiences! This space was easy to find, beautiful, well-equipped, and in a fantastic location. Highly recommend!!

The studio was thoughtfully designed and made great use of the space - I had everything I needed for a comfortable stay. The location couldn't be better, with easy access to the L, buses, grocery stores, coffee shops, and restaurants all within walking distance. I'd happily stay here again!
I like the place it was very peaceful and the neighbours are very nice. It was near by Chicago Downtown and it’s easy to ride a buss ..

I was very well received by Geeta and her family, she is an amazing host! She was really helpful with plenty of recommendations to do in the city.
The place itself is a basement unit with its own entrance. It feels very homely and will have everything you need.
It has windows to the exterior you can open to let plenty of light in too.
Has a kitchen fit to prepare meals, with an oven, stove, microwave, fridge and utensils.
I was very well received and it would stay there again, definitely recommend!
We had a wonderful stay at beautiful place with a great location!
The apartment is nice and clean. Everything you need was provided and the area is great.
I've stayed at many houses close to Wrigley, but I believe this is the absolute closest.  Thank you for the great communication.
Great place to stay!
Accommodating host, clean space. Would visit again. :)
Extremely clean and comfortable top-floor apartment in a quiet and walkable part of Avondale. Easy access to Logan Square and the blue line to O'Hare.
Excellent accommodations for a long weekend!
It a great place to stay. Provides excellent service and has a proactive host. Would recommend the stay for the price. Just remember, you are in the southside of Chicago.

Our stay at Tom and Angie’s exceeded our expectations. The apartment was beautifully decorated and very comfortable. The turntable and vinyls were a nice addition.   Tom had a notebook of menus and recommendations, which were sooo helpful. The neighborhood was cool and interesting. We loved it and would recommend highly.

I had stayed at their AirBNB in the same building last November, and it was really cozy, so I decided to stay here again this month. The unit I was in was really comfortable and clean. I ended up extending my stay by one day.
The owner was responsive when I asked if I could extend my stay. She also responded when I voiced concerns about something I left behind at the studio. She said she would check with the cleaner—although the outcome is still up in the air as I write this.
My only issue was that someone from management came by to inspect the blinds and the bathroom just as I was about to head out, and he ended up spilling some water on the floor so I had to clean up right before I left. It would also be good if there was a microwave in the unit. Anyhow, I still enjoyed my stay and I would love to stay there again when I come back.

Excellent communication.  Great location.  It is a very popular location so the room is small for the price.  Perfect for two people.  The unit is very clean and modern, but the building is showing age.  It would have be nice to have a little more room for a couch.  I would stay here again since you can't beat the location and the owner made the stay easy to check in.

My stay at The Dugout was fantastic, earning a 5-star rating! Just a 2-minute walk to Wrigley Field, the location is unbeatable. The apartment is cozy and well-equipped, perfect for a Chicago getaway. I’d definitely return! Note: the backyard access is a bit unkept, and low ceilings may challenge taller guests (over 6 feet). Some might notice minor floor creaking from above, but it didn’t detract from the overall charm and convenience. Highly recommend for a memorable stay!
Loved the location
Great stay overall!
Great Stay!
I had such a good time! The place was cozy and Sarah was super welcoming. Definitely recommend you stay here!
Great unit, clean and safe.  Location was perfect for easy access to Loyola University.  Lots a good restaurants nearby.  Leila was very responsive and helpful with the check in process.

Kasey’s apartment was very comfortable, easy to access, very clean and homey. Her apartment has lovely little touches, and having access to a kitchen and en-suite full bathroom makes things incredibly easy. The neighborhood has a couple of good cafes and a big supermarket nearby, and it is easily accessible by public transportation.

La propiedad de Anny es ideal si quieres ir en grupo y tener tu espacio.
el departamento es amplio y comodo
la ubicacion es muy buena para recorrer chicago. todo a un paso
Gracias por recibirnos!
Great location and great apartment! Highly recommend.
Great experience at Esmirna’s Airbnb  she’s a wonderful host!

A comfy place to stay in a great location. The bed was comfy, the curtains kept the room dark, and we were pleasantly surprised by the overall quietness of the bedroom. I expected the city noise to be a problem but it was overall quiet. They went above our expectations and provided us with a crib and a bucket of toys and books for our toddler to play with.
The location was amazing. We walked to wrigley field and to the lake. Wieners circle was great and is right next door. There is a 7-11 and a target nearby. Lots to do.

I went back and forth on leaving a review since I have never left a bad Airbnb review before, but I don’t want another family traveling with a baby to have the same surprise we did. When we walked into the unit it immediately smelled like cigarette smoke throughout, of course this could have been situational since none of the other reviewers had this experience but it was strong enough that we did not feel it could be fixed by opening the windows. We were also traveling with our one year old and did not feel comfortable staying there with him. When we reached out to the host to share our concerns, we did not hear back for over an hour and while they did send someone over, their only offer of remediation was to spray something into the air to cover the smell. No proactive discussion around solutions we would feel comfortable with, just denial of a smell and refusal to offer a refund when we needed to find another place to move to last minute.
Fantastic communication from Milan. His instructions were very clear, he accommodated our family of 7 nicely.

My Mom and I had the best time visiting Chicago and staying at this location, with Nate as the host. He was so responsive and welcoming, the neighborhood was quiet, and there's a grocery store within a walkable distance as well as public transportation. The apartment was spacious, clean and comfortable. I would definitely stay here again on my next visit!
Thank you, Nate!

This is the 4'th time we have stayed with Molly. As always, the room was super clean, and the mattress is one of the most comfortable we have ever slept on.  We always enjoy seeing Molly and her 2 Gordon Setters and hopefully will be able to book again when we come to Chicago next year.

Nathan’s condo was extremely spacious and clean. It had a very homey feel to it and it was very comfortable. His check-in instructions were easy to follow. We will definitely look to stay here when we return to the Chicago area. We also loved the surrounding neighborhood. His condo is beautiful!
Good place good location so nice

we had a lovely stay here. very close walk to L train. we parked in the garage which i’d recommend, street parking would have been tricky to find. cozy beds, well stocked kitchen- we would like to come back!

Clean and easy to access. My only issue was the super low ceilings weren't mentioned in the listing. I'm only 5'10 and my friend is 6'1. We both spent a lot of our time hunched over so our heads weren't brushing the ceiling and he hit his head on the door jam into the bedrooms a couple of times. The bathroom mirror was mounted so low we had to bend all the way over to look into otherwise we'd only see our chests in it. So, if you're a shorter person, this is a nice spot to stay, but if you're 5'10+ in height....beware the ceilings.

We loved our stay here. My main priority is always safety and privacy and we got just that. I loved that we had more than enough space than we actually needed and how responsive John was. We definitely agreed that anytime we visit again if this space is available we’d rebook. Finding parking was a hassle at times but, not overwhelming.
Exceptionally clean with good amenities.
Great place to stay i loved everything
Very prompt responses to emails; the dedicated parking slot behind the building was very convenient as on-street parking was full.
Very nice place, cozy and me and my family we did have a great time.

House is beautiful and made for a great stay for our group. Plenty of room to spread out with lots of areas to congregate and have fun. We didn’t cook but the kitchen was nice.
My bed was very comfortable but one of our friends in the room with the bunk beds said the mattress wasn’t very comfortable.
Overall, was a great place to stay and would definitely stay again. Highly recommend.

Overall, the house met all our needs. We could walk to the mini mall in the area. There was a great neighborhood sandwich shop that we often visited.   But, the linens on the bed weren't fresh and the 3rd floor hadn't been thoroughly cleaned. Grass was overgrown so the curb appeal wasn't appealing.  All in the all the house was comfortable and we'd definitely stay again but a few things would need to be addressed before our arrival.  Rafael came when we called and that was a definite PLUS.  So yes, I would recommend staying here with a few minor adjustments.   I'd give his place 4.5 stars.
Delightful stay, lovely space in a pleasant neighborhood.

A fantastic place near the city proper and great access to public transit (both the Brown Line and the bus) - Jean was great and responsive and helped answer all of our questions! Plenty of room for some friends looking to chill and hang out, had a super great time :)
This place was clean  quiet neighborhood I had no problems with the property.
Very nice and responsive host ! We had an amazing stay in her home. Check in was very easy and straight forward.

Perfect for what we needed! So walkable and heaps of useful things nearby, not to mention being absolutely spoiled for choice in restaurant options. It was great!! Thank you again for a great place to stay. It was well stocked and comfy.

It was a good place to stay if you have a lot of guest. There are a few things to mention. There is only one parking space for the apartment. If you take two cars there’s a limited amount of space to park on the street that doesn’t require parking permits. You have to get there early to get a spot. There are a lot of stairs to get to the apartment. The balcony door in the living room is broken, you can only access it if you go through the stairs from the back. Also furniture for the balcony was not the same as the picture. Bathrooms were not properly cleaned, especially the showers. There was a lot of dust in the bedrooms. Not enough toilet paper and dish soap had to buy some ourselves.

We stayed to visit our daughter and the location worked well for us. The unit is simply ok and we would have probably been more impressed if we didn't have all of those additional 3rd party "management company" procedures. We assumed it was a more luxurious apartment than it was. Furniture was minimal and not amazing quality. Kitchen amenities basic, at best. TV didn't work for us. Grill in building didn't work and unit had no equipment anyway. Overall, we didn't feel it was great value for money, especially since it wasn't fully cleaned for us. We wouldn't stay again.

Aaron was a wonderful host and both the house and location were excellent. There were a lot of great restaurants within walking distance, good access to transportation, a quick walk to the Wicker Park Farmer's Market, and several gym options nearby (Anytime Fitness is two blocks away, does guest passes, and had everything we needed to get a few workouts in). Highly recommend!

This is a beautiful vintage building filled with wonderful modern art. Modern Kitchen and baths. Great big dining table. The beds are good. The owner is very responsive. But there are some things future guests should be aware of: the only common room furniture is uncomfortable - no place to just relax; TV only in 1 bedroom and difficult to work and no regular channels; neighborhood is not the hot West Loop area, but rather an isolated area about eight blocks south of there near the highway and United Center - a bit sketchy; and on Saturday night the Mexican restaurant directly adjacent to the property rented to a private party blasting dance music until midnight. The noise was so loud the windows were shaking.
Pretty much as advertised.

Noelle and Robs place was perfect for our adult children and Laurie and I (6 total) to spend a weekend.  It is located on a quiet street with lots of family homes.  Lots of parking on street. Communication was easy.
Miguel’s home was very beautiful, easy to access,  and peaceful. Miguel was an amazing host and friendly. Can’t wait to return!

Avoid this host at all costs. We documented everything and created a full YouTube review exposing this experience. No one deserves to be treated this way, do NOT book with Adrienne.
We booked Adrienne’s Airbnb in Chicago and what should have been a smooth stay turned into a nightmare. One of our guests couldn’t make the trip, so we asked about a refund. Adrienne declined, and we confirmed we’d use the reservation as booked. Immediately after, she falsely accused us of having 3 guests via her backyard camera and attempted to charge $25/night extra, even though footage showed us leaving after helping a friend and leaving the property untouched.
Adrienne then removed the keys from the lockbox, effectively locking us out of a property we paid for. She ignored all messages, only admitting on the last day she had taken the keys and “put them back.” While the property was nice, Adrienne’s manipulative and hostile behavior made the stay impossible to enjoy.
I enjoyed my stay! Very comfortable and nice room. The air conditioner worked perfect. The bathroom very clean. I would definitely stay again!
Jasna was a great host. Her home is beautiful and well maintained. I look forward to staying here again!

I was traveling to Chicago for the first time and traveling alone and Richard’s place was very comfortable. I felt safe the entire time. I had everything I needed and felt right at home. Highly recommend and would absolutely stay here again!

This place is in a decent neighborhood.  We felt safe there and right around the corner was a "Little Italy" which we enjoyed going to. The beds are comfortable,  the couch not so much. Its made for a very long legged person and support on the back. The place is a decent size. The kitchen had most appliances, but we were missing oven mitts, a tea towel, baking sheets for the oven. and the cutlery is sparse. A garbage in the bathroom would be convenient as well. Overall not a bad place to stay.
All in all it served my needs well.  Pot AND COFFEE were appreciated. 😊
Great place for our weekend in the city. Thanks again!

I had a really great stay with Patt! She is a wonderful host who genuinely cares about making her guests feel comfortable. Patt went out of her way to work with me and accommodate my needs, which I really appreciated. The place itself was clean, comfortable, especially for students or anyone new to Chicago who needs quick access to the CTA. Being close to public transit made getting around the city so easy.

I’d definitely recommend staying here if you’re looking for a reliable and welcoming host in Chicago. Thanks again, Patt, for such a positive experience!
Highly recommend this place. The place is neat and peaceful. Very accessible to public transportation. Overall a very welcoming place to stay.

Lovely two-bedroom apartment. Close to Lake Michigan beach, with everything you need within walking distance - shops, coffee shops, metro, etc. The neighborhood is nice, with plenty of places to spend time with children. The apartment has everything necessary for a long-term stay for a family of three.
I want to highlight the hospitality of the host, Donna. She was always available and helped with various questions; thanks to her, our stay was wonderful.
I would like to note that the area has limited parking. In the evening, we sometimes had to look for a spot, but this is not the host's fault. There is also a paid parking option, which we decided not to use.
Donna, thank you so much, everything was brilliant !
We had a wonderful stay, highly recommend!

It was a comfortable place to stay. It was nice having essentially a whole living room (with a mini fridge and microwave), personal bathroom and personal bedroom to myself. There was plenty of street parking and the public transportation was a 10-15 walk away.

Olivia and Tom were great hosts and would regularly check in to make sure everything was okay during our stay. I really appreciated their organization and clear instructions, which made check-in very easy. They were also very helpful with providing recommendations for things to do and restaurants to try.
Good stay, apartment was comfortable for everyone
Everything was perfect!

Kendra’s house is unique, in this historical place that you can learn much of early golden days of great Chicago. And the rooms are so clean, we spent 3 nights and so enjoy every minutes in this house. The kitchen is fabulous, we even found a slow stew pot, so we can cook a traditional family ribs for our kids. And the neighbors are so kind, a lady showed me where is the garbage tank, we talked a lot. And the most interesting thing is we saw a family of raccoons, they are so cute!
In a word, we love Kendra’s house!
I really enjoyed the stay. Joe and his wife are very friendly and communication was great!Would definitely stay here again!

Excellent little brownstone pad nestled on a sidestreet in the Wrigleyville area. It fit my needs perfectly! Bed was very comfortable, and the shower was roomy. Bella was very responsive and communicated clearly. Would happily book again.

Carol is a great host! Very welcoming, responsive, and helpful. The place was clean, spacious, quiet, and had all the amenities we needed. We truly enjoyed our stay and will definitely book again in the future.
This stay was perfect for our weekend getaway. Highly recommend!

Terrence was a great host! We did a long term stay on our J1 and he was so responsive, friendly and helpful (especially with required docs he had to fill out for us) He was communicative and the place was fabulous - great location with transport too! Would 10/10 recommend and return in the future.

The host was always quick to respond to my many questions
Her home is warm inviting and comfortable
Close to train Safe neighborhood. A pleasure to walk around
The beds so comfortable

Cute/quaint apartment in a quiet and comfortable neighborhood.  Great spot for a weekend trip.  Close to popular areas but away from massive crowds.  Very nice area to walk your dog.   Heather gave great recommendations for restaurants and bars.  Would have given a 5-star review, except that the listing said there was parking on the premises, when only street parking was available.  Nonetheless, I’d still stay here again!

The place was tidy and and as described, a quiet and great neighborhood. With the starbucks being a couple of steps away.
Definitely recommend

I really enjoyed staying at Mirela’s house with my group! It was a great home base for all of our activities.  Very quiet and in a great neighborhood. My only con was that the key to get into the house is a loose key which for a traveller with a large group trying not to lose the key or remember it in my personal keys was a constant. Definitely recommend having a keychain or something identifiable with the key just as an easy grab in a purse or pocket. Otherwise I had an amazing time in Chicago and would 10000% stay there again!

La habitación es pequeña pero cuenta con todo lo necesario: buró para escribir y trabajar en computadora, secadora de pelo, ganchos para ropa, conectores de luz y mesa de noche. Igualmente la cocina u baño están muy bien equipados. Cerca del alojamiento está la línea azul de CTA, y a unos 35 minutos caminando el centro de la ciudad. la colonia es linda, tranquila y se come delicioso.
Rosseana fue muy amable siempre y responsiva. Es un gran alojamiento. recomiendo ampliamente.
A bedroom with en suite bathroom and private entrance in a great location in Chicago.

My friends and I throughly enjoyed our stay at Yolanda’s place. We actually got to meet her and she was very friendly and willing to chat with us about Chicago! She gave us some recommendations that we added to our list to check out during our trip. Would definitely stay again!
Great stay, very accommodating host. Do not hesitate to book.

Overall, the place felt very clean and comfortable. The amenities were great and anything we forgot to pack was prepared and accessible. We barely ran into other guests and felt like we had the whole place to ourselves at time. Personally, I felt it was a bit warm, but my partner thought it was fine (temperature isn’t freely adjustable). Location was quiet and safe. Only downside is that it’s pretty far from downtown. It’s about an hour to get to downtown either by bus or train. Host was amazing and communicative. We really enjoyed our stay.

Julie’s home was exactly as pictured in her listing photos. We appreciated her attention to detail, quick response times, friendliness, and ease in which we could check in and out. We feel like she went above and beyond to make our weekend stay a pleasant one. Thank you!
Solid option for a large group stay in Chicago, as long as you don't mind the short walk to the Blue Line.
love this  place for my family very cozy and comfortable
What a beautiful experience!!  Immediately upon opening the door it felt like home.  Such a pristine environment with an amazingly responsive host.

Our stay at this location was amazing.  We were in just for a couple days, so it was the perfect quaint, centralized, and accessible home-base to have while going out and experiencing the surrounding neighborhoods.  It's a short walk to the Lake Front, which we took further up to the beach, and also a good distance from Wrigley Field - not too close that its crowded with fans and not too far so we could still walk.  The restaurant/bar selection in the area was awesome and the corner stores had everything we needed.  Street parking wasn't too bad at all considering there were Cubs games everyday, especially with the help of parking apps!  The back porch area was a really nice touch and provided some extra space when we needed it; the shower was also really nice and spacious for the place.  We would definitely stay again.
Holly was great and a wonderful host.  I used to travel on business 26 weeks out of the year. This home is a great place to stay.
Great place. Well appointed. Great quiet neighborhood, well located, and comfortable beds

The unit is located near to some of the Hyde Park's attractions, including food and culture. There was ample street parking and it was also close to highways. Inside it was as described, with a porch area in the back of the unit where you can eat outside, if so inclined.

The place is exactly as pictured and in a great location if you are looking to explore the Andersonville neighborhood or north Chicago. The hosts are extremely responsive and kind. The unit is well-stocked with basic necessities and then some. Will rent this unit again in the future.

This place was perfect for the 2 of us. We had our own bathroom and entrance with access to frig and microwave. The host was nice and would make coffee in the morning if we requested. Would definitely stay again!

This place was very clean. The club below was loud Friday and Saturday, but we brought our own speaker doe brown noise and I never woke up. Very friendly people. Great location for going around to other spots. We didn’t check out the local neighborhood but all was safe and convenient. Great spot overall.
Chill place near the city. Spacious room, hot water, secure with key/ auto-lock doors & a solid room setup. Great for a simple basic stay.

Marie was such a great host. The place looks exactly like the pictures and is actually quite charming. It was very comfortable! She is also super responsive and easy to reach if you have any questions! I highly recommend!

Very nice place to stay. The apartment is spacious, has everything needed, fully equipped kitchen, comfortable beds, AC. Nicely located near to markets, friendly neighbourhood, lots of free parking spaces but also near public transportation stops. Also Victor and his family are very friendly and were always ready to help with everything we needed. Thanks a lot for a nice stay.

Un apartamento agradable para pasar unos días en Chicago.  Está bien ubicado, cerca de un supermercado,  al lado de parques y a un corto paseo de Lincoln Square. Destacaría la tranquilidad del barrio.
this place was super cool! I loved it my family loved it! Maria was awesome!!
Tanya was a great host, very responsive and also very friendly. The place was exactly as described and was exactly what I need for the 2 weeks. Thanks Tanya!!

We had a great stay. The location is great, as we were able to walk to nearby restaurants and other local businesses. There is street parking and we were able to get a spot within a couple of blocks each day. The home was clean, comfortable and well maintained. We would stay again!
Great place to stay in Chicago. Landlord and admin very efficient.
Will not stay there again.
Было приятно остановиться у Jose! Большой плюс в наличии стиральной машины и сушилки, личная ванная комната! Спасибо Jose!
never used Airbnb before, Carina was amazing!

Staying at Prema’s was a lovely experience! The house was very clean and had a really homey feel. There was always clear communication between me and Prema. I thoroughly enjoyed the last 2 months here!😊 If you’re in chicago, book here!!
The price is reasonable for the house, as it's a bit older, but it has everything you need for a comfortable stay. Doris is an excellent host.
Great place, very clean and well stocked. Great communication with Brett!

Lilian’s place was spacious and beautiful. It had all of the right kitchen amenities. The place was completely free of clutter but felt comfortable. Close to the red and purple line to get downtown and across the street from the grocery store.
Amazing experience, fully recommend to anyone looking for a great place to stay in Chicago

Alan was a great host.  He was very accommodating and responded very quickly with any questions we had. The condo was very clean and smelled nice! It was also well-stocked with an abundance of towels, toiletries, and kitchen utensils. We stayed there for an event at the United Center and it was a very short walk. The train station was also nearby, making it easy to get in and out of the city. I would definitely recommend both Alan as a host and the Cozy Condo as a place to stay if you plan on visiting Chicago.
Very clean interior.  Great location to museums and main attractions.  Would go back
Nice place exactly how  you see from the picture the host was great

Dario's place was nice for our large group. I'd bring a hdmi cord and a laptop because the TVs left a lot to be desired on wireless connectivity(casting from a phone etc.) Place was exactly as described and Dario was responsive throughout our stay
We had an excellent time during our stay. Carole and Basil were so helpful and kind and responsive. Would definitely recommend!

Kelly’s home was the perfect place for us to stay in Logan Square. The space was beautiful, stocked with everything we needed and we felt welcomed and right at home.
The hosts were proactive and responsive. I highly recommend their place and would definitely stay here again when I am back in the area.
Superb accommodations! Dede was a wonderful host, and the basement unit is so thoughtfully appointed. Very comfortable and clean. I highly recommend this place!
Cool place! Michael was really chill even when we were late for checkout! Thanks!

Our stay was great! We were a 10 min walk to where family lived so this was a perfect location. Chux was flexible with check-in time which greatly helped when we arrived 2 hours before check-in and had a little one that was dying for a nap. We had a great stay - the kitchen and living areas were spotless, the bathrooms were luxurious, and the beds were very comfortable. Thanks for a great stay!
Very detailed and thoughtful set up clean and fresh smelling
The host was very responsive whenever we had any questions or concerns. The space was beautiful and exactly what my group needed for our trip. Would definitely book again!
Great place with amazing decor! Tess was super proactive with communication and the place was perfect for me and my wife. Location was great, especially when the temps outside are 90+

Holly’s place is easily walkable to Wrigley Field, shopping, groceries and great restaurants. While it’s close to everything, it’s away from the chaos. We were worried about parking, but there was no need. We were able to find on street parking easily right in front of the place.
My stay was wonderful! The place felt very homey and was clean. It’s in a pretty quiet neighborhood, which made the stay comfortable. The host was very responsive throughout my stay.
Cate was very responsive and the place was extremely clean and comfortable. Will definitely visit again!

We had a great stay. The location was perfect- right around the corner from a grocery store, Starbucks, and other restaurants/bars, as well as the train station. The house was spacious enough for 11 of us and everything was well stocked including the kitchen. Would highly recommend if you’re visiting Chicago.
Place was as described. 2 adjacent units, more or less the same composition. No issues at all. We enjoyed our stay. Host was responsive and helpful, no complaints!!
Matt and Doug were amazing hosts and their property was extremely unique and homey!! Highly recommend. The surrounding area is amazing as well.
Great stay!

Air conditioning went out the second day we were there. It took them about 8 hours to respond. Host reached out and said it had to do with a safety feature on the thermostat. The issue was never resolved during our stay.
Beautiful area, good parking, but the place needs to be cleaned better and there needs to be better communication on the hosts end.
Great place to stay, with plenty of room and a great vibe.
It was a great stay! Loved the place and the area. Would definitely stay here again. Thank you Stephanie!

This adorable apartment is truly a hidden gem in Irving Park!  Absolutely gorgeous and brand new!  Perfect for 2 people to have a lovely weekend in the area!  So easy to get to and free parking right out front on the street makes it so convenient. Very easy check in and love the entry with its easy coded door locks!  I cannot say enough good things about the host Yadi and his beautiful apartment!

Charles provided clean, comfortable and welcoming accommodations for us during our stay in Chicago. He provided several recommendations for establishments to try out in the area as well as helpful instructions for us to get into the city using the subway. I will surely look to stay there again when in Chicago!

We loved the place. Great stay for a group. Beautifully decorated! Fun neighborhood. Keeping up with the key was a struggle for use but Magdalena made sure we had four copies. She also baked us cookies! Highly recommend!

This place was a great stay, it’s quiet and close to a lot of things. There was street parking so that wasn’t a hassle. The penthouse is clean and the kitchen is equipped with everything you would need. Also she has cards games and the massage chair was the best thing, you could fall asleep in it. The only issues we had were with the locks and keys, when we arrived the keys weren’t in the box but she responded in a timely manner and brought extras, you had to wiggle it a bit which could be frustrating to some. Other than that I would stay again or recommend to others.

Great space and great location! walkable to anywhere you'd want to go in the neighborhood with plenty of public transport to take you farther if you wanted to see the main city. We caught 3 cubs games while staying at this location and it was everything we wanted it to be!

This apartment is a unicorn in the downtown Chicago area. The rooftop is absolutely one of the best I have ever seen in a city-views are iconic . Apartment is cozy, clean, comfortable and well-laid out. A++. Reggie is a delight. Couldn’t recommend this place more highly.
Great stay in the basement of a bungalow house in between Avondale & Logan Square.  Pretty roomy space and a short walk to a ton of great restaurants and coffee shops

We enjoyed a great long weekend in Chicago. Apartment is in a great location, tons of amazing restaurants within walking distance either in Lincoln Park or over in Bucktown/Wicker Park. Highly recommend.

Jefferson was a pleasant host, he was the perfect balance of engaging and allowing privacy as well. The location is is good, even though on a busier street you can park right in front and I noticed no noise from the street at all.
Alexandra was a great host and the spot was awesome!
good experience

Tejal is an incredible host. We had the chance to chat and connect, and she’s truly so thoughtful and lovely, it shines through in every little detail of her home.
The space was perfect for my husband and me. The plants are beautifully cared for, there was tea to enjoy, and the bed and room were so comfortable. Tejal even thought of those “just in case” items, like soap and shampoo, which made everything feel effortless. The shower had great water pressure, the towels were soft yet absorbent, and transportation was easy with plenty of walkable options nearby.
Whether you take time to slow down in the mornings with the stunning sunrise views, or you spend your days out exploring, coming back “home” to this sanctuary was such a treat. We left feeling refreshed, grateful, and already dreaming of returning someday. ❤️

Satisfied! It's a bit far out and the neighborhood is a little sketchy, but the house itself was good. The main floor and upstairs are beautiful, the basement floor with two bedrooms and a bathroom were less attractive but were good accommodations overall. The backyard is quaint and nice. I would definitely consider staying here again with a large group.

Myself and my friends stayed here for the summer months. Ming was a great host, always responsive and helpful when needed. The accommodation was exactly as described in the photos and by Ming - a budget accommodation. It’s in a nice neighbourhood with easy access to bus links to the city and cool local bars. Would recommend this accommodation to a friend👍
Great communication. Great place to stay for a cubs game! Thank you!
Very spacious and a great find for us!
recommended

This home was just as pictured and a 15-30 min drive from everything I wanted to do! Ava was so kind, thoughtful and an overall great host! Responsive if I had a question and checked in with us throughout the weekend. She's a top tier host! The place was a perfect size that I'm recommending it for a girls trip in the future! Grateful for this amazing find!👏👏👏👏
nice, clean & comfy place. plenty of spots within walking distance

This was a wonderful place to stay, had everything you could possibly need. 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, and I think the sofa in living room even turned into bed if needed. Jake (the host) was very helpful an extremely fast responser.
Close drive or train ride to city, lots to do around the apartment itself. Very quiet place, didn’t see or hear from any of neighbors. Would highly recommend.

Great long term stay here. Right beside city and public transport accessible. Lovely neighborhood and clean, modern facilities. Fantastic hosts who were highly informative and answered any questions almost immediately. Overall, 10/10 stay!
The place was just as described. Beautiful and clean.  It was about a 25 minute uber to Wrigley. Great food options within walking distance or a quick uber ride.

Came to Chicago for a 4 day stay to check out the city. Rosemary’s airbnb was PERFECT! It was the absolute perfect location to be close to the city (Hyde Park and beyond). It was a 7-25 minute drive to all of the places we visited (Art Museum, Shedd Aquarium, Field Museum, Science & Industry Museum, downtown Chicago. Even a good distance from Medieval Times) just for reference! Very clean and comfy. It’s in a nice neighborhood where we felt safe, lovely park right across the street. On top of this, the free street and alley parking was top notch and spacious- something that mattered to us. We also enjoyed the small talk between Rosemary and her husband when we encountered them. Very friendly! 11/10 recommend staying here during your travels.
Great location. Nice and quiet while still being close to everything Chicago has to offer.

We had a wonderful stay! Micheal, the host, was very responsive and always quick to reply, which made everything smooth and easy. The apartment was warm, cozy, and very clean — it felt just like home.
Good location, good spot
Maciek was a great host and his place was exactly what we needed for a weekend In Chicago. We would definitely stay there again.

Let’s start with the pros:
-damani accommodated an early check in time
-location was very good
-place was clean
Cons:
-parking instructions were unclear and our car was threatened to be towed.
-WiFi is non existent
-we accidentally broke one rule regarding the pool (entered the upper deck unknowing it was off limits). Instead of giving us a warning, Damani restricted pool access for the remainder of our stay, and threatened to cancel the reservation if we used the pool again.
While I appreciated Damani’s early check in time, and overall responsiveness, he was extremely threatening and non-understanding. Our group was 10 people, all respectful, and it was sad that he was unwilling to allow us to use the pool, and threatened to tow our car late on Saturday night when we were all out enjoying the city.

If you’re looking for a spacious apartment, located next to Chicago downtown without having to pay a lot of money, this is the place. It’s a good experience for the price you pay! However, don’t expect luxury, sparkling clean or an exceptional service, it’s just value for money.
Place was exactly as described. Host was very responsive to questions and helpful. Plenty of walkable restaurants.

Great stay! Check-in seemed complicated at first but was actually simple. The apartment was spotless, stylish, and even better than the pictures—especially the two floor-to-ceiling sliding doors (one to a full balcony, the other partial for fresh air). The AC was perfect on a hot Chicago day, and while the host values cleanliness with a few rules, I appreciated this as a 40-year-old woman who values a neat and tidy space. It’s on the third floor, so keep that in mind, but overall it was a comfortable and refreshing place I’d happily book again.
Super nice host and beautiful place to stay in Chicago. Nothing much to say!

The entire stay the air stayed on 78 she tried to fix but we were gone and she said the property manager was gone out of town and she didn’t have another key. The shower pressure is very low, felt like we were still dirty after. The couch is disgusting and needs to be deep cleaned and sanitized, it has a dirty smell. I didn’t allow the kids to even sit on it in the living room, with one television.. Woke up to kids running at 8am from downstairs! The vents and ceiling fans have never been cleaned. I knew about the steps just wasn’t aware of it being two flights.

Beautiful home! And although we shared a kitchen and living room (on the first floor) with the hosts, the upstairs area (where our rooms were) remained very private. The entire home was absolutely stunning, historic, and well-kept. We felt right at home and would 100% stay here again with a large group.
Anthony was great, place is steal for the pricing. Cable, stove, laundry, pots, cleaning supplies...you name it he had it all. 1000% recommend!!!
Great location, friendly staff, rooms are a nice size great overall experience will stay here again
Omar’s apartment was a perfect spot for us in Chicago. Great location and tons of space!
Had a great stay, would definitely stay again!

This place was great for a large group. Cute and as seen in the photos. Adam was super responsive and provided recommendations for activities and restaurants nearby. House was clean and has amenities such as hair dryers, towels, soap, coffee pods, etc. Would recommend!
The property is beautiful and has everything you need. The owner is very detailed and meticulous. Wonderful, spacious, and very clean.

This place is as described and looked exactly like the advertised pictures. It’s even better that it’s in walking distance to two Blue Line (CTA) stations, so it’s easy to get around Chicago from here.
My only drawback is the shared restroom. If it’s shared, it should be cleaned my management weekly if possible. Management is very responsive and will clean if requested too though, so that’s a plus.
Also, you will spend a lot of money eating out since this place doesn’t have a kitchen or a large enough fridge (that also has a mini freezer).

Me and my guys loved the home, very clean
I recommend to stay here anytime
One of the only few homes you can rent in Chicago. It’s in a safe neighborhood and close to the tram so you can travel around town in minutes. Will stay here again!
Condo was just as described! Ola was very responsive and made check-in and out very smooth.
Great stay👍🏼
Louis was very prompt with responses to my multiple questions. The house was very nice and clean. I would recommend this house for a large group.

The apartment was clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed for a longer stay. The neighborhood was quiet, with the Metra and Target close by, which made things really convenient. Roxane and Michael were wonderful hosts and even showed me around when I arrived. Highly recommend!

This place is located in a fantastic area that is minutes away from the red line train and close to Montrose beach. As per the description, this place definitely feels lived in. There were some issues with cleanliness and the shower was clogged. The host was aware and it seemed there may have been some other plumbing issues happening in the building, so this may have been an anomaly. Overall it was a good stay, and my kids enjoyed the games and books in the apartment. This is a great option for families visiting Chicago.
Toby's place is an absolute gem. My family and I will stay again sometime!
puede mejorar
Great stay, the slippers and lofa was a nice touch.  Will definitely use again when in Chicago

This was a beautiful home near the train and beach. The guidebook was very helpful! Lots of great restaurants nearby and things to do. Comfortable beds and a large, modern kitchen, great for cooking for a large group. The hosts were accommodating for kids and left a pack N play, high chair, wagon, and sand toys for us! Considering the price, I did feel like there was some lack of attention to detail, but overall my family of 10 had a great stay!

Staying at Tiffany’s place in Chicago was amazing. I really loved the house and felt comfortable right away! It is decorated beautifully and I personally loved all the plants. The main bed was so comfortable (I want the name of the sheets brand!) and I slept great while on my trip. There are some fun games for the kids and ours loved the table tennis for the dining room! Thanks for the local recommendations about the neighborhood. I will definitely stay again when I’m back in Chicago.
Assel was a great host. They left clear instructions and provided us with plenty of recommendations.

Only had an issue getting in (user error). Host was very responsive even at 2am when my train got in late. House was clean and comfortable. Lock was easy to use after learning to use it. Great location with bus stop right there. My kid loved watching airplanes from the airport.

The apartment is in a great location and has an excellent gym. The  bed was comfortable and the kitchen had all of the basics for cooking including olive oil which was a nice touch. We enjoyed our stay and would stay here again.
Such an amazing stay. Very convenient home and location. Thank you for accommodating your guests.
Great location for a Wrigley Field weekend. MJ was a great host. We’ll stay again the next time we are in Chicago.
Very clean apartment, excellent communication, I recommend it.
Great place Pictures  as seen on site . Very spacious and felt safe in the area

Our group had a great stay. The location is hard to beat; right by public transportation and walking distance to all that Logan has to offer. Nights were quieter and peaceful. Unit was very clean and spacious and exactly as promised. I would recommend this unit to anyone!
My stay here was amazing! It was so cozy and the perfect little space to relax after a long day of walking around downtown. Hosts were so nice!
Lovely place and a lovely hosts.  Place is like a model home.  Location was awesome.

Geo is super responsive and communicative. The space was perfect for our weekend in Chicago and the neighborhood had a ton of restaurants and great coffee shops (and a trader Joe's a few blocks away!)!

We enjoyed our time at Terry’s place immensely.  We were in town for Cub’s game and it was the perfect location!  Terry and Ken were very accommodating and communicated well.  They even provided us with a gift certificate to the restaurant below the Airbnb.  We’ll definitely rent their place again!
Great stay.  Patricia was available for anything.  Great location for food, beach and accessible to the train

Suzanne’s place was a great place to stay for a weekend get away. It was a quick drive to all the places we wished to get to and if we didn’t have a car present the local transport looked super close. The space was well maintained and clean and comfortable. Her directions and recommendations were great and she was super responsive and friendly - would recommend staying if you are looking in the Chicago area for something a little more quiet

Multiple check in issues:
1. Unable to get inside property upon arrival due to hosts having a lock box with only one key to the building’s front door which is shared amongst multiple units they rent out. We were stuck waiting for a different guest to return the key before being able to get inside.
2. The code to unlock the door to the unit we were staying in did not work. It was difficult to resolve the issue and the host was not able to come help in person. Instead we were provided multiple different codes to try and see if they worked which led to us being locked out of the key pad multiple times.
Check out issues:
1. The cleaners walked into the unit unannounced before check out time. We told them to come back after check out but they did not speak English. They walked back in a few minutes later with the host on speaker phone. The host was extremely rude saying we are late to checkout and need to immediately leave. Host stated their policy is 10am checkout but the app shows 11am.

Very spacious apartment, AC and ceiling fans worked well for comfort. The kitchen is clean and open, but could use more dishes. The dual shower in the big bedroom is a nice perk, but the drains weren't working well. The living room is very comfortable and pleasant, and was conducive for playing music, watching tv, and even yoga.
Location was great! Walkable to Lake View and North Halstead. Vibrant area especially on game days.
This was a perfect place for our family to stay for a wedding! We would definitely stay again!

The Airbnb was just amazing!
Communication with Michael and Joanna was quick and friendly, I really appreciate they also give us some recommendations to go out.
They were also pretty flexible with the check in and check out which is always great, definitely I’ll book again when coming back to Chicago!
In a good neighborhood, was a great stay! Definitely recommend this spot, host was very responsive!

The place was great! Really spacious and great furniture. The rooms are nice with comfortable beds (with air conditioning). You can tell that Charles really cares about hospitality. My friends and I would definitely come back to the place. It’s perfect for group trips.
Great stay and great host.
Our stay at Dukes place was amazing! Nice clean house & great location! would stay here again
nice price and all the things match the descriptions and photos
I booked Amy’s place for family staying in town! They were really pleased with both the place and the neighborhood

I stayed at Maria's place for 2.5 months over the summer. This was my first time being in Chicago and moving to a big city was a little intimidating. But having a place to stay that felt like home made the experience amazing! I always felt comfortable during my stay; the place is kept clean and the other roommates are friendly and respectful. Maria has answers to ALL of your questions. She was very clear about house rules and goes out of her way to make your stay enjoyable. She felt like a second mom and was always a joy to hang out and converse with. She genuinely cares for all of her guests.
The house is pretty centrally located, so getting downtown or out toward the suburbs is fairly convenient. I felt safe in the area. It's walkable and public transpo is accessible.
I HIGHLY recommend staying with Maria for an extended stay, you will certainly enjoy it!
The home was very beautiful , clean and spacious.

Small but comfortable, literally all you’d need for a quick visit. The host was super responsive.
Not the biggest fan of how many people choose not to lock the doors, I was in the room closest to the door and barely heard it get locked behind others.
Fantastic house, really clean, and Diana is super nice!
Amazing location. Very responsive host. I will definitely book again if I'm in the area again
After a very frustrating experience before landing in Chicago with this host, I was met with a very long response time and horrible instructions.

Amy’s spot was a peaceful oasis in the city. Close walking distance to many shops, bars, restaurants and coffee shops, while quiet inside the unit. Small bedrooms, so families may struggle, but besides that it was great. Highly recommend for a weekend trip.
Other than bugs (silverfish), the apartment was clean and well-kept and parking was plentiful.

We enjoyed our stay here! Jordan was a great host and very accommodating. The apartment was lovely and had everything we needed. We felt safe in the area and enjoyed going on walks on the streets nearby. Parking was also fairly easy. We’d definitely stay here again!
Great place to stay! Easily fit 5 people and great food and drinks nearby
George was awesome and perfectly proactively communicative. Great experience and location as well

The place was AMAZING! The decor the cleanliness the air was set to 67 when we came in which was amazing because it was 90 when we arrived. The cinema was perfect for the 15 year old we brought! He loved it. Wished it was closer to the city but other than that it was absolutely amazing.
Very clean but too much clutter on dresser, table, and in bathroom.  No room for our own belongings. The location was great.  We were able to walk to many great restaurants and shops.

Drea was a great host, being responsive to questions and reaching out to us first to accommodate the stay. The recommendations for places to go and location made it easy to get around to places in the area.
My friends and I had a great time at this beautiful home. Wanda was great to work with. We were able to get around Chicago pretty easily from where we were. Home was beautiful.

We stayed for more than a week and everything went very well. Leonid was very attentive and his girlfriend is very kind. The bathroom is shared but we never had any issues with availability.  The metro station is just a few blocks away. The neighborhood doesn’t feel very safe, but we personally didn’t have any problems going to and from the station—you just need to take the usual precautions. We would definitely stay here again.

The building is nice and is in a great location. However, the management of the AirBnb is not great. We had a few issues. The unit was not ready at the agreed upon time, about 40 minutes late. I had to wait outside. Smelt very strongly of cleaning chemicals. No garbage bags were provided anywhere. I went out an bought my own. Many automated messages via email, text, and AirBnb. For our group, these things were not too big of a deal.
Big issues were as follows:
-There was an undisclosed noise monitor in a bedroom! I believe this is a violation of AirBnb rules.
-One of the bedrooms had a full size bed. I had confirmed with Ben before hand that the listing was correct with 4 kings bed and he confirmed.
-The host is holding back the security deposit for a "burnt comforter." I assume his cleaners burnt it in a dryer.
Overall would stay in this building if managed by a different company. But too many issues with our stay.
Quiet neighbourhood.  Hosts were helpful. Cute place
Very good and nice and comfy loved the beds and the kitchen was amazing and where it was located it was very calm and also liked how nice Yolanda was nice and also I would recommend this place

I had a great summer staying at Wonderful's place! the location is amazing for my work commute. Wonderful is a great host, very responsive to all my questions and needs, nearby neighbors were also friendly and sweet. I would totally recommend this place for any length of stay you would need in Chicago.
Chris was a great host!  His place was nice and clean and in a perfect location for our larger party.

The place was spotless and clean and matched to the pictures shown on the listing. Ron was very helpful in getting us access to the property on the first day.
It was a lovely experience staying in such a beautiful house.
Loved it will stay again 🥰🥰🥰🥰

I loved staying at Maria's place! The place itself was really cool, tons of fun decorations, great vibe, loved how spacious it was. The neighborhood was also awesome. Walking distance to cafes, bars, restaurants. Would recommend Brew Brew if you need to get some work done, Central Park Bar if you want to grab a drink on a patio, and Consignment Lounge for an indoor bar spot
Maria was great, quick to answer questions, and super friendly
Would def stay here again if I need to in the future!

This apartment is in a great location. It was disappointing that the shower was damaged and barely usable. Water was pooled under the tub lining, it was essentially like standing on a water bed while showering. We were concerned if it was safe. This made the stay uncomfortable despite a spacious apartment. While Ceasar responded promptly once alerted, the key was not in the lockbox when arriving at the apartment. Overall we don’t think this was a good value despite the great location and decent amount of space.
Amazing! The Pictures Are What You Get But Its Better And Has Plenty Of Room In Person! Great Host!

Robert's place was very nice and homey❤️ The building is secured, there is a local grocery store literally at the corner ( Save a Lot).   I felt safe, I'm around the way girl.  I think you need to rent a car to get around. Obama's house is near, stalked it once.😂 we went to Navy Pier, attempted to go Lincoln Park zoo ( an hour or so away), but there was absolutely no parking.  We went with no agenda, but still enjoyed ourselves!
6 rooms in the flat to share two bathrooms. One bathroom does not have hot water, so sometimes there is a wait for the good shower or you are stuck taking a cold shower if you are in a rush.
Can't say anything but great things- had an amazing stay and the loction is PERFECT
The home was very welcoming and comfortable.

Thank you for hosting us! Beautiful room located in the heart of Chicago, lots to do, walkable distances, and great transportation services that’s easy to follow along to. The hospitality the customer service provided us made us feel very welcomed. Would gladly recommend this place to anyone, thank you!
Convenient location, listing accurate, host very helpful.

Buen lugar y tranquilo, en buena zona y muy limpio
Muy recomendable ya que el metro esta a 5 min caminando

Emily was a fantastic host. She was very responsive and helpful before and during my group’s stay. The property is in a great location with many things to do within walking distance or just a short bus ride away. The property itself was great and was super clean and had everything we needed. Highly recommend that you stay here!
Very nice place and very friendly and helpful host. Defintely recommend
Convenient, affordable and quickly arranged for an impromptu visit to Chicago.
We had a great girls weekend here -- great location for what we needed and plentiful parking. We LOVED the layout of the apartment, and all furnishings look exactly like what you see in the pictures.
Genova‘s place was great. Whenever I had questions, she responded fast.
Great setup described exactly right. Steph was so accommodating and helped us with any questions. 10/10 stay.

Tram was awesome! She was so accommodating, her listing had a digital welcome packet with so much information and clear instructions. It was so nicely decorated, smelled so nice and was perfect for an our girls weekend. Would absolutely stay again!
Thanks for the stay. Everything was arranged as promised in the Airbnb description

Was clean and lots of room for our group! Close enough to the city to drive there. Was in a quiet area, parking was easy to find off street but the driveway was nice to have as well. Place was very clean and had extra things like blankets and pillows. Very cozy home to stay in.
We stayed here with a group for gal friends for a weekend, the location did not disappoint. Place was clean, roomy, and host very super responsive
very nice worth the price
Clean nice place was a little worried when I first saw streets coming in but is perfectly fine
Stay was great had a fantastic time and the Airbnb was perfect! Would definitely recommend!
William and Yolanda were very friendly and make you feel at home very naturally. They are kind and respectful hosts and we would be happy to come me back.

Great location! Hard to find a spot with 7 bedrooms at this price point. We had an awesome time. The only thing I noticed - some of the window AC units appear to be on their last leg. It was a scorcher when we showed up and it took an hour or so for the upstairs unit to cool down. But once it did it was great! Thanks again Josh!
We really enjoyed our stay at this place, the host is really friendly and helpful. We highly recommend this place to a family of 4 people.
Clean place, matches the description and photos. Responsive and helpful host.
2nd time here great place to stay! Whenever I come to Chicago, this is where I will call home!
What a gem, we had a great weekend. Obviously this place will be perfect for any animal lover. Also, the neighborhood was so welcoming!

Pretty comfortable spot, noticed some stains upon entering the Private room and some of the things provided like towels which were damp and had been used prior and paper towels and other little stuff weren’t provided but very nice looking place and safe area generally and the host was very responsive and helpful.
Great place! Very comfy.
perfect for a group, walkable neighborhood, spacious rooftop!
I would stay here again! Great place

We had a wonderful stay! The neighborhood is great—very walkable with lots of nearby restaurants, grocery stores, and parks. Public transit was close and convenient, so we were able to see all of Chicago without needing a car.
The apartment itself was comfortable and welcoming. The beds were very comfortable, and the AC kept us cool during a hot, humid August visit.
Oscar lives right next door and is such a kind person. We never needed anything, but it was reassuring knowing he was easy to reach if we did.
Highly recommend this spot for anyone visiting Chicago!
Great location on the South Side. Perfect for everything we needed to do. Highly recommend

I had a wonderful stay in West Lakeview, Chicago. The apartment was beautifully furnished premium and comfortable, yet tastefully simple so it felt like my own space. Inside was quiet and peaceful, even with the energy of the city just outside.
The location was ideal: Whole Foods, Target, coffeeshops, plus plenty of great bars, restaurants, and boutique shops all just blocks away. The neighborhood felt incredibly friendly and welcoming.
The host was excellent, and both check-in and (especially) check-out were super easy. I’d be happy to return and highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Chicago.
Loved that it was in walking distance to Rate field for a baseball game. We were majorly delayed arriving but they worked with us to make sure check in was smooth considering the late arrival
Great place to stay in Hyde park! Plenty of room for a large group, very clean and great location.
The experience was extraordinary. Everyone in my party was extremely impressed. Excellent communication the entire time. Close to everything. Just book the reservation, you will have no regrets.

The pictures matched the current layout. The host was nice and courteous. The house was clean and had everything you needed to live there temporarily. We were out and about a lot but I would say the only complaint was finding the garage. Trying to follow our navigation , her instructions, watch traffic and park was a task, especially at night. I was a little on edge with the negative reviews I saw here but overall felt safe. There are multiple locks for reinforcement/ security.  We were close to most of activities planned near Navy Pier. Parking is very expensive everywhere so I appreciated a nice place to stay and free parking. Thanks for the welcome gift !
Pretty home on quiet cul de sac.  Strategic location.  Well appointed.  Perfect for our needs.

Great place to stay in Logan Square. Very central to the main areas of the neighborhood. 10-15 walk to the blue line subway (both California + Logan Square stops). Great communication and very clean apartment.
Very clean , quiet, & safe -- would stay there again!
Very lovely home. Well curated, made the place feel cozy. Great location.
Great place very nice and the host was very good at communicating.

We absolutely loved our stay and honestly didn’t want to leave. Hannah was welcoming and always responsive. The home was pristine, and we all slept amazingly well because everything was so comfortable. It was so peaceful coming back to such a beautiful, quiet home after full days of sightseeing. We will always stay here whenever we visit Chicago, and we can’t wait to return! Cannot recommend highly enough!
Great location and AC worked well!  The hosts were great and checked in with us to see if we needed anything.  The beds were very comfy and the kitchen was well-stocked.  Five stars!
Well managed and appointed property. Worth the price, too.
Joe’s place is wonderful, and the property managers are friendly, communicative, and helpful. We highly recommend booking this lovely spot in Roscoe Village.

The location is great, easy to navigate, public transport is 3min walk.
I had a great time staying at Jose’s place overall.

No better place to stay for the cubs game! The place was much bigger than it looks in the pictures and was surprisingly quiet inside despite being right in the middle of the action. Host was responsive and accommodating. Thank you for hosting!

Vladimir was a fantastic host! He hosted us last minute when we were canceled on by another host. We loved the bubbly and snacks he left for us! He was very responsive and helpful. His space was very large and clean. We would absolutely stay here again.
