Greatly enjoyed our stay! Also, very grateful for the hosts’ flexibility relating to our check in and check out. They were incredibly responsive and friendly. Would highly recommend!

The proximity to where we wanted to go was fabulous! The neighborhood was lovely, we needed to adjust to the train as we are from a small town in Ct.
We would certainly return!
Great location, great amenities, great apartment, great value overall!
A+. A gem!

Apartment was cute ! Spacious the master bedroom is huge. Mark was quick with the responses, check in was easy location was perfect. The only downside of the unit is that the cooling/heating is centralized and you can’t control it in the unit and the unit was hot our whole stay, needs to say that in the listing.

It was difficult to get into the place. This was described once the booking had been made, but it is a bit disconcerting. After getting into the place, that's not an issue. The place is as described, it has a lot of character. It wasn't dusty, but was hot. The host is very responsive. The roommate is very helpful and kind.
I was looking for a base to explore Chicago, it was a bit far from downtown for my purposes. However, it would be a great place as a base for just about anything else!

I absolutely loved this unit. It was in a great location right by the train, and it was very clean and spacious inside. It accommodated our group greatly. It was a little bit tricky to get inside, but once we slowed down and re-read the instructions, we were able to get inside smoothly.
It was a nice stay
Place was great! Plenty to do for the little ones and a beautiful home.
Great place and location. Hosts were extremely responsive and appreciated the check in’s! Hope to stay again when I come back.

Staff at Level Chicago were very friendly and welcoming, which I appreciated. However, there were some issues during my stay. The A/C was broken for two nights, and the response from management was slow. Housekeeping was inconsistent and often not thorough.
The building is right next to train tracks, so noise from passing trains can be frequent and disruptive, especially at night. The lobby is also quite small, and with so many dogs in the building, it can feel crowded.
A major issue: the hotel sits on 354 Union Ave as the address, but USPS doesn’t recognize it. Packages only arrive at 355 Halsted, and this isn’t made clear—definitely a frustrating experience.
Great staff, but overall service, cleanliness, and communication need improvement.
Nice location and good for a short stay!
Great spot out of the way of the city to get around if needed. A lot of amenities within 10 minute walk of what you would need. Off street parking did not take to long to find.
Great space. Close to lots of great dining and local pubs in Bucktown/Wicker Park
Very nice , gave reccomendations in the area, responds very quickly overall pretty nice stay.
Great host and great location. Would book again
Had a great time visiting this home!
This was a perfect spot for a group of 10 looking to enjoy a Cubs weekend. Less than a 5 minute walk to the stadium. Highly recommend

Tameka was an amazing host! We were having some internet troubles, and she went out of her way to help find a solution, and then followed up the next day to make sure things were going well. she was so friendly and helpful! If we are ever in the area again we would definitely stay with her!

Host was super responsive.  We found the surrounding places to be friendly and helpful which we were initially unsure of.  We were a little ways out but Uber drivers were great and it was a peaceful neighborhood.  House was perfect for our needs - spacious and good use of home spaces so that 3 teenagers each had their own space to relax in.   Used the big screen in basement for a “family movie night”   Very good trip overall.
Overall not bad. There were a decent amount of issues that arose but Josh was quick to help me deal with them. I just think it is a little overpriced for what it is.

This location fit the bill. It had everything I needed for a short stay in the neighborhood. Like others have mentioned, I did get changed to a different unit in the building, but it was communicated before the check-in date. The only other issue was the wifi wasn't working as expected, but the host was able to get me connected to another network in the same building.
Overall, it was a nice stay on a quieter street. The kitchen had some basics which was very helpful to allow for some home cooking.
A cozy place with easy access to all the best of Chicago

The Horst was very nice - there was something wrong with the a/c and Bella contacted maintenance very quickly. Management replaced the a/c within a couple hours and even updated other things while he was at it. Everyone was super friendly.

This was adequate for our stay. There were a few minor issues that I communicated to Helen, who was very responsive. Place was tidy but I found the floor and furniture were not as clean as it looked in the photos. The area is walkable and we enjoyed exploring the neighborhood. Without a car it’s 10-15 minutes to get to bus/train.

Apartment is nice. The staircase is gross but it’s pretty nice once you get inside. I will say though, it seems like they kind of have this place on auto-pilot. The host isn’t very fast to respond. I was actually locked out because the passcode was changed and it took 3 hours for the host to respond. At a couple of points the host was basically unresponsive.

Our family of 4 book a lot of air B&B houses across the country for our vacations and we think this is the best one! What I loved the most was how close it is from all the downtown spots (15-20 mins drive from millennium park etc); my husband loved its spacious layout if two separate floors for kids and us, providing additional peace for us; my kids loved the game machine and everything else! Diana was always responding my messages and helping us solve problems re getting in and parking. She is kind and friendly. Would highly recommend this place!
Great little place to stay, had a great time. Beds aren’t bad but are a little thin. Overall would stay again.

Dan was a great and courteous host! He was always very responsive to any needs, and he was proactive in assisting with check-in, check-out, general instructions, and anything else that was going on during my stay. I stayed for 10 weeks for an internship and it was much more reasonable than living downtown, and still made for an easy commute on the green line. Overall, glad I stayed here!
Nice

Decent stay for the price, especially for a long term stay! I appreciated the close proximity to public transport and I had a positive experience in the neighborhood. Would stay again!
There is no cleaning service, so the cleanliness of the kitchen and bathrooms is entirely reliant on the tenants, which meant that these common areas were not clean. I did purchase some cleaning products and tried to contribute when I could, but certain things, like removing rotten food from the refrigerator previous renters, did not feel like it should be left to the current tenants to deal with.
Some of the amenities advertised were not clearly or consistently available (e.g., toilet paper, hand soap, ironing board, hair dryer, cooking basics etc.). However, the host was responsive, so if I had asked, that likely would have been clarified. The host was quite responsive regarding the few items I did reach out about and quickly rectified the issues I brought up-- which I really appreciated!

La habitación y baño está igual que la fotos, y es muy cómoda y acogedora. La zona también es buena hay bastantes cosas que hacer, la playa está a 5 min en carro y atrás está la universidad y hay bastantes lugares a donde ir; y no está muy lejos de las zonas turísticas de Chicago.
Lo único es que la áreas comunes no siempre estaban limpias pero eso depende mucho de las personas con las que te toque.

Fed was very responsive to my questions! Showed me around and made me feel at home for my stay. An incredible host. The room and bathroom were spotless. Internet's really strong and stable, which is important to me working remotely. Had an incredible stay. I'd recommend this place to anyone looking to stay in Chicago.

Honestly, a nice little spot for when you need to sleep and was in a great part of town. I was frustrated by the need to give them my credit card information outside of AirBNB and tried to cancel the listing for that but they refused. While this was listed in the listing it was hidden under a drop down button and I felt that their refusal to cancel was frustrating. However, I needed a place to sleep, relented, and it was fine. Why use Airbnb at all if you are going to ask for additional credit card information outside the site? I wish I would've just gotten a hotel.
A very unique and special little spot. Host was easy to communicate with. Highly recommended
Sarah was a great and communicative host. Moreover, her house was clean, well appointed, and accurately described. Would absolutely book again if we return to the area.
Micheal was a great communicator and was helpful whenever we needed something!

Host was very easy to communicate with, the room is large and bright, and the mattress was great.  Street parking is by permit, but there’s open parking a couple blocks SW of the unit.  Easy walk to the Brown Line.

Great stay in Chicago! Our first time with our 4 kids age 3-7. Space was enough for us. 8 min walk to the red line train. Public transportation was pretty easy for us to figure out for 1st time using. Was about a 30-40 min ride on the train to downtown. We kept our car parked on the street. It was busy but we always found a spot close enough. We felt safe in the neighborhood. The space itself was nice and met our needs. We would have appreciated instructions on the thermostat as it would climb to 75 after we set it but eventually saw it had some preset setting. Loved having laundry to do daily for our kids. Great that you only need to climb maybe half a flight of steps to access the apartment. Host was always very responsive and helped us with questions about public transportation and gave food recommendations which were delicious! Overall great stay!!
Great stay thank you!
Clean, friendly, and affordable. Enjoyed staying in Woodlawn. Hot with only the one AC, but with ceiling fans and windows we made it work. Ruby was a great host.
Great stay in a charming location, near many amenities but on a quiet street. Location close to many north side attractions. Friendly host and a very comfortable and usable space!
Great place
Todd was the ultimate host. He helped me out of a jam because of my own scheduling problem. We loved the place, it was perfect for our needs. We are coming back!!!

I enjoyed my stay at Josh’s AirBnb. Great walk ability easy access to Milwaukee Avenue. I would go there again. The Belmont 77 bus is very accessible. I believe it runs 24 seven gets you need to where you gotta go.

We had a wonderful stay at Kevin’s place! The home was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was perfect—close to Downtown . Kevin was responsive and made check-in easy. We would definitely stay here again!

Parfait pour visiter Chicago. Beaucoup de bruit venant de la circulation devant l’appartement pendant la nuit et seulement 2 chaises pour une location devant l’appartement 4 personnes.
À par ça l’appartement est très bien. Une place devant parking pour la voiture et à 10 mins à pied du métro pour aller dans le centre en 25 mins. Parfait

Tetyana was very responsive and the place was very clean. I had second thoughts about staying somewhere in Garfield Park for over a month but the area right around our place was safe. Parking on the street was safe the entire time (made sure to take caution to hide valuables if any were left in the car). Would love to stay here again if my career leads me back to the city!

Nice place that had everything I needed. The street isn't very busy, and it's a short walk to the blue subway, which goes directly to and from the airport.
Matthew was very helpful and accommodating throughout. Not much to complain about here.

The apartment is beautiful and is very well located. It's in a nice neighbourhood with beautiful surroundings. Unfortunately, the washing machine was broken, and it took almost a week to get a new one, with my clothes wet and stuck inside the old machine for 3 days. After I asked for a partial refund, it was given to me, but I wish the problem had been solved faster and more easily. I had to wait several times for technicians to come into the apartment to check the old machine and also to install the new one, and the communication wasn't that great. Sometimes they were slow to respond, and they would only tell me spontaneously when technicians or the machine were about to arrive. The other thing is that the mattress is quite old and uncomfortable; it sags in the middle. Also, the towels and bed sheets are old and in poor condition. The quality of these things doesn't match the standard of the apartment, the area, and the price. If they did some maintenance it coild be great!
非常感谢房东，服务非常好！房子很干净！我们一家入住的非常愉快！
Very convenient location, and amazing host!
It was a good stay
Michael was very responsive and helpful. The house was cozy and very welcoming
Very responsive host and very comfortable home with everything we needed. Thanks!
Great location!

I stayed here for a couple of months during my internship in Chicago and it was absolutely perfect. The apartment was spotless, well-furnished, and had everything I needed to feel at home for a longer stay. The location made it easy to get around the city, with plenty of restaurants, coffee shops, and public transit options nearby. Communication with the host was seamless. Jennifer was incredibly responsive, thoughtful, and made sure I had everything I needed throughout my stay. I couldn’t have asked for a better experience, and I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable, reliable home base in Chicago.

The place was renovated quite well, and looked very nice. However, I think some of the amenities, particularly the shower upstairs did not feel like they suited my needs; some rooms were also much colder or hotter than others, making it hard to sleep. Otherwise, it was a nice place.

This is a comfy 2-bedroom apartment in the West Ridge neighborhood of Chicago. It may appear to be a bit out of the way, but I arrived car-free and had no problems. The 84 bus is just steps away and eastbound gets you to the CTA Red Line, westbound gets you directly to a Whole Foods. That was about all the transportation I needed! The neighborhood is leafy, friendly, and safe. There's a very nice nature preserve within walking distance on Western Ave. The apartment is very clean, has great central AC and very fast WiFi, Mona and Giovani were both very responsive.
Tetyana is the best Airbnb host I have ever come across. The house is very clean and Tetyana makes sure your stay is safe and she is very responsive to messages.
My husband and I had a wonderful stay here! Walking distance from Wrigley field & super clean and comfy airbnb. Highly recommend & will definitely be back in the future!

Lovely stay at this apartment in Chicago! The space was beautiful and even better than the photos. Everything felt so high end but cozy. Host was incredibly kind and responsive, quick to answer all questions and concerns.

Loretta’s place was a great local ABNB for long term stays. This area is very walkable and close to train stations and bus stops.  Many local restaurants and several grocery stores are located within a one mile radius of her house. Entertainment close by includes a movie theater, seasonal  farmers market, and local weekend events.  Street parking is fairly easy on the street in front of the house.  Loretta, her dog blue, and her son were the other residents living in the house.

We moved out family vacation at this property! Conveniently located in a very nice area. Comfortable and clean.
We are glad we chose this spot to stay in Chicago.
We hope to be back!

Thank you Jennifer for a great stay! All areas were clean and had everything a guest would need. Great bathroom! Location was close to public transportation, shops and restaurants. Host was very communicative and made me feel very comfortable. I’d recommend anyone stay here.

This is my second location with these hosts, and they were absolutely fantastic! It was a perfect fit for what we were staying for!
Very easily walkable, several bus stops nearby, and the place was very easy to navigate with all the instructions given by the hosts! They’re also incredibly responsive, and incredibly kind!
Would absolutely recommend any place these hosts have! Thank you for letting us stay again!

I enjoyed my stay here. The place is exactly as described and the hosts are very responsive, even late at night. The place is very well maintained. The locations is very close to UIC and has is easily accessible via public transport as well with very quiet and peaceful neighborhood. If I visit Chicago any other time, I would love to stay here again.

During my stay I felt more like Ewa's roommate than guest. If you don't mind having little privacy and if you like dogs, then the unit is well appointed for a comfortable enough stay in a great neighborhood.

The property was a short drive to everything, close to my work and downtown. Inside was clean and spacious, and check-in was effortless. Ms. Sonia was an amazing host, she answered all my questions and took care of all my needs. I highly recommend!

I stayed three months at Jennifer’s for business purposes, and I could not have imagined a better place for this experience! The house is situated in a peaceful and charming neighborhood in Chicago, offering easy access to trains, buses, and bikes that provide a quick commute to downtown.
Everything you might need for daily life is close, such as restaurants, supermarkets, parks, and even sports facilities, making it a great place to build a comfortable routine.
Jennifer is simply wonderful: warm, kind, and attentive, she makes sure your arrival and stay are as smooth and enjoyable as possible. Her hospitality adds a personal touch that makes you feel at home.
The kitchen is fully equipped, and all essentials are thoughtfully provided, making a long stay much easier. The patio is the perfect spot to enjoy meals outdoors or spend beautiful summer evenings relaxing after work.

The good: location was good. We felt safe. Bathrooms were great! Parking was great (except when car was towed for a parade...and that is my fault...not the owners).
The Bad:
1) Many things all other AirBNBs have were missing or in very short supply (clothes washing detergent, paper towels, regular towels, etc.). Dom graciously reimbursed me for the cost of detergent and light bulbs (to replace several burned out bulbs). 2) Front door so hard to open I thought it was deadbolted.
3) Security door would not close in front of front door.
