Shomari was quick at responding and easy to work with. Would stay here again

We discovered a hidden gem in the heart of trendy Logan Square. The house was clean and spacious—perfectly suited for our group of seven women during our annual getaway. We loved relaxing in the kitchen and making the most of the outdoor space. Despite the summer heat, the indoor temperature stayed pleasantly cool and comfortable.
Each bed was generously sized and incredibly cozy, making it easy to unwind after a full day. We felt safe walking to dinner in the neighborhood, though we chose to take Ubers back. Getting downtown was a breeze—just about 20 minutes depending on traffic—which was ideal for our daytime plans.
This place was a fantastic fit for our group, and I’d highly recommend it to anyone visiting Chicago or Logan Square with friends or family. Huge thanks for the warm hospitality.
Great place! Clean, safe and quiet. I would definitely stay again
Great area with lots of walkable places. Host is very fast to respond

My family and I loved Keeva's place! It was in a convenient location to downtown and a nearby suburb we had to visit. Parking was easy to find for the most part, only one day we had to park on the next street, as opposed to in front of the building. If you struggle with parallel parking, this may not be the place for you. Getting into the space was easy, it is 3 flights of steps. Once we got inside we loved the beautiful decor and how spacious the condo was. It was also very clean. THE MASSAGE CHAIR IS EVERYTHING!!!! The beds were comfortable and the showers were good too! Great place, you should book it.

This Apartment was the perfect location for exploring some of Chicago's best neighborhoods (Wicker Park, Bucktown, Division Street). Also, walkable to great groceries, a free pool, & nice picnic areas. We would highly recommend!
We were so thankful to have a quiet and clean place to lay our heads while we were in town!

Stayed here for 3 months for a summer internship. Surpassed my expectations and had a wonderful experience. The host was very friendly and responsive. Apartment was very nice and clean with many restaurants nearby. The trip to downtown was quick and easy on the bus. I would highly recommend staying here.
Place was great! Very good location with good space for parking. Easy to check in and check out. Would 100% rent again!

This home is in great location, which was the best part of our stay. We also felt the place stayed pretty cool given the 90 degree temps. We appreciated the cold drinks provided in the fridge and the abundance of bath towels provided! We did feel the home could be cleaner, additional pillows provided for the bed and hotter water in the shower.
Communicative host!

Great space for bachelorette party! We did not have the maximum number of guests, would've been a tighter squeeze if so. Dustin was quickly responsive when we had an issue with the battery on the door and we got that sorted quickly. The upstairs was significantly hotter than downstairs but everyone managed fine for sleeping. Overall a positive experience, would recommend.

Great place, looks better than the photos which was an added bonus. Nice workspace for folks working remote and well appointed kitchen. Laundry was clutch. Perfect for a bunch of friends visiting Chicago for the first time. John allowed us to check in early too. Thanks for having us!

Great place to stay in a great location! My group (2 couples) were easily able to walk to the bars in the area, and uber was easy to use when wanting to go to further locations. Overall cute place, comfy beds, and the cold water in the fridge was a lifesaver post bar crawl lol
Easy, accurate, and convenient.
Thanks for our stay, we loved Chicago
It suited our nightly requirements just fine.  Just needs a good deep cleaning.  Washing machine makes the first bathroom smell like someone took a dump. Literally everything else was satisfactory.
Clean, great location, awesome amenities. Easy communication and instructions. Definitely recommend!

My stay was wonderful and Robert was an excellent host! The Airbnb was very clean, comfortable, and looked exactly like the pictures. The location was convenient, check-in was easy, and everything felt welcoming. I would definitely stay here again the next time I’m in Chicago!
Rosa was very friendly, helpful, and responded very quickly to questions.   I would love to stay here again in the future.

We loved our stay here! There were plenty of rooms and bathrooms for a big group, the location is fantastic, and the host was super proactive and informative! The space itself is really nice and super comfortable. We would definitely stay here again!
Great location- a perfect spot for a beach trip. It was clean, comfortable and accommodated our group well.
Great place for friends to get together in the Windy City.  Thank for being a great host!

Oyindamola's place was great. We needed a home base to be out and about visiting our friends and this was exactly what we needed. I was traveling with my 5-year-old daughter and searching for parking in the area would have been HORRIBLE. The fact that we had a garage and that she made it available so easily was a game-changer. We had some trouble getting into the backdoor one night and she responded immediately and made it easy. Great stay. Will stay again.
Wonderful place in a great area. Super easy, Dominic was very responsive. Great TV and great stay!

This property is absolutely beautiful! Clean, cozy, and in the perfect location, close to pretty much everything you’d want to do in Chicago. It made the best home base for our trip, and we even got to experience the Bud Billiken Parade right outside, which was unforgettable. Lester is such a great host. Friendly, responsive, and truly cares about making sure his guests feel at home. From check-in to check-out, everything was smooth and easy. We’d happily stay here again in a heartbeat!

Since I was staying Aijana’s unit for five weeks, I had higher expectations/questions than most guests. I’m happy to say that Aijana was incredibly kind, responsive to any questions or ￼needs that I had. She is clearly a host who really cares that her guests have everything they need during their stay. For instance, since most of my clothes need to be air dried, she purchased a clothes drying rack for me to use. When there was an issue with one of the appliances, she assisted right away to get it tested and replaced so it was working properly, and even gave me a gift card to make up for the time spent to resolve the issue! I really don’t think most hosts would go that far.
Aijana is local to the area, which was an important to me because I have had negative experiences where Airbnb‘s are owned by people who don’t actually live in the area.
The neighborhood is peaceful, walkable, and a delight to stay in. I highly recommend this location if you are looking for a peaceful place to stay
You pay what you get for. Very convenient to get around the city. Other tenants cleanliness was the only issue.
The coach house was perfect for our short weekend!  Loved walking to the local restaurants for our meals.  Beautiful mature trees and welcoming neighborhood.

They were extremely welcoming and accommodating. I had a last second cancelation on the same day. They were able to take care of us and made our trip successful! Cant say enought great things about the location and host.
Very nice place to stay with a family. Quiet place outside of the city. Groceries are close by. Michael is a great host!
Thank you for all the accommodations, beautiful home and lovely to have stayed there.
Great! It was a nice peaceful stay at Joe's. I love the devotion and expertise of the host to make his listing a considerable place to be.
Amazing spot! Would love to stay again.
Great space near lots of restaurants and bars. Lots of space for a large party and felt right at home. Would gladly stay again.
Beautiful home in an amazing neighborhood with plenty to do nearby.

My family came in to visit from out of town and had a wonderful stay! Great space for hanging out as a group in common areas and 3 big beds, each with their own full bathroom made for a great setup. Thanks!!
The Inn at Wriggleyville was a great location to Boystown and was very clean with nice accommodations. Would definitely stay again!

The house has charm inside, but the driveway is extremely narrow—heed that warning. Our full-size SUV barely fit, and the street parking made leaving nearly impossible. The biggest concern is safety. The neighborhood didn’t feel family-friendly, and although the beach is technically a 4-minute walk, the surroundings discourage it. The front door lacked an interior lock, and the latch area showed signs of tampering. We heard gunshots multiple times overnight. For over $2,000 for 3 nights, this location felt unreasonable. I quickly found a safer, more affordable Airbnb in Highland Heights for half the price. The original reviews were misleading and played a major role in my decision to book.

The host was amazing, i had trouble with getting into my room. It was late at night and they were still able to be urgent with their response to help me get into my room. Such a beautiful home and made my stay feel like home! Thank you guys!
we enjoyed our time at this family home! we had our dog our baby and the grandparents there babysitting and everyone was comfortable. thanks miguel!
Great spot

Bozena offers a personal touch as a host ensuring her guests are at home and accommodated. She’s around very often watering the lush plants surrounding the building and extending a warm greeting to her guests. Anything I needed during my month-long stay was delivered right away.
It's very clean inside & out. The mattress and pillows were very comfortable. Great updated bathroom with a tall showerhead. The outdoor seating areas are lovely. The street is peaceful with no commotion. There are no neighbors or noise from above so it was a very quiet stay.
Considerations but not dealbreakers: It is a smaller space with some tight corners. If the blinds are up, everyone that passes by will see directly in. You can open them half way to maintain some privacy while still letting light in. The air conditioner works great but is very loud when running. While the kitchen was supplied for basic cooking, supplies and utensils are pretty straightforward and minimal.
I would absolutely stay again!

Garrett & his wife's property was everything we were looking for on our family meetup in Chicago. The home was well stocked with everything you could need, we didn't feel like anything was missing. The pictures match what we experienced in person. Garrett was always extremely helpful in recommending things to do and responded to all my inquiries/issues very quickly. We really appreciated having a stocked fridge and snacks upon arrival, that was a lovely touch! Couldn't recommend this place enough if you're looking for a home away from home in Chicago :).
Excellent house for a big group. Highly recommend!
Very clean and nice, the owners were also very responsive and friendly

I'll start out by saying that for the price of this Airbnb is a great value. When I booked, everything else in Logan Square was 3-4x of this place, at minimum.
I came by myself, looking to explore Logan Square for a few days, and I didn't plan on being in the apartment at all—I just wanted a cheap private room in Logan Square with a bed and a shower. And for that, you won't find anything better. It's free of clutter and fully furnished. I've stayed in cleaner airbnbs—you do have to be okay with living in a house that's very "lived-in". I'd describe the level of clean as "an apartment w/ four guy roommates who are clean and respectful, but they're still guys."
It's not a place to take your girl for a romantic getaway—it's a private room with a bed and a shower. But it's one of the cheapest places in the area, and the location is amazing. Tons of stuff around, five minutes from the blue line. For me, this place was perfect.
Aaron was a great host, and I would stay here again.
Amazing as always ! I love this place . 10/10 everything was perfect .

Excelente lugar.
todo muy cerca .
100% recomendable

First time in Chicago and I know where I’ll be staying next time. Clean / perfect location / parking ( a must ) bikes that worked 😀😀
Loved it.
Nice cat.

The apartment is well equipped and clean.  It is perfect for 1 or 2 people.  It is near the freeway and trains, so there is that noise, but it did not bother us.  The stairs leading to the apartment are steep and rickety.  They feel unsafe.  Other than that, it was a great place for a lengthy stay.  We did an internship for a month and this place worked for us.

Tom was always responsive whenever we had questions — which we greatly appreciated. We hosted a bachelorette here and it was very comfortable and spacious. Would highly reccomend to anyone visiting Chicago with a large group. Thanks again Tom!
Nice space. Comfy bed. Beautiful bathroom. Grateful for the A/C, but it was a tad bit loud. Note: lots of stairs too. Otherwise great!

Difficult to find the right gate, pathway, staircase and door to the place—there are two houses, two different gates (which one is the garden gate ?) and two different stairways (which stairway to use for entry?) very confusing. Didn’t get check in code as well so had to wait to get in.
Could not adjust AC which was set at 79 in August.
Dryer could not be used without the whole room filling up with condensation.
The security alarm went off at 1 am on Saturday no idea why had to get up and push random buttons to disarm (no instructions).
And there was a shooting Saturday night at near the park across the street from house.
Rosemary was very responsive and sweet.

Maria’s place was VERY clean, organized and easy to find the things we needed. The neighborhood is quiet, as quiet as a populated city can be! The neighbors were friendly. The unit itself had modern finishes and appliances. If you told us it was renovated last week, we would have believed it. Maria was very responsive and kind. We would not hesitate to stay at her unit again!
Nice location
This was a beautiful place to stay, very clean and Chris was very helpful and always replied quickly!
The stay was wonderful! One of the best parts was the access to piblic transportation. The bus in Foster made it really easy to access the entire city!
Clean space! Great area! Exactly like the photos.

Thank you for a wonderful stay. the location is fantastic! walking distance to everything and everywhere. You have a wonderful brick 2 flat .. feels like a house. place was very clean and I wanted to thank you for leaving the water for the dog. that was very thoughtful and kind of you. I wish you had more comfortable seating, the chairs are nice but uncomfortable after a while. A sofa would’ve been nice to relax on. There’s lots of kitschy clutter everywhere you look, could be streamlined and linear. Rock star parking right in front of the house too! overall I had a wonderful time thank you for your kindness and hospitality.
It was great staying with Molly. Molly is very kind and the place was clean and peaceful. Thank you, Molly.
Immaculate and cute.

Carl was very quick in responding to messages. He gave a personal tour through the house.  Carl was a great and polite guy. If I come back to Chicago I will first check at his place if he has a room available.
Solid place. Convenient for transport. Would stay again.

Our tone for this trip to was set once we arrived at this Airbnb. We were welcomed warmly and instantly felt like home. Our host was friendly and welcoming to us. The place was big and clean! Would def recommend for a family of 6.

The place was very comfortable and spacious, and had all the amenities we could have needed. It's a really nice place to base a visit to the city, within about 4 blocks of CTA trains, closer to several busses, etc.
Wonderful place! Sparkling clean. Very safe and secure. Easy access to the bus lines. Host is extremely responsive to any messages. Would give them 100 stars if I could.

Loved our stay! The space worked great for our family! Lots of beds so everyone could have their own. So convenient with the blue line stop at Logan Square. Easy trip into downtown. Would stay here again!

This place is extremely spacious, clean, and convenient. Located in River North and close to the brown line Chicago stop, it makes it easy to get around to all the must-see sights.
This place comes with a pretty good sized price tag ... we only had one (working) key to the place with 8ppl in and out, this was very inconvenient and nothing was done to address the issue during our stay.

Julie was great!  Communicated as soon as we booked.  Place was perfect for our long weekend, just as described in the listing.  Even had a bonus room that was recently completed that wasn’t in the description.  Everything was really clean.
Great spot. Clean, comfortable, and well looked after. The hosts were friendly and easy to deal with, and the place had everything I needed. Would definitely stay again.
Our stay was fantastic! Everything was as described and all very clean! Would recommend staying here and I would stay here again
One of my favorite places to stay while visiting Chicago. Centrally located. Very easy check-in. Pictures and description are very accurate.

Overall, our stay was good. The a/c was nice and cold, which is very important in the summer. The host was responsive and quick to help with whatever we needed.
The location is quiet and we didn’t have any issues with noise at all. Street parking is free, and wasn’t too hard to find.
The host is new to Airbnb, so there were a few kinks that needed sorted out, but overall the stay was okay. It was cold, comfortable and safe.
Allende is proactive and willing to accommodate any needs. It’s a great place to come back to after exploring the city.

The space is totally cohesive with the theme. There are so many small details and thoughtful additions that are not captured in the photos. Highly recommend this space for creatives whom are looking for a space for inspiration.

We are so happy we found Jaime’s house, was exactly what we were looking for. Was perfect distance to downtown Chicago and also Mall at Lombard which was our 2 main destinations! House was clean and had everything we needed and much more! We definitely recommend and will recommend to friends and family!!

Kai and Jaiva were great to stay with! very responsive and communicative from the beginning and gave us great recommendations for restaurants catered to what were looking for. The house looks just like the pictures and was the perfect spot for our Bachelorette party. Couldn't recommend them any more!

I stayed in this apartment in Rogers Park, Chicago for two months, and it was a great experience. The space was comfortable and well-equipped with everything I needed for a longer stay. The amenities were thoughtfully provided and made day-to-day life easy.
One of the highlights was the host's communication—always responsive, helpful, and respectful of privacy. The location in Rogers Park is quiet and has good access to public transportation, groceries, and local spots.
Overall, I’d definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a reliable mid- or long-term stay in Chicago.

This listing totally met our expectations.  We were able to easily house all 6 adults in our family.  There were great places nearby that we could walk to for coffee and dinner.  We were not far from the Loop, so it was easy to get to the Field Museum, Art Institute, Gino's East pizza and the  venue for the wedding we were there to celebrate.  Cyrus was extremely accessible via emails and responded to my questions about things in the area.  We would definitely book there again!!!
Loved our stay, everything about it was perfect. Convenient, clean, great location.

Lenoid was a good host and the room and bathrooms were very nice and clean. The house is a hostile situation which I wasn't expecting from the description BUT everything was fine. The neighborhood is rough but I wasn't out late so nothing ever happened.I also broguht my car and it was safe parked on the street. Overall, good experience.
Beautiful place!  Exactly as advertised.  Perfect for two interns staying for the summer.  Very walkable to work, grocery, restaurants, etc.  Would absolutely book again.
Beautiful; clean place in a quiet residential neighborhood. Miriam is a great host. Really enjoyed our stay here!

During my stay, I found the property to be in very poor condition and lacking basic amenities. The bed was unclean, with old, thin pillows and sheets stained with tar, while the towels were worn and dirty. The bathroom was unhygienic, containing hair in the tub and crawling bugs, and the back door had hair balls. Despite having AC units in two rooms, the living area only had a small cooler that failed to keep the space comfortable in the summer heat, and the third bedroom had no AC at all, only a fan. No kettle, coffee, or bottled drinking water was provided. The location was also inconvenient with no stores in walking distance. Overall, the property was poorly maintained, uncomfortable.

Charlie's place was wonderful and exactly as described!
Would recommend!

Tara’s home was exactly as pictured, and she was an incredibly responsive and welcoming host. I stayed for three months with a friend from college while doing a summer internship, and although I was initially nervous about staying somewhere new, Tara made me feel comfortable right away. She met me on my arrival day, walked me through the unit, and made sure I knew where everything was. The only drawback was that noise from the upstairs unit carried quite a bit — footsteps and conversations could be heard very clearly. Overall, though, it was a great stay with a wonderful host.

For a first time user using air bnb i was impressed with how easy the host made everything for us, we had all necessities for a 3 night stay! Rooms were fantastic, it was a beautiful home. Good distance to china town, wicker park, and downtown! Could have been a bit cleaner on the floors and bathrooms but we enjoyed our stay :)

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Kristen’s place! She had provided many recommendations which was greatly appreciated. The rooms were tidy and was just what we needed for our weekend stay. She responded quickly to my messages.
Great place to stay! Definitely recommend to anyone!
This property was absolutely gorgeous.  the place really looks exactly like the pictures. smelled great and was spotless upon arrival
Good
Super responsive host! Clean and safe environment! Gave clear and thorough instructions!  Would recommend and utilize the space in the future!
Well stay there again
Emily’s place was beautiful for a short stay! The place was clean, felt cozy, and the neighborhood was so nice/private. If you’re planning to stay near Chicago, I’d highly recommend!
Being part of the shared aparment of Gurunishan and Jóse was a blessing. A safe place to learn and breath.
Beds were comfortable. Clean, quiet, fabulous front desk. Great location, beautiful scenery. Walking distance. They offered Early check in. Stocked kitchen.

Oscar’s home is the perfect stay for Chicago. His family and dogs were extremely friendly and it felt like a home away from home. I brought my dog with me, and he loved the private yard that wraps around the entire property. I would 100% recommend Oscar’s property.

This place is top tier.  My only reluctance to stating that, is that the selfish side of me doesn't want other people to know it, because I'd like it to be available when we visit Chicago.  This last stay was our second at this location and everything was perfect for us.  We appreciate the ease of entry and the parking situation.  The front sunroom is a great place to enjoy a cup of coffee.  We will definitely be back!

The neighborhood apartment is well appointed, clean and exactly as pictured.  The location is right in the  heart of a busy Lincoln Park intersection.  The hot dog place adjacent to the apartment (Weiner Circle) was happening at all hours so you really need to know it can be loud.

Clean, roomy house where a family could congregate for a wedding nearby. Great to have all the space, especially the well-laid out kitchen.  Everything clean, cared for. Matthew was very quick to respond and accommodating.  Overall, I’ll never forget the time with family in celebration of my daughter’s wedding.
Absolutely fantastic experience. Heather thought of everything we would need for the stay before we thought of it. Cannot recommend the place enough. It should be your top choice; book it!
girlfriend got stuck inside the bathroom for 10 minutes, overpriced for the stay.

eautiful apartment in a great neighborhood. The apartment is renovated with lovely decor and well-stocked. We were a group of couples and our young adult kids and it worked out well for accommodations.
NOTE that the owners live onsite (upstairs unit) and are very engaged with you and your stay. I know that’s not everyone’s jam and it’s not clear in the description so just sharing for info.
Otherwise it’s a beautiful place and you can walk everywhere!

Nael's place was great for our long weekend trip to Chicago! It was perfect for 4 people, with enough space to spread out in the bedrooms and shared spaces. The beds were comfortable and the sheets were very soft. The only note is that the water pressure is a bit low in the showers and the first floor bathtub makes noise when you move around in it. The place is about 15 minutes from downtown, which was easy enough to uber in and out of, and is in a quiet neighborhood near lots of restaurants and shops. Overall, we had a great stay here!
Incredibly responsive host. Great neighborhood.

You get what you pay for, I think my room and bedding wasn't clean so that was annoying. The house outside is neglected and dirty makes walking in feel like the area is unsafe. They need to take care of their yard and the dirt outside. The place has stairs you need to be aware of.
Anny was super communicative and the Airbnb was large with many rooms and bathrooms! Definitely spacious enough for our purposes and close to the blue line. Thank you Anny for a great weekend stay!
The location was phenomenal, such a cute neighborhood with lots to do within walking distance and a really fun vibe. The place itself was clean and exactly as advertised in the photos, very cute.

Clint was a wonderful host and was very timely to respond for any needs. The apartment is exactly as described and was very adequate for my 5 week stay with my dog. The location is perfect and the neighborhood is lovely. Having the backyard and the garage parking was extremely helpful.
Jamal's place was a great stay.  We stayed there for 7 weeks while on a work trip  and were very comfortable that entire time. Would definitely stay again if we're in Chicago!
We had a great time and really enjoyed this AirBNB!  It was just like pictured/described and a very nice place to stay!
Was very clean and well furnished!
Kind and attentive host. Had an amazing experience!
Make sure to check the refund policy. Host told me to cancel my reservation and that she would reimburse me and denied my request for reimbursement
Good space

It's good value for money. The house and the room were very clean, and Andy's communication was excellent. The location is fine - it can feel a bit sketchy at night, but I felt safe there. The walls are thin and you can hear well the guests in other rooms. Everyone was respectful and Andy was great about communicating the presence of other guests, etc., but if you are sensitive to noise or privacy is a priority you may want to consider this aspect. Andy was great not only in communicating but in accommodating my requests (for late check-out, etc.). Overall, I recommend.

This apartment is a short walk to the blue line El (subway) and bus stops. There are many good restaurants in the neighborhood. We especially enjoyed Longman and Eagle, Cafe con Leche, Reno, Federales and La Boulangerie. The online photos of this two bedroom apartment are very accurate. The unit is modern and clean with new appliances and a great washer and dryer. Thank you to Matt for providing a nice, “dog friendly” in a great city!

For a visit to Hyde Park, Kenwood is ideal because there are not many quality Airbnb listings in this area. Also, Kenwood is quiet, a neighborhood full of working people and homeowners going about their business. The on-street parking is easy to find; we ended up in front of our building nearly every night. The apartment is HUGE! Also the layout is ideal, with a spacious living room at the front for hanging out and room for a whole family, while the bedrooms are at the other end. For a weeklong visit Zainab's apartment was ideal. Would defineitely use this place again.

Arman is great, very responsive and friendly.  The apartment is in the perfect location - so close to everything you don't really need a car.  The beds are comfortable. The downsides were not really his fault, but whoever cleaned the apartment.  The dishes and glasses in the cabinet were dirty, like someone put them in the dishwasher after they were rinsed and then the cleaner just put them in the cabinet without running the dishwasher.  The couch needs some attention. Any issues we had he addressed immediately.  The parking was great - always a spot.  You do have to move your car for street cleaning, so that is something to remember.  We stayed in his place for 6 weeks and had a very nice summer.

Sebastien was a wonderful host - friendly and accommodating. The location is great, with lots of restaurants close-by. The room had everything I needed and having a private bathroom was a real bonus. Would definitely recommend and hope to stay again.
Wonderful experience and timely communication!

Giri was an extremely responsive host. Easy to work with. Great area and very safe place to live.
Had an apartment mate that I hardly saw.
Would rent again. Thanks Giri.

We loved staying at Casey’s apartment. It is in a super convention location, close to the highway, parks and restaurants. We felt right at home. Casey’s apartment is spacious, quiet and clean. We loved sitting on the back porch every morning too. We’d love to stay at Casey’s next time we come through Chicago!

Here's my Airbnb review
The location is excellent and easy to get into town by train. The apartment should not be rented to longer term tenants. One bedroom has no closet and the other has no dresser. A washer and dryer was included in the Airbnb description, however they were inaccessible and/or unusable for the majority of the stay. All 3 units share them, and they’re located on the ground floor. Major demolition and construction is being done on the ground floor (which contributed to the inaccessibility of the washer/dryer). The water to the apartment was shut off multiple times for extended periods of time, leaving renters without running water. No one mentioned the downstairs would be under construction before we rented this unit.
The owner is responsive to messages, however this unit has issues for anyone renting longer than a weekend.

Great commute-friendly, safe location! The apartment was clean. Some amenities were missing (coffee filters, hair dryer, trash bags), but the host was very prompt in providing them when I asked about it. Overall a great stay and highly recommended!

My stay at this apartment was wonderful! The location and views were great and the check-in process went smoothly. The World Class team was very kind and quick to respond to any questions I had. Would definitely recommend!

Had a lovely time staying here in July. The location is amazing, Jason was very responsive, and the flat itself is a good size and very comfortable! There's a nice little balcony where you can have breakfast in the mornings and greet his dogs (he'll keep them away if you ask though!), and plenty of room in the flat itself.
Incredible bedding quality. Super clean kitchen.
Excellent accommodations and locations. Clean,  quiet, and good communication.

We had a great stay in Chicago! We have 3 little children & Lisa’s house was the perfect choice for us. Some Airbnbs are just a place to sleep but Lisa’s house provided so much more. We have an oversized SUV & had no issues parking out front luckily.
Will definitely be returning.
Good spot!
This is a great place and location!  Would defiantly stay here again!
Victor was a very good host. The place was also very good for longer term stay.
I would definitely stay here again if I'm back in Chicago!

He is a nice person but somethings could have been better.  There was no jacuzzi, I recommend uploading a picture of the jacuzzi so prospective clients can see. We were given confusing directions to the apartment and for that we ended up in someone else’s house. The instructions could have been better. It was a good stay overall.

My stay at Yu’s place was quiet and convenient. I needed a spot close to public transportation, and it’s only a six-minute walk from the Orange Line CTA station. I appreciated having a grocery store nearby, and the on-site washer and dryer were a big plus. The kitchen is well-equipped with a stove, microwave, and fridge. One of my favorite parts of the stay was meeting Caesar—he stops by every day to make sure everything is in great shape. If you’re looking for an extended stay in Chicago, this is it.

This is such a great spot! I was there the entire summer and couldn't have had a better experience. The doormen knew my name and the facilities are really nice. Great location and the view from the apartment is beautiful. It is a perfect walking distance from the river walk, and Oak St beach. The host was really communicative and would order anything I needed on amazon for the apartment. Great kitchen that was super clean and had everything I needed. Very spacious apartment for Chicago!
Had a wonderful time at Jason’s place. Very unique features and excellent location.

Another excellent stay at Tracy's place.  I appreciated the flexibility regarding timing for my stay.  This is a quiet spacious unit with a very modern bathroom and plenty of closet space and hangers.  It's also close to Jarvis El and some cafes.
Very clean and nice room. Amazing location and very walkable.

I was visiting the Uchicago med and Sydney’s property was very close to it .
The place was just as described and had additional useful stuff apart from what is described .
The hosts were very responsive to questions and also were very mindful of the privacy of the visitors
I will rate this property as 5/5
Great place

Ubicación excepcional, frente a Lincoln Park, con el zoo a apenas 10 minutos andando. Zona tranquila, bonita y familiar. Bien conectada con otras zonas de la ciudad por autobuses. Hay buenos cafés y restaurantes cerca, zonas verdes y buen ambiente en general. El piso es cómodo y está limpio. David tuvo el detalle de dejarnos una trona, cuna, juguetes y cuentos para bebés, incluso una máquina de ruido blanco en el dormitorio. Todo muy útil! También nos dejaron recomendaciones de qué hacer en la zona durante nuestra instancia.

We had a wonderful stay at this unique and spotless home in Chicago! The highlight was definitely the rooftop patio with its breathtaking view of downtown — a perfect spot to relax and enjoy the city skyline. Communication was quick and reliable throughout our stay. Jerry, who welcomed us and gave us a tour on the first day, was extremely friendly and helpful. The location was great too — just 2.6 miles from the Willis Tower. Highly recommended!
It was a very smooth process and everything was as described. Victor was very responsive.

Mr. Lenoid was very communicative in details to answer any questions, checking in, amenities...extra. His girlfriend/ wife made us feel home and she is very nice and keeps place neat. I appreciate the filtered water and coffee machine...I had to use washer/ dryer and they welcomed us to use whatever we need... Big thanks. Bed & pillows were comfortable. Shower room& kitchen are great. Location: is close to DT plus has grocery within 5 mins walk, but not safe to walk after 8 or 9 pm so please use uber or taxi ... while we walked to train station in the morning and afternoon safely.
If I will visit this side of Chicago, I will book this place again. 😊

Anthony's place was user friendly, super clean and he provided great communication. The area was walkable and there were plenty of places to grab a bite to eat. I would definitely recommend this place.

Ewa is an excellent host—kind, friendly, and very accommodating. She made me feel welcome from the moment I arrived and ensured everything was comfortable. The space was clean, cozy, and in a great location, which made getting around Chicago easy. My stay worked out perfectly for the reasons I was in the city, and I truly appreciated her thoughtfulness and hospitality. And her dog Bruno is adorable!!!
great hosts.  great building.  great neighborhood.  the best summer of my life with my son!

Excellent Airbnb for a month-long stay and for remote working.
The Airbnb was as described and may be one of the well-stocked Airbnb that I’ve stayed in. The space included little touches of kitchen and bath amenities (ex: dish detergent, paper towel, etc) that were really appreciated for a month stay.
The master bedroom was extremely quiet and the bed was comfortable. Occasionally, the guest bedroom may experience some sidewalk noise at night, which can’t be controlled.
The host was very responsive, answered all my questions promptly and provided amenities requests within the day. Highly recommend.

Definitivamente es un lugar al cual pienso regresar en mi futura estancia en Chicago. El lugar se encuentra cercano a una tienda Jewel Osco (supermercado) y la estación Cottage Grove (línea verde) que te lleva directo a la zona del centro de la ciudad.
Helen's place was clean. Spacious bedroom &bathroom. Easy check-in/check-out, and she communicated well. Also, nice that she posted guidelines and expectations for the shared spaces.

Best airbnb I’ve had period. Myrtle was very kind and flexible and made me feel like I was at home which is more than anything I could ask for coming to a new city for a long period of time. From check-in to check-out, it was a pleasant stay and no issues whatsoever and everything was communicated clearly.

I absolutely loved this property and Jennifer was nothing but helpful and friendly. The area is super safe and quiet and plenty of space ti park a car if need be. Because I booked this property last min due to a previous property cancelation (for our safety, as Airbnb said) the agent in the phone made me think that this property was the closest to downtown so I ended up paying and extra 200$ difference to change to this  property. So I didn’t appreciate the dishonesty after I realized it.
Clean, affordable, easy access to downtown.
It was what we needed. Thank you!
walkable and accessible
Very nice!

This was a really comfortable stay in Hyde Park. I really enjoyed it. There is a kitchen, two bathrooms, and a built in washer/dryer unit all in the second floor. Overall, this was a really affordable stay with a lot of amenities. The host was really kind and very responsive. Definitely book the place if you’re staying in Hyde park.
Great and clean place, very convenient to downtown.
William’s place is located right where I needed to be. The room was clean and William a gracious and responsive host.

The location is fantastic for our business group of 19. The rooftop is incredible and the views out of the lake facing apartment are just amazing. The location and parking were easy to work with and it was a nice surprise to have two parking spots available.
Unfortunately the fridge didn’t cool, the ice maker and coffee maker are both broken, and dishes were put away unwashed. We were able to manage these issues and were not staying long enough to address them with management but for the price paid it would be nice to have the appliances working well.
Had a good stay here. Host provided clear instructions, and was responsive. Not much in the immediate area, but access to blue and pink line, as well as buses, so was easy getting around.

Excellent place and excellent host. Not far from Downtown and Wrigley with very accessible public transportation and plenty of Ubers. Additionally, located in a beautiful and quiet neighborhood with great restaurants nearby.
Host was wonderful and easy to communicate with and left clear instructions. will definitely book again if I need to go back to Chicago.

Great second floor apartment with plenty of room and great internet. Not too far from Horner Park and some great restaurants like Crust Brewing. Washer is downstairs out the back door and costs $1 in quarters only. Overall great place, would recommend.

We chose Toby's place at the last minute because we needed a place to stay near our friend who was recovering from surgery.  He was friendly, responsive, and very accommodating to our specific needs.  The house was quiet, comfortable, and spacious. It is located on a lovely street, and the garage parking spot was a nice bonus.
Dope place! Loved the location. Super easy to transport down to the loop. Just a mile to Lakeshore and a gorgeous view from the lake.
Great location, great host, would recommend staying here!
Great place to host a larger group in Chicago!
Very nice amenities, comfortable bed - would stay again!

Jeremy was an excellent host throughout our stay, going above and beyond for us, letting us know all about the area and what events were going on etc. Any issues that occurred he resolved immediately for us and he was always very polite in every interaction. Really nice location too with the locals being very nice to our group as well as the bus stop being only a 2 minute walk away, as well as local food spots and shops. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting the area. 5 stars.
I had a great time, feels like home. I wish I could be there again!

We chose Tony’s place because it was so convenient to Wrigley and the red line. His place is beautiful and comfortable! My husband and I took the queen bedroom off the kitchen and it was very comfortable. My family enjoyed having their own rooms and spreading out! The air hockey table was a hit. The kitchen is beautiful and a Whole Foods is super close. We parked right out front of the place, using the provided street parking stickers. We walked to the red line and zipped downtown between Cubby games. I definitely would stay here again!

Had a great time at Shay's spot. I had to work during the mornings and there were a lot of places to set up my laptop and stay cozy and comfy. The location is perfect, couldn't ask for better. The surrounding neighborhood is so fun but it's out of the hustle and bustle of downtown, which is an easy train ride to get to (literally right around the corner basically). My son and I had a ton of activities planned from baseball games to broadway and it was a breeze to use the transit from here. The place was super roomy and comfortable. Highly recommend for someone coming to Chicago for the first time!

Donna is a great host. She was very responsive and accommodated to all my requests. The apartment is older but clean and conveniently located near the blue line station and within walking distance to many restaurants. The street parking was also easily available and didn’t require any permit.
Very Clean.  Chialung was very nice, friendly and accommodating.  Bed was very comfortable. I would definitely stay there again next time I am in Chicago.

Our group enjoyed the stay very much and found the space to accommodate our needs perfectly. We enjoyed the walk, ability to local restaurants and the convention center and took advantage of the local bike trails. We would absolutely stay here again.
Perfect little neighborhood for those with not so friendly dogs that want to go to the city on the weekend. Private back yard and walkable streets under lush trees for cooler summer walks.

We stayed here for 6 weeks and had such a great experience. The host was incredibly accommodating and responsive throughout our stay, making sure we had everything we needed. The location is excellent, just a short walk to shops, cafes, and the Blue Line, which made getting around the city very easy. We really appreciated the warm hospitality and would gladly stay here again. Highly recommended!
Casa top
Great place to stay in Chicago. Lovely neighborhood. Great Communication.
Situated in a beautiful and quiet neighborhood! It was a great stay.
Nice stay at Daniel’s place!  I would recommend!

Had the pleasure of staying in this property for the Summer, it is close to shops and transport and makes commuting into the city centre easy. The neighbourhood is safe and friendly. We had zero issues and Nathan was always friendly and co-operative. Would highly recommend.

I loved this location I thought it really resembled Chicago being close to public transport and all, the inside was clean and neat and very comfortable, I wasn’t expecting other people to be living in the same kind of area as us but it was no biggie because all were friendly. Felt safe inside :) I also didn’t realize it was close to parkway gardens but still generally safe :)
A great stay with wonderful scenery

Great location and space. Daniel and his team were incredibly responsive and communicative throughout our stay, handling several small issues right away.
The area is a bit noisy because of the hospital nearby, but very safe and close to everything. The home is older, but great kitchen and had everything we needed for a long stay.
Cosy apartment nearby Chinatown. Made loads of memories here this summer and couldn’t ask for friendlier hosts who were very accommodating

Area was lovely, easy to get to wrigleyville on 80 busline. Football pitch right across road. 20 minute walk to blue line train so getting downtown was a bit more difficult but still very doable, generally was about a 50 minute journey. Great place to live for the summer and a great spot to have as a base to explore the entire city of Chicago and its suburbs. Rosa is very responsive and was helpful with our queries.
Great stay especially for the price. Host was great at communicating and clear with instructions.
Looks even better than the pictures. In a cool and walkable area. Great experience, would recommend!
Very nice place with nice hosts! Would stay here again

We had a great visit! The location was perfect…walking distance to everything. Also, easy access to the ‘L’. Street parking was always available too.
The apartment had everything we needed. Brett was very responsive to any questions we had.
We will be back!
とても親切に対応していただきました。中心部へのアクセスもよく、おかげさまでとても快適なシカゴ滞在となりました。また是非伺いたいと思います。

The Greenleaf house is a great place if you want to explore Chicago but like a quiet place to stay at. As a solo traveler I felt very safe in the area. The shared kitchen and living room are very well put together and the entire accommodation was clean! My room was very simple (bed, shelf and mirror) but I didn't need much more. I used the bus and train to get into town, it was very easy and took about 35 minutes. The reason I gave less stars for communication is because Greenhouse offers to give you extra blankets and towels. I messaged Brian where to find an extra blanket but even up to today no one ever replied to my message. I think a good communication is key at providing a place for people to stay at on Aibnb. I enjoyed my stay at Greenleaf so thank you for providing such a great place!
The room was clean and had everything we needed. It was located in the heart of everything  that we were able to walk. Loved every bit of our stay there and will be back.
Amazing stay and hosts. I recommend for everyone!!!

This was a phenomenal experience from start to finish. The place was on the second floor in a quiet neighborhood. It was clean and organized with everything we needed for our stay.
The listing described the apartment perfectly and Sean was communicative throughout our entire stay.
Thank you for a great stay!
Great stay! Affordable! Great value ! It was overall an amazing stay with easy access to the room and house. Highly recommend! Great host as well. By far the best experience i’ve ever had:)!

Ami is so lovely and it was great to meet him ! He was so communicative and accommodating throughout our whole trip. Staying here definitely made everything so much better. Bus stops were super close and places like The Hat and Hollywood Grill (open 24/7) made getting a quick meal super easy. It’s also a decent walk to get to a blue line station. There is a very nice shopping strip nearby where you can visit several curated vintage shops, record stores, and local restaurants. I would highly recommend this place if you plan on visiting Chicago.

Our stay was great! The place was exactly as described - beautiful, spotless, and with an amazing view. The location is perfect, just minutes from downtown, and parking was super convenient. The host was incredibly responsive, making everything smooth and easy. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience.
Place as described— very spacious and amazing location close to great restaurants and the blue line.

We absolutely loved our stay! Everything was very clean, modern, and so cute. Anny went out of her way to be responsive and helpful above and beyond what I would expect. On multiple occasions she went out of her way to help us and truly made our stay better! I only wish our stay was longer! Until next time! Than you for giving us a small home away from home! 🥰

The bed was so comfy! The space was very cute and the neighborhood was beautiful. A lot of love went into this space, I loved all the creative details throughout the apartment. Hosts were very friendly, neighborhood was quiet, felt safe walking morning and evening!
Great deal

Vi likte særlig godt takterrassen og den korte veien til stranda. Huset var veldig godt egnet til vårt reisefølge som var 2 foreldre og 3 voksne barn. Huset hadde 3 soverom. Alt fungerte godt i huset. Vi brukte buss og uber under oppholdet til og fra byen og det fungerte bra. Bussen stopper rett utenfor huset.
Brian’s home was clean, well furnished, and in a great location!  Would definitely stay there again.
Everything just as pictured.   We had a great time, LOVED the pool, pretty view and clean place.   Would def stay here again!

This was a very convenient location for us as we were in Chicago to help someone move to Brighton Park.  The apartment itself was clean and quiet. We didn't really need much because we were gone most days, but we did want to cook a few times.  The kitchen had no toaster, and the only pans were one very small frying pan and one very small saucepan.  The bathroom was clean, and the towels and toiletries were nice.  The bathroom door did not close all the way because of humidity.  Not such a problem since it was just my husband and I, but it is something that should be fixed.  I wanted to do some laundry, but I did not because the laundry facilities were down in the basement which was very dirty.  The front of the building looks nice and the apartment is clean, but once you go out the back door, the building is very old and dirty.  The description also says a spacious backyard "where you can enjoy a morning coffee or an evening under the stars" but the backyard had a lot of garbage in it.

We enjoyed our stay but we have a few suggestions: the house was very hard to find just from the address, as the trees in the yard obscure the house and the house is set back from the street. A picture of the property would have been helpful. The place was as described but was not as clean as we would have preferred. The kitchen cabinets were messy and “clean” dishes in the cabinet were not found to be clean.
The provided waffle mix proved to be an open package in the fridge, which only covered one breakfast for our family of 6. The pantry was filled with past dated food. The bathroom was decent but the bath mat was visibly soiled. The beds were ok, but we would definitely have preferred to have mattress pads on all of the beds. The only bed linens provided were duvets and fitted sheets, and the linens looked worn. This could have been because the host laundered them all faithfully; we hope that was the case. Overall, if the cleanliness were improved, we would book there again.

The condos are spectacular.   The views are amazing.  The location is great.  The unit has a very beautiful kitchen.  The appliances are top notch.  The mattresses are excellent.  The furnishings are plush.  This place was perfect for our small company get-a-way retreat.  Very spacious.  Everything you could want is a walk away.  The city is amazing to experience.  It was perfect to have this condo as our home base.  Our hosts were very helpful and friendly.
We had great service with the front desk Vontae was very helpful with all questions I had and treated us like royalty. He made my husband’s birthday special thank you Vontae!

J’ai passé un excellent séjour chez Helen. Le logement est très propre, que ce soit la chambre, la cuisine ou la salle de bain. La ligne verte du train se trouve juste à côté, ainsi que plusieurs lignes de bus, ce qui facilite les déplacements. Le quartier est très calme, parfait pour se reposer.
Je recommande vivement ce logement, sans oublier de souligner le professionnalisme de Helen, toujours disponible et attentionnée.
Je reviendrai sans hésiter !
Great location, great host!

I can’t say enough about this unit!
Clean and in a great location!
The rooftop was amazing! We had a lot of fun there!
Also James was very responsive and helpful!
Definitely be back soon!
Chicago is a very beautiful city, and the housing provided by Genova is excellent. I really like it.

Comfortable place. No parking on immediate street and hard to find parking even to check in..
The court yard was not useable and I was looking forward to that since it was in photos.
Nice place!

Caryl and Phillipe are fantastic hosts! Clear communication, excellent conversation and rooms and home exactly as seen in photos and clean. Breakfast was the perfect size and of great variety and quality. Location is also fantastic in Hyde park—you won’t find a better place to stay!

Yes me too. I fell for the Airbnb / room picks scam. Hidden fees that you don’t know about until check in.
And the guy checking in next to me as well
Messaged Airbnb and they said I saw it at check out. But then after you book that information mysteriously disappears.
I’ve always liked Airbnb but not anymore. Telling everyone I know that Airbnb is now a scam company that doesn’t care about its customers.
Was a very comfortable and enjoyable base for a week in Chicago.

We felt right at home! Excellent location, walkable to everything, excellent restaurants, bars, Lincoln Park, the lake, the ‘L’ train etc.
Spacious living area, we each had our own couch when we came back to rest. ;)
Hatice was an excellent communicator.
I would stay here again if I’m ever so lucky to come back to Chicago.
Jorge is a good guy and he treats people like family. The place was always clean and the amenities were great.
Great communication, clean place

I am very grateful to have such wonderful AirBNB hosts. Akiko and Masato could not have been more helpful and accommodating. We needed to find a month long stay at the last minute because our other rental plan did not work out. (beware of renting on rental platforms that are not vetted, as we were scammed). We are so grateful that there was an opening at this place. The hosts were extremely responsive. The house was in a safe neighborhood, walkable to the train, and had a nice kitchen and clean bathroom and common area. It was so much nicer than the rental we had originally booked. Also, my son needed to extend his stay for longer than expected, and Akiko and Masato were very helpful. I would highly recommend this place as a safe and clean place to stay. It is a little bit of a commute to downtown Chicago where my son had a job, but it was easy enough to commute on public transportation, and workable without a car. Thank you so much.

Milan always communicated kindly and responded promptly! He would also check in to make sure everything was going smoothly. The space was clean. There were great public transit options across the street & a short walking distance from the building. The house comfortably fit our group of 5. Good experience!
Matthew was very responsive, helpful, and clear with his communication. The condo was clean and livable; beds were very comfortable.

Me & Friends had nice stay at Rich’s house! We stayed for the annual lollapalooza festival and it was close to the train station and not a far Lyft drive to downtown. I would recommend some more cookware and utensils for the kitchen for people with longer stays. But it was very comfortable overall and would stay here again.

This Airbnb offers a prime location near Chicago’s top attractions, with convenient access to public transportation and a safe neighborhood. Highly recommended for anyone planning a visit to the city.
Thank you for a wonderful stay! So lovely and quiet—a perfect little stop on our road trip!

Wonderful stay! The apartment was clean, well-equipped, and in a great location. Hosts were thoughtful, responsive, and made everything smooth. Stayed here for a few months and would Highly recommend!

The house was beautiful, large with plenty of space. Loved the master bath shower. The place is better than the photos. Easy walk to the L, great location. Nicely equipped kitchen. We would highly recommend AJ and Hannah’s place and will definitely be back.
Great home and great host!
loved staying here with my family and great area

Gleatha’s place met my family’s needs perfectly. It’s quiet, clean, and comfortable. There were plenty of kitchen and bath amenities that were all super helpful and served real needs (felt much more like a home than a hotel). The location was ideal for us. Beachfront is an easy walk and multiple museums of interest are within a short distance. Our host was also on hand to answer questions and showed genuine hospitality. Thank you!

A fantastic place to stay for our family.  Location was IDEAL for getting around the city.  Did not need to rent a car we used an Uber and/or city bus, which was easy and comfortable for our family of four.  The place was very clean and comfortable and spacious enough for our family (2 Adults, a 16-yo and an 8yo).  Neighborhood is safe and locked gates were on each side of the alley that led to the door.  Never once thought about safety.  Plenty of places to eat within walking distance and one of the best coffee shops I've frequented within a minute walk.  Would recommend this place to anyone.
Perfect Airbnb if you’re looking to go to Wrigley! Walking distance from multiple places! Bella was easy to get in touch with at all times! Hoping to be back in the future!
We stayed here for 10 weeks during the summer. The apartment is very spacious. Jen is extremely quick to reply to any questions we had during our stay. We would definitely come back. 10/10 stay

Beautiful peaceful area that’s easy to get into the city from but has good restaurants in the vicinity as well. The space felt “like home” and had a nice tv and good wifi and plenty to work with in the kitchen. Ninoc was accommodating as well (from afar). Only recommendation is being that it is a basement unit, not sure how long it had been but could’ve used a vacuum for sure, but was otherwise clean and nicely appointed and beautiful convenient neighborhood.
Really enjoyed our stay! The home was spacious and clean. Close by 2 train stations making it very convenient. We loved eating breakfast on the back deck. Would stay again.
Was a great stay and she allowed me to book last minute and the place was nice

Lovely home, very spacious and easy to navigate to and around. Hosts were very responsive when we had questions or needed assistance. Kid friendly. Walkable to the train. Had an ac unit upstairs and plenty of fans to keep the house cool.
Ivy se mostró siempre amable y atenta, el lugar fue bastante acogedor y nos sentimos como en casa. Contaba con todo lo necesario y la zona es muy tranquila. Lo recomiendo!!
We had a great stay and were in distance to the blue line which was a lifesaver for getting around. Was always a relief to come back to Meghan’s place after a long day out. Definitely worth the stay!

Andy gave clear instructions on how to find the unit. As everyone described, it seems a bit shoddy since there are units under construction around it but we never felt unsafe. The space is as described and clean! plently of space to store things and the kitchen is labeled so you know where to store your belongs food-wise. But not only that lots of things were labeled which was very helpful. The room was as listed, two bathrooms as well to use and everything was clean. Andy most of all was very hospitable and responsive! Would stay again if we were in the area.
Very nice condo. Close to water taxi, walkable neighborhood.

Just met us on her porch as we arrived by Uber... Much appreciated.
The rental is the upper floor of the Duplex, the hosts below. Slippers provided to protect the nice wooden floor.
A keylock protects the apartment. A clean place with comfy beds and clean bathrooms.
25 minutes walk east to the Lake.
Can recommend the Peckish Pig on Howard about 10 minutes on foot.
Good place for the price.

Great place, coming in as a local to the area it was a treat to enjoy a place like Darren’s in my hometown. Very “Chicago,” if you catch my drift. Neighborhood is quiet, walk up building is beautiful, yard is pretty, unit itself is solid. Skip the high rises downtown and stay at Darren’s if you wanna experience Chicago like a local!

My 5 friends and I spent the summer staying in this apartment and it was amazing! Walking distance from Wrigley stadium and bars and right beside the red line Addison stop, you are in an amazing location. The apartment had all the amenities we needed and fit 6 of us comfortably. Special shout out to Dennis who was extremely helpful to us through out the whole summer! Would recommend to anyone going to Chicago.
Eric was an amazing and friendly host! He gave us helpful recommendations & was always responsive. We enjoyed our stay, and I highly recommend staying with Eric!

Pros: Close to the subway and restaurants (late night pizza anyone?). They also redeemed themselves from the big issue described below. I would have rated one-star if not for their attempt at making it right. The in-unit laundry was a big plus too.
Cons: Would have been nice to have filtered water and/or ice cubes, but the biggest issue was the lock. The keypad to my door stopped working, and I got locked out of my room at 11pm. I called the emergency line and went back and forth talking to various folks until 4am, when I finally had to give up on getting help that night. I had to sleep in a random room in my dirty clothes without showering or brushing or a phone charger. Worst night-- it severely impacted my trip. The next morning I was given a key and a partial refund, which I genuinely appreciate-- it was just a little too late, and I had to miss out on some sightseeing activities (first world problems I know, but I saved up a lot for this trip!). Overall, I wouldn't return.

Tejal’s apartment truly lived up to its outstanding rating. She’s an incredibly welcoming host who has clearly put thoughtful care into every possible detail. From the moment we arrived, we felt right at home and enjoyed every minute of our stay in the beautiful city of Chicago.
The location is perfect — just a short walk to Fulton Market, one of the city’s top culinary spot. And the view from her living room? Absolutely stunning. It was the perfect place to relax after a day of exploring.
We couldn’t have asked for a better experience — highly recommended!
Great place and great host!

If you need a place to stay, it gets the job done. Bathroom and room were clean, but it seems guests don’t throw away their food in the fridge/pantry/kitchen space before they leave so there’s lots of food items there.
Yes green line is close by, but it’s an intimidating trek. Our 1st day arriving, we got off, someone catcalled us and started following us and yelling things behind us. Scary to say the least. Next day on our way to the green line we ran into 5 people under the influence of drugs and one person approached us again. We walked fast and just didn’t look back. That was enough for us to just decide to Uber from then on. When we Ubered home that evening, our Uber driver told us that this area was extremely dangerous. He told us that under no circumstances should we go outside in the day time or night time because of the probability of getting mugged ~ says it happens all the time in this area. That was enough for us to book a different place. A heads up would have been nice.

My stay here was wonderful! The host is super responsive and makes sure you are well-equipped and comfortable for your stay. He allowed for a flexible check-in when my plans were cancelled and also flexible with my check-out which I was grateful for since I was able to time it perfectly with my flight departure! Although there were only 2 of us staying here, this place is large and suitable for 4+. This is a lower ground unit that basically looks like a well-kept basement. This would be a good place for a short-term stay. We were here for 6 nights and would not recommend to stay for longer due to limited amenities which is clearly listed on the listing (no kitchen or freezer). However, there was an air fryer (love!) utensils, microwave, sink, and fridge. There was only one trash bag and  to collect the trash BUT when I asked the host for extra bags he provided them with no hesitation. Thank you for the great AND affordable time at Chicago!

Great host!
Place is in a great location !!
All was good
The place was nice and clean. Recently updated and great location to Roger’s Park area.

We loved our stay at this place! The hosts were very friendly and accommodating to our needs! We used this Airbnb for Lollapalooza and it was very accessible and easy to get to and from the festival grounds. It is comfortable 10 minute walk to the nearest station (I am 5’1 and take smaller strides so take that as you will), and it was in a peaceful neighborhood. We had no issues with our stay and hope to book again if given the chance!

I stayed at Victoria's place for 6 nights during Lollapalooza in Chicago. Victoria is very warm and welcoming. If I needed to contact her, she would text back within 1-15 minutes and at home she would check in on me and make sure accommodations were okay (i.e. trash bag etc.) She didn't mind when we came home late from Lollapalooza, either. Overall great host!
A few details on the stay:
AC was at a comfortable temperature, didn't need to turn the fan on in the room, even though it was summer.
The restroom is shared with another AirBnb guest. Worked for me, I never even saw them once.
Victoria does have two dogs, though she keeps them on a different floor. If you have sever allergies though, maybe consider this.
The room was very clean. The bed was comfortable and sheets were good quality. Mirror in the room and dresser was great for getting ready.
Overall, I felt safe the whole time. It was only 45m-1 hr to take a bus downtown; 25min uber. 100% would stay with Victoria again.

This is our second stay here at the Clifton House. We love it. It’s a great house. The host is awesome to work with and has great friendly communication. Honestly we want to stay here every time we come to Wrigleyville. We will be back soon.

Diana was a great host. From the beginning she was accommodating and easy to communicate with. The house was amazing and had a lot of unique cool art and felt spacious yet comfortable. The house was clean and made the perfect place for us to stay during our trip. Thank you Diana for letting us stay at your place! I would definitely recommend and would stay again!!
Great stay yet again ! Would 10/10 recommend this place for anyone looking. Thank you Thomas for your hospitality!!

It was a beautiful stay and the place was just as advertised. The home felt welcoming and up to par with what the owner had shared. Excellent amenities and easy access, she also was very quick with her responsive which showed she care about the safety and well being of her guest. Close to public transit which is always a plus in any place you would want to stay at.
Great stay, cannot recommend enough. Will most likely stay here again next time.
The unit was as described- small but perfect for one person. The building was quiet and comfortable. The hosts were extremely responsive and it was obvious they cared about doing a great job.
