Great communication from Lewis, from clear instructions and details from his page to his response rates. Great size for a short stay, with comfy couches and big tv. We tried one of the beds first but it was way too soft and ended up switching to the firmer one (by the kitchen). There were a few cleanliness issues but other than that, we enjoyed our stay and the food in the area.

TERRIBLE. Pay more and go elsewhere!
The fridge didn’t work, and the host downplayed it even though it spoiled our food. She was hostile after we contacted Airbnb support and made us feel unwelcome. The listing advertised 3 bedrooms, but only 2 were accessible, even after we updated the guest count and paid the extra fee. The linens were stained, towels unusable, and we had to buy our own. There was a kitchen leak, water damage on walls, and missing basic amenities. The home felt unclean and unsafe. The steep entry stairs are dangerous, and a camera at the entrance felt invasive. Host blamed us for property issues and harassed us with early morning calls. We avoided being at the house most of the day. I had to rebook another place after 4 nights, spending $400+ just to feel safe.
This was my first visit to Chicago and my worst Airbnb stay in 4 years. Very disappointed. I’ve never felt so unwelcome or stressed while traveling. This experience alone made me question using Airbnb agai

Susan was a wonderful host with a beautiful home! My friends and I loved staying, and would definitely recommend her Airbnb to anyone staying in Chicago. The location is walkable to a gorgeous and very private beach. Susan also provided various snacks and drinks as a bonus for our stay which was so generous! she also went above and beyond with her recommendations for Chicago!! You can tell she really enjoys hosting with all her special touches!
The space itself was clean, spacious, quiet and private. We felt very safe and welcomed in the area! The AC was always on at the perfect temperature which was great during the Chicago summer.
We will definitely be back!

was a great little place to stay for our first visit to chicago. could pretty much get anywhere between buses and trains. close to Rate Field with a few eateries/plaza areas nearby. the home itself was clean, quiet and had everything we could need.

The highlight of this property is its exceptional neighborhood.
The street is quiet and picturesque, and the home is within walking distance of two beautiful parks, a top-notch bakery, and a fantastic Mexican restaurant. The area is filled with young families and has a very safe, welcoming feel.
The home's layout was ideal for our family of four, offering plenty of space to spread out comfortably. The beds were reasonably comfortable, and the home was well-equipped without feeling cluttered. Yao was highly responsive, and we experienced no issues during our stay. We’d absolutely stay here again!

I had a wonderful stay at Monica’s place , it was truly a great value for the price. The home was one of the most well-equipped I’ve ever stayed in, with everything you could possibly need and more. It’s thoughtfully designed, extremely comfortable, and conveniently located close to the city and all major attractions. Highly recommended!

My friend and I stayed for a week. It was perfect and better than what we were expecting. The area is fine about a 5 minute walk to the train. About 15-20 minute train ride into the city. Just be aware of your soundings, keep to yourself, and you’ll be fine. There was another bedroom we didn’t know about which was a nice plus and we loved the big mirror. Would stay again if given the chance.
Hosts and home were great! Sadly, no pool table. Wifi was spotty, too.
Great stay in a homey, clean, and safe environment! Ming was amazingly accommodating and ensured our stay was as wonderful as possible.
very clean and very beautiful, I recommend this house, if I come on vacation again I will gladly book this house!!!!
Muy buen departamento!
It was a fabulous spot
Great visit. Excellent host.
Great stay! Out family of 8 was able to get restful sleep after out packed weekend! Angie also reply really quick which was great for our fam😙

Jeremiah was an EXCELLENT host! When we accidentally locked ourselves out,  he went above and beyond to help solve the issue. The apartment is basement level and on a busy street so you’ll hear everyday city noise/walking above but nothing excessive to complain about. The neighborhood is very walkable with a nice park across the street and, a shopping district with many restaurants to choose from 10 minutes (by car) away. There were other guest staying in the room next to us but they were so quiet we sometimes forgot they were even there. I definitely would want to stay here again next time i’m in the city.

increidble location, airbnb and Host. Lee was always attentive and answering all questions we had regarding locations, restaurants, ways to move around, etc. and proactive on giving further recomendations that we would like.

This is a jewel in the city and a must repeat stay. This is the perfect spot for bringing your dog. It is close to the 606 trail which means lots of great walks with your dog. Neighborhood is very walkable with several great bars and restaurants. The master bath is a special treat with walk in shower. Quiet neighborhood so you can chill and your dog is not disturbed by loud city noises. Loved it!
good decoration and location
This was our first time to Chicago and we had a great time.  Lilian was a great host and responded quickly to any questions we had.  The condo is very nice, clean and comfy and we felt right at home.

The room and bathroom were just as described, and Flora was very communicative. The location was great - the CTA blue line, as well as a bus stop, were both within very short walking distances. I felt safe during my stay, and would stay here again.
Pleasant stay overall

Cloud9’s unit was amazing.
The unit was quiet , private and the views were nice. Everything was clean and comfortable.
Great location-We were a short ride from all the things we wanted to do.
Great communication- Charlie from the Cloud 9 crew was so helpful and responsive. He really made us feel at home with the breakfast goodies!!!
I would definitely stay with them again!

Ares kept me in the loop leading up to my stay. Staying in the neighborhood felt like I was able to be a local during my stay, with a place that feels like you can call it home, and kind inviting neighbors that greeted me on a morning walk. Lots of space all throughout to for everyone to have their own personal room.

Great place with a very helpful host, we flew in earlier than our check in time was able to help us out! We had such a great time chicago and stay at this home was a such important part of this experience!
Place was very cool and host was great!

We had a great stay at this Airbnb. The space was clean, comfortable, and just as described in the listing. There was a bit of a delay during check-in, but the host was very hospitable and handled it with professionalism and care, making sure we were taken care of and comfortable once we got in.
The rest of our stay went smoothly, and we appreciated the thoughtful touches throughout the home. I’d recommend this place to anyone looking for a clean, welcoming spot to stay!
Excellent stay, my second time there and it feels like home.
It was a nice and clean spot right outside the city. Host was responsive with any concerns and communicated with us.
if you want lots of daylight throughout your stay, stay here. they are very friendly and responsive and place is not too far from downtown. 15-20 mins at the max depending on traffic.
Great experience, it’s across from a firehouse so sirens are loud sometimes. Close to CTA stop.
Great place for a short-term stay.

It was a great stay at this apartment, very near to University of Chicago, walkable distance only 2 block away from university.
Host was also very responsive.
Metra station and CTA bus station is very close to apartment only 1-2 block away…very convenient for city ride..
Thank you so much

The best Airbnb experience we ever had. Big house with lots of charm. Beautiful neighborhood. And most importantly, Lisa and Mark were the best hosts ever. Always making sure we had the best time and we are getting everything we need. A wonderful experience which we will always remember!
Honestly if I were to come back to Chicago I’ll be more than glad to come back to this Airbnb because of how convenient the location was and most importantly how welcoming the host was to us!

Great location, especially if you’re catching a Cubs game or planning to spend time in Boystown. The photos are an accurate reflection of the Airbnb it looks just like what’s shown online. The host was very responsive and even offers early check-in and late check-out options for a small fee, which is super convenient. My only issue is the parking, but that’s to be expected in Chicago, so it’s not a big deal overall.
amazing stay,easy access to downtown as well!

I had such an amazing stay!! The neighborhood is beautiful with restaurants and local stores that are just a short walk away! The building is beautiful and I had no problems at all. I would definitely recommend staying here and I would definitely stay here again!
I had a wonderful stay. The host was exceptionally kind and responsive to all my queries. The place was spotless, well-maintained, and very comfortable. I highly recommend it!
Robert was incredibly cooperative and helpful with us. The property offered an incredible space in Chicago that was definitely worth it.

This stay is exactly what you’re paying for. You get a room and one bathroom that’s shared with three other rooms. I would recommend bringing shower shoes as you’re sharing the bathroom with many other people and, like they say in the listing, it doesn’t stay clean. If you’re a light sleeper bring earplugs or stay somewhere else because you can hear creaking in every floor of the house. The quiet hours aren’t great if you don’t want to feel like you’re staying in a library so keep that in mind if you plan on being out later than 9pm. The room was cute and the beds were fairly comfortable but I brought an extra pillow because I like more than one pillow when I’m sleeping. The walk to the train station is pretty quick so the location is convenient. All the cameras and sound detectors do kind of make it feel like you’re being spied on though. The host was great and very responsive!
Everything was good! Excellent communication, cute area to stay in, clean space.
This was such a accommodating and loving place to stay at with my kids and dog. Such kind people.

Apparently the person who was in the Airbnb before me had not left. So the host “upgraded” me to staying in a room in her house. I had to text her every single time I wanted to be let into the house as it was always locked with no keypad (keypad had been advertised). It was just a room in her house whereas advertised there was a kitchen, desk area that I could work from, and a larger bathroom. I paid way too much to only have a room in a house that I had to be let into every time.
Absolutely amazing stay! Very clean, very comfortable, very spacious. Highly highly highly recommend!

My sister and I had such an amazing stay. The location was perfect for everything we wanted to do. About a 15 minute walk to the train and about a 10 minute drive to the beach. The neighborhood felt very safe. We were able to find street parking close to the house each day. The space was very clean and had everything we needed. I would highly recommend staying here. We will be back! :)

I had an amazing stay at this property last week. The home was spotless, well-maintained, and exactly as described in the listing. The host was incredibly welcoming and responsive, making check-in and check-out a breeze.
The neighborhood was fantastic — quiet, safe, and filled with charming shops, great restaurants, and plenty to explore. It truly felt like a home away from home, and I loved being able to enjoy both the peaceful surroundings and the easy access to everything I needed.

I stayed at Gabriel airbnb for two months and it was great! The 606 trail is 3 blocks away, the bus stop is two blocks away, and the grocery store is one block away (neighborhood gem). The AC is phenomenal and parking was never a problem. Gabriel was very responsive accommodating.

This was a great little unit that had everything we needed for our stay. The washer and dryer were a big plus, especially for a longer trip. The location is super convenient, just a short walk to the blue line, which made it really easy to get around the city. The neighborhood felt safe, even when we were out late at night, and there’s a convenience store nearby for any last-minute essentials. For the price, this place was an excellent value. The host was friendly, responsive, and made everything easy. Would definitely stay here again!

Good place, didn’t know it was split in two different rooms but other than that, the host was communicative and helpful. The space was also a nice place to stay in for our large group.
Only nitpick is that the early check in & check out process was not lenient at all, but at least it was communicated

Stayed for 6 nights during Lollapalooza. The home was spacious and in a convenient neighborhood close to lots of stores and restaurants. The host, Emily, even had a helpful list of nearby dining recommendations. We were a bit disappointed in the level of cleanliness due to pet hair and odor, which we did not address with Emily until after we check out. She was understanding and helpful. Communication was quick and friendly. Overall, we appreciated the hospitality.
Amazing location. Would definitely stay here again.

This was probably the best Airbnb stay I’ve had. The bed was super comfortable, although I will note when I went I remember the pictures showing 1 queen and 2 twins, when we got there there were 2 queens. Despite people living the floor above you could barely hear them. The location was peaceful and easily walkable to the Blue Line. Sarah was super communicative and quick to respond when I had a question. I would happily book here again.

A beautiful space that’s close to the beach, parks, restaurants and public transportation. The host was very friendly and responsive. The space was well decorated and looked better than the photos. The mini fridge and microwave really made the space practical.
Roxy Jimenez was definitely the best host I’ve had from my experience with Airbnb. I will be returning.
Caprice was a great host. What you see in the pictures is what you get! It’s a great distance from the city. I loved it!

Great private home in the gorgeous and friendly Logan Square Neighborhood.  The description was spot-on for this home.  It looked better in person than the beautiful pictures. The home was very spacious and the downstairs den offered flex space for our teenagers.  We decided to splurge on a Lollapalooza experience for our teenagers and turned the 4-day festival into a memorable family vacation.  We did use the free parking for our one rental car (on the street in front of the home), however, if you have younger children and extra bags, etc, you might want to use the optional garage rental which is in the home's backyard.  Our family with older teens and only carry-on luggage could have gone without a rental car.  Walking to the 'L' (Chicago's elevated subway) was so easy (about 10 minutes on sidewalks) and then we were a quick train ride to Wrigley, Grant Park and all that downtown Chicago has to offer.  Our family from S.C. is already excited to return!  Great neighborhood too!
We had an amazing time at Alan‘s place for five nights overall would come back again really close to the subway  and restaurant. Alan is a very responsive host and answers all your questions.
Good location, easily accessible and the space was nice! Very welcoming host
I came for Lollapalooza and had everything I needed here to rest in between. The bed was super comfy, and the hosts were very responsive!

Phyllis was an amazing host, and we had a pleasure staying here. The place is clean, well kept with a stunning kitchen that's perfect for having meals with your family and friends. Being close to public transportation helped get to Downtown Chicago with a 30-35 minute train ride. Phyllis is very responsive and makes sure her guests have a great stay and have everything they need.

I stayed 5 nights here and I am super satisfied with the quality of stay for the price paid! Ms Delia and her mother were super kind and welcoming and checked in on me multiple times during my stay. Ms Delia also went out of her way to help me so that I could clean my shoes that got extremely muddied from Lollapalooza. The bathroom was shared but was always available and clean when I needed to use it. Additionally, the bed in the Red Room is a pull out couch but it did the job. Great price and really close to the J14 bus that will get you to downtown in ~35 minutes with walk time included!
Very comfortable. Garage parking was a huge bonus. Loved the neighborhood! I would stay here again.

Awesome location!
I was able to do a morning walk all the way to millennium park, it took me 45 to 50 min, but I was stopping to look at the architecture of the city.
Neighborhood really quiet.
The smell of some recreational items was a constant, but nothing that would really bother me or my friends.
Definitely worth it if you like a space close to downtown.
Tom was outstanding, he was happy to help and a wonderful host, I highly recommend his home.
The place was nice and worked for what we needed.

Dora was a proactive and friendly host. She was flexible with us and ready to assist in explaining how everything worked as soon as we arrived. The space itself is clean and comfortable! We loved staying here. Ride share drivers let us know we were in a safe pocket of an area and we had no problems getting around. Hope to stay here again! Thanks!

Amazing location and just the right amount of space for our family of 3! We spent five weeks exploring Chicago and were so happy to have such a great home base. It’s close to the Brown line, super walkable, and has easy access to a great running trail. The kitchen had a super nice oven / stove, so it was easy to cook. Spacious bathrooms and lots of closet space. The owner’s pets were very cute and friendly.
great stay

Place was great about a 10 min walk to the bus which you can take to the train to get almost anywhere in the city. My only con was the amount of fruit flies that were in the house. They were trying to be proactive with a catcher but it wasn’t doing a good job at getting the flies. Other than that Guillermo and the other guests were nice and we barely saw them, felt like we had the place to ourselves at times. Easy check in and easy check out and the host was super responsive. Overall I would say it was worth the stay.
Great stay will do it again

Location was great. Walkable to all the things we wanted to do. Had a few hiccups in the beginning but Patricia was quick to respond and fix the issues we had. It says it sleeps 7 comfortably but each room had a twin size cot in them and not suitable for an adult along with the pull out couch was more for kids not adults. Pillows that were provided were flat and not very comfortable- recommend bringing your own.
Wonderful space if you're visiting, close to numerous bus stops and has lots of places to eat nearby.
Elom was a great host and we felt safe and at home in this place! Loved the separate downstairs that felt private and the large bathroom was clean and perfect for two people!
Amazing stay had everything needed, was near shops and food places. A lot of space and host communicated well and responded within minutes. I would definitely stay again!
Such an easy stay!! So close to get around the city. We had a great time!

This place was cozy and comfortable!
As for the host, she is friendly, communicative, and responds very quickly. I came across an issue during my trip and I was quickly given a solution!
I would stay here again!

The place was very clean. There was like a private outside area and I honestly felt very safe. We were very close to the train station which was perfect. You’re literally like a minute away walk. There is some stuff to do around the area however we mainly just went to the main downtown of Chicago every day. But I’m sure if we explore the area where they would be stuff for us to do. Only thing that I didn’t like is that this Airbnb is right next to some type of bar so in the evening, you can hear the music and they were also a lot of people standing outside on the street. But overall, I still felt very safe. The host was very responsive whenever you messaged and the place was very clean. So it’s a 10 out of 10 for me.
Place was beautiful! Was very warm no ceiling fans in room but otherwise great air bnb for a chicago trip!

Had a great stay at Michael’s Airbnb, much bigger then pictures and has everything you need. He even helped us out with our amazon delivery’s! Only complaint is location and what is around the house but overall great experience great host.
Great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and in a good location. Would book again.

The space was very welcoming and felt like home away from home. The host went above and beyond to provide everything for guests. They also provide socks for areas that no shoes are allowed, very thoughtful.
This was a wonderful stay. Michael checked in and made sure we felt welcomed. Quiet neighborhood and wonderful space. I would recommend for all.
We enjoyed our stay here! The space was well furnished, clean, and the hosts were excellent!
Great place! Cool neighbors. Couch was a bit rough if you plan on sleeping on it, but it was more than ok otherwise. I would stay again.
Holly was amazing and let us check in early. Place was great, even better than the pictures.
Zenobia was helpful, professional and responsive. Her property was super clean. Plus the bedroom was really cozy, which was ideal after a long day of events.
Very friendly. Nice conversations with Tammy and her husband. The two dogs were cute. Near the Red Line and the lake.
Great place near lake Michigan, beautiful house. Lots of space inside and everything was clean, also lots of kitchen utensils. Overall I recommend!
hosts were very accommodating to our needs, and always quick to respond to any questions we had.
Great place to stay, lots of space, very clean and comfortable!
Excellent location, accommodates a decent amount of people, would highly recommend.
Easy host to work with.

My friends and I are very grateful to have been able to spend our first time in Chicago at Maureen’s place. It was the perfect place and met all our needs. The neighborhood is very peaceful but easily connected to downtown via public transportation. Maureen and her co-hosts were incredibly welcoming and made us feel right at home! Highly recommend staying at this beautiful condo if you have the chance!
Thank you for the stay! We enjoyed our time in the city.
Nice place in a great location. Close to the downtown area and easy to navigate on the subway system. Condo was very clean and Jake had clear communication.
John was an amazing host and so welcoming! The Airbnb is in a great/safe location with lots to do in the area.
It was very nice. The host would check in to make sure we were doing good. Neighborhood was good didn’t have any problems at all

My friends and I loved staying here! It is such a beautiful home and T made it so much more comfortable. She offered breakfast and made it a point to let us know she would be there for us if we needed anything. I loved the area that it was in, as it was a short walk to the train station which took me directly downtown. The people around the bnb were extremely nice and welcoming as well. I would definitely book again!

We had a great stay at Christina’s place! The apartment was super cute, spotlessly clean, and stocked with all the essentials we needed. The location was really convenient—just a few blocks from the Red Line, which made getting around easy. Christina was a fantastic host: super friendly, responsive, and made us feel very welcome. Highly recommend staying here!
Nice clean home, great location and amenities. Highly recommended 👍

Jeff is an amazing host. It was easy to check in and out and he was always responsive. The place was nice and cozy and we felt safe in the area the entire time. It was our first time in Chicago so he helped us figure out which lines we needed to take
into the city. We would 100% stay with him again!

Very clean place with pleasant freebies. Hosts were very responsive but we were met with some challenges. We were provided the wrong codes for the locks and had difficulty getting in our first night. Also, location is not too close to UChicago as we had thought and is in a pretty sketch area after hours. One of the perks we thought we would gain was to use public transportation during our stay but definitely not too safe in the evening and this is someone that lives in Baltimore. Price could be better for a single room in a shared condo with shared bathroom. Ok stay.

Obinna was very responsive and easy to communicate with, which was greatly appreciated. However, the home could benefit from some updates and a thorough cleaning. There were limited appliances and utensils for cooking(we ended up buying our own and being reimbursed), and overall cleanliness could be improved. The shower curtain appeared quite worn/dirty, though Obinna did have a replacement delivered during our stay, which was thoughtful.
The number of keys required to enter the property was a bit inconvenient, and the lighting throughout the home was quite dim, making it challenging for three women to get ready in one bathroom, especially for doing makeup and hair. The mirror in the bathroom was great though. Additionally, the batteries in the TV remote were dead, which was a minor inconvenience.
That said, the location is convenient and not far from downtown, making it a good spot for exploring the area.
This is a lovely and relaxing place to stay right outside the city

This was a amazing stay! We were very close to public transportation that got us to the green line train which allowed us access to downtown. This stay is also very close to a corner store right across the street to grab snacks or refill on amenity's! The area is very walkable which gives you access to other restaurants. Derick also allowed us an early check in which was SO useful! We originally were gonna stay with three people total but changed it to five later and the home was still very comfortable. I will be coming back to stay for sure and highly recommend it to others!
Obi was very nice and accommodating towards us. The place very clean and well kept. Would come back again.
great place to stay, had lots of fun in Chicago!
Roseanna was a great host, very accommodating and friendly. Would definitely stay here again

I had a great stay! I booked Michael’s place for Lollapalooza and it was worth every penny. It was an easy 30 mins to Grant Park, and was the perfect spot to relax after a long day. Super clean! Would book again!

Exceeded expectations!  One of the best Airbnb's I've stayed at in a long time. John's home is well-appointed, quiet, and very clean. His place is only a short walk to Lake Michigan and a multitude of restaurants. John's place is located on the second floor and the views from the living room were stunning. Will absolutely stay here again.
The stay was great! It was as described, close to the blue line for transportation! The host was very responsive and had great communication!

Thank you, Matthew, for a great stay.  We really enjoyed the house - there was enough room for our entire group.  We really appreciated your responsiveness and flexibility!  Great location for our activities, easy to park, and the house had everything that we needed.

Allende was a wonderful host and the home was super cozy! Has everything you need and Allende was super friendly and accommodating. Public transportation is easily accessible if traveling into downtown. Would recommend!!

The apartment is beautiful and in a good location. The host is very communicated and flexible in the time we arrive. Keep in mind we got to Chicago around 12am. If I come back to Chicago for sure would stay here again.
Thanks!

This house is in an amazing location with so much to walk to and public transit. We were in town for Lollapalooza and we felt very safe going to and from the house each day/night. It also has plenty of space and everything you need to feel right at home.
The hosts are perfect, they were so nice to us and welcoming when we arrived. They keep a wonderful energy and we are so happy we stayed here. 100/10!!!
Little dirty and the surrounding area was extremely sketchy. It’s worth the value to just sleep and go to downtown. Just take an uber
wonderful

El apartamento estaba bien, pero le faltaba una limpieza en profundidad. Se nota que está reformado, pero le falta rematar algunas cosas. El vecindario no me ha gustado, ruidoso y no me pareció del todo seguro

This listing was perfect for my friends and I during our stay for Lollapalooza. Going to downtown was super easy because there were bus stops 3 blocks away that take you right to the train station! The house was cozy, clean, and in a safe location. Cyrus responded quickly to all messages as well. The only “issue” we had was that the oven was broken, but they had a toaster oven to accommodate. Overall, we would definitely stay here again, we loved it!
Great price and the host was so helpful
We had a great stay at Rochelle’s place. It was perfect for what we needed and I would definitely stay here again.
Incredible place! Fun location. Super responsive host. The breakfast in the morning was so yummy and home cooked. 10/10

We enjoyed our stay immensely - the property was beautiful, lots to eat nearby and close to train & bus stops for easy access to other areas. Definitely worth the price and would stay here again the next time I'm in Chicago!
The place was super nice and spacious! Plenty of room to both sleep and hangout in!

Loved our stay here during Lollapalooza. Space was very comfortable for my group of 4 and certainly could’ve fit more. Host was very responsive as well. Very conveniently located near the L which made it quite easy to get around the city.
The only complaint was the location however, if we were in a better location we would have paid much more
OK
10/10 would stay again when in the area
Clean and tidy room with a very friendly host. Also a short walk to a main bus route which was helpful.

Such a nice place, natural lighting, convenient washer and dryer - and they have little containers of pods for both the washer and the dishwasher. They provide so many little things, like extra trash bags, surface cleaner and oven mitts. Coffee, tea provided or there are nice cafes near by!
great stay, i recommend!

Cinny is a 10/10 host and truly made our Lollapalooza weekend unforgettable! She checked in to make sure we got in okay the first night and even accommodated our earlier-than-expected arrival without hesitation. Walking into the home, we were greeted with a fantastic local restaurant guide, perfect for grabbing great eats before or after the festival.
The neighborhood was peaceful and welcoming, which was amazing after long, loud days at the fest. Street parking was plentiful, and we never had to park more than a block away. If we get the chance to come back for Lolla again, this is absolutely where we’re staying. Thank you, Cinny, for such a perfect home base!
Very comfortable place to relax for the weekend. Jonathan was very helpful throughout our stay
Great stay! Place was very clean and well located. Bed was a bit on the soft side but comfortable enough.
was a nice apartment.  dryer didnt work well unfortunately

Stayed there during the lollapalooza weekends. The train is really convenient to get to the downtown Chicago. The neighborhood is quiet and safe. Had a really good time. Thanks to Carl for everything and the amazing breakfast
The airbnb was spacious and had all the amenities we needed. We especially loved meeting the cats in the backyard! Joe & Brent were quick to respond to all of our questions/concerns.

Excellent space and location for our group of friends to explore Wrigleyville and take in some Cubs games.
Chris was a very proactive and helpful host.
Lots of beds and sleeping spaces and very close to a great selection of restaurants. I’d highly recommend to families or friend groups who are looking for a base to enjoy this area of Chicago.
Overall, our stay at the coach house was excellent.
Great host! The place is clean and a lot was nearby! Very responsive and accommodative host as well!
Great!

Denisha’s place was exactly what my large group needed to come into town and work a 4 day event.  We traveled in from all over the US and had no trouble finding the place; we especially liked the quick walk to the public transportation system to get us to where we needed to be daily.  We would definitely look up this place again in the future!
Good place
Felt like home. Mr. Carl is a great host!

Dawns place was fantastic. It is walking distance to the brown line which was incredibly convenient. It was clean and fully stocked. The neighborhood was quiet. I haven’t been in an Airbnb that was so thoughtful in what they provided in a very long time. Best Airbnb I’ve stayed in Chicago, hands down. Will stay again.

Brad’s place was beyond perfect. Super cozy , easy to get to — close to airport - and close to train / Subway - fun experience getting to city that way // the place felt very safe / very nice calm neighborhood/ overall perfect place to stay away from home ! The home and neighborhood exceeded expectations and was a perfect place and exactly what we were looking for.  The neighborhood really had a tight knit communal feel.
It’s awesome to stay at Nathan’s place for my short trip to Chicago :)

Will definitely stay again next time we’re in town for a Cubs game.  Just 2 blocks from the stadium and a quick trip on the redline to downtown.  It’s on the most charming street too.  Parking was a breeze.
Andrea was a great host and our group has a great time! The house was great for all of us and we would definitely stay again!

Very kind host, but not a good Airbnb.
Positives: had an iron available, kitchen necessities, first aid resources in the bathroom, as well as good hot water, and provided us with towels.
Negatives: Bedrooms rented out as Airbnb‘s with separate keys, a shared bathroom between SEVERAL strangers, at night somehow freezing cold in August with minimal blankets, janky doors, and an (albeit friendly) squatter in the living room. Neighborhood didn’t give off the greatest vibes either. I also had multiple Chicagoans online tell me that it wasn’t a safe area after the fact
Great hosts. Place was lovely.  very happy overall
Overall a great stay. Enough space for all of us who came, as well as a kind greeting from one of the cats! very talkative little one.
I really enjoyed the stay, especially after I figured out the trains and buses!! Codes worked perfectly and the lovely lady who was cleaning was SO nice!!! Thanks again :)

great stay, besides the washer/dryer. we had a lot of trouble getting the door to unlock after running a cycle, and getting the clothes dry. we had to resort to unplugging the machine for 10 minutes for the system to reset, and then it would unlock most of the time.

I recently had the pleasure of staying at your Airbnb in Chicago to celebrate my birthday. I wanted to express my sincere gratitude for such a wonderful experience.
Throughout my stay, I felt very safe and comfortable in the accommodation. I truly appreciated the historic charm of the property, which added a special touch to my visit. It is clear that you genuinely care about your guests and their enjoyment, and that made my trip even more memorable.
Thank you again for your hospitality.

Peter was a fantastic host and very communicative and helpful leading up to ,and through, our stay.
The location is amazing - easy access to trains and busses, and right in the middle of Wrigleyville, so we had tons to do and without needing to go too far. The location is also incredibly peaceful and relaxing, which is rare to find so close to the other amenities I noted.
Very nice unit, and we immediately felt right at home for our stay.
Would highly recommend staying with Peter at this place to anyone!
Absolutely loved our stay! Had no issues with ubers and lyfts! It was a great stay. Everyone felt safe and comfortable

Tonija was quick to  respond and informative from my first inquiry about her place up until we checked out. Her place was clean and comfortable. We had everything we needed to make it a lovely family road trip to Chicago. There are local restaurants and coffee shops a short drive plus the train is just a few block walk, which was convenient.
Apartment was clean and spacious with easy check-in/out.

The house was an amazing place to stay. I have two cubs but will get to those. The place was spacious and accommodated my party of 12 without any issues (as far as size). There were plenty of towels, the place was clean. They had Wi-Fi instructions placed throughout the house. There was a bathroom on each floor. Everything inside the house was perfect, and I’d definitely stay here again.
CONS:
1) The lock on the front door needs to get switched out with a different type. We had trouble getting into the house when we first arrived and throughout our entire stay. It got to the point where we couldn’t use the front door at all. The host did accommodate us by providing a $50 credit for the inconvenience (much appreciated); however, this was still an inconvenience and should be replaced.
2) The check-in and checkout times are at 4:00 pm and 10:00 am. We felt like we were robbed an hour on both sides. It costs more for more time. Even hotels have a 3:00 pm check-in and 12:00 pm checkout.
Very good place, no complaints. Would stay again!
Ann was super friendly , responsive and helpful during our stay! It was a great stay with our friends and would highly recommend to the next guest looking to stay here!

Great place to stay at a bit small if your a tall person like myself but still great for the two nights I was there. looks just like there pictures and has everything you'll need for along as you need to stay.
Looked as pictured and described, very nice and clean space! The area was nice as well. Would recommend to others!
great location.  close to Wrigley field, lake Michigan, restaurants
Great place near a lot of great restaurants and bars.
the place is clean and she messages back constantly to check in on you.
Perfect location.  We enjoyed our time Cihan’s place.  The bed was a little hard for my husband’s back but Cihan offered another place.  Very good communication!
It was good

Very pleased with our stay! Perfect for our weekend at Lollapalooza. Transportation to the city via train was very easy to navigate and not very far of a walk as well as some nearby restaurants. Caryl was very accommodating and made everything smooth and painless for us. Highly recommend!

Great stay! Good location with really good restaurants within walking distance. Anny sent very clear instructions on how to get to the location and how to get in when it was time for check in. She was very responsive when we had questions and made sure to check in to make sure our time in Chicago was comfortable.

This place was amazing! Stayed for a whole month for a business trip. It was a 30-40 minute commute to northwest Indiana. The area was amazing, we walked many times down the main streets to restaurants   and local shops. The host made sure everything was there when we arrived and even brought more towels later on for our comfort. She greeted us upon arrival to helped us find the place and was super friendly. We cooked full meals and the three of us staying were able to enjoy movies together up and down stairs. WiFi was fast and the beds were very comfortable. Loved this place so much. Would definitely stay again and the memories made there will be something I keep forever!
Our stay was great, close and walkable to great spots and a lovely neighborhood!
Stayed here for a summer internship and was a great place! Felt safe and lots of things in walking distance!
Our stay was pleasant and peaceful. Owners respond quick

Had a great stay at Monica’s place in Logan Square! We found it very easy to walk to restaurants and to public transportation (~15 minute walk to the major street). The unit itself was clean and had very fun decor.
Great place for a long stay!
Great place to spend a summer weekend in Chicago!  Rooms and amenities very accurately described -- James was very helpful and accommodating.

This was a fantastic home, and Ryan could not have been easier to work with. The house is extremely spacious, close to transit, and extremely clean. He was very flexible in the accommodations, and I would highly recommend this home. We had a group of 9 and it was more than enough space.

We had an okay stay overall but would not choose to stay here again. There is an overwhelming amount of information about the building presented at check-in verbally that should be communicated via message or a print out upon arrival. Our group did not even realize there was a second (safer) entrance on the third floor until our second day. The second bedroom is more or less a closet with no air vent. Both beds made noise and weren’t very comfortable. The blinds do a terrible job blocking the sun in the morning.
Very clean and comfortable.  Great neighborhood and an amazingly beautiful park close by.  Really good lighting in the bathroom.
Great place to stay was close to everywhere we went! Quick access to interstate and very close to downtown! Will definitely be staying again when coming back to the area!

We spent two months at Nora’s and had such a wonderful experience. It’s a beautiful, spacious home in a very peaceful part of Chicago. The house is lovely and has all the amenities you’d need for a shorter or long stay. Nora was one of the best hosts I’ve encountered throughout my years on Airbnb - extremely warm, helpful, and responsive in her communication. We sincerely hope to get to stay here again!

We had a fantastic stay at Gerrit's place in Andersonville last weekend. Location is perfectly walkable to the red line as well as the main strip with all the shops, restaurants, etc. Gerrit was communicative with us from start to finish, and the apartment was clean and exactly as described. I would absolutely recommend this unit and would stay here again in the future.

We had a great stay for our party of 11. The location was an easy walk to the redline L stop, as well as some great little bars. Plus, Loyola beach was two blocks away, which made for a nice morning walk.

This place was a great stay for our first “adult” trip. He kept us feeling safe and comfortable the whole time, and let us have a fun time!! The location of the building itself is great. Quiet, safe, nothing happened to my car while parking on the street, but shy away from relying on walking in the surrounding area near the main roads. Other than that it was a fantastic stay and I 100% recommend!

We arrived at night and had a bit of trouble getting in. Robin saw that we were struggling and called out to us on the camera. The Carter Blue was very spacious for my group of 7. There were enough bathrooms, beds, bedrooms and seating area for all of us. I would like to mention that the stairs are a bit of a workout for anyone who may have trouble going up and down. We did have to reach out to Robin about cleaning supplies, but she responded immediately and got them delivered.
Enjoyed our stay in Chicago. Host was very friendly and helpful providing great recommendations and complimentary donuts. 5 stars

This place was a great find. It was well priced for the area. The neighborhood was wonderful. It was very walkable with awesome restaurants, coffee shops, places of interest and conveniences right at hand. The owners communicated with me immediately whenever I had questions. There were clear instructions for everything I needed to know. The private garden was so nice in the midst of the city. A 10 out of 10!
It was a great place in a great location.
Great location.
Great location and space!

This Old Town condo was a perfect place to rest and recover during our annual Lolla weekend in the city.  Clean, spacious unit.  Great building with chill outdoor areas.  Plenty of food and drink options within walking distance.  An easy walk to the North/Clybourn Red Line station.  Host was very responsive and generous (the fresh donuts were very much appreciated!). Would absolutely stay here again.
Great location; close to downtown. Jailyn was very responsive, proactive, and ensured I had a great stay.  I recommend this place.

Alice's townhome was great and accomodated our family of 6 easily. The kids loved the bunks and their was plenty of space for the adults to have their time while the kids were sleeping/napping. Location was great, near a number of places that are walkable and safe.
As issues did come up, Alice was very responsive and attentive to anything we needed to make our stay better.
Great home, great host.
Great place with easy access to Medical District and downtown. Close to grocery store and very easy to hop on the pink line downtown. Great accommodations!

The home is as described- spacious and nicely decorated. Unfortunately, my group ran into a major issue and had to leave after staying one night, as we no longer felt comfortable. The host was responsive regarding the issue and we came to an agreement; I wish we could’ve stayed the entirety of the trip.

We stayed at Vladimir’s place for ten weeks while we were searching to buy a house. Vladimir was very responsive and helpful from the very beginning. He right away brought us a bigger dining table to accommodate our family gatherings when we asked for it. We found a few issues that he fixed promptly. He brought us everything else we asked for and made our stay very enjoyable. I would recommend this host and place to anyone looking for a home away from home. He even extended our stay twice to accommodate our needs.

Edwin was awesome, this place was as described. Very comfortable, very walkable to all kinds of amazing local shops and entertainment. Easy walk to the Blue line making it super easy to enjoy everything Chicago had to offer. Host was super responsive and caring, snacks and treats in the kitchen and refrigerator were great I have absolutely zero complaints about anything. Edwin even allowed me to store my belongings at the property safely on my last day so that I was able to enjoy the city.
NOTE: There is not wifi internet provided by the host (totally fine), but if you are a Comcast Xfinity customer with a valid internet login you are able to get access to very fast, free internet!

Everything was great during my stay. The unit is clean and has everything you will need. It’s not very large but gets the job done. Host was great and even came out to help me get the stove working (user error)
Check in and check out process was super easy. Host was accommodating with early check in and providing us with a place to stay for a weekend wedding!

Pros: Location is awesome! Very walkable area with restaurants, coffee shops, and bars close by. We were able to walk to Wrigley Field. The neighborhood was safe and quiet. Our group had 6 people, and this unit was the perfect amount of space for everyone. All the beds were comfortable.
Cons: This unit is definitely run-down. The shower curtain was moldy, one of the toilets didn't work, there were no amenities in the bathroom (no shampoo, no body wash, no hair dryer). There wasn't a lot of seating in the living room, there's only one couch. Also, we never received the check-in code, so I had to reach out to the host and wait for a response to get the code sent to me.
If you're staying in Chicago for the weekend, and you just need a place to sleep at night - then this place was adequate. Our group is pretty easy going, so we made it work. If you're planning on staying longer, and cooking meals and spending more time in the unit - then you might want to find somewhere else.
The place was great, we enjoyed the neighborhood and it was close to everywhere we went. The place looks just like the pictures. We were there as a family of three and had lots of fun.

Daniel was an excellent host and quickly answered several questions we had. The only reason this isn't 5 stars across the board is due to somewhat confusing presentation of what each unit has access to. We stayed in the Garden Level unit that appeared to have pictures of the backyard space included in the listing. We were a little disappointed to find out we couldn't use that outdoor space as it's for other tenants in the apartment so I would just recommend clarifying what spaces are included in what you are booking. With all that being said, Daniel was a very responsive and kind host!
I had a wonderful and peaceful stay here! The host was super friendly and sweet and the place was extremely nice! 10/10 would book with her again!

Pros: great location, bed was comfortable, towels must have been replaced because they were a good size and fluffy, very clear instructions on how to get to the correct door and how to get in, wi-fi worked fine for my limited needs.
Cons: the noise from above!!Unfortunately the people above came in at 3:15am one night. They may have been normal sized people but sounded huge due to the lack of any sound barrier. You could hear all conversations thru the vent system even tho they were clearly talking normally.
Kitchenette was missing knives and water glasses. There were wine glasses I could have used but I opted for using my own bottle. Oddly, thought I said there would be 2 of us, there were only 6 coffee pods - not enuf for 2 people for 2 mornings
None of the kitchen stuff was really that important. It was the noise level that reduces my score. It was bad.
Great home in a super fun neighborhood. Easy walking access to a load of wonderful places.

Not much I can say about Nicholas place other then phenomenal! The location is perfect if your looking for a great time out as it's surrounding areas are filled with bars,places to eat, people walking and some clubs! (Jazz club down the street open till 330am) it was an amazing time and we couldn't have been happier to be there!
the best days of my life were spent in this airbnb :) book book book!
Comfortable and relaxing after long days of walking and touring Chicago
I really enjoyed my stay here! Felt like home. Bed is very cozy and the shower is amazing! I’ll most def come back if I’m ever in Chicago again.
Loved this very cool place with all of the cats! Me and my friend love cats and were very happy with our stay there during Lollapalooza! Hope to go again!
she was incredibly generous with snacks and a welcome note. such a lovely lady messaged us over the stay.

Stayed here the weekend of my Son's wedding held at Sarabande.  It was only a mile away.  So convenient.  The home is beautiful and spacious.  Absolutely love the layout.  Each of the three floors had its own bedroom and bathroom which is nearly impossible to find in Chicago. Nice deck also.  Might be staying again for the next family wedding.

Where should I start? It’s been a while since we felt really like home in an AirBnB. It’s becoming more and more souless. Ginneh made us feel right at home since the first day with a surprise personal and casual phone call to help us check in early. She greeted us herself on the first day, and from there a never-ending flow of books and toys for our two kiddos, a personal note to our daughter, and more than adequate stocks of virtually everything we would hope for. The fridge was stocked and she never kept inventory. Our girl got to pick some of her books home with her. Basically this stay has set a revival to what bed n’ breakfast should have been. Some things weren’t perfect, but they weren’t meant to be when your host is your neighbor, not a manager. And she let us check out late so the little one could take a good nap before heading out to the airport. Five stars aren’t enough for Ginneh and her peaceful yet close-to-all home.

Great stay, it was so quiet! It was slightly awkward sharing a bathroom with other guests, but it worked out ok. There was also construction on the side walk entering the house just as a heads up. Parking on the street for the weekend was free and easy but I’d worry about getting a spot during the week.
Great location, very quiet place easy to get some rest
David was very responsive and made sure the stay was great. Place was very clean and spacious! Very comfy for our small vacation in Chicago! Neighborhood is also very peaceful.

The Airbnb was pretty bare bones. You get one towel and one small thin blanket for the entirety of your stay despite the place being freezing. In the description hosts offered transit directions from the airport and when I asked for them, they never responded. It’s not clarified in the description that the bathroom is shared, and it was really gross. There is nowhere to set towels or toiletries. There was literal blood on the door and hair in the shower. Prices were very inflated because of Lollapalooza which is understandable, but definitely not worth it. I left 2 nights early and crashed with friends. The street was pretty and felt safe, and the place was not hard to find. That’s about all that was good about it.

The home was comfortable and accommodating. Although parking could be a challenge, we were able find something. There was easy access to restaurants, shopping, and activities. When coming back to Chicago, I'll stay again.

Totally met my expectations. The photos and descriptions 100% matched reality. The location itself was super convenient. Very walkable to bars, restaurant, coffee shops, and just two blocks from the train. Overall, would recommend.

Our stay was amazing! Would definitely recommend if you don’t mind some sound at night (due to being on top of the Empty Bottle). What really made our stay was the music playing below us from the Empty Bottle. It was like a free concert! The neighbors were also super helpful in navigating us where to go and things to do in the area. Would definitely book again!

Excellent property in the heart of Lincoln Park, very walkable to sights and restaurants
Daniel was proactive and responsive. Would rent again

Roberto’s home was beautiful & clean. The beds were made beautiful with good pillows and he provided the softest towels I’ve ever used. He gives kitchen supplies & necessary essentials that a lot of people (like me) forget! It was so perfect & he provided entire lists of recommended places in Chicago & also how to get there to and from! He responds so fast it’s amazing, he made my first time exploring Chicago a beautiful experience! 🩷
I loved my stay in KASA, it really worth
Good host and good place. Will book again next time

This Villa was amazing! I was worried with the preconceived notions of Chicago and that area, but I felt safe the whole time. We stayed in room 103 and the only complaint was how squeaky the bed was… or the few spiders in the bathroom. Street parking was not bad at all, just watch out for the handicap parking.
The shared spaces were perfect, and they were filled with amenities like cups and plates. Super easy to wash and put back, and every room used them.
I would stay here every time I came to Chicago, no doubt about it.
Beautiful area. Assel was communicative and helpful.

overall the house is not bad and it is usually quite outside, but be prepared that your room is not cleaned upon your arrival and the host does not respond appropriately. There is no decent light in the room and also no soap, towel, toilet paper included - just FYI. Sometimes you might find spiders and ants crawling around your room.
The only reason to stay there is if you are somehow involved with Jackson park Hospital which is 2 min walk from the place and the probability to find a better option for the same price to live nearby trends to zero.

I truly felt right at home staying here for the week. The place felt clean which is a super important detail for me. Also located in a nice, quiet and peaceful neighborhood. Patricia’s communication was top tier and she was so very generous enough to work with me for a flexible check-in/out because of my flights. Thank you!
Genesys was one of the best hosts I’ve ever had!  She was unbelievable at being attentive and responded always. I loved how welcoming both her and her home was as well. I would definitely return!

The host was polite and responsive concerning check in and inquiries. The neighborhood is quiet with convenient street parking. The space is adequate for someone who just needs a place to stay, but the bedroom and bathroom are very very modest.
The villa was in a great neighborhood within close proximity to the Wrigley and the train!

We love staying near Bucktown. We also enjoy walking so we got coffee I believe at Hex down the street and we were able to Uber or walk quickly everywhere else we needed to go. The best part of the house is definitely the private roof top. The view is spectacular. You can see the city clearly and it's totally private. That is very unique for a place in the city. We've stayed a lot of places in Chicago. The house is beautiful and it's nicely laid out however we did find the couch to be small for 4 people to sit comfortably and watch a movie. Also know you have to walk up 2 flights of stairs so that can be hard for certain people. You are right on a Main Street so it's city living and there is street noise and neighborhood noise but that doesn't bother us because we love Chicago. we found parking easily for my truck out front and it was safe all weekend. Overall it was a great place to stay with 4 adults.
Great location with lots of restaurants in walking distance.  Off street parking was also nice to have. Back deck was a nice place to start and end the day.
Ran would answer right away if we needed help:)
Definitely would love to stay again!!
Highly recommend!
Great place to stay and very accommodating host

Hello!
As a Frenchman, I had an incredible vacation in Chicago. The location was perfect, just a stone's throw from the Pink Line to get to the city. Geneva was super welcoming and always responsive. The accommodation was top-notch: clean, spacious, beautiful, and it felt like home. My roommates were so discreet that I felt like I was alone! Plus, the neighborhood is nice with a park for sports, and the arrival and departure times are really convenient.
A big thank you to Geneva and the warm welcome from the Americans. It was my first solo trip to the United States and I loved it!
Tom De Witte

Jonathan was an excellent host! He respected my privacy, which was crucial for me as a solo female traveler, and he responded promptly to my requests and needs. The location is perfect—situated in a quiet neighborhood and very close to the bus stations. I am grateful to him for keeping the price affordable, given the great condition of his accommodations. His cat, George, is adorable and intimate, making my stay even more enjoyable. Thank you!

I had a wonderful stay overall. I found the communications super responsive and the location was great.
One thing to note esp for ppl carrying a lot of bags - there was no elevator. I didn’t realize I’ll be staying on the fourth floor with no elevator and I had four big luggages with me. It sure was a workout getting things up and down.
Great guy
Clean and comfortable, easy to access, plenty of street parking, Charlie is very friendly and helpful, great place to stay.
David and Carolyn are amazing hosts — kind, helpful, and always approachable. I loved and enjoyed being at their house and look forward to going back.
Carl was great! I would recommend his place when in Chicago. Affordable, clean, and close to downtown. Thanks Carl!

Everything was exactly as described. The space was perfect for the two of us, comfortable, clean, and thoughtfully set up. The kitchen was impressively well-equipped with everything you might need for your stay.
The bedroom and bathroom were both spotless and very comfortable.
We also loved walking around, Level River North is in a fantastic location that made it easy to get anywhere we wanted. Would definitely recommend!
Overall good area with endless restaurants and sights to see. Building was nice but the unit itself was dated and not well kept. Cleanliness could be improved.

Such a cute place! The neighborhood is super nice and safe. We’ve never  stayed this far north but glad we did! Reva was very responsive to answering all questions I had prior to my stay re: getting around on the public transport and concerns I had with coming in late etc. The place is just as pictured, beds are comfortable and nice, and a lot of thought was put into the space.
Great location

She was so lovely to host my friend and I for lollapalooza! The room was perfect and we had a connected bathroom that was private for us. She gave us lovely recommendations and was always responsive. Would love to visit her again :)
Amazing location amazing building with amenities. Very clean and modern apartment. Highly recommend

Our family was on a baseball stadium tour, and this stay was a highlight! If you're heading to Wrigley, you can't beat the location—just a quick 5-minute walk to the park, in a vibrant, walkable neighborhood that’s also a great jumping-off point for exploring the rest of Chicago.
We had 8 people—5 adults and 3 teens—and the house had plenty of space for everyone to spread out and feel comfortable. It was clean, spacious, and quiet. I don’t usually sleep well when traveling, but I slept great here!
Michael was a fantastic host—friendly, responsive, and accommodating.
We’d absolutely stay here again next time we’re in Chicago!

I had a great experience at this Airbnb. The space was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. The host was responsive and easy to communicate with, and check-in/check-out was smooth. The location was convenient and quiet, making it perfect for both relaxing and getting around. I’d definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area.

Within walking distance of Wrigleyville and the Addison Redline. Granted it was on a Friday night after a Cubs game but there is quite a bit of street noise to be heard especially in front bedroom till about 2-3am. The early bag drop off and checking is really nice and secure. Would’ve been nice to be able to use a restroom that’s accessible upon early bag drop off. Neighborhood is nice and clean. Inside is well kept as well. Our group had a great time at the game and enjoyed the overnight stay! Thanks.

Nice two-bedroom apartment in walkable neighborhood, close to restaurants, including delicious Pequod's pizza (literally across the street).  Walking distance to DePaul University and several L train stations.  There is also a parking space, so you can drive places too.  Full kitchen, washer/dryer, two bathrooms (one small, the other tiny).  Good privacy and plenty of common space.

Our group had a great time in Chicago and it started with a great place to stay. The location is close to public transportation so getting downtown was super easy. There was a grocery store and restaurants right down the road. The property itself is in fantastic shape and is very well maintained. The whole place exceeded expectations and was better than the photos! Carla was a little excellent host and makes the experience simple. She is a great communicator and made sure we had a great experience. would definitely stay here again!

Wicker Park is absolutely lovely. Location is convenient to downtown. Plenty of restaurants, markets, and shopping nearby. We, a party of seven had plenty of space to spread out. Our host, Christopher was very accommodating and made excellent recommendations for things to do close by. The neighborhood felt safe and residents were friendly.

This was a wonderful experience. The place was just as described- well lit, spacious, clean, comfortable. Hazel was super responsive to all the queries.
I would recommend this place to others.

Jennifer's place was excellent! We loved everything about it. The location was spectacular as well, right in the heart of Streeterville next to Mag Mile. Jennifer is an excellent Airbnb host, she was so helpful and responsive. Absolutely recommended!

This is a beautiful apartment that is so convenient for a longer stay in Chicago! Super close to lots of restaurants and in a beautiful quiet neighborhood. The space itself is super clean and beautifully decorated.
Keith's house was very comfortable, easy to find, provided the ability to cook breakfast and dinner.  Bedrooms and bathrooms clean.

I was able to put up some out of town bike instructors at Kendra's place. She was incredibly communicative and helpful! They had a great time and got to know the Pullman and greater South Side during their visit. Thank you so much, Kendra!
We absolutely loved staying here. Our family felt right at home. Our kids loved the set up, my husband and I loved the location, the quiet, and having coffee on the back deck. We will be back!

Place was nice and in a good area, all neighbors were kind. The check in and check out instructions weren't clearly communicated without asking further instructions and some dishes were left out and in the dishwasher. But overall it was a nice stay for the price and would stay again.

Was just as pictured. Mathew was always quick to respond and super easy to work with.  Only had issues one night finding street parking. Only suggestion would be to have some sort of dressers in bedrooms so we could have unpacked fully.  Other than that it checked all the boxes!
Akiko was great! Extremely kind, had lots of insight on what to do in the area, and the room was wonderful!
Had a lovely time!

I absolutely love staying with Asif and his family at their lovely home. The room and bathroom are well designed and everything has been arranged in a way that is si thoughtful. I enjoyed conversations with Asif and his wife and they are so hospitable and friendly. They have a nice selection of tea too! The neighborhood is great, very quiet and sit in a tree lined street. It is pretty close to public transportation, tons of cool restaurants and cafe in Logan square. Hope to come back again!
Overall, a very solid apartment in a great area. Host very communicative. Feels like its time to update some of the furnishings and more fully stock the kitchen accessories but overall a solid place

Jordan’s place was fantastic for our needs - it was so clean and we felt safe in the property at all times. He is communicative and the whole place was very well equipped for cooking/laundry etc!
Worth noting that for first time visitors to Chicago - the city is huge! The property is about 8 miles from the centre of the city so we tended to take Ubers in and out and split the cost (easier due to the fact there was 4 of us) but the public transport can be quite slow and in many cases it will take upwards of an hour to get into the city. This does not take away from how great Jordan’s place is however - and there is still a lot to do in the immediate area!
Thank you Jordan for a brilliant stay. Would 100% recommend.

I love Yu and their team of managers! Ed and Cesar are extremely helpful.
This place is perfect for me, a new student in Chicago. The hosts are extremely responsive, always willing to step out of their way to help. The rooms are comfortable, clean and just like the photos. Perhaps the best part is the walking distance to the orange line, literally 45 seconds or so depending on how fast your gait is! I love it here, and I intend to stay with them many times over!

The space was extremely clean and well kept. Had all the amenities you would need for a comfortable stay. The few items they stocked in the fridge was a nice touch.
Also it’s nice to have things like shampoo, body wash, hand soaps, q-tips, cotton balls etc provided for you. It was nice to not have to pack those items.
The common spaces in the building were very nice. We did play a few games of billiards up on the 20th floor.
The building is right next to the highway, so there is some road noise to be aware of. I live in a city so this didn’t bother me at all, it’s like white noise to me. But if you’re used to absolute quiet at night this could potentially be an issue for others. They do provide ear plugs and sleep masks you can use if need be.
I would definitely stay here again. It was easy to get downtown and there’s tons to do nearby in the West Loop. Also Target is just across the street for anything you may need.

Very reasonably priced. Location is a bit far away from downtown but chicago’s public transport makes up for it.
I LOVED the toilet.
Great host! The location is a bit off the beaten path for Chicago, but we were interested in that and had cars and city driving experience to deal with it. Was overall a good value.

I would absolutely stay here again.

Amazing stay in Chicago! The apartment was clean, cozy, and perfectly located. The host was super responsive and made sure we had everything I needed.

Jesse and Sam are great hosts. Their place is perfectly set up and they were incredibly responsive whenever we needed anything.
The location in Pilsen couldn't be better. This neighborhood is so walkable with amazing bars and restaurants.

Jesse and Sam have created the perfect setup for families, and their communication throughout our stay was top-notch. We can't recommend their place highly enough.
Alondra and Sandra provided clear check-in instructions. They were friendly and accommodated our needs. Will definitely consider staying at their beautiful home if I come back to Chicago!

Beautiful, quiet and safe area.  Stylish accommodations that were close to everything.  The hosts were extremely attentive and responsive to our needs.  We had a lovely stay and would recommend it highly.

Absolutely wonderful stay! The neighborhood is a dream. It’s quiet and private with restaurants and shops around every corner. The bathroom was impeccable! The apartment was as described and a perfect location for a 2 night Chicago area (especially for an event in Rosemont) stay with a teenager. Everything in apartment is new and modern. Despite being on a fairly busy road, it was very quiet and we slept well. Would recommend and stay again.

Gorgeous space close to lots of amenities, especially the Brown line, made going around the city very easy. Very close to wrigleyville also, only a 30 minute walk. Adelina was a great host and gave us everything we needed.

We stayed here for over 2 months on a J1 visa and had a great experience. The host was incredibly kind and responsive—anything we needed was sorted right away. The location was ideal, with a bus stop right outside that takes you directly into the city centre. Overall, a solid, private, and comfortable place to stay long-term!

Ben’s place is very well conceived with 4 bedrooms big enough to have comfortable king sized beds, 3 full bathrooms, and a nice living area.  The kitchen is well stocked. The building is quiet and has lots of great common spaces including outdoor spaces.  It was a wonderful place to stay.

We stayed at this location with a group attending a conference at McCormick Place.  It was very convenient.  We especially liked that the place is well suited for business travel with identical bedrooms and plenty of full bathrooms.
This place was perfect for my stay in Chicago for a rotation at UChicago Medicine! Patt was great and responded very quickly over airbnb chat and helped keep the place clean!
