La pasamos muy bien, todo muy limpio y el departamento muy bonito, si regresaría nuevamente
clean, quiet, and affordable and just right outside of city!! would definitely stay here again!!

This place was everything we were looking for and needed. The area was very walkable. We did not have a car, and yet everything we came to Chicago for was easily accessible. The redline, which took us downtown, and other public transportation was a short 5 minute walk. The lake was a 10 minute walk. The Andersonville Neighborhood along Clark Street was filled with restaurants, cafes, and interesting shops. The nearest grocery store was about a 10 minute walk as well.  We felt very safe walking through the neighborhood any time of the day.  Gerrit, our host, was very accommodating and responsive. He shared his love for this neighborhood and Chicago in general. He gave us many recommendations for food and transportation. The house itself was lovely. It was spacious, clean, beautifully decorated and very private. Overall, this was a great place to stay if you want to explore Chicago.
Solid place,  flexible check in, free parking. overall a good experience.

Beautiful apartment, great location.
Check-in process with the $1,000 deposit was difficult, didn't accept our personal CC for some reason, luckily we had a company card that worked.

We had a fantastic time dealing with Michael and staying in this lovely spot. No complaints whatsoever and we would gladly return for our next trip to Chicago! Great location and a perfect host! The accommodation was exactly as described and lived up to the expectations perfectly.
We appreciate his kindness.

I have stayed in many Airbnb spaces. This by far was the most beautiful artfully crafted place I have had the pleasure to inhabit. Even if it didn’t have this wonderful latino neighborhood with restaurants, bakeries and cafes within walking distance, this place is an absolute gem. But, it does have this neighborhood and in a time where we need to lean into community and protect our immigrant neighbors and spend money on their local businesses, I can recommend it more highly. If you love Frida and Mexican decor, this is the place for you. I wish I could live there, but enjoyed the time we had and the passion that went into making this apartment absolutely gorgeous. Thank you, Janet, for sharing it with us. ❤️

I first want to start by saying that Ms.Belinda house was so beautiful and well decorated! There were complimentary snacks and water. Anything you would need was indeed provided. I was overly accommodated during my entire stay. The house is on a nice quite block with ample parking spaces. I had no issues whatsoever. I was given a complimentary late check out and when I needed more time Ms.Belinda was more than understanding and communicative. The house was very clean and smelled sooooo goood! I will definitely be staying here on my next visit back home to see family. Did I mention Ms.Belinda was overly accommodating? Oh yeah I had to mention that again. Please don’t be afraid to book trust you won’t regret it!
Easy self check-in, cozy, and well-equipped. Great location and parking. Highly recommend!

You can’t beat the location of this Airbnb! Andersonville is an incredible neighborhood with lots of local small businesses and restaurants, a 20 minute walk through beautiful tree lined streets to get to the beach, and convenient to many different public transit lines. If you’re looking to spend a lot of time out exploring the city/ neighborhood, this is a great pick

Amazing place in a great corner of town.
Perfect access to transit and local spots. Would totally stay again!

We enjoyed the neighborhood and the place was clean and just like photos. Thankful there was plenty of street parking because that garage is very small. Aside from that, we enjoyed our stay and would rent again!
5 stars all around! Very friendly & communicative host with a lovely home
Amazing stay!

very easy to find and the perfect location for everything I wanted to do. I would definitely stay there again. I love we had parking right at the house. We didn't have to worry about coming back so late and there wasn't a parking spot available for us.

Angelica was very helpful and responsive! Rooms are super fun with their decorations and the neighbour hood is nice and quant. The other guests staying at the same time as me were also nice. Would recommend!

We had a lovely stay at Tejal’s place. It’s located in a nice neighborhood, walkable to Fulton Market and the downtown area (also very close to the blue line which made airport transportation easy). Everything about the place was great as described and we really appreciate it Tejal’s communication and flexibility with our check ins and check outs. Would definitely stay here again.

We stayed for 3 nights and had a great time. It was a very nice spot during the day. The Irish Nobleman Pub is close by and walking distance. Candace was very friendly, helpful and responsive. Place was clean and organized but some spider webs behind nightstands and beds. Parking is on the street but was able to find spots close by. Would stay here again. Thank you!!
Had a great stay thanks Ben and company
Oluwatosin was a great host. The place was very clean, matched the description, and felt very homey. Very responsive and helpful to any questions we had. I would stay here again!

The location is great for slower pace environment outside of the Loop with lots to do still but very close to public transit so you can get to other parts of the city with ease. David was proactive, friendly,  and accommodating. I would definitely recommend the Rodriguez House!

Awesome stay! Hosted a guys trip here and we were all psyched about it’s location to Wrigley field. Really pretty interior, much nicer than we all expedited or possibly deserved. We had fun tossing the football around in the big front yard. Easy to walk home to after restaurant or bars. Also very close to the Addison L station.
Overall pretty great!
Great place to host a large group and the location is perfect with many close restaurants and fun places to visit. Would recommend to any larger group looking into a place in Chicago.

Great place, but BEWARE THE FEES AIRBNB ADDS
The place was amazing but between fees and taxes, the price rose by 67%. This is not a joke. Taxes add a whopping 24% per night and then there is the cleaning and Airbnb service fees. What was quoted at $450/night became $750/night. This is not the hosts fault, it is completely on Airbnb. Aside from the price, this is possibly the best one I've ever stayed at. Beautifully appointed, nicely furnished, and top end everything from the appliances to the showers.

Awesome location, very easy access to transit and the highway. One thing to note, we booked this and even though the address after booking showed unit #3, we got check-in instructions for the 2nd floor unit. The bar on the first floor wasn't excessively loud by any means but we could definitely hear some noise coming through the floor and requested to move up to the 3rd floor since we were travelling with a baby. Nat accommodated right away and was always very responsive, but just keep in mind that there might be a bit of noise if you book this bnb. Overall a great spot for a reunion.

Charlie is very quick at responding and helpful. It’s in a nice area with great restaurants and I enjoyed my time there. There were other guests but we mostly kept to ourselves so there wasn’t any issues at all
Outstanding condo location just outside downtown Chicago within walking distance to public transportation.
Great place to stay!  Comfortable beds, clean spaces, easy access and very responsive and helpful hosts!

Nice place with lots to do in the area. Clear check in and check out instructions were provided. Host was super friendly, communicated well, and was very accommodating with any concerns I had. Highly recommend!

Nat was extremely accommodating and proactive.  The unit we stayed in was updated and exceeded our expectations.  For us, parking was not an issue at all.  We could hear the music from the bar downstairs but the noise did not disturb us. The patrons of the bar were younger and a very chill atmosphere.  Great location and safe neighborhood.

Jade's stay was a great host to my five friends and me during our Chicago trip.
+ The stay was a 15-20 minute walk from the subway entrance into downtown (Blue Line)
+ Jade was very responsive, flexible, and ensured a smooth check-in
+ Walgreens and other grocery stores nearby
- Around 5am each morning, there were loud footsteps from upstairs
- The bedding was not the most comfortable. One friend ended up sleeping on the couch

This was a cute, tidy, very clean & comfy apartment. It had all the basics that we needed (except coffee 😭) for a short weekend trip. We picked the location based on the venue of an event we were attending (a 15 min drive away), which was convenient, but the neighborhood was not very walkable. Some of the taxi/uber drivers who dropped us off seemed concerned about the safety of the neighborhood but we didn’t experience anything that made us feel unsafe during our short stay. There were some unoccupied/boarded houses down the block though. That said it was just a short drive from plenty to do/eat/see/places to walk, etc. Seemed like a good value for Chicago in general. We were happy there but next time I’ll probably splurge and check out a different area.
We did a long term rental (2.5 months) and Joe/team were great to work with. Very clean property, responsive hosts, and the perfect location for getting all around the city!
This is a fantastic place. Great location, very clean, and easy to get in an out. Would definitely stay here again.

This was our best AirBNB experience yet.   Ivan thought of everything. There were lots of nice touches and he anticipated many guest needs.  Ivan was very responsive and available.   We can’t say enough good things about our visit here.  It even handled our family of 7 well.

I enjoyed my stay! The neighborhood was nice and quiet. I had no problems with my car parked out front or my family members car parked down the street. Christina was great and very responsive. I had an issue about the upstairs neighbors being too loud. She responded quickly to my concerns. If I come back to Chicago I will try to book again!
perfectly private but close to everything we wanted to do. great space

I organized a bachelor party for a group of seven, and between the location, price, and Natasha's overall responsiveness, this was easily the best Airbnb experience I've had. Natasha let our group in earlier than agreed, had thoughtful arrangements set up inside, and everything was exactly as described - including two air mattresses and a very comfortable couch. Even at checkout, when we realized we had forgotten the garage door clicker, Natasha was incredibly understanding and accommodating.
On top of all this, every place you'd possibly want to visit was just a 10–15 minute drive away, and walking around the neighborhood felt safe.

Very cute small space perfect for a short weekend trip! The bathroom was well stocked with shampoo conditioner and body wash which I really appreciated as I forgot my toiletry bag! Hosts were very responsive in communication and provided more towels when I asked.  really great value for the money and I enjoyed my stay!
Everything was fine the place was clean and beautiful thanks for everything
Had a fantastic stay! The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-located.

We had a wonderful stay, Carole was very communicative and provided a ton of information on what to do in the city
Location was great walkable to a grocery store, movie theater, and all the cities attractions .
The place had everything we needed. It was perfect for our family gathering and we would definitely go back yet.

It was great space for a large group. Plenty of space and the two apartments worked out great. Parking was easy, getting into the home was smooth, and I was impressed with the location. I never thought we were too far from anything

Emily was absolutely wonderful, with a wonderful welcome PDF highlighting check-in details, local spots, and more.
The space was immaculate, close to local spots and, after that, a beautiful patio to come home to. Very grateful to have stayed in this home !
We loved the place. Jefferson was easy to communicate with. It was easy to find and get into the apartment.  I would suggest it to my friends for sure.
The experience was enjoyable.
The place was clean, and there was actually a lock on the door for each, though the listing said there wasn’t.

Ann’s home was perfect for our group of 11—spacious, comfortable, and ideally located. The outdoor area was a great place to relax between city outings, and having a subway stop nearby made getting around incredibly easy. We also loved the above-ground trail just a minute away, which was ideal for quick runs. Checkout was refreshingly simple, with no long list of chores. Thanks again for hosting us!
Very convenient to everything.

The place was as described and looked like the photos. It was great and spacious. It’s a short walk to the train and bus stops. It was very easy to get around. There’s not a lot to do or eat in the neighborhood but access to public transportation made that easy to resolve. Everything was comfortable, clean, and we had everything we need. All questions were answered quickly and we had a great time. Thank you!

This was a great spot to stay with my partner while in town for a wedding. Outdoor space covered from the rain, Roku TV, comfy bed, long mirrors, quiet location- there were many positives. Host was easy to communicate with and helped me check in, check out, and parking easy. The space is somewhat small (that was not a surprise based on the listing) and it was perfect for us a couple that travels light and didn’t spend most of our time at the Airbnb other than sleeping and getting ready.

Dede is such a great host, very welcoming and kind. She helped me and my friends feel welcomed to the city and gave some great suggestions of places to go and see. If you’re looking for a cozy place to stay with all the luxury and amenities you could think of- Dede is the gal to book with!

We really loved staying at Mark's place!
The house is big with lots of room to socialize, but enough rooms/privacy to then retreat for personal space.
The house itself is quirky with so much character and charm.
Loved the roof top patio. Kitchen is well stocked with anything you need and plenty of extra towels and blankets.
Chicago was very hot and humid during our stay and the house stayed cool. The neighborhood is very cute and very walkable, lots of coffee/restaurant/shopping options nearby.
I would definitely stay here again and recommend others to book this bnb!

Such a bright, airy, creative space! Despite the fact that she was traveling internationally at the time, Maria was in touch and responsive to my questions. I had a lovely week and highly recommend this sweet studio! 😊

My sister and I had a wonderful time staying at Patricia’s place. The place itself was decorated beautifully and was incredibly clean. It’s located in a fantastic food places. Patricia was super responsive to any questions or concerns that I had + she gave clear instructions for using the house’s amenities and checking out.
Charming little townhouse in a neighborhood that made us feel like locals! We loved the restaurant down at the corner and felt like we were part of the community. Highly recommend!
Great location, close to the park and transit.  Actually as described.
esmirna is a great host!! i arrived earlier than expected and she was welcoming! the work she does with the cats and helping around the neighborhood is also a plus! definitely would visit again! :)

Aaron's place was an excellent choice for our group of four. The host was incredibly helpful, accommodating, and responsive. We experienced a significant check-in issue that was out of his control, but Aaron quickly provided actionable solutions and kept us informed until it was resolved. This was a testament to his dedication as a host.
The condo was beautiful, spacious, and well-maintained. We loved the 3.5 bathrooms, which made mornings easier, and enjoyed relaxing on the nice back porch. The amenities were top-notch, with a well-stocked kitchen and a great coffee and tea station. The bedrooms were comfortable with good-quality linens.
The neighborhood was charming, walkable, and had a lovely green feel. It's important to note that while older reviews may mention a dedicated parking spot, the place is currently street parking only.
Overall, this was one of the best Airbnb experiences we've had. We'd highly recommend this condo and would definitely stay here again. Thanks, Aaron!
Gina was a wonderful host. We truly enjoyed our stay in her beautiful home!

Was the perfect spot for my summer residency at SAIC. A great place to return to after long days in the city. Always found a convenient place to park. The walls are thick so it was nice & quiet at night for a restful night’s sleep. Kristen was super friendly & made me feel right at home for my 6 week stay. Her place was nicely updated, clean & cared for. Can’t wait to stay here again next summer.
Continue to be who you are. It helped me out a great deal

Our stay at William’s was wonderful, even though we were really only there to sleep. The home is charming and tidy, nestled in one of the most culturally diverse neighborhoods in the city. The room was comfortable, cozy, and quiet.
William was very understanding when our arrival time was delayed til late at night, and he made sure we had everything we needed. I am so glad that we made sure to say hi before leaving, as we had a lovely conversation with William. He is very warm and welcoming!
The only thing I would have changed about our stay is utilizing public transit, as we returned late both nights, and finding parking was a challenge after 10 pm (we were made aware of this possibility).
We will absolutely stay with William again on future visits!

Victoria was a welcoming and attentive host. She was flexible with our later check in at a late notice, which was extremely considerate. Her house was very lovely!! The neighborhood feels safe and there was always parking fairly close. Also, we appreciated the code locks on the doors for privacy, but the house felt completely safe inside with the family. The only things to consider are the extremely squeaky floors in the room. We sadly didn't meet the dogs, however they did bark every morning at around 7-8 am, which was not too much of an issue but did wake us! However we loved seeing the photos of them. If we come back to this area, we would consider staying again. Thank you Victoria for all of your help and kindness.

We had a perfect stay at the coach house. Perfect, walkable location; safe; nice shower; one and a-half baths, little kitchen area with full-size fridge, speedy WiFi, nice A/C. Lots of nice, special touches. Ample supplies. We really liked the skylight which kept everything bright. Bed was super comfy. Parking was a breeze. John was exemplary in all interactions.
Highly recommend! Thank you, John!
Host was super nice and responsive. The place was comfortable and the neighborhood/ location is cool. Would certainly stay again.

This was by far the absolute cleanest BnB I’ve ever stayed in. Bedroom linen was fresh and bathroom had everything that was needed. Lots of privacy and in a walkable area. Uber was about $15 to get downtown during the afternoon. It was quite and outside common patio area was picturesque. I would consider this option again. The host were nice and was responsive and responded with in minutes. Entering the unit was easy and the instructions provided were accurate. I enjoyed my stay. I will stay here again.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Incredible Stay in Wicker Park!
We had an absolutely wonderful time staying in Wicker Park! The neighborhood is vibrant, walkable, and packed with amazing restaurants, cafes, shops, and parks—there was always something to do just steps from the door. Whether we were grabbing coffee in the morning or exploring local boutiques and nightlife in the evening, we felt like we were right in the heart of it all.
The house itself was perfect for our stay—clean, stylish, and super comfortable. Everything was exactly as described (or better!), and it truly felt like a home away from home. From the cozy bedrooms to the well-stocked kitchen and peaceful backyard, every detail made our trip more enjoyable.
If you’re looking for a place in Chicago with personality, convenience, and charm, this is it. We’ll definitely be back!

The description of the AIRBNB made it feel as if it was in a great part of town. While we didnt have any negative interactions with others we definitely didnt expect to be staying in that part of town. We could hear everything happening above us and outside and it was very inconvenient considering people were loud at pretty much every hour of the day. There was some rain and one of the bedrooms and the hallway ended up flooding a little. We needed an extra parking permit and she hadnt responded after asking if we needed one. Once we told her about the flooding she got back to me later that evening. When she did get back to us she said that it was probably flooding because of the rain so I assumed it had happened before. I’d expect at least an apology if this was a known issue that was never communicated with us in advance. After all these issues we experienced Id say its definitely nice and tidy inside but it’s probably not worth it considering everything else.
Room as they said it would be.
Great place with everything you needed for a worry-free stay! Loved how close it was to the CTA train to get anywhere you wanted to in Chicago!
Great stay. Clean place. Had trouble with wifi but that was then resolved.

Nice and clean. A bit sparse. Cooking definitely left a food smell in the bed area and the TV was mounted in a way that you could only watch from bed.
Luckily there was a lot to do in the area so I was always walking out somewhere in the evening. Printers Row is a great little area and always had something to do that for whatever mood I was in.
The location is great if you’re driving in on 55. It luckily avoids a few intersections that tended to get backed up.
It was perfect for my stay in the city while commuting to the suburbs for work.

Fabulous stay! The apartment was in a great location near and walkable to everywhere we wanted to be.great facilities and a beautiful pool. It was quiet and we felt very safe. All our questions were answered quickly and helpfully by Anthony. We would highly recommend and stay again.

We had an absolutely wonderful stay at Ron’s 4-bedroom Airbnb in Bucktown! From the moment we arrived, Ron made us feel right at home. He’s an exceptional host — responsive, warm, and genuinely attentive to every detail. Any small issues we encountered were handled promptly and with great care, which really made all the difference during our stay.
The home itself is spacious, clean, and comfortable — perfect for a group or family. We loved having plenty of room to relax and unwind after exploring the city.
Bucktown is such a vibrant, charming neighborhood. It strikes the perfect balance between being peaceful and residential, while still offering tons of things to do. We especially loved our evenings at The Royal Grocer & Co. — great food, cozy atmosphere, and a fantastic drink selection.

Freddy is very nice and helpful. But unfortunately I got car jacked right outside of his place. I paid around $4500 for the month, so definitely expensive too. Place was nice, clean and host was very responsive
Excellent stay! Great amenities. Helpful and accommodating host! Ideal location. Very walkable to Michigan Ave and Navy Pier. Fully stocked kitchen. Would absolutely stay here again!
Stayed here for the summer and Patt was fantastic. If you are okay staying with roommates around Hyde Park , this is a great pick!
Convient location and super close to brown line.
Ming and Yolanda are great hosts - they were quite responsive and helped with any requests I had!
Wonderful host.  Comfortable and clean apartment tastefully decorated.  Very enjoyable experience!
Beautiful home, easy to check in and Stephanie was very helpful! I loved this place.

From the moment we entered the building, we felt right at home. The person at the door was expecting, immediately showed us how to get to our room, and explained all other amenities. She was friendly and helpful throughout the stay. The room itself was clean and comfortable.  Our host reached out soon after we arrived to ensure we had everything we need for an enjoyable stay. The building itself was beautiful, the room had a wonderful city view, and it was extremely close to the L, coffee shops, and good lunch spots.

This Airbnb is perfect! We stayed here for a couple of months. Justin was responsive, friendly, and helpful. The place was stocked with household items and felt actually lived in, way more so than any other Airbnb we’ve ever stayed at. He also responded almost instantaneously whenever we had an issue or concern, which was perfect. Plus, the area is peaceful yet full of things to do and only a 10 minute walk from the blue line. Anyone would be lucky to stay here!

Everything is so easily walkable, with a neighborhood chock-full of great eats and the Blue Line close by. The place is clean and tidy, with a lush backyard and nice deck. Would absolutely stay here again
Very convenient location for people working/studying at UChicago, right next to a Jewel Osco and place matched description well.
Great host, great apt in a nice location. Would stay again

Ubicación 25 minutos en carro al centro de Chicago, es muy grande para alojarse con muchas personas, la limpieza del lugar deja mucho que desear, la casa tenía muchas pelusas por todos el piso, las sillas del comedor muy sucias manchadas, el piso de la cocina no estaba trapeado, la cocina en general estaba algo sucia; siempre encontramos estacionamiento afuera de la casa para dos camionetas grandes; hay supermercados y farmacias muy cerca, la comunicación con la propietaria es buena.
Thank you for an awesome stay Justin!

I am from Dublin, it's my second time to stay in Zam 'place, I can say that Zam house becomes my second home , even my 4 boys and my 18 years daughter have always liked here when we are in Chicago, because it's very calm, peaceful, clean, the neighbours are all too great, it's seems like they are my family.
on our arrival, it's lacked the news pillows covers and when we messaged Zam he was away, (independent day) but he sent someone quickly with the fresh pillows covers , we will appreciate it. I will say that Zam is a great and humble person, always there to answer our needs and our questions.
I highly recommend .

Loved this cozy place to stay, it was like being at home. Full of books and interesting artwork. Great, well appointed kitchen for anyone who likes to cook and a very comfortable mattress. I'll definitely be back again.
Clean and nice cool place to stay in Chicago.

We loved our stay at Michael’s place! We felt right at home and had everything we needed. Most importantly, the location could not be beat— we could walk to many places, including the lakefront and Red Line CTA. It also included a large storage room to store bikes for our whole family. The place was exactly what we were looking for!
Michael was an incredible host. He checked in multiple times and was very responsive when a need arose. On many occasions he went the extra mile to make sure our work-from-home set-up was sufficient, and that we had the amenities we needed to live comfortably for our 2 month stay. He was welcoming and gracious to our family, and we couldn’t have asked for a better host! We also made friends with the neighbors, who were incredibly welcoming and thoughtful.
Ivy was the ideal host. She was extremely responsive and conducive to my every request. I could not recommend her higher!

We enjoyed our stay there.  The host was very accommodating, even letting us drop our bags much earlier than our 4pm check in time.  We slept great and with the lock system we felt very safe. We also loved the proximity to the Green Line!

John was an incredible host! The space is exactly as described, he is extremely helpful and responsive, and the area is spectacular—great for running along the tree-lined streets, close to the Zoo, and very easy to get downtown by car or train.
Very spacious and had everything we needed. Would stay again if we come back to the area!
Jermailさんは私の初めてのシカゴ旅行に的確なアドバイスをくださり居心地の良い場所を提供してくれました。彼はとても親切で重い荷物を運んでくれたり最寄りの駅まで送迎してくれました。またダウンタウンや主要な観光スポットにもバスや電車で容易にアクセスができとても便利な場所でした。シカゴでの滞在におすすめの場所ですしまた機会があればぜひ行きたいです。

Gerard's place had everything I needed for my stay. The house is beautifully decorated with an amazing backyard (!) and the room is spacious and so is the bathroom. The day I arrived Chicago the city had an unusual heatwave but I slept very well thanks to the AC and fan. I had access to all the shared space. I was able to prepare simple dishes. Gerard was so kind and offered me home-baked cookies which were delicious. Both Gerard and Ernie are great people to converse with. Also, the location is unbeatable. It is very quiet and peaceful and yet super close to many great cafes and restaurants and gym/fitness studios. I had a car and street parking is very easy as well. I really recommend Gerard's place.

This was the perfect spot for a Chicago getaway. Located within walking distance to the heart of Andersonville, we enjoyed easy access to a great variety of shops and restaurants. The unit is situated on a quiet, tree-lined street—ideal for peaceful walks. The host was extremely responsive, and the space was well-equipped with all the amenities we needed for a comfortable stay with our 10-month-old. We’ll definitely book here again the next time we’re in Chicago.
Great stay; the host is extremely responsive and helpful.

I sold my home but didn't have a new home yet, so I needed a place to live--and I didn't want a 12-month lease on an apartment. My stay here was just what I wanted. The unit was comfortable, and it was the right amount of space for me. Bonuses for me were the office workspace and the open pantry off the kitchen; both spaces were really helpful. And Jonathan's attention to the overall building showed pride of ownership.
The location was also convenient. It was within walking distance to a Jewel grocery store, Washington Park, the Midway Plaisance, U of Chicago and Hyde Park, and major train and bus lines.
Jonathan was a great host. He was accessible and responsive. He was even flexible in working with me when I needed to stay a little longer than I originally planned. I enjoyed my stay.

Hanna was a wonderful host, friendly and thoughtful, making sure guests feel comfortable and a home away from home. It is at convenient location in Hyde Park with close walking distance or direct bus/train connections to anywhere in greater Chicago area.
We had a wonderful stay at this garden apartment. Just as advertised, great neighborhood, wonderful host. Highly recommend!
Great place to stay. Nice city view and walking distance from everything downtown.
Kole was a great host!

The space is spacious and cozy. I have OCD and have a hard time staying away from home. However, I am always at complete ease when I stay here. I am even willing to sit on the furniture, which is kept in immaculate condition.

This place was a complete disaster! It didn’t match the pictures on the Airbnb site at all. Worst experience with Airbnb ever! The host should be ashamed of himself. The reviews were completely false also. A complete disaster! I’m so disappointed that Airbnb has places like this on its site
Great Place to stay of loved the space and the cleanliness.I would definitely stay for long terms of time as it made me feel at home.
Easy to get to apartment for family of 6. We were able to walk to many places. Apartment was clean and host was very accommodating and helpful.
Great location and nice building.  The apartments were very nice and open with more space than I anticipated.  Fenton was very responsive.  Would stay there again!!
I had a lovely stay at Ewa's. It was very peaceful, clean, cozy, and had good energy. I also really enjoyed the sushi at Lawrence Fish market and chicken tagine from Zebda's nearby, both walkable.
We had a nice stay here and we're sorry we couldn't stay longer. Our host was extremely accomodating and responsive. We highly recommend the apartment.

Great stay! I would 100 percent stay here again. Eric and Robert were great hosts and answered almost immediately if I had a question. Close to the Metra, which is easy to take into downtown. Driving is only 25 minutes into the city. Sanders, the BBQ restaurant up the road is great!  Thanks again, Eric and Robert!

Thank you so much Anna for allowing us to stay at your Airbnb during such a difficult time for us.  We really appreciated your quick response to everything!  It was a wonderful stay at your Airbnb despite our circumstances for being in Chicago.  Thank you once again!  Mark
Lovely apartment and location!

I booked three units on the same floor to bring 26 people for a business trip. We absolutely loved the space! It was big enough to accommodate everyone sleeping, getting ready, and hanging out. We will definitely be booking with them again!!

The apartment is a meld of home and hotel. The beds are comfortable and the sheets are a high quality. Great attention to shower supplies and soaps.
I was hosting dinners for family in the area and the kitchen had everything needed to be a home away home. Gas range, assorted cookware, a full refrigerator with ice maker and a Keurig coffee maker with pods!
Parking was never a difficulty which is a luxury when visiting a large city.
The bus is only 5 minute walk and connects to the blue line with ease.
We will look forward to returning in the future when we visit our Chicago family.
Todo excelente! La entrada fue muy fácil y todo estaba perfectamente limpio. La zona es muy tranquila, Sin duda muy recomendable.
Affordable, very efficient and gives you everything you need for a short trip. would recommend 👌
A relaxed place in a very nice location (so close to the beach). I enjoyed my stay!
Outstanding, welcoming, peaceful, Definitely a great place to stay at to explore the city of Chicago. Don’t hesitate!
nice place

Ami was a great host. We had a last-minute trip to visit friends and family in Wrigleyville and his description of the house fit exactly what we needed. If you’re going to Wrigley for a series, this location couldn’t be any better! It’s a safe walk for a day or night game, and the Lakeshore Trail is a short 1.5 mile walk to the east. Quaint basement apartment serves as a good home base for your Wrigleyville stay. It’s not a fancy place with fancy accommodations, but its location is the draw. We’d stay there again!
Host was very responsive and check in process was easy. Apartment was clean and located on a nice street - would stay again!

We spent a wonderful week at Christina's place. We loved the neighborhood. The carriage house was very tastefully decorated, private, quiet, and homey. The kitchen was quite well equipped. Mario's grocery (Kroger owned) was just a block away as were the bus stops, one on Chicago taking you right downtown ending at Navy Pier, the other on Damen going north to Wicker Park. My favorite grocery, however was Ann's Bakery on the corner of Chicago and Leavitt which is much more than a bakery with wonderful Ukrainian deli and cooked specialties. Christina responded right away to all my inquiries. There was ample street parking though a bit tricky if you hit the days when street cleaning takes place. Thanks Christina and Pax for helping make our stay in Chicago a memorable one.
Very good stay experience and I would recommend this place to everyone.

We booked a room in Chicago, showed up to the front desk at 11pm and they tell us they are overbooked and do not have a room for us. Roompicks did not help us find something else, they did nothing. We were left in the middle of Chicago looking for hotels and all of them were full.

Unacceptable, would’ve at least appreciated it if they let us know a day before, this way we could’ve planned.
Horrible experience overall and still waiting for explanation.

While I knew the bathroom would be shared, from the write-up I was under the impression that only 1 other room would be sharing it. Clean accommodations.  We chose this spot for its close location to our daughter who we were visiting and fit our needs.  It’s walking distance to stores, restaurants,  and bars.  It is on a main street but good location.

The Rodriguez Home was a perfect spot for my 4 day stay in Chicago. Pilsen is such a fun neighborhood to explore with amazing food, and David's home is comfortable, easy, and perfectly located.

The living space is really cool, David has all kinds of interesting collectables and decor inside. It was nice to be able to use the fridge in the kitchen as well.
The house is a very short 2 block walk from the pink line 18th St metro, which is about 15 minutes ride from the loop. There's also tons do do and try in Pilsen - the Mexican Art Museum, 5 Ribanitos restaurant, Jumping Bean Cafe, and Pochos for brunch were all great. I also loved the two community bookstores in east Pilsen.
At the end of my stay, David very kindly let me check out late since I had an evening flight. Overall, perfect experience.

Brett was a wonderful host and the place was exactly what we needed for our weekend trip.

very expensive place with low ceilings. incredibly Noisy Neighbor downstairs and hosts couldn't do anything about it. three flights of stairs to climb with luggage in the dark with one ceiling light out.

I loved this little place in Bucktown. It's super cute and you have everything you need. I'd stay here again.

Mr Khoy is a great host. He responded and answered all of my questions, even before booking. The location is in a historic area with lots of culture. The residence was clean and comfortable. I would definitely stay again.

However the rest of the apartment was cluttered with Emily's stuff, in particular the bedrooms, one of which had no working closet (it was tie-wrapped shut) and the other of which was 3/4 full of Emily's household belongings (like extra vases, children's toys and other items) which meant it was also largely unusable. In addition, Emily's household rules, which were sent on check in day, included a ban on the use of advertised amenities like her outside deck. I would suggest asking for the house rules on booking and getting clear answers on basic amenities before booking.    While the neighbourhood is lovely, the  experience unfortunately felt like a bait and switch.

The house, while rather compact, is immaculate and extremely well decorated.  It felt like staying at a 5 star hotel.  The kitchen is modern and fully equipped for all your cooking needs - including a large supply of nspresso pods.  The location cannot be beat, with a quick walk to the park, north beach and all the restaurants / retail on Wells Street.  If you want to stay in Old Town area, I highly recommend this place.

Beautiful condo - looks just like the pictures. Big and spacious. The readily available street parking right out front was perfect! Place was clean and well kept. Surprisingly quiet inside considering it is right next to the highway. The back deck off the master bedroom was great! Kitchen could use a few more supplies. We had no worries walking to the United Center during the day. Beds were comfy. Nice place - we would stay again.

Michael’s place was really great. We all had a great stay and Michael was a polite and helpful host. He responded quickly and efficiently whenever there was an issue. Would highly recommend this place !
Good location if that’s the area you want to be in. Would stay again.

I felt welcomed. Slept well in a very comfortable bed. Appreciated the privacy of an en-suite bathroom. Enjoyed walking in a real neighborhood just 2 blocks from Lake Michigan and with short walk access to 2 “L” stations Howard and Jarvis.
Great place to stay especially if you are in town for a Cubs game.
Such a lovely place and Marek and his wife were wonderful! Very happy to have stayed here and the area was amazing too!
Wonderful place with beautiful neighborhood-

The apartment itself fit our needs well for a business trip. Unfortunately, the apartment wasn’t clean when we arrived around 8pm. We messaged the host and she said she was reaching out to her cleaners but didn’t provide any updates. We went out to dinner and when we returned, the cleaners were just starting to clean so we had to wait outside while they finished up. At this point it was ~11:30pm. After a full day of driving we were frustrated by the inconvenience upon arrival. The cleaners did a great job, but the place is in dire need of a deep clean. By the amount of ice buildup in the freezer, it seems it’s been a looong time since the host has checked on the place. Overall, I didn’t think the stay was worth the price.

There is no kitchen, but there is a small dorm style fridge. . You must use a sink next to washer to clean any dirty dishes.
Bedroom window shade was broken on arrival and my fault for not mentioning it, but I figured it was a known issue. I was accused of breaking it.
We enjoyed our stay. Parking was easy and the place was clean :) Perfect size for 2 people. Seating outside was fabulous at night and neighborhood was safe.

We travel a lot for sports.  This place was close to highway which made our travel to location easy. House was perfect size for my daughter and I. Enjoyed living room space after long day of games. Comfortable seating with large TV.  Kitchen was easy to use. I’m a cooker so appreciated the ease. Safe, clean home. Laundry machines are beautiful (which is key for traveling athletes, lol). Host was very easy to communicate with.
Our group had a great stay and the place was as advertised. Proactive communication and easy to check in and leave
Nice place and great layout for a small family. Location was good and host was very responsive and accommodating.

Everything was great except the kitchen was atrocious when we arrived. I spent 1.5 hours cleaning the entire kitchen as it was filthy- dirty dish towels, dirty dishes found in cabinets, counters were filthy. Aside from the kitchen everything else was decent.
Beautiful West Loop apartment. Thoughtful amenities. Thoroughly cleaned. Great views of the city. Easy to get around by foot, car and public transit.
Great location! Nice neighborhood! Perfect little place for me to stay while visiting my son!

I stayed over the weekend to celebrate my stepfather's birthday with my mom and boyfriend.
The space was perfect for the four of us; I even think six people could enjoy it. The kitchen was comfortable for cooking, and we loved the sofas, perfect for relaxing after a day full of walking around the city.
The only issue we had was parking, as the house doesn't have a space and you have to park on the street, we ran out of parking for one of our cars on the first day. We understood it was a bit of a luck of the draw, but David was a great host and was attentive to us, helping us find nearby parking spaces so that this wouldn't disrupt our stay.
Definitely recommend not to bring your car with you to the city. It’s not a neighborhood problem, it’s a city thing. Everywhere you go, you struggle trying to find a parking lot.
Of course the city was beautiful and David’s place makes us feel at home; I would definitely return.
Great place to stay and the host thought of all the details to make enjoyable!
Beautiful home! Tonija was very helpful when we had to reach out!
Perfect place for us while seeing three concerts at the United Center.  Great location. Great place, very clean
beautiful rental, and very comfortable!
Half a block from Wrigley, perfect location for attending a Cubs game!
Casa muy agradable espaciosa y bien dotada. Excelente anfitriona!
Lovely place in a nice neighborhood! Jessica was super responsive to any questions or issues that came up!

Location is AMAZING for a game at Wrigley Field. It could not be better, you can see the stadium as soon as you walk out the front door. The space is perfect for a short getaway and for the ballgames. It may be small for a longer stay and the train runs all hours, so we would not have lasted more than a few days, but again, it was perfect for a long weekend and gamedays. The hosts are very accommodating, and communication was great. You are just a short walk to shops, food, bars, and the grocery store. The train is around the corner if you want to explore more of Chicago. The 2 bedroom space was adequate for my wife and I, plus 2 kids. They had coffee but no creamer, so if you are a coffee freak like me and arriving too late to hit the grocery store, then bring something to get you by that first morning
Great at communicating!
Met or exceeded all of our expectations. The instructions were easy to follow, The host was very responsive and helpful. The location was perfect and easy to get anywhere with no hassle.

Tara was an attentive, informative and communicative host. Her ‘hideout’ is a short L ride to Wriggle Field and a great place to spend a weekend when coming from out of state to see a game. I would recommend her place.

Very communicative host. Always responsive timely and helpful when any problem arose.  Apt is as depicted and the amenities were all great. Range, stove and BBQ all in good working order.  Bathrooms very nicely apportioned and clean.  The location is great to the Southport corridor, restaurants in and around ravenswood and even not far from Jewel and Trader Joe’s.  Would stay again. Thanks, Laura.
Very nice and welcoming stay in the Windy City!

The house is in a very private, quiet neighborhood and close to fun things to do in Chicago.  There is plenty of room as there are two living rooms and five bedrooms.  Very spacious and the garage is a nice feature. Would recommend this place for larger parties and families
Very welcoming stay. I enjoyed myself the whole weekend

In town for Chicago Robotics Invitational Premeir Event the layout was perfect housing the boys downstairs and girls upstairs, 3 bathrooms and space to set up a practice field to program the robot and practice matches.
The most well equiped kitchen, such that eating out was not necessary and a good cost savings for student travel. The television was fabulous for watching the Tour de France and who can complain about walking distance to grocery store, pizza, shopping, and the Lincoln Park Zoo which is FREE!!!
Incredible access to Lincoln Park, museums and Lake Michigan, if walking isn't your thing parking was NEVER a problem.
Great host. Very helpful. Nice and quiet neighborhood
Milan was a great host and we had a great time in Chicago while staying at his amazing location. I highly recommend him and would use his hospitality in any future trip to Chicago !

Pretty sure they’ve never actually cleaned the “cabin.” Everything was disgusting when I got there. The kitchen was gross, the bed sheets were full of dried snot it seemed, stains on the walls in the main room and bathroom. The shampoo/conditioner/body wash dispensers were caked with old product and the body was completely empty. They made it seem like they were doing me a favor when the cleaner came back and did the bare minimum while I had to wait outside. I was there 2 days and it ruined the first day. After the cleaner left I kept noticing disgusting stains EVERYWHERE to the point I didn’t want to touch anything. Garbage Airbnb. STAY AWAY.

Pros: Large Home and spacious, good design and decor, had a good amount of linen and all basic toiletries and kitchenware. Sufficient bathrooms and extra beds for 10 adults and 2 children from Alaska and Texas. The two living spaces acommodated multiple families which was very helpful.
Cons: We could not check in until 4pm and we arrived in Chicago at 10am. We called regarding visitors but could not get any clarity. We asked and they would not say a word yes or no. Location felt unsalfe as we experienced gunshots. The property lacked proper maintenance with unsealed bathroom tiles, exposed foam and really bad renovation work and could use a deep cleaning. Dead bird on back patio. Door locks were not user friendly as it took a while for us to figure it out. The photos were great until you actually see it as stated the decor and design was good.

Great location for concerts at the United Center. We walked to and from for three nights and felt completely safe coming home after dark. Food was great nearby and public transportation was easy. Home was cute and comfy. No kitchen as mentioned but mini fridge sufficed and many nearby food options. Outdoor porch was a cute and comfy area for cooler days. Would definitely stay again.

I was told to communicate through the app provided on Airbnb. The owner explained to me that he could not see what I was sending and it went through a third-party. I was not able to get in touch with my host. I was stuck outside 11 o’clock at night until about 12 in the street of Chicago waiting to get in I had to leave the property because I didn’t feel safe and go back to the airport, which was a $52 ride there and now $52 gone back and then back to the house again you do the math This needs to be fixed. I’m not satisfied and it ruined my vacation.
Great place to stay. The condo is a 10 minute walk to the United Center. Alan is a great host.
Clean place in a nice walkable area.  Would stay again.

Vipul, estuvo al pendiente aunque nos hubiera gustado nos informara un poco más ya que cuando quisimos tomar el Bus no sabíamos que necesitábamos una tarjeta para pagar.
En relación al departamento no hay donde guardar la ropa limpia, además es urgente fumigarlo.
Great place to stay for my friends and me. Convenient location near the United Center in a nice neighborhood.  Can't beat the low price.

I recommend this place , easy check in & out process. Host was flexible with early check in , and always answered my questions , everything was labeled and easy to find. This place had everything i needed. I really recommend this place if You ever visit Chicago. I will definitely do business with him in the future.
Chris was very easy to work with and his home is beautiful, clean and perfectly located!

really good place! very peaceful location that made coming home late feel very safe.
our room was very cozy and well-decorated. the room and bathroom were very clean and felt welcoming to use.
the hosts were very accommodating and gave us good recommendations and suggestions. got local tips and tricks after we explained things we wanted to do.
Super Clean and Comfortable  - Host was very accommodating  -  Much appreciated   -   Restaurant Next door ***-  Super Friendly Staff and Excellent Tacos !!!   Great Location
The place was very clean and matched the pictures. The host was very responsive. The location was convenient. It was a wonderful experience. Will definitely book again when in Chicago.

This place has everything you'll need in a really cool neighborhood!
We stayed with Ryan & Elizabeth for our weekend in Chicago & couldn't be happier. They have really thought of everything to make their guest's stay enjoyable. Sweet & friendly pets to welcome you is always a plus too! Would definitely recommend anyone staying in Chicago to book this Airbnb as it is a fantastic value & hope to stay again next time I visit. 5/5

Such a wonderful place to spend in Hyde Park. There were so many beautiful houses to look at and cute coffee shops and restaurants near by. The place was cozy and quite perfect for relaxing! I’ll be back again!

came to Chicago with a group of friends and stayed 3 nights at the muse. place was awesome. I felt like I was in a private club with the grand piano unique deckre and lavish furnishings.  as for Sheldon he was very responsive. met us for the keys when we checked in.  was polite and courteous. he asked if we needed a second set of keys said he would drop them off and slide them under the door as he personally did not want to intrude on our privacy and stay. always what I personally value in a host. he was quick on communication and very helpful on parking instructions and house access.  he even messaged me about a truck parked in the wrong spot in the secure parking that was in the wrong spot concerned it may be ours but it was not. great stay. nice host. the shower was awesome! we even took time to socialize with the neighbors who welcomed us and gave us local dining recommendations. very quiet neighborhood without much street noise sirens or traffic . thanks Sheldon for a great stay

It was a beautiful home in a great walkableb vibrant neighborhood. The park is in walking distance and the fireflies were amazing. The house is in good proximity to the airport.
Genesys was a great host, very friendly and knowledgeable about the neighborhood.
Great stay!
This was a great place to stay   There were three bedrooms, a full kitchen ans a great balcony.  This place is very convenient for events at the United Centre.  I would definitely stay here again.

Maria was an amazing host and we enjoyed our stay! The apartment was clean and nicely decorated (very cozy!), and she was quick to answer any questions we had. There is a train within 5 minute walking distance that goes directly through downtown Chicago, plus many grocery stores and restaurants in the surrounding area. Highly recommend!
My family and I enjoyed our weekend stay! The neighbors were kind, the neighborhood was peaceful, and the location was close to a grocery store, shopping center, gas station, etc... Lovely home!
This is a great place to stay. We had 12 people and it was fantastic. Comfortable beds, great kitchen, walk to lake and restaurants.  We loved it
Convenient location in a good area right by UIC campus. 10 minite drive to United Center...great location.  walkable to several local casual food spots.
Great location, spacious condo, wonderful hosts.
Was a great experience. The space and bathrooms were just what was needed. The washer and dryer were also clutch.
Very clean, spacious, and convenient place to stay for our group!
Great apartment, spacious, clean and comfortable.  Matt was a great host. The neighborhood is safe and walkable.  Parking was tricky at night, but a breeze during the day.

Everything is fairly smooth, but as other reviews mention, be prepared for additional fees, they are apparently mentioned when you are in the confirm & pay section but are easy to miss, other than that everything else was good!
Shannon and Carmen were awesome hosts. I'd recommend you stay here if you're traveling through Chicago!
Good place to stay, with lots nearby
Clean and great for our party of six.   No better spot for a Cubs weekend
Andy is very responsive and helpful ensured I had everything I needed to feel at home while staying at this air bnb.

Beautiful stay! Rebecca is a very helpful and kind host, and made my stay extremely comfortable. The only caveat( and I should have read the instructions more carefully )- there are about 30 steps to get to the apartment, so go easy on the heavier luggage. There was ample food, drinks and amenities at her house, and it felt like home!

Ivan made us feel like family during our stay. We were in town for a long weekend to catch a game at Wrigley, and Ivan went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed. The place was just as pictured and expected - lovely, clean, and comfy! We enjoyed the family atmosphere around the inside courtyard of the property - one evening we were heading to dinner and there was a projector outside with a movie showing and the families enjoying popcorn on blankets. It was SO charming.
The house was comfortable, we slept great, and Ivan was very responsive to any questions we had…which weren’t many because the directions to the home, the check in/out process, and many other FAQs were already lined out in the guide we were given. Easy peasy and so pleasant!
We had an absolute blast celebrating the last summer before our youngest heads to college, but we will definitely be back to stay at Ivan’s place when we return to Chicago. We definitely recommend, 10/10!!

A wonderful experience. This beautifully remodeled unit was a pleasure to stay in. Well done with lots of amenities and extremely clean. Spent a girl’s weekend there and really enjoyed the space and the lovely, quiet neighborhood. The hosts were very welcoming and communicated everything necessary in advance of our stay. They were also very quick to respond to questions. Highly recommend.

This was my first time getting an airBNB and I will definitely do it again based on my experience with Brandon. The home was accurately described and perfect location for any Cub/Wrigleyville fan. I would highly recommend!

Our reservation was originally for 4,my sister could not get a sitter, we brought along her 2 grandsons. The host immediately added the 2 extras & the charge which we paid immediately. Ms. Sonia was responsive to all inquiries which was nice. There was plenty of space, but the major issue was being told that only the ice maker in thru refrigerator didn't work which was okay, but to learn the refrigerator didn't keep the food we purchased cold and ruined our food is not cool. I made her aware and it was treated like it was no big deal. A few outlets did not work properly and I mentioned this as well. In all the neighborhood was okay, it did not feel unsafe, and it was located near major store chains.

Great experience!  My wife and I felt right at home, and the accomodation was super nice. Great restaurants are nearby. There is a porch and a separate entrance for guests. Cathy was very hospitable. Highly recommend!
Nice house in a quiet neighborhood. The host was attentive. good place to stay.

Wow! We had such a wonderful time on our trip to Chicago and that was in large part because our stay was wonderful. Jake’s home was nice, cozy and very close to everything. It was exactly what needed for family vacation. We will definitely be booking with him on our next trip!
Everything was great. Excellent communication. My family were very comfortable there and we'd come back again! Thank you!

Place is very spacious as mentioned by other guest reviews. We were a family of four and felt that we were able to move and function freely in the unit. There were only two drawbacks to our stay...if you're a "cooking/kitchen is important" type of indivdual/family-the kitchen could use more cooking utensils and pots/pans-there wasn't a variety that we were used to in other Airbnb's we've been in. Secondly (and this most likely the owner can't control) parking was extremely difficult due to ongoing city construction and city tree trimming that was taking place. Many of the streets require permits from residences so you have to look for the streets that don't require permits or that didn't have "Tow Away Zone" flyers posted on trees. I messaged Obinna about where to park and he responded very quickly with suggestions!

Kelly and Monica were very gracious and the home is excellent! The space is well furnished, and I like to give bonus points to hosts that feature local artists in their home and they certainly do! Too many airbnbs feel sterile in that regard. The backyard is gorgeous and a wonderful place to have breakfast after cooking in the spacious kitchen that’s loaded with top of the line appliances. There’s a theater space in the basement that we did not use but is perfect for watching a big event or a movie. All the beds were comfortable and linens clean with fresh towels already out so there’s no hunting required.
The neighborhood is beautiful and certainly one that will impress guests with the wide selection of restaurants and bars nearby. There’s also a 24 hour grocery store and a pharmacy right around the corner.
Overall we had a wonderful time and really enjoyed our stay. My only regret is we forgot to sign the guest book!

I really enjoyed the neighborhood and apartment. The location is incredibly transit friendly and was able to get downtown will the Blue line conventionly. Close by there is a grocery store and CVS. great for people who want to see some Chicago sites without the noise.
Convenient location very close to Wrigley Field! Great restaurants & bars in walking distance. Comfy beds
David’s place was exactly as shown on Airbnb, the location was excellent.
We had a great stay. The space was very nice and updated bathroom was perfect.
Nice and clean place with good restaurants around the area not to far from the metro

Destine’s place was very nice and clean. She checked in on us right away when we accidentally alerted the security system. One of the room upstairs doesn’t have AC but a ceiling fan and it was somewhat hot for our friends. Overall, it was a good experience and what we needed for our group.
This was my second stay with Jose, and once more it was exactly what I needed for a weekend stay. Thank you again for having me!
Nicholas was a terrific host. We had an unexpected last minute change of plans because of weather and he was happy to accommodate us.
Simple clean room in a quiet neighborhood. Only about 10 minutes to the train.
Yolanda’s place was very clean and comfortable. And she was an excellent communicator whenever we had a question. Would highly recommend!

Assel was very responsive and the place was great for a big group. However after paying $75 for early check in for just 1 unit, it was frustrating to have to drop my stuff off and then leave and wait for the cleaning crew to finish before coming back.
We had a great stay. The place was large, nicely decorated, and had everything we needed. We liked that it was just a short walk to the lake. John was a friendly and responsive host. We’d stay again!

Accommodations were perfectly acceptable. It was pretty barebones but it was clean and no frills. The location is fantastic. As in, if you’re looking to both explore Logan Square AND have easy access to the L, it’s hard to beat this location.
Overall,  no complaints. Neighbors and neighborhood were nice, friendly and quiet. Very nice spot to book

Pretty accurate in terms of facilities and description. The location from Chicago downtown perspective was not that great but it was not bad by any means. Great and very responsive host. No issues whatsoever with check in and stuff.

The price seemed a bit overpriced for only two nights but the location was convenient to our conference and it had sufficient space for our group. The beds were not particularly comfortable (fairly hard). There was plenty of room for everyone and the kitchen was well-stocked.

We greatly enjoyed our stay here. Was comfortable for us and was at a good distance from downtown Chicago and the airport. Langston was also very responsible and on top of any issues we may have had. I strongly recommend booking this unit.

Great staying here really safe area and clean house. Private outdoor space was also nice and well kept. The only thing was I expected to have a parking spot biased off the picture but I guess you have to buy that as an additional charge in advance as stated in their description. If you’re planning on parking I’d just recommend using one of the near by garages. But, overall the stay was well worth it very clean and comfortable.
Great location and space. Exactly as advertised. Thank you!

Great location! Stephanie was really helpful and accommodating! She was very quick to respond to our questions.  Her place is very clean and the kitchen had everything for us to bring back dinner! Street parking is very easy and quaint…right across from a playground!

We had an overall great stay! The apartment was spacious, clean, and had everything listed in the description. Milan was an awesome host. He was very responsive and helpful throughout our visit. The only things to note are that the neighborhood didn’t feel the safest at night and the building security wasn’t present 24/7, but we never had any issues. Overall, a great experience and would recommend, especially thanks to Milan’s hospitality!

Sylvia was such a great host. Her responses were always quick and informative which was very appreciated since it was my first time at that side of town.
The place was spotless clean and it felt like home. Towels were super soft and the living room very cozy. I’d definitely stay there again if I have the chance.

Clean, quiet, secure, strong AC window unit. This was a straightforward and pleasant stay, and it was just what I needed (a jumping off point where I could basically sleep, shower, and stow my stuff). Thanks, Charlie!

We had a great time staying at Assel’s place. The apartment was clean, spacious, and had stunning rooftop views that were definitely a highlight of our trip. It was a great space to relax and enjoy the city.
That said, we did run into a few issues. The parking spot listed didn’t fit my truck, which wasn’t noted in the listing, so I had to find alternative paid parking nearby. When I tried reaching out to the number listed for Assel, it was unfortunately out of service, which made things a bit more stressful.
Also, while I personally didn’t notice anything, some of my friends staying in the downstairs unit mentioned a mildew-like smell that was unpleasant for them.
Overall, it was still a good stay and we appreciated the beautiful space, but a few tweaks could make the experience even better.
Very nice host clean house nice neighbourhood we had a lovely stay
Perfect space for our family of 4. We didn’t spend much time there since we were out exploring the city but it served us well.

This was my first trip to Chicago,  and I can't wait to return!   Wrigleyville is a fantastic neighborhood and this apartment was a 20 minute walk from the ballpark.   The place is perfect for 1-2 people.    The train nearby was a non-issue.   I slept like a baby every night and the bed was very comfortable!   Tara was super helpful and I had no issues!!!  Best trip I've had in a while!   I would definitely stay here again!!!
Great place in a great location. Very cozy and comfortable. Would definitely stay here again.
Al pendiente e mis dudas y contestaba súper rápido, la casa mejor de lo que esperaba
Had a wonderful time wasn’t disappointed.

Very nostalgic (especially growing up in Chicago). This home was like staying at a museum with a very old feel but cozy and comfortable.  We didn't stay long but had the chance to admire the front room decor which we fell in love with. The neighborhood is very peaceful and easy to find parking.  Close to Calumet park & lake front, which was a plus as this was the reason for our stay.  Kendra was very responsive... just a great host. I would definitely recommend staying at her home.
Beautiful home in a lovely location.  The host was always responsive, warm and friendly.    The breakfast spread was terrific and an opportunity to meet and converse with interesting people.

The location and proximity made it worth it. All the prices were surged this weekend tho so it was the best deal, definitely not worth the price for the condition. My friend rated the place a 2 and me a 3. When we arrived I actually ended up sweeping and mopping the floors, they were covered with hair and sand. I thought the hard wood was stained or had flaws but once I mopped it was just dirty and those “flaws” came up. May have been worth the price if the place was actually cleaned and didn’t smell. Had me second guessing if bedding was washed if other things were skipped.
Parking is tough but that’s understandable, thought the toilet didn’t flush but you just have to push the lever down extra hard.
I enjoyed my stay and all went well!

Armando was an amazing host, and he provides an amazing place to stay. Having a gorgeous place to stay made my trip all the more fun. I was never worried about reaching out to Armando for questions, and he always made sure to respond and help out quickly. The place is so close to a bus stop that everything in Chicago is easy to get with a bus pass. Similarly it’s very easy to walk/bus to the blue line.

Nat was great with communication. We didnt have hamd soap in the bathroom or towels for the kitchen and she had them dropped off a few hours after asking. very responsive and super helpful. The place is great. Loved the vibe with all the artwork ans bright colors. If you are planning to cook make sure you bring all the extras. The beds were pretty comfortable. We loved the location. Close to the bus and ther did a cookie shop right downstairs. Great place to stay.

Путешествовал с семьей. Все очень понравилось. Апартаменты находятся в самом центре, где до всего очень близко идти. Жене и детям понравилось. Ну и мне тоже. В общем все супер! Спасибо хозяину квартиры.

This place has it all!
I took my son to Chicago for the Black/Pink concert that I bought him tickets to as a birthday present. The location from downtown is perfect!
The room was great! Caroline was great! The room was clean and well organized. She went the extra distance to make us feel welcome, show us around the room, explain how to use everything, and was very communicative the entire time. She even decorated the room in Black/Pink items for my son and got sheets for the bed that he slept in, and allowed him to keep those after the stay.
There are many hotels in Chicago that you could stay at, but none will give you the experience and have the accommodations that this place does, including parking.
If you’re staying in Chicago, do yourself a favor and don’t miss out on this gem!

All told the overall experience was great. We had a slight issue with the combination for the lock to get in the door as we were given an outdated code. That problem was fixed quickly with a phone call. The place is a little narrower than the pictures show, but with only three of us there was sufficient room. Great location and great neighborhood.
Amy’s place was extremely comfortable and conveniently located. Plenty of room and loved the furnishings. Highly recommend

We had a great stay and loved the location. My only complaint was upon checking in, we paid a $89 fee for dining vouchers we did not need, which was not planned for. Also didn’t know about a $125 hold on top of the $250 for the room. It was excess charges that should be more transparent in the booking information.
We would book again if this listing is updated to include more details.
Everything was great at Martha’s place. It was unique. I loved how clean it was! Thank you for your hospitality Martha
Highly recommended if you're a cat lover and/or bringing a pet with you. Not sure I'd recommend otherwise. Regardless, the host, Esmirna, is warm, inviting, and extremely responsive.

This was one of the best Airbnb stays I have had! Genesys and Shannon were extremely proactive in their communication from the start. They provided crystal clear directions for transportation, checking in, things to do. Not only that, they went above and beyond to create a relaxing and peaceful atmosphere; I felt right at home! The amount of intentionality in her home was astounding! From the coffee and tea bar set up, to the luxurious toiletries, it was clear they care about their guests and their comfortability. I will most definitely be coming back!

This was such a cute little place, and great for walking to Wrigley! You have to climb 4 flights of stairs, so keep that in mind if you're packing for more than just a weekend. The bed was like sleeping on a cloud! I'm usually a firm mattress person, but this was soft and so comfy! I couldn't get the wifi to work on my phone, but I also didn't reach out to the host about it. So I'm not upset.

From the moment I walked in, I was blown away. Every detail of this lovely home has been curated with care, elegance, and warmth. It’s rare to find a place that feels both luxurious and welcoming, but this Airbnb nails it.
The location is awesome — close to the city, a train you can walk too, and tucked into a quiet, safe neighborhood that feels like my own little Chicago sanctuary. The space itself? Private. Immaculate. Beautifully designed interiors, incredibly comfortable bed, and every amenity I could need. And a gym! The kitchen is fully equipped, the bathroom is spotless, and there’s even a cozy living area that made me feel instantly at home.
What truly sets this place apart, though, is the host. Thoughtful, responsive, and clearly committed to making guests more than accommodated - genuinely cared for. From seamless check-in to helpful local recommendations, Jeannine has thought of everything.
I’ve stayed in many Airbnbs over the years, but this one raises the bar.
We really enjoyed our stay at this lovely home. It was easy to find, safe, and clean. Would definitely recommend.
Excellent experience

First time staying at an Airbnb and loved it! We were able to book just a few weeks in advance and it was so easy! The host/co-host were very responsive, usually within just a few minutes!
The space was well lit (basement apartment) and very clean. Air conditioning and floor fans kept the temperature very cool and comfortable! The bedrooms were large with comfortable beds and there were extra blankets in the closet if needed.
The kitchen area was stocked with everything we needed like utensils, plates, mugs. There was a dishwasher which made cleaning up easy.
Permit parking made it easy to find a parking spot very close by. The location was also fairly close to a train station. Far enough away that it wasn't loud but close enough to walk. The neighborhood was quiet at night.
This location suited our needs perfectly as we needed somewhere comfortable to sleep, prepare quick breakfasts, and get ready for spending our days and evenings in the city.
Would stay here again!
We were visiting family very close to this unit and it was just as it was described and everything we needed. The street was peaceful and the decor in the place was fun! Thanks for the stay!

This place is great! It was completely as advertised. We didn't need anything or need to bother our host because it was all provided and we enjoyed all the accomodations. I would recommend to anyone that needs a place in Chicago.

The house was okay. It definitely has seen better days- the walls could use a fresh coat of paint, and a few things were in need of repair (missing tiles, broken closet door handle). That said, it was clean enough and the bed that I had was surprisingly comfortable. The basement got very cold but the water was hot for showers. There was no hair dryer available.  The location was convenient, and check-in was easy. If you’re just looking for a place to crash and don’t mind something a little rough around the edges, it’ll do the job. Probably wouldn’t stay again, but it worked in a pinch.

I had an amazing stay with Ashley. I was nervous at first because I’ve never stayed in a communal AirBnb, but all the other tenants were extremely nice and respectful. Highly recommend staying here! Great location for the price.
Great location to experience Wrigleyville and see the Cubs play.

Alex's place was a great value for the the location! We needed somewhere close to Logan and walkable and also affordable and it's exactly what it was and had everything we needed. Like previous reviews, the place does seem relatively new and may just need a few more things to be fully comfortable but it is great value. One thing to note is that sound does travel from upstairs so light sleepers should bring ear plugs. Good for low-maintenance groups to stay at!
Had an amazing stay! Very clean, Elon was very quick to respond and answer any questions quickly, as well as being very nice! Lots more space than I thought, and free street parking was awesome!

We had a great stay! The space was clean, thoughtfully designed, and very comfortable. Everything we needed was there, and the host was responsive and easy to communicate with. Would definitely stay again!
Great stay—perfect location, beautiful accommodations, and Caryl was responsive to two inquiries we had about checking in and amenities.

The space is nicely tucked away in a building that is nondescript outside, yet visually appealing inside.
The security staff was kind and overall thebspace was well appointed and taken care of.

Amazing place. Amazing view. Very sad to leave.
The ameneties and location are incredible

We stayed here to have easy access to United Center. It was an easy 30ish walk and we felt very safe. Plenty of eating and drinking options with in walking distance. The unit was super big and plenty of space for 4 adults and a kid. Unfortunate the TV wouldn’t work and there was no way to connect to Netflix. They were responsive and hopefully this was solved for others. The rooms were comfortable and worked well for what we were looking for.
We had a great time staying at Ewa’s place! Everything was exactly as described and Ewa and her dog were both very friendly.
very nice cozy house with a friendly host who made a sign welcoming me and my friends and left us free snacks 🙂
Very clean and spacious. Stocked kitchen so you can cook, huge TV for movie night, spotless white linens, free street parking. Exceeded our expectations.
Alberto and Gladys were wonderful hosts. Great communication, clean and cozy apt. Perfect for my trip. Highly recommend this Host.
Great host!

Our stay at this location was great! Centrally located in the heart of Lincoln park, it was perfectly in between wrigley and downtown to get to do a bit of everything. Be aware that it’s a 5 floor walk up, which was fine for us but definitely not ideal. Also the AC was not great throughout the unit, the bathrooms and a few bedrooms got pretty hot in the summer heat.
Great, stay! Gerardo was a fantastic host and the place was exactly as described
Thanks for the nice spot!

This house is a gem. Sean and Raquel were beyond helpful and super attentive. The house is perfect, filled with all needed amenities. Kitchen has everything you need, beds are super comfortable and the street, quiet and calm. The backyard is fantastic. It felt like home away from home. I’m definitely coming back and hopefully soon.
Lots of stores and food close, just north of the city so outside the craziness but close enough to travel in.

Building is very new and the second floor was well appointed. The place was very clean and had all the amenities you would need for your stay.
It was a pretty quiet street close by to a grocery store and an easy walk to a coffee shop.
The street parking was convenient and it was easy to drive to all the sites in Chicago.
Overall, it was a wonderful place to stay and would consider staying again if coming to Chicago.

This Airbnb is one of the most calm, elegant and peaceful places I have ever seen, let alone been able to stay in for a long weekend in the city. I had an extremely busy family reunion in the Andersonville area and downtown and it was such a welcome respite to come back to a place that was so clean, private and lovely. I felt very safe and Gerard was always available whenever I had any questions about anything. If you are an older architecture lover like myself, the condition and renovation quality and design will blow you away.
