Do not hesitate to book your stay here, it deserves five stars and more, it truly is exquisite!!
Everything about this Airbnb is fantastic! Brad is a great host, and the location couldn't be better! The space itself is very nice and cozy too. I would definitely stay here again!

For the price you pay, it's very worth it. Everything about this place is communicated clearly on the listing and shouldn't be a surprise. Place is clean and provides all the necessities to stay for a couple of days near the city.

One of our favorite AirBnb stays! Place was cute, easiest street parking, plenty of air conditioning for the hot weekend, and the host was super nice. Our kiddo loved the chickens and bunny! We’d definitely stay here again!

Gleatha's place was exactly what we needed for our visit to Chicago. My teenage daughter and I were visiting for a concert at Soldier field, which was  a short uber ride away. We also had plans to visit Hyde Park and the beach, which were all close by. We loved that the beach was in walking distance! The space was clean and comfortable and Gleatha was helpful and friendly.
非常好

Emily's place was just what we needed. Very comfortable and clean! it was a nice neighborhood. Her pillows and blankets were amazing! We always bring extra but no need to at Emily's place! Overall, it was a great experience and would highly recommend!

This is as good as it's gonna get if you're not at your own home. Beautiful loft apartment in a handsome building, ONE block or less from Jewel-Osco (grocery and pharmacy), elevated train station, Burger King and Dunkin'. Walgreen's and several small neighborhood-type eateries within two to three blocks. Just on the corner of a main street, so Lyft drivers all knew how to find it the times we decided to leave he car parked and let somebody else fight traffic. One minor issue came up while we were there; Devon not only acknowledged, but took care of the problem in about 20 minutes.
The bed was very comfortable; bathroom was stocked with all the little things you might not have remembered. A to Z, this is what you hope for when you stay with a SuperHost.
Apartment showed the same as the pictures. Enjoyed the neighborhood cats!

I enjoyed my stay at Naomi's. The location was easy to find and access. The rooms were beautiful, and the extra half bathroom came in handy. I loved her back porch with the wicker chairs and the matching stool, and it provided a lovely and peaceful experience when you are out there. I will keep this location in mind for my next trip to Chicago.
Naomi was also a great host who was proactive in reaching out to see if anything was needed.
Great place! Good location in Old Town and within 20 min walking of everything you would want to see
Thank you for everything, Anthony.  He was a gracious host.  Regards.

Great Location! Would definitely stay again. Great restaurants and bars, cute boutiques. Many coffee shops close by for an early morning walk. Surprisingly quiet at night for such a vibrant area. Bed was comfortable and the room had everything we needed.
Fabulous!
a very chill environment that was walking distance to the university. The airbnb was also pretty clean as well.

Tejal may just be the best Airbnb host I’ve ever had! So friendly and communicative, gave us wonderful recommendations and made us feel at home. Her room is very well appointed with everything you need and clearly labeled. Couldn’t recommend more!
Awesome location and easy to walk to the main tourist attractions
We loved our stay!

We enjoyed our stay. Very comfortable with lots of room. It was stocked with board games that our kids loved. The neighborhood seemed safe enough. We did not get out and walk around too much but the pickle ball park around the corner was always packed and people were out walking.
Good weekend. Would stay here again. Close to Fulton Market area. Rental is right size and perfect for a weekend and being out and about! Good stuff!
Brand new apartment with all the amenities you need! Very nice place with plenty of space.

My friends and I had a great stay here. The hosts were super friendly and responsive any time I had a question. The home was very nice and looked exactly like the pics. Beds were comfy, bathrooms were clean. We didn’t use the kitchen but it was very well stocked for anything you might need. It took about 30 min to get to downtown from there. We would definitely stay again when we come back to Chicago.

Staying at Genesys’s place was honestly such a vibe and felt so much like home. The neighborhood was super cute and quiet. Meeting all of genesys pets was one of the highlights of our trip especially simba such a well behaved doggy. Also public transportation was super close to the Airbnb which was really good in exploring Chicago. Would definitely recommend and stay here again.

Luis was a wonderful and gracious host. He was great at communicating and kept in touch with me throughout the stay. The apartment was very peaceful and perfect to travel to work functions I had in the area this weekend. It was very clean and kitchen was stocked with items for cooking. I felt right at home. I would recommend to anyone visiting Chicago and would stay here again!
Everything was how it was described everything was neat kitchen was clean rooms were spacious I just like it
Die Lage ist zur Erkundung der Stadt eine absolute Empfehlung und das Hotel mit seiner guten Ausstattung (besonders der schöne Pool und die Dachterrasse) das Geld wert.
Nice space for a group

This was easily one of the best experiences I’ve had in an Airbnb. Carla is so nice and did a great job ensuring we had everything we needed for our stay! The place was spacious and well located perfect for larger groups.

Enjoyed our stay at this spot in River West. The grocery store nearby was very helpful with grabbing last minute items or a quick bite to eat with it being just a 2 minute walk.
Sameer and his team were responsive and friendly. They would actively check in on us and provide recommendations on local food places to go to.
I can’t recommend this more enough. Great place and great experience
Great stay, thank you!!

Great stay for our family.
Plenty of room to sleep

Overall - it was a great space. One of the most stocked Airbnbs I’ve ever been in and the extra roll away beds were really helpful. We had a couple issues with the house smelling like gas (resolved) and the door lock not working (not resolved while we stayed). They were overall helpful but these issues definitely made the stay a bit more stressful.
Emily was very communicative. I love the area. Very quiet even though you are still in the city! The commute is about an hour to get to the city but otherwise, everything was great!

Kind and gracious host in the heart of the best neighborhood in Chicago. Very responsive and incredibly easy check in/check out.
As other reviews have stated…
If noise isn’t your thing, maybe avoid. It is literally right above a bar. I can sleep through anything so it wasn’t a big issue.
Fantastic Stay. A great host and clean and safe stay.
OK if you just need a place to sleep.

Roberto + Carlos were such wonderful and friendly hosts, they provided MANY local reccomendations too!
Definitely would look at staying again the next time we're looking to visit!
Great place and we’d stay there again! It was in the Cambria hotel and the location was perfect for a touristy weekend!
Great place and good proximity to Chicago’s amenities…  Great communication from host…
Everything was perfect our first air bnb experience was great thank you.
Great stay and great responsive host! Thanks Keenan!
Not bad for a quick stay in Chicago

Nice stay and overall not bad. It’s an older building and it shows a bit but the space was overall very clean. Fans in all the bedrooms but it was still a bit warm in the night.
Biggest complaint was that there was a lot of city noise every night. It’s near a main road so police sirens, motorcycles and even fireworks are all constant during our stay with our 4 year old. There were though tons of little extra toiletries in case you forgot anything by which was appreciated.
Overall it’s a nice place, would suggest not for families thought.
Great stay peaceful location

this was the perfect stay for a chicago trip. this home is located in a quiet neighborhood with street parking, and isn’t too far (but far enough from the noise!) from downtown chicago.
the walls in the home were a bit thin, but otherwise, the home was beautiful and clean. spacious backyard with a firepit, stocked kitchen, and comfortable beds. (:
House is very clean with all the necessary amenities. Very modern household. I enjoyed staying with family and we had a good time.

I was really happy to find Milan’s place and stay here. We are a large family traveling together so to find enough space in a walkable area was a gem!
The unit was exactly as pictured. The rooms were really small, but there were 6 queen beds and it was clean.
Milan is an extremely responsive and helpful host. We wish they provided laundry pods, dish pods, extra towels, sheets, extra pillows, bedding. Especially for the price. They did eventually bring us things we asked for.
The first night we didn’t have any towels. The front desk was extremely rude and dismissive and said that we “may” get towels the next day. Panic ensued since 12 of us couldn’t take showers, no hand towels, etc. luckily they were able to get them to us before bedtime. The hand towels and wash cloths are pretty ratty.
The pack and play delivered to us was disgusting. No bag, and there was a large chunky spit up on it not even wiped down. I do not recommend. This seems like another front desk/facilites issue

Very solid location right next to a grocery store and within walking distance of a ton of retail, cafes, and restaurants in Wicker Park & Bucktown.  The house was spacious, clean, and full of character.

The place is great.  Spacious, with character.  Loved the Bronzeville area.  Parking is on the street but was plentiful.  The apartment is also just a few blocks from the green line (Indiana station) if public transportation is preferred.  We also walked to Lake Michigan easily.  There is a cute coffee shop on the corner, and a large grocery store a block away.  There are three separate bedrooms, two with queen beds and one with a twin plus trundle, plus my teenager slept on the living room couch and said it was great.  My four tall adult children hate sharing beds with siblings so it was great for everyone to have their own bed!  Two full bathrooms is also nice.  The coffeemaker broke the first day, but Richard responded immediately and offered to come up right then (I declined because everyone was asleep, and discovered the corner coffee shop instead!).  Apartment is up a flight of stairs, not difficult but not ideal if you have mobility issues. Would definitely stay here again!

We had a great stay. Great location with plenty to do within walking distance. New Argyle Red Line station is an easy walk away for getting around the city. The unit was clean and was perfect for our weekend needs. Would stay again. Thanks!
We had a great stay! Clean, spacious, and close to public transit. Would recommend!
Thanks again!

If it’s all about “location location location” then this is the place, especially for a Cubs game!! A nice, simple 1-bedroom basement apartment in a quiet friendly neighborhood, a mere block or two from a wide variety of restaurants, groceries, drug store, and of course many sights to see. Wrigley Field is literally 2-3 blocks away.

The place is really spacious. Communication with the host is easy since Brittany is responsive and she let us checked in early. We didn’t encounter any untoward incidents even though they told us that the area is not safe.
Great place! Worked well for a group of 6.

Place is spacious and love the individual bathrooms in each room. Street parking was easy as well.
Inside was modern and upkept nicely although some minor comforts were missing. Would definitely stay again.
Great location. Easy check-in/access. Nice option for our young family. Responsive hosts.
Nice place.

Absolutely loved the area and the space. Garden level apartment but was plenty comfortable for a month long stay. Super clean and would recommend for anyone wanting to explore any of the nearby neighborhoods or be by the medical district.

This Airbnb was beautiful and our stay was great! The security of the home made us feel very safe! Very nice furniture, kitchen accessories and place overall. Very clean!
Easy to access anything in downtown Chicago due to being directly off the interstate. Also it is walking distance to the train station which came in handy!
The host was very responsive the entire trip and the neighbor we met was very friendly!
We had an amazing stay!
One thing to note- bring ear plugs for the evening if you’re a light sleeper. There are block parties filling the roads behind the Airbnb and it was very loud at night with the music, people yelling and sirens!

Overall fine. Very obviously a permanent Airbnb and not ever someone’s “home”. With some maintenance and fuller cleaning it could be much better. Amenities were the bare minimum. They did allow flexible check in and provided permit parking passes.

It's located so close to downtown, and there is easy access to public transportation. It was a good place; it felt like home, and I recommend it if you want to take some days off. You'll feel recharged!
Todo estuvo muy bien, volvería a hospedarme sin pensarlo. Puedes usar autobús o metro sin problemas para llegar al centro de Chicago. Muy buena atención por parte de Joe, gracias
The place in general very confortable and clean. The only inconvenience we had is the noise during the night.
Milan was a responsive, problem solving host that I’d recommend to anyone!!
Josh was very responsive and one of the fastest to respond that I've dealt with on Airbnb. Very friendly and great location. Highly recommend.

En cuanto al inmueble, Andy tiene todo bien limpio y busca mantener el orden, lo que es muy bueno, todos los espacios muy limpios y en orden, me gustó que los demás huéspedes respetaron los mismos términos, lo que me llevo a sentirme como en casa. Excelente servicio, excelente todo. Muchas gracias Andy.

I booked this unit for family visiting from out of town, and they loved it! The unit is gorgeous, spacious, and well-maintained. They said it was very comfortable and appreciated all the thoughtful details. Jo and Mari were very responsive hosts and were great answering my initial questions about accessibility for my fam (it’s a second story walk up). And the location is great, as it’s less than a mile to Lake Michigan, Jarvis Square, the el, and the metra. We will for sure be recommending this unit for family and friends who visit in the future!
Our second time staying at this location. Super nice place.
Amazing area.
Had a great time staying with Jonathan. Super friendly and place was as described. And George is an awesome cat!

I unfortunately encountered bed bugs during my stay here - my first experience with them. It took me several days after returning home to realize the cause when the bite areas became swollen and intensely itchy. More than ten days later, I'm still recovering and even needed to consult my doctor for medical advice.
The host has been unresponsive to my concerns. Thankfully, after thorough cleaning at home, I haven't found evidence of bringing the infestation back with me.
Warning to future guests: Be extremely vigilant - carefully inspect under mattresses and consider keeping luggage off beds entirely. This experience has definitely made me more cautious about checking for signs of bed bugs when traveling. I DON'T recommend this place.
The host is very friendly. Treated me like family, even gave me a ride to the CTA station when I left.

Greg's description of this property is exactly as advertised.  He's clear that this is not a luxury listing and he's very clear this is a budget accommodation. That being said, you have all you need here. A clean, safe, quiet place to sleep in an excellent, convenient location. Plus, Greg was truly kind and accommodating!

I highly recommend staying at Ronaldo's apartment if you are looking for a place in the Ukrainian Village. They are extremely kind and helpful in accommodating my stay and let me leave my bags after check-out. I will definitely come back!
Great host, just as represented, if not a bit better. Would do the shared house thing again. Great neighborhood.

This was my first time not staying in Downtown Chicago. I was pleased with every aspect of my stay. Dawn is an excellent host ! Everything regarding stay was clearly communicated. I travel often  and stay at many air bnb’s  this one topped the list. Cleanliness was #1 . The air bnb had fully stocked kitchen which would make preparing or reheating  meals a breeze. I would definitely consider this place for my next stay
Ok value for money, host very attentive and good location. Place was clean and did the job. Can’t complain

Nay was always responsive to any questions I had from the beginning until the end. For my travels those 2 nights I was in town, the location was perfect. For it being the first time I have ever used AirBnb, I was very satisfied. Nay was very flexible with my request to check in early and I felt no rush in having to checkout, even though, we checked out when we’re supposed to. Nay was responsive, flexible and very friendly. Thank you, Nay!!

Great location and parking. Space was big enough for a large family and easy to get into. The house is clean and there are TVs in every room. That's too much for us but the kids liked it.
The amenities were lacking. We use Airbnb to be able to cook and while there were just enough items to prepare little things, it should have more kitchen items. There were no coffee cups, only two drinking cups, and just enough plates for each of us. There also absolutely no spices, cutting boards, only one large knife, no strainer, or cheese grater. This is the first place I've stayed at where they didn't at least have salt, pepper, and some other basics.
Rich did ask how the stay was going, and I shared my concern. He said he would add a few of the things I asked for, but we had to go to the dollar store to buy stuff to finish up our trip.
Beautiful multilevel apartment

This place was so sweet! I loved the lay out and the beds were really soft and comfortable. You can definitely tell that people actually live there - but in a way that makes it a great place to stay because everything you need is truly there. I love the chickens!!!!!! Love them! There were even fresh eggs left for us. It was a shared space (the owner stayed in the basement the first night) which I felt a little bad about because we were coming back a little late from a welcome party for a wedding - but that’s okay! The hot tub was also lovely. It was truly a lovely stay.
Great spot.

This was one of the best Airbnb experiences I’ve had! The place was very easy to find, clean, and comfortable! The area is also pretty quiet with a few walkable restaurants in the area. There is a bus stop on the corner which helps if you’re taking public transit. Wonderful very communicative and provided clear instructions! 10/10 when I come back to Chicago I will definitely stay again!

I loved the location of Arleth's home. Everything was a walk away, and being so close to the brown line station it felt like Chicago was in my backyard. Each day we started by deciding what we wanted to do for the day as we grabbed our CTA pass and jumped on the L train. I would highly recommend this location for friends and family looking to stay in Chicago and go on adventures through the city. Arleth was a fantastic host, if there were any questions or concerns she jumped on right away to respond.
No toilet paper, no paper towels, no paper napkins. Overall, place seemed dirty.
Good
Great place to stay!

This has honestly been one of the better airbnb spots I’ve stayed at with my family in Chicago. The place was exactly as the pictures described. Marie was very communicative and friendly during the whole check-in process. The area did just have a little sketchy feeling but other than that I can’t complain. Would recommend for sure!
The best part was the bathroom. I enjoyed my stay and the place was pretty clean

Gregory was a great host. Comfortable beds (queen + floor mattress), soft sheets, clean plush towels and plenty of workspace. The window units and fans kept the space very comfortable. The space was surprisingly quiet too. No street noise OR noise from the other tenants.  We enjoyed the public library and park that was about a 10 min walk. Groceries were easy to pick-up just around the corner too. We did run into some issues that Gregory helped to address very quickly. We also shared some general maintenance issues in the kitchen that we hope he addresses after we left.
Location is close to shopping and restaurants. Host was very responsive.
perfect spot for a Wrigley weekend. hosts were incredibly responsive, helpful and friendly from booking through departure!

I had an exceptional time staying at this Airbnb! I held my 26th birthday in Chicago with a group of friends and this was a perfect place for us. Keith was very helpful with any and everything that I needed. The location was not a concern at all. It was easy to find the home, easy to check in and out. It is a very spacious and beautiful home. I definitely recommend booking here! No complaints, 10s across the board.
This is an incredible location, especially if you are coming into town to see a cubs game. The place is super comfortable and modern.

Caitlin was a great host. She was communicative and helpful. We had everything we needed for our stay.
The space was clean, comfortable and in a great location in the city.
Had a great time!!
Great place! It was a low ceiling but for me it worked out because I am 5’3. There was Netflix provided on the tv. It was very clean.
Delia was absolutely wonderful. She’s a very friendly woman with many interesting stories and hobbies. The rooms in her house are very clean and comfortable. I highly recommend to stay here!
Nice stay for my family.
Beds were comfy. Less stark LED lighting would make it more comfortable in the evening.   A/C worked well. Neighbors were friendly in the building.
Great location, great communication! You ate staying in someone’s home, while they won’t be there but it is important to note.

The home was just like the photos and in a nice location close to U of C campus.  Parking on the street wasn’t an issue and we appreciated them accommodating our early arrival.  The neighbors upstairs were extremely loud, but we notified the owners and they handle noise complaint swiftly.  Overall we enjoyed the space and you visit again.

Location. Location. Location.
30-50 min from the hustle and bustle of downtown via public transportation. 15-20 walk to Wrigley making it an easy choice for a revisit! Need groceries- you are block from the local grocery store, and a 10 min walk from Whole Foods and target.
The futon offered additional sleeping (not that we needed) in addition a comfy place to sit back and relax after walking the city.
Bed is a firm memory foam- with comfortable clean pillows and linens- this helped with a great night sleep.
Rain shower head offered a small spa escape after a long day.
Hosts were easily reached and often checked in on how we were doing.
Overall 5 stars for our stay and experience.

Steph and Randy were beyond accommodating, as I selected this Airbnb for my parents to stay in. The apartment is great, with comfy beds, and kitchen appliances to die for (I live nearby and found myself wanting to come over and use the kitchen!).
Moreover, whenever I needed anything, Steph and Randy were super responsive and incredibly accommodating--including when I needed to extend my parents' stay when they had an unexpected appointment keep them in Chicago. Couldn't have been easier, and look forward to recommending it to any guests in the future!
Great, but stairs might be too much for some.
숙소 내부가 너무 깔끔하고 중앙에 큰 식탁이 있어 여러명의 인원이 이용하는데 너무 편리하고 좋았습니다! 다음에 온다면 또 묵고싶은 숙소에요!

NO parking on premises. Only street parking, and you must be extremely lucky to find a space if you arrive after 6pm. I spent 20 minutes for a parking spot and had to park several streets away (~6 minutes walking). The next morning I could repark my car next to the house and never touched it again. Airbnb itself is ok, matching photos and description, expect some noise, but nothing too crazy. Metro/subway/L is 10 minutes away, takes ~ 45 minutes to the loop. (Get daily pass which also works for buses). Neighbourhood is majority Hispanic, overall I felt safe, no shady individuals. There are couple homeless next to metro station, but they are not beggars and peaceful. I can recommend that place.

This apartment was amazing! Very comfortable and well-stocked. Lilian truly thought of everything one would need for a longer-term stay.
Lilian is also so kind and takes great care of the building. She was always available to answer any questions and share advice about the area.
I highly recommend this Airbnb!!

We (my wife and 2 kids) loved this spot, we used to live in the neighborhood and this was the perfect location, centrally located, easily walkable to everything, nice quiet street with easy parking. Inside of the house was very cleanly designed with comfortable high quality furniture and nice finishes.
Very clean and quiet! Host responded super quick and was helpful during our stay!
Quick stay.  Met my needs
Awesome location with lots of amenities. Anthony was a great host.

The space is pretty nice. Rooms each have a.c. and the common area is pretty big. The location is south Chicago so it does have some sketchy bits but overall the street the house is located on felt safe. You are really close to several nice parks, museums, etc that are about a 10 min drive from the home. Kitchen are isn't super usable. The oven and microwave were pretty dirty. Otherwise, the burners all work and the fridge is fairly spacious. Cheaper than a lot of other options and you are in a great location to explore a lot of the city if you have a car.
Great spot. Lack of cheap parking is annoying but that’s Chicago for you, there’s a Wrigley parking spot nearby for about 60 dollars overnight.
Propiedad bien ubicada y de fácil acceso. Anfitrión claro y responde rápidamente.

Jaime y Mariana han sido unos fantásticos anfitriones. El apartamento muy limpio y en una zona segura. Han estado super atentos conmigo y me he sentido como en casa. Muchas gracias de todo corazón y los recomiendo a todo el que quiera tener una buena estancia en Chicago.

Ami’s place in Bucktown was fantastic! Great apartment with everything you need, well setup with a wonderful porch and backyard space, in a lovely neighborhood. Highly recommend to anyone visiting Chicago!
Great place to stay with breakfast provided, water provided and discounts on meals.  Several restaurants around and walking distance to Magnificent Mile
This had everything I needed for my stay in Chicago and the location can’t be beat. The hosts are also super communicative and made the process seamless.
I am extremely happy with my stay, unit was pristine, view of the lake was amazing, everything was perfect, host was very proffesional A+

Place approved by 4-65 year old. We had a great stay- everything is so close and walkable. The views from the balcony are unlike I have ever seen from any other Airbnb in Chicago ( and I have been to Chicago 8 times).  The host were very helpful- the instructions were detailed! We would definitely come back and stay here in future.
Great host, place, neighborhood. Fantastic for medical professionals looking to stay near swedish covenant hospital.

The apartment matches the description.
We appreciated having three separate bedrooms and bathrooms, which provided comfort and privacy. The air conditioning was effective, though some noise was noticeable during the night. All kitchen appliances were functional. The location is convenient—just a few minutes’ walk to the subway and train station, making it a practical choice for travelers without a car.

Cihan’s studio apartment was so perfectly situated for what we wanted to do in Chicago. What a cool and bustling neighborhood, everything from old school Chicago dives (we finished each night at the Ale House), to hip new restaurants and bars, and everything in between. The building was clean and easy to get into, despite other units in the same building, it was very quiet and comfortable. And best of all, was the communication with our host, who checked in with us to see if there was anything we needed, and when we asked for something, responded almost immediately and beyond our satisfaction. We would certainly stay here again!

Rosemary's home was absolutely beautiful. It was clean, quite, and in an amazing location! The home was fully equipped with everything we needed for our visit. You could tell a lot of thought went into making sure the guests were happy and comfortable. Just an amazing experience all the way around. This will be our new go to anytime we visit Chicago!

Esmirna is warm, inviting and incredibly accommodating. Her home is comfortable, beautifully decorated and in a great location. A true pet friendly home, my cats enjoyed their stay just as much. Thank you! 💕
Thanks for being a great host. I enjoyed my stay and will look for availability at your place next time I visit Chicago.
Wonderful stay at Studio 424, love the coworking space 💜 everything was on point ✨
Reallllyyyy awesome location, a few classic restaurants in walking distance. Very clean and peaceful space as well.

Host was flexible with me putting my bags down before the check-in. There was an empty coke bottle left in the room upon check in. Host was a bit slow to respond, so I didn't get working wifi for at least 24 hours. Twice during my stay, "maintenance" came into the apartment without warning, stating the shower was broken. However, the shower was working fine for the duration of my stay. Overall, a pretty good stay.

Ginneh was a great host and her place was fantastic! It was a great location - easy to get to the beaches, Hyde park, and the loop. I also brought my dog and there was a  big, enclosed backyard for him to run in safely. Highly recommend this place!
This is always the location I stay when in town. All that you need and walkable to just about everything!
Nice and clean place. She left a lot of basic restroom necessities that you could possibly need on your trip.

We had a great stay and were happy with our choice! Everything was very clean, plenty of towels and linens, and even had padding for the outdoor furniture. It was a great location and all the shops and restaurants were easy to walk to. It was a great place and we will definitely keep it in mind for future trips!

The apartment is beautiful and spotless with lots of room, high ceilings and big windows. The amenities are amazing. The rooftop pool and indoor basketball court were open late and were a great way to relax after being out all day. The rooftop has beautiful plants/flowers and lots of comfortable seating areas along with a great view.
Highly recommend!

Helen runs a very clean and organized AirBNB and she was immediately responsive to any questions I had. I was sorry I didn't have the opportunity to meet her as she is clearly a very consciencious and responsible person.

Fabulous location, easy access to downtown/Riverwalk and Lincoln Park . Reasonably priced for 3 beds and 2 baths. Appreciated being able to cook and eat some meals in. Hatice was very kind and reached out throughout the stay to see if we needed anything. Overall great stay!

Great location. Clean room. Just wish it had some basic hotel features like mini lotions, etc. only mentioning it so future bookings can be prepared. First time booking a hotel versus a house with air bnb so it was different. But great spot, responsive, great communication, overall 10/10 and very happy with the spot!
not enough food to feed us guests in the Airbnb. dirty kitchen.

Great host, first off, very communicative and responsive, also quite friendly and down for interesting conversations!
Very much liked the place, good neighborhood and while the L is slightly farther (10m walk) Damen, Division plus Clybourn Metra are all close and accessible.
The laundry is a basement unit for the apartment building, with the apartment a few stories up, but no worries there.
Love the bedroom, spacious, good bathroom as well.
Overall very much recommend!

We very much enjoyed the space. We were with friends that we’ve known for many years and  this is the most we ever talked about interior decorating in our relationship. We were admiring the wonderful touches in the space, the use of circles, soft edges, light and contrast. This was a delightful space for us to share and the porch was wonderful. Lourdes was very responsive and easy to work with. This is one listing where the description and photos don’t do justice; it is even nicer.  We hope to stay again.  Book with confidence and you will be delighted.
The hosts were so responsive and helpful with anything I needed. I had a great stay and would definitely recommend!
Yolanda and the Airbnb were great. Would book again!
A pleasant stay
great stay cordial host lovely accommodating and decent area
Muy buen lugar, cómodo y limpio. Definitivamente si volvería
Cozy little room with a nice bathroom and the breakfast was just what we needed before hitting the road!
TJ and Hattice were incredibly communicative which was great given my busy schedule. Place was very convenient and really good value. Would definitely recommend!
Clean place in a wonderful neighborhood with plenty to do within walking distance. I would definitely stay here again.

Upon arriving i was threatened by 2 men who flashed a gun at me. after letting the host know i was informed i would not get any money back which is why i believe there’s a no refund policy. She told me she would only help if it was rebooked and i now was informed that you can’t rebook for less than 3 days, which was the duration of my stay.
i had to spend hundreds more to get a safe location last min and feel the threat to my life and out of pocket cost that i didn’t get back was absolute not worth the “deal” that this space seems to offer. Def scroll back and read the other concerning reviews. as i wish i would’ve before throwing away $300.

Nice and clean apartment, very convenient parking space on the back of the property, and easy to get in, as is in front of the street, all clean and everything working fine.
The only thing and it’s not an apartment issue itself, the elevator motors of the building makes some constant noise particularly in the bedroom, nothing huge, but if you don’t like any noise, then bring your ear plugs, besides this the apartment it’s perfect.
As well the communication with the host was really fast 👍

Quiet neighbourhood. 20-30min walk to the beach and supermarkets
Over 3hr walk to downtown.
15min walk to CTA Station then 40min trip to downtown.
Large comfortable couch which i used instead of the bed.
Some food in fridge/freezer however no salt and pepper or coffee or tea.
No duvet for the double bed, spare room had 2 single duvets though so used them instead.
3 doors to lock and unlock (only 1 of the doors self locked, the others needed manually locked)
Stairway to the flat, no elevator, fine for the able bodied.
2 doors on entry from main front door, 1 to air bnb the other to the hosts flat.
No hairdryer but host promptly dropped off within a few hours.
Great place to stay for walkability to the convention center
Great place to stay if you are new to Chicago or if you want to be close to the Lake!
Lovely accommodations and wonderful breakfast!  So much value compared to a similarly priced hotel room. Great for visiting UChicago and Hyde Park. Highly recommend.
Very spacious very nice shower lots of room and access to laundry
Really enjoyed my stay!! Room is exactly how on the picture and host was very communicative!! Will be back
Very clean and very pretty room. Would stay again.
Very nice and responsive host 😊 Wonderful space pretty close to the blue line , 10/10 would stay again.
This place was cute and had all we needed.
This was a great place to stay. Clean, easy, and amazing location!
J

Staying with Ewa was perfect, truly the best that Airbnb can offer. From the moment I arrived, Ewa made me feel like a long-time roommate and not a stranger.  She had great recommendations and is invested in the neighborhood. Her dog, Bruno, is so chill and sweet as well! The space itself was comfortable and clean. The only downside is that finding street parking can be a little difficult. (There are a lot of parked cars in the area, but it's not a busy street. It's very quiet.) That said, I never felt unsafe walking to my car or in the neighborhood. I'm so glad I chose Ewa's place to stay and would definitely stay here again.

Stop and book if it is available. The home has so much to offer. Beautiful, large showers (with steam), and perfect hosts. These hosts were there to answer any and all questions. Close to restaurants and in a safe friendly neighborhood

Really enjoyed our stay. It was all very last minute but the host was very understanding and hosted us. Would definitely stay again, the apartment is clean, very close to the L and easily accessible.
The host was quick to respond and was very helpful. Would definitely stay again!

We had a fabulous time at Alice’s place. We celebrated my 40th birthday with family and a couple friends and there was plenty of space for everyone,  with several open spaces to gather and spacious bedrooms and bathrooms. Alice was a fantastic host and incredibly responsive and accommodating. We had no issues during our two week stay. I would not hesitate to book this space if visiting Chicago. Easy access to great restaurants and public transportation and is located in a great neighborhood! Thanks again, Alice!

As Chicago Natives,  we were excited to stay in our hometown and close to where we grew up. Therefore,our experience was like being back at home.  Our stay was during the high 80s and low 90s, but the place remained cool with the ability to control the temperature.  We ate out mostly so we didn't use much of the kitchen. There is only one television with no streaming access. Stephanie was very responsive whenever questions arose.

This is a very comfortable loft place near Fulton Market/West Loop with ample parking, restaurants, etc. nearby. We arrived to a well stocked super clean unit. John was exceedingly flexible with us during the booking process. I would definitely recommend this place to a friend!

Was not happy with the cleanliness of the space, a lot of spider webs and dust.
The window facing the bed was way too bright. We needed to sleep in and rest., the brightness of the window did not allow that to happen.
There was also a rule about taking off the shoes when entering the premises that we did not see up front when booking and when we got there it really was so inconvenient, as there are a lot of doors to go thru and stairs plus the entrance is so narrow and it’s pretty much one door hitting another door., to have to drop everything and take off your shoes is just inconvenient.
Overall the space could be a 5 star but cleanliness is a big issue for us and where we stay. It’s hard to get a good night sleep when you can smell the sheets (bedding) isn’t clean in a place where many people stay.

We had a perfect one-week stay at Yanko's place. The place was absolutely spotless, and all the amenities were exactly as described. I would actually say the apartment was nicer in real life than in the pictures. We were grateful to have access to well-functioning AC, clean towels, and a fully-equipped kitchen. Location is great, super walkable and close to bus and train stations. Hosts were friendly and responsive throughout our stay. So grateful for our stay!
Met my needs for this 5 day stay.

Amazing location in the loop and beautiful view. Was even able to see the NASCAR race that  was going on at the time of our stay.  The pool was very peaceful and nice. Staff was very responsive leading up to and after the reservation was made. Had an issue with some ordered food being taken from the lobby and someone knocking on my door at 2am claiming they had a delivery (didn’t answer).  Both incidents happened during my 2 week stay and the hosts were notified. So, if you order food, make sure you track it and meet it down in the lobby. Otherwise, I had a good overall stay.

kasey’s place was great to come home to after a day of adventuring around downtown chicago or one of the up and coming neighborhoods.    we loved the native gardens and ability to hang out on the private backyard patio.    kasey provides wonderful and clear instructions.   place was very clean.     was a bit worried about it being warm as there is no air conditioner, but the little unit stays cool and kasey provides a few fans.   thanks!!    would stay again.

I Really enjoyed staying in this beautiful home. From the amenities, to the right at home vibe this was definitely the place for me. Comfortable reclining couches, clean linen, private backyard & patio area, Tv's in each room, clear communication and a flexible keyless check in.  I look forward to my next stay in Chicago. This is the home I'll be searching for.
Great Location!

Tom was super responsive and communicated great on how to access the Airbnb. Unit looks as nice as the photos shown. We had multiple guys there for a business event and dinners so more then enough space. The pool table, dart board, shuffle board table, and the swing were all great amenities. One guy had a car so the parking spot was huge. His adult size bunk beds were also appropriately sized for these guys. Only small gripe, and it’s small, is you have to walk a bit to get to the coffee shops and restaurants off Chicago Avenue. Neighborhood is quiet if that is your vibe then it’s perfect.

I completely enjoyed my stay. It was spacious & cozy. The bed was super comfortable. Only downside is that I couldn’t control the AC so the master bedroom was warmer than the rest of the house. The host was very responsive & accommodating. Highly recommend.

Great little place for our first visit to Chicago. In a quiet clean neighborhood surrounded by walkable streets. Only gripe is small bath towels that never really dried between showers. Would recommend bringing your own!
Hanna has a most beautiful apartment, in a neighborhood with the best vibes in Chicago. When I had questions she responded immediately and effectively.
Great place in the center of a wonderful neighborhood. Has everything you need, and Jason was easy to communicate with.

My sister and I came from opposite coasts to meet in Chicago for a getaway. After walking all over the city each day/night, we enjoyed this space as a home base. Lincoln Park, Gold Coast, and Lake Michigan are enjoyable walks from here. Though there’s a bustling restaurant next door, it closes by bedtime and the place becomes incredibly quiet. The unit is interesting and we had fun speculating about its past. I sat at the top of the outside stairs with coffee in the morning enjoying the skinny view behind neighboring buildings and resident birds.

Marv is a great host, very polite & helpful, gave useful tips. The apartment is in a perfect location for downtown commute. It’s spacious, clean with everything one needs for a comfortable stay.  We stayed for 2 weeks, totally worth it. Strongly recommend for short/ long term stays.
Cleanest and nicest Airbnb I have stayed in. Would recommend to future guests.
Great place to stay! Safe neighborhood, very responsive hosts! Would love to stay again!

Our stay here was perfect, Hazel and Andrew ensured we were always happy and didn’t need anything. The location is in walking distance to supermarkets like target or jewel osco. It’s also beside a bus line which brings you right into town.

Great location! Quiet street and easy on street parking.
Walking distance to Southport corridor.
Especially loved the close proximity to Dopio!
Hatice is very responsive and a great host.
It was wonderful stay and clean hotel
No visito Chicago a menudo pero de hoy en adelante voy a buscar este mismo departamento definitivamente, grande, cómodo y limpio y me encantó la ubicación.
很好，跟房东沟通非常顺畅！
Jorge is a really great host! Very friendly and helpful! The place is also really nice overall! Extremely satisfied stay!
The stay was great. Right near the airport and a short drive from the blue line.

We were on a long trip and booked this Airbnb as we stopped in Chicago. We booked it for its location which was great but also because it had an in unit washer a dryer. The dryer did not work and we spent an inordinate amount of time trying to fix it, hang dry our clothes, work with the building maintenance people and the Cloud9 support. Cloud9 offered no solutions and after multiple phone calls, many of which went unanswered, they simply offered us a credit to go to a laundry mat. The time wasted trying to get them to help was an aggravation and resulted in no solutions. We won’t be renting through Cloud9 again due to their lack of support, inconsiderate attitudes, and failure to help.
It was a nice private room with a living room.  Less expensive than a hotel with more room and better location for what we needed
I had such a wonderful stay. The apartment was beautiful and thoughtfully designed and Lourdes is such a great host. Definitely recommend!

I had a phenomenal stay at Jordan's place. It's somehow even more spacious than the photos show. Access to the apartment was easy and contactless and there's a ton to do within walking distance. Jordan was incredibly helpful and communicative throughout my stay! I would stay here again in a heartbeat. You won't regret booking!
Loved staying at Allende's house. He was super helpful and the place was cozy and comfortable. We already booked for next year!
This was such an amazing stay. We spent our honeymoon in such a great relaxing place. It was so well stocked, anything we needed was there. Also the AC was so nice!
Luis was a great host. He made accommodations for my stay at the last minute. He was such a great host. The house was perfect. He made sure to checkin on us throughout our stay.
Our first visit was awesome, thanks to Stephanie!! our airbnb experience wss nothing less than exceptional! We'll definitely be coming back!! Thank You Steph for everything!!

The Wrigleyville Suite, #1 (upstairs) was perfect for my one night stay, exactly what I needed and beyond. If you want to be in a safe neighborhood, steps away from a variety of dining options and Wrigley Field, this is for you.
Be sure to read the listing and pay attention to the details regarding shared common (including bathroom) and the allowed number of guests. The other 2 rooms were booked while I was there, but they were kind and respectful - which made a HUGE difference.
The outdoor courtyard is nice and WHEN I visit again for a longer stay, I'll be sure to take advantage of the space.
Beautiful home, T was responsive, such a great hostess!
Great location! Host was very responsive and friendly!

Cute, well-appointed space in a great neighborhood. Entrance is in the back of the place, so your view is the alley (in case that's important to you). The place is laid out really well, it's easy to get inside, Lauren was a great communicator and I had everything I could need. Loved being in the middle of a walking neighborhood.
nice and comfortable bedsheets towels smelled good clean
Wonderful location right by Wrigley Field.  I was not there for a game so it was very quiet!  Chialung was wonderful host and made me feel at home.
Great place for a family, rooms are large and quiet. In summer you may hear some noise from neighbors’ AC units

We enjoyed the stay in the upper floor of the house. The place was very well equipped, clean and quiet. Our host was very welcoming and helpful with practical instructions. The house was easily accessible by car from the airport. As we had hoped, the place was well connected with the city centre via bus and train in less than an hour.

I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb! The space was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was responsive, friendly, and made check-in a breeze. The location was perfect — close to everything I needed but still peaceful and quiet. I especially appreciated the thoughtful touches like [restaurant recommendations and extra towels]. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area!
Very cozy place to stay, really clean and has lots of space and essentials also. Would definitely come back.

Lisa is one of the best Airbnb host i’ve ever had! She waited up for us past midnight to ensure we had a smooth and safe check in. Her place is stunning! Huge apartment very very very clean everything you could need. The place was central we were close to everything! I will be using lisa’s place for future chicago travel.

First time in Chicago…All I can say is I felt right at home…the neighbors were awesome and our uber driver even offered us to visit his church. All the stuff you hear on the news about Chicago’s Southside is BS!!!! I loved it and I will definitely be back and staying in the same location

The place was clean and easy to get to with public transportation from the airport. It is near a couple of bus stops to get downtown or wherever you need to in the city. The neighborhood itself is quiet and close to a pharmacy and Target.
The hosts are very quick to respond and were flexible with our check-in which was later than expected, and we appreciated that!
The house itself is nice.
Very clean and great decor. We loved this location and would stay here again,
The apartment is very close to a grocery and green line, with a safe environment. Everything is good. We enjoyed the stay in Chicago.
We enjoyed our stay at Derrick’s listing. The townhouse was very spacious and clean.
Our favorite place to stay. Great host, great location, adorable space.
We had a very nice stay. Place was exactly as in photos, clean, and quiet. About a 10 min walk to Logan main area

Larry’s place is overall clean, comfortable, and extremely affordable for being in the city. The couch and big screen tv were great for movie nights with friends after a long day in downtown. The beds are clean comfortable and well stocked with blankets and pillows, as well as having a nice kitchen with lots of options and room. Overall loved the place and price and would stay again thank you for having us Larry.
Exceptional home.  Location, cleanliness, no stone left unturned!
This was a very convenient location for our stay visiting family, and we appreciated the neighborhood and Tara's attentiveness.

the place was beautiful and Mr. Charles was very nice and answers all your questions in a timely manner if we're back in Chicago we'll diffently stay again.  Thanks Mr. Charles for letting us stay at your home

Emmy is an extremely responsive host! She answered my questions very quickly both before and during our stay. The apartment is just as pictured - cute and nicely decorated, and very clean. It worked well for our four-day event at United Center - we wanted something walkable to the venue and restaurants. The area is a little deserted at night, but with three of us it felt very safe. The convenience of the El right outside the apartment means you can hear the train, so bring your earplugs if you are a light sleeper! Highly recommend Emmy’s
Place. Be sure to have a donut from Stan’s - a three minute walk!

Our first time in Chicago, and I do think we picked a great area! It was very walkable, not to downtown, but there’s a lot of vintage shops and great restaurants, which is more to our interest, so we felt right at home. It is on a corner, so lots of traffic noise later into the night, but not something we’re too bothered by. Linens and towels, specifically, were phenomenal! It was a great stay. We’re already planning our next trip!
This place is very very nice. It was 3 of us and we had our own bathrooms. I appreciated the decoration of the home. Very clean. Very modern. This place is a must stay.

Thaers place is beautiful the neighborhood is nice and I was comfortable. But Thaer as a host is horrible the electricity went out in all 3 bathrooms my entire stay and he wanted me to be an electrician and try to fix it. He didn’t want spend the money to have a professional come out over the weekend and we had no electricity in the bathrooms for 3 days it was horrible, he offered a refund but it was contingent on my review which isn’t fair. Be mindful of the rusty door hanging down in the back when entering the unit it’s dangerous. Also THAER DOESNT LIVE IN CHICAGO SO HE CANNOT HELP YOU WITH ANY URGENT MATTERS. The place is beautiful but Thaer’s lack of resolve made staying there horrendous. Book at your own risk!

Very nice place if you have a larger group. Was pretty close to things downtown too do but the surrounding area of the place was pretty rough with car windows broken and loud surroundings but we didn’t have any problems. Overall it was a good stay.
As advertised, not cramped at all , big fan of the lenins.

Clara and Jen truly exceeded expectations! From the thoughtfully placed toiletries on the bed to the fresh towels and delightful treats, every detail was handled with care. Their communication was seamless and attentive throughout. I’d absolutely consider booking again and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend this place to anyone! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Gina's place is great.   great location  clean
Had a great stay. Host was attentive. The unit was located in a nice location for us.

Definitely overpriced. The hotel is in a great location. Valet is good. Staff are very slow to respond to any needs. Gym is good but nothing to wipe down equipment with. Pool closes at 5pm and it’s very small with not a lot of lounge chairs. I would not stay again just because for the price you’re better off at a nicer hotel for what you pay here. I love Gold Coast & there are better options for hotels in the area
I loved it 💯

Overall, great place to stay. Nice area; we felt safe. Conveniently close to red line and grocery store. Bella was extremely communicative throughout our stay. Only con would just be the hair in the shower and the floor was a little crumby in the bedroom. I would stay here again 100%!
Host was very responsive when there was a small problem and had it fixed quickly. Obviously takes care of property. Grocery store less than a block away.
Great place, would stay again!

The house was spotlessly clean and located in a quiet and tranquil neighborhood. There was plenty of parking space on the street. Brad went above and beyond to accommodate us. Great host! I highly recommend.
Perfect place in Chicago!
Having a driveway and being near Aldi and the gas station was incredibly helpful. Freeway access was also very easy and convenient.

We really enjoyed his furnishing, so unique. You must feel comfortable climbing stairs as they wind around. Henry was a great host very sweet and responsive. Will definitely look for his place in the future.
Great host

Stephanie’s place is a great place to stay. I loved the character and large rooms. There’s a fenced in yard for dogs, which is so helpful. There’s a playground across the street if you have kids. It’s a great location, easy to get to downtown, maybe 25 minutes or so. The neighbors are friendly and they have ducks! Stephanie was very responsive and friendly. I’d stay here again.

Amenities were great but the actual unit was small and outdated. There was no view from unit as pictured in the advertisement. The shower took a while to get hot water and there were a couple of broken closet doors that were just leaning up against the wall. Ice machine was broken in the freezer. No clear instructions on where to take the trash out to. The couch was uncomfortable and I highly recommended getting a new one. Location was good and centrally located next to the blue line, but it was more of a commercial and business area.

Carrie's place is an excellent place to stay when visiting Chicago. 6 of us stayed there very comfortably and Carrie was super helpful with local recommendations and made us feel right at home. The apartment is spacious, tasteful and has all the amenities we could have wanted. I highly recommend Carrie's place and would definitely stay again.

Had great time
Enjoyed the stay I give it 5 stars HOWEVER depending on Chicago temperatures we needed a bigger air conditioner 😂 but overall 5 out of 5 #webrought2fans🙌
Very well equipped kitchen. Cute cat. Friendly host. A good place to live for the price. Has got everything needed.
Charles is a great host, and the apartment was very clean and luxurious. 10/10 recommend to stay, and is very close to downtown Chicago and Chinatown. Will definitely be coming back!
Spacious and comfortable home! All was clean and Don was a responsive and great host. We would definitely stay here again.

Don’t even think just book!!
Perfect location, clean, quiet and soooo relaxing. Cute shops and places to eat less than 5 min walk. Nice neighborhood. 10/10 recommend.
it was the first time  visiting Chicago and Olesya place was a great place to stay   we were really happy she was able to accommodate us . definitely a clase to come back .  thank you 🙂
The apartments were clean and spacious! This was a great space for our 10-person trip.

Beautiful area to stay in especially during the summer. The apartment is very clean and has great amenities including a rooftop with a great view. We enjoyed our stay here and found the target next door very convenient. Being in the west loop, you’re nearby a lot of activities. I loved walking every morning in the neighborhood!

Tomasso was a great host! He had everything we could possibly want in the 2 rooms including small fridge in each room with waters, plenty of extra towels etc. He was always available either in person or answering texts asking what he could do to help us. He was a very gracious host.
The Airbnb was exactly what we needed in an excellent location. Everything was communicated well and exactly as described. We will definitely stay there again.

Love that we were at the end of the street. It was quiet even though it was near the train it wasn’t loud at all. Would suggest getting a blender and new box spring in the Queen bedroom the bed was sunken in the middle due to the wood being broke. Other than that would definitely book again.
Great stay!! Had everything i needed

Our stay in Chicago was great thanks to Victoria. Accepting us into her home. It was easy to get to the house and get in and there is no curfew to showing up. Didn’t have any issues at all! We would stay again!
Amazing stay… nothing short of amazing! Host was great and very responsive for all concerns. Appliances, furniture, bedding, and towels were practically new. Very nice property, highly recommended!
Perfect location!! Close to transportation and easy street parking. Vibrant neighborhood and safe soundings. Looking forward to coming back and using David’s deck.

The place is big but very dirty bathrooms with mold, stains, dirty curtains, hairs on the floor. Kitchen utensils were dirty had to go buy my own soap to clean kitchen area, pots are old with stains had to buy my own to cook. Carpet was dirty full of hairs. The entente of the building is dirty not able to hold on to stand since it was pretty nasty. The front door was broken with a rock seconds prior arriving. Loud neighbors

We had an amazing stay at Chris' place! The apartment was stocked with every amenity necessary for a successful stay. If we had any issues Chris was extremely responsive and resolved everything promptly. The area is ideal for going to Wrigley Field and is in such a central location for accessing the city centre. Would highly recommend to anyone coming to stay in Chicago!
We enjoyed our return visit. We look forward to the next time.

Fabulous space, furnishings were amazing, including beautiful artwork. Location was perfect for our trip. The space is very comfortable, room to spread out in the common areas, including an attractive lounge area on the second level.
The only drawback was the misleading listing description of 2.5 bathrooms. There is only one shower, which is accessed through the primary bedroom-and not 100% private. Luckily we ended up a party of two (using both bedrooms), and no need for someone to sleep on one of the beautiful couches (neither are sofa beds). Still required coordination for showering, vacating the bedroom to offer each other privacy.
Our stay was exactly what we needed. Having off-street parking was perfect. Adrienne's home was tidy and comfortable.

This was the perfect location for our visit to University of Chicago. The room was just as described and had everything we needed. Ryan and Elizabeth were very friendly and welcoming. Ryan went above and beyond and created a map of Ferris Bueller’s day after I mentioned it was my daughter’s plan!

Totally enjoyed my stay at Gleatha's place.  It was located less than 5 miles from the event I was in town to attend.  Her place was beautiful inside, clean, and looked JUST like the pictures on the site.  The parking situation was not too bad.  There was free street parking on the streets surrounding the place.  That can be a little off-putting at first but in the end, it worked out fine. Gleatha was super helpful when needed and had everything labeled and described to a tee in her unit.  This place was great for a small family or a small group of people.  The overall experience of staying in Gleatha's airbnb was extremely positive and I would stay again if given the chance.
Simple with a good location. As she states you will hear the train but all in all a good place to stay.

Kymi’s place is lovely - it’s exactly as shown in the photos, and it was SPOTLESS. This is always important to me when using Airbnbs. I stayed with my husband and two teens; everyone enjoyed having their own space.
As others have said, the beds are amazing! The sofa has several recliners, which the boys loved. We did not cook, but there is a good supply of pots, pans, and baking stuff if you need. Lots of plates, bowls, etc.
There is a Walgreens around the corner. I Ubered to the Whole Foods but walked back and was fine / safe. I just had one bag tho-the walk is about a mile; good for steps :-)
We planned to use CTA, but the amount of time it took to get to the city via CTA didn’t work for our purposes, so we ended up Ubering everywhere (it’s a quick ride to most places). Do the math to see what works for you. We did use a local Divvy station to bike into the city one day and that was fun.
Kymi and Phyllis are very responsive and instructions were clear. We would stay again.

Our stay at Reva’s was wonderful.
Her place is fresh, bright, comfortable and spotlessly clean. The neighborhood is beautiful and parking a breeze. I highly recommend Reva’s place. We’ll be back!

I had a great stay at this Airbnb! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. The host was responsive and made check-in super easy. The neighborhood felt safe and was close to everything I needed. I’d definitely stay here again!
Cute house in a great location.

Absolutely loved our stay at this place! Plenty of street parking, the neighborhood felt safe, and being able to walk a block up to hop on the train was so great. The house was very clean, had anything and everything we needed, and they have friendly neighbors too. So many thoughtful touches throughout the home that made it so welcoming! We would definitely stay again if we travel back for Chicago.

We loved Jessica’s place. It was a great location and got the job done… being that we didn’t plan on spending much time actually in the Airbnb. I think that this space is better for 1 couple and maybe kids rather than 2 couples. One bed is a pull out couch that was not very comfortable at all due to it sinking in. So we ended up icing the mattress to the floor and sleeping there.

While our stay came with unexpected challenges, I truly appreciate how the host handled the situation. They responded with honesty, empathy, and a real commitment to making things right. Their professionalism and willingness to listen made a difficult experience much easier to navigate.
Thank you for your care and follow-through it made all the difference.
We felt right at home. We were so grateful that Esmirna accepted our 2 large dogs to join us. She was such a pleasant and friendly person to work with.

We are a family of 12 visiting from NC and this place was very spacious and clean. This place is minutes from Rainbow beach and local restaurants. The brown stone was more than we expected. Cozy beds, great showers, and the kitchen is fully equipped. We had a amazing experience in Shomari place. Upon checking out Shomari came and meet my family. This guy is a down to earth gentleman. We laughed and took pictures before we left and now he's family 😅. I most definitely would come back and stay in this place. Thanks again Shomari!!!! 💯✌🏾
Great stay
This was my second time staying at Gerrit’s. It was a delight to return. A wonderful apartment in a sweet neighborhood, with lots of nearby amenities.
Nice place to stay! The hosts responded to all questions promptly.
Amazing location, very helpful staff. I thought the room was going to be bigger, but all of the furniture was amazing.
Awesome place
Amazing place, amazing views! We really loved the access to transit in the grocery store next-door. The amenities were amazing and so was every person we encountered!

We had a great weekend in Chicago at John's apartment. The location is great--close to all of the things to do in Logan Square and also a short walk to the train and near good bike routes for getting out of the neighborhood. We enjoyed drinking our morning coffee in the lovely back garden and definitely appreciated the AC in the apartment on a super hot weekend!
un lugar agradable

Good location however place was dirty and I would not recommend. Also, keep in mind, it is on the third floor with no elevator. Master bedroom had clothes in the drawer with no access to the closet in the room. Had to live out of my suitcase. Another room had blood on the wall. The kitchen I had to make sure I washed the dish before use. Stains and cigarettes burns in furniture. This place needs a cleaning service. The stove needs replaced. The overhead kitchen light did not work. The ironing board was dirty. No wash cloths provided. This place was good for taking naps, changing clothes and leaving for your activities nothing more. No access to the washer & dryer. The front door and the main door to the building doesn’t latch on its own. Beware people!!
We felt at home and that we could ask for assistance if needed so we felt extra safe and everything was so hassle free! Very generous hosts!
Exactly as described and immediate responses to support during the stay. Excellent hosts! Thank you for the wonderful time in the West Loop!
My only complaints were checking in the host was unresponsive
I will be coming back
The home was very nice and spacious.  Dave was very accommodating for a minute change. Close to everything in from Chicago very good location.  Thank you Dave you will be recommended.

Stephanie's place was as described. The picture are accurate and the amenities a matched the listing. I was looking for a place that was centrally located to we could get to all the main tourist attractions, plus easy enough to visit with my friends north of the city. This place fit the bill perfectly.
Additionally, I took advantage of the swimming pool, hot tub, and sauna on multiple days. This place was a great value and quite comfortable. I would definitely visit again.

Great location in the center of everything, location felt safe, no loud noises, always was able to find parking right in front of building, which is a plus, because Chicago parking can be a headache. Pictures looked just like the home, very spacious, it was 3 ladies and 4 teenagers, with 2 one year olds and everyone had just enough room to move around, babies ran through unit freely with no complaints, the big dining room table was a plus we were all  able to sit at the dining room table eat and talk. Overall I enjoyed my stay and would definitely rent Charles, place again!!

The listing looked much better in pictures than in person, which was already disappointing but things went downhill from the start. Upon arrival, we were unexpectedly yelled at by the building security, which set a negative tone for the stay.
One of the biggest issues was the elevator being broken for our entire stay (Thursday to Sunday). We had someone in our group with mobility issues, and this made it nearly impossible for them to enjoy the trip comfortably. When I reported the broken elevator to the host, I felt completely gaslighted I was told it was “actually working,” despite clearly being there and seeing otherwise. It was frustrating and dismissive, especially when the situation directly impacted someone’s well-being.
The location itself was decent, but the experience overall left a lot to be desired. I honestly think a partial refund would be appropriate, considering the inconvenience and lack of accessibility. Unfortunately, I won’t be booking this place again.
We are happy with our stay and will be back.

The house has a distinct peaceful vibe. The location was fantastic and beautifully located 1 minute from a small beach. Easily accessible to the metro. Tammy was very responsive and welcoming host. She made us feel very comfortable and provided an enjoyable stay. The room cozy and adjacent to a wonderful modern kitchen. I definitely recommend it!

The hosts were very responsive and flexible. Our other Airbnb reservation wasn’t what we expected so at the last minute we booked with these ladies and it was totally worth it! I recommend this Airbnb to anyone. I felt right at home with all of the accommodations Jennifer and Clara made for us. They set the bar for what hosting is supposed to look like.

The place was pretty dirty when I got there. After a few days the cleaning lady came and tidied up the place which was nice.
I found it very strange that all of the lights in the shared spaces were super glued to be in the ON position. Something to know before booking.
There were also a lot of ants, like a lot a lot. If you kept food in the cupboards then you’ll likely have ants all in your stuff. Multiple times when I was making food i noticed dead ants in it.
And the neighborhood is okay but from some of the things I experienced not the safest place to be tbh.
Andy was a super nice host and I don’t hold any of this against him but from my experience there if you’re in a tight spot, the price makes sense. But overall it was one of my least favorite stays on Airbnb.
Great place when i travel again I will come here

overall we had an okay experience, host was willing to
accommodate us. please note that the area is not the safest, we didn’t have any issues but we were warned multiple times by uber drivers. also, not enough amenities ( towels, rags ), found ants, sheets felt unwashed, & trash was left behind.😭
We enjoyed our stay at Steve’s place. Great host and comfortable stay!!
Richard and his staff were very helpful. Every thing was nice .

We stayed at Denisha's place over the 4th of July. At this location, we felt like we got to experience real Chicago life. The neighbors were friendly. We walked to a local Chinese restaurant our first night there. Our favorite place to stop was a local gas station for drinks.
The house was easy to check in & out. It had all the amenities that were described in the listing. The kitchen was nice. I liked having two bathrooms with our big group of 9. The washer and dryer were nice to have as well.
The place was pretty worn though. There were stains on the living room carpet, a hole in the wall from a chair. The tub did not have a plug and the vanities were all chipped. The towels were faded, with bleach stains. There were no oven mitts in the kitchen and the utensils provided were cheap.
The bed in one room was missing bolts and collapsed when someone sat on it. When we lifted the mattress to assess, we found empty alcohol bottles, a flipflop, an inhaler, mouth wash, & a retainer case

My family and I truly enjoyed our stay. We felt very comfortable and were close to relatives. The neighborhood was cute and peaceful. The next door neighbor even ran over to give my mom his arm and help her up the stairs as she had a foot injury and was having difficulty walking. Danny was very nice and helpful. He was an excellent host. We will definitely stay again if the home is available next time we come to Chicago to visit family. Thanks for a wonderful visit Danny!
Home was very nice, was skeptical of the area but pleasantly surprised by the home. Would book again.
Great hosts and a safe neighbourhood. Host accommodated my last minute request and even picked me up at the CTA.

My husband and I had a great visit to Logan Square and the Chicago area while staying at this location for a second year in a row. The home is clean and comfortable, exactly as described and pictured in the listing. We really appreciate the historic neighborhood's beautiful architecture, and that the community is very active, both in the immediate neighboring streets and on the surrounding walkable blocks full of bars and restaurants.

I loved staying at eloms place he was very friendly and responsive if I needed anything the place was very clean and it was safe parking my car on the street he also had streaming apps available on the tv which was very nice and cool for the days I spent relaxing i felt relaxed and at home I will be staying again my next trip to Chicago
Great location, easy street parking, comfortable.
Amazing stay! 10/10
Clara is every friendly host, she always respond my requirements in time. The location of her property  is very convenient for students of Uchicago, I’d like to stay there next time to visit my son

Very clean and well appointed, smaller space (namely the bedroom size, but the living area and kitchen are more than enough for two adults). The brand new washer and dryer were amazing. We had an issue with the internet and Lauren literally purchased new equipment at Best Buy in order to solve the problem (all in under an hour).

This was the perfect place for a quick visit with family nearby! The apartment is very clean and tidy, no clutter, and it has all the amenities you need for simple cooking, a good shower/tub, and a full size bed. The garden out back is lovely - lots of pollinators enjoying the flowers! Best of all, Kasey and Charlie were super helpful.

Great place!
Place was bigger than I thought🙌🏿

House has everything but actually food lol
