Tenna was a gracious host! She was timely with responses. Check-in and check-out was smooth. Outstanding location. Amenities and lodging were comfortable. We enjoyed our stay and would stay again!

My husband and I enjoyed Rosemary’s beautiful place! There was a separate entrance, peaceful seating on the deck, and a beautiful garden to admire. The private parking spot was very helpful. I would definitely stay again!

The house itself was fine and as advertised. House is well maintained and kept mostly clean. Neighborhood on the other hand is not safe. It's in Austin look up the statistics in that neighborhood it's not the best in Chicago regarding crime. This is no fault of the owner though just simply the location. I left early as I was street parking and someone side swiped my car in a hit and run. Again not the owners fault, just be aware of the neighborhood if choosing this location. Overall my stay was fine in the house itself. The host was always responsive and I had no issues getting the door code to get into my stay for the duration I was there.

This is a beautifully updated unit on a quiet street and the kids loved the playground on the next corner! The layout and beds worked perfectly for my family. We anticipated some sound transfer from the unit above but the timing impacted our stay more than expected. The unit is well stocked, very clean and nicely decorated and the area feels very safe.
Great place to stay everything was amazing clean and professional
It is ok, however the room is too noisy and small, lot of light enters through the window, which makes it difficult to rest well; the bed sounds too much and is quite uncomfortable.

The host was very responsive to my questions and concerns. The area is walkable, with many stores, restaurants, and other amenities within a 15-minute walk. However, the "garden area," table, and chairs on the balcony were not cleaned and were unusable.
Buen lugar, muy amables.

If I could give more stars than the max, I absolutely would. I can’t express how much Patt has helped me. My original Airbnb had double-booked me and Patt had a room ready that very day and saved me.
She has been nothing but incredibly kind and responsive throughout my stay. I even lost the house keys during my first week, and she was so understanding and gracious through the whole ordeal.
The room itself was awesome. It had everything I needed: a private bathroom, a walk-in closet, and honestly it was just the right amount of space. The laundry machines were super modern and high-end.
The house is in a super convenient location, and the housemates I lived with were all super lovely. I absolutely enjoyed watching the fireflies at sunset here.
I honestly cannot overstate how grateful I was to live here. What was a super stressful situation turned into an extremely warm and memorable experience.

Very responsive hosts, beautiful home
Very accommodating. I definitely will be back
Wonderful spot. Great neighborhood. Very responsive host. We really appreciated the snacks and stay. Thanks so much!

The apartment was nicely laid out and comfortable. The beds were lovely after a long day on the town. Two bathrooms were incredible. The location wasn’t close to where we wanted to be for the sites, but still accessible by train or Lyft. We learned the area much better after being there.  Recommend this space for two couples, but maybe not a larger group. We had a few issues, but the owner was very responsive and kind. That was greatly appreciated.
Nice place for the money.  Good to use as a hub.
Helpful when we needed anything. Clean house. Short walk to must things.
I came for my batch party and we had a blast! AC was jumping, beautiful back porch and fun neighbors! I would definitely stay here again!
Great place!
Really good place to spend the weekend!
Nice house. Great neighborhood. Close to restaurants, coffee shops. Plenty of free stret parking.

The place was nice and its location super convenient if you are flying to/from O´Hare (2 blocks from Blue Line Division station). The spaces are clean, my room was cozy and quiet. Great place to stay in Chicago.

This listing is fairly accurate. There is no door. You're close to the apartment entrance and there may be another roommate and the host there at the same time, so your mileage may vary with how quiet and private it feels. You'll clearly hear the foot traffic outside, as well as the nearby brown line. There's a functioning air conditioner to keep you cool. Internet was spotty at times, and as a remote worker I wouldn't recommend this as an ideal choice for that reason alone. Carpet had some stains. It's located in a great neighborhood with plenty to do. The host is extremely friendly and responsive. But she is often gone too, so if there are maintenance issues or other concerns there's a good chance you'll have to do some legwork to get it resolved.
Everything about the property is really good and we thoroughly enjoyed the stay.

When my family and I arrived late to the apartment, we were surprised to find it was a third-floor walkup, something that was not disclosed in the listing. With three kids and lots of luggage, getting everything upstairs was extremely challenging.  Unfortunately, the apartment was also not properly cleaned before our arrival. It looked like there had been a party prior to our stay, and the cleaning was clearly rushed or incomplete. The dishwasher was full of dirty dishes, leaving us with very few clean utensils or plates. The master bedroom sheets and blanket were so dirty that we couldn’t sleep in them, and we found dirt and debris under the couch cushions and kitchen cabinets. Lastly,  all of the mattresses were extremely hard and uncomfortable, making it feel like we were sleeping on plywood. While this might be an issue with the cleaning service rather than the owner, our overall experience was very disappointing. Based on our stay, I would not recommend this apartment.
We had a wonderful stay with 3 generations under one roof. Awesome location, pretty building and nicely remodeled unit.

Fed was very accommodating and helpful. I had no issues with coming and going, the place was clean all the time and the neighborhood was peaceful. Great place to stay if you need a place for a bit. It has a garage too if you have a car so you don't have to park on the street. Also a washer and dryer right outside your door for laundry which is great 👍.
Awesome place, stayed for a month while my fiance was doing clinical rotations nearby. Building shared spaces are great to work from for remote. Kerem is great as a host very attentive.
Great host, exactly as described. Thank you!!

Extremely surprised by the reviews. My friend and I were certainly not expecting anything more than basic, but we were so uncomfortable with the state of things, we booked a hotel for our second night in Chicago after not sleeping at all the first night in this place. Things were not necessarily "dirty" (the apartment smelled so strongly of cleaner my friend was struggling) but the entire place was in need of updating. Paint was peeling off many surfaces, there were stains on the walls and in the shower, one of the windows was broken, a couple flies buzzing around, dead bugs on the window sills, etc. There was just a level of grime we weren't expecting. Airbnbs are not what they used to be.

We stayed here for 3 nights while moving our daughter to her new place. This place was very comfortable and convenient. Todd and Susan were super accommodating and responsive. Would definitely stay here again!

We had a great time. This place is an 8 minute walk from the train and 5 minutes to the bus stop that takes you to downtown. The neighborhood is very charming. We were very happy that this place had a pack n play and a high chair for our 14 month old.
Very nice!
David was super friendly and made me feel right at home!

Had a great stay at this place near Wrigley Field! Super convenient location, just a short walk to the stadium, which made getting to and from the Cubs games really easy. The house was clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed for a relaxing trip. Definitely a solid spot for any baseball fan or anyone wanting to enjoy the Wrigleyville area.
Great experience
Huge home for being the in heart of Chicago. Beds were very comfortable. Having a garage is nice. Host was very responsive
Great location. Quite neighborhood. Conveniently located. The only drawback is the single bathroom. I would recommend this place.
Great Location
I was very pleased with the value.  The apartment is quite clean.  Josh is a great host.
Very nice stay close to the riverwalk
Trayce was a delight as a host, and my stay was comfortable and lovely. I would love to come back!

This is one of the best Airbnb’s I’ve stayed in and I’ve stayed in my fair share. The host Bianca and the property manager Brock are fantastic communicators and exceptionally accommodating. The building feels historical without sacrificing any modern amenities. Floor to ceiling charm. And the location is fantastic as well. Short walk to two main cta lines and a handful of bus stops without being oversaturated with traffic. The next time I find myself in the city it will absolutely be the first place I check.

Great location, right across from a grocery store and walkable to many restaurants. Easily walkable to bus stops and Divvy bikes, and the brown line is not too far. The A/C unit in the bedroom is quite loud but very effective, I visited during a heat wave so it was much appreciated. Host is very responsive.
Unit was listed as having an in building washer/dryer but I had to walk about a block to a laundromat to do laundry. Floors could do with a little cleaning as well. Overall a great stay if you are with a small party (I stayed solo) and don't need parking.

My partner and I booked this room for a concert, and we could have asked for a better place to stay. The area is very nice and safe, and public transport is easily accessible. The host was easy to communicate with and provided great recommendations and advice. Would book again!
It was good, nice area.
La Vecindad and team were very responsive and friendly. Instructions given for check-in/out were clear. Would recommend!
Great stay
This was one of my favorite spaces I’ve stayed at while being in Chicago really felt at home. The Decor was Nice and the Distance to the Train Stations and Buses was perfect

Andy and Agustin are genuinely great hosts. They are very responsive to requests and are also really accommodating of requests. The rooms are nice and pretty bare so you can bring your stuff in no problem. The neighborhood is generally safe. There are a few sketchy areas if you walk/drive a few blocks away but I never felt unsafe while shopping, eating, or walking around the neighborhood. You are really close to a ton of parks and the lake front for biking, walking, and other outdoorsy stuff. Overall a pretty great experience.
Our 2nd time staying with Holly and Mark. Ita always a pleasure.
Great place to stay if you’re looking for somewhere in close proximity to things to do in Chicago! Nathan was a great and attentive host.
Very nice place,very clean,very comfy I highly recommend it

I had such a warm and memorable stay. The house was cozy, full of charm, and the host was truly kind and helpful.
Thanks to this place, I’ll always remember my time in Chicago with a smile. Thank you!
Really loved this place!  Great area of the city.  Clean and as described.  I would certainly stay there again.
Very convenient to Wrigley's field. Comfortable, peaceful, and safe location.

Had a good time in Maciej’s place! It’s about a 15mt walk from the California CTA station and close to all the cool stuff of Logan Square. The street is residential, so nice and quiet at night. The coach house is behind the main house, and it’s really spacious and clean. Chicago can get hot during the Summer, but luckily there was a window-unit AC to cool the place down. All in all a nice base for a couple to explore Logan Square from!
Kate’s beautiful studio had everything we needed in a tastefully designed space. The location was ideal to visit our daughter and her family nearby in Edgewater. We’ll definitely be back.
beautiful property,  the panini s were awesome.
Simply good location for parking,  plenty of space on the street at anytime,  hosts are very responsive and friendly

We enjoyed our stay and liked being close to a L line station to for easy transportation downtown. Having a parking space for our rental car was also convenient! The accommodation was clean and just as described.
The only problems I really had were a few stains on my walls and I felt like the refrigerator was a bit warm. Everything else was good.
Perfect place us to stay for a CUBS game with six tween/teen grandkids. Highly recommend!

A charming place in a great location. This space has everything you need for a fun filled visit to Chicago. Orsos is right next door...old school Italian with a garden is spectacular. A short walk to many attractions and great food. We will be back.
Great stay. Spacious place.

Bright and beautiful home - and as central as it gets! Great amenities.
Only downside is that it was the most time-consuming check-in process ever and I've stayed at 150+ Airbnbs over a decade.
Wonderful for a night stay! Easy to find and lots of things to do around the area! Would definitely recommend and plan on coming back , thank you!

I’m originally from Chicago and come back to visit my parents and adult children. Neighborhood is very important to me. The location and the apartment exceeded our expectations! The apartment is the perfect size, comfortable and nicely decorated. It has everything you need to for daily living. We prepared our coffee and breakfast before heading out, and sat on the back porch to enjoy the morning breeze. The bathroom is HUGE which was helpful for my daughter and I to get ready at the same time. Having the washer and dryer was perfect for us to take clean clothes back home. I hope to rent this place again when I come back to visit as I often do! Thank you Anna for sharing your beautiful home with us. We felt very nostalgic and at home in our sweet home Chicago!
As expected, good neighborhood and quiet home.

Had some issues locating the room at first tried calling the number in the description and no answer despite it being 10 am. The locks were a bit concerning as the bottom lock didn’t seem to lock right so we had to depend purely on the top lock. Other than that the place is located in a nice area very walkable and accessible to train routes.
Great location, clean, very comfortable and good sized space… what else could you ask for? We would love to stay again!

What an awesome place!  We loved everything about this place, especially the rooftop.  Kitchen was perfect for making a big meal.  It was so close to Wrigley, made getting out of the crowds a breeze.  We will definitely be back- can't beat it!!
Excellent stay for the value of you like a garden unit. Street was under construction, but everything was so walkable. Boat got a late request and got people over to set us up immediately. 5 stars.
We wanted to explore Chicago and this was perfect for us. It is a beautiful, quiet neighborhood with beach access, yet easy to get to the city.  We loved this space and our time here.

This location was a great stay. Easy access and the off street parking was a huge plus. We felt very safe and secure and had walkable access to great food and short drives to major attractions. Highly recommend this stay.

We visited Friday-Wednesday July 2025. It was my husband, his parents, and our 8 month old. The house was located in a great neighbourhood, super walkable. It’s decorated beautifully but still very comfortable and homey. It is way bigger than what looks like in pictures. We stayed in the primary on the third floor while my in-laws stayed on the ground floor allowing for privacy for all. Alice was extremely helpful and friendly and went out of her way to ensure we had high chair, pack n play, and other supplies for the baby. Cannot recommend enough for families looking for a nice stay in Chicago.

The room was spotless and very comfortable, just like the photos. The location is perfect, close to everything you need. The host was very attentive and responded quickly to any questions. I’d definitely stay here again.

Host was quick to respond and reached out throughout the trip. They were not on-site when I reached out, but did have the security team help when we asked about the missing remote.
A few issues we discovered during stay below. The stay was still fine, but we felt it needed some maintenance.
Bathroom mirror shelf only secured in the front, stuff would fall if placed on top drawer.
Toilet seat lid broken and seat was loose.
Toaster has a bent filament (burned food and could easily create fire if not noticed)
Bathroom door drags on floor and rubs against door casing, making it hard to close.
Elevator stopped working for one day of trip, and one of two stopped working for about half the stay.
No notice give about Fire alarm test. They went off two separate days early in the morning.
Broken coffee table. They offered to replace it, but we asked that they do it after.

We loved this place! It was great to have so much space in the city for our pups, plus there was a great dog park just a 15 min walk away. The grill was great and we are so glad we had the fenced in backyard too! We’d stay here again in a heartbeat. SUPER easy to get on the interstate to go west, while still able to walk to so many incredible restaurants!
Great stay! Would definitely recommend!
Perfect place for a medical school rotation

Lilian's place is impeccably clean, organized, and comfortable - it's exactly as pictured.  It's in a nice area - very convenient to lovely restaurants in Evanston.  There's a nice grocery store across the street.  Parking is a breeze - next to the building.  Check in was very easy - Lilian is a clear, proactive communicator.   When a minor glitch happened with the wifi connection to the TV, it was fixed immediately/remotely when Lilian rebooted the wifi system.  In the "heat dome" this summer, the air conditioning was very welcoming after a hot day exploring Chicago.  The back bedroom is very quiet - away from traffic sounds.  The kitchen is well equipped; it would be very easy to make dinner with lots of seating around the gorgeous island.  Would highly recommend, and would stay again.  Thanks Lilian!
Donna was great. No AC so it was hot when the heat wave rolled through

Geo was a wonderful host! So accommodating and helpful — went above and beyond. He was also very communicative and responded quickly to any questions. We appreciate such a nice, easy stay with kind hosts.
Nice place. Convenient parking and location.  Better rates than many places near by

Staying here is a privilege. We felt at home from the minute we arrived, and we knew that if we had needs, our hosts would be always ready to help. There was a wonderful balance of privacy and friendliness, which we greatly appreciated!
All was ok

Space was ideal for the 3 of us, especially 3 bedrooms although  one didnt really have much natural right from small internal window. Good kitchen and bathroom facilities. Immediate neighbourhood very quiet which was ideal but then main strip was lively within a 5-10 with a variety of bars and restaurants.  Station 8 mins walk away,  3 stops into Chicago,  50 mins to the airport. Areas for improvement would be larger TV, new bath suite,  colander , pedal bin with working lid but nothing major. competitive price, homely flat and good location,  would recommend.
Great place at a great price!

The Kasa in River North was such a great spot. Really nice amenities and the apartment itself was very clean and spacious. The couch could have been more comfortable but other than that it was very cozy. Would definitely recommend.

Karen was very responsive and incredibly helpful! The house was pristine and smelled so lovely. The beds were comfy and she even left us some treats! Definitely will be booking again in the future! Thank you for everything Karen! 🩷
This space is comfortable in its simplicity. It is calm and spare and easy to be in! The bed is really comfortable

i really enjoyed my stay here. i was both comfortable and felt safe the entire time. genova has everything thought out for your stay to be comfortable while reciprocating the care needed while staying in someone's home. following the instructions will help ensure your stay goes smoothly along with anyone else staying there. it's a community vibe so everyone has to contribue to each other's stay, experience there. unit, room, linens, bathroom were all clean. no problems. 100% accurately described. if you can read instructions, check-in will be simple. genova was always responsive to my messages. location is near bus stops that will take you east into chinatown and red line, definitely walkable to ride pink line into downtown loop. i plan to book again for future stays.

perfect stay, comfortable bed and really simply a pretty and easy peasy visit! inn keeper was kind and helpful and the location is perfect! thank you :)
and oh! the room was a lot larger than we expected!
Great place and location — highly recommend if looking for a nice place in West Town
Was visiting Chicago so I decided to stay here, me and my guests loved the place so much! Very quiet area, almost everything is about a 20 min drive.

We stayed in this apartment for 2 months and had a fantastic experience. The place was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and fully equipped for a longer stay. The area felt very safe, which was important to us. The host was incredibly helpful and always responsive whenever we had a question. Communication was smooth and consistent throughout our stay. We truly felt at home here and would absolutely recommend this apartment to anyone looking for a stress-free and enjoyable stay. Thank you for everything!

This place is truly perfect. The hosts have gone above and beyond to provide guests with an elevated experience. The unit is elegant, clean and extremely well maintained. The kitchen is stocked with every appliance and utensil you could want. The beds are so comfortable that we want to purchase one for our home! The views are stunning at any time of day, the pool and bbq lounge are are a fantastic, fun bonus and the front desk staff are so helpful and kind that they quickly became friends during our stay.
Both hosts were so responsive, generous and helpful. The neighborhood is safe, beautiful and steps away from shopping, amazing restaurants, the River Walk and tunnel to the beach. The unit even supplies beach towel and a picnic basket on hand for a park or beach adventure.
Highly recommend staying here if you are lucky enough to find open dates. We are planning anothe trip back next year, mostly because of how much we love this unit!! Thank you for a gorgeous, memorable stay!
I would probably stay here again, but I found it to be mildly stressful 😢

This place was as described and all that we needed for our stay. Short walk to the train and had a few great bars and restaurants within walking distance. The host was incredibly responsive and provided great instructions for checkin! The place was clean and comfortable. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend a stay here!

Easy street parking and also close driving distance to Logan Square and Montrose beach. Good central location on the north side.
Adela was very attentive and accommodating. Plenty of towels and extra sheets. She made sure I was very comfortable! Great host.

Chris is a great host and super cool dude. We will look to stay here again in our next visit to Chicago. The location is close to the lake and great restaurants.

I stayed at Joey’s for 11 nights and it was the best Airbnb experience ever!
Joey offers entire home to his guests. Kitchen is well equipped and outdoor sitting area was very nice. Room that I stayed had very comfortable bed. Desk, closet and refrigerator were very handy.

Most importantly, the vibe and energy of this home is really nice. Host is extremely friendly and hospitable. Other guests are also kind and considerate.
I will definitely go back to Joey’s!

Guilaine was a great host who communicated with us promptly and proactively. Her place was amazing. It was more than enough space for our family of 5, clean and in a beautiful quiet neighborhood. We would absolutely stay here again when visiting The Chi.

Beautiful apartment and lovely neighborhood, very walkable!

Hanna is an excellent host and I would definitely book again. She is very friendly, down to earth and an excellent resource on things to do in the city!
very nice and accommodating
Clean and convenient! Front desk staff were friendly. Felt very safe. The pool was nice and everyone was having a great time out there. Would stay here again.

A wonderful place to stay while we were house-hunting in Chicago! Alexander was very helpful, from sending a picture of the yard when I asked for my dog to recommending a shop for my dad’s car and responded super quickly to questions. Definitely recommend as a home base to anyone house-hunting or just visiting.
Loved our stay here! Lots of space, chill neighborhood, and great restaurants nearby!
Patricia was great, answered all our questions promptly. The listing was great as well, amazing location and had all the amenities we needed.

it was a lovely stay the room wasnt huge which was what we preferred the kitchen had everything we needed. the beach is right next door which was super nice. and Christina was super nice and understanding and helpful with all things. we would love to stay again in the future
Casey was a warm, friendly, and very responsive host and the place was lovely. We had a wonderful stay - would recommend!
The overall stay was very comfortable and central to things we wanted to do in Chicago.
Five stars. This location is awesome!

In a prime location nearby to downtown. Really appreciated the check ins, making sure I entered and during my stay and after I checked out. Really enjoyed this Airbnb, would stay again!
great cozy place.

Absolutely worth the money. enjoyed having more room than a traditional hotel stay, and the ability to cook and eat together like we would at home was really nice.
Enjoyed the ability to have a day-in and watch some TV after a long day of walking/and going to a huge concert at Wrigley Field.
Doris checked in on us, and was very responsive when I reached out with any questions or concerns. The beds were very comfortable, and the temperature was heavenly. Would absolutely love to stay here again whenever I make it back to Chicago.

For the neighborhood, the price was ok, but the value of having a public parking lot closeby in such a bustling  neighborhood has a huge value. Host was super responsive and the place was really clean.  I like a more full kitchen (with stove) but it wasn't really needed because everything is so close. My husband and I are not small people and the bed accommodated us fine. Huge TV and cute little balcony to enjoy coffee. I would recommend this to a friend or relative (mind the stairs).

We enjoyed our stay. Host was great, lived nearby and answeres our request immediately.
Apartment is nice and clean, there were towels , toilet paper and bathing staff, but we used our own. Kitchen had silver, plates and mugs, but not everything was for 4, some was for 2. There is pan, pot and kettle, cups coffee machine and microwave, fridge. Stove and oven work perfect. There were even salt and spices.
Bedsheets were provided for 2.
Washer and dryer work great too.
All apartment is fresh and clean, everything smelled good. It is very important for me as me and mi kid have allergies.
Very clean, comfortable, felt safe. She had everything we needed and more. Thank you!
Amazing for a getaway for you and your significant other.

We stayed here in June of 2025 on the weekend of Chicago Pride. We booked VERY last minute (10pm on the night we checked in) and were surprised to find a place that was competitively priced, considering the busy weekend and the face that we were so late booking. The apartment was adorable and nicely updated. For our group, who do not live the “big city life,” it gave a nice little taste of living in the city (loved being in the basement apartment with shared gates and entryways) but in a quiet, peaceful neighborhood. Parking could be difficult to find, but not impossible and we were able to find a spot pretty easily, even heading into a busy weekend. The neighborhood is very clean and quiet and the apartment is too. Good AC and nicely decorated. Overall we were very pleased with this place and will stay again on our next Chicago trip if we can. The host is very responsive to messages and goes out of her way to make sure your stay is comfortable. Loved our stay here!
Pretty good neighborhood with good parking. The place is pretty good for the price.
It was fine! Although the area is not the best, it wasn’t bad at all. It was quiet while we were there, but parking is hard to find. The inside of the apartment was nice & clean.

Darryl’s place is in a beautiful neighborhood with very clean well-designed interiors! We absolutely loved our stay, super worth the price as well! We had a car and to be honest street parking wasn’t that hard to find. We were here for a weekend and Darryl was very responsive to my questions and concerns. The AC was a bit loud but it was a really nice space! We had five people and the apartment was exactly packed with linens! Enjoyed reading the Hamilton book as well ;) We will definitely come back for the beautiful Chicago summer!

However, there is a bus stop very close that one can take to get for example to the shops on Lake Park Ave.
Nice place, good location, great for a quick stay.

Everything we needed in a great location right around the corner from Wrigley Field. Peter was very responsive for check in and parking was feet away from the door. The apartment was clean, had great space, and the AC worked good. Would recommend Peter’s or stay again.

Ayla was extremely communicative and helpful in addition to being open to any and all feedback. She was truly a great host!
I had a fantastic stay and would absolutely come back again in the future.

Kelsey’s spot was perfect for our girls reunion! She provided super clear instructions, and the location was perfect! Had a wonderful stay!

You can literally feel the energy from the stadium—it’s surreal. Parking is a bonus, and the location couldn’t be more walkable. You’re right by the CTA Addison Red Line, plus tons of bars, restaurants, and Wrigleyville nightlife. Whether you're in town for a game, a weekend getaway, or just want to soak up the Wrigleyville experience, this place knocks it out of the park.

Ryan is a great host, super responsive. Place is great, clean, great location, no issues at all during our stay.

Very nice place - felt like a home. Plenty of space for our group and felt safe! Lillian responded to our messages immediately. Loved that we could book 2 nights when most places around would not do less than 3.

I can't say enough wonderful things about my experience and I appreciate my host hospitality! Would recommend to everyone! Oh and I got to teach my 6yr old grandson Connect 4 thanks to the assortment of nostalgic games she had available in the living area! Thank you Ava Marie
Edward was very welcoming and helpful. The place met our needs for the weekend. He was more responsive to calling rather than a message.

We loved the apartment - was spacious and nicely decorated:) Very

6 stars if I could! Amazing Airbnb! She gave me the wrong code and didn’t respond when I tried to check in. Couldn’t reach her and neither could Airbnb support. After about an hour, Airbnb canceled it for me and gave me a refund. Don’t book with this lady.
Obinna was a great host! He responded quickly and was understanding when there was a problem with key! The place was very cozy!!

Amazing location and a great stay overall! This was my first time in the neighborhood and I absolutely fell in love. You’re right next to the vibrant Fulton Market district, with many of Chicago’s must-see spots within a 1–2 mile walk.
The unit was comfortable and had almost everything you’d need for a short stay. There’s a grocery store a short hop away—though I initially took the scenic route and missed the stairs up to it (not a big deal, just something to be aware of).
The smart lock uses the August app, which took a minute to get fully set up. There was a brief hiccup, but Dina was super responsive and helped get it sorted quickly.
One small note: the provided shampoo/conditioner/body wash wasn’t quite my style—totally fine, but if you’re particular about your products, you might want to bring your own.
Would definitely stay again—such a great jumping-off point for exploring the city!
Was a nice stay, clean and very nice place.

Good location
Easy to get $20 Uber into the city.
Good local coffee shops within 2 mins.
Great apartment for groups.
Enjoyed our stay.
Shomari was a great host always responsive and helped us out whenever we needed something. Great host!
Nice place in a great location. Assel was great too.

Two of us stayed 3 days. Right from the door we were pleasantly surprised. It smelled so nice, clean and fresh. Everything was spotless, didn’t stay in an Airbnb that was this clean. Neighborhood was nice, walkable. Loved 3 minutes walk to the cite coffee shop. Didn’t hear any noise from outside while in bedrooms. Our host was very responsive. One more positive thing, all tvs are smart, I didn’t expect that since listing mentioned hdmi. All together, much better than what we were expecting!

To be completely honest - check out was very difficult - the elevators weren’t working - the floors were very gross - the microwave was broken- the extra fees that were associated with late checkout and parking were a bit much - the people working at the desk were of no help at all. The overall interiors of the place wasn’t nearly as luxurious as the pictures show. I will say the stay was not horrible by any means but for the price it wasn’t accurate and too much in my opinion.
Great location, plenty of rooms and amenities.
The home is in a great location. There are lots of good restaurants nearby and parking on the street wasn't bad. The home was clean and perfect for our group.

Brian was an amazing host! We felt right at home! He was extremely prompt with his responses and responded efficiently to our needs. Hands down, my best air bnb experience! 10 out of 10, highly recommend! Thanks Bryan!
Great stay! A little pricey for what it is. But loved it for what we needed
Timothy was a friendly and amenable host, very concerned about our stay. The building staff was professional and friendly and you can’t beat the location
What a win! Really great place for connecting with friends
I stayed for 3 weeks. Can't begin to explain how wonderful  my experience was. Greatest stay ever. Will definitely be back

Yaharra was a great guest, we really enjoyed time!
Thank you!
We had an excellent stay. It wasn’t too far from the city. The space itself was great. Spacious, stylish, and comfortable. Would recommend again.

Great stay we had at Garrett’s place! They were EXTREMELY accommodating for our family! So appreciative for that, even when we booked to extend our Chicago stay at the last minute. Home smelled and was extremely clean. I’m hard to please and they exceeded our expectations! Recently redone and every detail was thought of. It’s an older charming home but looks new inside! Excellent condition! Even the basement. Wow.
Loved the two car garage! They were so generous with their amenities, shampoo, conditioner, TP, garbage bags, paper towels ect! They even left some welcome goodies! Thank you!!!
Great location and property - great for a city vacation, also has nice outdoor hang out areas for warmer months. Hostess was very responsive. Highly recommend!
Beautiful place, quiet neighborhood. I would recommend this  place to anyone who are visiting Chicago. Amazing host! Thank you

Responsive and helpful host! Everything was orderly, clean, convenient. Easy walk to the Red line, close to Chinatown and the excellent food and market. Not far from Soldier Field (one stop and a 20 min walk). This was my first AirBnB experience, and Jake was helpful in coaching me through everything.
The bed was extra firm. There was a washer/dryer in the apartment, so you can pack lighter. There was already shampoo/conditioner/body wash in the bathroom, so you don't need to pack those. TV was good, wifi was flawless. Helpful little tags throughout the apartment. Easy checkout procedure.

Beautiful home and very spacious, plenty of beds for everyone. Derek was super friendly and flexible with our stay. The downstairs basement/ hangout room was a great spot to all hangout together and have a good time.
The home was cozy and comfortable. It looks just like the pictures. A great stay for a Chicago weekend getaway. And nice and quiet in the evenings.
The oven did not work had to get maintenance to fix it , bathroom toilet was loose, cabinets were dusty, front door was difficult to open , upstairs neighbors kinda noisy at night.
This was a great place to stay for our first trip to Chicago! It was a nice change of pace compared to where we live and it was a great home away from home!

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at Logan Square SRO! The hotel is in a prime location, with close proximity to public transportation, restaurants and bars, and shops. The smart locks on the building provided me with a sense of security, and the staff were friendly and helpful. My room overlooked a busy intersection so it could be a little noisy at times, but nothing too bothersome. The shared bathrooms were kept clean and stocked with TP and complimentary toiletries if you needed them. The common areas were also tidy and kept clean. The best perk IMO was the free wash & dry in the basement laundry room! Thank you so much for accommodating me!

We had a great stay in Adam's Chicago AirBnb. I booked it to stay with a group of friends in town for a wedding. We loved having multiple hang out spaces and enough bathrooms for everyone to get ready at the same time. The AirBnb was spotless and the location was fantastic (one block away from the train to O'Hare and into the Loop, and in a very fun neighborhood). Adam provided clear instructions for check in and a bunch of great recommendations for restaurants and activities. Highly recommend!
The stay was absolutely wonderful! The house was decked out with any of the products we could possibly need. This stay was great and I will definitely stay here again.
Caleb's place was very comfortable and loved the location!

Location was great. We were close to great food and felt safe! Unit was very clean! The apartment is listed as Luxury but it could use a few things. The pots and pans were old. One of the things he asked of us is to clean the dishes before checking out. However there was no dawn left and the dishwasher was out of service. I'm glad my colleague knew how to use a regular coffee pot because I do not. You would think a luxury apartment would have a Kureg. There was coffee and sugar there to use, the French vanilla creamer had an expiration date of 2024. Shower curtain in master bathroom was too short so we had to wipe up water with each shower. Window in living room was broken and couldn't be closed all the way which made livingroom warm. Wifi password listed with instructions did not work. I wrote him about it and he responded quickly, however the new code didn't work neither. A/C was loud but worked great. Overall a good stay! Would recommend for an adult trip!
This Airbnb was GORGEOUS! Everything was so clean and so beautiful. The pictures are excellent and a true testament to the amenities. Mary was a great host, 1000/10!
Great place to stay with a nice pool! Would definitely stay there again!
We had a great time at Rosa's place and had no issues. Description and instructions were accurate.

The house was perfect for our Chicago girls weekend. Short walk to train lines to see the sites. The house was well stocked, clean, and beautifully decorated.  Mark and Marcelo were very easy to communicate with as we planned our trip.  The house was a perfect respite in the evening after touring the city. I recommend staying here!
It was a lively cozy room. overall the location was very busy but it was so fun. will be back

Was everything we needed for a 2 month stay!  Everything was great. We had one repair that was needed at the beginning of our stay and it was fixed quickly. Co-host Jenn was very responsive answering all my questions quickly and made our stay perfect!

Great location! The Brown Line was just blocks away, which made it so easy to get to Wrigley Field and to Chicago’s north loop. The place was comfortable and was as described (with some furniture improvements). Betty was very helpful during our stay, and check out was a breeze.
One thing to note - one of the people in our group is 6’ tall, and the lower level rooms have a lower ceiling. She needed to duck to get to the bathroom and the lower level shower was too small for her to use. Luckily the ceiling in the main level was high, so there were no issues there.

Loved staying at Laura’s place! The location is a short walk to wrigley field where we were attending a concert! The street has lots of restaurants and bars so there is lots to do! Thank you again Laura for hosting us!

Great place, super clean and conveniently located. Ben also really helped us out by accomodating a very last minute booking. Great communication and fast responses.
In-person check-in was completed with a very helpful and knowledgeable host.
Would recommend!

I had a great time at Michael’s Airbnb in Bucktown! It was very safe and walkable. It was also very easy to go to downtown using the blue line which was about 15 minute walk. Michael was very responsive and was always willing to answer any questions or concerns.
Great space! Close to restaurants and a market. We will definitely come back.
Helen was a great host! The place was good, it did exactly the job it needed to for a one month stay! Great for medical students working in the area!
Great home base to explore Chicago. Close to brown line for easy transit.

Reva's place was a perfect spot when visiting Chicago. It wasn't too far from the bus stop to get you to the red line. The park was across the street, so the neighborhood was quite peaceful and safe. It was a little hard finding the place as the map kept routing to Carmen St, not the street it was really on, which was a little annoying. Once we found the correct street and address, it was very easy to get inside. We had great street parking right outside the place, which Reva did say that it was easy to find a spot. Overall, it was a good experience and would stay again.

Christina's apartment is just beautiful -- clean, bright, open but cozy, architectually interesting and creatively designed. Christina was a pleasure to interact with -- friendly, helpful and responsive. We will certainly stay at her place again.
My stay was just as I expected close to everything and the place was beautiful!
Cute place in a great location!
Friendly host & a great place to stay!
It was a nice room, clean house, very pretty. Fatza and hakim answered any questions I had and were overall super nice. Would stay again.

David and Cathy were great hosts! My husband and I are pretty light travelers, and their place had everything we needed and more: a comfy bed, a private entrance and porch to relax, our own bathroom, and a little mini kitchen area. The area is great, lots of restaurants and stores within a 10 minute walk. I would definitely stay here again the next time I’m in Chicago. Thank you again for welcoming us into your home!
Rebecca was kind and generous, a lovely host.
It's not too far from all the basic tourist attractions. We spent most of the time in the city and the drive wasn't a terrible drive.
It was overall a great stay. Didn't notice Brad and he was responsive to questions. Would stay here again!
This place was a hidden gem!! Beautiful and a galf block walk to the beach. They had everything for a beach day - including a cart to haul all the things!

Myself and 9 girlfriends stayed here for 4 days/3 nights for the Stray Kids concert at Wrigley & everything about this experience was AMAZING!!!!
Tony let me come a little early to do some gift set up. But even before we arrived he was always responsive to my questions!
I’m so happy I was able to ‘meet’ him and support his side hustle by staying here. I want to come back to Chicago just to stay at this location again!!!!
We absolutely loved this accommodation. Beautiful, quiet, modern, private and centrally located. We felt right at home; our host is very friendly and a wonderful person. We hope to return soon.
Great location! Stephanie was super helpful and communicative. SpotHero helped find some reasonably priced parking within a block of the place. Would stay again!

It was a great place that worked well for our family. It is in a great location close to downtown, with plenty of restaurants and nightlife in the area. Milan was extremely communicative and proactive with outreach. The instructions to get checked in were clear, and the staff at the building were very friendly.
Beautiful, spacious home in a great location.  Walkable to everything in Logan and Palmer Square but still quiet/private.

This apartment is in a great location. We loved roaming the neighborhood and it was easy to get around. I also appreciated the chore-free checkout, which is rare these days. Doug sent very detailed check-in instructions, so that was quite clear.
However, that's kind of where the good ends. There is a portable AC unit in the apartment, but it only cooled the kitchen (the vents would not stay focused toward the other room), so it was still very hot in the sleeping area and the bathroom was a sauna. It made us not even want to be at the apartment, much less cook or shower.
And while there is technically no charge for parking in the neighborhood, that's only if you can find a spot, which was quite difficult. We ended up having to park in a neighboring garage for over $30/day (I don't remember the exact cost).
If I were visiting in a cooler month and not driving, I would absolutely stay here again, but I wouldn't repeat this trip.

Tena è stata un'host davvero gentile, amichevole e molto disponibile. Fin dal primo momento ci ha fornito tutte le indicazioni utili per il soggiorno, rendendo tutto più semplice. Si è persino offerta di accompagnarci in auto al supermercato, cosa che abbiamo molto apprezzato.
L'appartamento era confortevole e ben attrezzato, perfetto per il nostro soggiorno. L’unico piccolo aspetto negativo è stato un il cattivo odore nelle scale del palazzo che portano all’appartamento e la presenza di capelli nella doccia, ma nulla che abbia compromesso la qualità complessiva dell’esperienza.
Grazie ancora Tena per l’ospitalità!

This is the second time we’ve stayed in the Great Migration House in Woodlawn. We couldn’t ask for better hosts or a more comfortable place while we do summer outreach with Living Hope Church across the street. We will certainly stay here again and again if we return to Chicago.
Thank you for a lovely and very comfortable place to recuperate from our work in the city!
Thanks for the stay
I had to ring the bell close to ten times to be let in. Very unresponsive. The neighborhood is very sketchy too.

The apartment, location, and amenities were all fantastic—everything we needed for a perfect vacation. Jen was attentive and responsive throughout, and we appreciated the support. We’d definitely stay with SuiteHomes again!

We stayed here to see straykids at wrigley and it was the perfect place. We walked the first day for presale merch and had it not been the hottest summer days its been with the heatwave it would've been such a nice 20-30 min walk. The place was situated perfectly for Lyft and the bus as well. Definitely a bonus for the trip. Such a cute little place and we got to meet the dogs they have and if we can come back we'll definitely try to stay again. ☺️

Amazing location and friendly host! I did have some trouble with check-in, as I didn't get the information until three hours after check-in began, but Charlie was responsive once he knew what was going on. Heads up that the bed is comfortable if you sleep in the middle, but isn't comfortable if you sleep on one of the sides (in case you're sharing this room with someone). Overall, I'd stay here again.
very nice place

Location was very convenient for train access and in a very beautiful area! Host was super flexible and understanding. Unit was just as seen in the pictures- very roomy and nice kitchen! Highly recommend 👍
Had a great and comfortable stay at Daniel’s. The area was quiet and easy to get to. Would definitely stay again.

Had an amazing stay at the 747 Lofts. Easy place to get to. Best part was the host was always friendly and responsive. Located close to different transit options like blue line train or bus. Definitely would stay here again!

This apartment felt safe, with lots of security measures, while still being easy for us to come and go. The area surrounding was super walkable and there were tons of great coffee shops and restaurants nearby. We would stay here again!
Very clean, great communications.

Overall the accommodations were adequate.
The pictures showed a drip coffee pot, so we brought our own coffee to grind & couldn’t use it. There were no linens for the 3rd person. We arrived late in the day & the condo was extremely hot 🥵. It would have been nice to have had it on a couple of hours before we arrived.
Roberto was extremely friendly and helpful, I loved my stay here!

We had a great stay at this large house. 3 levels accommodated family and friends for a wedding. Many commented how perfect it was for our large group. One bedroom had one less bed than described but accommodations were made and we all fit without a problem. The place was very clean. The host was very responsive.

Had a great stay at Jessica’s place! Very easy walking distance to the University of Chicago and some late night food, and the train and bus lines. The bed room was cozy and the porch was great for morning coffee. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for a relaxing place to stay!

Wonderful Host!
Great location!
Extremely Clean!
Amazing Communication!

We stayed 6/25-6/27. The description states the penthouses are side by side, which they are not, they are across the hall from one another. We had a family of 14 and we were constantly walking up and down, across the hallway to each other's kitchens and living spaces. We were under the impression they would be attached as they were supposedly side by side. We were also getting check in instructions from 2 different companies/people. One said there would be a blue box to obtain the key, and the garage key cards would be in the kitchen. The other had diff info. Furniture was broken and dingy. The one apartment was extremely hot, and it was 95 outside, and the other one was fine but had a giant window ac unit sitting in the living room. We were told multiple times not to let the temp to below 72, but the thermostat appeared to be programmed to 68 so we were constantly bumping it up to 72. The owners did take care of furniture once notified, and answered questions promptly.
Exactly as listing described. Very clear check-in and check-out instructions. A very comfortable place to stay!
It was the perfect spot!
My daughters and i went for a girls weekend and we were walkable to everything, the place felt like home and was clean.
The place was located in a very convenient area where it was a short walk to the train station. Lots of nice local spots in the area. The place was very clean and the ambience was very unique.
The place was clean and organized! Had everything we needed for our stay! It was also a perfect 10 min walk from WrigleyField which was perfect for my friend and I!!
We came to Chicago for a concert and to explore.  We had a great experience and so many restaurants to pick from, that are within a walking distance.
There were kids living in the unit above stomping/jumping on the floor through the day, and starting at 6am. It was impossible to sleep through, and we are heavy sleepers
It was a quiet area with stores nearby and free on street parking. the place itself was nice and clean
Nice place. Perfect for the couple days we had in the city.  Lots of places within walking distance and the University is close by.

Excellent stay at Jaqueline's place.
Large, clean apartment. Located in an excellent area. 👍🏼

We stayed for a week, during the hottest week of the summer in Chicago. I think if we had only been staying for a couple of nights it would’ve been doable. Despite leaving the only two AC units running, we could not get cool. Thermostat on the wall read 29 Celsius most of our stay. Nights for the kids were fine, it was really hard for adults to sleep. Not the fault of the owners, but I would recommend at least one additional AC unit, and a fan for the back room—there was a small heater available for that one but no ceiling fan or table fan. It was the hottest room. Despite searching we couldn’t find dishwashing soap or dishwasher pods/detergent or additional trash bags. Beds were super comfy, towels were soft.
tl;dr Probably a great stay for a couple days, wouldn’t stay for a week again.
We had a great stay!

Fantastic location. Nice, clean room. Had no problem finding street parking. Only negative was that the other guests in the apartment were not considerate about others sharing the space…refrigerator, bathroom, etc. However, I don’t blame that on the owner. Some people are just inconsiderate.
I would definitely stay here again!
Amazing location. Fun building with character in the mix of the loop. 3 min walk to the train and close to the river. Would definitely stay here again!
Great place, very clean and spacious, close to everything.  We enjoyed our stay very much!
Very acccomodating enjoyed it all

This condo was extremely clean and well maintained. It's very spacious, and the open concept kitchen/living room combo made the place feel even larger. It's a short walk to Chinatown and public transit was pretty accessible. Though you're right by I-90, it was surprisingly quiet within the actual condo unit, so it made for a good night's sleep. We'd definitely book again!
ok
spacious apartment on a quiet street. We tried a new restaurant every day, it was all amazing!
This was a perfect house for our family and close to everything! We will look to stay here again!

I really should have been able to give this place 5 stars at least 4, but the lack of urgency in correcting the issues with the air did not sit well with us at all. It was in the upper 90s with a heat index of 100 something and the 2nd and 3rd floor had no air. We were a large group with teenage girls on a summer reward trip.
I informed her of this, let her also know that we couldn't get the ceiling fan on (remote to fan did not work), also informed her the refrigerator upstairs was not cooling probably due to the heat. There was no offer to bring fans, battery for remote, the air was not fixed until 4pm the next day and the filters were filthy! Something that should have been addressed before we got there so we wouldnt have to be miserable when sleeping.
There were so many other little things that we couldnt even address those because of the bug issues. We werent even able to use the half bath because it was locked (cleaning crew) and had to finally unlock it with hanger. Never again

Chi was a very responsive host and I never had a problem with getting in contact with him. The street was quiet and perfect for our needs. The garage and washer/dryer were wonderful conveniences. It was easy to walk to a lot of different food options and very close to the hospitals for our post-surgery stay.
Steven was a great host to us! He was so helpful with anything we needed. Place was clean and tidy. Perfect space for 4 of us. Ideal location, so close to train station, shops and Wrigley.

Rooms were comfortable and location was great. Apart from that this was a very bad experience. This is a hotel and the front desk recommends to book directly rather than Airbnb. The charges are not mentioned accurately. We were charged additional $145 dollars per room at check in. I would rather have the full price shown upfront than having surprises at check in.

This AirBnB is in a great location and would highly recommend for that reason. It’s definitely not the cheapest place to stay though.
They need to update their listing and their binder in the house. It’s clear this used to be run by an individual and a property management company has taken over so there’s some incorrect info lingering leading to come miscommunication.
There were some little things that could be improved. Most of the towels are old and well used, we could not find any wash cloths, there’s a hole in the wall of the primary bedroom, and just some things that could use a bit more attention.
