We really enjoyed our stay this time. Your quick responses always made us feel at ease. The apartment was clean and comfortable — my kids and I were very satisfied. We’d love to come back here again in the future. 😊
We stayed with Patricia and she’s an amazing host. The house is very clean and in the heart of loop. Many restaurants and attractions are within a walking distance. Will stay there again anytime

This place was perfect for my stay in Chicago, the location is extremely convenient, the neighbourhood is one of my favourites to visit and the space has everything you need for a solo/couples trip. Would definitely stay here again when visiting Chicago! The host is super helpful and responsive. I also think the space is bigger than the photos suggest !
Inaccurate descriptions of room and facilities on Airbnb. The room was smelly. I had to apply for a refund. However, the Airbnb team was responsive.

This place was exactly what I expected from the photos. It was nice and clean and the showers are LOVEEEEE. I wanted to take them home. It was quiet and peaceful. The only thing I disliked was the hauling of our suitcases up all them stairs. Good thing my man was with me 🥵Overall it was a nice place and spacious. 10/10 highly recommend. We had NO issues and didn’t have to reach out to the  hosts AT ALL.
Nice stay
We had a great stay at Anna's apartment - we felt right at home, very comfortable, we had everything we needed. would highly recommend!

Steve is a wonderful host! My wife and I would’ve stayed longer if the place wasn’t booked out. The location is excellent with a great view of the lake. We had a car with us but public transportation is easily accessible as well. Overall we had great stay!

Hands down Joe and his staff need to make way for me to move in. All the hosts here are attentive and alert. They are legit 24 hours around the clock. The location along makes you not want to leave their residence along with the superb hospitality service. Thanks for all you guys do, see you soon.
Angela was a great host!

It was the perfect location for us because we wanted to be near city center but also out in a neighborhood. Parking was super easy to find on the street and free. Coffee shop down the street that we walked to! Felt safe and like a family friendly neighborhood.

This a perfect stay if you are seeking a place to crash while checking out the city. Ming is very communicative of any and all throngs related to the stay. Offered some local recommendations that were pleasant visits. Met some kind people staying in the other rooms of the unit. I would definitely rebook this space. Thank you Ming!

I was a little confused about parking and Milan was QUICK with their responses and resolutions for me. The apartment was clean, perfect for our family of 6, and just as described! We love the fact that there were roku TVs in every room! If coming back to Chicago, we will look to rent Milan’s properties. Highly recommended!!

Overall, the stay was pleasant, and the place was clean and well-maintained. However,the door lock was difficult to open upon check-in, which was a bit frustrating. Communication with the host felt slightly impatient at times probably I am not good at English. Additionally, the mattress was too soft, affecting sleep comfort.
Very nice space, very nice host, would recommend.

Everything was as described in the listing. Very cute studio apartment located in a great area with lots of shops, restaurants and everything else you need within walking distance.
Hatice was very responsive, usually within a few minutes, and answered any of my questions.
My only con is the mattress. It's a memory foam which has suncken in making it rather uncomfortable. I woke up with quite a bit of back pain. Might be time for a replacement.

This is the best air bnb experience I’ve ever had! The apartment was charming, artistic, clean, private, quiet, and good AC systems in the middle of a heatwave. Holly was amazing throughout the entire process. Great communication about the unit and the area. She helped me out when I experienced a minor injury (which did not occur in the house or premises). She really cares about her guests! I am already planning my next trip back.

The space is beautiful and looks just like the photos. The host was responsive and even reimbursed me for part of the stay and the broken amenities, which I appreciated. That said, when I arrived, the place was dirty—stains on the sheets, a used deodorant bar in the bathroom, and visible dirt on the floors and counters. The bathroom was especially unclean. I didn’t want to make a big deal, but too many things were wrong to stay silent. The host did bring new sheets, but the blinds were broken and had to be duct-taped, which felt unsafe as a young woman traveling alone. The AC stopped working, and with the extreme heat in Chicago, I had to end my stay early. While the host tried to coordinate fixes, they often didn’t work with my schedule, and the issues should’ve been resolved beforehand. Overall, the place could be a 10/10, but I wouldn’t stay again.
Our stay was amazing, the space provided was amazing
This is a cute place, nice walking distance to a lot of restaurants and pubs, playgrounds, parks.

As a native Chicagoan very familiar with Hyde Park, I can confirm that Rida's place is in a prime location. Rida herself was friendly and responsive, and the apartment was just as described. There were a couple issues beyond her control that simply come with apartment living: Sometimes, the main doors to the building were difficult to get into and it often took several attempts before the key turned in the locks. Sometimes, the neighbor above walked hard (or maybe was exercising?), which can be unpleasant if constant. So, would I recommend Rida's place? Absolutely! It is cute and cozy and has the same amenities you have at home. Plus, you're in walking distance of plenty of good restaurants and shops and you're a bus or train ride away from downtown Chicago. Hyde Park also has a bustling nightlife, so if you like to be out and about, Rida's place is ideal. Just keep in mind that HP is congested, so if you're driving, you will have to navigate parking.

We will add our praise of Brian’s place to all of the others! The flat is lovely, comfortable, beautifully decorated, conveniently located and in a quiet, tree shaded neighborhood. The kitchen is very well equipped, good WiFi and tv. Nice outdoor spaces to sit, we loved the front porch bench.
We hope to stay there again when visiting our daughter and son in law.

Comfortable accommodations for our 5 night stay (we didn’t cook though).  Definitely a basement, but hosts have done a thoughtful job of making it cozy.  It seems as though hosts do not access the site, but use a 3rd party for cleaning/maintenance.  There is always a disconnect in quality control in these arrangements.  Just a few items that we will leave private comments for host.  Nothing terrible; I would stay again.

The host is very responsive, and I had a nice stay here. This is a great place to stay if you are flying into or out of Midway. There is no beating this place in terms of convenience if you need to catch an early flight! The apartment is well-kept, with brand new appliances and a fresh coat of paint. There is some traffic noise because of the location, and a strong incense smell in the hallways, though it doesn’t overwhelm the apartment.
Again for the location next to Midway it is just too convenient.
loved my stay! host was extremely responsive and gave recommendations

Beautiful home that was perfect for my family of 5. Very spacious and stocked with all of the essentials plus more. This home was also in a great location as it was a 15 minute drive to the museum campuses and Navy Pier. Kymi communicated thorough and was very responsive. This was my first Airbnb experience and it has definitely amazed me!
It was good. Good location and very easy to access. Parking lot situation was easy to manage as well.

Michael’s apartment was absolutely lovely! Perfect for our stay of almost two weeks. We stayed in a similar apartment at Roger’s park a while back but that one was rundown and part of the ceiling plaster collapsed. Michael’s place was renovated, warm and really immaculate. The apartment is absolutely beautiful, so well decorated and has absolutely everything we could need and more :) Twelve minute walk to HarvesTime grocery store (brilliant selection and interesting), and ten minute walk another direction is the great Bros Perfect cafe, and other international restaurants. We loved experiencing a little living in Chicago and felt at home and less like tourists :) Thank you for hosting us :)

Obi’s place was very clean, well stocked, well located, and comfortable. Unfortunately the A/C broke on our first night right at the outset of a heat wave. Although Obi was not able to have it repaired during our stay, he was extremely communicative and helpful in finding alternative lodging options and offering fair reimbursement for the inconvenience. This is a great Airbnb for the Evanston area.
Nice stay exactly is advertised, would go here again without hesitation if I have another University of Chicago conference and am coming from out of town
Worked very well for our friend’s 1 month stay in the neighborhood!
Very cute place in a great location. Water pressure is poor and towels low quality.

Jolie et grande maison,  mais climatisation très bruyante, pas efficace dans le séjour. Réveillé dès le levé du jour par manque de rideaux occultant dans les chambres. Dommage qu'il n'y ait qu'une seule salle d'eau et un seul wc.

the location is fantastic -- literally right next to Wrigley -- and I like the boarding house style set up. there's also a spot hero option on the backside I used. the room was pretty good and the style was too. the water spigot at the sink didn't work and there were no fresh water options, and the hot water didn't last enough to fill half the tub sadly. otherwise, no complaints
Enjoyed our stay. Great location

Had such a great stay at Patricia’s place. Location is very convenient with restaurants close by and the pink line only an 8 minute walk away. We had a car and were concerned about parking but there was never a problem finding a space nearby on the street. The neighborhood is very charming with unique architecture - and also very quiet. The apartment is very cozy and is beautifully decorated. The mattresses in both the bedroom and in pullout couch were very comfortable. Bathroom was fully stocked with plenty of toiletries and extra towels. Patricia was very quick to respond when we had any questions. I highly recommend staying at Patricia’s place!
We had a great time in Chicago even though it was really hot. Carrie was a great host.
Easy check in, great location (groceries 1 block, restaurants near), excellent amenities.

I wanted to leave this place a good review, but unfortunately I had a bad experience with the host.  Within 24 hours of our our stay, the host messaged me accusing my guests and I of having additional guests than indicated when we booked our stay.  I felt very uncomfortable and it made our stay uneasy given these accusations especially since they did not obtain the proper investigation prior to the accusations.  We were the only guests the whole stay in the home as indicated and the additional guests were from a different unit within the building, but we were the ones accused.  My assumption is they only looked at the outside ring camera.  When they did attempt to reach out afterwards to apologize for the 'mix up', they got my name completely incorrect and it felt very informal and not sincere (my name is Ruth - not Abil).  This could have been avoided if it were brought to my attention properly or formal investigation was completed beforehand.  Thank you.
The host was very friendly and the place was clean and wonderful. We really enjoyed ourselves. I would recommend it.

We stayed in the SUNNY room for 4D3N. Other than the room felt a bit warm (it was 95F) everything was great. Guillermo was very responsive and friendly. The house felt modern and clean, felt like home. We have our own shelf space in the kitchen, and in the fridge. Highly recommend.

Joe and Brent were extremely helpful at all times and made sure all of our needs were met at an exceptional level. We had zero problems when contacting either Joe and Brent and would receive a response very quickly. They are definitely the best hosts I have ever dealt with!

Great and affordable place to stay if you come to see Chicago. There are several public transportation routes to get to the city center and back so you won’t be stranded, even at night. The room is small but has everything you need for the comfortable living. We really appreciated small details like toothbrushes in case you forgot yours or laundry detergent so you don’t need to worry about it. The host was always available and responsive with clear communication and instructions. We highly recommend staying here!

The place is very clean and very accommodating. We will def come back again. I love the convenience of  being able to park my big truck in their driveway as the parking on the street seems very hard to come by. They initially offered the garage but it was too short for my truck. Thank you!
Great place to stay ! Even  greater host !
Awesome place, quick response to questions. Excellent location in an awesome neighborhood. Close enough to all the activities you want to do.

Cam's place was roomy and clean. It is in a great location, especially for conferences at McCormick convention center. It's in a quiet neighborhood and includes off-street parking. Walking distance to Fat Peach bakery and Ctrl Z coffee, which we recommend. We were there for several days during a heat wave. The basement location along with the air conditioner kept things  cool. The air conditioner is in the main area; the bedroom has a fan. We didn't cook, but we didn't see a chef's knife or cutting board.
Awesome place

⸻
We absolutely appreciated our stay and truly enjoyed the charming and thoughtfully maintained space. The location was convenient, and the home itself was both quaint and welcoming. We especially appreciated the quick communication and how responsive and supportive the host were throughout our stay — that made a big difference and didn’t go unnoticed.
Overall, we truly enjoyed our time in the space and are grateful for the hospitality!

The only issues were the doors were difficult to use (many gates, doors were hard to use, and the main door got stuck alot), the bathroom door barely closed, and the air conditioning was not the greatest (although at the time of the stay it was high 90's).

Great host and a bang for your buck stay. Easy check-in, clean place, easy walk to public transport. Only negative was the temperature of the room, which we had no control over. Wasn’t so hot that it was a dealbreaker, but the fan provided was broken. The host was very responsive and likely would have had it replaced had I asked but it wasn’t big enough of a deal to warrant that. Would definitely stay here again.

Staying at Jaylin’s Airbnb was truly a wonderful experience! The space was exactly as described—clean and thoughtfully put together. It felt welcoming from the moment I walked in. Jaylin was an exceptional host—friendly, responsive, and made sure everything was perfect for my stay. The location was convenient and peaceful, making it easy to relax and enjoy my time. I would absolutely recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a comfortable and well-maintained place to stay. Thank you again, Jaylin, for such a great experience—I’ll definitely be back!
Our appartment was great!  we had everything we needed! Anthony was a great host. Looking forward to our next stay in Chicago.
Beautiful, quiet area ! Host was very responsive, kind and understanding ! Will book again !
Wonderful home, very clean and cozy!  Senada thought of everything when she stocked this home.  We all enjoyed it very much!

Awesome place for a group. Very nice place to stay. Walkable to restaurants and grocery store. Easy check in and check out. Wonderful rooftop to hang out on. All the beds were very comfortable. Would definitely stay here again!!

One of our best Airbnb experiences ever. Peter was very kind and flexible, his family’s house lovely and comfortable, and the neighborhood surrounding was just beautiful. The house is a very short walk to the Blue Line with access to O’Hare airport and the Loop. We had great barbecue right around the corner at Smoque, and came home after our exploration of Chicago to a lovely home with a nice, intimate back yard and lots of comfortable hang-out spaces in the house. Our walks around the Villa neighborhood introduced us to a wealth of cool early 20th century bungalows. Hard to say enough good things about this visit!

Ava Marie absolutely exceeded our expectations in many ways!  We visited during a heat wave, so she made sure we had plenty of water (and snacks), she allowed flexible check in & check out and was highly responsive when we had questions. Her home was beautifully decorated,  clean and had everything we needed. Lastly,  we really appreciated the kind and thoughtful neighbors - super friendly! We will definitely be back. Thank you for hosting us, Ava!

I definitely plan to stay here again! Not only was the space perfect for me and my disabled son, but Naj was extremely helpful and responsive in case I had any questions or needed anything. Very grateful for my time in this space.

The house is beautiful although the bedroom floor plans weren’t as described. There’s no 2nd room with 4 beds and no room with a king bed and 3 singles outside the main bedroom.
The home is 4 levels with narrow stairs which was small issue due to the age/health of some of my specifics guest but not too bad.
The neighborhood and neighbors on foot did raise several eyebrows but we didn’t feel unsafe (we actually dropped our extra food to the people we saw out on the corner before we left) and we made sure to utilize the provided security system. We had to call maintenance for the shower, but he came immediately! Samantha also responded immediately every time I reached out. If I ever have a big group visiting chicago again, I would definitely consider rebooking Samantha’s home.

Still’s place was definitely a home away from home! Squeaky clean, neat and very comfortable! Had huge TVs in all rooms and a great recliner in the living room. The beds were very comfortable and the bathrooms were super clean and modern! I loved every aspect of it and will definitely be rebooking whenever i’m back to Chicago! It was truly an amazing experience!

The stay felt right at home and the house smelled so good right when you walk through that door and it felt so welcoming, definitely worth the price and Doris was very friendly and fast at responding for any questions
If your traveling alone this is a good spot it’s around 25-30 minutes from downtown it was very clean and bed is comfortable also it’s a nice neighborhood felt safe the whole time.

Overall it was a good stay for my friends and I. The only negative thing I have to say is the air went out the second day of our stay, when it was 95 degrees outside. Once we told the host they took care of it right away.

Justin was a good host. Communication was good before and all during our stay with recommendations. This was a guys trip for our first time in the Chicago. I loved the location. It’s a historical section of the city. We were able to see some great places.
The houses, on the street that the house is on, seem to be getting updated. We actually passed the place at first. Then we found it and at first I was a lil nervous. The house is next to what looks like an abandoned house. Both needed yard work. But once we got in, everything was nice as the pictures. Except there was trash still on the back the whole time we were there.
I would recommend to all guest to read everything about the place. I didn’t see that we would have to pay for the washer and dryer. So we had to reuse our one set of towels & washcloths.
It’ll be good to have a coffee machine. The only other thing that I didn’t like about it was we had to check out an hour earlier due to him booking back to back. Not our fault
Very clean and spacious. Neighbors are friendly and was nice coming back to peace and quiet at the end of a long light. Would recommend to anyone with a group
Great stay! Looks exactly like the pictures and we enjoyed ourselves!
Very beautiful space . Thank you again .
Thanks For. everything

This was a lovely home with a great host! The house was clean, beautiful , and exactly what we were looking for. Our host was friendly with great recommendations! We felt right at home and hope to visit again in the future.
Beautiful house. Also very near to major attractions in Chicago which was really good.
Good sized apartment in a nice neighbourhood, convenient walkable location from the subway line and local bars, shops and restaurants.
Had a nice stay here - the neighborhood is great and apartment was clean and comfortable.

Larissa‘s place is beautiful, comfortable, and close to all of Chicago’s many attractions! The neighborhood is safe and peaceful with an El train stop, grocery stores, and restaurants all within walking distance. We really enjoyed our stay, and will definitely stay there again if we are in Chicago in the near future! Also, Larissa was a very reliable, communicative host.
Tarek’s listing was extremely spacious for a group of 8! Space felt a lot bigger than pictured. The host was responsive and attentive during our stay. Will be back again!!

Hello! This was the first location I stayed at where it was a shared space and it was what I expected. It's a family home so expect a lively family and some noise (which is expressed in the description) but nothing that kept me from sleeping. I enjoyed the private entrance, the fully finished basement/kitchen, with pool table, and Cilmar was such a pleasant guy! Thank again, be well ☮️
Nat did a great job accommodating our group of travelers!
The house was better than I expected.  There was a nice park nearby for the kids to hang out.  I would stay there again.

I booked this room because of the reviews that I had seen and I did not get that experience. My room wasnt very clean snd still had lashes and dust from the last guest. The washer was broken and wasnt made aware until I got there so I had to pay extra and outsource laundry. The rainy days there was a leak in my ceiling and at the time said he couldn’t do anything about it and never came to fix it after the fact. He gave me a rug for the leak and my room was extremely humid with the heat coming in and the moisture that was created. The window also started leaking as well, he requested the house of room inspections but wouldn’t fix the leak. Also the room I booked shared a wall with the kitchen via a blind, wasn’t the most private and always was paranoid someone was looking in.
Host was absolutely lovely. She responded very quickly. House was very clean. Would most definitely stay again.

Great location!
I think for the price paid per night each room should have a TV in room.
Also as a guest - please be sure to bring your own wash cloths & essential toiletries. I personally did not like the fact that the other house guests that I stayed with during my stay used the bathroom hand soap to shower with because they arrived unprepared.
Really enjoyed my stay at Silvia’s place!
Delia was a great host very polite and her family as well. It felt like home for me and my 4 year old daughter.

Easy access to train. Everyone speaks strongly about the area it is near but I didn’t feel unsafe or uncomfortable during my stay. It is around some residential spots that made me feel more like a native than a visitor.

I truly enjoyed my time here at this home. Checking in was a bit difficult at first because I’m not used to so many codes but it was better than using a key. The house was nice and clean. The AC is very powerful for this time of year. The host was readily available and answered all my questions in a timely manner. I don’t have any complaints about my stay. I rate it 10/10. I will definitely be booking another stay here before the summer ends.
I absolutely loved staying in this Airbnb! Will most definitely stay here when I return back to Chicago!
Perfect place for a weekend getaway. Very responsive host. Very friendly. Place was clean and nice. Comfortable bed. Tidy kitchen and bathroom.

The place was as good a place as we have stayed with Airbnb. We plan to return. Although we had trepidation about sharing the place with the owners we felt comfortable. As I told Marty we entered as guests and left as friends.
Highly recommended.
Very flexible with our check in and check out times. Very nice and helpful and the ac was very nice with the heat wave.

Stephanie was very responsive and communicative. She let me check in early and check out late which I really appreciated her accommodating my requests since I took a red eye in and had a 5 year old with me. There’s so much to do in the area and the neighborhood is great.
Would definitely stay there again.
I would highly recommend!!!

We enjoyed our stay here, the layout was as described, the location is walkable to the train but we caught Ubers for convenience purposes only. The back deck was relaxing to sit out and catch a nice breeze after a busy day.
It was overall an amazing place to stay! My only qualm was the cleanliness when we arrived. It was by no means filthy, just some spots seemed to be overlooked accidentally.
cozy little studio with available street  parking :)  Was very clean!!

Daniel’s place was perfect for our 4-person long weekend. The weather was exceptionally hot, but the unit stayed comfortable and cool. The location was great for lake access (~1 mile) and restaurants/bars (~1 block). Thank you, Daniel!

We were delighted with Gerrit’s place. It was spacious, immaculate, and comfortable with tons of natural light. TheThe bed was very comfortable, the bathroom and shower were great, and the kitchen was well equipped. Gerrit was a super host and met and walked us through his place and answered our questions. The unit is on a gorgeous street with friendly neighbors and within walking distance of tons of great restaurants and shops. We would definitely stay here the next time we visit Chicago.
Nice little play to stay.  Quick easy walk to Wrigley.  Good local recommendations for dining.
Perfect place for us during our family visit. Loves that it was close to the train and the place was warm and cozy.
Place is just precious. Ademola is warm and welcoming. Grateful we found this gem near campus.
This was a great place to stay at! It was easy to get into and was very clean. The host was very responsive and friendly!
Marek was an amazing host and had an amazing place. Everything was as it was described. His place is very nice and clean. I would definitely stay at his place again.

Small group of friends and myself booked this stay last minute for Black Yacht Weekend. Initially Augustine was great and responding very quickly to inquiries which was appreciated. She gave instructions at check in not to lock the building door because a key wouldn't provided and our group obliged. However, we left for brunch and went shopping to return to the door being locked by someone else. We were unable to access the unit, and I was unable to get a response from Augustine for several hours, Airbnb Support was also unable to reach her. We were lucky when a guest came to visit the unit next to us, otherwise it would have been very late before we were able to access the unit again. Augustine was apologetic about this but it still impacted our experience. The stub/shower in the restroom was not very clean and something was in the kitchen sink when we arrived. The beds were hard, the unit was warm, and the couch was the most comfortable place to sit.

The home worked well for the four adults in our group. Straightforward accommodations, lots of snacks in the pantry, easy to find, and parking was always practically in front of the house. Maria was incredibly responsive to messages and the checkout process was incredibly easy!

No negative things to be said, hostess was responsive and welcoming! It was definitely a good space that was perfect for us. Everything was clean and had the perfect accommodations needed for our stay:)
Great host and location! My family and I stayed and it was perfect for us! Lots of walkable restaurants, bars, and train stations near by! Also public pool at the end of the street!

I really enjoy staying in this style of Apartment. I really wish being a Travel Nurse I could find something in every city just like this. I love that there was one bed a kitchen area and it was very spacious. The unit was clean. I really enjoyed my stay thank you.
Worst stay ever.
Place is as advertised. Great host— very responsive!
El alojamiento de Lyle es cómodo para familias. El anuncio refleja lo que es. Tiene detalles que se agradecen como café. Buen lugar para hospedarse. Lo volvería a reservar sin dudas
Great place for large groups, comfortable beds, plenty of restaurants to walk to. Our host was very responsive.
Great place to stay very nice family

Terrible experience. The listing says A/C, but this is a joke. Its the tiniest window unit not sized for the size of the place and there isn't a single ceiling fan to move the air. We had an infant with us and couldn't get the temp below 80 degrees at night. Not safe and not okay at all. Bathroom also smelled like sewage and the owner said it was because of our damp towels. It was day 1 and none of the towels had been used yet. Ridiculous.
Overall 10/10 BUTTTT as a girl! We love us some full body mirrors and there were 0! Other than that I loved it! Very clean and spacious!
Easy check-in, Rich was responsive. Although, stove top and oven did not work. We also did not have hot water durring our stay. Otherwise, pleasant and air bnb was as described.
Rochelle was a great host very accommodating and quick to respond to any questions. We will definitely book again when visiting the Chicago area. We rate our stay five stars.
Great stay, nice area, highly recommend

This was truly a hidden gem- we walked in and were in awe of the space. Rooftop access was beautiful and we loved that we could watch the trains go by. Highly recommend if you are looking to scope out the West Loop/ Fulton Market area.. we felt like royalty while staying in this space!!
Spacious, clean and comfortable place in a trendy neighborhood with amazing views. Host was communicative and very proactive.
Very clean, quiet street, well supplied.

A beautiful house on a quiet street, close to Logan Square and with easy access to the city.   Several spacious areas for relaxing, including a terrace and little garden, makes for a spacious and relaxing refuge.
The place was clean, comfortable, and in a great location to downtown Chicago. Host was responsive and helpful.

John was great and responsive, the place was nice and clean with good amenities (washer dryer, lots of lighting options, kitchen appliances & tableware). Very close to some restaurants and bus stops, not too far from the train so it was pretty easy to get around the rest of the city.

Michelle was a great host and quick with response. Airbnb looked just like the photos online, was very clean and felt like home. I would recommend anyone to book with her if looking for somewhere to stay in Chicago for vacationing!
Lots of space quick to get downtown and freeways

My friend and I loved this stay! The house was super close (<10 min walk)  to the train, and the neighborhood was safe with easy access to the grocery store and a great breakfast restaurant. Ebony and her husband were amazing hosts; offered recommendations, proactive in offering help, and even gave great advice. When we come back to Chicago, we'd definitely stay again! 10/10
Had a great experience! Very nice and place looks just like photos.
Very enjoyable experience. I would recommend this location to anyone looking for somewhere comfortable to stay!

Terrible experience – would not recommend.
My bad experience with Connie began just hours after she accepted my same-day booking and tried to cancel two hours later while I was already on my way to Chicago. I was extremely stressed—I had nowhere else to go. Airbnb asked me to checkin at 7 PM so Connie could resolve a cleaning issue. When I finally arrived around 8:30 PM, the cleaning crew was still there doing a terrible job. Even after they left, the place was still dirty, and I strongly suspect the bed linens weren’t even changed.
Around midnight, as I was half-asleep, I felt something on the bed—it was a huge cockroach. It was horrifying. I ended up sleeping on the couch.
While trying to find where the cockroach came from, I also discovered dirty baby wipes behind the headboard. The entire place—from the entrance door to the interior—is cluttered, messy, and unhygienic.
This was a nightmare stay, and I absolutely do not recommend this listing.
Very nice and cozy place to stay with quiet neighbors!
Beautiful spacious apartment. Close access to the train and beach.
This is a vey clean apartment. The beds are comfortable. We felt safe.
Ruth was a fantastic host.  Fabulously, friendly and helpful very easy checkout process.
A gem of a property!  All the other reviews are spot on.  The house is wonderful, the beds are comfortable, there is gated parking, the host is welcoming and communicates. We would stay here again!

Easily one of the best Airbnb experiences I have had.
The Place:
Divided into two floors, the main floor has the kitchen, dining, sitting room, 2 bedrms and 1.5 bathrooms. It is beautifully decorated and thoughtfully stocked. Nice touches included, remembering to fill up the Brita so we had cold water to enjoy upon arrival. Downstairs, comfy basement style (great for sleeping in!) has the family room, wet bar, king bedroom and 1 bathroom. The bathroom downstairs is one of dreams - they even stocked salts for a bath! We were 4 adults and a 7 year old and had enough space to gather when we felt social or break off into our own spaces when we needed a break.
The Host:
Super responsive and pro-active! Messaging on here was like texting directly because the response time was so quick!

We had a wonderful time and made lasting memories in Chicago. The building is a nice central location that made coordinating Ubers and getting to activities all over the city very easy. Would definitely recommend for large groups.

Overall, our stay met our expectations. Responsive host, clean place and easy to find. Parking as about a block away, which I expected with street parking. We could have used some extra stuff in the kitchen - cookie sheet for baking leftovers, paper towels or washcloth for cleaning up minor spills. I also did provide feedback to the host that their front door jamb needed to be looked at and they responded that they will be looking into it.
Would stay there again, very convenient for heading over to McCormick each day.
Great location and clear instructions from the host. The room was clean, but the common spaces and bathroom needed some attention.

This house is in a quiet neighborhood that is close to many attractions. It was easy to find our way to all the places we wanted to go. The beautiful architecture and the vintage furnishings made this house very inviting and comfortable.

Our stay at MJs was in a great location, in an iconic looking Chicago town home and walking distance to Wrigley Field.  Additionally, it is close to the train station.  MJ was accommodating in holding our luggage while we waited for our flight.

Great place.
Great location.
Super helpful and responsive host.
Not at all what we expected for the price we payed. There also was no sense of urgency when Victoria was contacted regarding our stay. I highly DO NOT recommend
Great!

My family and I had a wonderful stay at The Muse in Chicago! It’s in a peaceful, well-kept neighborhood on the south side — just 20 minutes from downtown and close to parks, the lake, and plenty of food spots. We loved having private parking and access to e-scooters and bikes nearby to explore. The home is absolutely beautiful — stylish, clean, and even better than the pictures. One thing to note: there's only one full bathroom with a shower, and it's inside one of the guest rooms with a glass door, so it can be a little awkward if you're staying in the master. Also, the master bedroom gets pretty warm during the summer, but turning the A/C down and using the light bedding helped. Sheldon was a fantastic host — friendly, gave us a tour, and even shared late-night dinner suggestions. We felt welcomed and cared for. Overall, we had a great experience and would absolutely stay again!

Spacious place to stay in wicker park. Very comfortable and easy to find. Lots to do in the neighborhood and easy access to public transportation. Parking was also easy to find. Would stay again. Nice place!
A room is good and affordable. I like it. Andy, the host, is very nice and good. We communicated well through message. I appreciate the detailed information and pictures he provided.
She was a very friendly host that will help you at the drop of a hat.  You will not regret your stay.

Tiffany and William were great hosts and we’ll likely see if they’re available next time we’re in town for a Cubs game. They’re located just a few minutes from the Kenzie Brown Line stop and we took that to Southport stop to walk to Wrigley. We also took the Brown Line down to the loop one day for downtown stuff. Tiffany was also great in telling us about a neighborhood farmers market, which we walked down to on Saturday. The neighborhood is lovely and seemed super safe. The apartment was clean and spacious. Really appreciated everything about our stay.

Overall, was more than pleased with our stay! Definitely would recommend to other people to book with Carla!
Will definitely consider coming back in the future!

We waited till the very last minute to book our stay even though we knew we were coming here for months to see one of our favorite bands play.  We were pleasantly surprised to stay here and meeting Shannon and Carmen made it even more special.  John and I felt like we were in our families home and would have just gone to Chicago just to spend time with them.  We loved having a dog, cat, birds and turtle fill the home with great energy.
Loved our experience
Great host, very responsive.

we enjoyed our stay at Allen's place. it was very clean and well maintained. his check-in instructions were super clear and we were able to find everything we needed in the condo. it was very warm when we were visiting but there is a window AC unit and the condo stayed cool with the curtains and blinds drawn. the bedroom was a bit warm but it was over 90 degrees.
transit was very accessible and the area felt very safe. it also was a great price especially as we were visiting in June, a busy tourism season. Allen also checked in with us to make sure we had no issues. thanks again!

House was located perfectly for our stay. Check in took too long. We arrived early evening of first day. Dropped off our luggage and went to my son's house. Got back to house and went to bed. Got up 2nd day and took a shower, NO HOT WATER! Reported as soon as we discovered. 9 a.m.   Viktor did not respond until several hours later. By the time he looked into problem it was 3 p.m. And then informed us there would be NO hot water for the duration of our stay, another 2 nights. He did not offer any solutions to the problem. Offered me the cleaning fee as a reimbursement. I felt not enough. The house did not meet our basic needs. Had to go through ABNB support. Feel Viktor was not held accountable at all for our inconvenience. We will not be staying with Viktor again.

We had a great stay for a Cubs game at Wrigley Field. Parking was easy with the available windshield passes. The place was cool, clean, and quiet. There were fans provided for an extra breeze. Chris was a great host. We’d definitely stay there again!

Dan went above and beyond with our current stay in his place. He was extremely well prepared and responsive. The place was beautiful and very comfortable the beds were extremely clean and comfy making sleeping very peaceful . Bathrooms all spotless and ample seating throughout the space. Very easy to find and even had an extra door for bringing luggage in and out. Easy to control the climate of the unit as well. Dan provided brand new towels and there were plenty! He may have been the most hospitable host I've had here on Airbnb we will absolutely be back !
Wanda was a great host! Always replying back fast. Helping us find things to do in the area. She did her thing! I’ll be back again to use her home.

This was an excellent stay — and it was a beautiful, quiet neighborhood. The hot tub was clutch!
Andrea was extremely responsive and an amazing host. There was an incident where the entire neighborhood lost power for 15-minutes due to an uncontrollable circumstance. Andrea was quick to answer my call, check with neighbors to see they were experiencing the same situation, and assure me it should be fixed soon. It was a nice conforming feeling and I appreciated her responsiveness and checking with neighbors. To be clear — the outage was due to the city of Chicago, not Andrea’s property specifically.
Overall — amazing stay and would come back in a heart beat!
Great location. Close to everything and perfect space.

Loved staying here, very comfortable and clean! We loved being able to walk around wicker park to coffee and bakery shops around the corner in the mornings, as well as some restaurants and bars for dinner. Would love to come back and stay here again.

This was a fantastic Airbnb!! I’m impressed we were able to find a place in Chicago that can host 12 for such a great price. What stood out were all the thoughtful touches. There was music playing and fun disco-like lights already turned on and ready for our arrival. The basket of snacks and a bottle of wine were so nice. We really appreciated the coffee station, as well. The hot tub was a great addition!! We ended up not using it due to a heat warning this weekend, but I’m sure future guests will enjoy!
Comfortable apartment in a great location.  We stayed cool in the 95 degree heat.

I recently stayed at this Airbnb just minutes from downtown Chicago, and it was a fantastic experience! The price was unbeatable for the location, making it a great option for anyone looking to explore the city without breaking the bank. The space itself was cozy, clean, and thoughtfully furnished — perfect for relaxing after a busy day of sightseeing. The bed was especially comfortable, and the host provided everything I needed for a comfortable stay. Highly recommend for anyone wanting an affordable, comfortable home base near all the action in Chicago!
This place was great! Looked just like the photos and was easy to access. Great deal, better host!

Host was nice but this place was not, didn’t know it was a shared building locks unlock with just your finger nail bathroom is shared with random people so if your a young girl I highly don’t recommend didn’t know it was shared the rooms the size of a closest so no space to get ready, super noisy outside!
great cozy place, would definitely stay again.
Great host! Very clean place!
for a family of nine, we were all comfortable. location was convenient. we would definitely stay again!
As described; beautiful apartment in a fantastic area
Overall a great location with great views
Her place worked out great for our family in town for a wedding.
Great place to stay that is very close to navy pier. It was a wonderful time.

This was such a great find! Right in the heart of Boystown, there is endless fun and entertainment right outside your front door!

The setup is very unique, and if the rooms are full you will definitely hear and meet your housemates, so I can imagine who happens to be there at the same time as you can shape your experience.
Kind of hostel vibes though, which I appreciate. We met some nice people, but were also able to retreat to our room after a long day and night out and get cozy in a super comfy bed.
The space was very cozy and immaculately clean. Would definitely stay here again and recommend it to social and adventurous travelers!

We had a wonderful time in this Airbnb! The location was incredible, Wicker Park is very charming, friendly, and walkable. We ate at fabulous restaurants, walked everywhere, and loved the spacious, artsy  interior of this place. My favorite thing was the steam shower and the deep soak tub in the master bathroom.
Nice place, easy to get in and out of with good parking (one way street). Some upstairs creaking during day, but quiet at night. Well lit comfortable space.
Really enjoyed my stay at Hanna’s and would book again if I’m in Chicago! She was a very friendly and responsive host. I was set up with everything I needed!

Great place to stay! Very close to several bus stops, an Aldi, convenience store, and there were several local restaurants within walking distance. Victor was responsive, friendly, and answered any question I had! If we are ever back in Chicago, I would see if his place was available!
Location of this house is too nice and Room was also well cleaned and maintained

Rebecca was a wonderful host who went beyond what one normally expects in terms of hospitality and help. Her apartment is in a very charming 100-year old building two blocks away from the eastern edge of the University of Chicago campus, and closer than almost all conference hotels in Hyde Park if you're going to be in town for a conference there for a few days. She is very generous with use of her kitchen, which is well stocked with snacks and amenities. I drove and the free street parking was available on a summer weekend when I arrived. Beautiful walking neighborhoods on the way to the U. Would love to stay again when in Chicago.
Overall great experience. Great location. Place was clean and as advertised. Host was super helpful & responsive. 10 min walk to train. Would stay here again.

This place has great potential. The bedroom was reasonably spacious, but there were some downsides. I had trouble initially getting into the building (the lock didn't properly open – they needed to come and replace the batteries, which they thankfully did quickly), and the AC did not work. With some better upkeep, I think this would be a great place for those visiting the south side of UChicago.
Very responsive host.  Great location.   Highly recommended.

I stayed for three months and overall had a good experience. Ahmeena was a kind, communicative, and attentive host who genuinely cared about my comfort, which made the stay much smoother. The unit is walkable to a grocery store and the Green Line, making it convenient to commute downtown without a car. It’s also very close to the University of Chicago. That said, the location is in South Chicago, just outside Hyde Park, while it served my needs well, it wasn’t a neighborhood I personally felt comfortable walking around in, so I mostly used the space to sleep, eat, and study. It’s also a shared space with multiple roommates, which worked fine for me, but may not suit everyone’s preferences. Despite the longer commute to downtown, the pricing was very reasonable compared to Airbnbs in other areas. For anyone needing an affordable, short-term stay for school or work, this is a solid option, and Ahmeena’s responsiveness truly stood out and made a difference.
Thank you Cihan

Ann was a great host, went out of her way to help accommodate us. Parking was right out front and easy on their street. The location was great for us, with the train just north and the 606 bike path just south.  No complaints, Would stay here again.
Great place to stay and the hoat is responsive and helpful. Also, the place is well connected and is in a safe neighborhood.

This place was not only beautiful but very quiet.
The area was perfect to get to anything you need and most importantly the free zoo in Lincoln park! Its also maybe 15 min walk to the Oz park too. We loved out stay, 10 out of 10!!!!

Great place!

This place was great to stay at with a lot of people. We had enough rooms and gathering space for our entire party. Le'Dia was so response and helpful. She made everything so easy. There is a grocery store just a few blocks away. Very easy access to the L we took it all the way to a Cubs game.

Nathan’s place was great! Looked just like the pictures and was super clean. Was easy to find and check in. Nathan was very accommodating the whole time and was great at communication. He met me for check in and told me where I could park and showed me around the house. The room was perfect and had everything you need. Bed was super comfy. The place is located in a great location close to great restaurants. Would 100% stay here again if I ever need a place in Chicago.
Excellent host, safe, quiet and comfortable stay. Thanks Delia!

Overall, I had a nice stay. I do wish there was more/better parking in the neighborhood. When my daughter drove me to the unit, we had to park in a disabled space to unload my luggage. All the parking on the street is permit parking. We had the same issue when I left, even though it was a weekday morning and people SHOULD have been at work.
The neighborhood is nice. I felt safe as a woman traveling alone.
The unit is very clean and tastefully decorated. Lots of extra toiletries, plenty of towels, and nice little touches, like snack size bags of cookies, chips, etc. Also, instant coffee, tea, and hot chocolate. Plenty of paper products and disposable plates, cups, etc. , There was not one sharp knife in the place, which was very strange, since otherwise it was well stocked! Had to borrow a knife from my daughter to cut bread, vegetables, and the like. Market and quaint cafe close by!
One important note-there is a definite odor in the bedroom and bath. Maybe just basement smell?
Great base for our Chicago adventures

I booked Jeff’s place for my visiting family, and they had a great stay. The location is super convenient–close to transit, groceries, and shopping. The condo had everything they needed for a nearly 2-week stay. There was an A/C issue, but Jeff responded quickly. Neighbors upstairs and downstairs were very friendly. Overall, we were very satisfied. Jeff was a great and responsive host.
Very nice spot!
We had a great stay, everything was as described. The views from the penthouse were amazing! I would definitely stay here again.

Delia's place felt like visiting family.  Everyone was extremely friendly and welcoming, without being intrusive. Delia always had a bright smile on her face, and available to provide information on what to do in Chicago. As a remote worker the home provided the privacy and quiet needed and the Wi-Fi was awesome. The location is ideal for shopping, walking, and easy accessibility to getting downtown. I never had an issue finding parking, even coming home in the early morning. This would definitely be my go to place anytime I'm visiting Chicago.

The place was well stocked with kitchen items which made our family gathering a hit. The beds were comfortable and the back patio was great for meals and relaxing. Jeff was very responsive and helpful. The location is great especially if traveling without a car.
Came in for a work conference and it was perfect home away from home. Enjoyed my stay.
Great place
I have no complaints
Another fantastic stay. Milan was quick to respond if I needed anything loved the communication this was my second stay here and I would definitely be back. Thank you so much.
very nice and responsible host! I’d like to come back next time!

We enjoyed our stay. The kitchen could have been better prepared with a drip coffee maker, a toaster and a cookie sheet.

Great place! Close to everything! Host was super nice and around to show us around.
It’s older so the floor creeks and the AC takes a while to cool but after we got used to the house it felt like home
Great place!

Estuve varios días en Chicago y creo que el lugar es perfecto, está literalmente a 15 minutos del centro se la ciudad, es fácil llegar, con una sola línea de Metro y este funciona las 24h, el espacio es limpio, cómodo y con todas las comodidades necesarias para sentirse a gusto en la estadía. Yo lo recomiendo 100%
Very spacious, clean and great area. Host was very responsive.

Josh’s place was great. There were 9 of us in town to tour wrigley and catch a game. 20 min walk to stadium. In a great area and the unit was everything described. Part of the group got in early in the morning and were allowed to drop off bags and check in an hour early. We’d stay here again if ever visiting. Great time exploring Chicago.
Had a great stay! Keenan was a helpful and responsive host. The place was clean, comfortable, and just as described. Thanks for the hospitality!
The perfect base to explore Andersonville. Charlie was very responsive and the room was clean and provided easy access to this vibrant, walkable neighbourhood.
It has what you need, and I notice Viktor is super responsive and makes sure you have all the check in details considering he has a lot of guests (according to airbnb)
Clean and spacious

Gleatha made the entire experience wonderful! She assisted us with directions, joined us for a good laugh, and helped make our stay very comfortable! Taking a right - We enjoyed a short walk to the lake, even to Hyde Park and the science museum. It was real easy to hop on a divvy bike to get back. Then to the left only 0.6 miles to a nice big grocery store.
We will come back! Thx Gleatha!

Here is a summary of just some of the issues: (1) the only way to access the rental was through a steep set of stairs on the outside of the building with no covering. For someone with arthritis in my knees and back issues, this was a painful climb several times a day. 2) a copyable key was provided in a lock box. Anyone who has had access to the key could return to the rental unit to steal things or attack the occupants. In addition, the neighbor was tying down a long pole across the walkway and hanging their wet clothes to dry. The only way to reach the door was to bend down and crawl under the pole and wet clothes. 3) Third, as the unit was absolutely filthy, including the bathroom, kitchen, floors, and linens, I was very uncomfortable. I took many pictures of the filth, especially in the bathroom. 4) Fourth, the furnace, which was in the center of the rental, was extremely loud. 5) the rental lacked essentials that would be expected (toilet paper, sponges for cleaning dishes, etc.).

I stayed at Melissa’s place for three months during my third-year clinical rotations, and I couldn't have asked for a better experience. The home was clean, tidy, and well-maintained, with a comfortable setup that made it easy to settle in and focus on my studies. Melissa is truly a fantastic host—kind, thoughtful, and always available if any issues came up. The monthly cleaning service was a huge plus and helped keep everything fresh and organized. I felt well taken care of throughout my stay and would absolutely recommend this place to anyone looking for a reliable, peaceful home away from home.
Great location, train stations within walking distance

First the good stuff, location is spectacular for games at Wrigley field and walks to the lake and restaurants. The home is spacious and fit 8 adults without feeling on top of each other. Communication during check in was great with quick responses to questions during the first day or two.
Now the not so great stuff, communication was spotty at best as our week went on and we had other issues including one bed which needed repair and made for a terrible week of sleep for one of our guests. By the last day the host finally responded and said we would get a credit on our stay but that still has not happened as of this writing (4 days after check out). We also told the host about a bedroom light that was hanging by wires off the ceiling fan in one of the bedrooms, no response. It also was not clear to us that 2 of the bedrooms are in the basement, dark and no windows.
And yes, the train is right on top of the building and very loud.
All in all it did the job, but I wouldn't return.
Easy to get to. Easy entry. The place was clean and in great order. Plenty of street parking right in front of the building.

Our stay was great with great communication. Only one really rough evening for about an hour when trash was collected. It was impossible to sleep during that time, otherwise a great experience.

The location was perfect. Everything is walkable. The room was quiet, cozy and clean. My only complaint is the shower, which cycled from boiling hot to freezing no matter what the temperature was set at.

Overall this is a beautiful place to stay. There are great views, a fun floor plan, easy drive to hwy 41, and walking distance to the lake. We were able to have a floor for each family to have privacy and still have a great shared living space on the 2nd floor with the kitchen. The kids loved to run up and down the three flights of stairs, stopping to take in the views from each balcony. It's worth mentioning the train tracks are right next to the home and when the windows were open and the train drove by, it was very noisy, but not too bad when all closed up. Trains don't run as often at night and we didn't notice them too much after falling asleep. The host was great with quick response time.
I believe written instructions available in the room would be helpful.

We enjoyed our stay here for my daughter's graduation weekend. The neighborhood felt very safe and the park across the street is wonderful. Street parking was never a problem. I would stay here again.
Quiet place to live in the busy and lousy Chicago city!

Great long term stay. So close to the University and public transportation. I stayed for a couple of months with my school-age daughter and was very comfortable. We rarely heard/saw our roommates unless we sought them out. Fantastic stay, overall! Would definitely stay again.

I enjoyed my stay. The place has lots of space . Perfect for families. I would definitely stay again.

The place was everything we needed. We had lots of privacy and lots of space to unwind and relax. The location was good, we were able to explore a part of Chicago they was very local and had lots of well known eatery’s. Overall we would stay at Raymond’s again if we could. Him and his wife were very nice and communicated fast.

This is an absolutely beautiful, spacious, immaculate apartment in a three-story home on a lovely street in the charming north Chicago neighborhood of Andersonville. The 2nd floor apartment is large, light filled, and beautifully furnished and appointed. The hosts live on the third floor, and John was an uber-host, offering a clothing steamer, extra towels, even offering to get us groceries ahead of time. He was available the entire time, gave us local recommendations, and often checked in to make sure we had everything we needed. The three bedrooms had super comfy beds and were conducive to a beautiful night of sleep. The kitchen is spacious and stocked with whatever tools, pans, dishes you might need. We couldn't find a dirt speck in the entire place -- absolutely immaculate. We have never stayed in such a well-kept airBnB. The garden in back is also charming. Enjoy!

Geneva’s place is a gem! 💎 Located within such easy access to both trains and buses, this AirBnB was also clean and quiet. I especially enjoyed the neighborhood and Genovas presence. She has excellent communication skills and delivered amenities when they had run out.
Price wise this is a steal, and I will definitely be staying here in my future Chicago endeavors. Thanks, Genova!
was a nice location and very easy to get around place.
Host was extremely kind & helpful made my stay exceptional!
Lovely apartment block with sensational HUGE gym and great pool and spa.  Stephanie was very responsive and helpful.
The place was amazing just as described the area was very nice and quiet ! Will definitely book again next time we are in town
It was a great stay! The house is really nice and clean. It's close to the train that goes downtown and to the airport.

We came to Chicago for the first time and consider ourselves very lucky with the apartment.
Firstly, the hosts are very attentive and responsive, everything in the apartment is thought out to the smallest detail, which allowed us to enjoy life while traveling.
Secondly, the convenient location: a direct subway line to the city center in 20 minutes. The same subway line in the opposite direction brings you to the magnificent Oak Park, where the Hemingway House and Museum and the Frank Lloyd Wright House and Studio are located. Oak Park also has many architectural masterpieces by Wright.
In addition, morning coffee on the veranda among the greenery adds charm to this apartment.
Thanks to Robert, Twania and Todd for our great stay.

Nicole’s place was a truly cheerful home. It's located in a very quiet neighborhood, and we felt right at home. It’s nice to have a place you can come home to relax. It was convenient to visit both Chicago & Evanston!
I enjoyed this stay for my 31st birthday 🎉 very nice place . Clean , quiet, and pretty lol. No complaints at all . I will definitely book again with her. Thanks !

Nat originally provided directions and keypad codes that sent us into a rental unit that was occupied by someone else. Luckily, they were not in the unit at the time, and we left once seeing it was occupied.
Nat also provided unclear instructions regarding check-in time. We were booked for Thursday arrival, and for some reason she thought we were talking about a Sunday. I am not sure how she came to think of this. Originally, Nat waived the early check-in fee, but after the miscommunication, Nat revoked it in retaliation. I was completely respectful through the whole discussion and apologized for the miscommunication repeatedly. Nat kept fueling the discussion multiple times after I accepted the normal check-in and tried to end the back and forth.
The staircase leading to the units is also unsafe for the elderly or someone with poor balance. The railings are not attached to the wall, and held together with wire, and the stairs are very steep.
The unit was clean.

great location, especially if your going to a Cubs game .
clean , comfortable

Great location. Not far from downtown and locals. Quiet clean neighborhood, in a LI area some noise but during working hours. The stay was perfect and allowed me to be mins away from family.
The place was located in beautiful Lincoln Park, great places to eat and transportation within walking distance. Very quiet, comfortable, well equipped

Beautiful home! Clean with plenty of amenities. Street parking was easy. Host lives upstairs and was very responsive and nice. Would have family stay here again! Thank- you neighbor ( I live 3 blocks away).

Kymi’s place was just as the listing said. We were drawn to her place because of the 2 1/2 bathrooms, large bedrooms and historic setting. We had a car so that made transportation easy, but it’s also within walking distance of the train. Highly recommend this place!
Great space. Nice and big and sufficiently clean. Good location and with included parking, ya can’t beat it. Sorry for leaving the garage open for a bit!

Fabulous location, safe, walkable, great restaurants and coffee shops nearby. Close to the beach and perfect for first time visitors to Chicago.
The upstairs bed was really comfortable in your own private apt. There is a shared entry way and you can hear the comings and goings of others. Hosts were excellent communicators with clear directions and quick in their responses including great parking advice. Though you don’t need a car if you are just exploring Chicago.
This was a return visit for us to stay at Emily's place.  We love staying in this apartment when we visit Chicago.  Thank you Emily
Great location within downtown Chicago. I will definitely repeat.
One of the nicest places I have stayed at. Beds are as comfortable as the hotel rooms. No smells and kitchen is so clean

Cam’s place was a great find — spacious, clean, and surprisingly quiet despite being on a busy street. The photos don’t do justice to how much room there is. The layout is unconventional but adds character, and everything is well thought out. The kitchen is fully stocked, there are plenty of towels, and the TV area is perfect for relaxing, comes with private parking. Located in a safe neighborhood just minutes from the Orange Line, it’s super convenient for getting around Chicago. I already miss this place — absolutely worth every penny.
Michael always responds to any question, great place.
Great experience! We did set off fire alarm as it is above kitchen so sorry about that! Great for our extended family - everyone could have a private space or gather together. Incredible patio!!

Thank you for a very pleasant stay in a great location. Apart from a couple of minor misses (incomplete cleanup from prior guests and a tripping hazard in the kitchen) we were very happy with our visit.

I absolutely loved that this place was on the basement portion of the floor! The beautiful wall decor was a nice touch it was anime themed. Samsung products in the home were awesome, and the beds were all soft i felt right at home. I had parking right out in front everytime i came back to the house and the next door neighbor was really nice he always spoke when he saw us!
Jason's place was very charming, comfortable in a great, peaceful neighborhood where you can walk to restaurants and bars, and it is just a 10 min drive to Downtown. We truly enjoyed the stay.

Perfect stay. Spacious appartement. Everything you need to feel at home. Friendly and responsive host. Clean. Neighbourhood wasn’t the best, experienced some disturbances at night. Overall would definitely recommend!
Emanuel was very nice and communicative, he ensured all our needs were met during our stay. House was clean and quite and our group enjoyed our time in Chicago

Mrs Jean was very helpful and had very clear instructions on what to do to get in. Once inside she had a folder with everything you needed to know about using the laundry room shared areas ect. Nice place.
Such a wonderful host and an amazing place to stay. Felt like a home away from home. Couldn’t recommend more!

Very great stay, it was everything I needed and more.

Had an amazing stay at the MGM property on Airbnb! The living room was super comfortable and spacious, perfect for relaxing after a long day. Check-in and check-out were a breeze, made the whole experience seamless. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a hassle-free and cozy stay. Will definitely book again!

Our second stay at Walker's Paradise was as good as, if not better, than our first! Our group of 5 felt comfortable in our rooms and common areas. The charm of an historic building was evident throughout - original wood floors, high ceilings, and period hardware added to the atmosphere without sacrificing modern conveniences. The kitchen had all the necessities. Neighborhood was quiet. The accessible garage was a great feature!
Nice stay in quiet lovely neighborhood.  Host was very responsive and took great care of us

We had a great stay at Rizwan's place.  It was very convenient for our family of 8.  There was plenty of space and it was clean and comfortable.  The location was a little farther than we expected but it was still close enough to do everything we wanted to do.  Rizwan was was very kind and communicative!

This apartment is really spacious with beautiful natural light.  It's decorated in a really lovely way and it was very peaceful with beautiful plants everywhere and 2 light-filled sun rooms on both the front and back end. Tiffany was very fast to respond to any questions that I had.  We'll definitely stay here again if we are in Chicago.
My son is very happy with his stay at Evelyn’s place. Evelyn is very easy to communicate and very helpful. Thanks Evelyn!
Great place!  Maria was very responsive and everything was as described!  We appreciated the short walk to the L for easy travel into the city!

We had a relaxing stay at Monica‘s for three nights. It’s in a cool neighborhood close to some good restaurants, shops and good coffee. The location was quiet and the bed was comfortable. Some thoughtful touches in the room too.
We crossed paths with Monica a few times; she was always warm, friendly and great to chat with.

Glad we found this rental property.  Location was perfect in between DePaul and Clark street.  Hosts were very responsive.  Plenty of space for 8 people to sleep.  All the rooms were nice, including the kitchen, but the back deck was our favorite spot.  I would stay here again if we had another big group.
Very smooth and convenient experience! Easy to communicate

We had such a nice stay with our family. It’s in a very walkable family safe area with shops and restaurants galore. We most appreciated the sunny living and kitchen area and enjoyed the balcony where we watched all the dog walkers and strollers strolling! The primary bedroom and bath is lovely and our daughter enjoyed the bunk beds, alternating between upper and lower.

5 stars are not enough to rate our stay with Gerard and Ernie.  Our room and common areas were spotless and well maintained, safe, and comfortable to return to after busy days in Chicago.  They are both knowledgeable and enthusiastic about their neighborhood and what was happening in Chicago while we were there.  Their recommendations added ease and enjoyment to our activities.  We've rarely felt so genuinely welcomed by any other airbnb host.  Every comfort or need was anticipated and provided for.   We're looking forward to a return stay.
Areeba was very kind.
The place was perfect for our group. Lots of beds and still a nice sized living space. Centrally located in all the northern neighborhoods of Chicago.

The space speaks for itself - clean, spacious, cozy, green! We enjoyed the small outside sitting area, the peaceful tree-lined street, the kitchen, and the big couch / TV in the living room. We were 5 adults and felt very comfortable during our visit. I'd also like to note that from check-in to check-out, Olabisi and Aishah's written / photo instructions were clear, and they were communicative. I felt that the house rules / expectations / quiet hours were all very reasonable.
A great place to stay if you LOVE cats!
Great open and airy space. Great value for being in Chicago.

Incredible apartment with lovely hosts in beautiful Bronzeville!! Easy to find and super accessible, lots of bus to Metra, easy walk to green or red line.
I was staying here as my apartment in Chicago was being renovated and it really ended up feeling like a little getaway in the city. I will definitely be recommending Jailyns place to any travellers coming to visit Chicago !!

Very nice place to stay overnight. Expect a lot of door slamming outside the unit.

My husband and I stayed in this apartment for three nights on business. It’s just a stone’s throw away from Wells Street, where you’ll find plenty of bars and restaurants. The apartment is a good size for a couple. The bathroom overlooks a popular restaurant’s outdoor dining area, but we used our phones’ white noise machines to drown out the noise, which wasn’t an issue at all. There’s a large, open-air, paid parking lot just two blocks away.
However, the foyer is quite dingy and dirty, with stained carpet throughout the stairwell. But don’t worry, once you step inside the apartment, it’s spotless. I wouldn’t call this place “luxury” because the bed is very thin (both my husband and I felt the coils every night), the towels are old and thin, and the furniture is cheap and/or inexpensive. The space and layout of the apartment are unusual, but they could be better utilized.
On the bright side, the balcony was very pleasant. Hatice was exceptionally responsive, and eager to improve.
Great stay, easy access to the city and great view from the pool.

The view is awesome, being on the top floor is a big perk and location is great. For the price definitely expected beds to be comfortable (very firm uncomfortable mattresses). It's always nice to have a place to set down personal belongings, but one bedroom didn't have any dresser just two very small nightstands and closet. No hooks in either bathroom which made it difficult to hang up towels or clothes, the bar above the toilet just isn't enough for a few towels and washcloths to dry adequately. The personal host was a very nice touch, but unfortunately the key fab didn't work so we had to ask the front desk staff to let us up the elevator every time we came into the building. Thankfully they were each very nice, but it definitely felt like we were annoying them. Overall the unit is pretty modern, but shows a lot of wear and tear from rentals. Felt deceived by the "host" being listed as Jason, yet this unit is managed by a rental mgmt company. Personally would not stay here again.

The place was quaint and had all amenities needed for a comfortable stay. Kitchen was well kept and had good size for being in it daily. Bathroom was big and host provided towels and linens. Comfortable beds and easy good size rooms. I would definitely stay again for my next visit. The host was very nice and helpful. Thank you
Nicole’s place was brilliant and Nicole was an excellent. Very helpful and responsive
This was a great space for our Chicago weekend. Beautiful home with big bedrooms. Note: there are lots of stairs so be prepared for that! Will definitely rebook in the future.

Very spacious and cozy. It felt like home and had all the essentials. The space was peaceful and everything I needed Justin had stocked up already. I’d love to stay again in the future !

This was a great spot for our family of three with a toddler. We used the (semi) heated pool space, the fire pit every night, and were very walkable to most all things you need and want, or a quick train or bus away. Loved the simplicity of the space and the storage while traveling for five nights and lots of activities (so many changes of clothes), was top notch!

This is a great spot for a longer term rental. I stayed here two months while taking classes at Second City, about a 20 minute walk. The apartment is comfortable, nicely furnished and the host very responsive. The location is great; there are a couple of restaurants and a local market a block away and a Target two blocks. The neighborhood is a beautiful, quiet residential area with lots of people walking kids and dogs. One of the nicest, more unique features of this apartment is the patio in front which is decorated with flowers and a wonderful place to sit and visit.
I have no hesitation recommending this Airbnb!

We enjoyed our stay here. We felt safe and the home was very clean. The kitchen had everything you need if you desire to cook at home. Our host was very accommodating us and allowing us to check in earlier which was extremely helpful! We will definitely come back again!

Why aren't all host like this? It's a family approach. Who has pizza and a sip while getting to know you and your expectations of your stay? Who makes sure you feel at home? The culmination of my stay was marked by my host and son giving me a Father's Day card and gift. I was in awe as well as very appreciative. My stay was remnant of the original BNB feel. Truly a winner and a hidden gem. Will definitely book again.

We had a great stay at JR’s place. The apartment is perfect for two people, with a comfortable bed and a fully equipped kitchen. The neighborhood is residential and much quieter compared to other areas in Chicago, which we really appreciated. There’s a supermarket about 10 minutes away and the Blue Line is a 15-minute walk. JR was always quick to respond to our messages. Highly recommended!
Wonderful stay!  Clean, comfortable, well appointed!

Lovely clean spacious accommodation in a great location with close proximity to metro and buses and local grocery store (Mariano’s). Very comfortable beds and great aircon.
Host was very responsive and very helpful with any queries we had throughout our stay..
Great cooking facilities and very clean throughout.
Would highly recommend it
