Brad's home was extremely comfortable. great communication. safe location. will definitely rebook when we're back in Chicago. can't say enough about the positives.

John is an awesome host, super friendly and responsive. Tackled any minor inconveniences immediately, even we accidentally locked ourselves out lol. Area is super safe, peaceful, and walking distance to anywhere you could want to go. 10/10 Recommend

Nice living space with a historic home feel.  Easily walkable to Lincoln Square restaurants and shops.   Convenient access to metro and connection to downtown Chicago.   I was concerned about finding street parking but was able to easily find parking close to the house.   I would definitely look to stay at this property for future visits.
beautiful apartment, airy and comfortable.  Gerrit was great.  would recommend.

My husband and I have returned to Thomas’s lovely home again and again, it’s such a comfortable and welcoming space. Tom is a wonderful host, and he makes sure that everything you could possibly need to feel at home is well stocked. The tree lined neighborhood is peaceful, and very walkable. We feel so fortunate to have found this gem, and we will always hope to return.
Nice comfortable apartment. Several restaurants / bars a close walk nearby.

love this place! in a good area for walking but just far enough outside the city that you avoid major traffic. very cozy place.
(:
Place is as described. Great communication. Great neighborhood. Would definitely stay again.
Great host. Made traveling for business easy.
Great shower!!

Great location in the heart of Chicago. The building has top-notch amenities—loved the pool, fitness center, and especially the indoor basketball court. Cloud 9, as always, made everything seamless and perfect. Highly recommend!
Very responsive host and great location

Ran was always there when I needed something during my extended stay spanning 8 months. Everything brought to his attention was solved and handled very quickly and professionally. Great place to University of Chicago workers or students.
Great stay

Shaun and Christina were very helpful and responsive throughout our stay. The location can't be beat—you're in the heart of Avondale with a short walk to Logan Square. Just a half block from Central Park Bar and a bit further is one of my favorite cafes in the city, Sipping Turtle.
The place was as it was described
Our stay was great! The unit was clean and in a great location. The host was super responsive and friendly.
This was our second stay with Candace and it was just as good as the first one. It's a very walkable location and we had an enjoyable stay.
Great stay!

We met our friends in Chicago for the Blues Festival. The location was close to public transportation which we used for the entire week we were there. After a long day out, we enjoyed coming back to relax and have a drink outside. Beautiful quiet neighborhood.
Nice place to stay.
Definitely a great spot to stay!

Looks like the pictures and is very spacious. Safe neighborhood. Free parking in the back. Host is helpful. 25-30mins to downtown Chicago and 30 mins to ORD airport. 15min walk to the beach. Easy access to lakeshore drive. Good restaurants options within 2miles radius. Worth the price and would recommend staying here.

Cristina’s place was amazing- precisely like the pictures. The place provided everything needed for a long stay. The Airbnb was also a 15 minute metro ride away from downtown. I personally didn’t feel safe walking around the area alone; would recommend coming with/walking around the area in a group. Otherwise, it was a perfect stay.

The place was in a great location, great condition, and Beca was very responsive. Pretty spot too. The only issue was working the oven, but I’m sure she would’ve answered if I asked. We just used the burners instead.
Great place!

Needed safe, simple, non-fussy and affordable lodging for a longer solo vacation (11 days) in the city to do different activities around the city but also work remotely for several days. This place was a perfect fit in all ways! There were other guests staying at the property (plus the owner, Joey for a few days) and everything went smoothly, considerately, and stayed quiet, calm, comfy, and clean. Slept great thanks to mattress quality, window fan/AC unit, and ceiling fan. Remote Work went great thanks to big desk and mini fridge in room. Street parking was the easiest and safest of any of my trips to Chicago with a car for 15+ years.

My stay at Evelyn’s place was fabulous and Evelyn is such a great host! First class. Very friendly atmosphere.
The home is cozy and clean and artistic. Evelyn is so friendly and makes it very easy to be sharing a home with her. She gave me lots of local happenings recommendations for things to do.
The area is so perfect for walking anywhere and right near public transit
I would not hesitate to book here again

Larry's place would have been the utmost get away spot for us but for the fact that Larry provided everything to make a visitor comfortable but there was no MICROWAVE. Also, all the TVs could not come on except in the back room. These are really minor for me as long as I have a microwave. To make matters worse, Larry is not responsive and could have checked the visitors the next day to see how things were going. For that reason, my family and I would give Larry a 4 star rating.

I had the pleasure of staying at this cozy apartment on S Luella Ave during a recent trip to Chicago, and it was a delightful experience. The unit was clean, spacious, and had a great mix of vintage character and modern upgrades. Hardwood floors, a full kitchen, and comfortable bedding made it feel like a home away from home.
The location is in the South Shore neighborhood, which has more of a neighborhood feel than downtown. We still found the location very accessible with commute to downtown via car only 15 - 20 mins without traffic. Also minutes away is access to the following locations: the beautiful lakefront where you can ride your bike, go running or take a relaxing evening stroll. Jackson Park golf course, the historic South Shore Cultural Center & Rainbow Beach are less than 10mins away. There’s even a free rock climbing park tucked away close by! If you’re looking for a
Shopping & Dining experience away from downtown the historic Hyde Park neighborhood won’t disappoint!
It’s been a nice stay, the apartment was quite empty and lacked some essentials (wardrobe, desks..) but the area was quite tranquil and the space was nice.
Great stay in Chicago!

Staying in Aqua building, one of the most famous buildings in Chicago, was a real treat. We loved it! It is a beautiful and extra secure place. It has a receptionist 24/7.
We were on the 47th floor, and the view is amazing!
The apartment is equipped with everything necessary for a long stay, and most important for us, it has a great working space with fast Wi-Fi for my husband who works remotely.
Drew is a great host. We had an issue with unusually cold weather in Chicago. The building administration had turned off the heater, and the apartment was really cold. I notified Drew, and he brought two portable heaters that solved the problem. We needed more plates and cups, so I told Drew, and he brought plenty right away. He is really attentive and friendly. He even brought us a bag of the famous Chicago Garrett popcorn. We were pleasantly surprised with his nice gesture.
This building is located near the river and all the popular attractions in a beautiful and safe area.
Very responsive host in a perfect location. Loved that it was a quite neighborhood woth parking close by. Made it easy for a day trip into the city!

The garden apartment was in a beautiful area of Lakeview. Close to the wonderful restaurants and coffee places on Lincoln Avenue, Sheffield, Belmont, Clark and Halsted. Restfall color in apartment. Everything thoughtfully assembled and arranged. Lovely touches - like bags of laundry detergent and quarters. Easy to get in.

Bucktown House was perfect in every way. It was spotless, well stocked and the bed and robes were comfy and luxurious. The neighborhood was quiet and delightful and the adjoining garden gorgeous. It’s within walking distance of the blue line, a wonderful corner bar and the 606 elevated walking path.
Great location. 3rd floor walk up with balcony. Can’t beat it!
It is a nice and clean place, exactly as expected!

I cannot express how beautiful this place is! We were a little hesitant about the area just because it was me and my sister and nobody else but the minute we got into the neighborhood we felt right at home. The pictures were exactly what we got when we walked in. Everything was thoroughly noted and we had no confusion on what we needed to do as a tenant staying at the home. I plan to do an annual trip to Chicago and if this unit is available, I will be picking it every single time!

Nice place to stay with easy access to public transportation and public parking available, mostly quiet and very clean.
If you are not used to light noises like cars or planes passing by “close”, bring a shusher. To me these noises are natural and I can filter them out, but I can understand how a light sleeper might have troubble with it.
Host is very nice and very responsive
The place was located in a very nice and safe area with great restaurants and easy access to public transportation. Cihan was a great host and provided clear directions.

This place was really nice and described accurately. The hosts were very responsive and attentive! The only negative is that it was at least 30 minutes from the main attractions in the city but I’ll place that blame on myself for not doing extensive research. However, I would stay here again and explore this specific neighborhood. It was quiet and peaceful which is important to a southern girl like myself. Highly recommend.
Very quiet, very nice place. The owners are really nice, always helping me whenever possible. The location is also close to restaurants and markets. Very convenient.
Nice residential neighborhood. Good easy parking. Very clean. Exactly as pictured on the listing. Perfect location for our Chicago vacation and to attend our daughter’s location from UChicago.

Tuve una excelente experiencia en este Airbnb. El lugar estaba muy limpio, cómodo y tal como se muestra en las fotos. La ubicación era perfecta, cerca de todo lo que necesitábamos. El anfitrión fue muy amable, respondió rápido a los mensajes y nos hizo sentir bienvenidos. Definitivamente volvería a hospedarme aquí. ¡Gracias por todo!

Very good value for the price! Also having the 2 condos right next to each other allowed us to keep separated when we needed alone time and still gather and talk when we wanted. The stairway to the underground depths was interesting… but overall the place was clean and easy to access!
It eas a great place to stay! Close to so many popping places!  Bryan was receptive to all our needs! Loved the extra touches with the toiletries!
Beautiful and spacious condo, in a very walkable neighborhood.
Beautiful little apartment nestled in the nicest neighborhood.
Perfect place to stay at when visiting Chicago
The entire stay was amazing
Great place in an amazing neighborhood. Silvia is a fantastic host.
Great location with easy communication with host! Apartment is well decorated and stocked with kitchen essentials. It’s in an older building but the street is pretty quiet and it’s in a great spot.

Esmirna is one of the sweetest hosts I’ve ever had the pleasure of meeting. She is an extremely gracious host and will make sure you feel at home and comfortable the entire time. I feel grateful to have stayed with her. Her kindness made me feel safe and supported during my stay. Would absolutely book with her again.
Extremely attentive and friendly. Very accommodating for an early check in. Responsive to inquiries. CLEAN place with nice things and no clutter. I appreciate those things. Would stay again.
It's nice and fabulous.

A great neighborhood, never had any problems during our two-week stay. The apartment looks exactly like the pictures. The laundry is $2 on the ground floor. Everything was clean and nice. No noise, the bed was soft and comfortable. Had a minor problem with hot water which was quickly fixed. Overall a great stay.

I loved staying at Valeriy's house for the week! It is so close to the Pink Line that I was able to comfortably get around the city. When returning later in the evening, I could take the Blue Line down far enough that I could then take a 10 min Uber ride the rest of the way back.
I also really appreciated that I was able to extend my stay for one more day when it was super last minute. I will definitely come back!
Great place in a quiet area. Perfect spot to commute to the city. The host was very responsive and provided great recommendations!

Spacious, quiet location, comfortable, and stylish. The home is west of Hyde Park, actually Washington Park. Close enough. Owners were responsive to questions. Home could use a drip coffee maker, but otherwise we had everything we needed.
Perfect place for our vacation.
Great location with many restaurants nearby.

The stay was great! Plenty of restaurants around for eating out, and lots of pans to cook with when you’re wanting a home meal. The location is very neat and nice, and an easy commute for anything more inside the city. Great stay!
I had a wonderful stay with my family.

The Good:
Spacious and very clean place. Comfortable beds. Quiet. Good AC/heater. Justin was pleasant and provided information. Overall good value for the space.
Room for improvement:
Response time is typically a few hours. That's mostly OK, but some times a problem (like when we waited for the wifi password).
There are no provisions to make coffee/tea and no shampoo/conditioner/body in the shower. Those things were not listed in the amenities, but they are such a standard in the dozens of Airbnbs I stayed in that I was surprised.
The bad:
The neighborhood does not feel safe and walkable. 2 separate Uber drivers advised us (unprompted) not to walk there.
If you are just there to sleep and then drive/uber in and out that should be fine.

Very beautiful comfortable clean apartment! Felt cost and right at home, love how the place is decorated. Friendly helpful responsive host! Very cute neighborhood, we enjoyed taking our dogs out for walks, so many beautiful flowers everywhere. Love the pretty houses.
Very comfortable beds, very nice big bathroom, well stocked. Kitchen has everything to cook food. Quiet neighborhood, 10-15 min walk to restaurants and shops. Strongly recommended!
Very clean! Stocked with everything you could need to cook a meal. Comfy beds. Really nice bathrooms. Very communicative.
There was some confusion about the spaces that I was renting. Two spaces available and it wasn’t clear what I was booking.

Stay!
This is hands down one of the best Airbnbs I’ve ever stayed in—clean, peaceful, and clearly cared for with love. The hosts genuinely go above and beyond to make sure their guests feel welcome and comfortable. You can tell they take pride in both their space and how they treat people.
Everything was exactly as described, and I felt safe, relaxed, and taken care of during my entire stay. It’s the kind of place that leaves a good feeling with you even after you leave. I’d absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone coming to the area.
Thank you again for a wonderful experience!

Luis was proactive, responsive, and eager to make my stay as pleasant and easy as possible. He was very welcoming and left personal touches and lots of snacks around the apartment. The apartment itself was well-appointed, with more cooking supplies in the kitchen than I've ever seen in an Airbnb. The place was immaculate. The neighborhood felt safe, even when I came back late at night. It was very close to a bus stop, easy to navigate by car, and several grocery stores close by. I can absolutely recommend this Airbnb.
A lovely house in a lovely neighborhood, with a friendly and helpful host.

The price definitely allows this place to be super convenient. What I loved the most was the neighborhood. I was a solo traveler and felt so safe casually walking the streets to go down to the local cafés to catch breakfast or a walk around the nearby parks. There was always parking available every night. It wasn’t too far from the city. Prime location for me, and the things that I had planned to do while in Chicago.

Lilian was great! The rental was the cleanest I have ever stayed in. Fully stocked kitchen, including spices and oil. Washer, dryer, comfy mattress, grocery across the street, gated parking, private back yard. Lilian was responsive through the app within an hour and answered cell immediately.
If I could have stayed longer, I absolutely would have, and hope to book it again!

Awesome communication, the host over goes above and beyond With response time and accommodation. Home was clean and convenient to everywhere I wanted to go as a driver. Train station is literally around the corner. Free parking, Just be mindful of the cleaning days on which side of the street to park on. Home is just like pictures, neighborhood looks like gentrification but I had no issues as a single mom. Nice parks and laid-back neighborhood. Only con a kid stays upstairs If you're a light sleeper. I definitely would stay again. Hidden Gem
Konakladığımız süre boyunca keyif aldık. Merkezi konumda olması harikaydı. Güzeldi. Tavsiye ederim.

Staying at one of Elizabeth’s Airbnbs was an immense pleasure. She was very kind, and my friend and I appreciated how much she checked-in with us during our stay to make sure we were comfortable. I’ve traveled quite a bit, and Elizabeth was by far the best host I have ever met. I cannot recommend her enough. You’re in good hands.

Really enjoyed my stay in Mark’s quiet, well-appointed garden unit. The location can’t be beat! Communication was easy and quick. I had to work a bit during my stay and the Wifi was fast and reliable. Highly recommend and would happily stay again.
Great host who communicates within a timely manner. Adjusted well to our needs as guests and was flexible with our requests.

What a lovely place to stay. Lady Delia showed us her turtles and had a beautiful cat. She was very friendly and talkative. She drove us to get bus passes when we didn’t know where to get them. Jeffrey jump was a convenient bus to get from her place to the city very quickly. The bathroom had the window creaked open which made it smell like the coast in the mornings. The house is a historic bungalow which gave it a very different look and feel from what I’m used to. Spent some beautiful morning strolls along the neighborhood and got to see the beautiful architecture in the city; overall was worth what we paid.
Ideal location. Friendly family. Flexible check-in and check-out times.
Luke & Ligia were great--always responsive and friendly! I'd happily stay here again in the future!!
Can’t say enough wonderful things about Daryl and his place!! This was our second stay in this lovely place!. It felt like we were at home. I give 10 stars!

Jake was incredibly nice and a great host. The apartment was super clean and had everything we needed at a good price. It’s a really nice walk into China Town as well which was a great way to spend the day.

The best view in Chicago!  The rooms were very spacious, the kitchen was updated and well stocked, location central to everything.  We loved our time here, loved spending time on the balconies, and would definitely come back.

Brad was very friendly and extremely responsive to issues and questions. The location of this flat on the middle floor of his three-flat complex
was perfect for our venue! His place was as pictured and very nice. I wasn't able to control the thermostat and room temperature from my flat though, and Brad did his best to accommodate our temperature needs by adjusting the centrally-controlled complex thermostat located in his flat above us where he resides. This type of thermostat setup was a first-time
experience for me in an Airbnb rental or in any other hotel or house or apt or resort I've rented over the years during my travels.
My family enjoyed Sameer’s place for a graduation weekend. It was open, spacious and had everything that you needed. Everyone loved the place and the thoughtful , playful  design …just fun!

The house is located is a quiet, somewhat secluded neighborhood on the south side of town. While this is not a drawback, you do have to plan a bit for any excursion that includes going downtown or the north side. On the other hand, the house was clean and did appear exactly as pictured. The host was responsive to all of my messages and was able to help when needed.

Tony’s place was exactly as described and more. Laid out perfectly for great family or friends time. EXCELLENT location for a Cubs game. Lovely, walkable neighborhood-close to shopping, dining and anything you could want. Will definitely stay there again, if in the area.
Thank you for having me!
Nice area not far from the city house spotless clean. Host very friendly and responsive to questions I had highly recommend

Our stay was wonderful and relaxing the home was clean and inviting. The hot tub was so nice to soak in after a long day. There is a rug in the living room that is pretty slippery and posed a tripping hazard but other than that it was definitely worth the money! It was super nice there wasn’t a huge list of chores to do when exiting just normal clean up and there is a Mexican restaurant within walking distance that we ate at numerous times during our trip. Overall I would definitely stay again!
very friendly and definitely the most communitive
Great place to stay! Check-in was easy and the host was responsive.

David was an amazing host. We didn’t have any issues while there but he was very responsive when we had questions about where things were located. The place was extremely clean. We would definitely stay at any property he hosts again.

Martha was so friendly and so responsive. Coming back to her place was just the perfect way to end the day. Super quiet and peaceful but close enough to everything that you want to do while staying in Chicago. I highly recommend staying here and hope to do so again in the future.

This is a great place to stay in Chicago, very convenient to the public transportation, grocery stores and restaurants, but also quite enough during the day. The beds are very comfortable and kitchen are fully equipped. There is a piano in the living room, which is different than the photo. The host is very friendly and complementary. Highly recommended.

We stayed here with a large group of 15 people for a basketball tournament, and the space definitely accommodated us well. There was plenty of room for everyone to sleep comfortably, and the location was a little ghetto, but Samantha’s BnB was properly secured and convenient for our needs.
That said, we did experience a major issue with the hot water throughout the weekend. Despite efforts from the host to resolve it, the problem was never fully fixed, which made it difficult—especially for our athletes and older guests—to shower and relax after long days.
Overall, the home has great potential for big groups, but we do hope the hot water issue gets fully addressed for future guests.

Awesome place! Micheal is a great host, very responsive and kind! Definitely would recommend if you have a family or like to cook/play games as the living areas/kitchen are spacious. There is a bus stop right on the corner that takes you to the train if you plan to go into the city and want to avoid driving. Love this place!

Was here for my sons graduation. Ava understood what I was in Chicago for and decorated the place to welcome our family! She made last minute arrangements to accommodate my brothers family too. She even asked her son to be around as we checked in. Amazing host
The house was perfect for our trip! The living space was huge and a nice space to hang out, bedrooms and bathrooms were all great as well, and we appreciated sitting in the backyard on a nice day.

This is a great location. So walking distance close to many different kinds of places! This was real Chicago at its best.
Next to empty lot w trees a bonus (this will change eventually in future with new construction)
The place is very functional for a group or family. Liked the big long table for eating family meals and family board games. Liked big long kitchen island for cooking , and also had some seats. Plenty pots pans etc for cooking. The deck was very nice and we used it a lot.
The kitchen could have more linens as we really like to cook, and wash and clean as we go. We did get more linens on request in an hour. The barbecue grille gas cylinder was empty, and we did not have time to go fill ourselves. The driveway gate does not close all the way, so safety issue at night. A little more attention to detail needed.
We could not get early check in or drop off bags. This is somewhat understandable. We did get one hour later checkout.
So overall a real good place.

Amazing stay in downtown Chicago! The location was perfect—close to everything we wanted to see and do. Chicago Theatre, largest Starbucks, Harry Potter store, Art museum, First Lady Boat tours. We even got to see the channel 7 news broadcasted live! The place was spotless and exactly as described. Our host was incredibly responsive and made the entire experience smooth and enjoyable. Will definitely stay again.

This was a great spacious place in a perfect location. So close to the Division CTA stop and near several bars and restaurants. We unexpectedly had to add an extra day and were able to do so very quickly. Would definitely stay here again the next time I visit Chicago.
Very nice place and sauna downstairs was delightful.  Julie had very prompt responses and gave some great ideas for things to do

Gerardo’s garden apartment was conveniently located, clean, and comfortable. He was extra responsive to messages and consequently everything went very smoothly. The apartment is spacious and great for a family or small group. Grocery store, buses, and some eateries are walkable. Great stay!
The property was as described and he was a wonderful host.
Nice spot and it’s close to downtown, easy access inside. The place was just how it’s pictured and very spacious, I’d stay here again
Had a great stay! The place was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. The host was friendly and responsive, and the location was good for everything that we needed. Would definitely stay here again.

The place is stayed had everything I needed, air fryer is a BONUS! absolutely loved the welcome basket Langston left for me at the beginning of the stay. Next time I come back to Chicago, I'd definitely stay here again. City is about 30-35 mins away, so not too bad of a distance from the city and from ORD.
Great place in a great location. Nice sundeck and pool and gym as well.

Great location.  Responsive host.  Obinna was accommodating even with late checkout.  Near Indo Pak neighborhood.  Good food convenient for food and drink shopping.  Near transportation.   Easy to get to downtown.  Good walking around.
Perfect for our stay in Jefferson Park. Impeccably clean.
Our stay was great! Felt secure knowing there was a gate lock as well
Location is a short walk from the L train station. Lots of great restaurants in the local area as well.

It was awesome stay lots of do around. Tons of bars and restaurants near by, also a couple of stores. The red line is a 5 minute walk if that. Used park hero for my car. that was was less then a 5 minute walk when I did use my car . Stay there for  4 nights. Host was very responsive and fast! Great host she also recommended a few spots for parking when I asked and would check in while I was there to make sure we were doing good.

Wonderful’s place was very clean, the beds in each bedroom were very comfortable, the bathroom towels were fluffy, the kitchen was nice with the dishwasher and refrigerator. However, it was rather parsley furnished with not quite enough coffee, cups, and dishes, and there were no drinking glasses. However, there were wine, glasses, which was nice. There was a lovely front porch, but no porch furniture to enjoy the fresh air. Wonderful was easy to communicate with, and the red line was only.4 miles away. There’s also a coffee shop about 10 minutes away with a little minimart across the street. The neighborhood is pretty vacant, with some abandoned buildings nearby, but it did not feel unsafe. Also, the heat and air conditioning worked beautifully, and there was a washer dryer… But bring your own laundry soap.
the airbnb was very comfortable  and in a great location, lots of options for meals nearby

Great place. Quiet, clean, convenient to walk around. Good area. Parking can be tricky but as to be expected. Also, the BnB is down an alley way at the side of the main house. I wasn’t expecting that. Entrance and alley could’ve been cleaner/tidier. A/C wasn’t super cool for bedroom and nighttime got a little warm. Overall everything was good.
Great place, great location
Angelica’s place was great! The room itself was a lot of fun and the area was walkable and wonderful. Would definitely stay again!
The actual apartment space is nice but it smells like a wild zoo soon as you hit the front door to access the apartment. The smell carries into the house.

We really enjoyed staying here! Just a short drive or bus trip from downtown and was very clean when we arrived. Sharing the space was no problem as the other guests were courteous and friendly. For what we paid, it was an excellent stay!
Convenient location (close to the L), quiet, and clean!

Mostly clean, great neighborhood, host is very much responsive. However, the 6ft recommendation for max height is more so 5’5 to be somewhat comfortable in this studio.
The ceiling height and bathroom height for majority of the space is probably around 5ft. The tub is tiny like designed for a midget or dwarf. Any normal size person will not be able to stand and take a normal shower, although it states they have a shower, you simply cannot use it normally if you are 5ft or taller.
Air conditioning: the AC is operated from the 2nd fl unit, out of your control, for this reason air mostly remained off and uncomfortably hot.
Privacy: all the windows have NO curtains and everyone from street and apartment level can view in. So yes as you exit the shower, and early morning when the sun is high and bright the whole room illuminating from the rising sun every morning.
The bed is highly outdated, I could say more however I will leave it at it’s just not worth the price vs other comparisons.

Once again, Holly & Mark provided a beautiful experience. They go above & beyond in hosting duties. A small example: I needed toothpicks for a project, & was about to go buy some, when Holly offered an assortment of 5 different kinds of toothpicks for me to choose from!
I was staying for nearly two months, as I was teaching at Northwestern. The location was perfect! The neighborhood is friendly & has great restaurants & easy transportation. Holly & Mark are warm, wonderful, & take excellent care of their guests. It felt like home, & I look forward to staying there again the next time I’m in Chicago.
Great spot, great hosts, great value. It's a great place overall long or short stays, the description is as what it exactly says and the hosts are really nice and they are able to be flexible!
Great place, the internet was dysfunctional but that was literally the only issue with the place.
This place was a great stay. The home is older but has a lot of character. It is in a very safe neighborhood with free street parking. Would stay again!

Allen’s Airbnb was a great place to stay during my first trip to Chicago. The condo is about a 15 minute walk away from the nearest train station, and toward the town square. Cute shops and restaurants just down the road, close to several gas stations and right across the street from tranquil park. If you want to visit Chicago and stay in a place outside of the city, Allen’s condo is perfect.
Neighbors are friendly, neighborhood feels safe. We had some trouble getting into the lockbox upon our arrival, but Allen quickly and kindly communicated with us and resolved the problem in a timely manner. The condo was clean and fully equipped with dishes and basic cooking supplies. Towels were provided, as well as shampoo, conditioner and soaps. The bed and couch was comfortable.
Perfect Airbnb for two!
Great location and stay. The walls are a little thin and mattress could be more comfortable but I would still recommend this property.

The host was super nice and getting in was easy! The place was really cute, pretty small but I expected that. The neighborhood was really nice, and safe. Me and my boyfriend had a great stay here, and a great trip to Chicago!

Great host. Always responded fast and very respectful. The place was very clean and fellow travelers staying there were nice as well. Great location and peaceful neighborhood as too. Will book again in the future!!

Host was fantastic! They were always available to answer all of our questions from getting into the main door, to breakfast recommendations, to any concerns we had during our stay. Handful of extras were available and we were grateful for those! Place was as described and we were really only there to sleep while we explored Chicago! Only thing I didn’t realize is that the upstairs is also available to rent. So on day two we had folks upstairs and we could hear their child running back and forth and talking well into the night. So if you’re a light sleeper, heads up on that. Overall, great host and decent spot to sleep! Thank you for allowing us to stay!
Steve was very timely with his responses and a great host!

Fantastic location; if you're going to anything near Wrigley or want to be near the Southport corridor, it's hard to beat.  Ver easy to find and host was proactive in all communications.  I never really needed to contact the host given the clear instructions, proactive communication, and the instructions in the apartment.  The floors are a bit thin, so you can hear people above you but it was manageable.  It is a younger neighborhood, so there may be some partying in the area.  Great place, pictures are very accurate and perfect for a weekend in Lakeview.
Stayed for a few months and the place was great for us!

I really enjoyed my stay in the Pullman cottage! Kendra put a lot of love into renovating this place to represent a bygone era. It felt like staying in a museum, truly--even details like the style of wallpaper and beds that were chosen. She's shared all about this journey of restoration in a notebook in the home that I enjoyed looking through. The whole vibe of the neighborhood row houses was very cool. A really unique experience to stay there coming all the way from Alaska! Thanks again.
Daniel was very responsive and kind. We had an issue with the door code and even though he was out of country, he got right on it and it was fixed in minutes.
David was a very kind host and answered all questions I had
I would definitely stay here again! Great location, unit was as nice as photos, very comfortable.

Caitlin's place is in an incredible location! Everything was so walkable, and there was so much to do within just a mile of the bnb.
Plus, she was so thoughtful and accommodating, which seems especially rare these days when most hosts are sending automated messages. We're so lucky to spend a much-needed mom getaway here. I highly recommend!
Very well maintained inside. Garage gameroom could use improvement in organization and cleaning. Otherwise a great experience.

T was a great host from start till finish. Very responsive when we had questions. The place it self is a gem. The nostalgic decor was a dope. I would definitely recommend this for anyone visit Chicago.
This was one of the beautiful properties I have been in. Thr host was very helpful with understanding the parking and getting into the apartment. Would differently use it next time I'm in Chicago!

Great place to stay, close to trains, close to bars, and close to a 7-11 which gave me the ability to buy snacks and drinks after a long day out! Good responses and response time, clean place, clear instructions for entering and exiting. Felt very safe.
Spacious, well designed railroad apartment in a beautiful neighbourhood, everything you need and very easy check in and out. Recommended!

Carol was a wonderful host! So responsive and incredibly sweet and patient. My family and I had some last minute changes to our reservation as well as late check-out needs, and Carol generously accommodated all our needs and was very helpful throughout the stay.

We asked to be let in before check in time at 10am When they got to the house the lock box was broken We called him and were treated like children Asked my friend if she tried everything before calling him Very condescending His cleaning staff confirmed the lock box was broken. We waited almost 12 hours to get into the house. The moment we got into the house the was an ant infestation He claimed that the previous party never complained about it I highly doubt that because it was all over the showers and toilets. He came to spray the house The spray revealed how bad the infestation was. All of our snacks and food were ruined No one in my party even felt comfortable using the kitchen The towels were old and overused The downstairs bathroom did not drain well or have a curtain The floor was always wet and smelled disgusting Everything in the house was cheap There’s a halfway house around the corner Did not feel safe to walk around We paid 2.4k for a weekend You can afford to do better

We throughly enjoyed our stay at Louis' place!  it was on a quiet street and walking distance (10-15 minutes) to multiple restaurants/coffee shops.   There was plenty of space for the 8 of us who stayed at the unit plus 5 more family members who came for the day. Louis is very responsive and helpful.....Highly recommend this unit!
Fun place, cool vibe great location.

I had a great stay! The place was exactly as described — clean, comfortable, and in a great location. The host was super responsive and made everything easy from check-in to check-out. I really appreciated the little touches that made the space feel welcoming. Would definitely stay here again and recommend to anyone looking for a smooth, stress-free stay!
I had a last minute business trip coming up and Zenobia responded and let me stay! She came in clutch and a real MVP!
Great place to stay! Very clean and spacious. Bat was a very helpful host.
Great hosts
Lots of space in this historic big home.  Pool table a very fun addition!
We really enjoyed Teddy's clean, spacious apartment on a very quiet street. We appreciated being able to park the car and take the train into the city.

The apartment was clean with a great family-friendly layout with a bunk bed and good-sized living room. Check-in was a breeze with clear instructions, and the host's quick, helpful communication throughout our stay made everything stress-free.
We enjoyed our stay.

During my stay I had a very pleasant experience. The host was warm and welcoming. He gave plenty of recommendations that enhanced my my trip in Chicago. I felt like I could relax in peace and comfort. I would definitely recommend this host and hope to stay again in the future.

Visiting Chicago for a wedding in Evanston and this AirBnB was a perfect spot for us to access everything for the weekend. The rental was beautiful, very clean, and comfortable - Lilian especially was a great host who was proactive and immediately responded to any questions I had. We had a great trip in large part to this rental and look forward to visiting again.

The location was perfect for all the things I had planned. The Red line train was a short walk away, as well as restaurant and stores. The apartment was clean and comfortable. Friendly neighbors and nice neighborhood. Bella and Ben were very helpful I would definitely stay again.
Place was great and Richard was helpful

Liked the place
Quiet, 20-25 mins drive from Chicago downtown
Would definitely come back again in future

This apartment allows walking access to the University of Chicago, and easy access by car to Lake Shore Drive (and so the Chicago loop). Very comfortable stay for our group with comfortable bedrooms and baths.
Access and location is very private. At 1st I was worried about parking on a busy street, but, nothing bad happened. Actually ideal location.
Great communication. Easy check-in. Fantastic location.

Es una casa realmente grande y muy bonita
Mucho más de lo que esperaba
Pasamos unas vacaciones increíbles.
Nos sentimos como en casa.
El lugar es muy seguro
Dejamos el auto en la acera aún que si hay parqueo privado
Tiendas cerca.
El dueño súper amable.
La atención 10/10
Cuando llegamos me gustó mucho su olor a rico
Todo súper limpio
🫶🏻🤍🥂
She was super nice, very helpful when in need, responds back very fast. The house was very clean and homey 10/10 would recommend!!
It was great perfect location for my plans for this trip… great price. Clean and straightforward. No elevator so be prepared.  Access to the brown line. Very centralized would book again
This was a great Airbnb for young families! The hosts were helpful and the place was clean. All in all a great home base for your time in Chicago!

Sentral worked great for us going to a graduation for a long weekend. Unit is exactly as described, modern, and clean. Kitchen utensils are reasonable while shelves and refrig are empty save for some coffee so if going to cook/eat be sure to bring everything such as butter, spices, etc. - a Trader Joes is 3 blocks away. Price is not cheap but is very convenient and easy so on balance okay for us. Front desk is very helpful and cheerful.
Jerry was very friendly and accommodating! Will definitely book with him again!
This is a great place to stay if you're in Chicago. Will definitely recommend staying here.

We had a great time! The rooftop deck was the highlight. Living spaces were great! We didn’t use the hot tub but that was a nice surprise addition. 3rd bedroom is a bit of a stretch since it doesn’t have a door and couch isn’t very comfy. But the other bedrooms had very comfy beds and nice bathrooms.

The property was a described. Entry and access was seamless and the apartment was very clean and secure. We felt safe in the area. The apartment is in a fantastic location lose to grocery shops, transport and restaurants.

We had a great stay at this family-friendly Airbnb! The host was very responsive, and access to the property was smooth and easy. The home had plenty of space for everyone to feel comfortable. Would definitely stay here again!

Todo desde en principio fue tal y como lo explicado
Disfrutamos la estancia

Long is a great host. Instructions are very straightforward and the room matches the description. Clean, quiet, and convenient access to bus and train stations. Great value for the location and quality.
really awesome for my first trip,  stocked fridge and very clean
Great location and very well kept, nice apartment. Would stay here again next time.
House was great. Please bring your own wash clothes because they are not provided.
We can't wait to come back. They went above and beyond to ensure we had a comfortable stay. From the spotless rooms to the thoughtful touches, everything was perfect.
The place was clean and had plenty of amenities. Hosts were quick to respond and made sure we were comfortable during the stay. Parking was easy to find for Chicago!
We loved the place.  Well located to Soldier Field and the Museum campus.  Beautiful views.  Street parking is not available, so be sure to have a plan.

Mimi's place was as pictured. Her detailed description of the neighborhood (city ambience) was accurate... but I found it really quiet for a city location.  The street is lined with nice trees and folks walking cute dogs. There was a grocery store just a short walk away and a drug store.   It was a very comfortable stay and fulfilled all of our needs.
Great communication, clean and well located within the city. Space was bigger than I expected as well!

Apartment was well taken care of and bathrooms were pretty clean when we checked in. Some issues related to neighbors smoking and being really noisy at 3 AM, but it is beyond the host's control. Bring some earplugs if you are sensitive to noise.

Cleanest Airbnb I’ve ever stayed at! The house was well stocked and looked exactly like the pictures. John was incredibly responsive before, during, and after the trip. If you are traveling to Chicago with a group definitely stay here!
El lugar estaba muy bonito limpio y cómodo
Lovely home! We were here for a short time but it’s a great location and neighborhood. Ginneh was a wonderful host as well.

This condo was perfect. Everything was clean and the neighborhood felt safe. Alan was such a great host! He was very responsive and his instructions were clear. The beds were extremely comfy and the bathrooms were clean and I appreciated the included toiletries (body wash, lotion, towels, etc). We also loved the balcony. Everything was pretty great.
Assel was very communicative and was very responsive to all of my questions. Great place to stay for a group. We had a great time and will definitely be back!

I enjoyed my stay in Rebecca's place very much. It felt truly as "home away from home" because I felt that if I needed anything or forgot to take something "little" with me on my journey, I would fine it in Rebecca's home. And yes, there are generous offers of snacks and drinks in the welcoming kitchen. Another great thing is the location which has public transportation nearby but is also a nice short walk from the center of the university's campus. Last but not least, the bed is very comfortable! Warmly recommended.

Stayed for a couple nights, just the two of us. Space was a small studio in a historic building. Was about the size of a hotel, but had a full kitchen which was nice. Entry is easy and the lock on the door is old, but works well in our opinion. The bathroom is very small though, you have to sit kind of sideways! The location is honestly perfect if restaurants are as important to you as they are to us! Also not far from the green city farmers market as well. Scooters and bikes are available all around, even right outside of the building. There is a parking garage right down the block for $35 for 24 hours! Communicate was good between the hosts as well!

We stayed over the weekend. It was a nice apartment and I liked that there were four rooms. It was easy to find and the host, Dylan, provided clear instructions for check in and check out. We did go for an event and with there being only one bathroom having additional larger mirrors would’ve been helpful for getting ready. We had trouble finding the thermostat and a couple of the rooms did get hot. There weren’t curtains so a couple of the rooms were bright as well with sun coming in. Overall it was a nice and spacious apartment for our weekend stay.

Fantastic location and house!
Exactly like it used to be described! Beautiful furniture and art!

Karen's place was just as described , easy to follow instructions, loved the availability of a clothing hamper in the closet. It was very enjoyable to have a personal air conditioner unit in the room. This wa a great fit financially and accomodations were appropriate for my extended stay.
We enjoyed our stay and the neighborhood felt safe. Viktor was very attentive!
Good communication from host. Great, historic neighborhood

Larissa’s vintage home is ideally located in Lincoln Park, a short walk to the metros and buses, and super easy to either get down to the Loop or up the shore.
Very peaceful and comfortable. You’ll be greeted by Larissa’s cute little dog Amy.
Definitely recommend for an ideal location in Chicago.

The booking process was a bit messy. I tried to book a stay that showed as available, then received a message that the place was actually unavailable; however, another property that showed as unavailable was actually available. I agreed to the change bc location and cost was similar. If that was the only issue, no probs at all.
When I arrived, I was told that the booking instructions I received were for a room no longer available and I was put into a room without air conditioning. This was not as advertised. I came down for a race so sleeping in my own sweat for two nights wasn’t what I wanted. Also, I was given a diff door code which made me question if someone else in the shared space had my door code. I didn’t like leaving my stuff in the room knowing that.
I would not have agreed to switch had I seen an accurate description.
This stay was truly outstanding! What an amazing place - will absolutely return.

Great location right near Wrigley with access to transportation and lots of restaurants and things to do. Parking is challenging, which is typically in popular locations such as this. Great set up for a large group looking to enjoy the city.

High quality linens and towels. Comfortable mattresses. Temperature outside was all over the place the week I was there, but the heat and AC were easy to use.
I will definitely be back!

The apartment is beautiful, clean, large. Ademola was very responsive -- a wonderful host! The place was stocked with water, coffee pods, and treats. The block is lovely, parking was easy. Several grocery stores nearby; the Jewel-Osco (about a mile away) had wonderful fresh fruit and everything we needed. The only negative would be: The Comelit app they use for entry into the front gate is a bit clunky to download and use. The other note is about location. The listing described the apartment as "on" the UChicago campus. It's about 5 blocks south. While South Side is seeing quite a revitalization due to the university and the Obama Center, walking from campus to the apartment might feel awkward to some people. We had no problems, and were delighted to see so many beautiful new buildings going up in the neighborhood. We hope South Side becomes a safer neighborhood for everyone -- especially the full-time residents -- but I thought renters should be aware of the location.
Great location. Rooftop deck has amazing views. Easily fit large group.

Absolutely loved our stay! Zainab was an awesome host…super responsive, kind, and made sure we were well taken care of. Hands down one of the best Airbnbs I’ve stayed in. The beds were actually comfy (rare!) and the place was easy to find and access. 10/10 would book again!

This is a nice little apartment. The couch is only good for sitting and would not advise sleeping on it. The bed, bathroom, and kitchen were great. Areeba, the host, was responsive and helpful.
The worst experience we had was the parking. DO NOT stay here if you have a car as the ‘free parking’ is extremely limited. Between 6pm-6am on week days and all of weekends, there’s practically no parking whatsoever. We had one night where we searched for parking for an hour within a two mile radius and could not find anything. We ended up getting our car towed twice over our stay. Speaking of which, the “unauthorized parking spots” are VERY poorly marked and inaccurate. When we realized our parking mistake and called the tow company, the sign said it was $170 which ended up actually being $240. The tow sharks are everywhere around here.
Stay here only if you plan to walk 1.5 miles to the nearest subway or take Lyft/Uber into the city.
Great stay in an ideal location!
We came for a concert at the Outset. Adamm’s place was the perfect location and perfect size. Highly recommend!

Perfect hosts and a fabulous property that was more than enough for our family of 4. It can hold more, but we prefer the space. Well maintained and appointed. Pictures really don’t do the property justice. Our hosts were very responsive and attentive. We would definitely recommend it and stay in it again. Super property.

We had a great stay for our work retreat this past weekend. We had 9 adults present for a retreat and managed to have beds for everyone (only 2 people had to share) and ample living space for us to meet as a group. I love the neighborhood - was very walkable and cute restaurants nearby. Also ample parking. The train is loud but they have ear plugs in each room. Overall excellent stay and perfect for our needs!
Great host! Great place!
Patty was a great host and very responsive! The unit was clean and nice. The instructions were very detailed. my friends and I thoroughly enjoyed ourselves.
Ming was a great host! Very responsive and helpful. This is a great spot close to Chinatown, downtown Chicago,  and the pink line (all 15 min by car)
Good place to celebrate with a big group. Clear that the host is working hard to continually improve the experience.

We had a wonderful experience and are already looking forward to staying again.
The space was immaculate and had everything we needed to cook during our stay. The beds were comfortable, the unit was easy to access, and everything was simple to set up. It was also surprisingly spacious, which we appreciated. The private parking lot was a huge bonus—truly a blessing in Chicago. The bathrooms and showers were spotless, and the large TVs were a nice touch.
You must walk to Lickity Split in the evening for ice cream, a block away.
We’ll definitely stay here again the next time we visit.

Despite this home being in "the hood", it's really nice & quiet. We never felt unsafe or worried. Parking is open-street so you could be close at one time but houses down later. The house was remodeled nicely, but still had that old, musty, almost water damaged smell all over (stronger in some areas). Once you settle in, it probably won't bother you as much unless you're a "smells" person. I guess I didn't realize from the pictures but there are only 3 tvs; none in the bedrooms (one didnt work so they brought a brand new one to replace it the next day). Unless you like to lay in quiet and darkness, bring a tablet or something. The internet was constantly offline which is bothersome, especially if you have kids as we did (host did attempt to fix it remotely but it persistingly went off). Lastly, the tub was clogged with so much hair that it wouldn't drain and there were DIRTY underwear left from previous guest (cleaning crew.?.). Walk to bus & train (CTA) was quick & expressway access
Clean and comfortable condominium as described.  Responsive host!

Great apartment in excellent location.  Lots of places to walk to and enjoy.  The furniture is comfortable. Kitchen is functional but minimal. The only drawback is the literal farm in the backyard. 19 chickens means chicken poop on everything, so the yard space is not a place to relax or enjoy.  The sheep was cute to watch out the window but, there is also a tremendous amount of rubbish, old stoves, piles of disused lumber which is not visibly appealing.

Overall it was a great experience. The apartment was clean, charming, had everything plus extras like games and in shower soap dispensers. The location to downtown was a perk. Due to festivals and events going on that weekend there was some extra street noise and nosie from the neighbors, but still worth being close to shops and restaurants and also is outside the control of the owner. I would highly recommend and would go back again!

The renovated classic Chicago greystone is spectacular. This is an amazing update of an architectural gem. The space has all modern amenities but the character and charm are thoroughly maintained. The spaces are spotless. Rogers Park is a wonderful lakeside neighborhood and is a melting pot of ethnicities and cultures. There are great restaurants within walking distance as well as close by in Evanston, Andersonville, etc. The Metra and the El are an easy walk. Lillian was so accommodating and proactive. We loved this stay and will be back.
Our stay was nice. I’d recommend to bring a fan and a body mirror.

Lovely home and perfect for a girls weekend! We spent a lot of time hanging out and catching up on the patio. The backyard is lovely and very big! There was a hot water issue but Nicholas replied immediately and gave a quick an easy solution - we were able to get it fixed within minutes.
This is a clean and lovely place to stay. Bella responded very quickly. I highly recommend.

Great place to stay as a family! We had peace of mind knowing we picked this home that had extra items to accommodate our toddler. AND this home is in a neighborhood that did not have extra parking hassles like we noticed when seeing other listings. It was very important for me to be able to park in front of or at least near our Airbnb n easily walk in, while lugging around things and a toddler. This place allowed that.  We had a place to park in front of the home each time! Very family friendly place. Loved all the extra family touches this home had. Would definitely stay again if ever in Chicago.

Our stay was really easy and nice, the place was just right for our quick weekend trip. Small things such as the upstairs neighbors (college age)being loud all weekend late hours of the night and getting everyone locked out the building. Requiring us to call Joseph in the middle of the night to get us back into the apartment. Joseph responded really quick and get us all in the apartment as quick as possible.
This was a great place to stay. Kelly was very helpful whenever I needed anything. Great location
Clean, great communication. Would stay here again!

The apartment matched the description perfectly. Both bedrooms are spacious, and the mattresses are comfortable. The location is excellent, just a short walk from the Blue Line, making it very convenient for getting around. The home is well-equipped overall, though it's worth noting that the kitchen accessories are a bit dated, which might be a consideration if you plan to cook frequently. One issue we encountered was with the AC/heating system. My wife stayed in during the day and noticed that it occasionally stopped working, so this may need attention.
Exactly as described. Great location safe neighborhood. Easy parking. Wonderful - will definitely stay again.
Enjoyed our stay very much. Great location too. Everything you need within walking distance

Had a great stay!
The hosts were super friendly and helpful and the neighbourhood was very quiet and peaceful.
Would highly recommend.

Excellent location. Room was clean. However there was a bad smell in the hall and the bathtub in our room was clogged. Beside that, we had a great time there. Close to downtown and all the fun. I would still stay at this location. Thank you for hosting us.
this is a really easy place to stay in the city.   I really recommend this for the people looking to explore Chicago.

Caution: No on premise parking despite what listing says.
Airbnb apparently allows people to claim "parking on premise" as long as there is parking "nearby." That being said, I was able to find parking on the same block over half the time during a one week stay. I never had to park more than two blocks away our one, and could usually find a spot without circling too long. So, overall, it was not a huge hassle, I just felt misled because I filtered for on premise parking and reserved this unit because of that.
This location in Bucktown is great! Close to the 606, great for walks, plenty of restaurants and bars nearby. The unit is very quiet and was plenty cool (a couple of the days were almost 90 F outside), and great for sleeping at night. Aside from the parking we thought the unit was a great find! The shower is a little short, so if you are 6' or taller, your head will hit the ceiling if you stand up straight in it.

Rene’s place was very nice! The host was responsive and friendly. He went out of his way to help with any issues and even brought us a complimentary bottle of wine! I will say bring an extra mirror if you are booking with a group of girls!
excellent place and excellent host

Ms. Helen is a gem! Her husband and son are very kind. They all are great individuals. Her home is cozy and comfortable. The rooms are spacious, so working from home is not a problem. There is always space to chill to yourself in the house. This is my second time here. Highly recommend!
We were really happy with our stay. The place is really clean and spacious and the location is great. Chialung is also really nice. We would definitely come back if we're back in Chicago.
Location is very convenient-easily accessible to train and buses. Safe street. Room was clean.
Absolutely beautiful! Front desk was very helpful

Pros: Safe location and host was very responsive. We rented this property to celebrate my elopement and it worked for what we needed and was fairly close to the city. Plenty of bedrooms and space for everyone to get ready.
Cons: The place could have been cleaner (walls were dirty and some dirty utensils and bowls found in the kitchen cabinets), some furniture was definitely showing signs of wear, and grill barely worked. The parking situation is also not great.
Overall was a good stay and worked well for what we needed, appreciate the host being so responsive and helpful for the issues we did have!

A spacious home with an abundance of natural light! We loved how open it felt and was free of clutter to make ourselves feel right at home.
Easy to work remote with great WiFi and ample space for two people to work independently.
The place is quiet at night. The rooftop is huge with a great option to be able to grill, cook out, and enjoy the views.
We loved the location. Lots of great spots that are walkable or a short drive or uber to downtown and other neighborhood.
The host was easy to communicate with with clear instructions and proactive.
Look forward to staying here for a longer stay in the future.

I have stayed at Silvia’s beautiful Airbnb four times in the past two years. It is a lovely flat with tons of space to spread out and relax. Excellent location. Very close to buses and trains. Short walking distance to excellent pubs and restaurants. Highly recommend.

Great location - near restaurants, the train and the lake. The unit was pretty much as advertised. There were a few things lacking - hand towels, dish cloths, dishwasher soap ... however John made arrangements for these to be supplied once we requested. Parking is very limited so be prepared to walk several blocks - better yet plan on using the training which is one block away. For seniors like us - be careful entering. the first two steps into the unit are much deeper than normal.

We had a pleasant stay at Daniel's house. The house is beautiful and the kitchen was perfect for us. The neighborhood is amazing. There are a couple of things we didn't like so much. The layout of the house was a bit funky, one long hallway and only two full baths with one being inside the master bedroom. The other thing was the noisy neighbors upstairs. They woke us up at 5am each morning. They were also loud at 11pm and 12am. Aside from those two things, we really enjoyed our stay there. Every room was beautifully remodeled and there was plenty of space for us to spread out.

Great host and right in the heart of Lincoln Park on a beautiful residential street. Very near to everything (lake, pond, zoo, restaurants, bars, coffee, Walgreens, etc etc). For those who don’t know the area - parking is a challenge as many streets are permit only at certain times each day and it’s a very lively and full neighborhood. That’s Chicago (any large city) and maybe especially this neighborhood. Host very helpful and communicative. A few minor details in need of some attention.
Wie were very hsppy with our stay and would like to come again.

We stayed 4 weeks due to a long business trip. The are is super calm but downtown easily accessible with public transport. Jason is a great host who is responding very quickly and giving a lot of information around the area.
Very good, clean, cozy unit. Whatever you need is there. Quite, safe neighborhood. 5 min waiting  response from host if you need anything, Highly recommend.
It was shch a cute place! We had a great time in Chicago. Cihan and Hastice were very responsive and helpful too!!

When the host was notified about missing AC and washer/dryer they promised to fix it in two days. When it wasn’t, they offered $100 for the AC but then charged $100 to use the washer/dryer in the basement (which was another missing amenity)

Other than the missing amenities, the interior was okay and updated. There were some spots where the renovations were lacking, for instance the window seal letting in air and missing screws/boards. Host was responsive if there was anything needing fix.
Host is very particular about cleaning which doesn’t bother me but requires for long term stay a near daily cleaning schedule which is demanding.
The area is not the safest in Chicago and during my stay heard some gunshots and myself along with another tenet have had bad encounters on that side of town. Do your research before booking!
Great place for exactly what we needed. Stayed a week and it was great!

This was my first Airbnb experience, I stayed for 3 months, and it was a great stay! The apartment was clean, well-furnished, nicely decorated, and very comfortable, exactly as described. It’s an older home with a lot of charm, and it was perfect for a longer stay. The location was convenient, with easy access to everything I needed, and having parking available made things even easier. Armando greeted me on arrival and was an exceptional host always friendly and responsive. It truly felt like a home away from home. Highly recommend!
We had a great stay and hope to book this rental the next time our team is in Chicago!
I have stayed here several times, and will return again- clean, comfortable rooms, nice common spaces and amenities- thank-you
Amazing stay

This place is very nice and located in a nice area. The price was nice for the amount of days I booked for. It was spacious and slept up to 10 ppl. Really enjoyed myself. What I really like was that Dario checked in with me on my second day! Any issue I had, I contacted them directly and it was addressed. I will definitely start again!

I've stayed in a lot of AirBnB's and this one is unique in a lot of ways.  The place is absolutely HUGE with an incredible location steps away from the Damen Street L Station.  That said...you'll hear the trains going by and even the "doors closing" dong from time to time.  The apartment is quite a mix with a Viking Range (missing knobs), great cabinets (with doors taped shut saying "don't open or this will faill on your head"), a huge shower (with a drain that backs up) as well as LED party lights and mixers.  It's a bit of a head scratcher.  All that said, the price was reasonable (for the location and size) and Omar was responsive and supportive so sure, I'd stay here again.  Also, the wifi was blazing fast!
Great location surrounded by lot's to do. inside felt comfortable with all the necessary amenities.  Will definitely book again.
Great quiet location in lake view. Would visit again

The place was conveniently located near downtown Chicago. The beds were comfortable and the place was exactly what we needed for our family. The cleaning crew could’ve done a better job: we found some cobwebs on the wall and dead flies on the floor, one of the washcloths had a stain and the towels were still a bit damp when we arrived. Overall, the place was good and the host was very responsive and friendly.

amazing place with great connectivity. thr Bkue line train station is right next door.
Jason is a great guy ready to help and has kept the place super nicely stacked with all the required basics including cooking ouls/spices. if I come again to Chicago, will surely chose this place.

Great home. Has all the things you need for an extended stay. Location is very quiet but within a short walk to shops and restaurants. Best of both worlds! Zam was very responsive and the overall check in, smoothness of the stay, check out, and simplicity of house rules is a testament to their being a great host.

This was a great place to stay for two nights! Pretty small but it was perfect for two people and a short period. Only complaint is I had to ask the host for the check in instructions, as I didn’t receive that until after the check-in time. Also, I was not provided the entry code to the apartment complex upon check-in so had to wait for a response to be able to enter.
Amazing Airbnb ! Felt very at home , it was very quiet and peaceful.

No frills place as stated. Clean, comfortable and quiet. Enough room for 2. Close to Blue line and buses which is a plus.  I would give 4 1/2 stars, but that option wasn’t given. Only a couple of annoyances not worth mentioning here but I’ll let him know directly (easily fixable). Would stay again.  No TV but strong WiFi so watched programming on my travel laptop.
This is a great spot to stay at! I stayed for a work trip when the cubs were out of town and it was perfect!! I would absolutely recommend this airbnb to others!
Nice apartment in a nice and safe area.
I did not end up staying here after communication with the host.
Jenn is a fabulous host!! Staying here again in August!!!!!!
Delia’s place was very nice and clean! Would definitely book again!

Overall it was a nice stay. The apartment and the room are totally fine and good price-quality compared to the surroundings. There were some problems -- mostly unexpected for anyone -- but the host was always quite responsive. I feel like cleanings could be scheduled more often. The district is very close to the University so it's perfect for students or visiting personnel. The area is quite safe during the day, just keep your eyes open at other times.

El apartamento luce tal cual se ve en fotos. Es muy cómodo, cuenta con todo para pasar una estadía agradable, hay supermercados y tiendas cerca, moverse con transporte publico es fácil por la ubicación. Recomiendo el apartamento para una estadía tranquila.

Stayed here for 2 weeks in between leses and it was well equipped and great for the price. Bed was super comfortable, bathroom & laundry was good,  kitchen had everyrhing we needed, and the WiFi worked well for 2 people working from home. The apartment was safe and check in was easy, and the location is well connected by bus to Lincoln Square, Andersonville, and the brown/red lines, and it was close to the river park. I would stay here again!

Absolutely stellar stay! Kymi’s Airbnb in Chicago was everything we hoped for and more during our time at ASCO. The home was beautifully decorated, exceptionally comfortable, and stocked with everything we needed. My family felt incredibly safe and at ease the entire time. Kymi herself was a dream host—warm, responsive, and genuinely hospitable. She graciously allowed us to extend our stay and have a late checkout, all without hesitation or hassle. Her kindness and attentiveness made the experience even more special. I highly encourage anyone visiting Chicago to stay at her amazing home—you won’t regret it!

5 stars because this place met my needs. Things to be aware of: this is a basement unit that may be shared. I stayed for one month and the other room was occupied the first few days, which was no problem. However, the bedroom door doesn't lock. Laundry is included. Common room is spacious, bedroom is a little tight but was fine for me as one person. Bedroom has ample natural light despite being a basement unit; common room doesn't have much natural light. My biggest issue with this unit is that the tenants living one floor up were noisy. Insulation between floors in this building is not great, so you can hear them, voices and walking (sounded like stomping) around. They also seemed to have groups of people over on random weekdays late, so I used earplugs at night a few days of my monthlong stay. It wasn't a daily problem or enough to make me lower my 5-star rating, but be aware if you're a light sleeper. Overall good stay, very quaint area in Noble Square, felt safe to me, good WiFi.

Adoramos a hospedagem! Staying with your family was truly one of the most heartwarming experiences I’ve ever had. From the moment I arrived, I was welcomed not as a guest, but as a part of the family. Your kindness, generosity, and warmth made me feel completely at home—something that not everyone can offer so naturally.
Whether it was the shared meals, the late-night conversations, or just the little moments of everyday life, you created an atmosphere filled with love and comfort.
Thank you for opening your hearts and your home to me. I’ll always carry the memories of my time with you with deep gratitude and affection.

Tammy is a great host, generally there when you need her. Location surprisingly quiet in a noisy city, half a block from Lake Michigan on north end of city. Express bus on the corner takes you downtown and runs frequently. You're only a block or so from the beach if you want to wade in the lake or a stroll through the park. A convenience store on the corner helps.
It helps to like dogs. There are two small ones. One is rather shy; the other always enjoyed my company and likes to kiss hands. The place was quite clean. They rent out two rooms; I got the small one, which is fine for short stays. I was there a week. If you want to stay much longer, you'd probably want the bigger one. My room has a desk and bed but no room for anything else, so you have to live out of your suitcase. There's a small closet where you can hang things but no drawers. Bathroom was clean and well stocked with everything needed. You're welcome to hang out in the living room. Would be glad to return.

Overall, we really enjoyed our stay. The location is excellent, walkable to so many great restaurants and sites. The apartment is comfortable and was very clean. The host was kind and generally responsive.
We had issues with building access for the first half of our stay (the fault of previous guests losing the building fob), resulting in a couple of instances where we couldn’t get into the building for up to three hours. The host was apologetic, but we think some sort of credit should have been offered for the stress and inconvenience.

I think this was an unusual situation and would give the benefit of the doubt that this isn’t typical. We would likely stay there again if visiting Chicago with our family in the future.
Johana’s place is in a great location, with a great view, and amazing amenities! It had everything you’d want in your favorite local neighborhood with big city access.

Overall great place and close to what you need. A little noisy but enjoyed my time.

We had an amazing 5-star stay in Chicago! The home was spotless, artfully decorated, and full of thoughtful touches like a piano, guitar, and a welcome gift. The location is unbeatable—near top spots like Swift & Sons and City Winery. Natasha was an excellent, responsive host. We’re already planning to return!

A few things to note: the apartment is situated adjacent to a busy street, which can result in considerable noise, particularly during nighttime or rush hours. There are also a lot of stairs, which could be a challenge if you have heavy luggage. The washer and dryer are located in the basement and a bit inconvenient to access. Overall, Jennifer’s gracious hospitality and the overall comfort of the space made for an enjoyable and worthwhile experience!

Had some issues getting access. I was coming off a red-eye and the promised door codes did not arrive at the specified time which was a bit annoying.
But that should not detract from this being a great AirBnB; clean, great location, nice neighborhood, easy access to public transit, very responsive host. Hoping to come back to Chicago and if I do so I would plan on staying here. Thanks Charlie.
David is a great host.  He was flexible with the check in which really helped.  The location was great and safe.

Our stay was excellent!   We had the top floor of a wonderful old house set in a cozy neighborhood.    The kitchen was fully supplied.  The beds were all very comfortable.   It's a bonus to have a little porch for morning coffee.   Having a private parking space was fabulous!  Streets were busy but safe.   Fun vibe.   I'd stay there again.    Host communicated well.
Nice safe neighborhood and home!

Very friendly host. Loved staying at Patt's place. The house had lots of utensils, dishwashers and materials such that I didn't have to buy anything at the supermarket for the most of my stay.

really amazing stay and I love this area! I will definitely be coming back! :)

Exactly as pictured. The condo space was great, the record player was a lot of fun. The location was good for us and the amount of restaurants in the area is great. The Corner Kitchen was excellent and so convenient for breakfast. The front bedroom is a little bright in the morning.
Everything was as stated in the listing, would recommend to anyone looking to stay by the city

We loved the location of this place!! The neighborhood was quiet and within walking distance to many shops and a park, and only about 20 min walk from the train. I will say I wish there was more control over the temperature and a standing fan would be a nice addition. The only other downside is that the walls are very thin and you are able to hear everything from the unit above, but we weren’t bothered as we spent most of our day out. All in all the place was a nice studio for 2 people who plan to spend most of the day exploring Chicago. We would definitely stay here again if we ever decide to return!

The place was kept clean consistently through my stay, every message I sent was replied to within the hour, and the self check in made the place feel like my own. I had a good experience here and learned a lot about the bridgeport neighborhood. It was very quiet here and still close to so much. I would stay here again.

Chike’s place was very nicely decorated and clean with all the amenities that we needed. Maria is charming.  We did have an issue that could not be remedied because it was a weekend.  Maria was on top of it.  She gave us a reasonable discount for the inconvenience. Very cool place that isn’t too far from downtown Chicago. Loved how it was decorated, clean and big. Would definitely recommend if you’re visiting Chicago. Nice neighborhood and neighbors. Really neat place! No complaints from me, just get ready to use stairs!

The location was a bit sketchy, the entrance into the building was smelly, the dishes and pots in the kitchen were old and beat up, the linens were cheap material. I had expected a bit more for the price.

Peter is an excellent host and his home is a special one-of-a-kind chicago experience. None of these were dealbreakers for us, but worth mentioning for full transparency!
It was situated in a quiet and private place. It looks exactly like the pictures! The rooms were spacious and the beds were comfortable. It was so spacious more than enough room to move.

Generally a satisfactory experience.

Wonderfuls apartment was clean and comfortable, the photos were completely accurate. Being a single female I felt very safe in the space and area. I would absolutely stay here again!
