This is a newly renovated garden-level unit with clean lines and high ceilings. The furniture is comfortable. The kitchen is well-stocked and functional. I will definitely seek this place when I return to Chicago in the future.

This Airbnb was a gem! Nice and quiet neighborhood, safe and peaceful. He always responded within a fast manner. A lot of roaming space, about 10 minutes from downtown. Would definitely recommend staying here!
Great place! Very comfortable and quiet.
Drea’s place worked great for our group! Plenty of space, enjoyed the hot tub, and nice park right across the street. Would recommend!
We loved the fact that it was 3 bedrooms and 2 baths.  It was 15 min from downtown.
it was just the space we needed. everything worked,and was clean and organized. we enjoyed our stay. thank you Jake!
Great place to stay outside of Chicago. Smaller than expected, but was clean and the host was very responsive.

This Was My 1st Time Ever Using Air Bnb &’d My Experience Was Great. I Felt Comfortable. He Was Very Friendly , Communicated Well , The Hospitality Was Great . I Even Left Shoes &’d He Was Able To Meet Me With No Issue To Get Them . Overall I Had A Great Stay . I Would Recommend .

very spacious felt right at home

I often travel to Chicago and I had the good fortune to book this wonderful apartment. it's very spaceous my girlfriend and I had ample room to relax and for her to do a little work from home.

I managed to park pretty much right outside for my entire 10 days, I can't imagine even if it were busier that you'd need to walk more than 20 seconds to a space.

Massive credit to the host, Anna, for providing such a wonderful, cosy and homely feel but also for being incredibly responsive to queries. This might be the best place I've stayed in Chicago yet!
the place is exactly what the pictures show. Augustine was very polite and checked in on us during our stay.

The location and the size of the unit was perfect for my stay. Disappointed in the lack of everyday items like kitchen linens and dish soap. The window blinds are in need of repair. Great host. We had a wonderful stay. The host was very helpful with their recommendations for restaurants in the area. The space was clean and cozy. The neighborhood it is located in was lovely and quiet. Definitely would recommend.
Great place would stay there again!

We also really enjoyed the decor of the whole place and it was just overall a nice vibe. Would highly recommend!

This place was perfect for our family reunion/wedding! Had the whole family stay together and still had room to visit with extra guests in the livingroom and play pool with the kids. It was just perfect for a big family group. Beautiful house, cozy and fun. Vanessa was very helpful as well, great food recommendations and quick to respond to questions. Great experience!

The condo was really nice, everything was super clean and in great condition, the beds were comfortable and over all it was a pleasant stay, Damaras was always one message away, really friendly, we had a great experience.
Good place to stay for a few nights, host(s) were responsive and check in was easy. For the price it definitely could have had nicer sheets, tissues, and been cleaner.

The only negative thing I would have to say is when the water heater turned on it was super load and would blast the cigarette smell from the unit above. The shower was small and not meant for taller people. It is very dark with the curtain closed. There is a stove but not sure if it works, there were no pots or pan if you wanted to make a simple meal.

Great stay! The apartment was clean and cozy, the bedding very comfortable, and although we never used it, the kitchen seemed well equipped if you wanted to cook. We loved starting our day on the balcony with coffee, a great place to watch the runners and walkers and dogs go by.
The neighborhood is amazing! Bakeries, coffee shops, bars and restaurants all just a short safe walk away. We had an amazing experience and can't wait to come back!
we loved staying at Hamlin House for a quick trip to Chicago! it's a beautiful house very convenient to University of Chicago and the Metra.
perfect place to stay for a quick trip! quang was very responsive and even assisted shipping back an item we forgot. the place quaint and perfect for 2. very pleased with our stay!
This location was perfect for a large group of adults attending local events. The neighborhood is lovely, and the location was spacious and immaculate.
Great place; Less than a block walk from the train station and a decently calm neighborhood.

my friends and i stayed at Bosede’s lovely home for sueños festival weekend! it was lovely very quiet neighborhood. we had everything we needed from towels and shampoo/conditioner/body wash to extra blankets or pillows! we all enjoyed our stay and Bosede is a great host!
Very clean and comfortable place. Quiet neighborhood. A bit away from downtown, but easy rides with Uber/Lyft.

We had 12of us. Coming in from coast to coast n abroad. This gave us each matching bedroom sizes. There were 4 equally nice bathrooms and 6 near identical bedrooms so no arguments. We realized that we were taking a risk by being the firsts to book this place and I’m sorry we did. For 2 months, we corresponded with Cloud9 about our stay and still leading up to the trip and during the trip, we faced issues. PLEASE DO NOT BOOK WITH CLOUD9. They are clearly only about making money, even if that means targeting their guests and reneging previous agreements. For example, when we booked, we were told that parking was free but as the date of check in approached, we received a message saying that we would have to pay for parking per day. We confirmed an early check in but on the day before arrival was told that our check in was at a later time. We received a key that was loose from its keychain but we still kept up with it and 2 days after our trip, we were told that the key was damaged and instead they would be charging us for the key as if we lost it. The apartment is directly next to the train, so don’t expect the sleep well and the bedrooms are small. DO NOT BOOK.
Besides the free parking being changed to $54/day a week prior to check-in, the stay was worth the price for us.
Enjoyed my two day stay here very cozy and peaceful!

Place was perfect for our group of 9 to spend the long weekend in Chicago! Plenty of bed space for privacy when needed but a large communal area for everyone to get together in the evening. Very close to the train which worked out perfectly for us! Would book again!

The room was as described. The host was great, responding to my messages quickly and being very accommodating. The area was safe, and public transportation was easily accessible, which is great for visiting downtown.

Place was very nice and clean and in a great location but communication could’ve been A LOT better. Didn’t receive check in instructions until almost the end of the day and just a lot of inconveniences all around.
Very nice place.  Host was responsive and easy to work with.   Would stay there again.
Very cute and clean stay outside of the city! We had a very comfortable time staying at Jennifer’s place!

Todo excelente, muy buena ubicación. Carol was very kind and helpful. The residence was very clean and well maintained. plenty of amenities were provided. A guide book was provided and very useful.

Jane and Lewis are lovely hosts--friendly, accommodating, generous, flexible. The Rogers Park neighborhood is lovely (esp. this house's proximity to the lake), albeit a bit far from tourist sites. The room and bathroom are well-stocked.

it was a great stay

The app enabled clear dissemination of check-in instructions and the possibility to purchase add additional services, such as early check-in. Very tech-savy and very convenient.
I'm from Chicago and did a stay-cation thing with friends; the size and location of her flat is absolutely incredible. Enjoyed our stay and would recommend

Jeremiah siempre contestó rápido y fue muy colaborativo al dejarnos ingresar un rato antes del horario de check-in. El alojamiento es tranquilo y acogedor, ideal para pasar 2-3 noches en Chicago. La casa puede resultar levemente ruidosa, pero para nada insoportable. Excelente opción precio-calidad. Gracias Jeremiah!

Abacus is a fantastic host, who is very responsive, proactive in communicating, and flexible. The home is exactly as pictured, quite spacious, with large bedrooms, kitchen and living area. There is plenty of tea, several coffee makers, but no coffee, so plan on bringing your own or asking the host to kindly supply the home before you arrive.
One minor item, which is not the host's fault whatsoever, is that the home does not have the best sound insulation, therefore the sound from the downstairs neighbors travels up into this unit. The noise did not disturb our sleep on the top floor, but my guests staying in the first floor bedroom were able to hear the neighbors below. A minor consideration for any light sleepers. Other than that, Abacus provides very clear documentation about how to enter the unit and was attentive to all our needs!
Overall great stay and nice host !
Great stay! Very comfortable for our group. Would stay again! Has two living rooms and kitchens which is helpful for large groups.

very good place . host is very humble and responsive .

Enjoyed our stay, nice place an host 👍

Though, my stay was taxing as I was shuffled between rooms and eventually had to vacate my reservation entirely due to an unforeseen problem. This kerfuffle made it difficult to focus on a conference I was attending as I was worried about where I would be staying for the latter half.
Anny did the leg work of locating a new spot and even negotiating an earlier check-in/later check-out with the new host and for that I am tremendously appreciative. At the same time, I found some of her communication unprofessional after she learned that I had reached out to customer service, confused and unsure of what to do. This exchange may be due to her coordinating all contingencies while out of the country (e.g. time differential) but it does not necessarily excuse her treatment of a guest.

I had a fantastic stay at Block 37 Marquee! The apartment I originally wanted was taken, but they offered me a more central location at the same price, which I really appreciated. Walgreens was right across the street, and a Target was only a few blocks away which made it super convenient.
The rooftop and gym were great perks I used often. Matt and his team were super responsive - when I needed sheets and an air mattress for a guest, they ordered one right away. My only small complaint was the limited essentials, just two rolls of toilet paper, one paper towel roll, and not many cleaning supplies, so I had to pick up a few things. Also, the water jug had some residue, but I didn't use it. Only thing to keep in mind is that most businesses in the area close around 8pm. I had a great stay!

Paul’s place was very nice, had a little hair going on the bathroom floor but i couldn’t really complain! Very responsive and gave good details on the stay. Surrounded by a lot of things to do! Overall we enjoyed our stay with Paul and would book again!

Would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable and welcoming place to stay!

Also the water pressure in the shower was non existent. Other than that, and a slight issue with the lock when first arriving, was a great stay. Beds were comfortable, decor is nice, smelled nice and clean and gave us privacy.

this place was awesome

very nice

Very nice place to stay.

Awesome stay!  Centrally located, and everything was just as described.  Everything we needed was provided and it was very comfortable.  The hosts went above and beyond to make sure our stay was perfect.  There was a temporary power outage…and once notified,  the hosts made it their priority to fix the problem quickly.  I highly recommend this listing!

This was such a great experience! First, Jennifer is an absolute gem, responsive, helpful, warm, friendly, professional! During a crazy rainstorm, water came in through a few closed windows and the front door (we let the host know). A more complete coffee setup, flat bed sheets, luggage stands, basic shower items, and more towel options would be great additions. Communication was friendly, though I did need to reach out to get check-in info that was supposed to come earlier. With a few updates, this could be an excellent stay!

The place is exactly as described. The hosts are friendly and very easy to get ahold of. The free breakfast is a great perk. The neighborhood felt safe and parking was always easy. Can't beat the value for the area.
Great host and great place to stay.
Apartamento completamente nuevo y justo en el centro de Chicago, facil acceso,  parqueo en frente. Ideal para grupos de hasta 7 personas que quieran conocer el DownTown de Chicago.
Great location for any expos at McCormick.

Gracjan is a terrific host.  This place is in a fine location and served our needs well enough.  It has a few quirks, but overall it was a comfortable and satisfactory place for the few days were were there.
Had a great stay at Hatice’s place! Her place was right next to many different restaurants and a short drive to downtown! Would definitely stay again if in the area!

Bryan was super responsive. Very helpful. His managing of the unit or monitor became creepy though. If he lives on-site, with the stairs being wood and women wearing heels, you’re going to hear “noise”. During the checkout a disabled uber driver was helping one of the guest leave, leaned on his porch a bit for balance and Bryan told the man to not “pee” in his yard, when he wasn’t. Great location

The house was wonderful, and Danny was absolutely;loy fantastic.
The inside of the house is lovely. The downstairs has a living room with a fountain and a light that puts stars on the ceiling. There is also a full bathroom in the downstairs. The main floor has a HUGE bedroom with a king bed, a bathroom, a living room, and a kitchen. The upstairs has two large bedrooms and a full bath.
The surrounding area felt safe, and we appreciated the off-street parking. During high winds, a tree fell on the power lines to the entire block at about 9 pm. Danny was super-proactive in calling the power company and communicating with us. When we woke up, the power was back.
We booked this because one of us grew up on the south side of Chicago and just turned 80 years old. It was perfect!!

The room was on the third floor, so be prepared to climb up and down stairs with your bag(s).
I wasn't really hanging out in the kitchen/common area as I only used the Airbnb room as a place to sleep and wash up.
The bedroom was comfortable with enough space to lay out my clothes and bags.
I didn't have to use the AC unit as when I went the weather was chilly in Chicago around mid 50s.
The restroom was clean. I know that there were people in the other rooms as I heard doors creak open and close at night, but I never actually ran into anyone else while I was staying there for 3 nights.

We had a great stay here! Instructions and communication were so good. And a great location
pure perfection

Bathroom was actually pretty fancy!
All in all, a great stay for the price, if you’re used to the city 👍

We were extremely happy with Yaharra’s place! Easy contactless check-in through a lockbox a block away, and then the apartment was just as described and pictured. We took advantage of a few kitchen items (mostly pans for warming up leftover pizza) and the fridge has automatic water and ice which kept our travel bottles filled. The shower had good pressure and it’s a deep tub if someone wanted a lovely bath. The water stayed hot enough for the two of us but O wonder if more than two could shower in a row and have water. We got surprised with needing a washing machine and were grateful to have the washer dryer. The bed was one of the more comfortable mattresses I’ve slept on, and I liked the minimalist decor.
Now let’s talk about the view! It’s on a high floor so we had a beautiful view of sunsets and also gorgeous city lights at night. We could see the river and even better for me, there’s a direct view of the iconic River City Apartments which was cool to look out at. Great stay!
Amy’s place was perfect for out trip! Gorgeous, spacious home in a nice neighborhood. Thank you for hosting us!
The place was clean and as described!!

Staying uptown at Tara's place was wonderful, peaceful, and so convenient. We loved the neighborhood, the access to stores, and really delicious food. We ended up adjusting to the sounds of the train and it came to be nice white noise (: Thanks, Tara!
Beautiful house! Beautiful kitchen. Perfect for hosting, and that hot tub. Is. Everything.
I love Chicago but needed a place that allowed me to work. Kenneth's place was the best of both worlds. Have already recommended it to friends.
We enjoyed our stay. The location is great and the house is just as described in the listing. Well kept and easy entry.

Stayed with my family for 4 days for my sister’s graduation. We loved the place and found it quite cozy. The decor and the wonderful back eating area was a nice touch.

Nice neighborhood location . Easy access to downtown by Metra train or CTA bus & train.

Amazing location in a friendly neighborhood! The home was clean, with a well-kept kitchen and washrooms, and the bed was very comfortable.

Hola todo muy bien el cuarto impecable , el baño también , muy tranquilo y silencioso el barrio, en la esquina tienes un bus que te lleva al downtwon en 15 minutos, el tema q por la zona del alojamiento no hay nada de supermercados o tiendas y por último muy buena atención de José pero sería bueno q use Whats App
It felt just like home, very cosy and the hosts are very welcoming!! Loved it!!
Wonderful location, the building has an old town feel and is in a beautiful, walkable area - so close to the water. Enjoyed my stay! It felt very safe, clean, and comfortable!

The place was quite lovely and accurate to the listing. My stay there was more than worth it for the surrounding area. The place was very clean and in a great area of Chicago. Jake was very informative and responsive. We had a great stay!!

My stay was just WOW! The apartment is well maintained and equipped. It has an impressive gym and all the amenities I need. And of course, Jennifer is an amazing host! She is exceptionally helpful and incredibly prompt with her responses.

100% Recommend. Comfy, cozy spot in a quiet neighborhood.

Perfect for our weekend in Chicago! We were able to walk to several restaurants and a quick and easy drive to the museums and Solider Field! We felt very safe in the neighborhood and would definitely recommend to others :)

His place is a 25-30 min drive to downtown, soldier field and McCormick place, it can be less or more depending on the traffic. It was a great stay and I would recommend.

It was a great stay! Check in was a little rocky, but Bella was continually in communication with us throughout the process. The property was as described and is newly remodeled. It is in a great neighborhood that you could walk around in. We also liked the distance to the L-Train (a few blocks) We noticed a few small things in the bathroom, which we made the host aware. Bella assured us these would be taken care of. We would stay here again!
I enjoyed my stay here! It was amazing and a great area. The condo was very clean and the hosts were very helpful with instructions and questions. I definitely would come back and stay again.

My family and I came to stay for a concert at Solider Field, and this was the perfect place. Not a bad distance from the stadium, and close to plenty of spots for food and shopping. The place was well decorated, stocked with snacks and any supplies we could’ve needed. Great experience, would definitely stay again!
Perfect stay!
Very nice! The pictures don’t do it justice! It was spacious and accommodating for our stay.
Wonderful stay in the Blue Room! Would definitely recommend and stay again next time I'm in Chicago!
Host were available and always responsive. I felt like I was in a 5 star hotel

Nathan and Jake were wonderful hosts. They were incredibly attentive and even down the the last moment when we had a mix up with the keys they were able to answer my questions within minutes. Couldn’t be a better neighbourhood to stay in while you’re in Chicago or a better listing at which to stay.
What a great experience this was! Genesys’ place was very cleans and she was SO NICE! They made you feel so welcomed and went above and beyond! Thanks for the great stay! We will be back!
Great place to stay in Wrigleyville with responsive host.  Everything was very clean and comfortable.  The host was very accommodating even with our flight getting in unexpectedly late.

This location had great access to transit, and the walk to the train was super easy for us to get to our various activities - down to the Beyoncé concert at Soldier Field, up to the Cubs game, etc. The place was very cozy, clean, and perfect for our group of 4. The free street parking was a nice perk with plenty of room. Lyle was a great communicator, and check-in was easy. I would stay here again!

Daniel is a friendly and responsive host. The place is in a great neighborhood, safe and walkable. As other reviews noted, the rooms are down a long hallway limiting interactions but the kitchen/living room is great for gatherings. We enjoyed our stay, the apartment, and neighborhood. The reason for the 4 stars is the noise from above the apartment. While the rooms were quiet within the apartment, we could easily and often hear steps above, including late at night (1:00) that awakened us.
Amazing stay at Beth’s was even better than the pictures! Beth was very responsive, the neighborhood was amazingly walkable, close to Soldier field but also very quiet neighborhood!
Had a wonderful stay, host was very friendly and helpful.
I enjoyed my stay
Casper was a great host. Communicated well . Good location.
Grateful to Rene for her responsiveness and kindness—and her space.

The home was recently remodeled and it served its purpose for our trip there!! It wasn’t decorated, but it was clean, as decorations at rental homes don’t matter to me. There wasn’t a lot of hot water, but that could also be attributed to the construction going on at the home next door. The 4 of us enjoyed our stay ultimately and would certainly rent again!

This was my first time in Chicago and wanted to pick a low-key progressive area and I was impressed. The unit looks just like the pictures, the area was quiet and it’s next to a Starbucks. My only negative (has nothing to do with the host) is that the unit is roughly about 30-40 minutes from Downtown, so that’s something to consider. There are a lot of restaurants near the area as well. If I decide to come back to Chicago I would rebook with no hesitation.

We (group of 10 women) stayed here for a weekend reunion. There were enough beds, including a few to double-up. We spent most of our time on the main floor hanging out in the front room and dining room areas. Kitchen has all the amenities (although we didn't cook much) - mostly used the fridge and coffee maker! Getting into the house was super easy for everyone since its a code access. The location is great for walking to shops and restaurants and a nearby L station.
We loved the house and we will most definitely stay there again.  Roscoe Village was, quaint, beautiful, friendly, easy to get to.   Our trip to Wrigley was a huge success for our party of 9.

Oscar y Ana fueron unos excelentes anfitriones que nos hicieron sentir como en casa, siempre dispuestos a ayudar y resolver cualquier duda. La casa está muy bien ubicada, en un sitio tranquilo y accesible. Sin duda repetiremos.
Enjoyed our stay!
Everything was nice clean and more than expected. Very spacious

The place was beautiful! Close to the blueline transportation. The communication was awesome, it felt like we were talking to friends.
Overall it was amazing!
Danica was a great host. Very prompt with communication.

Paradise met us when we got there and did a walkthrough she was very nice and helpful. The Airbnb was clean and looked exactly like the photos. It was in a quiet neighborhood. It was stocked with everything that you would need and we felt at home. We would stay again.

Went to Chicago for a family trip and this place was perfect. We had a lot of amenities that made it well worth booking an Airbnb versus a hotel room. The place was clean and everyone had their own space. There was a patio outside and the owner was very flexible for check in. We even had a few grocery items like eggs and milk to make our stay better. There was parking right in front, which made it easy to come in and out. This was by far one of the best stays we’ve had! We highly recommend and we’ll definitely be back.

Great, cozy place to stay, and I’d stay again. Just note: this building has central air that is not controlled by you, but by the hosts. The hosts are very accommodating to changing the temperature, so just give them a heads up. But luckily enough, they’re VERY responsive and lovely to connect with.

As a former Chicago native, this place was fabulous for our girls trip (7 adults). There was plenty of space, it’s a beautiful lakeview street, and excellent location. The renovations were done nicely and I found the beds super comfortable. Daniel was able to accommodate a slightly earlier checkin which was super helpful to our group.
The unit does have neighbors above and below, and quiet hours are enforced in the outdoor space.
Overall I would definitely return if traveling with a group to Chicago!

This place was a great little spot to stay in for our Chicago vacation, close enough to the L lines to walk and see a decent bit of a great neighborhood with cute restaurants and shops along the way
Very much worth the trip and Lindsey was very helpful and responsive. It is worth noting for any prospective renters, though, that when we checked in whatever cleaners were hired didn’t show up for their appointment. Lindsey got cleaners in the same night while we were out in the neighborhood and would have been gone anyway so the trip wasn’t interrupted or hindered in any way, but that was our experience. After that little hiccup on night 1 the rest of the stay was a nice peaceful getaway in Chicago

Great location, very spacious and clean unit. Front desk receptionist, she was very friendly with every interaction we had with her. Easy access into the building and to the unit. Great restaurants in the surrounding area. Would definitely stay here again.
Great option

I had a wonderful stay at Jordan's. The house is comfortable and the location is very convenient, just a 10-minute walk to the University campus, and various stores and restaurants. It's also close enough to the lake, which is very enjoyable in the spring. Jordan was a very good host, always available when needed. I would stay here again in the future.

We absolutely loved Roberto’s place. It’s so cheery, warm & comfortable. Everything was just as he described, and he was there to meet and welcome us when we got there. The backyard common area is so lovely with fairy lights & plants/flowers. It was perfect for our stay, and we will definitely book again on a future trip!! Thanks, Roberto & Carlos!!!
😊

Lovely, clean home in a safe neighborhood! Nice host who is extremely responsive and made sure we had everything needed.
Two things that are worth mentioning, no shoes are allowed inside the home. You have to take off your shoes and walk upstairs. Isn’t a big deal, but is worth being aware of. After a long night and when rushing out the door it’ll slow you down a tad! Nice to know you’re in a clean home without outside shoe germs :)
Second, we did notice it gets hotter at night in both bedrooms and there are no ceiling fans. The unit is nice and cool throughout the day.
The host was very responsive and gifted
A complimentary bottle of wine and snacks. That was thoughtful! We had a great stay. Thank you!
Brad was a great host ! If you're ever in the chicago area, this would be a great place to stay very clean and a great neighborhood. I will be returning back.
Place was great for our family

John’s place is in a pretty neighborhood a few blocks from public transportation. There was a nice market and a couple restaurants. Be aware that there is a fairly steep stairway up to the unit.John was very responsive when we had a question. There are some condiments available which was appreciated. The unit is tastefully decorated. We would stay there again.

The Irving Park area is a convenient "hub" at an affordable price. Great restaurants nearby, walking in Irving Park, and very residential with lots of families. Heather's place was comfortable and had the amenities we were looking for. Parking on the street was pretty easy and not an issue. We were traveling with our 2 young adult kiddos, so it was a bit tight...but if it's just a short weekend, it's perfecto.
Restaurants we loved were D'Candela (Peruvian) and Cafe Beograd.
Great location, easy check in!! Perfect for a weekend at Wrigleyville!

You get exactly what is described in the posting. It was in a good location between the airport and downtown but it was a little further from downtown than I realized, so plan ahead for that if you’re taking public transportation. It was very easy to access the home and the host was very responsive and reliable. The only draw backs I had were more personal. I think I probably won’t get just a room the next time because I like not having to share a bathroom with a stranger. I also think the price could be a little lower for just a room and shared spaces but overall it was a good experience.

Maureen was incredibly hospitable to myself and my family during our girls weekend!  She was so responsive to all our questions and really went the extra mile with complimentary treats and amenities. I would highly recommend her space if you are looking for an aesthetic and affordable spot that’s just outside the city. Thank you so much for the great stay!
Really cute place and clean. Thanks so much!
The pie shop across the street is a MUST visit—try the coffee toffee!

We had a few minor inconveniences that were very quickly addressed.  Large clean space.  The neighborhood was not super but tolerable, however there seems to be some neighbors or residents making things worse for everyone living nearby.   We did not have any noise issues as some had mentioned.  Just normal city noise.  Comfortable beds.

Would definitely stay at Rhett’s place again! He was super accommodating and helpful. The place was spectacular with lots of space to relax and spread out. We had a lovely time enjoying the house and the backyard!
Very homey great for a large group. Felt right at home!
Very responsive host and wanted to make sure we had a wonderful stay.

I had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb! From the beginning, the host was incredibly communicative, friendly, and made sure I felt welcome and well taken care of throughout my visit. The unit was exactly as described, if not better! It exceeded my expectations in comfort.
Everything I needed was thoughtfully provided, from kitchen essentials to extra towels and toiletries, which made the stay feel effortless and homey. The place was spotless upon arrival, and the bed was super comfortable, perfect for relaxing after a day or night out.
The location was also ideal, with easy access to everything I needed, whether it was dining, shopping, or transportation.
Overall, I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. I’d absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a clean, convenient, and well-hosted Airbnb.

genesys has a beautiful home, and such welcoming energy. even her pets are welcoming to guests, and that’s extremely telling. we thoroughly enjoyed our stay! everything is exactly like the photos, i was farrrr from disappointed <3
Great, spacious place with everything you need for an excellent stay. Furnishings make it feel homey and pleasant! Highly recommend.

Genesys’s had a beautiful home with lots of space! I was so grateful that they were able to accommodate my last minute request due to another host canceling on my hours before my check in. They were so friendly and I loved their dog Simba! He was so sweet.
Seller was very responsive and kind allowing access to the bnb at 1pm.

We came for a college graduation, so not a long stay. Place was just what we needed with small fridge, coffee machine, and tiny kitchen. We took advantage of Chicago’s great restaurant food. If you are wanting to do your own cooking, this might not be your place.

Bart's place was a great size and had everything we needed for our 3 week stay. The beds are comfortable and there's plenty of living space. It is a garden apartment, so you will hear the kids upstairs occasionally but it's quiet by 9 pm. We were worried about the ceiling height as my husband is 6'4", but the majority of the space is surprisingly tall with only a few lower ducts. The fully fenced yard was perfect for our dog and there was a beautiful park a block away. Bart and his family were always so friendly!
Great neighborhood and location, especially if you want to be close to Wrigleyville. We enjoyed the projector and back deck/yard especially.
Very clean apartment and host was great. Everything was just as described and I would recommend it to a friend.
Nice location on a cute, quiet street. Lots of restaurants/cafes within walking distance and only a few blocks from the blue line. Unit is as described and the host was responsive.

The unit is newly renovated and has modern features, which we appreciated. However, it had a noticeable bug issue—several spiders were found on the walls, in the kitchen and bedrooms, and even on our belongings. We also experienced loud stomping and noise from the upstairs unit starting around 6–7 a.m. each day, making it difficult to sleep. Most disappointing was the complete lack of communication from the host, who never responded to any of our messages during the stay. Unfortunately, we left feeling disappointed and wouldn’t recommend this listing.

Natasha was a very responsive host and always quick to respond whenever we had questions.  The home is near a very high-traffic street, but there was still plenty of street parking and it's walkable to plenty of restaurants/bars.  It was a great fit for our group of 5.  Good experience.

Cozy house! My family and I had a wonderful time celebrating my birthday…my grandchildren felt right at home. Beds were amazing, really comfortable—we loved them! Niall’s place is close to many restaurants and surrounding area is walkable.

Stayed here for a week while in the process of moving to Chicago. Couldn’t have asked for a better welcome to the city. Great location. Clean and comfortable apartment with every amenity you could think of. Beds are so comfortable! Chris was very welcoming and easy to communicate with if we had any questions.
Exactly as pictured. Easy check in process and very walkable to restaurants and the river front!
Viktor was amazing! Clear communication and a beautiful home . 10/10 would recommend the neighborhood was so peaceful and quiet as well , thanks again Viktor !
Perfectly good place for a short term stay!
Very cute place in a nice quiet suburb
Always a great stay! Thank you!
Staying at this Airbnb was great; it matched the photos, and the area was quiet and felt safe. Victor was always available to answer any questions.
Our stay was absolutely amazing, Andre was very responsive and quick, also he helped us with our car parking, everything was perfect. Thank you so much
Chicago feel, nice up and coming area!
Very beautiful property. We felt safe. Didn’t get to enjoy the home much because we were out sightseeing, but the property looks just like the pictures!

Martha was great she was so nice to us. She was always helpful.  She was very helpful with street parking info and the place was extremely nice and very clean.  Would absolutely love to stay here again.

We had a great long weekend visit. Location is absolutely perfect! You can easily walk to the lake and check out so many restaurants and shops close by. Cihan and Hatice were great, checking in and always making sure we didn’t need anything. We’d stay again!
Great space for larger groups and easy to get to and from the airport!
Great location in the middle of transportation and restaurants, would stay there again!
Great location. Host did not respond to messages.

I loved Darryl’s spot! Great for our girls weekend. Clean, comfortable & well thought out amenities. The neighborhood was beautiful and felt very safe. Would stay here again when I return to Chicago, highly recommend!

I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Chicago! The place was spotless, beautifully maintained, and had everything I needed for a comfortable visit. The host was responsive and helpful throughout. The only reason I’m giving 4 stars instead of 5 is the neighborhood—it wasn’t the best, but it wasn’t the worst either. I still felt reasonably safe and had no major issues. Overall, a great experience and would consider staying again!
Host is very helpful and responds immediately!

Place is as pictured. Nice welcome basket with circulation and some amenities. Host was helpful. Need more clear instructions for checking in and sending automatically when the booking began. Prepare to  keep up with/3 small keys to enter 3 doors. There is absolutely no parking at any time of the day within 2 blocks bc it’s a congested area with things in walking distance. It felt safe although not close to downtown or the expressway. It appears the ceiling paint dust falls bc it’s white fine particles all in the room carpet, couch and throw. It also got in my hair from laying on the pillows. That said,  the carpet and room furniture could’ve used some vacuuming/dusting. Slight odor of feet. The bed is really soft with quality linen. Overall, I would definitely recommend if you don’t have a car & ok with garden units but I would not stay again.

Home was very spacious with lots of room for our group to hang out and relax.  Beds were super comfy and welcome snacks were so nice, especially since we got in late.  Neighborhood was great—wish we had longer to explore all the cool spots!

Ava Marie was the best host! She was responsive, friendly and made sure we had everything we needed to feel at home. The space was very clean, secure and comfortable. We had plenty of space to move around comfortably and with ease. I’ll definitely stay here again. Thank you for everything!

We enjoyed our stay in Chicago! Quiet neighborhood, but walkable to so much between restaurants, bars and the train. The space was comfortable for our group and we're already looking forward to visiting again!
The house is clean, and it feels like home. Jeanne is very responsive and friendly. A lot of great restaurants nearby.

Stayed here for the epic Cowboy Carter tour weekend and Chinatown was a great location, plus the metro was only a 10 minute walk from the Airbnb. The host meticulously labeled everything which was helpful. Some comforts like a water filter and thicker towels would have been great. It was also tricky getting the temp in the apartment just right, but the weather in town that weekend was also incredibly erratic, making it more difficult.
I love Quang. He’s so nice. Room 3 is great. Comfy bed and clean sheets. The bathroom light did stop on the final day for my stay but it didn’t bother me.
Incredible Stay, really enjoyed the place!

Excellently located apartment in friendly neighbourhood with secure entrance.  Beautiful building with good amenities and shops close by. Nice apartment with all one could wish for - quiet, clean and well equipped. Thanks for a great stay.
We had a great stay with Carol! Neighborhood was quiet and close to the L! Her home is super cute and comfy! Plus a great backyard to relax in!

The location was very convenient, but I’ll never pay this much again for what was given. Sharing a bathroom wasn’t ideal. They don’t provide anything for your stay. You have your bedroom and a shared bathroom which you’re only provided two towels for. I had reached out to the host about something I had lost during my stay and they never responded back to me. Overall the stay was just not enjoyable and seemed unprofessional.
My friends and I had a lovely stay in Chicago! The AirBnB was wonderful and spacious, and it was very easy for us to reach the downtown area via the bus.
The stay was good. The bed has a spring base that made sleeping in it difficult.

Allyn is great host and super quick responsive. she was very accommodating and made sure I have everything that I need.
No wonder she is superhost.
This place was great, and Jose was very responsive to any questions and always willing to help accommodate what I needed. Really enjoyed my stay here!

Well positioned near Ventra 66 Bus on Chicago Av to get downtown.
The host shad some confusion towards the end of my stay and cleared out my food and 2 days before tried to get me to move to another location which was not logistically possible

Very well-kept home with free laundry! Patt is ultra-responsive and lives in the area. The wi-fi connection is reliable and surprisingly fast. This space was very quiet and very clean. Nice part of the neighborhood and exceptional value considering it is Hyde Park. Patt is super nice and offered to install an ac unit when I found my room to be a bit too warm to sleep. She even dropped me off at the train at the end of my stay. Highly recommended.
Great location, accommodative and easy to communicate with host

This is a quaint ground floor apartment, nicely furnished, clean and comfortable. Check in and out was easy-peasy. It was a bit too cool for us to hang out in the backyard, but there’s a shaded patio. You can hear footsteps from neighbors above, but most were very careful to observe quiet hours. East walk to Roscoe Village and Lakeview, buses and brown line. Would definitely stay again.
Had a wonderful stay. The host was great with communication, and the neighborhood had so much to do in walking distance.

I didn't have the pleasure of staying at this airbnb due to personal reasons but the airbnb host was considerate enough to check up on me to ensure everything was okay. Highly recommend booking at any of his hosted locations.
Great location, very walkable neighborhood. place worked great for what we needed.

Positives:
-Big open space
- Proximity to good restaurants
- Proximity to Blue Line (easy access to airport as well as downtown)
Good to know beforehand:
- Lots of city noise, including train outside of window.
Negatives:
- Cleanliness (dirty floors, clumps of hair in sheets)
- Disrepair (broken cabinet, exposed wires, plates missing on wall sockets, cracked glass interior door)
- Limited bed space (while the rooms are huge, each only has a full size bed)
Some relatively minor tweaks (professional cleaners, basic repairs, bigger beds) would go a long way; perhaps these will be addressed prior to future stays?
So thankful that Zam allowed an early check-in. This was just what we needed.

I absolutely adored the stay in Jake’s AirBNB. The conditions of the unit were PRISTINE! I loved the location and the walkability of everything in Chinatown. Next time I do in Chicago’s Chinatown, I would only consider booking with Jake! We booked for a girls trip, and there was more than enough space for all three of us and all our toiletries. The street parking was so convenient!

Caroline is super sweet, she greets you and explains everything about the area and the house. She keeps everything clean and tidy, the house is spacious and the cats are adorable. The 26 bus that can be grabbed in front of the south shore culture center is super fast and you can be in the city within 30 min. Also Manjani is a definite must, the vegan soul food is exquisite.

Great apartment with easy access to bus, groceries, and restaurants. Erika was friendly, and willing and able to accommodate my checkout fiasco. Overall, a great stay for me and my cat.
Thanks Erika!
Great place , we stayed while doing work in town for a few weeks , great host !
Anny is one of the best! She made the place as a healing home for us. Her generosity and attention to detail is very appreciated. I would highly recommend this home to future guests.
Victor is a fast communicator, and the experience was worth the price paid. The proximity to a supermarket, parks, and public transport is convenient too.
the home is modern and clean, they got everything, and the host is very responsive

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Chicago! The space was clean, spacious, and located in a great neighborhood. Our group of four women had the entire 10th floor to ourselves, which included two separate units—each with 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms—giving us plenty of room and privacy.
We felt very safe in the building and the surrounding area, which made our visit even more enjoyable. The hosts were fantastic with communication, especially when it came to keeping us informed about ongoing work in the building. Their attentiveness and transparency were much appreciated.
We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to others!
Amazing place!
We loved our stay here! The apartment was great, centrally located and easy to get everywhere. Any questions we had were answered quickly. We’d stay here again!

Это было отличное аутентичное место для проживания. Расположение великолепно для посещения достопримечательностей и прогулок. Я остался доволен и рекомендую для проживания и наслаждения атмосферой Чикаго!

Doug’s place was a wonderful home base for our month in Chicago! Really great value for a big two-bedroom, only a 10 minute way to the L. Lots of things to do in the neighborhood too! If you get the chance to meet their cute dog Lemon, do it!
I had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was friendly, responsive, and made check-in super easy. Highly recommend for anyone visiting the area!
Perfect spot for us. So close to Wrigley Field. Our 2nd time here and we WILL be back next year if it’s available when we need it.

Loved our stay. Right in the middle of everything we wanted to do in Chicago. If we couldn't walk to it, public transportation was readily available. Stephanie was always friendly and responsive. Would definitely stay here again.
Cloud9 was a great choice.  First time we used them will definitely recommend!!  Customer service was excellent  and the units were exactly as described!

One of the best Airbnb I've stayed at! Condo itself was so neat and clean. Quality bedding and towels were a huge plus!   Great gym onsite and lounge area with pool table.  Also felt very safe with front desk attendant on duty. Lots of restaurants within a 10 minute walk. Would highly recommend!
Great host! No major or minor problems with the place. I was really surprised by how good it was compared to its price. I will definitely keep this place when I come back to chicago
This place is great! Located in a very nice and walkable neighborhood. Hosts are very responsive and helpful. Great place to stay to check out Chicago

We had a great time staying here! Not only is the neighborhood very accessible to the big city but it felt very safe too. The hosts made sure every room was clean and gave small things like paper plates and silverware to help make things easier. The balcony had a great view, we will definitely be returning in the future ⭐️
Place was clean. They responded well to messages. We're disappointed by lack of bonus room that was pictured.

I stayed for 3 weeks while transitioning to a new job and my stay was peaceful and easy. I was grateful that Anna was willing to be flexible when I had a last-minute change in schedule. The unit was clean and had everything you would need if you forgot some travel supplies. Everything is well-labeled and easy to find and everything you need to cook a decent meal is available. I was also able to park right in front of the house every night despite being on a busy street. Thanks for a great stay!
Bon séjour chez Jose, pas de souci particulier

Bairro muito tranquilo, a 20 minutos do centro de ônibus, extremamente fácil, um parque lindo praticamente no quintal da acomodação, casa extremamente moderna, exatamente como nas fotos! Tudo muito limpo, cozinha super equipada! Com certeza já quero voltar a me hospedar novamente aqui!

Amazing location! The neighborhood is cute and the people are friendly. I felt safe traveling solo. It's close to bus routes that will take you to the heart of downtown. FYI: included breakfast was only kid boxes of cereal, BYO milk. Also, you have to meet in-person to check in (just to get a keypad code - that felt a bit odd). Candace was responsive and nice. I recommend this place for an economy visit close to downtown.
I had a great stay, the location is perfect and I love it. I’ll be back for sure.
Broken lights in bathroom which host committed to fixing but didn’t that I couldn’t turn off and smell in unit. Also woken up by vacuuming at 6:55am.

I would stay here again. The only things I would change are the pillows and add some sort of dining space. There is nowhere to actually sit and eat with more than one person, which I found odd. Was great for me being solo though.
It was the perfect place for my work/family trip. Enough space for everyone and great hang out places. Would definitely book again when in Chicago.

Her şey gayet güzel ve anlatıldığı gibiydi. Temizlik konusunda sorun yoktu. Perdenin arkasında bir oda daha var ve kullanabiliyorsunuz. Odanın dışında bir veranda var, yazları kullanılabilir. O’hare’den uber ile 110 dolar tutuyor, bunu. Yerine tren kullanılabilir, yeşil hattın “cottage grove” durağı oldukça yakın. Evin olduğu mahalle özellikle akşamları çok güvende hissettirmedi ama bir sorun yaşamadım. Ev arkadaşları çok cana yakın. Uchicago’ya yürüme mesafesinde

I’ve said it to John so many times, and I’ll say it again. John’s place is a warm home away from home. It screams family love, even down to the lack of clutter, so the littles can move about freely without the adults worrying too much about their safety. John went above and beyond to supply all the baby gear we needed. He was always available to answer any questions we had. I would totally return to this home again.

The host was very responsive and the place looks just like the pictures. It was a little difficult to get inside we had to push the door a little hard to get in. Both of the bathrooms were left a little unclean and we had to clean them
ourselves. But overall it was not a bad stay.
Had a pleasant stay. No issues.
Can’t say enough good things. I wish I lived here. Wonderful stay. No problems at all
Place was very welcoming, clean and the host was very responsive about any questions. Great location.
Inka is the best host! His place on s absolutely amazing!

I’m a quiet, respectful guest who doesn’t use shared spaces and weren't even home that much due to long work hours. Unfortunately, the day before checkout, the host made me feel extremely uncomfortable. After returning from work at 3am, I hadn’t left my room. When I stepped out to use the bathroom and greeted her with “good morning,” she ignored me, suddenly got up, and cornered me in a small hallway space. She shouted at me in an accusatory tone, demanding to know if I signed for a FedEx package under a name completely unrelated to me.
Despite me clearly saying no, she acted like she didn’t believe me and then asked what time I was checking out, making me feel pressured to leave. Her son later messaged with excuses and pointed to their 5-star reviews, which doesn’t justify how I was treated. I never received an apology from Judy for her unnecessary aggression.
The last part of my stay was tense, uncomfortable, and not something I’d want to experience again.
Keenan is a great host!
Awesome stay! Victor was very kind and accommodating.
Awesome!!!
Awesome host
Enjoyed my stay!
Victor was very flexible with my extended stay extensions and provided a clean, safe stay while I was between places.

Absolutely flawless stay! I spent nearly 3 months at Mary’s place and couldn’t have asked for better. The location is unbeatable—peaceful yet close to transit, vibrant restaurants, and a truly welcoming, diverse neighborhood. The unit was fully stocked, incredibly dog-friendly (with a local unofficial dog park!), and perfect for remote work. Parking was easy, and Mary was an exceptional host—responsive, thoughtful, and efficient. I’ve already rebooked. A perfect home away from home. 10/10!
The owners were warm and welcoming, shared common spaces were always clean. If we had any questions they were fast and responsive!

This is my second booking with Nicole. Her place is clean, cozy with all the amenities needed. It feels like home! She was also flexible in making my check out later and I so appreciated that. I plan to book again in the fall.

A nice and spacious unit! I stayed here for a little over a week and felt right at home. The bedroom was cozy. It’s in a convenient location - easy to walk to restaurants and take the bus, train, or uber anywhere.

Very pleasant host, and talkative!
be advised that there will be other guests, if you couldn't gather that from the photos. You will still have your own privacy/locking room, so no possible issue of someone invading your space!
Great place, good location, as described in the photos. Thanks for hosting!

Amazing stay just as described . Wonderful responsive and cooperative host. Stayed there for a month didn’t have any problem the area is not as bad as we heard its calm not very walkable at night but nothing unmanageable. + it was very close to almost everywhere we needed to go .

I really enjoyed my stay. The neighborhood is very peaceful and quiet, which makes it perfect for anyone coming to study or work. The accommodations are excellent — clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. There’s a good sense of privacy, and the environment is calm, ideal for focusing and relaxing. Sharon and Mr. Hank are very friendly and helpful hosts. I would definitely stay here again if I return to Chicago.

The place is in a perfect part of Chicago. Very close to the park and we were able to find street parking for our rental car fairly easily. There’s some noise at night from the surrounding businesses but it’s not too bad. Having 2 bathrooms came in clutch and the place was bigger than expected.
Really enjoyed our time here and we will look to book through them again when we come back to Chicago in the future.

non disclosed daycare downstairs, you can hear children screaming. Spacious apartment that’s great for kids (child safety gate, pack and play, toys, baby bath tub, bassinet). Great location close to Loyola and the red line. Very walkable. Hosts were responsive and very accommodating.

Awesome spot ! Really nice place looked just like the photos. Super clean and in a great area. Bryan is such an amazing host super friendly and quick to reply. Check-in was so smooth, and everything went great. Would totally stay here again.

I stayed at Yelena’s place for a travel contract for about a year, and I would have kept staying if I didn’t need to travel to another location. The location of the apartment is the best part. I’m sure I’ll be back in Chicago again for work, and I’ll make sure to message her again to see if her place is available!

+Josh is very responsive and helpful.

We loved this condo! Everything was exactly as described and the close proximity to Lake Michigan was great. I ran by the lake every morning. There is a train stop walking distance and a short rid to Wrigley Field. Our group loved this place and we highly recommend it!

This is a nice aesthetic basement apartment just as described. It has everything one needs for a long stay.
Close to transit, groceries, drugstore, restaurants, cafes, and some music venues.
Best of all the hosts Nofar and Josh are amazing. They are very hospitable and helpful. Meeting them was a pleasure.
Would happily stay here again.
Beautiful house. Great furniture. Will recommend

William, and the property manager Ross, were excellent hosts. The space was exactly as depicted, with a grand bank of windows looking out over the neighborhood. Ross was extremely helpful throughout our stay.

Lee was extremely accommodating, quite friendly, so full of life and knowledge! Kenwood can be tricky if yiu aren't from the city so bare this in mind. A tree-lined street greets you upon arrival.  "L Train" is a very decent 10min walk... especially when the weather agrees. Aldi is basically around the corner. The neighborhood dogs were a nuisance with the incessant barking but that's really only negative. The space is private, well kept and stocked with all the essentials. I would definitely stay again.
Perfect stay!!

Monica’s place was an amazing stay. Everything was clean inside and was very easy to locate. The only thing I would say is that there were little bugs and centipedes all over the other room. But other than that it was a great stay.
Very clean, comfortable, and great location

We had a wonderful stay in Chicago! Beautiful house, very clean. Very nice neighborhood. We got confused about how to get in, it was our fault, we looked at the wrong number code. My second time staying at this apartment. Great location and set up. I felt right at home!

Lovely, lovely place. When I come back to Chicago, i will definitely keep this place in mind. Some airbnbs make you feel uncomfortable with the space and how its being used but my girlfriend and i felt right at home immediately.
There are walkable options food and drink options nearby and its a quick ride share ride to various venues, landmarks, restaurants, and sites around the city.
Very responsive! I had some timing issues of my own design that they were extremely communicative and flexible with! Above and beyond!
Great location! Exactly as described lots of restaurants and bars. Definitely would come back.
Wonderful stay—clean, cozy, and exactly as described. Highly recommend!

I visited Chicago with a large group and our stay at the air bnb was perfect. Everything matched the listing perfectly and the space was exactly what we needed! Very walkable to surrounding neighborhoods and close to downtown. I would absolutely stay here next time I visit

I stayed here for four weeks, and it was a truly comfortable experience. Patt was very kind and helpful, and I felt at ease throughout my stay. Thank you for a wonderful stay!
Great location and place to stay

I would definitely recommend this location. My family and I had a wonderful time staying at Belinda's. The location was superb it was 20min from everywhere i needed to go. Air freshener extra trash bags toothbrushes cleaning supplies cause im sharing the bathroom with 3 males. She was very accommodating and overall the perfect host. Thank you for making our family trip complete ! 🤩

10/10 I’d definitely recommend! I will definitely be back.

Great stay, good location, no complaints.
Great place in a great location! Assel was easy to communicate with and we enjoyed his Gold Coast home!
Great apartment for larger groups.  Plenty of space in the living room/kitchen area for a group of 10.

I stayed 32 days in Sena's place. It was delightful. The apartment is spacious and clean, and there are tons of restaurants within a walking distance. There is also an Aldi store just across the street. Sena was very responsive and addressed all my needs. Great stay!

I would rent here again.

Stayed here for 2 months and it was a great stay. The place is great (big with a lot of natural light) and very spacious with a really nice kitchen. You are close to a bunch of great restaurants and bars as well as the L (blue line).

Justin and his wife are very communicative and were great to deal with.
Would highly recommend!

Bella was pretty helpful! The floor was pretty dirty when I got there and it took a few days to get it cleaned which wasn't a great experience. It seems like this is one of several units in the building she is renting out because a lot of the amenities didn't really match the picture, especially in the kitchen. I was missing a lot of the pictured pots and pans as well as the coffee stuff. overall though it was a pretty good stay!

Great house, we enjoyed our stay very much. Spacious and well appointed, tastefully renovated while maintaining its old character. Two living rooms with TVs was helpful for our group to be able to separate when necessary.

The room with the small bed is indeed quite small, best for a child. Floors are VERY creaky but that's to be expected in a house this old, bring earplugs so you aren't awoken by others going to the bathroom at night. Some harsh white bulbs that would be better replaced with softer lighting. All in all though we were quite happy.

Mark’s place was a perfect home away from home for our long weekend! The space was spotlessly clean and so comfortable. Getting in and out was easy and the location was peaceful and convenient. I’d stay again any time!

Stephen's place is as advertised. Booked it for a large bachelor trip of approx. 30 year-olds (give or take). Ample space, good location, easy to access, and Stephen was always responsive when needed. We had a great trip and the house was one of the features that made it happen.
AJ and Hannah's place was perfect as our home base for the weekend. Large and with several areas to sit and talk, it was comfortable and inviting. Absolutely recommend it and them as hosts!
Cloud9 was a great stay! The building is beautiful and the apartment is spacious and clean. Thanks to Charlie for timely help.

great place to start a day and walk  around the city

it was good. I feel like for the price it should have central AC, also Amazon and UPS never had the latch codes so my packages were always either delayed or left somewhere easy to steal.

the hosts were attentive and helpful with a few small things that weren’t working or needed to be repaired. The unit was cozy and in a great neighborhood and I thoroughly enjoyed my time there!

The neighborhood is absolutely beautiful — peaceful, safe, and surrounded by great restaurants, cafes, and local shops. It’s one of the nicest areas in the city. Public transportation is super convenient too, with both bus stops and the Brown Line just a short walk away.
The host is incredibly kind and responsive. She explained everything clearly and was always available if I had any questions.
And I have to mention her amazing dog, Theodore — he’s one of the friendliest pets I’ve ever met! Always happy to see you and full of positive energy.
I would gladly stay here again and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a quiet, comfortable home in one of Chicago’s best neighborhoods.

Beautiful place and well responsive host!
Loved our stay!

This was the worst Airbnb I’ve ever stayed in.
My items were stolen from outside, and the host refused to check the cameras, citing “policy.” The listing falsely advertises breakfast—there were no cereals, fruits, spreads, or syrup, just old sugar and peanut butter. The AC barely worked; it was too hot to sleep. The freezer was full, and I wasn’t given space to store frozen food. Very nice and unique space and close to a lot of great places in the neighborhood. Also had a house guitar which for a musician like me was a nice touch!

Logement agréable, bien situé dans le Loop avec toutes les commodités dans le quartier. Petits problèmes avec la serrure à l'arrivée vite résolue et l'eau chaude par intermittence.

Carrie and her husband were so accommodating! Their airbnb is pet friendly and they are so kind, caring toward dogs/cats. 10/10 would recommend staying at their place!!

Easy street parking. Easy location. Right by humboldt park.

Great place to stay with a good location at a very convenient price!

Beautiful location and views.  Host was responsive to questions and issues.  Had a fun and enjoyable stay.

I’m giving 5 stars even though there were many issues, because I think Patricia is still getting the hang of this property and I was one of her first guests.
My recommendations:
- switch the mattress for a nicer memory foam mattress, it’s very soft and caves in, anyone that needs more firm support shouldn’t book until that’s fixed
- have the internet serviced. My devices wouldn’t stay connected and I had to use my mobile hot spot and upgrade to unlimited internet with AT&T

- building entrance code was changed without informing me so couldn’t enter when bringing home groceries
I think Patricia will fix all the issues. She’s very kind and responsive.

Cozy, very clean and convenient place to stay in Chicago!

I highly recommend this place!

Chi was not only a gracious host but a responsible one too. Our needs were met, the home was perfect and his professionalism is unmatched. I would recommend anyone to his place and encourage those that do business with him in the future to take as much pride in that home as he does.

We had a great time in Marriannes home! We stayed in Chicago to attend a conference at McCormick place, which was easy as its just 20minutes walking from the house. The house itself was a rustic beautiful historic home with a lot of charme. We’d stay there again!

Decent stay for the price! Know that there’s no cleaning service so it’s entirely reliant on tenants, meaning common places like the kitchen are not the cleanest. i loved my stay with miss delia it was awesome ill definitely be back again

Tetyana was very kind and responsive throughout my stay.

During my stay, the main differences between the picture of the sleeping arrangement and what I got was the bedding was leopard print. It was fine, though, as that comforter was soft.
The bed was a good balance between firm and soft.
The pillows are on the softer side, in case any future travelers want more firm or medium pillows.
Also, the desk in the picture has been swapped out with a white one which can increase or decrease in height, based on which mode you want to to be. There was no lamp on it, but I didn't need one.

The listing did not include a working desk as shown in the pictures. There was one locked room on the property, which may have originally contained the desk. Additionally, the amenities were limited—only about a quarter roll of toilet paper was provided in one of the two bathrooms, and despite communicating with the host, no solution was offered. Nice space and wonderful community.

Todo estuvo excelente, la atención y el lugar

La casa è molto bella, si trova in un bel quartiere, a 10 minuti a piedi dalla linea blu della metro che porta in centro e in aeroporto, posizione perfetta.
