It’s a good place to crash if you’re just looking for a place to stay. There’s usually other people so it’s not lonely. They know the city pretty well and can give you instructions on where to go and how to get there.

I have doing Airbnb's for about five years now. Nate's place is the biggest, cleanest, beautiful Airbnb I have stayed a. It's close to the green line that takes you to the Loop, which then gets virtually anywhere in the city!! I would most definitely stay here again!! Great Job Nate!!
Enjoyed my stay. Great place
Great stay nice and quiet
Gemessen am Preisniveau in Chicago ist das ein super Preis / Leistungsverhältnis.
Nice place with great views near a lot of good food.

Peaceful and very walkable location. Kate has stocked the place with anything you might need, from coffee supplies to extra bottled water and towels. The shower is amazing!the location is a few minutes walk to the train and to lots of great restaurants in Andersonville. We will definitely stay again when visiting this part of Chicago!

El departamento es realmente como está publicado en las fotos, muy limpio, facil de accesar y muy bien ubicado. Supermercado muy cerca, parada de camión a 5 minutos y estación de tren a 8 minutos caminando.
La zona muy tranquila y segura. Hatice muy amable y atenta para cualquier duda, proporcionó las instrucciones adecuadas en todo momento.
Realmente lo recomiendo y me volvería a hospedar. Es excelente.
Celia est très réactif , séjour très agréable l’appartement est très bien situé proche de la station blue line

Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt! Die Unterkunft liegt in einer schönen und ruhigen Gegend – perfekt zum Entspannen nach einem Tag in der Stadt. Alles war super sauber und gepflegt, wir haben uns direkt wohlgefühlt. Besonders praktisch fanden wir die gut ausgestattete Küche mit Waschmaschine – ein echter Pluspunkt, gerade bei einem längeren Aufenthalt. Die Kommunikation mit dem Host war top: schnell, freundlich und unkompliziert. Falls wir wieder nach Chicago kommen, würden wir definitiv gerne wieder hier übernachten!
Excellent, and communicative host. Great location in West Town. Near West Town Bakery and my new favorite restaurant Mott St. Downtown is easily accessible via CTA.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and found the location to be great! Parking was easy and Mark was responsive and easy to work with!
Merek was a great host from the time we arrived he made sure we had everything we needed ! Easy check in good location if you’re visiting Chicago I recommend this place!
always a perfect stay++

Some reviews I saw before booking were concerned about the neighborhood but in my opinion, the neighborhood was lovely and people around were kind. The apartment was very nice inside with super comfortable beds. Only thing we did know or expect was the apartment being on the 3rd floor. The host was very responsive and quick to solve all problems we encountered at the Airbnb. It was a great trip for sure. Thank you for hosting us.
All good, no complaints. Nice place, huge basement, cozy living room. Would stay there again.

Great location. As the listing notes, it is a smaller space in that it's just the room and bathroom. It did have good amenities, but could have been a little cleaner. That said Junior was super responsive.

Nice, affordable little basement studio on a quiet street in Lincoln Park. The Airbnb was just what I needed for a short weekend stay, but a few things to note:
- Neighbors upstairs can sometimes be noisy, the walls are quite thin so you can hear people exiting and entering the halls and walking around and talking upstairs early in the morning or late at night which was kind of annoying, but manageable.
- I think the window coverings next to bed don't fully obfuscate the interior when you're inside with the lights on at night. I heard a neighbor walk by the window before entering the same building and audibly say "this unit is almost on full display" which made me a little self conscious when I was in there getting ready for bed
- The conditioner dispenser in the bathroom didn't work, but the host had someone come in and fix it the next day which was nice.
Aside from those minor things, I enjoyed my stay! :)

We came in from Boston,MA , our daughter was getting married and everything was perfect. The pictures and videos in front of the house came out superb. You truly made this a memorable stay.A beautiful white “ brownstone” was it! We come  to Chi once a year,see you soon
Nice area, nice apartment. 15 min from downtown, Would book again .
Great apartment. Close to where we needed to be. Clean and quiet!

My stay was nothing short of exceptional. From the moment I arrived, I was impressed by the impeccable attention to detail and the luxurious touches throughout the property. Every corner exuded elegance and comfort, from the high-end linens and designer furnishings to the spa-like bathroom amenities. Mesh went above and beyond, offering a level of service and hospitality that truly rivaled any five-star hotel. The location was prestigious, private, and convenient, making it the perfect retreat. This place is a sophisticated and unforgettable experience, it’s simply unparalleled. I cannot wait to return!

Had a great stay at Nicholas’s place in Chicago. The open-concept kitchen was spacious, modern, and perfect for cooking and hanging out. Big backyard was a great spot to relax and play games. Located on a quiet street but still close to everything. Nicholas was a top-notch host—flexible with check-in and quick to respond. Bonus points for the downstairs bathroom with a urinal! Would definitely stay here again.

This was the 2nd time my husband and I stayed at one of Max's listings, this particular visit being a different listing of his, and it was no surprise that it was a wonderful visit.
Clean place, friendly neighbors, and great for visiting the city. Highly recommend!

We had a great stay! The apartment is spacious, cozy, and well-maintained. It’s located in a nice neighborhood on a quiet street, which made our time there very relaxing. We would definitely love to stay here again in the future!
Brooke and her team, especially Tim, were extremely helpful and accommodating!
We had a great trip in Chicago. The house was in a great location and was very nice/clean!
This apartment is very clean, suitable, and found in a wonderful location.
Super location, elegant house, good breakfast, interesting guests, would highly recommend.

Great stay at this house. Lots of beds for our big group and everyone had a room. Clean and safe. Parking wasn’t an issue at all. Best of all, Hatice was quick to respond and very flexible and accommodating. Can’t recommend this place enough.

The apartments are beautiful, well located, and super clean. The large windows and balconies were awesome to soak in the sun. We had a large group and there were more than enough beds and plenty of space for us to eat and hang out. I also loved that the apartment was dog friendly. I would definitely stay again and recommend to large groups who want to be centrally located. All told, we really enjoyed!
A few things to note: we only received one key per unit, and the key is absolutely necessary to come up to the units or go to the garage, so it may require some additional organizing on your part if you have a large group that’s planning on splitting up. If you’re bringing a dog - the area is safe to walk around, there just aren’t any green spaces (even a small patch) close by. Also, I would recommend bringing a sleeping mask if you’re sensitive to light. Finally, the beds have firm foam mattresses, which was fine for some but not comfortable for others - beds are always tricky!

I paid $400/nt for 4 nights (with fees included), which is about the same or more than a hotel would have been. The mattress on the floor was pictured, so I can't complain too much about that, although a bed on amazon is like $100. 🤷‍♂️ The main issue was there were ZERO bathroom towels (just a tiny face washcloth) and no soap or shampoo for the shower. Maybe some people travel with soap and shampoo...but not towels! When I messaged her about this, I was told to go to Walgreens to get what I need and that the cleaning person did not have time to wash towels... But then, I looked at other peoples comments and several people have mentioned that this place had no towels, so it seems this wasn't a cleaning person/time issue at all. Regardless, I was never offered to be brought a towel or to be reimbursed anything for needing to take time out of my trip to go out and buy stuff. Walgreens didn't have towels and I didn't have time to go towel shopping, so this was very frustrating.
The place was good, Ryan was a very understanding and helped alot throughout the stay, will recommend.

My friend and I had a good stay. We found the unit to be too hot to our liking, and unfortunately you cannot control the air conditioning yourself. You have to communicate your preference to the host. Cihan was immediately responsive.
We felt that it was a bit pricey for the stay, but the higher price may be due to the good location.
Would have also appreciated more than only two small + thin towels for our weekend stay.

Ami was a great host and very responsive whenever we had any questions regarding the house. He was also very kind to allow early check in for us upon arriving to the house. Highly recommend using Ami if you’re looking for a nice place to stay in Chicago
Definitely will use again. Very clean and well maintained. Close to everything.

Easy Check-in, nice place. Descriptions and pictures are accurate. I would definitely recommend this place for anyone looking for a stay in the area.
Just some advice for larger groups: If you have 5 adults all wanting separate beds I would look closely at the pictures of the sleeper sofa and lounger to make sure that's going to work for everyone. The apartment setup is probably a more comfortable situation for adults in 3 rooms and kids on the sleeper sofa and lounger, but your mileage may vary.
Thanks for the nice stay!
such a cool little spot! and Roberto is very lovely company, we have no complaints 👍🏽

We had a wonderful stay! The space was perfect for our family, with a great location just a short walk to both the synagogue and our family’s house for a bar mitzvah. The size of the space was just right, with everyone having a comfortable place to sleep. We also appreciated the large fridge, which made it easy to bring and store food. Our host was incredibly responsive and accommodating. He checked in to see if we needed anything, and when we mentioned a food heater and hot water dispenser, he provided them right away. He also brought napkins and Kleenex when requested, which was very thoughtful. The accommodations were simple but exactly what we needed for a family-focused weekend. The host’s family lives upstairs, and the lively energy added to the homey feel of our stay. Overall, a great experience! We’d definitely stay here again when visiting family in the area.
Great spot to stay - would highly reccomend!

To say that Jo and Mari are great hosts is an understatement.  The 2nd floor apartment in Roger's Park is fantastic and the hosts  thought of everything! We had  snacks upon arrival, clear key and parking instructions, spotless home, and all of the cupboards labeled and organized. Nice, hot shower with wonderful shower gel, shampoo and conditioner. The bed is super comfy. And how could I forget the cool artwork?! The neighborhood is quiet, close to great restaurants and parks, and very walkable. I felt very safe. We truly enjoyed our stay and so did our dog, Wyatt (he got to meet the chickens at a house in the area). Jo and Mari are quick to respond to messages and were one of the few places that trusted my word that our dog could be trusted alone for a few hours. Easy street parking but having the garage made it even better! We are already planning to stay in this place on our next Chicago trip. 5 plus stars!!

Doug is a great host and was flexible with dates and also with giving us permission to stay an hour over the check out time .
He was very responsive and had clear instructions
Well maintained space that is extremely well furnished with plenty of room to relax and comfortable beds and linens
Plenty of towels and hand towels as well as comforters / quilts
Would recommend putting up a house number on the front porch/ door
Also, there are 3 full baths and 2 half bathrooms - which is plenty( but description of 5 baths might need to be amended on description)
Would highly recommend

Adeline’s place was just as described, look just like the pictures, it was very cozy and I felt like I was at home. It was decorated really nice and clean. When I come back to Chicago I’ll def stay here again. She responded in a timely manner and great communication. I loved that big lounge chair very comfortable. Thank you again Adeline :-)
muy bien
Great place to stay! There was always street parking (a rarity in Chicago), the apartment itself was clean and comfortable. I especially liked the "greenhouse" room, bright with plants and sunshine.

Lilian's place was the perfect base for our group of 3 friends to enjoy a few days together in Chicago! Communication was great. The unit is exactly as shown in the listing and is clean, modern, and comfortable. We'd love to stay here during another Chicago visit!
Third time we stayed here, and we hope to do so again next year.  Perfect location, clean and well-furnished apartment, and Don makes everything easy.
Amazing house in an amazing location right down the street from Wrigley Field.  We loved it!!
Beautiful Airbnb, easy walking distance for our family to get to the Cubs game.

room was clean! no plug in the bathroom so it made it hard to use the provided hairdryer but that's not a big deal
room was nice and easy to access, although very thin walls so we can hear everyone else (not the host's fault!)
Had a great stay at Alexi's place. She did everything she could to ensure we had a good stay. Beautiful home and timely communication.
I stayed for 42 days as I came to help with my son/DIL’s new baby! Clean, great bedding, walkable. Host was responsive. Will stay again!
Great apartment, spacious and clean. My family and I realy enjoyed our stay and would consider it next time we are in the area!
Lovely home on a beautiful street in Lincoln Park!   Safe, walkable to food but quiet.

A cute little place close to the train, buses, and lots of places to eat! The hosts are very nice and attentive as well. This is a nice place to stay if you’re seeing a show at The Salt Shed or plan to brave the long line at Kasama since they’re both a short walk away.

Tiffany and William were fantastic hosts. This stay is such a gem—everything was absolutely beautiful and incredibly clean. Super aesthetically pleasing and completely matched the expectations from the listing. Perfect location and nice quiet neighborhood. Parking right in front of the stay. Tiffany took extra time to make amazing recommendations for myself and my family. We would highly recommend and look forward to coming back to stay again in the future!

Все было отлично. Жилье полностью соответствует фотографиям. Никаких бытовых проблем. Рядом Jewel-Osco и аптека. До станции метро и metra 10 минут пешком. Очень тихий семейный район, в минуте ходьбы школа. Неподалеку есть парк, где можно погулять или побегать. Мы были чуть более месяца и все было замечательно, за что спасибо хозяевам.
We had a great stay! The neighborhood was great and it was easy access and walking distance to the Brown line into the city.

The good: great location, lots of space, very clean
The bad:
1. The front door knob falls out of the door and does not lock or open properly. Twice at night we were stuck outside trying to get the door open for 20 minutes. This was not fixed by the person they sent.
2. The inner door with the code before the suites would not lock. This was also not fixed.
3. The third suite shower did not turn on consistently or drain. No one ended up using this shower.
4. The third suite toilet would not flush. There was no blockage. No one ended up using this restroom.
5. The second suite heater is very close to the bedsheets and with turning it on, we were concerned for a fire risk.
6. The upper bunk bed of both the basement and second suite bunk was unstable (shaky) and difficult to get off. My guests ended up sharing beds rather than using the upper bunks. They were concerned about falling.
2/5 due to safety concerns with the door and the fact that one bathroom and two beds were unusable.
Great Location. Walking distance to a bunch of bars and restaurants. Would recommend to stay here to anyone with a big group
Great stay, and Lyle has great communication. Not far from where all there is to do! Would recommend and stay again
Gorgeous space, well kept and in a great location. Stephanie’s instructions were clear and our group had a great time!

This space is an ok place to stay, and had all the amenities they claimed. Yet the space is much smaller than expected from the photos. Also the villa hosts quite the amount of people, yet has very thin walls. If the price was half (or less) than it's current cost this place would be worth it. However as it it's current cost, it would have been better to book a hotel with my money.
I was in town to celebrate friend’s birthday and this location was in a great location for me. The home was spacious and immaculate with fluffy towels.
Kai and Beca's place was a great place for a visit to Chicago.

The space was beautiful! Everything was spotless. I really enjoyed the hot tub, fireplace with complimentary wood, and seeing the chickens on the patio in the morning. The neighborhood was safe and peaceful, only about 20 minutes from anything in the city!
Natasha is a great and responsive host. The house was clean, safe, and had lots of amenities. Would highly recommend for large groups of people.

We’ve stayed here a couple of times and we love it! It’s clean, comfortable, and beautifully decorated.
We will be staying here again for our convention next year!
The place and location were amazing, recommend if going to a cubs game or need the red line
I have no complaints. It was a comfortable facility.

Brenda and her family were very kind!! The area is beautiful and street parking was free and always available! The room was cozy and the bathrooms were very clean! The futon was a bit smaller than expected, but fit me and my friend just fine (and was pretty comfy!) The house is right next to train tracks, but we didn’t notice the noise while sleeping. Overall, a nice stay!

We really enjoyed staying at Vinithra's apartment in Chicago's Ukrainian Village. It is a quiet, not too vibrant neighbourhood, where we felt safe at all times. The apartment itself is spacious and light, very well-equipped, and you can tell that someone has made it their home. Vinithra's detailed plant-watering instructions only added to the homely feel.
Probably the major downside of staying in Ukrainian Village is the relatively poor public transport in the area. The nearest L stations are a steep walk away, although there are several (more or less reliable) bus lines that we used a lot to explore the rest of Chicago. Fortunately there is also a big (and tot too pricey) supermarket called Mariano's within walking distance, which we loved.
For anyone who is staying in Chicago for more than just a few days and who can appreciate a more suburban feel, we can highly recommend this apartment. Vinithra is a great host, and communication was swift and straightforward. Thanks for having us!

We loved our stay - the home was beautifully furnished, clean, and very thoughtfully equipped.  We had plenty of space for our family and were able to easily cook dinner one night using the kitchen equipment provided.  Our 3 year-old loved the playground across the street and parking was easy.  Super clear communication and Ademola was helpful and accommodating.  We will definitely stay here again when we visit our daughter at UChicago again - location was so convenient.

We had an excellent time here. Our whole dance team was able to stay comfortably and safely. We managed to fit 5 cars in the parking which was essential to us. It was all clean close to everything we came to Chicago for. The communication with the host was great and always prompt. We loved it here.

This place was easily top 5 Airbnbs I have stayed in. SO clean, modern, great views, quiet, well equipped, great location, beautiful building, and the front desk staff were so nice. I will be back in June/ July and I am staying here for sure.
Beautiful and fun area, felt very safe and would love to come again!

We absolutely loved our stay! The place was spotless, cozy, and exactly as described. The host was friendly, responsive, and made everything super easy. Would definitely stay here again – highly recommended!
Caryl is a wonderful host. She communicates well and fostered great conversation during our tasty breakfast.
Nice, convenient & quiet location.  Highly recommend.
It was a great place, the host was very friendly and communicative, also the place was very quiet and clean. Thank you for hosting us Jeremy!

Carols place was great. Has everything you need for a comfortable stay. Beds were comfortable and felt safe. We didn’t take advantage of nearby recommendations as we Ubered everywhere for planned family gatherings, but seems there are plenty of places you could walk to to grab a coffee or a bite to eat. Would recommend.

Great stay in Chicago. Parking was easy and getting inside was a breeze with the instructions provided. The unit was just as expected with added touches like extra towels and cold drinks in the fridge on arrival. We enjoyed our time and recommend Shomari’s place for a perfect weekend in Chicago with family and friends!
Clean and very nice place to stay in. Close to downtown Chicago, and safe place to stay in.
Nael’s place was comfortable and spacious. Perfect for 3 people.
Very easy access to a great neighborhood. Private unit with all the basics.
Great second story apt.  Felt like I walked into a 1940 bungalow.  Really had a great vibe.  Loved it.
We enjoyed the apartment a lot. It is one of the best kept places we have stayed at, if not the best, in the Chicago area. Easy check-in with the keypads. Convenient to where we wanted to go.
Beautiful unit. Very spacious and cozy. Understanding the lock was a bit hard but able to manage. Would recommend and hopefully stay again.

We were worried about the neighborhood at first, but we had no issues with anything! Quiet neighborhood, spacious air bnb that looks just like the pictures. Our host was always responsive right away & we had a great time in Chicago.

We have stayed here multiple times throughout my daughter’s time at UChicago and it has come to feel like home. The house is gorgeous but also so comfortable, and filled with books that are hard to put down. The breakfasts are wonderful and so are the conversations with other guests.
great accommodations. very clean. easy access.
Great Location for watching a game at Wrigley Field

I had a lovely stay here. The unit is well maintained, has everything you need, and located in a beautiful neighborhood. Jennifer was friendly and available to assist with anything. Had some nice housemates too.
Peaceful and comfortable stay, convenient location for commute on train. Great value for the price.
Michaels place for nice clean and beautiful to stay at I will recommend anyone to stay at the place I’m even thinking about Coming back for the summer lol it was excellent!!!
He was really helpful and great host. 10/10
flawless stay, great communication :)
Love the neighborhood. Lots to do and plenty of restaurants. Apartment is quite large. Well equipped. Lots of extras to welcome you. Would stay again.
Enjoyed our stay! Much more comfortable and relaxing than a hotel. Thankful for the street parking right out front, with a peaceful neighborhood to walk around. Would stay again when in the area!

we loved staying at Chikes place.  it was quiet and close to the metro to get down town.  not to many options for coffee and food close by but a full kitchen and a stocked Kerig coffee bar!!! it was very clean and comfy for our stay!! the bed was so soft and comfy!
Ron was very helpful in our search for a longer stay and was always very communicative throughout. Plenty of space to move around and easily walkable places to go out to - in a real neighborhood feel

From the moment we arrived we felt so peaceful and at home in Irena's space. The location is excellent and the apartment is beautiful, well appointed, and comfortable. Irena is a responsive and helpful host. We will definitely come back!
En général bon séjour.

The all-white interior on the photos make the space seem like it wouldn’t be homey, but I had a great stay and loved the unit. It was super accessible, they provided ear plugs (didn’t need but appreciated), and i could walk anywhere for a yummy bite. I would definitely stay here again.
This place is always clean, breakfast food is included with your stay, housemates and guests are friendly, Joe and Alex are the best! I always enjoy my stay here.

Sam and Jesse are wonderful hosts with a beautiful place in the heart of Pilsen! They were incredibly responsive throughout our stay and provided fantastic recommendations for the area. The space felt like home, with thoughtful housewarming touches that made it even more special. I would highly recommend staying here to anyone visiting Chicago—especially if you want to experience the vibrant and colorful neighborhood of Pilsen!
Great place to stay. Great location.

This was a very clean and spacious apartment. There were two floors: main bedroom with bath on the second floor and three bedrooms with bath on the third floor. This was great for our family of 6. The bathrooms were immaculate with more than enough towels, and even tooth brushes and toothpaste. The kitchen was well stocked. The only challenge is that we did not receive a code to enter the main door. The person on the first floor was kind to let us in, given that we had small children. There is no local host so it took a while by phone to get the code. The place itself was very clean and quiet. There was lots of on street parking with a playground three blocks away for or kids. Overall, great stat that was about 15 mins from downtown.
Top tier host. Amazing room and comfortable bed. Not a bad area for public transit as well.

Overall it was a great stay! There were some hiccups at the beginning however, I appreciate both Gerri and Jeannette’s attempts to rectify any issues. Also, they were transparent about some updates that they were actively working on to get the condo back to its original state - so I was understanding of that as well. Very spacious, especially the kitchen. Calm and quiet for the most part (despite being right on the street). The highlight of the trip was definitely the hosts, both Jeannette and Gerri checked in to make me feel comfortable and I especially appreciated Jeannette’s flexibility.
We had a nice stay at Bart’s place and our requests were well accommodated.
Second time staying with Judy!! She’s absolutely the best host and her home is so cozy. I always recommend her place when friends or family stay in Chicago.
It was the perfect location! The place was nice and cozy!

Really nice place with lots of upgrades and great appliances and stocked kitchen!!! We need a great kitchen and this was perfect. We had a little trouble getting in the door, but Marcus could see that on the ring and he walked us right through what we needed to do. Lots of restaurants nearby. Plenty of space for a family of three. We would stay again. Great big tv.

Great apartment in safe, walkable neighborhood.  Easy walk to the Brown line or access to several bus lines. Mark’s place was clean and has a lot of communal space and a cute backyard. The 2 bedrooms worked well for my husband and I. We appreciated having the washer and dryer so we could do a quick load of laundry. Overall I recommend Marks’s place and hope to visit again!
Great place, just a 15 min walk from the blue line. Very safe neighborhood as well. Bob was great!

We had a wonderful stay! The place is very calm, extremely neat, and exactly as described in the listing. The downtown view from the balcony is absolutely fantastic. we spent a lot of time just enjoying it. We stayed for two days, and all my friends loved the place. It had all the essentials like towels, body wash, and shampoo, along with extra bedsheets and towels, which was really thoughtful. Overall, we loved everything about the stay — every dollar was truly worth it!

We had an awesome stay here.  Our family of 5 fit perfect - 2 in one bedroom, 2 in another, and our youngest on a fold-out couch bed.  The place was spotless.  Included a high end drip coffee maker with coffee grounds provided.  Location was amazing - bustling area full of restaurants.  Easy drive to downtown.  We parked in an apartment parking garage across the street - needed to download the ParqEX app to gain access.  All in all a fantastic stay and we would absolutely book again.

Laura's condo was beautiful.  The kitchen was fully stocked.  We cooked dinner twice and breakfast daily.  The master bedroom was very comfortable.  I loved the heated floors in the bathroom and the large walk in closet.  My parents were comfortable in the guest room as well.  We would definitely stay again!
Had a great stay — everything was new, modern, and very clean. They even provided a mid-stay cleaning during our month-long visit, which was a nice touch. Would definitely stay again!

Dan is very kind and super understanding. What is more he is willing to help out no matter what the situation may be. The only thing “bad” I would say about my stay is that it is located around a neighborhood that is not the safest; however, as long as your aware of it, it does not matter.

Great location with awesome views and a lot of space. Parking is a huge plus. Hosts have done a lot to make your stay comfortable including K cups, sound machines, extra towels, extra pillows, and extra throw blankets.
Overall disappointed with the stay though. The smells of the building (trash, cigarettes, and weed) was very noticeable in the lobby, hallways, and units. We also struggled with the single air system. We knew this from the listing before booking, but did not expect the apartments to be 88 degrees during most of the stay, despite the HVAC being turned off (we confirmed with the host on this) and when it was only 68 degrees outside. And the cleanliness could have been better in the common areas.
Would not rent this space again unfortunately.
Very straightforward. Good value
Joseph was a great host, responsive for every situation, even at night. I really liked the place. Much recommended!

Everything was exactly as described. Walked to Wrigley Field in 10 minutes. So many cool places to eat within walking distance. As Ashley describes, this room is small. Plenty is food and snacks during the breakfast hours. The bad news: The room has a terrible odor. The air is heavy and possibly moldy. It never goes away. And I saw a bug. The bug is not the end of the world but the air and odor is hard to get past. I would certainly stay with Ashely again but I would not stay in this room.
Had a great stay.
loved staying here, quiet house, super chill vibe. thanks Josh.
Great on all fronts. Lovely hosts, exceptionally clean room, great food, can't say enough positive things. Looking forward to staying here again sometime.
Had a beautiful Easter at Kelly’s house with some friends. Great space and backyard.
Had a great stay! Great host and communication as well.
Lovely place. Had a fantastic time.
Great stay! Anny was super communicative it was amazing super great!

I felt at home at Judy's place. It was clean and great. Ms Judy was so warm and great too. I look forward to staying again soon!

Great place to stay Shaena was very friendly and communication was on point!!! We locked ourselves out the house and she came right over to open the door for us after dropping her babies off at school and that was a plus for me cause we locked the house keys and our truck keys in the house!!!!
Great place. Great host. Will stay again.
I enjoy myself for the time I had there i just think it's should be tv's in all the bedrooms because ppls like to Netflix n chill before bed! I can't wait to book again!

Great location—it feels like a basement apt with quick construction and no attention to quality details, but it’s completely fine, beds and bathroom are comfortable. Host is friendly and dropped off things we requested, which was appreciated.

Felt very comfortable, had enough space, very peaceful building. Would stay again and again. Everything was just like the pictures.

This is a wonderful option for a couple or a solo traveler in Lincoln Park. As a visiting research student working on my PhD in Immunology, my time in Chicago could have been all work and no play. But Michael and Roxane included me as family, not only at the dinner table, but also for special outings. Their specialty seems to be hosting scholars and professionals pursuing advanced degrees who also enjoy house-sitting. I loved the occasional responsibilities, especially caring for their two sweet dogs. Like mine in Brazil, they barked excitedly when I arrived and calmed down with affection, another way I felt at home. The neighborhood was perfect for dog walks, bike rides, shopping at Target, and exploring nearby Pakistani/Indian shops. I slept incredibly well, and if anything needed fixing, they handled it right away. Their friends are thoughtful and kept conversations meaningful, even when the news wasn’t. It took me 10–15 minutes more to reach the lab than if I’d stayed in Evanston, but staying on Chicago’s Far North Side was absolutely worth it.
Nice stay, would recommend to anyone visiting the city for a couple days

Had a great stay (4 months)! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was very responsive and helpful throughout. Great location too — close to everything but still quiet at night. Highly recommend and would definitely stay again!
Highly recommend!  Clean, well stocked, and comfortable.  Walkable to most attractions and the building amenities were a hit!

Great location, close to restaurants, grocery stores, and the train to go downtown. Walkable neighborhood. The unit was clean, cute & cozy, and had everything you could need to feel at home. Hands down best experience! Thank you Jed!

Highly recommended Airbnb 🤝
Don’t hesitate in booking 👌

This location was amazing! Across the street from Wrigley Field. With soooo many restaurants and things to do.
The host was incredibly responsive. He made us feel taken care of.
The master bedroom features an incredibly comfortable mattress that my wife and I slept very well on.

Buen lugar, la estación de metro no está cerca, pero la línea 60 está afuera de la casa, es zona tranquila, realmente utilice la casa solo para dormir.
El anfitrión responde rápido, volvería a elegir este alojamiento, además es una persona muy educada.
Gracias

My friends and I stayed in Janet’s home for a concert trip. Being Mexican-American we were so excited to stay here and be immersed in our culture. The home was listed as is and we were so impressed by the articulation put into the design of the home. We had everything we needed. We felt safe in the neighborhood and indulged in the amazing food near us. We appreciate the great hospitality. Overall we had a great experience and would love to visit and stay here again. Thank you!

Very peaceful for being in the city! The location is great, with a small garden that almost feels like another world, tucked in-between the other buildings on the street. A neighbor's cat even stopped by a few times to greet me as I was going in and out. Room was perfect for 1 and there was a lot to do within walking distance. Complimentary coffee was a nice treat.
Amazing host and clean place.
Great host, very responsive

I have been on AirBnB for a few years now, utilizing it several times for work travel. And I must say, by and large, this is the best experience I have had on the app.
You have a tremendous amount of space and privacy. Essentially, you’re in the basement, and it’s akin to a garden apartment/suite. With that, you have everything you need - your own restroom and kitchenette. The washing machine is in the basement as well, and it was available every time I tried to use it. I rarely heard any noise upstairs, and I truly felt as if I had the space to myself.
It is on a quiet street near public transportation. There’s plenty of restaurants and bars and stores nearby.
Angela was always helpful and in good spirits.
Oh, and the price is phenomenal!
Thanks again, Angela!

We stayed here after relocating to Chicago to see different areas of the city.  The location is very easy to use public transportation with bus stops right on the corner.  It's a good central location to explore Lakeview, Lakeview East and Roscoe Village.
Great place to stay.  Beautiful building, great room. close to  bus lines.  I especially liked the views of the street from the bedrooms. I strongly recommend this.

Thank you for a comfortable and pleasant stay. Place felt like home. Quiet and quiet neighborhood had all the necessities. Easy access to local stores nearby, convenient location less than 10 minutes from downtown and host was a great person very responsive. I would highly recommend.
Great place that has everything you need for a stay in the NW side of Chicago
Joseph was quick to respond and very accommodating
Great Airbnb and phenomenal host who were kind and very helpful. Place was super clean and nice.

Host was very responsive and kind. Location was great.
I found the place to be smaller than I expected and it is on a basement floor, which does naturally carry a scent of mildew in the hallway to the rental.
The bed was comfy however bathroom very very small. Oddly the toilet seat was super high off the ground.. not sure why so high!
A couple of complimentary bottles of water would have been nice.
The towels they had were small and thin and not usable. I had to buy 2 at local Target. He offered to reimburse which was thoughtful.
I think most people would like the value and location of this place, it just wasnt my vibe.
Good communication and very nice.

I’ve traveled a lot and I can say that Jen was THE definition of a perfect host: clear instructions, apartment as described, no hidden fees… Jen was also super sweet, always making sure the our stay was perfect, checking in to see if there’s something she could improve…. She goes above and beyond for her guests and it was truly appreciated. Would return anytime!
Thank you so much Jen for everything!

It was a great trip. The house gives me comfort and joy. All hosts are friendly and helpful. Variety of breakfast options available. Bike ride distance to Northwestern University and Lakeside. Short walking distance to Mcdonald's and bus stops. I commuted nearly everyday to Northwestern Evanston campus, even in the extremely cold weather. No issue. Local amenities are good also.

The Airbnb was perfect. It has all the amenities needed and made my stay very comfortable.
Gabriel is an amazing host and helped me out in multiple occasions when I needed support with things in the apartment, and was also kind enough to give me some suggestions for things to do.
I would love to come and stay at this apartment again.

Alis and Ishin were wonderful hosts: polite, superfast responses, welcoming. The location couldn't be better: it's in the heart of one of Chicago's most vibrant networks and yet because it's on a very quite side street you have a rare, perfect mixture. The design aesthetic is simple, the place is flooded with light [Note: consider bringing a sleep mask], the views are sweet [trees! sky! clouds racing across the skylights!]. If Wicker Park wasn't so packed with wining and dining venues, one could easily spend a long the entire time inside for a romantic getaway. Thanks for a wonderful experience!
Place was just as described, and felt right at home. Usually found parking right in front. Enjoyed my stay!

This landlord is a complete fraud! The property is nothing like described: First, the backyard is disgustingly filthy, completely different from the photos — you deliberately used angles to hide the full mess. Second, it’s not even an entire property but part of a row house with other people living on the first floor, which you blatantly hid. Worst of all, you refused to apologize and had the audacity to call *us* scammer ! All evidence has been submitted to Airbnb!

It's a short term and long term rental building so we felt more comfortable. We had a 20th floor room (so the pictures are not exactly the room you may get). We had a great view. Large spaces. Shower water was hot. Lobby was clean. The swimming pool and hot tub were a plus. The park across was wonderful for our dog. We are staying here again!!

Jorge provided exactly what I was looking for as I transitioned back here to Chicago. The kitchenette he posted was fully stocked and so convenient for my needs. Location was great !! I appreciate you Jorge. Thank You !!
Good location, as described, nice gym and pool as well as common areas, good security with doorman

I enjoyed my stay at the Airbnb! The place was as described and was very clean. The location is great! Very accessible to public transportation.
The host Eman and her husband were very nice! They were so kind! They invited us to a Saint Patricks Day Breakfast! It was a misfortune we couldn’t go because it was Ramadan.
Great Place! Highly recommend!
Excellent stay, Maria is very responsive, apartment has plenty of space. I have throughly enjoyed my stay.
Great place and location. The owner is very responsive
Great stay
Loved this place with an amazing hosts &other guest and Good communication, clean & safe area and respected the house rules. I highly recommend.
Good place and easily access to spots which I like.

Mushka and Binyomin were very welcoming and even shared some toys and kids playthings with us to make our stay peaceful with our kids. The neighborhood has so much to discover and it was a great location to reach everything by foot.
This Airbnb is the nicest place I’ve ever stayed in. The space was cozy, there were lots of coffee shops and other restaurants nearby, and was a quick jaunt to the two L stations nearby!
Victoria was a great host and really friendly. She gave me great recommendations on the surrounding area and was very friendly and accommodative to my stay. I for sure would stay with her again.

My Stay was absolutely bittersweet and very clean. Anything that you could ask for or need it was there, she had everything labeled such as toiletries and necessities and Each Room had anything you could have think to need along with snacks and beverages . The home was Very quiet, peaceful and relaxing. The master bedroom was amazing. I fell in love with the king bed and Ava was an amazing host. I did not need for anything If I asked any questions She responded quickly. Each visit I make to Chicago will be at Ritzy Suites and definitely will refer to friends and family there was a local grocery store nearby and restaurants and it was very easy to find the expressway to visit downtown Chicago, there was not a sleepless night in this beautiful home.

The place is generally okay. The location is great, its nearby lots of bars and restaurants, close to public transit. The place is private.
The apartment itself was clean but also same time didn’t feel like it was because furniture and stuff felt cheap and not well maintained.
In the winter it gets very cold because insulation for the building is poor. Heating worked but not enough for the space. Water was either very hot or very cold, it made showering tough.
Laundry room is shared with barber shop so it didn’t feel clean to use it with all the hairs.
There were maintenance issues during check in that were resolved right away, but could have been avoided in the first place if they maintained the property well. It isn’t maintained well in my opinion.
Generally was an okay stay but would not stay again. No refund was offered for the 1.5 days I could not use the shower/bathroom.

Highly Recommend. Kasa was very communicative with instructions on how to check in and make the most of the apartment. When my flight was canceled just before I was to check out, they helped me quickly and easily extend my reservation so I had a safe place to make travel plans. They totally saved the day!
The apartment was terrific. The beds were very comfortable, with nice linens. The main bedroom was a lovely place to wake up with the light from the window, and the small side bedroom made it great for a group of three to enjoy privacy easily.
The View! We got takeout just to spend time in the apartment and enjoy the terrific view. The living room was tastefully decorated and a nice place to relax, with a convenient desk tucked to the side for work.
Very Walkable with restaurants and river strolls close by. Shops nearby make it easy to get not only necessities but also niceties like good wine and cheese.
We will absolutely rent here again the next time we come through Chicago.

The bed is horrible. We barely slept and were achy all weekend. Worst bed I've ever slept on in my life. Also, 1.5, rolls of TP (for 4 days!) , no paper towels, and one towel felt cheap and petty. We spilled a drink and had to decide if we used the last of our toilet paper, our only hand towel, or the one towel we were left. This is a stupid decision to have to make in an Airbnb. Replace the bed and stock the apartment appropriately and this would be a 5 star review.

Molly and Bryan are the epitome of amazing hosts! Our family of four stayed at the Swan House for several months while repairs were made to our home - and we couldn’t have asked for a better experience. The house is exactly as pictured/described and Molly & Bryan were so incredibly accommodating… making us feel right at home during an otherwise chaotic period of time for our family. The house itself is conveniently located in the Lakeview/Roscoe Village area and we loved the walkability, proximity to a local park, public library and fantastic restaurants. Thank you for a great experience, Molly and Bryan!
Charming house and a nice neighborhood. Host was responsive and friendly. Would recommend.

We ended up here after we left a not great stay on this trip, and were very happy. Great location, quiet (there’s even a sound machine), very comfortable bed, everything we needed including a very nice coffee maker and a clothes steamer.

Above and beyond. From the perfectly decorated rooms to the one-in-a-million prime location, this place went above and beyond my hopes and expectations. The host was so friendly and accommodating. Dominic is amazing, and always goes the extra step to ensure a happy stay. I savored every second of our stay and left feeling refreshed with beautiful memories to cherish. We were impressed with every detail from start to finish! The inside was nestled in comfort and the outside had something fun to do in every direction. A perfect stay!

We had a great stay! Everything looks just like the pictures. Everything is really nice and modern with plenty of space for a good group to stay. We did think that it was the entire house to ourselves but it’s more of a duplex stacked vertically where we had the entire first floor and basement to ourselves. We still had a great time with an easy and clear check in and check out process. Keith responded very quickly and answered every question we had.
Great stay!
Great stay and great location! Thank you so much.
We had a great stay and Dawn was a great host! The property was spotless and the amenities were perfect. Would highly recommend this property to all!
Condo was spacious with all needed amenities. Great for families with young kids.

Daniel and Tatyana's place was wonderful for our four person stay. We had ample room, were able to do a load of laundry and hung out in the main living area catching up. While we didn't cook, we made ourselves coffee and tea and both were easy to do. There are plenty of restaurants nearby and we sampled many of them.
We spent time on the outdoor porch which was lovely for the duration of our visit.
The hosts were friendly, responsive and respectful. They clearly communicated and made sure we felt comfortable. Would definitely stay here again with friends or family.

The apartment was very spacious and large. Bathrooms and bedrooms were great. The beds/pillows left a bit to be desired. I would recommend to bring your own pillow if you are sensitive. The location and building are great. Very safe area within a 5-10 minute uber for everything.

Julie’s place is so comfortable and tastefully decorated. The place has all the modern amenities - most of it pretty brand new. The place is amazingly clean and everything in working order. The beds are very comfortable as well.
The location is perfect - walkable to all the great restaurants and bars. Parking is no problem - street parking is free and I never had an issue getting a spot.
I would highly recommend. Overall, a resounding 5 star stay.
Thanks Julie for your hospitality!

Great place, great location
I would definitely stay again
One caveat- if you are a light sleeper it may not be the place for you as there is street noise and noise from the bar below. Didn't bother me. Otherwise I would definitely recommend it.
Heather’s place was a cozy place to land during our stay. Easy, comfortable, and welcoming. Would absolutely stay again.
The view is amazing and enhances your stay for sure. The unit is comfortable with great food options within walking distance.

It was a fantastic experience staying here for one month. The hosts are really really kind and heartwarming. And it’s a beautiful cozy room with a bright window, located in a safe and clean community block. There are bus stops and restaurants nearby. Really nice housing!!
It was great staying here!
Would book again

Fiancée & I were looking for a weekend bed and breakfast around the chicago or suburbs and this came up. False advertisement! I’ve never been to a business advertised as “bed & breakfast” without breakfast provision. There is no breakfast included here.
It is overpriced for a private room in a house that smelled like weed, noisy fan & a dead TV. Only pros is free street parking which you can also get in their west loop, south loop, Hyde park, burbs or near north & cheaper for a whole apartment to yourself, while closer to restaurants and lively spots!

Enjoyed staying at The Neighborhood Hotel in Lincoln Park. The location can’t be beat. Walkable to everything —Target, Trader Joe’s, restaurants, coffee shops….
The Weiner Circle (Chicago style dogs) next door was a bit loud at night. There was a large group of teenage girls singing as girls do, BUT the host has a great sound machine in the bedroom and it totally did the trick. Couldn’t hear a thing and slept great.
The hosts were quick to respond. No problems. Would definitely stay again.

I stayed in the Lincoln Park duplex for three months and cannot recommend it highly enough.  The space was immaculate when I arrived and throughout my stay Bozena was warm, accommodating and beyond that - an incredibly sweet person.  You will never have a more welcoming host.  The apartment is so comfortable.  It is beautifully laid out.  The bathroom is perfect.  I don’t think I’ve ever had a better night’s sleep anywhere! And I think I used the fireplace every night!  The neighborhood is beautiful.  Peaceful and just a lovely place to walk around.  It’s a touch of Greenwich Village right in Chicago!  Everything about my stay there was perfect.  Thank you so much Bozena!  I hated to leave!

Excellent location and the house was well suited for our family of many ages - from babies to seniors. I especially appreciate that there was plenty of comfortable seating in the family room and two king sized beds. John was an excellent communicator as well!

Great place! Great Host!
But, reason for 4 stars, not 5. I've NEVER had to do this before:
--The faucets in bathroom and sink are old and defective. The cold water faucet in bathroom was broken. The kitchen faucet has to be help up or it slips down to off.
--Cleaning fee? it didn't include replacing the empty toilet paper roll when we arrived or dusting the ceiling fans which had months of dust build-up. (we are NOT high-maintenence people)
--The bedroom closet had an enormous empty TV box in it. So we couldn't store luggage inside.
--The King bed room--is beautiful-- unfortunately needs black-out blinds. The alley lights are BRIGHT and sleep-disruptive light shines through the blinds all night. Bring eye-masks!!
--The door is more complicated and temperamental to use than the arrival instruction photos imply. Hard! My brother set off the door alarm when he went out to jog our first morning.
--There are no surfaces to open luggage. But the floor. Why no folding luggage racks??
We very much enjoyed our stay at Tiffany’s place in Chicago! The property was the perfect size for our group of 5 young adults.
Great apartment close to the airport. Baby friendly and clean. Street parking only but available on the side streets. Sunny and relaxing, perfect for our long weekend visiting family nearby.

I recently had the pleasure of staying at a truly incredible Airbnb in Chicago, and I can honestly say that it was one of the most wonderful stays I’ve ever had. From the moment I arrived, the host, Julie, made sure that I felt welcome and at home, and her kindness and attention to detail were evident throughout my stay.
One of the standout features of the property is the bathroom, which is nothing short of a spa experience. It features a luxurious double-headed shower that made every morning feel like a mini vacation. The heated floors were a dream, especially during the colder days in Chicago, and the plush towels provided an extra layer of comfort. It was clear that Julie took great care in creating a space that’s both functional and indulgent.
The kitchen was another highlight of the space. It’s not only aesthetically pleasing but also incredibly well-stocked. Every little detail, from the high-quality cookware to the charming décor, made
I really enjoyed my stay it was just to get away for the weekend and I enjoyed max thanks again
We really enjoyed our stay. Tracy is super friendly, allowed us to check in early, and took the time to give us a tour of the place

I rented these two penthouse condos for a big family gathering and everything lived up to our expectations! We had plenty of space to gather and sleep and the views from both units were incredible. We never waited long for the elevators and the units were both very quiet. We couldn't hear any floor noise or other tenants once inside. Most of our guests were not from Chicago and they were all so impressed with the location. You CANNOT find a better place downtown. The area is safe and lively and we walked to everything... Chicago attractions, restaurants, shops, etc. Our hosts were super communicative both before and during our stay and answered all my questions quickly. I would 100% rent these units again!

We had an amazing stay at Shay's place! The home was clean, spacious, and perfectly located—close to everything we needed. Shay was warm, responsive, and provided clear, helpful instructions that made everything smooth and easy. We’d absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to others!
Vladimir’s place was a perfect fit for our group. We will definitely be staying here when we come back.
Loved staying at Mark's coach house. Our family felt right at home and they were such helpful and attentive hosts. Would highly recommend!

Hits all of the solid points of a great AirBnB:  Comfy bed, nice 'n' clean, coffee and a cookable kitchen, and just a simple experience. All the best parts of Andersonville are just steps away, and you're not too far to the L (public transit) for exploring downtown.  Daniel reached out ahead of time to make sure we were taken care of, and was accommodating throughout the stay.  It was easy to enjoy this uncluttered, no-nonsense, old Chicago apartment.
We had a wonderful stay! Great communication and a wonderful location.

Apartment is VERY nice once inside.  Building was sus.  Not walkable at all.  We had to purchase additional pillows as no extras were available.  Neighbors are rather loud especially during the night hours.  Typical outside noice which is expected with city living.  It was kinda hard to sleep on the 1st night.  Matthew was a great host, extremely communicative.
Great apartment and host. Dina very responsive and helpful.

Great location and perfect for our visit to Rogers Park. We will definitely be back!
The hosts were kind enough to look for my sunglasses that I thought I had left in the unit. I appreciated them for being so kind about it.

My family stayed here for over a month (Feb/Mar) while we had work done on our local home. It was lovely, comfortable, and secure. Some of my favorite features were the updated primary bath, the large farmhouse kitchen sink, the washer/dryer, and the garage for parking our car. The wifi was good enough to work-from-home, and the blue line was a 10-min walk away.
Some of our favorite destinations within walking distance of the home: Hopewell Brewing, Lula Cafe, Sugar Moon Bakery, and Unity Park (a great playground for kids).

Perfect for our family of 6 for 4 nights. Great location and easy to get to. Always found street parking right in front. Very clean and comfy. Would highly recommend. Must be able to handle stairs regularly as you go up half a flight to get into the building, one flight to get to the main floor and then up another flight to get to the other three bedrooms.

Staying at Marek’s is like staying with family. The apartment has everything you need for your stay, no matter how long. It’s in a great neighborhood with some awesome restaurants and coffee shops. You won’t go wrong staying with Marek and his wonderful family.

We had a great stay at Kai and Beca's.  The location is amazing - very quick walk to coffee, bagel shop, corner store, and everything else you could want.  We thought it was an easy walk to the Fullerton station and therefore convenient to downtown and anything else on the train line.  The parking spot was super convenient. The house itself was clean and exactly as described.  The skylight over one of the beds is definitely something to be aware of, but it didn't bother us because there were only 4 of us and we didn't need that room.  The light up there sure is beautiful though!  We love having a king sized bed, so that was a plus for us. All the beds were comfortable and linens were clean.  We would absolutely stay here again.
Enjoyed my stay! Very clear instructions!
We stayed for one night, but it was fabulous. Spotless , clean, pristine great customer service location is in the middle of everything.

I had an amazing stay at Jennifers place! It was exactly as described—peaceful, comfortable, and perfect for remote work. The location was fantastic, with plenty to do nearby and easy access to downtown. What truly stood out was Jennifer’s attentiveness and kindness. She was incredibly responsive, always helpful, and went above and beyond to make sure I had everything I needed—even ordering a blender when I asked if there was one available! I truly appreciated the hospitality and would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommend!
Nice place to rest, easy enough to move around the city, thanks

Comfortable, clean, and super safe! Some noise from the upstairs neighbors but not bothersome at all. Dominic and Paul were very responsive and the unit was exactly as pictured. Lakeview is a great neighborhood with a lot to do!

Truly an incredible stay! Whether just for a weekend or an entire month, Bozena’s place is now my go-to for Chicago. I caught up on so much rest and really enjoyed the fireplace. Extremely tidy and pristine as well. Thanks again!!
Don was such a great host! He was very kind! I had a fantastic stay
Great stay!
The place was very clean.  There were books and other antique items that showed the history of the neighborhood, quite a place
Great space and great host!
This was the perfect place for our few day trip. Bed was super comfortable and never had trouble finding parking

This is a very nice and safe place in West Town,Chicago. 15 minute walk to West loop. The train is about a 10 minute walk away from the house. Mike was very communicative and flexible. I had to leave the Airbnb early and he was able to accommodate my request. The Airbnb was fairly clean. I felt that it could’ve  been cleaner. Checking in and checking out was very easy. I would recommend staying here!
Good host
Was a great place an pretty quiet building, I would definitely come back
All good!  Great stay
Will stay here again.  Place was clean and well kept.  Great location.  Walkable to lots of restaurants and cute shops, and easy access to bus or “EL” if you want to go further.

Good location, trouble with the garbage disposal and the oven was Smokey when heating up that the smoke alarm went off and there wasn’t even any food inside. Bathroom wasn’t the cleanest and same with couch and floor. Great public spaces to do work and the work out rooms as well! As well as a coffee shop attached that sells Beacon donuts which are some of the best donuts!
Great place!!

Lauren was a super host! I had a wonderful Airbnb experience with her. She is kind, calm, generous, easygoing, and easy to live with. Always responsive, flexible and friendly. Lauren made my stay comfortable and easy. From the moment I arrived to the moment I left I felt completely welcome and at ease. She really went the extra mile and made my three month stay very pleasant. Lauren is communicative, responsive and completely balanced being welcoming and giving space. The space itself was charming, quiet, clean, and great value. It had everything I needed and a warm, homey vibe (heating left nothing lacking either). The neighborhood is safe and very close to university security. I left feeling relaxed, grateful, and already hoping to return. I would definitely stay with Lauren again. Highly recommend!

Despite being placed in a different unit than the one we booked, the apartment was comfortable & clean & well stocked. The location is great for activities in Lincoln Park. It’s right on the bus line, but about 15 minute walk to any of the L stations.
Getting put in a different unit than the one I booked, wasn’t really that big of a deal, but would have been much less irritating had I known it was a possibility OR if they had communicated ahead of time that they needed to move us…perhaps with a bit of a discount? Instead it seemed like maybe they thought we wouldn’t notice! But they were really good with communication otherwise.
When I let them know we were in the wrong apartment, they just said…”Sorry, we had a housekeeping emergency in the other one…thanks for understanding”! Which I suppose is understandable, but communication about it before we arrived would have really gone a long way.
Great place, great host, we really enjoyed our stay
Great hospitality, I love the area,  they were responsive and helpful
Great space, very convenient with a garage to park my vehicle. I enjoyed this space a lot. I hope to be back in the future!
Great stay

I needed a local place to stay while my apartment was being renovated, and this spot was perfect – homey and very clean! The unit I stayed in was slightly different from the photos, but the decor and layout were similar (as noted in the listing). It's located in a quieter part of River North but still super convenient, with Whole Foods, CVS, and plenty of restaurants within walking distance.
I’d definitely stay here again!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay which was just over a month duration. We are long time Chicagoans and moved here while our condo is being remodeled. The location is wonderful. It is within walking distance of all types of restaurants (one on the premises), coffee houses, pubs, multiple big chain grocery stores and all within a big city with a small vibrant neighborhood feel.
The unit was very clean with all the expectations and amenities of a home. The internet and TV work very well and the beds were very comfortable. It was exactly as pictured. We would stay here again in a heartbeat.
Excellent location and beautiful apartment for a true urban experience. We loved our stay in the penthouse!
I recommend this stay as a very responsive host, Candace, and a clean and organized house.

Carla and Trey are wonderful hosts and their apartment is lovely. I felt right at home and both were very good hosts. The neighborhood is peaceful and safe, no concerns whatsover. Multiple buses close by and close to the train station.  I would definitely recommend to stay here!
The place was very clean when we arrived, Vipul was very helpful with the laundry, overall a good place to have a good time during our stay.
I felt the place was clean and very homey! They were very responsive and helpful!
Patt is a fantastic host, helpful and kind. The way she handled unexpected problems with her house was perfect. Much recommended!
Decent.

My family and I had a GREAT time staying at the Lincoln park townhouse. Three floors and a large private patio. There was plenty of space for my family (3 kids, husband, in-laws and I) to be together or to spread out and have some space to ourselves. The only concern I had was the glass dining table- my 3 yr old leans on the table for balance when he is getting up and down and the glass tabletop was not secure on the base. Everything else was great. Comfy beds, well-appointed rooms, place felt and smelled clean, and the blackout curtains made resting after a long day walking around the city super restful. We would definitely stay with Kai and Beca again!
Perfect for a visit to the city. Safe and friendly neighborhood tucked into the great food and drinks of bucktown.

Michaels place was just lovely and just what I was looking for in a home while visiting in Chicago. It was very comfortable and inviting and quickly began to feel like “home” in the nearly weeklong stay. The kitchen was a dream and very well stocked. I would highly recommend and I will definitely consider staying again on a future visit!

Great spot in an easy walkable area. 10 minute walk away from Damen station on green line. House was nice. The only thing that I would recommend is better wifi. With a family of six, the Internet couldn’t keep up with one person watching TV if anyone else was online at the same time. Overall, place was great and the neighborhood was nice.

I am so glad that I stayed here over the past 2 1/2 months. Nofar was such an incredible and caring host and the place was so cozy and had everything I needed. Laundry is very accessible and there’s parking included too which is huge for me. Also love that the lake is walking distance away. I definitely recommend staying here, I always felt like I was in good hands with Nofar and also felt right at home.
everything was perfect for my family of 8 house was clean and comfy felt like I was at home

Chris’s place is an oasis of wonder. His place is so peaceful in an urban landscape that I actually reached out again to stay. The location is above and beyond in not only its location but in the restaurants so near by.

Rather than list these additional expenses in the price breakdown where they would be accounted for in the actual price of the room and charged up front, RoomPicks tucks these expenses into the details of the listing, where we usually find check in/out procedures etc. I'm doing so they circumvent the airbnb payment system. Theoretically, by engaging in such a predatory business practice, they could increase the nightly rate five times (or more) and claim, as they do, that they are being straightforward about the price. But if they were really dealing in good faith they would put those expenses into the nightly rate.

We had a great stay, check in was seamless and early. The location is great, right in the heart of the theater district.
There were just a few issues.
1. Chicago drivers love to use the horns on their cars. We heard this unorganized symphony pretty much constantly. Sirens and blaring music from below also was not uncommon in the night. I recommend noise canceling headphones or earplugs for a good night’s sleep. #note…this was not a dealbreaker. The location is unbeatable.
2. The elevators were insufficient at times (often) to handle the guests waiting to get to their rooms and to the show upstairs. Additionally a guest elevator was closed to accommodate show attendees. The lifts were overcrowded and one got stuck with guests on board. Excellent place to stay in Chicago! Clean, comfortable, great neighborhood and WONDERFUL hosts! I booked this for a group of 5 of my company employees in from out of town and they felt completely at home and at ease the whole time thanks to this place!

On a final note, the hosts are super helpful and quick to respond, and I can't thank them enough for such a lovely stay. (:

One thing to keep in mind: you will likely be sharing the apartment with another guest and the host on occasion, so whether or not that is your preference, I would keep that in mind. Overall, I really enjoyed my stay here and would definitely choose this spot again if the need arose!

I had a great stay at this Airbnb. It's on a quiet street in a great neighborhood that is walking distance from restaurants, bars, and the brown line. Steven was very responsive and proactive in giving recommendations for the neighborhood. I would highly recommend this Airbnb!

The Coach House was perfect for my long term stay in Chicago as I wanted somewhere to stay while I looked for apartments before moving here full time. The unit had everything I needed with a functional kitchen, living space, comfortable bed, laundry and a nice bathroom. It’s connected to the main house but there’s no one above you to cause noise and feels completely private. The area in general is great as you feel safe and secure on a quiet city street while still having the walkability to get to shops, bars and restaurants. It’s also easy to get around with the Blue Line L being a 10-15 min walk and access to 2 main bus stops to take you north or east within a 5 minute walk. Overall, this was a perfect place to experience living in Chicago for the first time and a good central hub to explore the city and find a permanent living situation. Would definitely recommend.
Very responsive and enjoyed my stay!

Overall, hosts are responsive on the app and the apartment was enough space for me during my time in Chicago.

I really appreciated how extremely helpful, accommodating and friendly Aiste was, I couldn't have asked for a greater host and will gladly stay at her place again the next time I'm in Chicago!

I was very satisfied with my stay and would definitely book again if I had to choose.

I was very happy to stay there for three months. The flexible checkout was also a great bonus, as it allowed me to stay a bit longer until it was time to head to the airport. I wholeheartedly recommend this apartment!
Very clean , nice and spacious. We loved the outside balcony. Responded quickly whenever I needed anything. 10/10 recommend! Thank you xoxo

I can honestly say we enjoyed ourselves in Bronzville. To places to walk to to close by as far as food, Icecream and I got my nails done close by. Very Friendly neighborhood, to Jailyn keeping in touch to making us feel Comfortable. The place is very clean ,and cozy we truly enjoyed.
Definitely will be back🥰
Effortless from check-in to check-out. Perfect location, friendly building, assessable to all of Chicago.
nice

Nice house. Great location. Proactive host.  thank you

Great place to stay! Clean and conveniently close to downtown. Would definitely stay here again.

Great location!
exactly what was described, easy check in, earlier because we needed it, super easy and great to work with. had a great stay, thank you!!

Die Viertel in der Umgebung sind einfach fantastisch – viele gemütliche Cafés, Parks und tolle lokale Geschäfte, die wir gerne erkundet haben.

The front desk was super nice! The view from my room was AMAZING and the in-house restaurant Hoyt's food is bussing.
