The room I stayed in was very cozy and I will check to see if this is available the next time I need to stay in the area.
Amazing place and building, highly recommend.
Easy to get in and out. Even smelled clean. Great location.
Cozy 2 bed 1 bath in a safe neighborhood!!! It had all the basic appliances & amenities that one would need for a brief stay. I would love to stay here again!!!
Always a pleasure staying at Aly's condo.  Location is within walking distance to most of the theaters as well as Lyric Opera House.  CTA stops are close by as well if walking isn't your thing.
Great host and great property. Would recommend 100%
Me gustó que la estación de tren estaba a una cuadra del departamento y me pude trasladar muy rápido a los lugares , el departamento está muy cómodo , lo volvería a rentar

Great amenities and a supermarket and laundromat across the street. I stayed comfortably for about three months and completed a time-intensive project working in the space. The apartment is fully set up for remote work with a reliable wi-fi connection. There were a few messy guests and resultant issues but the owners dealt with it. Overall, this is a great deal on a spacious room.
The unit is Clean comfortable and spacious great location with everything you need in walking distance from restaurants, groceries, target, the train and bus
The host was very responsive and well-communicated. The location was convenient, lots of restaurants and close to a blue line station.

The place was great, very clean and comfortable.  The amenities were great too.  The shower water pressure, which is always very important to me, was excellent.  Additionally it was very walkable to restaurants, bars, coffee, Trader Joe's, and shopping.  Public transit was close too. I would definitely stay again.
Nice place in a great neighborhood!

Nick and Jesse's place was a fantastic stay. Spotless, beautiful, and artsy, the interior was very comfortable and interesting. Plenty of amenities. Heating was good. Hosts were communicative and friendly, even when we had a delay in check-in time due to issues at the airport. Location is great, and very walkable to interesting sights nearby, including the lake. A Walgreens is pretty close too in case you forget to bring anything.

The place was nice, the neighborhood was nice. There’s a Jewel Osco down the street you can walk to. The Midway airport is 25-30mins away. There were a couple mishaps but it was taken care of. It says to be quiet and to respect the neighbors because they’ll call the police, but the neighbors were very loud. We almost couldn’t sleep the third night. They were dropping heavy things, walking hard, running and there was a continuous clicking sound. That’s not the host fault though. Overall, I had a good time here and Karen was nice and responsive.

The place is as the photos the only thing I would notate is it’s not that big of a space which the sq ft may be listed somewhere and that’s my fault. The photos make it look a tad bigger. I had issues getting into the Airbnb however the host way very responsive and I was in quick! Walkable to so many food choices and more. The parking was tricky so bring extra funds for parking (if you drove to chicago). The kitchen was so cute and has everything you need. The patio area was a nice touch. I would stay here again if I had to visit Chicago. Thank you Jonathan!

Mila's house was perfect for our business trip to Rosemont for a convention at Donald E Stephens Convention Center - less than 10 minutes drive each way even with traffic! Plenty of space for everyone and very clean! Would definitely book here again for our next trip.

It was a wonderful stay with a very hospitable host. We loved the access to the beautiful kitchen with instant hot water for tea. The homemade baked goods were a delicious treat in the morning. The room was immaculate. The back rooms face the tracks for the busy Chicago Transit Blue Line, so if noise bothers you, ask for a room facing the street.
Wonderful stay! I’ll definitely be back at this location again.
Esmirna is a very welcoming host and respectful of her guests' privacy. Spending time with the cats was an added bonus!

Terrific location, house is very clean, and Don is a responsive host. It just about served my purposes for a quiet place to sleep during a busy weekend attending my friend’s wedding. Unfortunately, the insulation between the apartment and the upstairs neighbors is non-existent, and on one of the nights I was there they had people over to watch a boxing match (which I know because I could clearly hear the commentary from the tv). So, for a couple hours, not the quiet place to sleep I hoped for. Otherwise met my needs, but the experience was less than one I would recommend in the end.
I literally call this place my home away from home for a reason. The best place to relax in such a busy city. Love both the host and will continue to visit.

The airbnb itself is Amazing! Very clean very accurate to pictures, if you’re black or a GD be careful this area is a Tiny Village full of Hispanic gangs, we got checked by a few Latin Kings so be safe!
The TVs are old so don’t expect to set up the game
Late at night people in the area did gather outside the building next to ours and were drinking til 3am blasting music not an issue to us but keep that in mind it is a possibility lol
The hosts were very quick and respectful it was an easy check in easy check out and the airbnb itself is beautiful and comfortable!
Very comfortable stay. Great location. Only complaint is that we didn’t have a comforter, only sheets. But the room was temperature controlled so it wasn’t a big deal. I would recommend to stay here.

Thank you for a beautiful stay. The place looked even prettier in person. Loved the art throughout the home; the record player, the sky lights in the bedrooms was a wonderful surprise. Every detail was thought of and the home is full of character and art.
Even though it was just me and one guest, this space is perfect for larger families. Pull out sofa sectional; plus four bedrooms and two living spaces. The kitchen has everything you need to prepare meals which I enjoyed cooking during my stay.
Plenty of towels and essential items included; even though I brought my own lotions and soaps if you ever forget yours no worries! Her home is fully stocked. Even had flat irons and blow dryers.
The space was very private. I felt completely safe during our stay. There are a lot of beautiful murals in the surrounding neighborhood worth viewing. I would love to stay here again!

The stay was okay, but the listing needs more and updated photos.
The WiFi had issues; only one network was available instead of the two mentioned + it was unstable, often disconnecting. We mostly used mobile data/hotspot. We contacted the host, who responded the next day and restarted the router, which only helped briefly. The issue returned, and the host didn’t follow up after our second message. Responsiveness was 3/5. The shower is small and dark due to the curtain, which also doesn’t keep water off the bath mat/floor. There’s a loud heater (exposed) and a snapping water tank in a locked closet. The bedroom “closet” is unfinished, with exposed concrete, a clothes rack, and a curtain to cover the entrance.

Anny’s place is in a safe location, close to public transportation lines. Responsive host, clean location, and stay.
She went above and beyond for me by returning an item I forgot at her place.
Best appointed airbnb I have ever stayed in. Reflects Marco’s attention to detail and commitment to guest comfort. I usually don’t go over the top, but I would come back. Easy access to everything.
Great location, very responsive host via email, will stay here again.

Tuve la oportunidad de vivir en esta casa durante 10 días, y la experiencia fue excelente. La vivienda está en perfectas condiciones, muy bien cuidada y equipada con todo lo necesario para una estancia cómoda. Las habitaciones son espaciosas, bien iluminadas, y la distribución es muy funcional.
Además, la ubicación es inmejorable, El vecindario es tranquilo y seguro, lo que hace que sea ideal para relajarse y disfrutar del día a día.
El propietario/a fue muy amable y siempre estuvo disponible para resolver cualquier duda o necesidad, lo cual hizo la experiencia aún mejor. Sin duda, recomendaría esta casa a cualquiera que busque un lugar acogedor y bien ubicado.

Kristen's home was the perfect place to come back to at the end of the day! I was visiting Chicago to see a concert, and it was easy to find a great restaurant beforehand, and a short ride to the show itself.
Kristen provided great recommendations for outside of her home, and a tranqil space on the inside. It's a small detail, but it really stood out to me because the temperature outside had just started to err on the cooler side and the rooms had the potential to get chilly, but she provided a space heater which kept everything at the perfect temperature.
This was my first time staying at an airbnb where the home owner stayed on the premises, and Kristen is a kind and respectful host. My stay wasn’t disturbed in anyway and she really cares about making sure that your stay is comfortable. I would definitely recommend booking Kristen's home!
One of the best places I ever had the chance to book! Fabulous host, great stay all in all!
Estoy en espera de mi depósito, aún no me lo regresan
Beautiful apartment in an excellent location. Host responsive and pleasant to deal with.

Convenient location - 6 to 10 minutes to Trader Joe, Wholefoods, Target and downtown attractions (i.e. Navy pier, River walk, Chicago Art Museum, The Cloud gate, McCormick place, etc.) - 10 to 13 minutes during traffic hours! Ample amount of street parking! Insanely comfortable mattress & bedding! Very quiet & private, all kitchen necessities are available. Coty was a very responsive, courteous, and considerate host. We would definitely stay here again!
It's a good place to stay in a fun neighborhood, I would book again.

Overall, I was quite satisfied with the property and wanted to share some observations.
Firstly, I found the house to be meticulously clean, and I appreciated the attention to detail in maintaining its cleanliness. The photos provided prior to the rental accurately depicted both the interior and exterior of the house, which was reassuring and contributed to a positive experience.
However, one minor issue that I encountered during my stay was the creaking noise produced by the hardwood floors. While this might not be a concern for those accustomed to such sounds, it became somewhat bothersome for me personally. Perhaps some maintenance or adjustments could be made to address this issue in the future.
Overall, I had a pleasant stay at your property and wanted to express my gratitude for providing a comfortable accommodation. Your attention to cleanliness and accuracy in representation are commendable.

Wonderful place to stay for the weekend. The host was very responsive and helpful with check-in. This corner unit provides unmatched views of the city and is a few blocks away from public transportation. I would stay here again.
Everything was awesome 😎.

Th convenient location with parking can’t be beat. The room and bathroom are well-appointed, and the bed is comfortable. Jane is responsive, gracious, and accommodating. She’s my favorite AirBnB host I’ve ever met! I’m hoping my travel plans allow me another opportunity to stay here again. Thanks for the hospitality and a place to stay!
easy check-in and check out. the host was very responsive and all the instructions/ rules were clear from the begining.
My stay with Omni entertainment went smooth, and the place was better than the pictures! Will definitely stay again
very cozy and lovely apartment, was perfect for a weekend getaway in Chicago and close to a great pizza place!

I don’t usually leave negative reviews, but I feel compelled to share my experience. I wasn’t going to mention the dusty bathroom vents or the bathroom lights that were full of insects. I also didn’t plan to bring up that the headboard of one of the beds was held together with zip ties. However, when we discovered that someone had entered the premises while we were away, that was the final straw. This was a blatant invasion of our privacy.
Despite having proof of this intrusion, the renter continually denied it. He even showed up unannounced and continued to deny any wrongdoing. Additionally, he tried to accuse us of having an extra guest, which I believe was an attempt to distract from the fact that someone had entered our accommodation without permission. Thankfully, Airbnb took care of us and helped us get to a safe location that night.

if you don't plan on spending a lot of time in the unit or relaxing there, then it's a great place.  there is no TV or form of entertainment. most walls are bare and there is no view.  you have basic amenities and that's really it.  the price was high for what was provided compared to similar listings. location was the real deal for me
Loved the place. Close to downtown. We felt like home. The master bed was super comfortable.
Great time!
Super clean apartment in a perfect location.  Plenty of space.  Would definitely go back.
This was a very nice and spacious AirBnb in a great location, less than 3 miles from Wrigley Field. Would definitely stay here again.

The host was absolutely wonderful and incredibly helpful throughout our stay. The neighborhood felt very safe, adding to our peace of mind. The accommodation was not only comfortable but also impeccably clean, making it a truly enjoyable experience. I highly recommend staying here.

The overall stay was pretty good. The location is right near the train which was GREAT for easy access to the city. The host had great recommendations for things to do near the listing. The host was very responsive. This location is better suited for adults given the amount of stairs leading to the unit and the lack of TV’s in the bedrooms.

Great deal for a huge loft! 2 doors to the outside, inside door to the upstairs shower, laundry and kitchen. I paid for parking at the house and it was really convenient. Great spot in the best neighborhood in Chicago. Patt is very responsive and helpful. I'm a travel nurse working nights and I had a comfortable 3 month stay. There is some noise that travels from the upper floors, but nothing super disruptive. Thanks again Patt!
Great stay!
Vladimir was an incredible host! Very responsive and helpful. The space was clean and super convenient for a large group. Would definitely recommend staying here. Will visit again.

Way to many fees (written in small letters ) $49 a day for 6 water bottles and some cokes , no room service cleaning , that’s why there is no cleaning fee , and the desk concierge had a lot of attitude , it was the passive aggressiveness in his tone that really through us off , their rooms are click bait

This place could not of been better for a game at Wrigley Field.   It is literally 20 feet from one of the entrances.  The place was clean spacious and just perfect.  Will be my first choice from now on when visiting Chicago.
Great price for the location!

Loved it! Comfortable and cozy home in a beautiful location of Logan square with amazing  walkable coffee and restaurants. Very clean with friendly and responsive hosts. Will definitely be coming back!
Highly,Highly recommend!! Space was beautifully decorated, comfortable beds and super clean! I felt right at home! Street parking right in front. Host was always responsive!! Book it!!!
John’s place was great for our college reunion group. Plenty of space, nice basement for hanging out. Beautiful street and convenient to everywhere on the north side of the city.
Great location
We had a great stay! Everyone in the building from front door security to the hosts were consistently helpful . The condo’s were able to sleep 20+. Fantastic outdoor kitchen.
Great location to explore Chicago on foot and by car/train! Very good host!
Great location and very clean.  Great communication.

The location was easy to get to and didn’t take too long to get to from downtown. Easy access to buses and trains. The unit isn’t as nice as the pictures depict but if you just need a place to crash and not a place to hang out, it’s sufficient. The kitchen was very dirty. The bathroom sink was dirty as well. Either the cleaners have no experience or didn’t clean at all. Hard to tell! The property management company was kind and responsive when I reported the uncleanliness of the unit. For that I’m thankful. If they can step it up with the cleanliness this place isn’t half bad. Beds were comfy.

This is a really nice loft apartment. In a good location, close to the CTA Red line and overlooking a shopping center with a large grocery store, Starbucks and burger king.  The main room living area and kitchen are nicely, furnished and comfortable with a big, smart TV with all the streaming apps that you need. the bad it's comfortable and the bathroom is nice and clean with some bonus supplies provided by the host. The host stayed late to help us with a very late checkin and was very helpful and courteous.  I would definitely stay there again.
I loved the airbnb
Mo was very responsive. If there was any questions he would answer quickly. Very close to Wrigley. Lots of stuff to do in the area. I would highly recommend staying at his place again!

The location was absolutely perfect for visiting my son at UChicago.  The place was spacious enough to accommodate my two teenage boys and I as well as my brother and his spouse and daughter, allowing us space to all be together and private space as we needed.  We felt perfectly safe, it was much easier to navigate than I had expected.  I would definitely stay here again.
房子非常整洁干净，且空间大，能够容纳我们一家六口。Tom回复非常及时。周边可以步行至超市和餐厅，非常便利。
Great place.  Great communication.
Excellent place for the price! Great location with quick ubers to various parts of downtown. Would definitely stay with David again!

We had an amazing time staying here. They were great hosts and made us feel welcomed. The place is cozy and beautiful. We loved the design of the room and bathroom, it inspired us. Kelsey gave us great recommendations for food and things to do in Logan Square. We ate  at yummy places such as Daisies, Sugar Moon bakery, Lula’s cafe, and Loaf Lounge.
Very clean, plenty of extras (shampoo, conditioner, soap, coffee and tea provided). Lovely home.

Brian’s apartment was in a very convenient location and close to wonderful restaurants and all the theaters and great shopping! I love running and could access the river walk just two blocks from his apartment.  It took a little help to get the smart home lighting working for us (but I am not the best with technology!). Brian was helpful at getting it going for us as we liked the lighting.  He was immediately responding to any questions we had. Perfect for one or two couples spending time together in such a fabulous city!

The communication with Naj was efficient and cordial. He made himself available and responsive. While we didn't need to talk much (the place was clean and well represented in the photos), we appreciated his care and approachability. The place is quite close to a train line and the neighborhood felt safe!

Chialung was a great host. He was friendly and quick to respond. His place was nice, as pictured and was within walking distance to many places in Wrigleyville. It’s less than a 5 minute walk to Wrigley Field which was great for us going to the OSU/ Northwestern game. His guest bed and pillows were very comfortable! We enjoyed our stay.
Place is exactly what we needed when coming into town for an event at Wrigley. Walking distance and enough beds for our group.
This place is good for short term ...

Gerard and Ernie represent the best of AirBNB and what it was in the beginning years - friendly, hospitable hosts who are sharing their home with you.
Firstly, they met us in person to welcome us.
Their home was beautiful and wonderfully designed and set up. They were very clear and organized about which spaces we had access to and what we could use. Details matter - they had power plugs by the bed, a little welcome packet with wifi access, and told us where the coffee machine was.
We really enjoyed getting to know them and get recommendations and about the history of their neighborhood and Chicago.
They were warm and hospitable. Superhosts!

Tiffany & William’s place was perfect for our stay in Chicago. It was in a quiet neighborhood walkable to cafes, restaurants and many areas of town. The place itself was cozy yet spacious. Extremely clean & well taken care of. We had a wonderful stay & would book again!
Felt like home and the dog loved to lay on the rug.

Great spot in Ukrainian Village. We came in for the Ohio State football game, and hotels were outrageously priced. So, after doing some pretend talking to my friends in the West Loop, this was the perfect spot for our plans.
Check-in was smooth, the place was spotless, and it was a friendly neighborhood overall. A friend we were visiting lived only two blocks away, and we had no idea we were that close to them.
I would definitely recommend Nikkole’s place and stay there again.
FIVE stars.

This apartment was located in the perfect spot. Restaurants, bars, the L, and plenty of vintage and locally owned retail within walking distance. The apartment itself is cute and clean, and easy to find and access.
Great location for our group to get together. The accommodations are tight…but that was our expectation based on the accurate description.
This was a great location. The unit was very spacious. The bathrooms were updated and the beds comfortable. It was clean, which is so important. Ahmed was very responsive to all my questions.
Enjoyed my time here. The listing was accurate and would stay here again.
My stay was wonderful and exceeded my expectations! Everything was spotless, communication was easy, and the hosts could not have been more welcoming. So glad I was able to stay here!

Easy to get in, and an OK deal size wise (can sleep 4+ people). The check-in instructions were accurate and convenient. It is close to a metro station, and makes it easy to go to city center. Carpet needs to be replaced, and the place needs a deep cleaning to rent out for the $140 asked per night.

The host was always very responsive. There was a mixup in the beginning where my room was changed last minute but I ended up being ok with the change. The only thing I would add is that the cleaning wasn’t always a thorough cleaning. But very nice host and respectful guest.
Loved staying it the apartment, perfect for a longer stay as well as it has a fully equipped kitchen as well. It really felt like a home away from home!

We had a fantastic experience in Lincoln Park. This is a very family-friendly area, we enjoyed the playground at Oz Park several times each week. Lauren was great all around, and the place was even bigger than we expected. We were sad to leave.

Another wonderful stay here!  The is our second stay. It’s becoming our Chicago home away from home and we wouldn’t think of staying anywhere else!  The space is very comfortable and well set up and the location is very convenient to what we needed. Thanks again!

We had a lovely stay at this cozy 1 bed in lakeview. The place was extremely well stocked with all the essentials and beyond- especially the kitchen! Cooking here was fun and convenient with pots, pans, utensils and even tea! The laundry unit was convenient to access and use, with detergent pods and dryer sheets included. Trash and recycling was easy to access; trash bags were stocked. There was a vacuum cleaner and several cleaning products. The neighborhood felt extremely safe, clean, peaceful and walkable. Public transport is just a few blocks away, including buses and the brown and red lines. Because it's a garden unit, it doesn't get a ton of natural light, but still a decent amount into the living room. There is a backyard though! Also, the curtains and couch cushions were a bit dusty, but we were able to use the laundry room to wash and dry these as desired. Brad is seriously an incredible host and will try and get you anything you need to improve your stay! Would stay again!

Fantastic stay, extremely responsive, in great shape, good neighborhood, 10/10 would stay again! Kati was so helpful and the place was so well kept.

I loved the place and location! One of my best experiences on an Airbnb and perfect for longer stays.
It was clean and equipped with everything you need to feel right at home, Kari is super kind and responsive. The view is amazing from the apartment. A CVS and a Mariano’s are on the same building, and obviously super close to everything you want to do while in Chicago.

Great apartment in a wonderful neighborhood that is walkable with good restaurants, bars, and activities nearby.  Parking is very easy and the space is as described and really very clean.  Nice extra amenities to make you feel at home.  As noted in the listing details, if the upstairs neighbors are entertaining guests, you do hear it in the bedroom, but at all other times it was very quiet. I would also note that there is not a table to sit at to eat which did not impact our stay as we were eating out, but for some stays that might be important to know.  We would definitely stay again as Lindsey was a great host and the apartment is very nice and perfect for a visit to Bucktown and surrounding Chicagoland.
Great place with lots of space. Beware of the extra 200$ deposit the hotel will place on top of the 100$ one. Along with a 96$ maintenance fee
Very nice place to stay everything was perfect
Great stay, would use this host again.

Patt is a lovely host and the room is in a adorable house! I stayed here for 2.5 months and really enjoyed it. Patt is very communicative and keeps the common areas clean. There is plenty space in the living room and kitchen, which are well-furnished. The location is actually more convenient for reaching downtown than I expected. It’s a good deal for all the amenities and utilities included.

Greg was fairly responsive and helpful, but overall, I was disappointed in this place. First, it was dirty upon arrival - the bathroom was filthy and there was trash left by the last person, which Greg looked at and didn't do anything about. I should have said something, but I was fairly flummoxed by the situation. I ended up cleaning up other people's trash.
Second, there is a preschool's playground directly outside the windows of this place and you can hear young children screaming at peak volume from 8am-4pm most days.
Third, the apartment was fairly hot and the air conditioner didn't work great. When the heat came on, there was no way to turn it off. The sink in the kitchen didn't work and Greg had to come fix it. The key to the back door didn't work, and Greg gave me a key that did work and set me up to be able to buzz people into the locked gated area.
Overall, it was a fine place for a short trip, particularly if you're a morning person and don't mind children screaming.
Great place to stay in Chicago. It’s nice and out of the way from all the craziness of Chicago. Location is as described. Definitely would recommend.

Olivia and Tom's place is perfectly nestled in Roscoe Village. We had a lovely month long stay here while exploring Chicago. The gardens in the back were an added bonus, we wish we were around when they were in full bloom!
Stay was really nice. Tanya and Lee were really nice and responsive. they were very accommodating. I had a great stay and enjoyed my trip.

We were staying there because my husband was undergoing treatment at the University of Chicago Hospital.  The location was perfect and it had a washer and dryer in the unit, so for our extended stay, it was a great place for us to be.  The apartment was bright and sunny which made coming back from treatments a nice place to come "home" to.  Windows overlooked a playground and gardens, so it was a peaceful to look out.  There were many restaurants close by as well as grocery stores and drug stores, as well as the lake - so for an extended period like we had, it was perfect.  Our host was always quick to respond to any questions or issues we had.  We enjoyed our stay in Hyde Park.
Cute and clean!
Nos sentimos muy aguados en el lugar. Todo ordenado y limpio.
Its a basement unit. Be prepared for a noisy upstairs neighbor. Also the bldg is under maintenance and there is a lot of extra noise.

Stay was good, only because during the last two weeks of my stay the building elevators broke down and only one elevator was working. This was a huge inconvenience but obviously not something in anyone’s control. The apartment and ambiance was beautiful.
Jennifer was responsive and worked with our budget. Thank you so much.

Place was great and host was as good as it gets. Very thoughtful and accommodating and proactive. Provided everything needed including parking passes for the whole duration, extra towels and space heater.
Place is very homie and loaded with books, even the guitar was tuned.
Will be back there in my next stay.
Très bon séjour, hôtel de qualité et très bien placé
the place is so lovely and clean! it felt very comforting, i really recommend this place.
overall was in area 2months lots work/exploring! great food tourist spots! i loved it! come to chicago often so never a dull moment!
The proximity to Starbucks made this a perfect work from Airbnb location.  Very cozy and spacious.  Really nice.

Roxane’s place was great! I stayed for two months and really enjoyed my stay here. She is great with communication and always helpful for anything I needed. The location couldn’t be any better, it was safe, easy to walk, easy to get into the city, and quiet. The place was clean and felt like home. I would highly recommend this place to anyone coming to Chicago!

Leah was a great host! Would definitely stay again!
Thank you very much! The rental was perfect, very well equipped and everything ideal, only the location is quite sketchy so always take an uber.

Inicialmente eu ficaria 3 meses no espaço mas por conta de um imprevisto, tive que retornar ao Brasil.

Caso tenha que receber encomendas da Amazon, os lugares de entrega também não são muito acessíveis para andar a pé, sendo necessário andar de ônibus ou de carro para o lugar mais próximo, mas que não parece ser muito seguro.
Por fim, quando tive que encurtar a minha passagem, apesar de ter avisado com duas semanas de antecedencia, o inquilino me cobrou a taxa de limpeza extra que eu já havia pago para o mês de novembro, sendo que eu ficaria até metade do mês. Ou seja eu paguei o custo de manutenção dele.
Great Airbnb! beautiful location with lots to do. Airbnb was exactly as described and cozy for the night I stayed. Would recommend!
Walkable, nice location , nice stay
Amplia agradable limpia céntrica
Bob’s place was perfect for a short stay! It was great and accommodating for 6 people. I would recommend it for any one wanting to visit Chicago and stay near Wicker Park!

We really enjoyed the Old Town neighborhood. Lots within walking distance.
The place was spacious and had good amenities. We were also able to arrange for a dedicated parking space.
I would definitely recommend this place and Matt as a host!

Adorei ter ficado por quase três meses nesse apartamento super aconchegante e delicioso de morar.
Tudo perfeito. A localização, a vista, o toque dos sinos da catedral ecoando dentro do apartamento eram uma delícia de ouvir, ia caminhando para os melhores pontos da cidade, lojas, mercados, restaurantes, minha escola de inglês, enfim não poderia ser melhor.
O prédio oferece toda a segurança, portaria 24 horas, toda a estrutura de lazer, festas proporcionadas pelo condomínio aos moradores, etc
A Andrea é uma pessoa maravilhosa que tive o prazer de conhecer. As minhas necessidades eram atendidas prontamente quando solicitadas. Adorei tudo!

Chicago é maravilhosamente linda e estar bem acomodada fez toda a diferença.
Recomendo muito e se precisarem de mais informações só dizer
Amei minha estada nesse apartamento que corresponde exatamente ao descritivo e fotos.
Aproveitem bem, também.

We arrived early and Market let us check-in early with no charge. The place was clean and private access. The bed was very confortable. The area is quiet and nice to take a walk. There is a walking distance pizza place in the corner. Everything was cery clean and confortable.

My dog and I enjoyed our stay at Andre's! The unit was spacious, well-equipped, and located in a nice neighborhood. Having access to the garage for an additional fee was incredibly convenient. Overall, a great stay—would highly recommend!

Airbnb customers BEWARE that the price listed on the front page does not include benefit package, reservation recovery fee, or resort fee. After discovering what hit me and deciding that's just the way it is, our stay there was quite satisfactory. Staff was very pleasant.

biggest infection that I ever seen. it was impossible to stay there. I can't believe that this apartament is possible to be offered for rent. I'm sorry that I can't  post photos.  the pictures from the app are not even far from how look inside.

El alojamiento estaba súper bien, era cálido, privado, sin ruido, sin molestias, lo único que podría mejorar es la cama, colchón demasiado suave. Para un día o dos esta ok.

We had a wonderful stay at Aqua! Kari was a fabulous host and was super responsive in her communication with us when it was needed. Transfer of keys and parking pass was smooth and unit was clean on arrival. We look forward to staying here again!
A nice place with a good location! Was in town for a conference at the Hilton and this was a great walking distance with a lot of options along the way for a bite to eat.

Didn’t know there was going to be an downstairs neighbor had a packages delivered and the other tenant got it and we never received it wasn’t a big issue because it was just something edible. The place was nice though for 4 grown adults.
It was a wonderful place
Old town is a great neighborhood!
Very responsive host, great location and comfy home  with all the amenities of home. Very impressed with the adjustable bed as most Airbnb have cheap beds. Slept great and felt safe n secure.
Great location, with so much to do and eat. Price is very competitive and the hotel is only 15 minutes from the L.

The pictures don't do the home justice. It was beautiful and perfect for our team retreat. Our stay was great! Host was very communicative, gave us local recommendations, and also reached out and made sure all was well. Nice area, not too far from downtown. Would definitely recommend staying here!
Nothing to say — Anny is extremely responsive, helpful, friendly, and overall a fantastic host. Would definitely book again on my next visit to Chicago!

Location, size of room, safety, and cleanliness were all good.   The only thing that came up that was not posted clearly was the extra fees upon checking in.    Hotel "REQUIRES" a guest fee on top of the nightly. ($60/person/night)
Everything went well pictures matched description matched! Very organized and easy check in
Kelly is a great host! Very responsive and friendly :) will definitely stay here again.

This is a great property. Great location.
Great place, great staff, great location

Was a beautiful place! Mark and Jo super welcoming and responsive. Great location, surprisingly quiet and easy to get to everything. Would absolutely return!

Excelente anfritrión. Siempre estuvo presto a explicarme cómo moverme por la ciudad, restaurantes cercanos, comercios. Me llevó a conocer algunos lugares de interés turístico y estoy muy agradecida por ello. Sus gatos son hermosos y muy amigables. Lo recomiendo 100%.
my only opinion was not enjoying the mattress on the floor. other than that it was great.

John’s place was incredible! We were a large group and it had plenty of sleeping arrangements for everyone in our party. Central area is HUGE and it has everything you could need and more. Would stay again!
Great stay; nice romantic studio for 2

Marco’s space was a perfect fit for our family.  Marco personally met with us to show us around.  The location is very close to the metro stop and several grocery stores. Being that this was my first time in a shared Air BNB I was skeptical. I also was there with my teenage daughter for her 16th birthday. Love love love! Super cute space very spacious and easy to get to transportation or calling Ubers. Loved the look of the space and appreciated the clean bathrooms and the luxury linens we were given. Overall a great stay and would love to come back!

Un studio agréable dans un environnement calme, tout près du métro. Prévoir 30 min en métro (Red Line) pour aller en centre ville.

This place was in a very convenient location for my activities during the stay which is why I chose it. It was a great stay, close to the train line, and other people in the Airbnb super friendly. I will do it again if need to stay in that part of the community

Really loved this beautiful space. It is so eclectic and cozy and in a great area! It is a great neighborhood with lots of shops and food along division street. It was perfect for our group stay.
This location is awesome. Would stay again. Leah was very helpful and kind.

Beth was an outstanding host., I would recommend to anyone visiting for business or pleasure!
Enjoyed the stay !!! Wonderful host

Bien.

Amazing place

5/5 Stars, gonna recommend this place to others aswell.

The building is great, with all the amenities one would need! The staff is incredibly friendly and helpful, and it’s one of a very few in the area with extended stay availability. Great place, neighborhood was the only reason for 4 out of 5 stars.

Teresa is a great host and very responsive. We were in Chicago to participate in a trade show held at McCormick Place. Teresa’s apartment is very close to the exhibition venue. I will book this apartment again for future trade shows.
The booking was perfect for what me and my girlfriend needed: a place to temporarily stay so we can see a concert. No complaints.
Perfect location for a trip to beautiful Chicago! Views were outstanding. Comfortable and spacious accommodations.

I had a great couple of days at Daniel’s spot, it’s easy walking distance to West Loop restaurants and attractions as-well as Chicago Loop and Riverwalk if you don’t mind a longer stroll, we had everything we needed and the apartment is very spacious.
Jean was extremely helpful. Would highly recommend.

The check in process was excessively difficult, requiring everyone's ID downloaded even though there was a large security deposit x3 already paid. Lastly, 2 things- the beds are very small fullsize and hard as concrete and there was no water pressure in the shower. My employee had to take a sponge bath the whole time. I do not recommend this overpriced place.

Excellent location within walking distance to McCormick Place and right in the heart of Chicago. The place is renovated and seemed brand new and was exceptionally clean and comfortable. Highly recommend for anyone visiting the area!
Great place to stay in Chicago! Clean, comfortable, and close to main places in Chicago.

It was above and beyond.
It exceeded my expectations.
Very very pleased with everything.

In any case, we appreciate the service and I can tell they are very experienced people doing what they do.

A cozy room in a decent location (7 mins walk from the train, about 15 minutes to the city). Well-equipped kitchen, washer is provided, bathroom works. Plenty of a space for a solo traveller, fine with two people for a night or two. I enjoyed talking with Akiko, who is kind and communicative.

This is the ideal place for a foreign exchange student or other young person visiting Chicago for the first time. Maria is warm, prefers being called "Mom," and will mother you all stay long if you're open to it.
Unfortunately, as a 48 year old man, I really wasn't looking for a mother, this was just the best place I could afford. While I was there her son was having his house renovated so I had to share a bathroom with him, a first for me at an Air BnB. Maria often asked me to prepare this or that so she could have the place cleaned, and as someone with a chronic illness since I was a teenager, that wasn't always easy for me; neither was her constantly asking me if I needed this or that.
All that said, I recognize that Maria meant well and if that is what you want, she's perfect for you. As a former Principal she's also very knowledgeable about Education and management (she gave me great career advice), and there are many shops and restaurants within walking distance. Recommended.
Awsome place highly recommended
Very good location. quite and friendly neighborhood.

Incredible location and a stunning apartment. Everything was above and beyond, Stewart was incredibly helpful and responded very quickly. Only “negative” is that it’s listed with a private bathroom, but it’s disconnected from the room. Other than that I would recommend this place every time.

An exceptional rare jewel! This was definately top of the line. The home was clean, and decked with comfort, and such beautiful decor. The location was far better than I had envisioned, and we quickly fell in love with the charming little town. Dominic was so accomadating and generously kind. Nice location and nice host. I had a few things that I discussed with him, but he was responsive.

Had a great stay at Monica’s place, it was clean and tidy and spacious. Felt like a home away from home. Our family of 4 (2 kids under 6) had plenty of room. Overall we would highly recommend staying here and would return if we come back to Chicago!

I am staying in Yelena’s place for several months while on contract. The view is amazing. I love the safety of having a doorman. But what’s best is that Yelena is a great host! I love my stay especially when I found out my Airbnb was on the first floor no stairs .  I love that a washer and dryer in kitchen.

great place and great host

perfect!

The view was absolutely breathtaking. Thank you all for giving me the most amazing experience in the Airbnb culture that I have ever had customer service at this location was pristine. Absolutely cannot wait to come back.

Wow, wow,wow!!

You can hear everything going on the floor above you. The dry cleaners next door are making noise late into the night as well. The unit was hard to cool down. Flooring is separated all over the place. The bed was much too soft for my liking but this is personal preference.
The Good:
The unit itself was incredibly clean. The neighborhood was incredible. The price was hard to beat for the location. The included amenities were nice, like moisturizers and feminine hygiene products.
Ultimately this is a fantastic spot if you do what we did: go out and explore the city and come back to shower and sleep. That’s what you should be doing on a vacation anyway.

a cozy stay in a historic part of Chicago, this place has a lovely charm and is easily accessible to the heart of the city. I really appreciate Ilya’s responsiveness in taking care of a minor issue and wouldn’t hesitate to book a space with him again. Thanks for a pleasant stay.
I love Mark & JoAnne; they are great and always helpful.  It's always a great time when I stay at their property.

This apartment is amazing! Awesome location, quiet neighborhood, close to public transportation, easy parking, and lots of great restaurants within easy reach. The apartment itself was really comfortable and had a nice private terrace. Mary was a wonderful host and responded super quickly to any questions I had. I would 1000% stay here again!
great i like it

I am a travel tech and my stay at Marisa’s was my favorite of anyplace else I stayed. Her home is beautiful, perfect area, and convenient to so many places. She was so friendly and helpful and made you feel at home. I would not hesitate to stay with her again, I highly recommend staying with her.
good location and a super clean room

Very safe area. Decent size space. When I first got there, there were some issues (with the keypad working to the door, very few kitchen supplies, the shower rod kept falling, and it was very cold in the unit) but the maintenance person was quick to respond. Small kitchen and overall not a lot of outlets but fine to stay for a few days. Overall would recommend understand.

Aubrey is a wonderful host - extremely communicative and helpful. We are a family with a young baby that recently moved to Chicago. We stayed at Aubrey's place for one month, and she worked with us to accommodate our needs ... she even went above and beyond by ordering us a blender so we could make our son his home-made puree's.
The airBNB is well maintained and clean and has everything you need for a long stay. This is a bottom floor apartment, so you can expect some noise from other residents living in the building; but generally, the neighborhood is very residential and peaceful.
Nice place to stay. The house is clean and tidy. Location is near to public transport. Andy is very responsive and made my stay comfortable.
Departamento muy bien ubicado y bonito. Excelente comunicación con Aly.
Great place , Great area , Great people. Comfy bed , good AC , Nice kitchen , No ce hot water and great water pressure. 👍🏼I would  definitely book again.
Victor is a great host! He is always available and open to communication. He is literally solution-oriented. I was so satisfied with my stay. Highly recommended!
Very well decorated large room

I had a wonderful experience!
The apartment is spacious, clean, and cozy, making it a lovely place to stay. The host is friendly and welcoming.
It's conveniently located near the subway and has fantastic shopping options, plus there are plenty of parks nearby, which is a real bonus for Chicago.
If you’re an airplane enthusiast, you’ll enjoy watching them fly by every day!
Thank you, and all the best!)

Bilel was a wonderful host. He was communicative and welcoming, and his cats were friendly and always said “hello” when I came back to the BnB. The space was cozy and in a great location. Would definitely recommend.

Lester was an excellent host and was very kind, helpful, and responsive. Check in and check out was easy. This is a GREAT location, we were able to walk everywhere. The apartment and building were great as well, very clean and cozy. We will definitely stay here again!

I really enjoyed my stay Victor's listing. It was clean, cozy, and in an amazing location. I really enjoyed the view. I appreciated how safe the location was and how walkable the surrounding city was. Apartment was exactly as pictured.

I had a great stay in Hyde Park! Loved the neighborhood, and it was walking distance to UChicago hospitals, where I worked for the month. Very convenient for any person studying or working at University of Chicago.

The place is great. Although I wasn't sure before arriving, since it's not on a residential street, that slight apprehension was relieved by the location to many great restaurants and shops. In fact, it made parking very easy and traffic noise almost non-existent. The home is very open and bright, with attention to details. The kids liked the record player and books. The back patio is a nice touch for Chicago downtown. Randolph and west loop restaurants are about a 15 minute walk away. Andy was always very responsive and friendly to communicate with. This is a great place for both professionals and families, you can't go wrong. Thanks again!
besides being locked out at 4am in the morning. in the freezing cold...everything was very clean and host was extremely friendly
Great stay!
Good overall! Very clean, very responsive host. The room was just VERY small. Not much room for my suitcase to open but the host was very accommodating and allowed me to use the desk.
nice
anny's place was great, in a good location and close to public transportation. Anny was nice and very helpful

I’ve had a great stay! Evelyn is a very welcoming and  friendly host and it was a pleasure to share her unique space. She goes above and beyond to make her guests feel comfortable. The room and common spaces were very clean, and the apartment is situated in a quiet and convenient location close to red and purple CTA stations.

Sharleen’s place is just as it looks in the photos. She is very responsive if something comes up during your stay. The location is great. It’s walkable to the Roscoe main street of shops and restaurants as well as Southport Corridor

Not a very warm reception from the staff but really great location close to everything. My door handle was a bit broken and the place didn’t feel very clean, but it was nice to receive a case of 6 waters a day and coffee available downstairs. Place did not feel very monitored regarding people walking in, and I was woken up early morning by some loud banging and yelling next door or in my room which made me put the latch on. Also didn’t see the extra charges “resort fee” (not a resort so confused by this) and added percentage fee in the original listing, so ended up costing about double what the listing suggested.
Not bothered or upset but this was my honest experience.

We stayed around a month and a half, with our dog. We loved the location and it was easy to get in and out of the city but still be at a distance.
Our only problem was the neighbors, we had a couple strange encounters which made it a bit off putting.
Otherwise all the amenities you could need and then some. Definitely recommend!!
I had an amazing stay in Chicago! Larry’s place was just as described, beautiful apartment, the location was great, reception folks were friendly. Highly recommended.

The apartment was beautiful and matched the description perfectly. It is also located in a great neighborhood with a lot of great places to eat near by. Timothy was an outstanding host! He was always responsive, and very flexible and accommodating. The apartment had all of the essential amenities and then some.
Great stay as always!!

My husband and I had a long term stay here and we felt it was great! Josh was very communicative and check in was super easy. Overall the place was very clean. Couches appeared a little worn out (nothing major) and carpet was peeling off in some places for the stairs going up to the living room. Again, nothing major that affected our stay so overall great experience! The place is by the highway so sometimes it can be a bit noisy so something to consider if you're a light sleeper! Had plenty of towels, laundry was great, kitchen was stocked with some pots and pans so didn't need to bring much.
Great location, great apartment very clean and a fun place to spend time. Highly recommended

Cute quiet and safe neighborhood. The building itself is old so occasional bugs might come along but Javier came promptly and sealed everything off! I also placed a zevo for gnats. It’s important to keep moisture out and empty the trash every other day to avoid this. Other than that my stay was comfortable, and the place gets great natural light which was very important to me.

This is the kind of place that you hope for when you book an airbnb. The pictures don’t do this place justice and you can tell that the host really cares about the quality of your stay from his communication to all of the small details. The neighborhood is fantastic. So many shops, restaurants and businesses at your foot. Easy access to the train system. It’s really everything you could want in a listing. I stayed for almost a month and a half and would have stayed longer if I could have.
My two year old and I had a very pleasant stay. Elom was friendly and responsive. The space was comfortable and clean. The neighborhood was quiet and the neighbors were friendly.

I stayed at Suzanne's AirBnB for over a month and can enthusiastically recommend this place! Suzanne was a terrific and extremely responsive host and the location is excellent to explore the vibrant Lakeview / Wrigleyville neighborhood of Chicago. In a nutshell, I had an outstanding AirBnB experience and I would book again at any time.

We stayed at Adela’s place for a month, and everything was perfect. The apartment was well-equipped with everything we needed, and communication with Adela was excellent. I highly recommend staying here!

I had an awesome stay! The apartment is beautiful. The location is perfectly situated amongst the top architecture downtown. The hosts were great! Always got back to me quickly & were very helpful & kind. Zero complaints! Booking with them again would be a no brainer.
Decent place for long stays

Shaun and Christina allowed us to use their lovely two-bedroom 2nd floor for several months. It’s a classic Chicago townhome with hardwood floors and a bay window area. We had plenty of space, full kitchen with modern appliances, big screen TV, and fast internet. We felt very welcomed and comfortable there. It’s a quiet, walkable, growing neighborhood with surrounding restaurants, groceries and bars. Will definitely AirBnB with them again!

Had an absolutely wonderful stay. The place was clean and quiet. Really appreciated the fans in the bedrooms as I always sleep with one at home. The rain shower head was such a nice way to start my day. There were plenty of towels and wash rags. Communication with Mariena was excellent. She answered all of my question right away.:)) hope to stay there again on my next visit to Chicago!

We really enjoyed our stay at Mike's place. It was in a really convenient area and the home had everything you needed. Mike was super responsive and we'd recommend the place to anyone looking for a longer stay!

This was a great airbnb to stay in between moving from one home to another. The hosts were great communicators, and were very welcoming for me to bring my dog and a few extra boxes/items as I transitioned space. I cannot say enough good things about the place, location, and experience.

The apartment was terrific. We were under stress because we were in town for medical actions at U of Chicago Medical. The apartment was near where we had to go and the inside was well appointed enough it was one less thing for us to worry about.
Since such stays are open-ended because the doctors don't give a defined end date, we appreciated Leonard and AirBnB helping us get a refund when the doctors gave an early hospital discharge.
Nice place, peaceful and quiet neighborhood. House fully equipped for long stay.

I recently stayed at this beautiful apartment. The photos accurately represented the space, which was lovely, comfortable, and impeccably clean. Our host was incredibly kind and responsive, quickly addressing any issues that arose during our stay.
Check-in and check-out were seamless, making our arrival and departure hassle-free. The neighborhood was quiet and safe.
I highly recommend this apartment to anyone looking for a enjoyable stay. The host's exceptional hospitality and attention to detail made all the difference.
Thank you for a wonderful stay!

I was in Chicago as a visiting scholar at Northwestern university and stayed at Evelyn’s place for several weeks. Evelyn is nice and social and her home is full of character and personality. She lives herself in the apartment making it feel “homy” unlike most Airbnb experiences today. The place is clean and nicely decorated. It’s placed conveniently between Evanston and Chicago downtown making it ideal for visiting scholars at Northwestern who also want to explore the city.
Great place coming back
Place was accurately described, beautiful safe neighborhood with lots to do.
Great location

Brian's apartment was well-situated with an easy locking keypad, good bedrooms, and very nice bathroom. He was super responsive when I had questions or comments and helpful with storing our luggage until it was time for us to leave for the airport.
Rhonda's place was really nice and clean. It was quiet and peaceful. I really enjoyed my time there, I would definitely stay again.
Une bonne adresse pour visiter Chicago
Beautiful and very spacious unit in great location

Patricia’s place was perfect for our long weekend in Chicago. We wanted to get away from our busy lives and felt comfortable and cozy on garden level. We had access to Netflix, and the couch is so comfy you want to sleep on it too! Would book Patricia’s place to stay again for a home away from home.
Nice and neat room at a reasonable price
Beautiful apartment! It exceeded our expectation! Clear instructions for check in and plenty of amenities. I really like that they made suggestions for local businesses.

Delia's place is so reasonable priced and she's so friendly. Delia and her family were super nice. It was my first time visiting Chicago and Delia's family made me feel so safe/ welcomed to the area. They were super friendly and looked out for me during my stay. Delia also gave me so many recommendations on where to visit, checked in on me, and gave me flexibility to leave my luggage in her house till my late night flight. They had amazing an energy that made me feel right at home. An amazingly sweet person. The house is a squeaky clean home and is well put together. I fell in love with Chicago and will be looking to book with Delia first when I come to visit again!
Let us check in a little early at no charge since we flew in early. Everything was great and a very good location. Walking distance to a favorite restaurant.

Mimi’s place was great for two people for a weekend trip in Chicago. Location was quiet and convenient as long as you understand it’s not centrally located to the main strip on Milwaukee. Our flight was delayed and so we did check in very late, but we appreciate Mimi accommodating us for check-in.
Parking was available and worked out, but upon booking, we did learn that another tenant had booked a spot and so we could’ve been left without parking, which we needed. Worked out in the end, but it’d be nice to know if parking is actually available prior to booking as street parking is permit only.
We were a bit overwhelmed with the rules list once the reservation was confirmed, especially with the requirements regarding the couch. It’s a beautiful couch, but maybe not the best fit for an Airbnb unit. We just didn’t feel as comfortable/relaxed as we could have in the unit.
Overall we did enjoy our stay as it was a very nice apartment and convenient for us.
Lovely weekend with the family. It was nice to come home to a clean, put together place. Chris was very nice and accommodating. Thank you for sharing your home!
A very clean and quiet apartment. Location is convenient with 10-15min walk to trains and buses. The host was very friendly and responsive.
Excelente departamento, con los espacios necesarios para estar agusto. el anfitrion siempre estuvo al pendiente de todo. Regresaria sin pensarlo.

Perfect central Logan Square location walkable to really interesting restaurants and bars, parks and public transit. The space itself was really clean, a fun comfortable design and matched the description and photos. Amber was easy to communicate with, responded quickly and the local area guide in the unit was super helpful. We really enjoyed our long weekend exploring Logan Square and downtown and coming back to Amber's place for a comfortable home base. The only reason that I rated 4 instead of 5 stars is because we had a hard time sleeping in due to footstep and other morning noise right above the bedroom. Amber does disclose this noise in the description, but we came from the west coast and were hoping to sleep in to around 9am while on vacation. If you are an early riser, then this is a full 5 star review. The weekday had the earliest noise starting around 6:45am, weekend noise started later ranging from 7:45am to 8:30am. So this is really dependent on personal sleep preferences.

We had a wonderful time at this stay! We had some troubles during check-in with the lock but Carla helped us sort everything out as soon as she could. The space was cozy and clean! We wish it was a bit closer to the city, took us about 45-1hr using public transport but was not complicated, one bus and one train ride in. Carla and her husband were very friendly! Would recommend this place if you are looking for a quiet place outside of the city. Great place!
Great place and only 10mins from downtown

this was my first time using AirBnb. Liz was an exemplary host. Kind, welcoming, an all around delight! Eager to address any concerns and super helpful with recommendations. Cant recommend highly enough and I hope to stay with her again on future Chicago visits.

The hosts were great at communicating and responding. They provided detailed instructions on apartment location and entry. The unit was perfect, as described. Will absolutely consider rebooking in the future.
Home is a mile from Lincoln Square. It’s a garden apt so there is a bit of noise from upstairs. Space was clean and well set up. Host was very nice and accommodating .
Great home with the greatest host, Super pleased with my stay! Absolutely worth it! Thank you!
Very nice place, great location, everything as advertised.
This unit is well-appointed and equipped, well-located, and Joseph the host is both proactive and communicative. I really liked staying here!
it was a great place to stay, great Chinese food just a few blocks away, friendly bars, and the radius music venue all within walking distance.

The stay was great for the price. It was in a great location, within walking distance to the beach, shops, restaurants, and a bus stop. Every question I had, Brian answered quickly.
Although the description did not mention it, the Greenleaf IG account led me to believe this was a bed and breakfast. However, the host explained that since COVID, they have not been including breakfast in the stay due to city hoops. With that said, the kitchen was very accommodating to anyone who wanted to cook for themselves.
The house was clean and we had no problem with other guests. The neighborhood felt very safe, and parking was not an issue. I would stay again.

Overall it was comfortable, quiet and in a good location to see my son and daughter in law who live a few blocks away.
I would book again!
Great location, very nice place.  Loved the pool table!
Great stay and customer service

A very convenient and charming flat in a beautiful neighborhood. Being in a basement was not a problem as we were all day outside.
On top of that Jon is a very reactive owner. Our week was very cool
Great place to stay for our party of 4. Clean, easy to find. Hosts were great. Would recommend.
It was cute and clean.  We will be returning.

Darryl was just extremely proactive with his communication. Very easy check in. Great location. Place matched the online description and pictures. Very convenient to UChicago. I would stay here again no question. Great overall experience.

For a quick stay this Airbnb is for you. The airbnb is fairly close to Chicago Downtown. And there are train stations close by. One thing I would say is that because it is listed as “Free Parking” that doesn’t mean that parking is going to be easy! Usually the neighborhood is stacked with cars so be ready to walk 2 blocks down. The airbnb was cute and clean and will not  disappoint, its pretty quiet and fairly clean.
Stewart’s place was very clean and in a great location. Communication with the host was timely and effective. We would certainly recommend the place to other travellers.

Amit's home is beautiful, new, clean and quiet.  The high ceilings, big windows and open space feels luxurious and comfortable.  We wanted this neighborhood and are so glad we chose this individual, private home versus the many high rise apartments.  The location was exactly what we needed to be close to our daughter who lives in Chicago and we were a 20 minute walk from Lincoln Park, 3 minutes away from tons of great restaurants, shopping, coffee spaces and bars.  It felt very safe.  We had a question about wifi and Amit responded and fixed our issues immediately.  I'd highly recommend.

I loved staying here. Kelsey and Zach’s place is well thought out for a guest: beautiful home, great location, clean, friendly hosts, and clear instructions for questions one might have. I felt right at home and slept so well haha! I’d choose this place again anytime :)

This was the best air bnb I have ever stayed in. The place was immaculately clean. The beds and pillows WERE THE MOST COMFORTABLE BEDS AND PILLOWS we slept so well while staying here. Had no issue finding parking free street parking all weekend. The back yard is so cute and a great hangout spot. The house has the coolest art inside. The pictures in the app do not do this place justice. I am telling you this is such an amazing place. And John our host was AMAZING! So kind, so responsive, we are so thankful!!!!
great

It's a very cozy place, worth the price, with great walkable locations and transportation via the Red and Brown lines. Also has a desk to get work done if need be. Host is easily reachable with quick responses, and the neighborhood is lively. Halloween decorations were everywhere!
As I expected, the AirBnB is on a very busy, boisterous street. I brought ear plugs and definitely needed them to sleep.
Great location really enjoyed the stay!

Great location for a friends weekend out of town. It was a bit of an adjustment that one of the bedrooms was downstairs and the entry was from the lobby of the building but it worked out fine for us. The lockbox was a bit tricky to maneuver after a long drive into town but once we got the keys out, everything was great!

We enjoyed our stay at this property.  We had everything we needed for a weekend stay. The home is well kept and comfortable.  I had vehicle so did not use any public transit and I felt I was close to everything. I would stay here again if I had the chance.

My family and I really enjoyed our stay! It was the perfect size for 6 people and a baby. The space was well equipped with everything we needed, very clean, and comfortable. Zainab was super responsive to any questions.

Any issue we had, they always responded quickly which I really appreciated. This room itself has a great closet space that was convenient for our party of 3. It didn’t feel as cluttered as we thought it would have been! Simple, short stay next to McCormick.
Sonia’s place was cozy and very comfy

This was a very nice home with helpful amenities. It was very clean and exactly as described and depicted in the photographs. Actually, nicer than we anticipated. Also appreciated the easy checkout instructions. It’s always difficult to be getting out of an Airbnb for a long day of travel ahead with a giant check list of things to do to leave the unit- particularly when you’ve paid a healthy cleaning fee. Not the case  with this Airbnb!! I hope to stay here again as we visit Chicago to see family. Thank you for everything!
Maria was very helpful and accommodating. We appreciated her warmth and hospitality. She is a lovely person and a great host. The space was as described and met our needs well.
I loved the neighborhood - felt safe and reasonably walkable. Everything was clean and labeled and the communication was clear. Would absolutely stay again.
Marek is very kind and helpful person. Whole apartment is clean and in standard according to description.
It was a beautiful air bnb that was within walking distance to a train station if you wanted to go into the city. The hosts were responsive and flexible about check in - overall a great stay!

Our stay was amazing. It’s exactly what you see on the pictures. My family and I chose this place for a surprise birthday dinner for my son. It’s plenty of space to have a small gathering all the bedrooms have a mini frig and microwave . The three full bathrooms  was a plus as well. Looking forward to booking a stay next summer to enjoy the beautiful outside view. You can literally walk to the lake !!!

Place was in a great location, check in was smooth and easy.
Very strong moth smell, no tv in the bedroom or access to control temperature. Overall good deal for one night.

Fantastic stay for anyone visiting UChicago.
Lovely house and location.
Private boutique / B&B feel.
Stayed for a few weeks the place is great! Always clean and the host will help you out.
Great place to stay.  It was clean and quiet. I would suggest this unit.

Sam and Jesse are the most friendly, considerate and responsive hosts I have stayed with. If you have any questions or problems they respond quick with great detail. If I’m ever back in the are, I’d be happy to stay there again!

Fue una excelente estadía. Comunicación 100% y gran apertura de Masato y Akiko respecto a dejar nuestras maletas más temprano por nuestra hora de llegada. La habitación es pequeña pero comfortable, tiene un buen closet para almacenar cosas y la casa es linda y acogedora. Aunque el sofá cama es un poquito incomodo porque no se queda totalmente horizontal. Cuando llegues a la parada de tren de 35th y Archer puedes tomar el bus 35 Western y te deja a 2 cuadras de la casita (para que no camines desde la estación que no es lejos pero con maletas es pesado). Es extremadamente fácil movilizarse desde casita hacia la ciudad, tiene paradas de bus, convenience stores y restaurantes cerca y el sistema de tránsito de Chicago es increíblemente amigable. Me volvería a quedar aquí!

Wonderful place..
Easy to get everywhere with public transportation (many options), very close to the lake if you enjoy running or cycling, safe surroundings, 24h reception, fast elevators.
The apartment is clean, has everything that's needed for a short or longer stays.
Rob is always helping with relevant informations about all you might need.
Excelente lugar para hospedarse por estancias largas, las amenidades del lugar estan simplemente increobles y muy accesible a diferentes lugares

Highly recommend!! Absolutely loved my stay! The location was perfect for getting back and forth to McCormick Place. Close to the lake, so we were able to spend some time there as well. The unit was very clean, well decorated, spacious, and had all the amenities described. The hosts communicated well with us throughout our stay. It was super easy to find, and ample street parking. Will definitely stay again if my travels bring me back to Chicago.
Alles bestens; gerne wieder.

Alex's place was absolutely wonderful. Spacious, clean, easy to check-in, fully-stocked, and the location is top-tier; walking distance to so many great places and near the Blue Line. ....and that rooftop view. Would definitely stay here again. 10/10.

Great place and apartment, Aiste was very helpful and understanding. The room is great, bathroom is comfortable and with plenty of hot water. The room only has a small window that offers little natural light if that is something that you want but everything else is just amazing

O apartamento é confortável, limpo e iluminado. O chuveiro merece destaque! É muito bom mesmo. A comunicação foi ótima e os anfitriões foram muito gentis. A localização é ótima, com vários restaurantes e bares muito próximos. O metrô também está próximo e vai direto para o centro. Eu certamente voltaria para esse lugar.
Thank you! Great place to stay.
A comfortable, cozy space that’s walkable to everything! Thoughtful touches and beautiful paintings!

I have done this property through Air bnb and after paying online full amount after reaching hotel they have charges more, similar amount to booking......very costly property not recommended from my side
It was a good and pleasant stay and clean place. Spacious and good service and quick responses from the owners.
Great modern hotel and definitely recommend!

We loved our experience with Jennifer and place. We had to stay in Chicago for over a month for a medical treatment. She. And v the whole team were amazing. They were helpful and responsive. The place was beautiful and in walking distance to so much. We could get to Target, Whole Foods and Trader Joe’s easily for grocery shopping. Great restaurants were close. And Ohio Street Beach was a 5 minute walk away. We felt very safe in the Streeterville neighborhood.
We needed to extend another week for the treatment and Jennifer was so accommodating. She made what could have been a very trying time easier. We are so grateful. For an extended stay is was so affordable!!!
Patt was always easy to work with and always there if I needed something! Worked at the hospital so it was an easy walk. Thank you Patt!!

This was exactly what we needed for our business trip - 8 people, each had their own room. Very spacious and comfortable. So many amazing restaurants in the area, very walkable - the location is incredible! Would definitely rent again next time we have another team meeting in Chicago.

I had a wonderful stay here! Before check in they sent me a video for where to park, how to find the place from the main street, and how to get inside and what all the codes were. It was incredibly helpful and a very smart thing to do! I had no issues while staying here, and there was a lot to explore in the immediate area. I would definitely recommend them if I ever have anyone needing a place to stay while visiting!

De plek was erg ruim, waardoor we met 5 mensen makkelijk erin konden. Het was ook erg comfortabel en schoon. de locatie was fijn omdat het op loopafstand was van de metro, de bus, en de restaurants in Old Town. ook waren er veel toeristische tips achtergelaten. Wij verbleven hier met plezier!
Helen is such a great host!

This AirBnB was the PERFECT place to stay for the week! My friend and I stayed as we had a concert, and I would totally stay again! It looked exactly like the pictures,  it was a great midpoint between the city and Allstate Stadium, and there was plenty of stuff to do in the area. The area also felt super safe. The bed was comfortable, and the bathroom was very nice! Honestly, I have nothing but good words to say about the place. Carla was also very friendly!

It was so lovely to stay at Timothy’s place. Super central location, great communication from the host, and exact description of the apartment. A cozy, lovely place for a longer “short stay”. Would recommend for single or couples who is looking for something lovely in downtown Chicago.
Over all it was a good stay. I dont mind it.

I definitely recommend the host Nikkole! she is a friendly and proactive host , easy to talk and understanding others and care. Thank you so much! When next time to Chicago,  we definitely come to visit;)
Great modern condos in a great location to experience all Chicago has to offer.
The place itself was clean and nice. But we had to pay extra for a lot of hidden fees and parking.
Had a great stay here!
We were very comfortable and felt like home, except one of the other guests cranked the heat up to 82 degrees had to go buy a fan..other than that it was great!
Celia was a very responsive and helpful host. The place was very clean. Parking was easy and it was in a nice neighborhood, close to public transportation a good food spots.
Great location and excellent communication!

Henry is very lovable, helpful and interested. He is always reachable and friendly. The house is perfect for 3-4 adults. Three bedrooms, fully equipped kitchen, nice living room even with a grand piano. The El - public transportation- is less than five minutes walking distance away. People in the neighborhood are friendly and positive. The Lake is in walking distance. But it is on the South Side, black belt area of Chicago. Restaurants and shops are not in walking distance. It s useful to have a car which we had. For us it was perfect, the Grand Ballroom on Cottage Grove in walking distance, most Blues clubs we went to were on the South Side. So perfect for a blues trip. Would recommend to stay there, it will be an option for my next stay in Chicago.
Stewart’s place was very clean and had a good size kitchen living room dining room.  It was a good value for a nice place!  Stewart was responsive and friendly.

I 100% would recommend Nora’s Apartment if you are ever in the ChicagoLand area. This is the 1st Airbnb I’ve stayed where it truly truly felt like home. The apartment has everything, amenities that were not even listed. For instance, there was a blender, an air fryer, fully stocked kitchen. I don’t drive, but there tons of free parking. Also, Nora is extremely helpful and responsive to any concerns. If I’m forced to offer criticism, you are far enough to sometimes get a suburban feel. But it’s kinda block by block. Also the Metra is a 10 min drive, and the Blue line is 15 mins away. Logan Square is 3 stops away.
I’ve stayed at many Airbnbs. This is the most pleased I’ve been with any stay. I wish I could have found a nearby gym.
On this platform, reviewers have saved me many times. I try to pay it forward by doing the same. Being honest about my experience. This time it’s easy for me. If you’re in Chicago, I think you should strongly consider Nora accommodation.

Brandon’s place was an amazing visit! He was very responsive with the initial booking. The house itself is super clean and in a very quiet part of town. He provides temporary parking passes for the guests to abide by the parking rules. The bedrooms were super clean and the beds were also immensely comfortable, as well as having a nice ledge you can sit all your belongings on beside the bed. We enjoyed this apartment place. It was quiet and nicely located a few blocks from a rail station. There were many restaurants within walking distance. Also, the bike docks are close if you want to ride, as we did! Thank you Arman.
Our stay was great! Josh was very accommodating and always answered our questions in a timely and friendly manner.
We enjoyed meeting and talking with Marek, a friendly and helpful host. The place was clean and homey. Very user friendly access, close to bus stop, etc. We would highly recommend his place.
Martha’s place was perfect for the long weekend. It was in a very quiet, safe neighborhood with easy parking. Martha was very friendly and check in was easy and flexible. We would stay here again.

This was my second stay at this apartment, and I can confidently say it’s my go-to whenever I’m in the area. Everything that made my first stay enjoyable—the cleanliness, convenience, and welcoming atmosphere

PROS: Anny was a perfect host. Very prompt with communication. Attentive. Genuinely cares about her guests’ experience. The house was meticulous. Plenty of supplies, particularly both for the guests’ bathroom and kitchen essentials (and even non-essentials!) that the great majority of Airbnb hosts don’t provide.
CONS: Nothing that Anny can do something about, but the noise issue within the household was a real problem for me. I heard no street or commercial (like from the bar/restaurant just around the corner) noise, but plenty of noise from the other guests. The house was like an echo chamber. I heard everything: footsteps, toilet being flushed, the rushing water from the bathtub or bathroom sink, the clang of plates being stacked in the cupboard, even the sound from a suitcase being zipped…And I’m partially hard of hearing and don’t use a hearing aid! Needless to say, I slept poorly the entire week I was there, which adversely affected my vacation.
Great location!
Angelica’s space was ideal for our family’s long weekend in Chicago. A lovely walk through the neighborhood to hop on the blue line, easy parking, quiet & comfortable. Thanks again Angelica!
