Devon's place feels like a 2nd home, always a great place to stay! 5 stars all across the board.

It's getting 4, not 5, stars because of the check-out expectations. I walk with a cane and choose listings based on how well they seem to work with my disabilities. They wanted me to put used towels in the washing machine and used dishes in the dishwasher, which I could see. In addition, they expected me to not just collect the trash (which I always do, whether it's a hotel or somebody's guestroom) but take it up the stairs and out a gate to the outside trash. That's not something I can physically do in my own home, and I wouldn't have chosen this listing if the check-out assumptions were clear before booking.
All in all, it's lovely if you're able-bodied and fine being expected to take the trash out and get the dishes and laundry ready for a button press.

All privacy is respected, however it is important that the room is next to the bathroom (only one door ivides both rooms). Also I recommend to be aware when you walk from the train station to the neighborhood, ther are a couple of blocks that have some homeless people which I cannot say they are dangerous but just be aware or maybe not being so late around.
Anyway, the neighborhood inside is very nice and calm.
The room is very spacious and comfortable, however the micorwave and oven inside don't work and need to use the common ones.

We stayed with 7 people, and the apartment was comfortable in terms of size. The location is a definite plus, as it’s close to a metro station, making it easy to move around the city. However, I feel it’s important to share some concerns about cleanliness and maintenance. While the kitchen was equipped, many of the utensils were old and not clean. We were unable to use the oven due to its condition and had to clean the microwave ourselves before using it. The refrigerator also wasn’t clean upon arrival. In the living room, the furniture showed signs of wear, with visible cigarette burn holes and general dirt.
I don’t mean to be harsh, but based on my experience, I wouldn’t choose to stay here again unless these issues were addressed.

Excellent place; the roommates where very respectful and the zone is quiet and calm. Near the bus and the Metro lines

Let me say first that I am also an airbnb host myself, so I do admit that I am a pretty tough critic about wherever I stay. This airbnb is a vintage, mostly well kept home in the true suburban Chicago. It is not really close to most things- its about a $30 Trip in Uber to downtown. The house is spacious- having a considerable amount of open space. Its pretty creaky in the vintage hardwood floors- but they are clean! That space could be filled with some things that could REALLY ADD to a stay. Some truly very missed items were 1: A coffee pot! Everyone wants morning coffee. 2: a toaster- the morning eggs need toast with them. A blender that was provided. 3: maybe a few pictures on the wall. There is no dishwasher, so you are hand washing everything so a 4: dishes drying wrack would have been VERY helpful. Overall, the owner had great response time. The complimentary amenities were toothbrush, toothpaste, loofa , plackers, and shampoo. Nice host, good stay.

Location? Absolutely ideal. Nestled in a charming neighborhood, it’s close to great coffee shops, restaurants, and the best of what the South Side offers. Whether you’re in town for a quick getaway or an extended stay, Maureen’s place strikes the perfect balance between convenience and relaxation.
But what truly sets this Airbnb apart is Maureen herself. She’s one of the most welcoming, responsive, and kind hosts I’ve ever encountered. It felt like staying with an old friend who genuinely cares about your experience. I can’t recommend this place enough — it’s a 10/10, and I’ll be back for sure!

The entrace was a little messy and the stairs squeaky but other than that nice and clean place to stay, definitely good value. The host was nice and very clear with instrutions. Definitely recommended.

There's exactly 50 steps to walk up to get to the most wonderful unit for an AirBnB that I've ever seen - Gorgeous space! Very open. Very clean. It feels very GRAND when you walk in with the high ceilings and open concept. It was beautiful, and spacious. We had everything we needed in the place, and the location was only a few (maybe 4-5) miles from downtown. We found parking on the street in front of the space nightly without a problem. We felt very safe and secure in the place. We would definitely stay here again. Absolutely loved it!

This place was great for my visitor. The apartment is very well organized with all amenities. It is in a very convenient location close to transportation, restaurants, cafes, and grocery stores. I will definitely book this place again. Thank you Luke and Ligia.

1000% recommend staying here especially as a lone female traveler :)
I had an issue with my code and the host quickly fixed it !!
thank you for the wonderful stay!!

This stay was exactly what we wanted: close to the L stop, nice neighborhood, close to some good restaurants (The Little Goat is an easy walk and an excellent breakfast spot), the place was tidy and comfortable. Check in and out were a breeze; Mo and Ganna were super nice and let us check in early to drop off our stuff.
I would stay here again and highly recommend them as hosts.

His place was comfortable and affordable, and we really enjoyed the stay! The only issue we had was the location, which was not the safest area in Chicago. But, we didn’t encounter any actual issue as we used Uber or Lyft every time we went out. Obi was also very kind and helpful throughout the stay.
Elizabeth was responsive throughout and super accommodating. Very nice person and a great stay!

Mr. Marek and his family were very welcoming. Neighborhood was quiet and calm. Home was clean and very charming due to their aesthetic plantation. We would like to recommend this place to future visitors.
Very nice place! Private, quiet and clean. Jordan is very friendly and provides clear check-in instructions.
Very inconvenient to get in and out.

This was a nice place and the pictures were accurate. The neighborhood was a little sleepy and a few rooms were missing curtains. But overall my interactions with Daniel were great, check in/out was a breeze, and the apartment was nice and well decorated.
It is a tranquil place, perfect for business travel. It is close to Chicago's major conference convention center, and public transportation is also very convenient.

Decent place for the price - a single bed in a room, with shared amenities. Make sure to find the host in the pharmacy on the first floor to get your room key. The kitchen is very nice and tidy. The bathroom shower takes a while to heat up (only one of the bathroom actually has hot water as far as I could tell).

Abel and Flor provided a wonderful place for my parents to stay in the neighborhood where I live.  They felt very comfortable and safe, and the location was extremely convenient.  They would definitely stay again!

Super cool spot!  Incredible amount of space in the main living area - perfect for a big group to hang together.  Bedrooms were as described!  Would definitely recommend if you’re looking for a unique space and perfect location

L'appartamento è ampio e comodo, con una cucina ben fornita. Inoltre nel basement c'è la lavatrice, che è una buona cosa. Purtroppo quasi all'inizio del mio soggiorno è iniziata un'infestazione di topi, che si è prolungata per tutta la durata ossia diverse settimane. Charla è stata molto reattiva e d'aiuto, chiamando anche un disinfestatore. Però nulla è servito. Questa cosa mi ha impedito di avere un soggiorno sereno anche perchè non potevo lasciare cibo e pentole in giro, dovevo disinfettare tutto, sporcavano il piano cottura della cucina... e poi li sentivo correre di notte.
Posizione: molto buona. A 5 minuti dal campus di UChicago. Ben servito dai mezzi pubblici: le fermate del 55, del 172 e del 4 (che va dritto in centro, passa vicino al MacNamara Center) sono a pochi minuti a piedi.
La zona è residenziale e tranquilla, sia di giorno che di notte. La polizia del campus passa spesso di lì.
A 15 min a piedi c'è Hyde Park Produce che è un buon grocery store.
me ha encantado muchas gracias
This was a great home base for a Chicago trip with my daughter and mom. Convenient to transportation and quiet at night. Really great neighborhood.

We had a family emergency.  Stephanie was a fabulous host, communicated with me frequently, was extremely easy to be in touch with, and most of all, she was considerate, compassionate, and thoughtful as our family worked through a tragedy.  I cannot thank her enough for her beautiful house, and most of all for her thoughtfulness and kindness.

I constantly travel and this was one of the best places I've ever been to.
Beautiful neighborhood, fantastic interior. Felt right at home. Lots of space.
The hosts were very kind and responsive and flexible. 10 star experience

Overall the building is wonderful- gym, meeting rooms, business center, outdoor area with BBQ and walking path, indoor and outdoor pools. The apartment has a great balcony that you can see north (river and a peek of lake) and south (park) and faces the beautiful skyline to the west. The pictures should be retaken so they show the north and west views of the city from this corner apt on the 39th floor. Tremendous! We ran into some problems when the building did maintenance twice on the water boilers (not Andrew's fault) and an electrical outage, but Andrew was always very responsive and we got everything worked out as soon as possible. When we checked in, all the blinds were up and the cords so tangled that we spent an hour untangling them to get them lowered so we could sleep. The bedding and pillows could use a refresh, but were adequate. Kitchen stuff is chipped and mismatched, but again, everything you need. Feels more like a rental than a home. Perfect location. Good wifi.
Sebas is by far the best host we’ve ever had. He gave us great recommendations, and the place was great! We had an incredible stay and the location was beautiful.

Muy buena experiencia y opción hospedarnos con G, muy lindo alojamiento coincide con la descripción y te hace sentir como en casa, amigable en todo momento y al pendiente.
La zona es agradable y tranquila, un poco retirado del centro pero vale la pena, hay transporte super accesible.
Sin duda elegiriamos este lugar nuevamente!

Exactly what I needed for my month-long stay. This room is apparently the biggest at this location, and I felt like I had plenty of room and everything I needed. Patt warned me there was no stove or oven use, but there is a hot plate that was plenty to make pasta, soup, etc. as well as many other appliances. The window does open to the street, which can get loud, but it’s on the 2nd floor so still safe. Locks on every door from the street to the floor to the room itself, which is good as you can’t control if your roommates lock the street door. It’s maybe 5 doors down from the rail stop, which made it convenient for getting anywhere. I didn’t walk around too much at night, but someone else may feel more comfortable. There’s no system for communicating with other roommates and I’m not sure how many people were there, but people overall kept to themselves and their respective rooms. Patt was available and very kind, though I didn’t end up needing further assistance during my stay.

I was originally booked at their 2 bd/2 bath unit. Due to a leak above their unit, I agreed to move to another unit of theirs. The unit I stayed in was 1 bed/1 bath (lost the potential of a roommate). The unit was clean. It had everything I needed (Bedroom, Bathroom, Kitchen & Washer/Dryer). I didn't spend much time, other than sleeping, in the unit due to work. At night, while sitting on the deck, I heard people yelling (all hrs), helicopters hoovering above (probably at least 4 times) and plenty of police/ambulance/fire truck sirens). Maybe that's normal for that area (I got used to it after a week or so). Originally, I felt uncomfortable being in that neighborhood (one of Chicago's bad areas, the South Side), but I got over it. The neighborhood residents, the ones I saw/talked to, were friendly. Besides the switch in units (negotiating a fair refund), my stay was fair. Would recommend the 1 bed/1 bath unit to someone who is more comfortable with an urban environment. I'm not for it.
Great reception and very responsive.
we had a nice time at Christina's place.

This listing was exactly as pictured and the host Ava Marie was very friendly, accommodating, and hospitable throughout our stay! The host was flexible with check-in, provided great recommendations for spas, restaurants, and roof top bars, and she left us snacks and beverages! Ava Marie was very responsive to our questions and concerns before, during, and after our stay. Definitely made us feel welcomed.
I had an amazing stay, cozy house and friendly people.

Small apt. neat as a pin, everything matched the listing and was perfect for our 3-day stay. Jon/Lesley were very nice and communication was great re check-in/out and tour of the place to go over the amenities.

Had a really great experience staying at this location. The host was extremely responsive and kind and had all kinds of snacks and toiletries available for use. Really appreciated all the help throughout our stay.
Very nice and cozy place to stay at very welcoming and was always quite never once heard neighbors outside,chill neighborhood
Carl is an awesome host, friendly, kind and helpful,  accomodating.  I would recommend Carl to anyone who wants a quiet, clean and comfortable stay in Chicago

Alan’s condo was as described and pictured. Alan was responsive to questions. Street parking was easy and plentiful. The condo was clean and comfortable. The three keys (with double locks) was a challenge when carrying groceries and/or luggage and the fire station across the street impacted our sleep. Other than those two issues, we recommend Alan’s condo.

Delia seemed like a chill person to interact.  However when I requested she wash my sheets in cold water which she agreed to, she single handedly tried to extort $25USD from me for doing that without any agreement with me .  When I spoke with her over the phone and told her I did not agree to $25 payment for washing my sheets in cold water she hung up on me leaving me  in a position where I had no contact with her ever since.  She lied to me about the area which was unsafe and crime ridden, she lied about the noise which was ridiculous people walking at night on the ceiling stamping made it hard to rest, flashing light coming through the window at night, suffocating space with no fresh air flow, no lock on the door, people sleeping behind the curtains and room dividers in the hallways, no privacy , no safety.  She left me no instructions how to locate the room, except how to get inside.  I had to get help from others inside to locate the room. the place is a slam and unsafe, loud slam

I had a nice stay at Michael’s place. The apartment has ample space and all the necessities needed for a long stay. Check in and check out was seamless and I had great communication with Michael during my stay. Best of all is the location, it is in a beautiful and quiet neighborhood.
Great home! Loved the neighborhood

My wife and I stayed here with two small dogs for a weekend wedding, our first time in Chicago. The place was comfortable and perfect for our stay. Great location, close to local restaurants, bakeries, vintage shops, and only a short transit ride to attractions like the Art Institute and of course the Bean. Host prepared nicely knowing we had dogs and it was overall an excellent stay.

It was a great stay at Tanya’s airbnb. A very welcoming host. The Airbnb was very clean and organized when I arrived. The city is really close as well. Tanya’s made me feel at home and that was appreciated because I was traveling by myself. I got to go to an event with her and it was a great time. I’m definitely coming back!

Excellent all-around. We hosted a team here during our conference and everyone loved it. It was a great value for the utility, I have never seen an AirBnB that has this many actual beds. Our team loved it, and the host was so easy to work with. We will be booking regularly.
Great place! We really enjoyed our stay
Beautiful room.  Dirty bathroom and kitchen so bring your own cleaning supplies. No other complaints

My husband and I stayed at Gabe’s Airbnb for a month and had a fantastic time! The apartment is located close to several bus stops which made relying on public transportation easy during our trip. It’s also just a few blocks away from the Bloomingdale trail that we walked everyday and I used for my morning runs.
The neighborhood felt very safe and quiet, and there were several restaurants and grocery stores just within a few blocks of the apartment. We were able to easily walk or bus to the main part of Logan Square where there are tons of amazing restaurants, thrift stores, and other shops.
The kitchen had everything needed for cooking, and we were able to use the shared laundry machines throughout our stay. We also both worked during our stay and requested an additional office chair so we could have 2 work areas which Gabe was able to accommodate - the extra chair was already there when we arrived. Communication was very prompt and all of our questions were answered efficiently.
Wonderful home with great amenities! Close to public transit, lots of things near by. The home was very clean and very functional!

Fantastic apartment in a great neighborhood.  Lots of nice restaurants in the area, and a simple 10 minute walk to Roosevelt station to catch the Red Line downtown. My wife and I walked from the Red Line Friday night after dinner downtown and had dinner locally Saturday night.  Felt very safe.  Lots of people in this bustling area. We were there for a Bears game, and it was a very enjoyable 20 minute walk to Soldier Field.  The apartment has the typical outside noise(s) that one should expect in a downtown location.  I would point out that if you use Daniel's paid parking spot (as we did), you have to go into the apartment first to get the garage door opener so that you can get into the basement garage to park.  Not easy on a busy Friday afternoon in Chicago, but we made it work.  Thanks again for a great weekend, Daniel.

Andy was so communicative and welcoming, great host! The room and home were clean and comfortable and had everything we needed. Easy walk to the Harold Washington Cultural Center, where we needed to be- did not have a car, took train/bus from ORD. Yes, some nearby units are boarded up, but they did not affect our stay. Great value, comfortable stay and excellent host. Thank you Andy!

This was my second time staying at Carly’s place in Chicago. I love it here!!
Very comfortable and stocked with the essentials, Lots of natural sunlight and cute decor - I felt right at home.
Safe neighborhood with free street parking options and coffee shops/restaurants within walking distance.
Another thing I really love about this place is the rooftop, it has a great view of the city!
Thank you Carly for hosting me again, you’re the best!

Loved this apartment in Lincoln park! Great area. Can be noisy at times because of the super nearby subway line and sirens down on the street below. Nonetheless loved the spot and William was super straightforward and responsive! Would stay here again!

The (blue) room has lots of windows and is well furnished. My back & neck loved the ergonomic chair! Caryl is a wonderful host. Breakfast is special because Caryl attended to us during the entire time plus we got to meet & talk with other guests. Both UChicago & the lake shore are at short walks. I'm definitely coming back here!
Nice mansion space to spend time with friends with interesting decor.
We loved this place! Exactly as shown in pictures. Responsive host and a comfy environment.
We were disappointed with the inadequate towels, pillows and lack of a couch. We ended up having one of our four guests sleeping on the floor

This was an excellent stay on the south side of Chicago. A beautiful quiet neighborhood with plenty of parking on the street. In addition to the garage that is already available in the property. Wonderful was able to help me with any of my needs and he went above and beyond, even adding a desk to the property when I asked. I stayed for three months for school, and was sad to leave after. This Airbnb had everything I needed even things that I usually travel with or not necessary because he provided them such as an air fryer, cookware, and even a squatty potty! I was so happy at this Airbnb because of the host and also because of the location. The community there is wonderful, and I felt safe every day. I even walked around and met people in the neighborhood and spent a lot of time there. It was quiet on the weekends and accessible to the downtown area.

Shay is a great host - very professional and responsive to any questions or issues. The apartment itself is a small unit in an older building but is in good condition and clean, and the building is very quiet. Location is super convenient to public transportation - there’s a bus stop right outside and two train lines nearby - as well as anything you’d need , eg bars, restaurants , and two grocery stores, all easy walkable. It’s not luxurious, but it’s a good value in an excellent neighborhood.
Great location. views the lake Michigan,  and the navy pier and walking distance to the river walk, trump tower, Michigan Ave thr shopping mile, and more. also very spacious,
Very nice place centrally located close to downtown

Apartment was as shown in listing photos and close to the green line train as stated. We did have an issue with the front gate getting locked.  We were in town for a business event and had slow response times from the host on multiple occasions. (When asking for the wifi password and when the gate was locked and we could not get in.) There were no check out instructions so we did what we have done in the past at other places we have stayed and stripped down the linens & cleaned up after ourselves. Over all the stay met our expectations on location for our business event.

All in all a quality stay.  Red Robin team was responsive.  Unit was easy to access.  Easy walking distance to Univ of Chicago and local Hype Park neighborhoods.  Rental was 50% cheaper than staying at the nearest hotel.
Great place to stay.  Good location, quiet street, comfy beds.   Very reasonably priced

this was honestly the best Airbnb experience I have had! Mercedes truly went above and beyond! I had a small amount of trouble with a code and she responded very quickly and even sent someone down to personally help us. she is very informative of the area and gave us an abundance of great ideas, food, local spots and activities. her space was perfect for us being pretty close to all the things we planned to do and had more then enough sleeping options to host us easily. she has definitely earned her super host badge! If we ever need an Airbnb in Chicago again she will be the first person we call! thank you so much again!
Very friendly and fast responses
Enjoyed our stay! Starbucks and other cafes and restaurants within walking distance.

I appreciated that this place was available short notice but paying $270 after tax & cleaning for 1 night is ridiculous. I get that it’s one of the biggest cities but wow. I didn’t feel safe in that neighborhood as an out of towner. We just needed a place to sleep after a wedding & it was close enough to the venue.
The bed was comfortable. The lighting in the bedroom made it impossible to get ready in. Then there was the bathroom light hanging down from the ceiling covering the bathroom
Mirror so I couldn’t use that spot either. I used the big common room mirror with natural light. I was thankful no one else was there at that time.
We didn’t see anyone else while we were there. It was fairly quiet just your normal big city noises.
I wouldn’t stay again but it worked out for two people who needed a place to stay last minute.
As described,
Great quiet place to stay.
Love the place!
Very friendly & hospitable host family!
Wonderful location and a nice host! Great communication and accommodating. Amazing view of the city skyline. 10 /10

I had a fantastic stay! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and just as described. Vladimir was incredibly responsive and made check-in a breeze. I recommend this place to anyone looking for a great experience.
Great space, location, and price point! Would recommend.

Very cozy and nice place. Close to bar, clubs and restaurant, host responsive. I would only recommend to the host to let guesses lock the door after leaving the bedroom. Just for a matter of safety. Anyway. I would def go back.

Great place in a walkable neighborhood! The space was especially great for our family with young children — so many thoughtful accommodations like a high chair, toys, books, and more. The host was very friendly, responsive, and helpful with tips for parking in the neighborhood, etc. Would highly recommend!

O was very accommodating with checking in early! Very responsive host. The loft was in the absolute PERFECT location! Super close to anything & everything. Right around the corner to the L, we were able to quickly get to & from everything. The beds were comfortable. The loft is incredibly spacious with neat little quarks all over. Slightly noisy at night due to a downstairs bar, but nothing that kept us up all night. 10/10 will stay here again with a big group!

Beautiful home, comfortably fit the four of us, had everything we could need. Lots of easy to get to restaurants in the area and a grocery store close by. Easy access to Logan Square, which is where we spent most of our time. Would def recommend/stay again! Our host was friendly and communicated proactively with very clear instructions. Thank you, Michael!
Great place to stay.  Very clean and easy to check in and out of.

I had a comfortable stay at Michael’s place for about 2 months. The apartment is thoughtfully furnished and comes with a well equipped kitchen. Michael was responsive from the very beginning, answering any questions I had during my stay about the apartment, building, and the neighborhood in general. The location is 5 minutes walking distance from two bus stops and about a 20 minute walk to the Green Line. Moving around is convenient but would recommend having a car. Overall, it’s a great place for a long term stay.

I stayed with my partner for a total of 4 days. It was wonderful just for the two of us. The bed was great and location was awesome. The front desk was attentive. You could easily get in the bus or train they were both around the corner.If you need waters, or snacks, there is a gas station right across the street.  overall our visit went very well and the views were great as well.

Christina is a dedicated and helpful host. The location of this place is perfect if you want to be near the lake, and the neighborhood is nice. Buses are convenient.
The apartment is very clean and the bed is comfortable. But it's a bit shabby overall--chipped paint in various places, loose door handles, reluctantly flushing toilet. There is no bedside light, which is inconvenient. The apartment door has a keypad lock for access but no bolt for security.
The building is not nearly as pleasant as the apartment itself. The hallways have disagreeable stale smells and dirty carpets, and the elevator seems to have been stripped of its panelizing, leaving ugly, rough surfaces. Too bad.
We had a great stay in Chicago. Aly gave very detailed instructions so it was an easy space to navigate. She also responded quickly when we asked her questions! Great stay in Chicago!
Very beautiful place to stay with amazing views
We had a wonderful time in every way.  We hope to stay at Telly’s place again sometime.
Stewart was super helpful and responsive. Great location and enjoyed the stay!
Location, location, location! This spot is right in the middle of things especially great places to eat! The host was extremely responsive and helpful!
Very good host , willing to accommodate check in & check out timings if there is a possibility
Exactly as pictured, extremely convenient area with great access to the Loop. Very proactive and responsive host and building staff, would definitely recommend!
It was noisy across the street and would not have gone outside past dark, it just had an odd feeling. Uber drivers said it was a safe area.

This was a great stay! The area was great, there were so many places to walk to, the check in instructions were easy, and everything was very clean.
The only thing I wasn't a fan of was the bed as it was very firm, but that's definitely a personal choice.
Overall, I would definitely stay here again! I had to reach out for Kelly for a couple of things and she was very quick to respond.
We loved our stay! Def will be coming back.

We enjoyed our stay! The communication was great, and the suite was tidy and perfect for our short getaway in Chicago. We were out all day, so we just used the place to sleep, and the bed was comfy. If you want to cook, there's a kitchen in the condo available for guests. The neighborhood was quiet. Parking was a bit tricky at night, but we knew that going in. It's permit parking during the week, but Roxane hooked us up with some permit stickers. Thanks, Roxane!
Great stay! My group and me had a great time.
Great place and Anna is great!

The pictures do not do this place justice.  They accurately show the rental but it is much bigger with useable space than I envisioned.  And the location is amazing.  You can walk to so many restaurants, playgrounds, and stores.  We were going to spend more time downtown but ended up hanging around the rental more.  Would highly recommend.
Great stay, flexible check in, clean and big space. Host was wonderful! Very communicative and allowed us an early check in when he heard our flight landed early. Definitely 5 stars!

This was just what I needed, very close to a work event at UChicago and also quite close to Build Coffee. I was on a work trip so I really appreciated the full size desk in the room and various small lamps. The bed was comfortable and the blinds kept out the light from streetlights. And the fellow tenants of the larger space were quiet, especially during the quiet hours. There was space in the fridge for me to store my things, too, and everything was great!

La anfitriona fue muy amable y fue muy flexible ya que nos dejó dejar las mochilas antes del check-in y después del check-out. Tuvimos un problema de limpieza ya que el baño estaba muy sucio pero le pedimos que lo limpiara y accedió muy amablemente. La cama principal es súper cómoda pero el sillón cama no es del todo apropiado para que una persona duerma cómodamente. De todas formas, la valoración es positiva ya que ella nos facilitó todo mucho.

Great apartment! A lot of space and very clean ! The location is very central !! Bus 3 min walk - groceries and errands near by made everything very easy if you have  no care !! Definitely a place I would rent again !! Aiste was great ! Very professional, kind and fast to help out !
I had the basement to myself for my entire visit! Gerardo always responded quickly to any questions or concerns I had. Loved the space!

I spent close to a month at Guru Nischan’s and felt right at home from day one. Both her and her housemate, Jośe, were very genial, generous and welcoming. The room was neat and cozy and I had access to a well stocked kitchen with everything I needed. Ultimately, I felt it was worth the price and I loved the warm atmosphere at the house. I look forward to staying with them again soon!
Loved staying at Morgan's!
Awesome,

The overall place was nice it was a nice location and the street parking was easy to get a spot. The only thing is that they do clean the street and you have to move your car which might be a bit inconvenient. The room was spacious and looked like the picture. The negative thing about this place was the cleanliness. When we checked in my friend wanted to use the bathroom but there was hair all over the toilet sit which was nasty.  Although they did come up later to clean the restroom we already had that one bad experience. Nevertheless overall the location was good, parking was free, and there was no disturbance at night.

Unfortunately, I was unable to stay at Lucas property due to numerous issues. The ceiling beams forced me to duck, and they were covered in spider webs and dust. The sink was filthy, and the bedsheets were clearly used and disgusting, with numerous spots on them. The headboard of the bed was broken. The smell of the entire place was musty and very unpleasant.
This was truly one of the worst experiences I've had while booking through Airbnb, and I believe it’s important for you to address these issues.
I strongly suggest using this opportunity to clean up the space, fix the bed, and ensure that the sheets are changed properly. I would prefer not to leave a negative review, but I cannot overlook how unacceptable my stay was.

Great location, close to everything! Short walk to lake, Aldi, and Jewel. Host was super nice and responsive, fixing our TV issue quickly.
Laundry and garbage facilities were easy to use. Parking was a breeze, with a nearby garage just a 2-minute walk away.
Inside, it was quiet, with a firm bed and big comfy couch. Full kitchen had everything we needed.
Felt safe and comfortable, would definitely book again!
Roberto is a very nice person and respond very fast as the host. The apartment is clean and sweet. The community is quiet and safe. Highly recommended.

Host said I could park across the street; signage said parking was only for church (this AirBnB wasn't a church). Host said to call to get in, had to wait 20 minutes for her plane to land. Most importantly, I WAS PUT IN THE WRONG ROOM, with no washer/dryer (in listed amenities) and no counter space (in pictures). Asked where washer/dryer was, host pretended it was there, then said it would be installed one day, but they just drilled holes (and accidentally trapped me in the bathroom!!! glad I had my phone or I would've had to break down the door), wasn't installed until a week later, had to pay for coin laundry (never reimbursed). Left early because found permanent housing, host tried to scam me one last time by getting me to shorten my reservation (would've needed to pay more). Never any apology. Tried to frame the wrong-room-missing-amenities disaster as an "upgrade"!!! The only good part was she was absentee and left me alone. All documented and shared with AirBnB. Room wasn't bad.

I had a really enjoyable and comfortable stay, the room was super clean and the host Jorge very friendly and helpful with my questions.
The area is perfect if you want to be close to the city, but in a bit more calm and safe area.
Great location!
they don't refund security deposite
Location and room were nice just hotel fees a little more than expected
Die Unterkunft war in Ordnung, sehr gute Lage. Die Betten sind etwas sehr weich.
John’s space felt like home! Easy check in, super communicative host, and generally a smooth experience. I would stay again

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!
UNIT: The unit itself is modern, spacious & clean. It was evident right away that the host takes great care in thinking thru what items one would need for an extended stay. The unit has a very spacious main bedroom, large bathrooms, great closet space, and an in-unit washer/dryer. The Wi-Fi was stable throughout our entire stay.
LOCATION: This building is close to EVERYTHING! You name it, and it’s not a very far walk. Access to main streets is quick & easy. The beautiful Lake Shore East Park quickly became a favorite of ours! Parking is plentiful, and the front desk personnel are extremely helpful & friendly (Thanks Mike!)
VIEWS: Absolutely stunning views from this 47th floor corner unit that primarily provides northern & eastern views. Both day & night views are spectacular as your eyes take in the sunrise during the day, and the sparkle of the city at night.
HOST: Very communicative & responsive throughout the entire booking process and during our stay.

Todo estuvo de maravilla, la atención fue excelente y todo marchó con normalidad, mis amigos y yo estuvimos un mes explorando la ciudad de Chicago y disfrutamos mucho, al apartamento solo le falta un poco más de ventilación pero nada que no se pueda resolver, había todo lo necesario en el apartamento, la zona es un poco insegura pero nunca tuvimos problemas con nadie

Traveling for work, but I needed somewhere affordable, clean, and safe. Victor's space was exactly that. I have absolutely no complaints. I kept to myself was in late and out early and honestly hated leaving my room. Not just cause I was tired but the room was just so comfy and clean. I felt very at home, only saw one other renter. Also the bathroom was beautiful, water got perfectly hot, it was super clean and the vanity was nice and bright. I was provided a towel, and my own key for my room so I felt safe locking my things inside. Checking in was easy, same checking out. If I ever come back to the area I'd def book this space even in place of a hotel. The energy in this space also felt very comfortable and welcoming, was very blessed to find this listing when I did. I wish them all the best !
This is the best and most affordable place in Chicago. You won’t get a better deal in Airbnb. Sharing the bathroom is not a big deal when everything is clean and works properly.

I stayed here for a month and had a great experience, the room was very clean and smelled great, the sunlight was great, Mary was a great landlord, she responded to messages very quickly and always helped me a lot, it was my first time in Chicago and I was really happy to have met such a landlord, and the roommates were very friendly, highly recommend it to everyone, the location of the room was also very good and safe!
Very good experience.

When I mentioned stains to Andrea, she insisted it was clean - only after I sent a picture, she offered to replace it. Cookware was greasy and most unusable because it was wobbly. I ran all plates/cups in dishwasher first because it wasn't clean. Bathroom was not clean either - one of the drawers had a literal pile of nail clippings. There were no instructions about the unit or building. Water pressure in shower was AWFUL, even after I asked Andrea about it. Also, Andrea advertised the unit with a parking spot for $150/mo but once the cancellation deadline passed, she "clarified" it wasn't available. I had to rework my trip because the only other option would have cost me $550. It's clear this is VERY passive income for her.

Very pleasant stay! , property is right next to the Blue line so was easily able to get to downtown. Nice place, felt really comfortable and at home. Host was very responsive and always checked in on us. Great stay overall, would highly recommend.

We really enjoyed our stay in this condo for a month. The views from this apartment are spectacular, and the layout of the unit works well.
The location is perfect for enjoying Michigan Ave, River North and walks to Lake Michigan. Both the staff and the people who live in the building are friendly. The outdoor plaza space in the building is great for city views and relaxing as well. Chicago is a great city and we hope to be back for another month next year.
We definitely recommend this unit.
I had an awesome time staying with Suzanne this summer and would highly recommend anyone looking to spend an extended time in Chicago to stay here
Great place for a stay!
Great Host! Very responsive and have a great apartment

I stayed here for nine months while I was in Chicago for work. Jason was a great host, and always responsive if I ever needed anything.
Apartment: The apartment itself is in a good location, right on the cusp of West Loop, with a bus stop out front and easy access to a couple train lines. I'd stay here again if I'm in back in Chicago and would recommend it to anyone looking for a convenient, comfy place for a long weekend or extended months-long stay. The king bed was very comfy, as was the large sectional couch. The small patio that overlooks Union Park has two chairs and is a nice place for the morning coffee (and there's a Dunkin' attached to the building). Street parking is also easy next to Skinner Park.
Local recs: Highly recommend Froth / Bunker for a great coffee shop and patio bar just around the corner). There's a West Loop Market about 10 minutes away for groceries. About a 25-minute walk or short drive over to Fulton Market, which has lots of good food and bars.
Decent stay. Hosts were very responsive. Expected to be in a better area based on the definition.

You can’t get much closer to Wrigley and the surrounding neighborhood than this. It has a great location and was perfect for our stay. Everything was walkable and easy to get to. The snack basket inside was especially a nice touch for my pregnant wife haha she loved that. Would love to stay here again!
Great place to stay in downtown

Our experience here was great, Matt was very responsive during our stay and gave us clear instructions on arrival and checkout. The place was comfy, clean and the surrounding area was calm and very walkable. We walked to get breakfast, then to the zoo and it didn’t even feel like a workout. Definitely will be staying here again when visiting Chicago. 10/10
Thanks Matt!
Great stay, and very proactive and responsive host.

This was a wonderful Airbnb,
Super spacious and Beautiful! looked just like the photos.

I was only in town for a couple days but i wish it had been longer!

Location-wise, it couldn’t have been better! It was within walking distance to local shops and restaurants, and the lake. I enjoyed exploring the neighborhood and appreciated Sena's recommendations for hidden gems.
Overall, I had an amazing experience and highly recommend staying at Sena's place. I would definitely return on my next visit!

The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was super responsive and helpful with any questions. The location is perfect, close to all the main attractions, yet in a quiet area. Highly recommend and would stay again.

Overall not a bad stay! The area was not as nice as I expected. There was a train station nearby which was very convenient but we did not feel overly safe walking there. Definitely wouldn’t at night.

Max was very attentive to our needs and quick to respond. The cleaning ladies forgot to restock the toilet paper but when we messaged him he delivered some right away. Even brought some bandaids when my friend broke her nail. Overall a good stay. But wouldn’t want to stay for longer than we did.

myrtle was very nice and very thankful she let me stay in her comfortable home, however just wish i was aware of another guest staying before i came to check in and wasn’t made aware til i was at location.

I enjoyed my one night stay in Chicago with my teenage sisters! The room was just as described, spotless bathroom, and comfortable beds. The hotel does have Valet for $75, which I should’ve used instead of self parking, because the fees ended up being more. I’ll definitely stay here again if I am looking for a great deal on a budget!

Eric's place was very well decorated, clean and even nicer than the photos. There was a mall with some restaurants, shops and a Whole Foods five-minute drive away, which was a plus. We could tell that the house was well taken care of and we enjoyed our stay!
Part made everything super easy and clear with both check in and check out super nice and I would highly recommend!

My recent stay at Doug’s house was nothing short of amazing! From the moment we arrived, Doug was incredibly accommodating, allowing us a late check-out, which was a lifesaver. The house was spotless, comfortable, and had everything we needed to feel at home. The location is perfect for exploring Chicago — just minutes away from all the major attractions, yet in a quiet and peaceful neighborhood. Doug went above and beyond to make sure our stay was enjoyable, and we really appreciated all the thoughtful touches. Definitely one of the best Airbnb experiences we've had, and we’ll be back for sure! Highly recommend!
Enjoyed my stay at this unit. Alexandre was very responsive and helpful and gave local suggestions.
The check-in was very easy and after check out i could leave my luggage as long as I wanted.

Hotel was nice. Staff was helpful. Good location. Parking was expensive. And “roompicks” advertised one price but I ended up paying nearly double in fees at this hotel. And it was NOT clearly advertised in the description of the stay. Overall pretty disappointing.

The spot was soo beautiful and very clean

Akiko herself is an exceptional host and a good human being . She is very helpful and tookcare of everything during our stay . It was pleasant staying at her place
Comfy and clean place! Nicole provided everything needed for a home away from home. Bed and pillows perfect for a good nights rest. Excellent location. And I hope to be back and stay in the future!

My guest and I enjoyed our stay. Perfect location in between O’Hare and downtown. Easy to access public transit that gets you where you need to go. Very walkable, felt mostly safe to go in and out as we pleased. Would stay here again.
Brian was very attentive and responded quickly with any questions we had. We had a great stay.

Daniel was a very welcoming and accommodative host. He was quick to respond and went above the standard to help. I highly recommend booking with him and hope to visit again soon.
The property felt homey and had everything you could need for a comfortable stay. The space felt lived in and smelled amazing.

Overall we had an amazing time in Chicago and Daniel’s listing played a key role in our experience.

I booked this place for my parents for 3 months for their visit, and it's such a fantastic experience. Everything was perfect. If my parents come back to visit us, I will definitely book the same location for them!

This Airbnb served its purpose as a place to stay during our work conference. The location was convenient for our needs. It was adequate for a short business trip.

exactly as described, the location is super close to downtown but there's little to no traffic and the neighborhood is very quiet and walkable

This is a great spot to hunker down and explore Chicago. Great value, clean, quiet, comfortable.

I had a great time staying at the Airbnb provided to me by Cloud9. The instructions to check into the unit were very clear and they were very quick to respond to any questions I needed answered during my visit.

Exactly where you want to stay when you are out of town and don’t need over the top amenities. Room was very clean and comfortable. Linens were very soft, bed was very comfortable. can Missouri responsive in the place worked perfectly for a brief trip for trade show in the city

I had a really nice stay with Jordan and his familly. They were all very welcoming. The house is close to grocery stores and restaurants, and a short 15 minutes walk from University of Chicago.

Great place, very spacious, just as described. Stairs are a bit of a hassle if your travelling with heavy bags and are the stairs are a bit noisy when stepping, but nothing to worry about, the place is awesome, would defo come back.
Best host on earth

Great place to stay and close to public transit.
Marrianne's place was just as advertised.  The host was very polite and helpful. I would recommend staying here.
Carla and Ronaldo were very friendly and accommodating. I loved the ground floor location and the interesting and walkable neighborhood. I enjoyed my stay.
Great place with an exceptional host could not recommend more
This place was perfect for our group’s business meeting and for staying.  Very clean! The space was huge and spacious! Perfect location in Chicago!

Lovely spacious apartment.
Quiet building. Great neighborhood. Responsive friendly host. Reasonable price. Would stay here again without hesitation.

Cozy and clean area within driving distance of all things Chicago!  Bed was super comfy and the whole place was clean and well maintained.  Cicero Ave is always busy, so I don’t recommend if you need quiet to sleep!  Also, there are 2 flights of stairs with tight turns, so not exactly luggage friendly, but overall it was a good stay and we would do it again!
Great Host !!!!

Great place to stay right on the green line that will take you downtown easy peasy. Some really good restaurants nearby. Host was a great communicator via the app with appreciated detailed instructions and reminders.

This is my second say at this address. First was a private room and this time was the entire apartment. The location is very convenient for travel on the Green Line L train. Allowed parking is close by, about a half block. I would stay again if it is available on my next trip.
This place was phenomenal. Felt right at home. The place was super clean and comfortable. Amazing location on a quiet street near the park. Would highly recommend.

Disappointed with the room it was nothing like in the pictures I was expecting a room on the higher floors and a nice view and was put in the 8th floor with a view of air vents and the roof of the place next door and the room was way smaller than what the pictures showed, and when I asked front desk if they could move me they said they couldn’t do anything about it, but other than that it was a nice place friendly staff other than the valet that didn’t want to approach me up to my truck, so I had to find a whole other hotel that would park it for me. Overall disappointed it really didn’t feel like it was worth what I paid.
The place was clean and very nice!  Enjoyed our stay!
I can’t say enough about how beautiful the place was, how nice the area was, how wonderful the staff was from booking to check out!  We loved everything about this host and property!!!!

Everything went smoothly for our stay. The apartment is cute and spacious. The bedroom has a white noise machine, which is a nice touch because it is on a busy street. The kitchen is set up for basic cooking. The only thing we really wished it had was a mixing bowl, but there were utensils, frying pans, baking sheet, basic condiments, etc. However most other basics were available.

Had a great time. Tom and Megan were extremely responsive and helpful with any issues that may have come up!
A great mix of in the mix and private enough to get away as well. 10/10

The "Garden Apartment in Historic Hyde Park Mansion" is absolutely perfect! My sister and I needed to find a place in Hyde Park rather last minute. We had reached out to a different AirBnB host with a request and had not heard back from her. It was crunch time so fewer than 8 hours before our flights to Chicago, we saw Darryl's listing. I'm not sure how we both had missed it when initially looking. We're both so thrilled that my sister didn't miss it that last time!
The flat is very clean, quite spacious and exactly as described. Check in is super easy, and Darryl is an excellent, prompt and thoughtful host; his communication is outstanding.
It is in a perfect location to explore Hyde Park on foot; you can easily walk to the UofC, the lake, restaurants, shops, museums, grocery stores, etc.
I have stayed at many AirBnB properties around the world and Darryl's "Garden Apartment in Historic Hyde Park Mansion" is easily one of the best.
Thank You Darryl for a terrific stay & space!

Could tell from photos ceiling was low, but was not prepared for how low. I could not stand up in rooms. While rules emphasized no smoking and potential fine, upstairs residents apparently smoke like chimneys. After scent of air fresheners wore off, it was obvious that there was active smoking going on in upstairs unit. Saw upstairs residents smoking on back porch on weekend.

Thank you for the stay! I will be back if I'm ever in Chicago.
Everything was exactly as the listing described.

I had a great time at Vachetta's place. The place is easily accessible, safe and clean. The host was reached easily. She came to the room to assist with the TV.  Kitchen is fully equipped, I will be back for sure ... Thanks for the hospitality!

We had a great stay at Marek's place. We had the opportunity to meet Marek and his family and they were very nice. The place was as described. We didn't spend a lot of time there because we had activities planned downtown but when we were there, it was very comfortable. The location was a close enough drive to downtown and we didn't have any issues commuting back and forth. The neighborhood seemed quiet and safe. Plenty of parking if you were to rent a car, as we did. Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would stay again.

It was our first experience with Air BnB, our concerns were logistics of entering the property,  parking. and safety. which all turned out to be no issue. The property was exactly as pictured.  It fulfilled all our needs.  More importantly,  Kaila was very responsive to messages and professional when explaining the process. My husband and I  were very impressed. We will definitely book with Kaila in the future.

Great location! Hyde Park is such a great neighborhood. Stayed for 3 months & it felt like home. Couch was super comfy, and the apartment was spacious. Very walkable location. If you’re taking public transit, the bus stop was literally right outside.
I would give 5 stars but we had water leaks in the apartment 4 different times. It wasnt negligence from the hosts or anything, but was due to someone else in the building. It was def annoying, but thankfully none of our personal stuff got ruined and Gabriel & Diana were extremely communicative and quick to respond each time! Diana even came by to help clean up (:
Would definitely stay here again- even after all the water issues!!!
Perfect for one person. The ceilings are low so tall people may have difficulty moving around. I plan to stay again when I return to Chicago to see family

The unit had plenty of storage space. I was able to unpack and hang all my outfits and put the folded laundry in drawers or shelves. Same goes for the bathroom. It had plenty of drawers and cabinet space as well. The shower has a nice handheld shower head that can be adjusted to any height. The shower door was nice and tall.
I don't mind this location but I think I prefer the location at One Superior Place over this one.

Jermaill was a great host - waited for me when checking in and helped me with his local knowledge on where to go and what to see. He was extremely kind and helpful. Even though I rented just a room + bath, it felt like I had the entire apartment, as we haven't met after check-in. The apartment was well-equipped with a huge kitchen and a nice living room, and I think was a very good value overall. The neighborhood was quiet, I liked it. I can certainly recommend Jermaill's place.

We had a nice corner apt. But  bathroom and kitchen is only supplied for over nite stays not 4 days.  Requested more to bath towels but never showed……. Very good location and friendly staff and patrons  building was secure and very clean would gladly stay again
Had a great stay!  Host was very helpful.  Would recommend and stay again!
Se encontraba limpio y estaba muy bien ubicado, no hubo ningún problema.

Amber's place is wonderful, nice and clean  with good decor, a gorgeous backyard and rooftop and close to whatever you'd want/need. She is also very helpful and responsive to any questions you have.  I would definitely rent from her again.
Had a great time at the Chicago Oasis. Def will use them again.

The area is nice and conveniently located near public transit lines. I've lived in older homes before, so I understand how difficult it is to keep them clean. That being said, the room I was staying in looked as if it had not been vacuumed in quite some time, with visible debris on the carpet. The shared amenities (living/dining space and bathroom) were in better shape, though as an older house without proper ventilation, there was visible mold on the bathroom walls.
Great host

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The location was great, a short walk to the train or bus providing easy access to the City. Nat was also great in making sure we had everything we needed and ensure we enjoyed our stay. Do note unit #2 is directly above a cocktail lounge/bar so music into the evening is noticeable but not too loud or obnoxious (great bar too, must check it out when visiting). 10/10 would recommend.
We loved staying here. The space was great and clean. Would 10/10 recommend anyone staying here.
Devon’s place had a great location near the EL and Evanston. It was clean and secure. I would definitely stay there again.
This place is in a safe quiet area. Very clean and spacious for our need. And the host was great! I would love to stay there every-time I come to Chicago.

She was great, really responsive. Her house was set up just like my house in Ohio (except hers was much bigger lol). We really enjoyed our stay. We had an issue with a local residents car blocking us in the driveway and she quickly gave us the information to have them removed. We loved her garden it was beautiful in the front, the yard was very pristine and the inside of the house was nicely decorated. You really felt like you were home there.
Thanks!! Everything was great

Dean’s spot is an amazing long weekend spot in River North. Great walking to great views of downtown but close to fabulous neighborhoods that are just a short trip on the L. Would stay in this property a million times over, cozy, great vibe.

This house is so much more interesting than most the bnbs out there- way more fun
Lovely stay- parking was easy- I would recommend it to anyone who likes old houses - built in the 19th century - you can’t beat that!
Washer and dryer a terrific plus-

Overall the space was fine. We had a few inconveniences/issues.
1. The address listed on Airbnb was incorrect. We had guests order things for delivery which we did end up getting but they had to be retrieved by the host.
2. The host seems to have a team that works with them. The communication was inconsistent between them at times but they were very responsive. They require you to download a seperate app to communicate. They wouldn't allow communications through text or Airbnb.
3. The check-in process was a bit odd. It was a code to get into the space but the host needed to meet everyone when they got in and wouldn't allow us into the space until we met with him.
4. The biggest issue we had was the beds were listed incorrectly. There was one less bed than listed. We specifically booked this space so all guests could have their own bed. Their solution was to either find a new place to stay and get a refund (not realistic with 13 guests) or sleep on the couch. No discount offered.

Sidd was the best host! He always answered all my questions and every day he used to asked me if everything was fine or if I needed anything. He and his mom are so kind, if I come back to Chicago, i would not doubt to stay there again!
The appartment is pretty near to the Walmart, like 5 minutes walking. And it is near to the Blue Line Train Station and Bus Stops. Thanks for everything, Sidd!
It was a good stay as advertised!

I  enjoyed my stay

I stayed at Bilels for 3 nights and he was amazing and super responsive and made sure I had everything I needed. If I come back again with myself or another person I would gladly stay at Bilels again!

I let Carla know about the noise; she apologized and I felt that my concern was taken seriously. It got a bit better the following night (though I didn't get home until late, so also hard to tell.) It was back to being noisy again the next night. The apartment itself is really cute. The noise just made me feel like the value wasn't worth it, and I wouldn't stay here again.

This place was great! The apartment we had was on the second floor, so there are steps to climb. The place was bright with a wall of windows facing Wrigley Field. The kitchen has high-end appliances; even though we decided to eat out since we were only there for the weekend. The bedrooms and bathrooms where very clean and having 2 bathrooms was a plus since there was 9 of us. The pool table was a nice touch, we managed to play a game or two while waiting for everyone to get ready. The location of the apartment was wonderful, everything you need is withing walking distance.

I would definitely recommend staying here.
I recommend this place . They do a great job to prepare the place for you to feel like a 5 ⭐️ hotel . Walking distance to restaurants and stores .
We had a great stay! We especially loved the extra amenities provided

Great access to the lakefront, if you are a runner or walker the lakefront trail is just steps away. Kitchen was great equipped with all I needed to make meals on a three day stay.  Hyde park close by…

I had a good stay. Charlie has been responsive through messages and took great care of me!

The apartment itself was functional, clean and in good condition, however it felt slightly lacking in personality - no one seems to live there on a permanent basis so that probably explains it.

Mimi was an amazing host who was very responsive when messages were sent over to her. The place was beautiful and close to downtown. I would definitely recommend Mimi and her home for anybody going to Chicago that would love to stay close to downtown, but not in downtown.
We stayed for about a month and loved it! Great location, amazing amenities, and the view is incredible. Highly recommend!

Our stay at Olívia's house was great. The place matched the listing, the neighborhood is quiet, with nearby grocery stores and restaurants. Property is clean and has the amenities listed as described, and the couches were so cozy after a long day. Neighborhood is calm and not on a busy street. Jennifer is an excellent communicator too, and the way the apartment was set up, it was very very private.
The home was beautiful and in a quiet neighborhood. The drive to get to downtown or around the city got that master was easy. Great location to be if you want to get to any of the sporting events!!!
This location is fantastic for dining, shopping, and just a great location for a Chicago trip!
Completely satisfied and would return if we come head back to the area. Great location, everything one could need is within walking distance.
Great spot! Spacious, walkable to every thing! Clean and cozy. Here for a wedding with a family of four and a nice stay. Parking on street only
Place was exactly as described. Safe, easy to access and incredibly close to hundreds of bars and restaurants in Wicker Park. We had a great trip and would definitely stay here again!
Great customer service ! Always was on the roll with responding. Any questions and concerns he was right there. I appreciate him for showing us to stay during that short time.
Incredible area and super close to so many things. The house has a ton of space and is great!!

The space was clean and beautiful. The area itself was quiet. The host provided lots of recommendations of local restaurants and activities in the area. We enjoyed our stay very much and would stay here again.
Great stay!! Host is Amazing

Destine’s place was amazing. The location was great and neighbors were nice. The location was close to everything. The house was bigger than I expected and very spacious . And THAT MIRROR in the living room was perfect I love it. I would highly recommend this home to anyone. Destine was very responsive and very accommodating and understanding. I would stay again the next time I’m in Chicago . 10/10 highly recommend👌🏾
Samantha’s home was very clean & she responded very quickly definitely would stay again

Tera’s space was great. It was very clean, pretty quiet and felt safe.
Check-in was super easy, zero issues.
The kitchen is a good size and well equipped if you want to cook or prepare food, and the main rooms are comfortable and spacious for relaxing after being out and about for a day. It’s a short walk to all the action around Logan Square, and transit, and there is a great bakery (get there early) and a great coffee shop just 1 1/2 blocks away.
I would definitely stay there again.

This is a great stay for a guys weekend, not comfortable for more than a day or two. The ceiling is VERY LOW with overhead ductwork throughout that creates a hazard for anyone over 5’10”. The kitchen is well stocked with dishes but there were no basics like sugar, salt & pepper. The bed and pullout couch are extremely firm, much like those in the 2024 Summer Olympic Village. The separate work/office area was a little desk in an awkward shaped storage room co-located with cleaning supplies. The best thing this place has going for it is the location…steps from Wrigley Field in one direction and the lively Southport Corridor in the other.

Great place to stay - expensive for the space but makes sense for the location. Very clean, excellent location - had a great bachelor party weekend.
Host reached out requesting a security deposit but was quick to accept "no" as an answer when I noted that Airbnb TOS does not allow their hosts to charge a security deposit.
We had a wonderful peaceful time. Thank you for being flexible with the check out. Would definitely recommend

Incredible stay. Highly recommend this studio and all of Andrew + team’s properties. Andrew was the perfect host - always responsive, thorough, and helpful. He was quick to answer any questions or provide what was needed and often went above my expectations.
The studio is new - very clean. The furnishings were immaculate- from great interior design to high-end high-quality bedding and linens (a very nice touch and made me feel at home)! The studio is just as you see in the photos… It’s a small space, but it does the trick. The bathroom is huge, with a phenomenal shower and even complete with wonderful bathrobes. 12/10 if I could give it… thank you Andrew, and team!
Amazing location and perfect for a weekend trip to the city!
was close to our event,  great parking. safe, nice amenities and host very responsive.

Loved staying at Yashar’s place while visiting Chicago. The place was exactly as described, spotless, and a 10 min walk to the train which I used a lot during my stay.  Yashar was very responsive and even flexible with allowing my friend and I to check in early! Thank you Yashar!
David was a great host and the place was nice.
Todd and Susan were great host. Responsive to questions and met us when checking in. Neighborhood was nice and super close to Wrigley Field and many restaurants/bars. Would stay here again.
This house is conveniently located, well kept, and definitely a worthwhile stay!

Really great area. Good gym. Rooftop access. Communicative host. Unbelievable city view!
Hotel hidden fees were very disappointing. They were detailed in the Airbnb description, but I missed it.

Also the walls feel petty thin. Would not recommend for light sleepers.

Amazing little room with everything you need :) location is great and neighborhood is so calm and family oriented.
Ronaldo and Carlas place is like an art gallery, we enjoyed that. They are very friendly, thoughtful and have great food recommendations:)

Visiting for Cubbies and Yankees. About 30 min walk to Wrigleyfield and 15 min walk to train to downtown. Home and neighborhood was very enjoyable!!😀
Highly recommend!!
a repeat stay... Always a joy to stay with Caryl and Fabrice at the Univ. of Chicago!
Was in town to visit my sister and for Yankees / Cubs series. Rhett’s place was great!  Fantastic location, very walkable and close to good bars / restaurants!  Would stay here again.
I absolutely loved this place.  I was in town for a funeral and I didn’t have to worry about anything involving my AirBnb.  It was so easy and a beautiful place to stay.  Thank you Thomas and Angie!

Patty was an awesome host and this apartment was perfect for our Chicago cubs game visit. Very clean and we felt right at home is this great Neighborhood with plenty of street parking.
If you’re looking to go to the Riverwalk it’s an easy drive or Uber. Our stay was awesome and the accommodations were top notch! Patty and her Husband were very responsive and gave us great recommendations for the area .
Thanks again Patty

Great place to stay for larger groups. House is even better in person. Good location and backyard space. No complaints, very happy with our stay!
The stay was great!

Great stay for my family of 5. Extremely clean and spacious accommodations. Thank you!

The bed mattress was caved in almost like it’s overly used and you can feel the wood underneath it. Overall we were looking for a cheap way to spend our anniversary trip and it did the job. Thank you for hosting us Akiko!

Great location in the heart of Mag Mile, lots of good restaurants near by, and super close to CTA and various buses. Room and bathroom was spacious, and access to the roof deck to relax was nice. Excellent place to stay for a short 3 day trip to Chicago.

We had a wonderful month staying in Clark, one of the most beautiful apartments we've ever experienced. Special thanks to Lilian for being such a gracious host. We thoroughly enjoyed our time here and will definitely be back.

My fiancé and I stayed with our 2 cats for about 7 months. We had a wonderful stay and felt right at home. The space was comfortable, clean, and had everything we needed for a long term stay. Matthew was a great host, always being responsive with any questions we had and always helped with anything we needed. I would recommend this space for a nice long term stay.
Excellent host...excellent properties....excellent neighborhood...excellent location!  You'll have an overall great time here :-)
Amazing location and very quiet!  would definitely stay here again!

Kati’s place is bright and open as her pictures show.  The location is convenient to public transportation, restaurants, grocery stores, and coffee houses.  I recommend this place to all.  The host was easy to communicate with.
Great location and great neighborhood. Host was very responsive.

GuruNischan's place was a perfect cozy stay for my trip to Chicago. Her space makes you feel right at home with a welcoming environment.
Would definitely recommend to anyone that want the feel of a local Chicagoan in a accessible neighborhood to eateries and public transportation.

Overall a great stay and host. We will certainly look to use the space again in our returns to Chicago.
Had a great stay! Quiet location, but near all the action!

Location is fantastic and probably one of the better options for the prices in the area.

Great place and host, most definitely will be rebooking!!
