Fantastic location, great host.
Fantastic place given the price point! Lots of things to do in the area
Bilel was such an accommodating and generous host. The room was clean, convenient, and close to public transportation. I recommend booking his place if you’re looking for a place to say in Chicago.

The hotel and rooms are as described. Overall a nice stay. We booked a king room but were given a double queen. We did get early check in , daily room cleaning, and easy check in and out. Overall, would recommend.
This is a beautiful home on historic Logan Blvd, with tons of walkable restaurants! We had a great time having this as our home base as we explored Chicago. Hope to come back soon!

The place was perfect for a solo stay. Has everything you need and easy to get around the rest of the city or suburbs. Very close to the lake and the el. Parking was also super easy. Niah and Ken were super responsive and helpful for anything I needed.
This is my 5th or 6th stay with Ms Myrtle. Convenient for me to visit family. Cozy and comfortable stay. Ms Myrtle and her family are wonderful and loving people that care about others.
Great
My partner and I stayed here for a month, and it was an excellent experience. We’ll definitely book again if we return to the area.
Very responsible and communicative host. The Airbnb was beautiful and very inviting. It felt like a home away from home.
Great place. Kind of a hidden gem for the price and what we got. Neighborhood isn’t the best but don’t let that stop you
O's place was perfect for us ... really spacious, comfortable, 3 minutes walk from the L, loads of great restaurants and bars nearby. If you want to sample Chicago loft living, check out O's!

Very clean bathrooms. The furniture in the room had some hair & suspectful stains. The artwork & decor in the home was amazing the where it feels warm & welcoming. An upscale boarding house or hostel is what my stay reminded me of.
Josh is a super friendly, helpful host who keeps his guest spaces immaculately clean and free of clutter. If you need a place for a few nights to just sleep and shower, it's a great value.

We were getting pretty tired on our last day and still had one more attraction to view so i had asked for an extra day. Kaila didn’t have her notifications on at the time and i didn’t get an answer until i texted her again the next morning. She was very kind and apologetic about the whole thing since she usually responded in good time and we got an extension on our stay. Very cooperative. We enjoyed our time at Kaila’s.
Great weekend!

The house was nice. Just two of the rooms have AC. The others felt really hot, we couldn’t slept there. The living room and kitchen felt really hot too. The Ac big problem. Other than that, the place was nice

Nikkole is an incredible host! She went above and beyond to provide a great and personalized experience for us, including stocking us up with snacks and drinks before we even got there. She was always very responsive and proactively offered recommendations for things to do in the area and places to eat, one of which ended up being one of my favorites from the whole trip!
My main feedback for booking this particular location is to be willing to compromise on quality of the actual residence. It is functional, provides a roof over your head to sleep/shower but it needs a lot of work in my opinion. Seems to be an old building with well used furniture, and is not for anyone that wants a conventionally nice place to stay. There’s a lot of cracks/holes/spots on the walls so it may not appear to be pristinely clean.
That being said, Nikkole really is great overall and wonderful in addressing the immediate fixable concerns so still a 5 star stay to me, especially if location is priority.
숙소는 깔끔하고 좋았다. 위치가 아쉽긴 하나 동행인이 있다면 다운타운에서 이곳으로 좋은 가격에 접근할 수 있을 것이다.
Great and respectful host
This house was a cozy place to stay at and felt like home. It was nice and private and Gracjan had amazing communication for any questions I had.

The location is great in Ukrainian Village.  Street parking was fine.  Very safe neighborhood and friendly people.  The bed was a little uncomfortable for us.  Bathroom was super nice, but could use some additional space for toiletries.  The clothes dryer was difficult to use and needs to be repaired.  Jason was very prompt in responding to our questions.  Some of the blinds didn't fully close & need to be repaired.  The flat is in an older builing, so the wooden floors squeak and it's easy to hear the neighbors and people outside.  But, this did not disturb me or my sleep.  Overall, it was a great stay, a nice location and very comfortable.
Great place

close to public transportation, restaurants, bars and pharmacy. nice big space for relaxing after a day of exploring. beds are on the smaller side and if you’re tall the upstairs bedroom ceilings may be a bit low but otherwise great!

The location is amazing! Extremely walkable to the lake & the river. So many places to eat & shop nearby. This room is a Superior king room, which isn’t noted in the listing, so look it up on their website; where you may even get a better rate and choose the type of room you’d prefer. It is quite small @337sq ft, even for just 2 people, but a nice room nonetheless. There is no dresser, just a closet with 2 smaller drawers, which worked ok for us. Full size lighted mirror, a shower & soaking tub (!!!) The pillows were all down feather or like.They did have water stations on 3 of the floors to fill your bottles, a great feature. The rooftop bar had delicious tapas and craft cocktails and a beautiful view of the city and lake. Paid $386 a night at the end of August & Labor Day wknd. The staff were extremely friendly. Overall, we enjoyed our stay very much! Would def stay again, but would book through Viceroy directly and get a lake view room that is larger.

Honestly, I don’t have any real complaints about this place. Everything was pretty spot on. The cleanliness of the place, Roberto’s communication, everything.
Keep in mind, though, that the place IS 420 friendly, so if you don’t like smoke, then maybe this place isn’t for you.
But honestly, I really enjoyed my stay here and would TOTALLY come back again.
Thank you, Roberto!
Everything about the stay was great except for not being able to turn the AC on.
Good place

Fine stay just a couple times though we went to the front door of the house without realizing that the door to the apartment was in the back so we apologize for accidently disturbing the downstairs neighbors. Anais was very responsive though and she and her father were there to help us with anything we needed.
Nice space with lots of amenities.
Had some small hiccups but Rich was very responsive and helpful!

We loved our stay here!  The location is perfect. Very walkable and in a nice neighborhood. The home itself is beautiful and was extremely clean and comfortable. Nicholas was very responsive and a great host. We will definitely be looking to stay again next time we’re in Chicago! Couldn’t recommend more!
The stay was as expected and communicate clearly in the overview.  Very clear unit overall and excellent decor.
Great stay, nice neighborhood, very walkable, next door to weiner Circle, dog friendly stay and neighborhood. We’d definitely stay here again.
Enjoyed our time in Chicago!  Place was clean.

Overall the place was great. We got a better view than pictured in the listing but that couldn’t be the case for everyone. The “problems” we had was that the place was full of stains which I understand it might be clean despite that but still makes you feel some type of way. And they only provided a small amount of toilet paper/handtowels/bathing towels/ face towels for the amount of time we were staying. You can hear train and cars in the middle of the night so if you’re a light sleeper you might want to keep that in mind. All those problems are easily solved but just thought someone would like to know.

Overall good stay, I just was surprised by the area.
Host was responsive.
Room was clean.
Bathroom was shared with other guests but clean.
Multiple rooms with different guests.
The bed sheets were not how they looked in the photos and were two mismatched sheet sets so I felt a little bit strange about that. Uber driver told me that the area was sketchy.
TV was small and old and not a smart TV, I couldn’t turn it on with remote.

Shay was an excellent host! the apartment was well maintained, clean, and had everything i needed for my stay! i felt safe and comfortable my entire time there and shay always got back to me very quickly when i needed something and i can’t thank her enough! will definitely be returning to this air bnb when i come back to visit chi ! appreciate you shay!!!

Loved staying at Tera’s place for a long weekend in Chicago. Location was safe, private and walkable to some coffee shops and restaurants. Easy to park nearby as well! Couch and beds were super comfy. Would definitely go back.
Great location, comfty beds

Very nice, open studio apartment in a quiet, friendly neighborhood. One neighbor invited us to the block party that was happening during our visit. Walked to a great coffee shop nearby, Brew Brew. Lots of indoor light from the many windows, but they weren’t the type that you could open for fresh air. Entry through the breezeway was pretty dark, so a security light would be a great addition. The house was full of nice amenities, comfortable places to sit and relax, and a great kitchen.
Nice place to stay. Had everything we needed for our time here.

Our stay was wonderful thanks to our fantastic host, who was incredibly accommodating and respectful throughout our visit. They were always quick to respond to any questions, making our experience smooth and enjoyable. Highly recommend!

This suited our needs. We were just in town to visit family and sight see. So, we didn’t spend too much time at the Airbnb. It was in a really great location, close to downtown. The neighborhood was nice. The place is small, but again suited our needs. It was clean, the beds were comfy. My son is super tall and had trouble standing in the shower, but totally not the owner’s fault. Just the structure of the house. Street parking was available, we didn’t have trouble finding a space each night. Leah was nice and responsive.

Tonija’s place was exactly what we were looking for. It was clean, modern, full of amenities. Air Conditioning on point, access to the house was easy, beds were comfortable & the kitchen was beautiful. The entire house exceeded our expectations. Tonija as a host was accommodating and responsive.
10/10 would definitely stay here again! Thank you, Tonija!
nice place to stay

A friend and I traveled to Chicago for 72 hours and Phebes place was perfect for the two us. The place was spacious, clean and welcoming the moment you walked into the door. The layout with the living space dividing the two bedrooms is top tier for travelers who want to have individual & communal exspirences, lots of food options in walking distance and the neighborhood felt safe and quiet. Private parking in the back was key, 100% would stay again.
Decent place to stay, held 7 us with no issues.
We will cherish our time spent at the Roscoe Rose. It was an incredible place to host a family. We recommend staying with Brenda!

The location is amazing. You can walk to most places, but if not, you are right by the trains to go just about anywhere you want. The interior was very clean and looked exactly as portrayed in the photos. Aly was quick to respond to any questions we had without any confusion. Would definitely stay here again.
Great stay! Host very responsive and accommodated us well :)

Louis was very responsive and flexible with our requests! The apartments have more than enough room for our groups of 8. Right down the street from the blue line and easy to get to the airport! I highly recommend this place!
The place was quiet despite it being a shared space! Check in was easy & the place was cute and spotless. Would stay again!

Carl was very responsive with texts. Overall I enjoyed my stay and he was a good host. Just a few recommendations.
Pros:
1. bathroom shower had nice pressure and hot water
2. Mattress was double size and bed firm
3. Lots of availability for parking
4. Nice fresh towels, shampoo and conditioner
5. Quiet at night
Cons:
1. No a/c but able to open 1 window and put fan to blow air
2. 1 sheet for covers, no blanket
3 address hard to see on bldg
4. Big tool shelve in the kitchen and a door to the left of my room with more tools. Unsightly
5. Very small room. enough space for 1 double bunk bed, dresser and small night stand. The rest had just enough room to walk around.
6. Bit pricey for the 2 nights I stayed

It's comfortable and convenient place. The rooms are spacious and clean. Vachetta is very friendly and communicative.  One thing to note that I suggest to spend time to look at some of the details, such as how to lock the doors, how to check out.

We planned a cousins trip from Minneapolis to Chicago and we couldn’t have made a better choice. The location was in a quit neighborhood and the home was perfect for all of us. It was clean spacious and very private. Belinda is hands down one of the best host I’ve ever had. She was willing to accommodate to last minute changes and kindly communicated with us. She was always just a message away and they even came to help us when we needed it. She couldn’t have been any better and that was the best part about the trip. Being able to feel at home and also know your host is looking out for you and making sure you are comfortable. Great home, and great host!!!
Laura was extremely accommodating and we had a great stay. Definitely would come back!
I will recommend this place is amazing

This was a great stay with 7 people for the weekend. I really liked having a garage for parking and patio for hanging out in the evening. I felt safe here and the place was spacious, modern and comfy. The owner was responsive and easy to work with!

Having both apartments was great for our large group. They were very nice, clean, and well kept up. The location is optimal as there are restaurants, a target, and a Starbucks all a short distance away. I would highly recommend for large groups.
Great neighborhood to be based out of and the dog felt right at home!
Very comfortable stay and friendly host. Perfect location for us and Melissa provided everything we needed. Would stay here again!
Chris' place was beautiful and perfect for our group of 8 who thoroughly enjoyed the amenities and location.

Jackie’s place has everything you need and a roof deck with an amazing view of the city. The location is very walkable with amazing restaurants all over. Access to the blue line is a couple blocks away without the noise of the trains! 10/10 would boom again.
Our group had a great stay!

Had an awesome stay here with a few friends. Really cool and convenient location, with plenty to do nearby and a five minute walk from the train to downtown. Amber was responsive, helpful, and very accommodating. The place had plenty of space for the six of us, and there were no complaints about the pull-out couch in the living room. Highly recommend this location, and would absolutely stay here again on my next visit to Chicago.
Great stay for my group

Kelly's unit is exactly as advertised - a welcoming apartment right in the heart of the fantastic Logan Square neighborhood of Chicago. What really impressed me, though, was Kelly. I had a family medical emergency that I was dealing with during my stay, and not only could Kelly not have been more understanding about the whole thing, she truly went above and beyond. Her hospitality and generosity was beyond anything I could have expected. Kelly, if you're reading this, thanks again for making my stay so much less stressful than it could have been; you are a wonderful person.
Good stay not the best neighborhood
Really clean and spacious apartment. Beautiful balcony and kitchen. We had an issue with the stove and trying to get in. Samara was very helpful in both situations. Overall, really good stay/place.

The hosts were fabulous--so responsive and kind.  Renters should know that there is no living room or common space, just two bedrooms, a kitchen, and a bathroom (plus the great deck).  But those rooms are great.  We happened to have quite weak wifi during our stay, but that seems to have been an anomaly.   The location is great and parking wasn't a problem at all.

We had no issues with this property. Everything looked exactly like the pictures. Parking in the back was very convenient & no stressing about finding street parking. We were 30 min or less from everything we wanted to do. The water in the shower was strong & hot lol. I would definitely stay here again!!!

Place was ok, a bit expensive based on what you get relative to other listings but it was a late booking for me... It is not self check-in since you get the lock to the main door but host will personally give you the key to your bedroom. Other guests are staying in the same house, so might be noisy, might no be, depending on who's there. Carl seemed confused on who was supposed to be in what bedroom; I was waken up at 1:30am by Carl, asking me what my name was and if I was in the right bedroom because other guests came in at that time and apparently they were supposed to be in my room. I was in the right room and I'm not sure if he got confused or if he double booked the same room, though later on he knocked on another guest's door and did the same thing to them... I think he ended finding another room for the recently arrived guests to stay, but he while dealing was unprofessional and quite inconsiderate considering it was at 1:30am...
Host was responsive and flexible with check in time. Apartment was neat and did not encounter any issues.
Charming spot, felt right at home! The neighborhood is very walkable, and there’s easy access to public transit.
Great place, awesome location.  Next to everything Wrigley has to offer.

We are so happy to have stayed with Tracye for our first visit to Chicago. She was a communicative, kind, and overall wonderful host who gave us plenty of recommendations for our stay. The house and room were comfortable and private. Just a short walk from the train which we used the entire weekend. Thank you so much Tracye!

1. Even though my reservation said Building 5430, upon my arrival, the maintenance guy took me to the building next door 5436. I had to wait for him to give me a key to my bedroom and wait separately for the host to provide me with a new code for the building.
2. The host needs to communicate more clearly on the listing that I'd be sharing common spaces & bathrooms with Unknown no. of guests. Other than the main door to the building and the bedroom lock, everything else is open & can't be locked. So you can expect unknown people to roam around at all times.
3. The host expects you to send them $100 "security deposit" on the check-in day AFTER you've already paid for the Airbnb. They gave me a phone number saying it is associated with money transferring apps and told me to send the deposit or else my reservation would be canceled. So I Zelled the money and when I checked out and asked for the deposit back, the host mentioned that she never got the money.
4. Overall very confusing!

Jeffrey was an excellent host. His place is immaculate, which is a very spacious 4 bedroom apartment. The neighborhood is quite peaceful with beautiful homes. when we arrived, Jeffrey reached out to me to make sure we were settled in nicely.. I couldn't have asked for a better experience. Would definitely stay again.

Camillia and her husband were wonderful, thoughtful, and communicative hosts. They made sure we had everything that we needed from the moment that we arrived, and checked in with us regularly throughout our stay. Their home is absolutely beautiful, with lots of natural light, and a lovely back yard. We felt right at home and are so thankful for such a lovely stay so close to U Chicago!!

Eric’s home was very cute! Small and quaint, but had everything we needed. In a really nice neighborhood too. I really liked that it was on the back of the property and off the street. Would stay here again!
I spent my days exploring the city and only spent time here at night. Overall, it was quiet, easy to find, close to public transit, and near so much great food in Chinatown!

We came from Florida to Chicago for work. We stayed here for about 6 months and it was totally nice. We fell in love with the apartment. It has all the necessary utensils for the stay, kitchen, living room and bedroom fully furnished, we didn't need anything else. The area is very safe and in an excellent location. The building is quite quiet, there are bus stops and supermarkets very close, and it was also easy to get parking on a daily basis. I recommend this place without a doubt and the host Gabriel is very responsible, We had excellent communication and our experience was very satisfactory.

Excellent stay, one of the best apartments I have ever stayed in. Everything was clean and comfortable, the apartment is well equipped. Thank you Roberto for always being aware of my messages and answering my questions.
Excellent stay & excellent host - everything you need walkable.  Friendly neighbors and area.  I will definitely stay again. 🌟

The place was comfortable and spacious and what we were looking for in a long weekend getaway for two friends to meet up. We were able to check out some local and nearby businesses as well as uber to downtown relatively easily. The bottled water in the fridge was nice as well.
Thank you so much for a great stay. My family and I really felt welcome and at home.
Great location.  Spacious for large groups.  Not spotless but quite clean.  Needs a little updating and care but the price was right.
Amit’s place was perfect! Well located for our visit. Very nice accommodations and exceptionally clean.
Great location for the activities we attended.

We definitely made the right choice to stay here when visiting Chicago! The location was perfect—around a ten minute walk or less to public transportation, restaurants, and other amenities (you can even walk to the beach in around twenty minutes), but so quiet and peaceful in the neighborhood. It seemed like a very safe area too. This was also maybe the cleanest Airbnb I’ve ever stayed at—it was spotless! And it had everything we needed and more. Matt has thought of everything travelers could want. We were particularly grateful for the closet space to hang clothes and the washer/dryer (huge plus!). Hope to come back someday!

I had a great stay at Yashar’s place
We needed a place to stay for the Arc festival. We didn’t have to use Uber, we used the train and the station was so close
We wanted to cook our food and the house had everything we needed
The beds was comfortable
We had such a great experience

Bella and Key were extremely communicative during our stay and they helped us as much as they could when we ran into some issues. The property is in a suburb where most people are friendly; the neighbours say hello and try to get to know you. Chicago’s public transport is great and the property was only a 10 minute walk from the nearest station which takes you directly into the Loop, where you can explore the city or change lines to travel elsewhere around Chicago. The property is modern and has all the amenities listed, although washing and drying is $2 each per cycle and the property is in the basement which isn’t clear in the booking. Despite this, our overall experience was pleasant and relaxed.

Die Unterkunft entspricht der Beschreibung und die Gastgeberin hat uns immer schnell geantwortet. Da die Unterkunft mit anderen Gästen geteilt wird, kann die Gastgeberin natürlich nichts dafür, wenn diese nicht besonders sauber oder abends laut sind. Alles in Allem ist das Preis-Leistungsverhältnis aber absolut in Ordnung und es ist toll, dass man direkt vor dem Haus Kostenplans parken kann.
Great stay, easy access to the metro and nice area. Super kind and helpful hosts, would recommend!

Better than the
Photos! Miriam is an excellent hostess. Very conscientious. Directions and information was so helpful and detailed including photos. We stayed here with our daughter, son-in-law and 2 grandkids. The place so spacious! We would stay here again.

Jeannine was very accommodating. Despite her sudden trip to the ER, she still took the time to communicate and remain flexible with our circumstances. Treat her well! We want to keep good hosts like this in the business!

Hana was always concerned for my well-being making sure I made it in safe and left safe. She provided me with more than what was promised for my short stay making my stay more comfortable and accessible. She described the place as is in the listing and it was as described a lived in home with a spare room comfortable to get a good nights rest and explore the city all day. Thank you Hana for making this trip to Chicago a breeze!
Maureen set us up for a great long weekend in Chicago. The space was relaxing and very clean, overall a great place to lay out heads after exploring the city all day. Thanks Maureen!

Stephanie is a very proactive, friendly hostess. We felt at home immediately. When we had an issue with one of the TVs, Stephanie had a new one delivered to the doorstep the same day. She also sent her maintenance man to help. Stephanie is very responsive and available with an easy text. The house is comfortable and the backyard and garage are great areas to hang out. Will definitely return the next time we're in the area.
A well equipped sanctuary in the South of Chicago.

I want to give Reiss major props for being the most accommodating host I’ve ever experienced. We were allowed to check in early, and check out was later than typical (12PM). Reiss was super proactive about communications and responded to a question I had immediately.
Another really nice thing about the space is that it has the right window coverings to make it pleasant for sleeping. The upper bedroom has windows that look out into the living space, but because the living space also has blackout shades, this isn’t a problem for those who like it darker for sleeping. The lower bedroom gets nice and dark.
Location is also phenomenal. Walking distance to whatever you need in Bucktown. The neighborhood is safe and feels peaceful while still being easy access.
Overall, we had a good stay. I would come back again.
Great host, excellent location, quite comfortable. My wife and I worked remotely and it was very easy to have meetings in different parts of the house.

Carl was very helpful and responsive.     We had our own private room and shared spaces for the kitchen and bathroom with other tenants but all in all, it worked perfectly for our needs.     We were out and about during the daytime and just needed a place to sleep.    I’m glad Carl had fans everywhere so that we slept well at night.
We had great time!  Host was very responsive and helpful!

I had a great stay at Caroline's place. The room was exactly as shown in the pictures, clean and comfortable. Caroline was a fantastic host, always quick to respond and very helpful. The area was also nice and felt safe. Highly recommend!

My wife and I took this trip to celebrate an anniversary. The listing was for a king bed, however when we arrived they told us the only room they had available was one with 2 “queen” beds, but that it was an upgrade since it was a river view. We had no choice but to accept, otherwise we would’ve have had no place to stay. After getting to the room we quickly realized they were full sized beds, not queen. My wife and I couldn’t even sleep together in the same bed on our anniversary. How sad.

John's place was perfect for our Chicago weekend! The rooftop outdoor area was so nice! Inside was well appointed with great linens and comfortable beds and furniture. The location was great as it is walkable to grocery, restaurants, convenience store. John was super responsive and a great communicator. We had a wonderful stay and would highly recommend!

Great little condo for visiting relatives on the south side of Chicago. Building has charm. Could use updating and there were no lights working in the stairwell. However, the host was very responsive and the place was clean.

Crash pad was the perfect place for my husband and I . Super convenient location for two concerts at Wrigley field.  Plenty of space, clean, safe, walkable area in Wrigleyville. Carlos/ Wrigleyville Oasis staff very helpful and accommodating!! Even greated us and directed us where to park upon arrival. Highly recommend!!
Our stay was perfect from beginning to end. The accommodations & location are  excellent. Our hostess was awesome. Highly recommended!
cute place, with personality. 24 hour desk is a big help. clean space.
Great host. Came and helped our group settle in

Kiana’s place has been my favorite airbnb place to date. She is extremely responsive and accommodating. Seriously, she’s just the sweetest! The area is up and coming. I love that I could grab a Lime scooter within a block of her place and zip around the city with ease. Highly recommend and I’ll definitely be back!

The place was great. Parking was easy, usually right in front of the apartment. The space was very clean and well appointed. The deck off the back of the house was great for morning coffee or cocktails on a warm evening. The neighborhood was very welcoming with a family even offering us fresh-picked pears as we were walking to dinner. It was in a convenient spot as we were attending a concert at Wrigley. The were great restaurants and things to do in any direction.
Telly was a great host!  We enjoyed our stay in Chicago and found Tellys suggestions helpful!  We would definitely return in the future!
Thank you for all
Perfect location for those traveling with a car! Check in was very easy and Mariena was super responsive to all our messages.
Great place to stay at if you’re looking to visit Chicago. And the price is good for the location which is 15 min out the city.

The space was very clean and on a peaceful tree lined street.   Good working space and walkable to all Lincoln Park has to offer (restaurants, shopping, coffee, etc.). Larissa was very responsive and communicative - truly a super host.
Great location, the apt has everything you’d need for a short stay! It’s an older building so it definitely has some character to it, but very accessible to downtown and nearby food!

Tracy was friendly and helpful, and her dog was so cute!
She does a great job of making you feel at home, and everything was straight forward. Really enjoyed my stay!

Great place for a large group (we had 18). This will definitely be our annual rental. The entire home is BEAUTIFULLY decorated and IMMACULATELY cleaned. Spacious sleeping quarters & bathrooms, well stocked kitchen w/every appliance imaginable, huge game room with lots to do, and plenty of private off street parking. Close to downtown- although Chicago traffic is horrible.
The host was SUPER nice and very responsive - maintenance arrived in 10 minutes to help with minor issues.
This home will NOT disappoint so don’t hesitate to book.

We really enjoyed our stay at Sam's place. Sam was responsive when we reached out. Location was perfect for exploring the city and the neighbourhood was perfect! Would hope to stay here again next time we're in Chicago!
The place is nice and Comfy. Would love to be back !!
Great time. Top notch place to stay. Walkable to Wrigley and surrounding area. Coffee shop was great around the corner, as were the nearby breweries.

We needed a place for my friends and family to stay while celebrating my 50th birthday! And boy it did NOT disappoint! It was perfect for the 12 of us! The views were breathtaking! And the location was perfect! The train was right there, tons of food near by & you can walk to everything! We will definitely stay here again! Heck I'd live there! The on-site staff was so nice & friendly from day 1 to the last! We were sad the week went by so fast!
The apartment was great! Good spot in Chicago in a nice building. Great for a long term stay!
Well kept and clean , maintained very well . Definitely would stay again, it's pricey but in the long run worth it. Omni checks in making sure your stay is going well . 5 stars
Great stay! Lester was very clear in his instructions and even let us check in early! Definitely recommend!!
Perfect location for events at Wrigley Field and a plenty of restaurants to walk to.
The place was really nice and well located. Sebas is very friendly and helpful

Great place in a great location.  The beds are very comfortable.  Plenty of hot water in the shower, moderate water pressure.  Well equipped kitchen.  Walking distance to Wrigley & the “L” station (local metro rail).  Coin laundry in basement of the building.  Street parking only, but it is very easy to find parking spaces nearby.  We highly recommend this place for a stay in Chicago.
Had issues getting the shower to work initially. Toilet didn’t flush well. Great location. Very clean.
Pristine space in a quiet neighborhood ; perfect for a weekend getaway!
Great place in a good location! Josh was a great host and made the stay amazing - our crew took over the whole house and was the most fun experience for a work project

This place was in a great location and quiet neighborhood. Worked well for 1 guest, but I believe would be tight with 3-4. It is a garden unit but had decent sunlight. You could hear tenants above.
My only callouts - I stayed a month and was only provided 2 rolls of toilet paper. There is only 1 AC unit in the living room. This was not pictured or called out in the listing. Other rooms did get stuffy/warm.
Steven was great and responded and checked in.

The house is lovely and in a location where public transport is readily available but also walking distance to the shore or the university of Chicago. Every detail of the room and bath seemed thoughtful. I hope to stay again and again over the next few years.

Four of us stayed at this beautiful space over Labor Day weekend and it was absolutely perfect. The space is dreamy with attention to detail like you can't even imagine. I just enjoyed marveling at every little design detail. One of our clients stayed at this property for four weeks, and it was a smooth process coordinating with Diamond. We hope to have the opportunity to do so again next year!
Enjoyed our stay and will definitely book with Ethan again!

Laura was amazing! The breakfast and bed is a unique gem in Wicker Park! Our room smelled so clean! I felt comfortable instantly and the staff was so welcoming. This is a great place for long and short term stay. I stayed here for over a month and had everything I needed. This is a great place to stay. Fully furnished and ready for a good stay. Wireless and streaming services with the place helped out a lot since I could not use my own. Having a full kitchen made meals easy.

This place was very cozy and private, was there for a little over a month and I really enjoyed my stay at Derick’s place. Would definitely recommend!

Location so close to the brown line station was incredibly convenient. Over the 2 months I was there, I never had an issue parking within striking distance of the apartment. Quiet and cozy. Hot shower, good air-conditioning. Excellent for students and work visitors who need a peaceful place at a great price.

Victor is a great host, I had a really pleasant stay! He helped with all problems right away and responded within minutes! The location is great, quiet and peaceful with a supermarket and huge park nearby! I highly recommend staying with Victor!

Aly is great and very responsive but the place smelled like cigarettes really bad and lotsa dirty corners so we bailed after about 10 minutes. Staying at Nicole and Vince's was best experience. This location is dreamy - 5 minute walk to blue line, 30 second walk to 606, and SO much walkable in a 1 mile radius. For being an extended stay I was pleasantly surprised at all of the kitchen and home items available

Loved Stewart’s place. It was so clean and quiet to come back to after a long day of sightseeing. The bed was very comfortable and the bathrooms were clean. I was happy to have a washer/dryer in the unit and be away from the road noise. Stewart was so responsive and was just so polite! Thank you again for a nice and safe stay in your home!

Wonderful experience and highly recommend. Extremely responsive host. Excellent and clean accommodations with just a 5 minute walk to local hospital and 10 minutes to grocery store. Nice bike and walking trails nearby. Definitely would stay again!
Ilyas has a nice place. I’d stay there again if I’m that part of town and would gladly recommend it to anyone.
This place was great for my 1.5 month long stay! Cesar was a great host and the space was great and exactly what I needed. Thanks!

One of my best Airbnb experiences! Steven is very communicative, helpful, and friendly. I swam in the lake from the dock behind the townhouses several times. Steve and Phyll also invited me to two BBQs they hosted while I was there, and I met their friends! Steve was very understanding about my sensitivity to heat, providing me a nice fan and turning up the AC when I needed. Other than that, I had no complaints. No frills space, but a very good value for the price!
Loads of hidden costs. DO NOT book with them, book via hotel.
The place itself is clean, spacious and cozy. The problem is not the airbnb itself, but rather the area. It's in Lawndale, google it!

Perfect home away from home for an extended work trip. The unit is lovely, exactly as pictured. They had a fully stocked kitchen which made life much easier! Great stay in a calm neighbourhood but close to both O’hare and the Loop. Kelsey and Zach are just excellent hosts, easy going and very welcoming.

Perfect place to stay while settling our daughter in at DePaul. Our little dog was right at home and comfortable while we ran errands. The breakfast place below has good food at a reasonable price. The Inn at Wrigleyville is in a great location, just behind Wrigley Field.  It is a busy area so if you are looking for a quiet place, this might not be the best option.  There were no Cubs games the weekend we were there but there was a concert, which brought large crowds and noise.  Again, this did not bother us but may disturb others looking for a quieter place to stay.  Additionally, we knew we would have to pay for garage parking (the listing clearly states no parking is included) so we chose a nearby garage that was listed at $45 for 24 hours (we stayed 2 nights) -- however, when we left, we were charged over $220 for 2 nights because of "event parking" - the concert we did not know about ahead of time (had not thought to research that).  The garage states "higher prices may be applied during events" but does not give any prices.  Needless to say, had we known there was a concert, we would have looked further away for parking.  So, just something to be aware of.

Neal's place was great and ideally located for exploring around Chicago. The neighborhood was quiet yet steps away from all the hustle and bustle. The place itself was clean, had all the needed amenities, and the deck was a big plus! Would definitely recommend.

The apartment is fully updated, as shown in the photos, and spotlessly clean.  Beds were super comfortable.  Kitchen and bathroom were both excellent. Brian was very kind and helpful during our stay!
Very comfortable and amazing owners!

Great place to stay. So clean and the host was great.  Love the option for off street parking but with a larger vehicle we had to park on the street which was a challenge. We wound up leaving the car in the spot we found and took an Uber.  It’s a little bit of a distance, about 35 mins, into the city center. But the place is large, beautifully decorated and worth the trip.

This apartment was perfect for our weekend trip! It was a great size for two people, clean, and cozy. We also loved the neighborhood- the street is quiet which is great for when you're ready to relax, but there's tons of restaurants and activities walking distance, as well as public transportation. We were also surprised by how great the street parking was (we were able to find a spot at 2am after coming back from a wedding!).
Overall Matt was an amazing host. He was proactive in reaching out to see if we needed anything, and he was available for us at all times if we had any questions. We will definitely book again when we come back to Chicago :)

Our group of seven had a wonderful stay at Cloud 9. The location is prime, just a 6-10 minute Uber ride from everything we wanted to see and do. The place was very clean, spacious, and felt extremely safe. It had everything we needed for a short stay. I would definitely come back again!

Clean and looks just like the pictures—super cute space! Jen and Andy were always friendly and quick to fix any issues. Having the outside space was great, too. Would recommend to anyone looking for a long term stay.

This location is just as described, and shown in the photos. More than enough space for everyone in your party, in a very nicely renovated home. David is very prompt, and swift with answering any and all concerns as well which for me goes a long way.
It was decent for the night. Had an issue with restroom that wasn’t able to be solved until next morning after and we were already leaving
Great location! Was in walkable distance to Soldier Field. Apartment is really nicely decorated and just a very cool space.
Amazing view and accommodations!

Melissa is an amazing host. Very Responsive and available when needed.
She met us first day in person, showed us around the home, made us feel very comfortable.
Would 100% stay again on our next trip to Chicago.

Sam and Jesse are amazing hosts—always kind, helpful, and quick to respond. Our family of two stayed for 2.5 months, and the apartment had everything we needed to feel at home. The initial supplies were a thoughtful touch, and we appreciated it.
One challenge was the shared laundry room, available only on fixed days (Tuesdays and Saturdays). Sam and Jesse helped arrange swaps with other tenants, but this may not always work out, so be ready to use a laundromat if needed.
Without a car, getting to supermarkets was tough. The nearest small shops are a 30-minute walk away and only carry basic items. Future guests should plan ahead.
For longer stays, note that getting to downtown Chicago requires both a bus and a metro, which can turn a 10-minute drive into nearly an hour due to intermittent service. If you’re okay with this or have a car, you’ll be fine.
Overall, very accommodating hosts, and I’d recommend staying here if you're comfortable with these caveats.
Beautiful apartment in a Chicago neighborhood.  Close to Lincoln Square and all the shops and restaurants.  Bedroom is quiet and dark. Entire apartment is spotless and well kept. Highly recommend!

Very responsive and caring.  An incredible Airbnb tucked away in the city.

I recently rented a condo in Chicago for a week, and overall, it was a fantastic experience. The location was perfect—close to all the major attractions, with easy access to public transportation. The condo itself was clean, well-maintained, and tastefully decorated, making it feel like a home away from home.
The kitchen was fully equipped, which was great for those days when I wanted to cook instead of eating out. The living area was spacious and comfortable, with plenty of natural light streaming in through the large windows.
The only minor issue I encountered was that the walls were a bit thin, so noise from the condo could be heard in the hallway, and vice versa. It wasn’t a major problem, but it's something to keep in mind if you're sensitive to noise or plan on having late-night conversations.
Despite that, I thoroughly enjoyed my stay and would definitely consider renting this condo again on my next visit to Chicago. Highly recommended!

Nice apt, not the one we signed up for. The “rental agent” first stated the new apt was 62 feet next door to the apt we rented, but it actually a half mile away (she then said she mis-spoke and that it was a couple blocks…. I wasn’t sure she was even in Chicago or had any familiarity with it). The stated reason was the first apt had water damage and needed repairs (I have noted reviews saying exactly the same thing, so it seems to be an excuse). It felt like sleight of hand. There were specific reasons the location was chosen and the replacement apt meant increased commute times.
The replacement apt was fine. Different neighborhood, but very reasonable. And the apt was 2 bdrm/2 bath, which helped in a very nice building with a beautiful pool/spa on the roof we used every evening. It was on the 3rd floor, so no particular view and it was fairly noisy. But it amply sufficed for our needs. I would actually go back there. The apt had a great view of Hooters across the street 🤣

This spot is perfect if you're looking for walkable to some of the best drinking/eating/shopping spots in Chicago. Right in the heart of Wicker Park/West Town, there's so much right out the door off Division and Milwaukee. Loved this spot.

We really enjoyed the area, the accessibility to restaurants, stores, and whatever else we needed. The neighborhood was nice quiet and peaceful, the dogs on both sides of the place were friendly and cute. We will reserve from now on when we visit our hometown.

Would stay here again! This stay is 2 separate apartments located directly above and below each other on the 2nd and 3rd floors. Super clean. Nicely stocked nespresso pods and machine. Nice building amenities. Great view of Sears tower from the rooftop pool.

Traveling from Texas and this place felt like home away from home. We had such an amazing stay. Clean & comfortable.
Great parking and my favorite part was the kitchen being well equipped! 😁
Would definitely recommend this airbnb stay.

This apartment is a gem and worth the 3-floor walk up! It’s spacious, well decorated and the kitchen has everything you need. The street is quiet despite being right off a Main Street, which makes it even more convenient!

the place was very well kept! sabrina set it up very nicely and even left snacks for us during check in! the only issue was responsiveness—it was difficult getting ahold of her for almost a full day, and it was kind of important because we needed more than one parking pass. overall though, we felt safe and very at home here!
Terrific spot for our trip to sail in Chicago.  Close to Belmont and Wrigley.  Great time was had by all.

Airbnb does a great job of showing the tacked on fees/taxes when searching for a place so that you get a better picture of why your total price will be. This host is deceptive and does not have their fees in that filter, so their price looks more competitive (cheap) compared to other local listings. There’s a $100 deposit charge collected upon check in (refundable), as well as a $58 a day/person “benefit” charge. Again, these do not show up in the Airbnb “fees” filter and are instead mentioned in fine print after the fact.
The room itself was nice & clean. The location was perfect for walking to several landmarks & restaurants.

Hosts were very responsive; staff was very friendly and helpful; apartment was clean and beautiful with great views and a nice balcony. Terrific access to Michigan Avenue and the Riverwalk and not far from the lake. Large pool with plenty of lounges; at least some shade always available and sun on the water til mid-afternoon.  We have no complaints and very much enjoyed our stay.

Very well maintained and updated. We met John (owner) on our arrival. Every detail was thought of and the assortment of treats in the kitchen was a welcome surprise!  We stayed here to attend a family wedding at the Firehouse, which proved to be a super convenient location. Street parking was easy. Would stay again.

Our stay at the Duplex was amazing. We hosted our bridal party for our wedding and it worked perfectly for having the groomsmen on one floor and the bridesmaid on the next. Very nice area with lots of free street parking and on a quiet block. Would definitely come back

Chris place was amazing and he was extremely communicative. Awesome restaurants, coffee shops, Wrigley, tons of bars. Two things That are interesting to know…I was there w my three year old during Cubs season and so it’s very very hectic during games as this is the center of the restaurant/bar scene, BUT the bedrooms were perfectly situated and my kid slept like a dream. Bonus points cause there are tons of little parks for the kiddos around the corner from the place.
I do however wish this place had a working desk as I was primarily working out of the apt. But that’s an easy fix. Overall I’d rate this a 4.5 out of 5!!

Hatice was great! She allowed us to check in early and extend our check out without having to ask. The neighborhood is quiet and the house was big enough to fit our whole group. I will be coming back when I’m in Chicago and will be sure to work with Hatice and her other property’s as well.
Overall this stay was a positive experience, the rooms and beds were large and comfortable, we slept well!

Definitely too pricey when it comes to the hidden/after-purchase fees. You pay around $1000 in the first place, and after you make the listing you're roped into an extra $60 per room per night plus an additional no-sense 16% upcharge on top of that for seemingly no reason at all. These really feel like "you've already made the reservation so now you're locked into paying 150% of what you were expecting to pay" fees. Felt very predatory and the "amenities" that cost an extra $400 were a couple Keurig machines and your average hotel gym. I could have paid a couple hundred at a Holiday Inn and been just as happy (and probably will next time).
That being said, the location was hard to beat with some night life hotspots and great restaurants nearby. More than anything, I'd say this hotel is convenient, but not necessarily worth the price.

After having left both units running for several hours, it was 80 degrees inside when we returned. Several hours passed and we received a message that Kelly was unable to find anyone to install the AC and that we would have to do so ourselves. We recently stayed at this home in Chicago, and while there were some positive aspects, there were also several challenges that impacted our stay.
**Pros:**
- The home, despite being over 100 years old, has been recently remodeled and looks clean and modern inside.
- The kitchen and living area are well-maintained and comfortable, providing a nice space to relax.
**Cons:**
- Only one bedroom is equipped with suitable bedding, which was a significant issue for us since we had more than two adults. The tag of 4 bedrooms was totally misleading.
- The closets were either insufficient or already occupied with the owner’s belongings, leaving little room for our own storage.
- The bedsheets were very old and could not use during our stay
- We found that the time and cost of commuting to downtown Chicago outweighed the savings we expected from staying here compared to a hotel in the city center.
