I cant say enough about the place and host! Its big dint get intimated by the word apartment its huge enough for all 12 of us with room to spare. The host recommended places for my family and the kids had a ball. We did all recommended which made the trip 10 times better. This will be my number one place to stay with my family. We loved it!!!

While the neighbors upstairs sounded like they were a-town stomping instead of just walking.    The rest of the stay was beautiful and wonderful. It was clean and that is the comfiest bed I’ve ever slept in. I almost didn’t want to leave!
Good value for price

No communication prior to check, I had requested the possibility of an early check in days prior to my trip with no answer. The room was extremely small for nearly $700 per night, it was difficult for two people to get ready at the same time. The pool is VERY small when we went up there were maybe ten other people up there which left the area with no seating and the pool felt crowded. There were unruly children up there as well and the attendant said nothing. The room itself was very clean however the restrooms in the lobby were rather disgusting, this was just around check out time on a Sunday. Everyone who worked there seemed Extremely nice and attentive but they were obviously over worked things like getting ice to my room took a minimum of 30 minutes. The water bottles provided with the room were nice but there was no where to fill them unless you went all the way down to the lobby. Overall this is a nice place but for the price point there are many better options in downtown.

The inside was clean and nicely decorated. Location is close to a bus stop if that’s important to you. I will say that we struggled to get the doors unlocked. There are three doors that all have old locks that were extremely challenging to open. This was quite frustrating. But, overall the place was as described and pictured.

My friends and I enjoyed our stay at Iman’s place. The space was well thought out and was spacious enough for our weekend getaway. It was very clean and Iman was always quick to respond when we had questions. The airbnb was a bit far from the downtown area, but public transportation was only a few minutes away which was awesome.
Fantastic place ! Stayed there for 3 months. No issues at all
Sonia’s place was clean and quiet. She was also very flexible when it came to us having a late check in and check out. I would definitely stay with her again!

The location was perfect. Room was exactly as described . we were a little disappointed in the breakfast selection, and the fact that on the weekends, it did not begin till 8 AM. Many of us needed to get traveling and there was some confusion as to the time frames. It’s a self-serve breakfast not typical in a bed-and-breakfast.

David made our stay in Chicago really easy. He met us upon arrival to explain how to get in & out & where we could park and also gave us the opener to the front gate.
His home was also super nice, clean & roomy and it made us feel at home and his warm welcome from the start made it that much better. You never get a second chance to make a first impression and by him being so welcoming and going over everything definitely made a good first impression of everything.

We had a great time!
LaKesha was very helpful and responded very fast to all of our texts.
The surrounding neighberhoods felt less safe so we used uber to take us to the red line, but other than that it was great!
Still was very responsive and helpful throughout my stay. The place was clean, private, and a great location. I would highly recommend not only this location but any place hosted by Still!

Great place to explore the city. Our group of six adults and one dog were very comfortable here and  the place could accommodate a much larger group as well. Street parking was easy and the garage was convenient as well. We were within walking distance of restaurants, coffee shops, the train and the lake while also being able to enjoy a relaxing walk with our dog through nice neighborhoods. Definitely would recommend and would love to return soon.

Tom and Megan were very responsive during the entire stay. This unit is very easy to access. The location is amazing, it’s right downtown Wicker Park where everything you could want is within walking distance but it’s never too noisy. No issues with the unit or check in/out process!
Great!!

The rental company was excellent, responsive and accommodating. Nothing but top notch communication and assistance. The room was super clean and comfortable, exactly as it appeared in photos.
Unfortunately, the bathroom was quite dirty with hair in the shower drain and the trash overflowing. Thankfully, the rental company was quick to respond and very helpful. They sent over a cleaner as well to tidy the location.
I would recommend this airbnb and rental company as they were excellent in making my stay great!
As advertised. Nice spot which is literally across from street from great bars and restaurants.
Nice basement apartment in a quiet neighborhood.  We enjoyed our stay!
Clean and welcoming space in a good location with a kind and responsive host!

When we pulled into the neighborhood there were loud parties and trash everywhere. Some might feel unsafe. Thankfully, cops patrolled the area frequently and there was a station down the street. The apartment was as pictured and described but it needs a good cleaning and maintenance.  If it had just been cleaner, we would have had a much different experience! Thankfully we were just there to sleep. I did not complain because I didn't want to have to find another place to stay after a long drive. I can tell that Sabrina tried her best to make the place feel homey and comfortable. She had a helpful book of local attractions and suggestions to do in the area, which I appreciated.

Thanks for the lovely stay, Sharon and Hank. You have a beautiful home in a great part of the city. Really loved being there and hope I get the chance to stay again. It was nice to meet you both. Thank you for all your help! :)
It was a great stay! It was great having Milton as the host.

My husband, myself, and another couple always spend a weekend in the city in the summer. We are just from the suburbs and plenty city savvy. This is by far the BEST property we have had the privilege to call our home for a few days. Every picture perfectly captures how much love and attention went into making this such a unique space and shows the love that goes into maintaining it. The hosts are beyond friendly and added such a personal touch to our check in process. The neighborhood is great and so close to all the Andersonville buzz. Do yourself a favor and book this space today!

Had such a beautiful stay at Telly’s home. Close to everything I needed and such a safe friendly neighborhood. There’s no doors that separate the upstairs from downstairs. Felt weird at first, but Telly was quiet and gave me my privacy. The home is beautiful and has a high end feel. Definitely my style of a place to stay. There is a gym within walking distance if you like to workout like me. Trader Joe’s and so much other restaurants are a 5-10 min walk away. Telly had a few drinks and snack he provided which was very kind of him. You access the home with a code instead of a key. Which was a bonus because I didn’t have to worry about losing any keys. Thank you so much for a welcoming into your home. Definitely recommend staying here if you want a splurge a little bit.
My family and I  had a good experience here it wasn’t to far from downtown Chicago the neighborhood was peaceful and friendly.
Great place to stay if you're comfortable with the area. Super nice and budget friendly.
Great stay and great host! Easy to get in
El lugar está a 15 minutos de todas las atracciones de la ciudad, es una zona muy tranquila y el apartamento es muy cómodo.

It was truly a home away from home experience! Exceeded my expectations and we are grateful for such a beautiful home and host! We definitely have recommended this place to all of our friends and family!
This was an amazing stay for me and my brothers!! It definitely helped with a last minute booking and was far better than expected. I would definitely book again when I make my way back to Chi-town

My overall experience here was great. Except for a few things like the floor being dirty in the location was not close to downtown like I thought. Overall, I’ll give it a seven out of 10 very nice lady in the future. I could see myself staying there again.
Good communication and listens to critiques.
Thank you for letting us stay!!
Host was very friendly and helpful, he responded quickly with any questions we had and helped us out.

Recently stayed at this location to celebrate a birthday. Cristian provided clear instructions, the place was easy to find, and very clean. Any questions I had, Cristian was able to answer, and he responded quickly. This is a great location, my group felt very safe, and it was an easy trip DT, with very affordable ride share options from this location. The home was clean, comfortable, and easily accommodated my group of 5.  I’d definitely use this location again, thanks again Cristian!
Great place for a great value
Thanks to the lovely staff, so friendly and helpful.

Great location next a super cool walking trail.  Place is a little dated, but well taken care of by the owner. We enjoyed sitting on the back porch each morning drinking coffee and watching the bikers and runners enjoying the trail.

Very Accommodating of Variable plans.
Went Above and Beyond to Improve Our Stay!
Daniel was a great host! Nice location, had a fun time in Chicago
Está okay para el precio del alojamiento
Great location and very easy to work with host

What a terrific apartment! For those focused on safety, there is a 24/7 doorman, cameras watching the elevator banks and elevators, you need a fob to access the elevators, and deliveries are kept on the ground level in cubbies near the doorman. The street that the apartment is located on is wide with streetlights and many other doorman buildings nearby. The apartment itself has a stunning view of the river and all necessary amenities, including its own washer/dryer. It was so easy working with this management company that was highly responsive and professional. The location and the apartment itself really added to the positive experience that we had living in Chicago for ten weeks.

I had a wonderful stay in Chicago! The hosts were very communicative and friendly. The place itself was very clean and the location was amazing (right off of the 60 bus to take you downtown). The place was equipped with a nice welcome kit, cookware, linens, etc. which was very convenient. Highly recommend this place!

Buyer beware, this place is in a very unsafe area of Chicago. There is nothing close by. The pictures are deceiving. Its very ran down, unclean, had bugs and smelled like an animal. She said she had a clezning crew there right before we arrived but there was literally soider webbs hanging off od light fixtures, food in the fridge,  ants on the counter, the so called game room in the garage was dirty as hell, it looked more like a storage area, it had spider webbs everywhere,  pot and cigarettes laying around. Definitely not prepared for visitors and she knew this, this why she wasn't there for the intial walk through. DO NOT STAY HERE
Really nice place. It was the perfect spot for our adult family. Would definitely rent again.

We had such an amazing time at Rhett's place. Rhett was a really friendly and welcoming host, and his home was lovely. I would absolutely live there if I could ;) It was spacious, the bed was extremely comfortable, the kitchen had everything you could need to cook in, and we loved hanging out in the backyard area. The location was perfect for us, within a block or two from the brewery, coffee shops, bunch spots and the CTA. Street parking was easy to find as well. All in all, we would absolutely stay again when we return to Chicago!

I stayed at Sadia's place for the first time, and it was amazing, as everyone wrote. The location is walkable everywhere and the view of the Michigan Lake from the unit is wonderful!
Sadia is very responsive and her instruction was always clear.
I will definitely stay here again if I have a chance to visit Chicago again. I strongly recommend this great place and the wonderful host.
A very excellent place, nice atmosphere and very friendly, highly recommended thanks Roberto y Carlos

I had a great stay at Anna's place, in part because Anna was such a lovely and thoughtful host. When I realized there were no ice cube trays provided, she not only brought me some, but also brought a ton of ice so I could had a supply right away. I also loved having a private balcony space to enjoy the beautiful summer weather.

This place was clean and the pictures were accurate which is important.  A few things kept me from a 5 star review. I got a home so I could cook.  There was 1 pan, 1 pot and 1 spatula. There was no knife, cutting board, or cooking spoons,  the bed was really hard and parking was hard to find.  The parking they can't do anything about since this is Chicago. The other 2 are easily fixed. Thanks for sharing your space.
House was great, the location was exactly what we wanted, there was a few smalls things but overall very good host and definitely made our trip a lot easier
She treated you like family.
This is my second time staying here as Temporary housing for my work in downtown. Great & Safe Location. 2-3 mins walking distance to CTA. Friendly host. Great communication. Highly recommend!
We had a very comfortable stay at Melissa and Marcelo’s. Looked just like the photos. The unit was clean and tidy. We had everything we needed. A short distance to downtown too.

Carl and his wife Denise were absolutely wonderful hosts. They made me feel right at home with them . It was just me in the room so the bed , the restroom and other amenities were as described.
They made sure I had everything and made sure I felt safe too. They went above and beyond as hosts to cater to anything I needed. Thank you so much! I appreciate you both .

Vas was extremely helpful at all times during the stay and whenever we had any questions, he answered us within the same day. There is a lovely family who lives in the apartment below and they were kind and welcoming. Overall, this was a pleasant living situation for the summer.

This is by far the best Airnbn I stayed in. I will most definitely have to check it out again. Everyone was so incredibly nice!! They even wished me a happy graduation when I was leaving. Seriously, Thank you for being an incredible host! This app needs more people like you! 😊

Stayed here for 10 weeks over the summer with one other person and it was great for a long term stay. Ini was very responses with any questions we had. Beautiful apartment in a great neighborhood pretty close to public transit
Stayed for 3 months over the summer, Aubrey was a great host and the property was located close to the pink line for easy access to downtown.
Love it
Great place, great location, still quiet, and host was very helpful and responsive!

I stayed for the summer and Roseanna was very helpful and responsive. If there was an issue she would send the maintance guy quickly. The room was comfortable and the kitchen was nice too.
The location is excellent! Lots of food options in the area and also walkable to the train station and bus stop. The surroundings are very safe. Even coming back from the city late at night, I never felt discomfort. The neighborhood is very quiet and peaceful.

Karen's place was super clean and was exactly like the pictures. We had everything we needed. She was very responsive when I asked her a question and gave me several things to do while we were in Chicago. She even left some snacks and drinks which we thought was super sweet of her to do. The neighborhood was super quite and it felt very safe. I would definitely recommend staying at Karen's. Thank you Karen for everything!
Excellent stay and communication
Great location! Huge space, plenty of room for us our two young adult kids to have their own space too.
He canceled at the last minute

Amazing spacious place with a modern vibe. Super close to the Blue Line, which opened up access to a lot of areas. Also safe area. Going from the CTA stop to home felt safe at all hours. Laura was also a friendly and helpful host, who made sure we had everything we needed. Fast response times, and also just a really nice person!

Hatice was extremely responsive to any issues I have had & speedily fixed all of them without any hassle! The place was super clean and the neighborhood is fine - the Western blue line station is your friend to get downtown really quickly. Thankfully also had nice roommates! Would def come back again on another visit to Chicago
The location was fabulous, very close to train stations. Aly communicate well with us

Unit was just as described and is in an amazing location. There was street noise on Thurs/Fri night, but nothing out of the ordinary. Bed was very comfy and there was lots of surfaces to put things on. I wish the bathroom light was brighter for applying make-up and the shower's water pressure was not good. Other than that everything was fine. This was not like staying in a hotel, more like an Airbnb with no TV, dining room, or kitchen. There was a communal kitchen next to my room, but I did not use it.

This place is great! I stayed here by myself for almost 3 months and felt very safe. The unit was very clean and well kept as well. Also, there is a huge closet that fit all of my clothes and some other stuff I brought with me. Storage was definitely no issue! The garage was also a huge plus.
There is a bus stop right outside the window which was very convenient. It did not take long to get downtown either. There are many bus routes nearby that are less than 15 minutes to the nearest blue line stop. The buses do tend to run behind so I would recommend planning accordingly for that.
The laundromat across the street was also very nice and hardly every crowded. There is a nice coffee shop within a 5 minute walk that is very good as well as one that is about a 15 minute walk. There are not a lot of food options near the apartment unfortunately, but the Aldi, Target, CVS, and local market were both very nice.
Overall, I would recommend this place for a long visit to Chicago!
It was great:)

We really enjoyed our extended stay at this Airbnb! Michael and his family are great hosts — super responsive, very friendly, and accommodating. The unit is fully equipped with everything you might need and beautifully decorated. It’s also really close to several bus stops that connect you to major L stops (namely Red Line and Orange Line). Also right by one of my favorite cafes in Chicago. Highly recommend for anyone looking for long term or short term stays!

John is awesome!
His place is cozy and very neat. Also very cool with all the books and the guitar. Definitely recommend!

Nous avons apprécié le confort des lits et la proximité du transport en commun (environ 15 minutes de marche de la station de métro la plus proche). À noter également que le logement se trouve à une vingtaine de minutes de marche d’une des plages de Chicago !
Bien que les chambres étaient confortables et propres, le reste du logement était moins confortable: la cuisine n’est pas suffisamment équipée pour se faire à manger, plusieurs taches, manque d’équipement pour faire la vaisselle. Au niveau de la salle de bain, des traces d’humidité sont évidentes.
Finalement, nous avons apprécié la rapidité de réponse de Max lorsque nous avons eu un soucis avec le logement et sa proactivité à trouver une solution.
Merci pour le séjour !
A spacious unit with all the amenities needed for a comfortable stay.
We loved our stay at Tracy's towhome.  The location is perfect we walked to Wrigley many times for a game, shopping, lunch, coffee.  Would love to stay here again and will look to I the future.
Cool apartment that was close to everything we wanted to see.

This was the perfect spot for our stay. It was right next to the highway, which I personally enjoyed as I got to fully experience the big city vibes. The host and co-host were very kind and patient with me when I had delays in my communication with them. I'd highly recommend this place to anyone and stay here again if I ever return.

Exceeded our expectations. Wonderful accommodations in a great location! Quiet neighborhood with easy access to public transportation. Kelly was an amazing host, very helpful. We were very comfortable leaving our young adult son for the summer to complete his internship. He biked to work daily in the West Loop, took him roughly 20 minutes , if he took an Uber it would range $13-$16. Plentiful appliances, comfortable beds and friendly neighbors. Will definitely stay again if in the area.

Helen es una persona que siempre está atenta, responde rápido y es muy amable. Las condiciones del lugar son fieles a lo que muestra el anuncio. Es un lugar accesible rápidamente por transporte público e inclusive en bicicleta. Me voy contento 😁.

Jennifer was a great host, me and my gf stayed here for 3 months together and she was responsive continuously throughout our stay. Any issues were ammended very quickly. This was our first visit to the States from Ireland and she made the integration process really easy by providing some useful local recommendations and the check in process was extremely easy. thanks again Jenifer from Gordon and Eva
The place is very nice, all organized and clean. There is space for parking a bike so that was helpful. Bilel is very helpful and responsive. Definitely recommend.

Very nice place. Property is exactly what it purports to be. Nice place, downtown. Walk to everything. Very nice building. Other tenants/guests are friendly and there is plenty to do.  Thirties crowd.

We were really impressed with the spaciousness and comfort of the apartment. We travelled as a family of five and did not feel like we were tripping on one another. The area was easy to get around and had so much to do within walking as well as via public transport.

A perfect stay! The space is beautiful, cozy, clean, and private. Fantastic location for enjoying the vibrant local neighborhood, and easy access to downtown Chicago. Check in/out, parking, and communicating with the hosts couldn't have been easier. Kelsey and Zach are extremely attentive and kind. It would be a treat to stay with them again!

The overall stay was awesome!! It was easy to find and the on-property parking was a big plus. The house is nice and the neighborhood too. The best part, for me, is the location. We walked to the beach often, and the train, super close by, takes you straight to the center of Chicago! The only thing that made the trip less than, was that others staying in the house didn’t respect the quiet hours, and the houses walls/doors are pretty thin. This isn’t something that the host can control, but it is something to keep in mind if that’s important to you.

"We had a truly pleasant stay at this Airbnb! The space was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Our host was fantastic—always available to answer any questions and quick to resolve any issues that came up. The location was great, making it easy to explore the area. Highly recommend!"

We had a great stay at Sean’s house! It was clean, walking distance to the L-train and both Sean and Joy were super helpful with parking and suggestions for food! We would definitely stay here again 😊

We stayed with our small children and really felt at home here. Spacious and clean. Nice place to stay, easy to walk to a lot of restaurants or parks. Loved having a garage so we didn’t have to worry about parking. Would definitely stay again!

Tracye was able to fit me in when I needed a last-minute place to stay. the location was perfect for me as many of my events were very close. Parking was easy and I felt very safe coming home late at night and walking to the apartment. Definitely is a place I would would love to stay again!
No complaints whatsoever had a lovely 5 night stay at Myrtle's. Great Suburban location nice and quiet neighbourhood. 40 min Train ride downtown. Would recommend.
I stayed here twice. Host is extremely responsive & helpful. House is quiet & comfortable.

Great location! Walking distance to lots of restaurants, movie theater and grocery store. Gated parking lot is definitely a plus! The condo feels like home, with all the essentials in place. Stacy, the owner, is incredibly friendly and responsive! We had a fantastic time in Chicago!

We enjoyed our stay at Alice's place and would recommend it. It is located in a great tree-lined neighborhood and is within walking distance of many restaurants. You can take a quick bus trip or walk to the Brown Line to get downtown in about 25 minutes and the Diversey bus with a transfer to the Blue Line will get you to ORD in an hour. Alice's home is well appointed with plenty of space, 4 floors of it! The description and pictures are accurate (please note there are a lot of stairs). We were a party of 4; a couple and two 20-somethings. The kitchen is well supplied with plenty of plates, utensils, pots, pans, coffee makers, etc. It was nice to hang around the dining room and share meals Check-in was easy and each person in our group had a key so we didn't have to coordinate getting in and out. Alice answered any questions promptly. She was flexible on departure giving us an extra hour until we were ready to depart for our flight.
We had a great time at Dustin’s. Perfect for our family and dog while we were in town for a Cubs game. Would stay here again.

Gennie's place is perfect in every way. Very spacious condo, comfy bed, excellent water pressure in shower. Great amenities from grills, social areas, pool and gym. It's right in the heart of it all. So many restaurants, shopping and sights near by. Walkable to Lakefront paths, beaches, Navy Pier and River Walk. 1.5 blocks to Bus or El.
Gennie is super responsive and an excellent host. Building Staff, Doormen and maintenance are friendly and helpful. You will love your stay at Gennie's condo and your stay in Chicago.

The location and Airbnb was gorgeous and exactly as was described. The stay would have been perfect if not for the issues below:
Cloud9 requests license and background information for each visit. I provided my information 2 weeks before check in but was told that my background check was not done, and they did not have my information at the front desk. We had to wait 45 mins before we were allowed to enter, with no apology and rude customer service.
The unit had issues with the A/C and doors being unable to close, which is a safety hazard for our toddlers if they run out of the room at night. We reported it as soon as we could and Airbnb was great to work with (kudos to amazing customer service!). On the other hand, Cloud9 only told us that maintenance would only come in the morning and offered no other solutions. We had to use a chair to block the door from opening the first night.
After the door was fixed, the stay was great.
Hope Cloud9 can fix check in process for future

Lovely home in great location, exactly as pictured.  We appreciated the excellent communication, easy check in and lots of nice touches plus the great bathroom as others have highlighted!  Upstairs noise others have reported upstairs did not bother us at all, we found it only audible during daytime hours.  Parking also was quite easy, we found plenty of free and unrestricted spaces close by. The hosts have clearly gone to a lot of trouble to respond to all feedback installing white noise machines and upgraded temperature controls.  Clean and comfortable.  Highly recommend!
Our stay at this beautiful home was fabulous with above and beyond with lots of amenities at our fingertips!  We all highly recommend this home it will not disappoint! Enjoy!
Great location and amazing space. The area was very walkable. Vas was always quick to respond and very accommodating, would definitely recommend staying.

This was our second stay at Eileen's. The place is clean and comfortable with everything needed for an extended weekend in Chicago. We always felt safe in the neighborhood, walking around a lot both day and night. Nice little breakfast place 2 blocks away.
Great hosts and location
Great experience. Clean room. Fast response.
This place was cozy and comfortable. Great for a place to rest and clean up after a long day of urban exploration.

Nothing short of a NIGHTMARE. I spent 4/32 nights and it was mentally and physically exhausting. The place was unclean and unsanitary. There was dust and human hair everywhere. The bathroom wasn’t cleaned thoroughly. There was a bottle of bleach that was leaking. Luckily, I put the bath mat on the floor cause the next morning, the ends of the mat had torn to shreds after coming in contact with the bleach.
I requested the host to clean the place since I’m allergic to dust and her response, at 2am, was for me to find another place if I wanted to. No empathy or consideration whatsoever. I had to quite literally fight with Airbnb support to issue a full refund considering the disaster of an experience I have had with this stay.

I loved staying at Eric’s AirBnB. He was always extremely nice and responsive when I needed him. The house was really cozy, and the neighborhood was really safe and full of very kind neighbors. I also loved the proximity to Saint Xavier University where I took physics this summer and could go to the on-campus gym (about an 8 minute drive). I also had the privilege of meeting Eric’s lovely family members when they came to visit, and they included me in their various 4th of July festivities even though they obviously didn’t have to. I enjoyed my early morning or late night conversations with Eric. He’s an amazing person and always had a lot of insight as to how to navigate Beverly, as well as the downtown Chicago area. He was extremely welcoming when I had my mother stay with me which I highly appreciated. Overall, I have no complaints! I would definitely recommend staying here if you find yourself in the area. His house is very clean and charming!
Sean’s place was clean and comfortable. Within walking distance of Old town restaurants. We loved it!

I stayed in this airbnb for the Summer and it was a great experience! Location is arguably the best you can get in Chicago. The doorpeople and amenities are great too! Overall this was a great experience and I highly recommend.

The location is perfect for a cozy Chicago stay. Settled in an adorable and walkable neighborhood, amenities, attractions and transportation are all within an ideal distance. Thank you for hosting us, Arman! We look forward to our return in the future!

Paul’s place is truly a gem in the wonderful Andersonville neighborhood. It’s quiet, peaceful, spacious, and very comfortable. Also very walkable and safe when wanting to explore Andersonville. The Red Line for the subway is within a short walking distance as well, giving easy access to Wrigley Field or an excursion into downtown Chicago. Will definitely stay again!

This was a very spacious and clean apartment that comfortably hosted our family of 6 for several days.  Having two separate living areas was very useful and allowed our group to spread out a bit. The full-size crib in the extension area off the master bedroom was also much appreciated as we had a 2-year-old with us. The building is on a quiet street just one block from Humboldt Park and two blocks from restaurants and shops on North Avenue.  There was a grocery store within 2 blocks.  Dubbs was a very responsive host, and we appreciate his flexibility with checkout time. We would happily stay here again.
Such a fun place to stay! My friends and I stayed here for Lollapalooza this year and it was a perfect home base for us. It had everything we needed and Naomi was a great host.

I absolutely enjoyed my stay and first visit to Chicago! Mz. Bobbie was an amazing host and the property is clean and cozy. The green line is less than a 10 minute walk and will take you straight into the downtown area. There’s also lots of nice parks, local restaurants, and museums/galleries nearby. The area has lots of cool history so get out there and explore a bit. There were other guests on the property but I hardly saw them so comfort and privacy was never an issue. I would definitely stay here again next time I visit Chicago.

Kaila's place felt just like home. She provides all the amenities you could possibly need and is only 2-5 minutes from public transportation! The neighborhood can get a little noisy at night as the house isn't super soundproof but it didn't bother us much.
Very easy to communicate with and super friendly. I would love to stay with her again!
we enjoyed our stay! Great host! very responsive and straight forward.

We stayed in Chicago for two months and really enjoyed our time. This apartment was clean, spacious and matched the images provided. The kitchen comes fully stocked with utensils, towels and linens were provided, and access to a washer and dryer was provided. It is conveniently located near bus and tram lines that connect directly to the city. There is a variety of supermarkets, bakeries and shops located near by.
Jeremy was very helpful and accommodating throughout our stay. He responded quickly to any questions or concerns we had and ensured we had a safe and enjoyable stay. We would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Chicago.

This apartment is stunning and has amazing views of the city. It is in the heart of downtown and very close to the riverwalk, millennium park and other main attractions. The amenities in the apartment block are unbelievable. We would definitely stay again

very nice and accommodating hosts! the house was very welcoming and I felt very comfortable staying here. the check in and check out process was very simple and smooth. the hosts are very communicative and kind. highly recommend and would stay here again!
Fantastic view & great location!  Kitchen had everything we needed and it was very easy to stock up at the Jewel-Osco downstairs.  We had a very nice stay.
Quaint place in a nice cozy neighborhood on a tree lined street. Kate and Leo were both wonderful hosts that made checking in and checking out a breeze.
Beautiful, historic location. Kendra was there for us when we needed her to be.

Great place. Looks even better in person. Located in a good neighborhood.
Kind host.
LaKesha was an amazing host and always responded quickly which was so helpful!!
Overall stay was great! Destine allowed us flexible check in and out times. Location was about 20 minutes away from everywhere we went.
Great place to stay! It was just like pictured. Very cozy and big house. The train is walking distance as well, making it easy to get to the city. Host was very responsive and friendly!
David and Cathy were wonderful hosts who have prepared a very comfortable and welcoming space for guests where access to their neighborhood and unit are very convenient.
Beautiful home and great communication from the host.

easy check in. felt like a very nice hotel with two rooms and a balcony. plenty of space. you didn’t have to talk to any hosts which was amazing. it was so clean and well stocked. we went for lollapalooza and it was so walkable and a great location.
10/10 would recommend. THANK YOU KASA

Stayed with a couple friends for a long weekend.  Perfect location to experience downtown Chicago.  Erma was an easy and great host.
Doris was responsive when we had questions about check-in and answered everything in a helpful way :)
It's a comfy little place to stay. Very friendly people and very knowledgeable on local things to do. Even helped find cheaper and safer transportation. overall would stay here again.

Since I don’t drive to Chicago I really liked how easy it was to get around by walking/walking to the subway to get to other places like downtown. Tetyana is an incredible host. She constantly checked in and made sure we had everything we needed and constantly made sure we were content. She was very responsive when I arrived and had some questions.

I recommend her place to anyone looking to stay in Chicago!
Beautiful view and great location!

If you are looking for adventure, hospitality and a great time this is the place to stay! It's within walking distance to the train for easy access to downtown Chicago. Thank-you for everything!
he was very nice and helpful. he even helped me carry my luggage upstairs! would stay here again!
very helpful and communicative, located close to transport and very nice place

Myself and the people in the group agreed that he was the best host any of us have had!
Thankyou for everything chuck!

Home is located on a peaceful street and we really enjoyed our stay! Felt safe, walked to local transit, and felt comfortable in the home as well. The hospitality Karen provided was greatly appreciated. I would stay here again!

very happy that the room had two comfortable beds and a lock on the door for safety and a double lock on the entry doors to the home, the room was very spacious and had a nice desk to do work. however the overhead fan did not work, the ‘AC’ in the room kept coming unhooked which lead to the room becoming hotter than outside. the fridge was not clean when we arrived and was never clean the entire 6 days we stayed, with leftover food left and a busted milk carton left in the door. we found dead bugs in the living room and the bathroom. in the bathroom the shower knobs were duct-taped into the wall and the shower head was leaking and weak and out of a hole in the wall. the tub was also very slippery from built up residue. while the cleaning people came we did not witness any cleaning besides a light mop and the trash taken out and the trash was only taken out once the entire stay.
however i do appreciate them letting us stay an extra night after our flight was cancelled unexpectedly
We ran into a few issues while we were there. Honestly I don’t think I’ll come back. The area it self just was not safe at all. Drug addicts and homeless people everywhere.

Great location, accessible to all of Chicago. We loved Pete’s local grocery store as well which was right around the corner. Condo was well secured, clean and roomy. We enjoyed the back patio. Parking was convenient and easy. Would recommend Alan’s place and we will definitely stay again.

Great place to stay! This room was perfect for a single person. Did not have problems with other guests (great rules and expectations set by host!) Neighborhood was quiet and finding parking was easy.

The location of this apartment was stellar- my friends and I were able to walk everywhere we wanted to go. The photos were accurate and the space was very clean. Any time I messaged the hosts, they were very quick to respond and extremely helpful.

Jeffrey was more than accommodating and super communicative! The location was PERFECT and the neighborhood was very quiet and safe. I would definitely recommend this room to anyone visiting the area, it has all of the amenities you’d need 🤭

Gracjan’s place was a perfect escape from the busy city. We came in to town for Lollapalooza and being able to enjoy some peace and quiet before/after the festival was AMAZING. The space was clean and welcoming, the neighbors are nice and Gracjan was a great and prompt host.

We stayed here for lollapalooza 2024. Great location and very friendly price for only being 10 miles outside downtown. Description is accurate. Attic turned into a smaller studio apartment. We only used the place to sleep and get ready in the morning. I would stay again while visiting Chicago.

Had a great time in Chicago!

Communication was great and the place was comfortable and had most basic needs.

Christopher was very responsive to our needs along the way — we’re so appreciative of his active engagement. Thanks again for opening your place to us - it’ll be a forever memory for us.

This Airbnb was perfect for our trip to Chicago! Angelica was extremely responsive, kind, and super helpful. Our stay at Martha’s was amazing! We had the perfect quiet retreat after long days in Chicago! Everything was as described and Martha was extremely friendly and helpful!

Also, for the checkout instructions we were asked to go through the back yard and take the trash to the can in the alley. However, the backyard was quite dirty, lots of trash laying around, and I had to squeeze through bushes to get to the alley. Those definitely need to be trimmed. We also had quite a bit of heavy rain and the basement was somewhat flooded afterwards- could have been bad if we left stuff down there.

The room itself has a comfy bed, fan, dresser. No AC but it was fine. Kitchen is well-equipped and Garfield metro is a 5-7 minute bus ride away.
Simple room with comfy double bed. Kitchen and bathroom were fine, as expected in a shared space. Great location, would stay again.
The place was very comfy for us to stay. There was a kitchen with fridge available, nice dining area, and a living room for relaxing.
It was a great stay and so close to the blue line to see all of Chicago. Would stay again for sure!

Loved my time here and the hosts were amazing! My first time using Airbnb and I had such a great experience.

friendly, cozy, and helpful hostesses! wonderful environment and many amenities provided! would 100% stay here again!!

Great place to stay. Very responsive host and a nice quiet area to live.

Wir waren als Familie zu viert 3 Tage in der Wohnung und haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und genügend Platz gehabt. Die Küche ist sehr gut ausgestattet.  Chicago ist mit der Red Line gut erreichbar und an spielfreien Tagen kann man auch gut mit dem Auto zur Haltestelle fahren und dort parken. Als wir ein Problem hatten und Teresa angerufen hatten, hat sie sehr schnell reagiert. Vielen Dank!
I stayed here for two months. The location is great and the host is very communicative and helpful.
Great place to live. Amazing location. Hosts were very warm. Patio has great vibes. Perfect for a low key stay in a great neighborhood in Chicago.
Solid stay, good host, clean living area, beautiful backyard area
Olga is wonderful and incredibly helpful! It's a great place to stay, and I would recommend!

We really enjoyed our stay in this Airbnb, the area is very close to the blue line so it was easy to get into town and back again.
The house is spacious and comfortable, any issues that arose were fixed as soon as possible by Martin.
Overall it is an ideal place to stay in chicago even if you don’t have a car.

Victor is a great host who is very responsive. Kept the place clean and items stocked. The house is close to a park, store and parking across the street. The only downside I have is the bed. It’s a bit soft for my liking but other than that can’t complain. I enjoyed my stay.
Brian's place is perfect for anything downtown Chicago. It is located in the heart of everything. Very easy to walk anywhere in the City. I would recommend for sure.
Very spacious rental, which was great since I was commuting to work in the area.  Close to public transport. Mostly quiet neighborhoods.

This is a terrific location and an incredible value. If you’re coming to spend time in the city, it’s beautifully located away from all the hubbub closer to downtown and other close in neighborhoods, well-being, easily accessible to them. Samuel is a very pleasant host and Nadar stay very easy and comfortable. Couldn’t recommend it more and stay again.
clean and quiet

Best kitchen I have experienced so far, lots of dishes, pots, pans and cooking tools available, free coffee. Jeff communicated well and early, making it easy to adjust in the wake of flight cancellations and delays. Perfect room if you have little luggage to carry up three flights of stairs. Wardrobe to store and hang closes helps managing the space well. A desk but no room for a chair, which you could borrow from the dining room if needed. Quite location makes it convenient when you fly in/out of O'Hare, half way to downtown. W/D in the kitchen with laundry pods available make it so convenient for travelers. Definitely on my return shortlist.

My family greatly enjoyed our stay. The home was gorgeous and had every amenity you could need. Andersonville is a beautiful town, and I can't wait to visit again. Nicholas and Jesse were wonderful hosts as well.
felt at home and Carl was helpful, accessible to the bus ( 55 Garfield bus midway/ science & industry musuem) orange ( western)/ green line (Garfield) cta train. thank you for your help.
Great set up enjoyed the common space

Lucas
Thank you very much! We had a blast. The Crash Pad was perfect. Thank you for everything.
Imovel corresponde exatamente a descrição e fotos. Bem limpo e bem localizado. Todo o processo foi muito facil, desde a reserva ate checkout.

This is a nice location - lots of places to eat and easy access to train - and the place looks as advertised, if not smaller.
However, the studio is above a garage and when the hosts open and close the garage it is a noisy and jarring experience, particularly early in the morning when the host goes to work. The shower is nice - but only a pump soap provided (we had to go buy shampoo) - and the toilet flush is spotty at best. Also, the Kuerig worked once during our four-day stay. Overall, it is a fine accommodation …as long as your hopes aren’t inflated by the other reviews.

Ich hatte eine tolle Zeit bei Judy. Die Unterkunft war sehr sauber und ruhig gelegen. Auf den Straßen in der idyllischen Nachbarschaft laufen Eichhörnchen und kleine Hasen! Zur Blue Line sind es ca 15 Minuten, man kann aber auch den 56 Bus (Milwaukee Ave) nehmen. Judy war sehr freundlich und man hatte viel Privatsphäre im Haus.

This is the second time I've stayed with Zhi and had a very pleasant stay. He's upgraded the bathroom and kitchen since the last time I was there.
He always responds within an hour for any requests. For what you pay to stay, it's an outstanding alternative to expensive hotels in the city.
If you happen to love Chinese and Asian fusion foods, there is no better place to stay than in Chinatown. The El Train is a walkable distance, plus McCormack Place is about a mile away. If you're on a budget and need to attend a conference there, Zhi's got the hookup.
Be aware that Zhi has a typical 3-story Chinatown walkup. You get a private room on one of the floors that features 2 shared bathrooms and a kitchen on each floor. The rooms are spartan, but you didn't come to Chicago to hang out in a room. It's where you store your luggage and get a good night's rest. Then explore the city the next day.
When in Chicago, I will continue to stay with Zhi. He's the best deal in town.
Great place not too far out of the city center! Free street parking available near the location.
Great place will be back!

First of all, Angelica is the most attentive host I’ve encountered.  The place is clean and has pretty much everything you need.  It is on the 3rd floor and ok for younger people but would not recommend it for seniors.  The master BR bed is very comfortable but the single bed is a little uncomfortable and I believe this place is more for a younger couple and not as accommodating for more than that.  It is close to the blue line and easy to get around with a Ventra week pass.  Easy access to and from O’Hare and into town.
A great place to stay

Very beautiful, quiet road. The house was perfect for what we needed! Loved the front sitting room to end the evening in. Also really enjoyed close proximity to the train. Loved dinner at Regalia! Definitely worth the splurge!
Nice place to stay

Had the pleasure to stay here for 3 months for a work related trip. This place had everything I could have needed and it was super comfortable. Camillia & Phillip were always responsive and made my stay feel like home. Super grateful for a lucky find.

Très bien situé du centre-ville,
Chambres impeccables, services au Top.
La seule surprise plusieurs taxes à payer en plus de la caution.
Mais comme même a recommandé.
Fantastic place to stay!! Wonderfully clean and neat, beautiful room, and perfectly located! Loved it, will stay here again when I come to Chicago!
Definitely enjoyed my stay there. Very quiet and safe area. The location is 10 minutes from Midway Airport and the same time to get to venue where the weekend event was. Will definitely use again.

Great location and good space.   The Logan Square/Wicker Park is a fun location with restaurants and bars nearby.  The host was very accomodating and responsive.   Thanks for sharing your place with us!
Thanks for a great stay! Easy to get to metro and into the city. Convenient, quiet and spacious.

The place was just ok.  Little things, like the lack of salt and pepper, were bothersome.  We couldn't control the temperature in the place, so we were uncomfortably warm.  The place needs updated.  Wallpaper is peeling, there were stains in the bathtub, and no lamp in the living room - just an overhead light, not the best ambiance.  Parking was a challenge and pretty expensive.  The place was very close to Wrigley, which was our destination, so that was nice.
Angie was super at communicating with us. She responded immediately to questions prior to and during g our stay. The place was quiet, clean and comfortable.

Brett was a fantastic host and I would absolutely recommend staying at his Airbnb. The place itself was in a great location (right by the train and a quick walk to the lake). The Airbnb was clean and spacious, and was perfect for my extended Chicago stay. Brett was extremely responsive and friendly. Overall, a great stay!

There were six women in the apartment and downstairs suite, and we had plenty of room, beds, linens, etc. Everything is well-marked. The place is well-appointed and well-stocked. The balcony and the yard are very nice. Easy to walk or Uber to where we wanted to go. We all had a wonderful, comfortable long weekend and would stay here again in the future.

Our stay at Dustin’s place was booked last minute when our travel dates changed and he was very communicative and responsive with any questions I had. We had three adults and two dogs in our party, and were arriving to the city in an oversized van so unfortunately we were able to utilize the garage (which is an awesome amenity in the city), but found street parking to be plentiful within a block of the home - which Dustin provides instructions for should you be driving and not using the garage. The neighborhood is stunning and we never tired of taking walks all around. Our stay centered around a Cubs game and the walk to Wrigley took no more than 20 minutes which was fantastic. For as much as there was to do around the unit, the street was peaceful and quiet. The interior of this place was clean, comfortable, and warm - we immediately felt like we were home (the pups, too)!  I personally loved all the natural light coming into the home. We would highly recommend this stay for anyone.

This apartment was beautiful and immaculate. I’ve stayed in so many Airbnb’s and never came across one as clean as this one was.
We were in town for my daughter’s wedding. It was nice to come “home “ at the end of our hectic days to such a clean place that felt very comfortable and homey.
The gentleman who checked us in, Ross, could not have been kinder or more helpful. He even provided us with an extra set of keys because we were all going in different directions over the week.
Ross provided us with a binder that had all the information a visitor needed about the neighborhood. It had maps, train information and even several restaurant recommendations ( we ended up trying 2 of them) and even take out menus. It was so very helpful especially since we didn’t know the area.
The apartment was well appointed with plenty of towels ,extra blankets if needed and a kitchen ready for cooking.
Definitely recommend and I will definitely look into booking next time I’m in town
Andy was a really nice host, provided clear instructions to get inside the house and just overall it was a nice place to stay at.

L'appartement est très joliment agencé. Il se trouve dans un quartier calme et comporte un agréable jardin à l'arrière. Un bus à proximité permet d'accéder à la station de métro, qui vous emmène en 30 minutes jusqu'au Loop.
Jennifer est une hôte prévenante, réactive et très arrangeante.
Je recommande vivement l'endroit, un bon emplacement pour découvrir Chicago.

Andris was really good at communication and he was so friendly and helpful
I did really like staying in there
Safe area, easy access to everything

Worth staying here! Couple of minutes from the central green line station, parallel street parking in front of the house and 2min walk from the bus stop. It’s a perfect quiet area. I very much would continue staying here.

We enjoyed the our stay. Be aware of steps, little steep when traveling with little kids and parents. Otherwise great place !
We had unexpected noise, the neighbors had party with loud sounds on the day of checkin that was on Saturday, other days was quite though.
Elderly people needs to be aware of the steps and house rule to put trash away at checkout, need to come all the way down.
Parking needs to be done on the road. But there was no issue finding spot.
Over all stay was great !

Instructions were very clear and any questions or concerns I had were addressed promptly by the host, both before and during my stay. I stayed for a month and the host made sure I had everything I needed. While I was there, people were friendly and respectful with sharing the common areas. Most of the time they were free so it wasn’t a hassle to shower in the evenings or watch my shows on the tv. Overall a pleasant stay!
If you are attending a Cubs game this is a must stay if available!  We felt very safe the entire time!  Everything was in walking distance!

Excellent location!!  You can walk to a lot of places. However, just remember all that you have to pay after you pay for your room. for ONE night I had to pay an extra $83 + $125 (which you'll get back) + $75 for parking (only option).

Het is een heel mooi ruim huis in een goede buurt.  Je bent direct bij de metro. Er zijn winkels en restaurantjes. Het enige dat vervelend is, is dat je de airco zelf niet kunt regelen.  Je bent verplicht. om in een frigo te zitten, en die dingen blazen dan 's nachts ijskoude lucht op je. Wij, Europeanen zijn geen airco gewoon en  vinden dat ook niet fijn.
Nette kleine Wohnung. War sehr sauber. Alles bestens.
Excelente estadía, regresaré sin duda

We had a very nice stay. We never actually got to see Onelia during our time there, as we were always out and about doing something, but whenever we had questions, she was quick to reply. I was a little confused about the security system, but overall it wasn't a big deal. The space we were staying in was clean and we were provided with extra towels/toiletries/etc, as well as snacks. There were no issues with sharing the full bathroom with the rest of the family. Overall, we had a good stay.

Denise and Paul were super accommodating. Their place was a wonderful place for our family to hang out and catch up. The outdoor space was great for a chicago accommodation. I would highly recommend their place!!
very nice, very clean,  the pool and communal spaces were beautiful. should have ling size beds for one bedroom apartments if going to be treated like a hotel.
The host is very kind and flexible! The room and space are pleasant, with thoughtful touches. The location is not ideal, but transport is easy

Paul's flat in Andersonville is fabulous.  Beautifully decorated in period but eclectic style, the apartment was comfortable, with all the amenities.  The beds were great, the kitchen fully stocked with the basics and the entire place was spotless.   The street is quiet, tree-lined and wonderfully walkable.  The neighborhood is filled with great local restaurants and businesses.   Paul was prompt in responding to our questions.  We will be back.

All went well, except the bedroom on the first floor had no curtains or blinds. We had to prop up pillows and blankets for privacy.
Also, the bedroom upstairs with 2 beds… one of the windows was missing curtains which brought in alot of light in the morning.
The house is spacious and nicely decorated. It was perfect space for our group.
The street was quiet and peaceful. It’s about a 15-20 minute walk to the green line train station.
We enjoyed our stay!
Ebony and her family felt like old friends after only a little while. The bed is very comfortable and the house is very nice.

My husband and I had a great stay at Martha's studio. The space is so cozy and homey, with a lot of natural light, and I was tempted to skip our planned activities because I didn't want to leave the space! Everything you need for a comfortable stay was provided. Martha and her husband were so warm and welcoming, and shared helpful information about the space and the neighborhood.
The studio is close (5-10 minutes walking) to multiple bus lines that got us into the city, but it did take at least an hour on the public transit to get into the downtown area and back. Despite the distance, we would stay here again on a future visit!
Great place to sleep for a couple nights, not tall friendly. But if you are smaller like myself, it’s a good place just to sleep. Its was nice and clean.
Crystal was a very friendly host with a beautiful home in a quiet neighborhood. Had plenty of room for my friends and I. Would book this place again.

Carl was very accommodating even though we booked last-minute. The place is a great deal for Chicago, and is near a convenient bus line. It is a shared apartment unit, but the occupants were polite, quiet, and helpful. There were fresh sheets and towels waiting for us on the bunkbeds, and we didn’t have any issues with sharing the bathroom. The door to the bedroom has a key for privacy, and no neighbor’s windows outside of the window in the room. The area was quiet whenever we were around at night and in the morning. Overall a very comfortable and affordable place to stay!

Great host. Everything was as described and in a perfect, fun location. It stands out because it’s the only house in between a long line of concrete buildings. There’s only one blanket and the pillows are kind of rough, but the price is right and it’s nice and private. The house is pretty cool, too.
Alex and Sean are great hosts and the place was perfect for us. Clean, comfortable, quiet and the location was great. We walked daily to Damen Avenue which has a lot to offer.  We highly recommend!!

This was a wonderful location for us for what we needed to be doing on our visit. Quiet neighborhood, great food just blocks away. Everything was as it was described to us. Teresa was great about checking on us and seeing that we didn't need anything.
Mark's spot was great -- beautiful, perfectly located, magic. No notes. Highly recommend.

Anais place was great. I was welcomed by her father whom was extremely nice! He made sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed. Anais was very responsive if I texted her. We stayed for some days for the Nike Nationals that week and Anais and her father made sure I felt right at home. Stairs were a little steep but her father helped us with all of our luggage. I will stay there again.
Cool art! Safe area! Thanks!
first half of my stay with Delia, everything has been great so far!
My family of 5 stayed in Phebes home this includes a toddler and an infant. Everything was as listed very clean and put together.
Thank you for the stay!!
Great location and easy communication. We’d stay again for sure!

We had a great stay and it was a good size and location to host our two small families. The yard was awesome for the kids and the hot tub was great! It is a bit creaky upstairs  as you get with old houses. Plenty of blankets. Kitchen was lacking for cooking and lamps in room would be nice. Hopefully more to come as it sounds like it is just getting started! I would stay there again, Andrea was great and super helpful!
Great location with easy access to Lincoln Square, a very clean, modern, and comfortable loft, and a warm and welcoming host who was responsive to our questions. Highly recommended!
Thank you Alan for sharing your home! The location could not have been better for exploring the city.

Our hosts were very kind and responsive. The unit was nice, clean, and family friendly. The neighbors were friendly the neighborhood was peaceful during the morning hours. We were 20 minutes from downtown (driving in normal traffic). Overall, we had a great experience.

Hannah's place was a great place to crash for a few days during a recent trip to Chicago. The location is very close to the trains, lots of great restaurants, and even a grocery store. The place was very tidy when I arrived. Only downside to note is that (not unusual for Chicago apartments), the A/C is provided through window units so there are some rooms that can get quite warm during the day.

The location was perfect as it was near my family. Pricing was a bit more than I would have preferred but Andrew made it worth it. He was prompt in his response to our every need - even delivering a new oven when the first one did not work. The space allowed my family room to spread out and just relax during a difficult week. Thanks so much for having us in your space.
Gran anfitriona. Muy atenta y proceso de alojamiento muy sencillo. Siempre hubo agua y todo lo necesario. Lo recomiendo

We had a wonderful 5-week stay at this beautiful apartment. From the moment we arrived, we were impressed by how well-maintained and tastefully decorated the space was. The communication with the host was excellent throughout our stay—they were always responsive and friendly. Any maintenance issues that came up were handled immediately and efficiently. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and hassle-free stay. We’ll definitely be back next year if the unit is available!
Naj’s home was quiet and clean! He controlled the air conditioning, not as cool as we would like.
Good stay!
Nice room & bathroom, easy check in/out, good comms w/ host.

A beautiful home in a quiet Chicago neighborhood with garage parking available. The house had everything we needed for our weekend trip. Location is a short ride to the Logan Square commercial district where there are several bars and restaurants. Public transportation is also available to get to anywhere in the city. Stephanie is a great host!

My family and I had a great time at the loft! The big open common area was perfect for us to gather, lots of comfy seating. the ability to hang out was one of the reasons why we booked this place. The location was excellent, it was really fun to explore Wicker Park on foot and we were able to readily find parking. parking on the main street is paid, but you can download an app and manage it from there. also a warning, there's a flight of stairs up to the loft, and two of the three bedrooms are up another flight of stairs. It was fine for us, but a heads up for those with heavy luggage. kitchen was well stopped, Wi-Fi and TV were all set up. figuring out which switches controlled which lights took a minute but super easy. The app made it very convenient for everyone to access and lock up the loft. If we had a group of people that needed to stay in Chicago again, we would definitely come back!

I had a great time at Allyn's place. The area was very quiet and with plenty of places nearby to get some groceries or food. It was quite easy to use public transport to get blue line to downtown Chicago.
The apartment was comfortable and well equipped.

Zhi’s place was perfect for us on a recent weekend getaway to Chicago. We didn’t mind the shared spaces since we mostly just needed an affordable place to sleep comfortably at night and this fit the bill! It was quiet and Zhi was always helpful and responsive.
Home was more spacious than we thought and very well maintained. Excellent experience.

Freshly renovated building and grounds , everything was beautiful and clean. Kitchen had all the necessities, large refrigerator! Three bedrooms and two bathrooms provides ample space to host us with our two adult children. There was ample room to store your items in the dresser or bedroom closet. Very easy access, free parking out front, well lit at night and a moments walk to the metro train station for easy access to anywhere in the city! We absolutely loved this home and working with Lashaun.

The house was perfect. The neighborhood was beautiful and felt very safe. Everyone loved being there. There are plenty of bathrooms so no waiting. The kitchen is gorgeous. The train tracks are directly behind the house but the noise is minimal and almost soothing. Only one person needed the whitenoise machines. TV's in each bedroom and both living rooms allowed us to keep evryone happy including the grandbabies. The area is truly fantastic and will definitely book this place for our next visit. Nicole & Matt were very helpful throughout the process and left very clear and reasonable instructions for our stay and checkout. This place is fantastic.
Perfect spot for our quick weekend trip! The hosts were nice and easy to access!

This is a really good spot for the price. Paid parking is across the street but the train station was about a 10 minute walk away and has a cheaper parking option. Finding the door to the place was a little tricky because the address is for a shop, but the door to get in is inconspicuous and off to the side of the shop entrance. The room itself was well kept and clean. The AC was not the best during my stay here in July but certainly not unbearable. This area felt overall safe to me as someone who is paranoid about that sort of thing. Again, really great value for the price you pay.
Very spacious master bedroom! Pictures don’t do justice. Enjoyed our stay
Great weekend! Property is right next to Wrigley and the rooftop deck was awesome.
We loved our stay at the Hooch! Walking distance to Andersonville and a beautiful neighborhood. Nicholas was friendly and an excellent host. Highly recommend!

We had a great stay at Nikkole's place - it was well suited for 10 of us. The neighborhood was really nice/convenient, and parking was super easy to find as well. Nikkole was an excellent host, very communicative and helpful.
Four bedrooms and lots of room.  Two full bathrooms, lots of TVs and beautiful kitchen.
Amazing location and a great host!

Tom and Megan allowed our group visiting in Chicago to stay last minute because our original reservation cancelled on us 30 mins before check in. They were very friendly and responsive and they have a beautiful
Home. While the description does say they’re pet friendly and love cats, we didn’t expect the overwhelming car dander smell upon arrival. They do have candles around so lighting those while we were home, definitely helped some. We didn’t have paper towels at one point but they ordered them and they came within hours. They offered us a bottle of wine and access to their fridge drinks as well.
Great place, family friendly! Would recommend and would stay there again.
Elizabeth was an excellent host and everything was as described and pictured! Great central location and great place to stay. I would highly recommend and book again on my next trip!
Pictures accurately described the inside.
Great host and location. We love this area and it was so nice to come back and visit.
J’ai aimé beaucoup la qualité de l’appartement. C’était très frais et j’ai aimé la lumière par les fenêtres. Cependant, je ne pouvez pas trouver des casseroles pendant quelques temps.

The brown line is about a 10 minute walk away. There are nearby restaurants, a grocery about a mile away. The bed was comfortable, both firm and soft pillows. Yanko was quick to respond. All in all, a solid place to stay for two weeks.

John was a wonderful host. Quick responses to our messages. Room was as expected. Perhaps a link to the site for transparency about the stairs? Good price for this area. A bit noisy especially at night. Can hear people in nearby rooms. None of this was something that would stop us from staying again. Easy to walk to restaurants and shops.
Host was very responsive and kind. Quickly reacted to short internet outage.

Dave was very friendly and responsive. The location was not as safe feeling and clean as I expected, but I was not familiar with Chicago to begin with. The apartment was mostly clean and had plenty of towels, dishes, etc. You could hear a lot of traffic noise, but we never heard noise from other people. Overall it was a good stay, and it worked well for us. Thank you!
Great space, easy parking. No issues at all. We had a great time in Chicago and enjoyed our stay.

Great location
Quiet bedrooms
Very convenient location
Well resourced kitchen

We truly loved the cottage ! It was even better in person than when we had looked at it virtually. We adored the fact everything was cleaned well and set up for us. It was a great experience for all of us , I definitely would recommend !

Absolutely, without a doubt, this rental must place in bold caps that getting to your unit requires navigating a set of steep, narrow stairs and dark hallways. I would not have elected to stay in a place where I would have to carry my luggage up this many stairs, quite frankly. Having said that, the location was pretty convenient as to make a lot of my stay walkable. Still, a funky neighborhood with both gorgeous homes and abandoned buildings.
The bed was comfortable, but the furniture was a bit uncomfortable for me, though someone else might not feel the same. There should be printed instructions on how to get to YouTube TV just as the instructions are printed in excruciating detail regarding coffee maker, dishwasher and stove.
The unit was true to the photos--the only problem for me was that I did not find the furniture to be comfortable.
Clean and safe place to stay. Easy access to public transportation
all in all the price dor last minute and the placement was pristine
Great basement unit, perfect for those wanting lots of privacy. Perfect location and pleasant backyard area to soak up some sun.

My family and I had a great stay. We traveled downtown and to Wrigley field with ease as the train station and multiple bus stations were close by. The place itself was very comfortable and had everything we needed. We would highly recommend Kate’s place and would love to return if I have other visitors come to Chicago

It was a nice place and a good location for a good price, and nice and clean, it was smaller than I imagined by the photos, both the living room and the bedrooms, and was darker because it is was in the basement and there were fewer windows.  Also, the air conditioning never really cooled the apartment down even though we left it on the whole time.

Very nice 2 bed, 2 bath apartment.  10 minute walking distance from train stations. Huge master bed and bath and overall a big place for a family to stay comfortably. A little pricey but everything is these days.
Victor is a great host who always responds to our concerns and get them sorted ASAP.
I had a great stay here. Jennifer was very responsive and helpful when messaging throughout the month-long trip.

Clean space and friendly hosts. Right down the street from the Howard station. It’s a great place to stay if you love Rogers Park. There’s just enough space for one person or a couple. It’s a garden unit so there’s not much sunlight, but doesn’t matter if you’ll be out and about anyway.
This space is affordable and left me wanting for nothing. It’s quiet and peaceful. A great place to retreat to after a busy day in the city. 10/10 recommend.

DO NOT stay here. Martin contacted me outside of the Airbnb app to inform me that I could not check in on the dates I paid for because the city of Chicago was doing an inspection (shady, and I have since reported him to the city of Chicago). Martin is just plain creepy.
The noise in this tiny gross “apartment” with the el tracks running is at 104.7 dB. I kid you not. The place is tiny, gross, strange dudes hang out in the walkway and alley, the internet is unreliable and Martin is not to be trusted. Please do all your communication with him within the Airbnb app.
I had to cancel my stay after 3 days and have lost almost 3k due to this mistake. Please don’t put yourself through what I went through. Choose another place ESPECIALLY if you are a female.
I’ve since booked a new place and I cannot tell how happy I am I’m out of Martin’s horrible place. Entire experience was absolutely awful!

Unglaublich schöner Aufenthalt bei Brenda, so freundlich und zuvorkommend, ich habe mich gleich wohlgefühlt und gut geschlafen. Alles super saube. Ich wurde gleich so freundlich empfangen und die umliegende Gegend ist sehr zu empfehlen, ich bin gleich zum Wrigley Field gegangen :) Beim nächsten Chicago Besuch werde ich da wieder übernachten.

L'appartamento è molto bello, spazioso e ben strutturato: le due camere sono di dimensioni ottimali e lo spazio non manca se ci si soggiorna per più giorni come noi. C'è tutto quello di cui si ha bisogno, la cucina è ben fornita e la presenza della lavatrice e asciugatrice è impagabile. La vista lago poi è molto rilassante. Il posto auto esterno è comodissimo.
Posizione ottima per visitare tutta la zona nord di Chicago (necessaria l'auto). Se si vuole andare in centro a Chicago invece, poco distante c'è una stazione della metro linea rossa che porta in città.

The room is very clean. The facilities in the house are very interesting. The surrounding area is also very safe! Judy is a very warm-hearted and tasteful lady. I will come again if there is a chance next time.

I stayed here for over a month and it was very accommodating. Great walkable neighborhood with friendly neighbors. Easy drive to work but also close to public transportation.
The house was bigger than I thought. Had everything I needed. And if I needed to get something there was a target 2 mins away.
I would 100% stay here again.
Thank you so much!

L'appartement de Charla est très bien situé, dans le quartier de l'université. Il y a beaucoup de nature et les rues sont très paisibles, tout en étant proche de commerces et de restaurants. L'appartement est un peu ancien mais cela lui donne beaucoup de charme, et il dispose de tout ce dont on peut avoir besoin. Charla a été d'une grande aide et d'une grande réactivité, en plus d'avoir de petites attentions très gentilles. Je recommande fortement.

Great place for a reasonable price.

Enjoyed my stay here for a month. The host is very responsive, welcoming and accommodating. The view is lovely. The location is perfect and is in the heart of the city close to grocery stores, restaurants, shopping and entertainment all within walking distance. Recommend!

I appreciated being able to get in early after our flight kept getting changed. I did have to call / text about getting in since I had not received the check in email.
It looked like the place was still going through some construction as there was cuts in the drywall that hadn’t been patched. The bathroom room was broken and had to be lifted to close. As stated earlier in the review there were areas that needed to be cleaned. Towels were really damp when we arrived. There were items that I expected to be there, window covering of some kind over the windows, wash cloths and utensils. The tv apps would just buffer even after resetting the router.
My husband and I stayed here for our honeymoon in late June. We LOVED it. It was clean, has a nice view of the city and walking distance to food and grocery stores we needed to get to.
Comfy, clean, easy to find.
Great location for the city centre
Ethan was very communicative and flexible with our needs. We had a very nice stay

We had an amazing stay! Clean and conformable. Fantastic city view, especially at nite. Modern and updated. The location is a short walk to the subway and very close to downtown. We can’t say enough good things about our stay - we loved it.
When we come back to Chicago, this is the only place we will stay. It’s perfect. .
