Great location and a very clean place to stay. There’s a nice little grocery around the corner, and it’s super accessible with the blue line stop two blocks away. Highly recommend!

Thanks Aly for a great stay. My colleague and I were in town for a conference taking place nearby and Aly’s apartment was perfect for us. We really appreciated having a doorman, and lots of elevators so never had to wait long. Walking distance to plenty of restaurants, great bars (try Monks) and public transportation. Also excellent AC - which was needed because it was a hot week in the city.
Highly recommend for your stay in Chicago.
Great and clean space. The house is beautiful and practical.
Great place to stay within working distance of U Chicago and some nice cafes/restaurants. The rooms were spotless and had lots of convenient amenities.
Yinqing was nice enough to let me back in after I locked myself out near midnight-- very grateful!

My stay, was excellent. It was quiet. Just what I needed. Perfect location not to far from downtown Chicago. The bus stop is right in front of the building. Overall I had an nice stay. I would recommend it
Nice, clean, well decorated.

Carol and Kevin were great hosts for us—very responsive and helpful. We are a family with small kids and had a great time in their house. The house has everything needed for a long stay, and the area is very peaceful and great for kids.
Good Stay ... Masato is very committed yo to ykwe care of any request...

Tivemos uma excelente estadia na casa do Andy e gostamos muito. Sua casa é super agradável, confortável, limpa, bonita, prática e funcional. Transporte fácil para o centro da cidade, próximo a supermercados, restaurantes e conveniências. Andy e Agustin são excelentes anfitriões, simpáticos, atenciosos, fazem tudo para deixar o hóspede a vontade e muito bem acomodado. Comunicação excelente. Parabéns Andy e Agustin. Gostamos muito e recomendamos com certeza.

Great Stay! Host was very accommodating and provided a clean, safe and quiet environment.
Thank you!
Great location, has a bus stop close by and restaurants you could walk to. Large backyard and cozy vibe

We loved this Airbnb!  It was spacious, immaculate and had tons of personality!  I stayed with my daughter and her 5 year old and the trundle bed worked out perfectly. My queen bed was really comfortable- always a plus!! The neighborhood is walkable - great for dining, coffee and even a playground!
Host very accommodating and responsive. Room was clean and efficient. Green line within short walking distance. I’d stay here again in a heartbeat.
x

Cozy is definitely the word for this listing! I enjoyed my stay in the burgeoning Bronzeville neighborhood. We went to a couple of nearby wineries/brewery and enjoyed the proximity to Hyde Park as well. Easy access to Lakeshore Drive to head up north as well, and the water was a short distance from the place! The hosts were very hospitable, friendly, and went above and beyond to ensure we were comfortable during our stay.
Anna is warm, the apartment is quiet and peaceful and clean. Will definitely go back if need be. I got the place for my friends, they left extremely happy with their stay.
Good stay. Erick was responsive and the place was clean as pictured

Margaret was a very responsive host. Main level is spacious, bedrooms could use some updating, but it was very nice plus it had a/c on the main level. Upstairs could get hot but one of the bedrooms has a window unit. Neighborhood was walkable, good restaurants nearby. Blue Line runs one block over so you hear it,
but ends up becoming more white noise at night. Was concerned that there was not another lock on the front door after you climb up the stairs to enter the actual living space, but front entrance door seemed secure with deadbolt. All in all would return as it was very comfortable space and had a new washer/dryer so great for traveling families.

Excellent stay! Flora was super communicative, helpful, offered us a flexible check-in time, and sent clear instructions following my reservation. The room as well as the private bathroom were thoroughly clean, and as described in the listing.
The extended stay was just what we needed. The neighborhood is lively with loads of restaurants and stores nearby. There are bus stops within walking distance, and the blue line train station is close by for easy commuting.
I found the queen size bed very comfortable with soft pillows, blanket, and comforter, I slept pretty well! I enjoyed watching movies and shows on the smart TV, in addition to fast Wi-Fi.
The room included shelving for storage, sliding drawers, a mini fridge, a full size mirror, clothing rack, adequate lighting from multiple sources. Plus, the A/C unit suited my need for cool air during the hot summer season.
Overall, I am very pleased with the stay as it exceeded our expectations. Thank you very much for accommodating us!

Roberto was so kind and welcoming to us all. We had a small query with the kitchen and he was there to help within the hour. The house is super clean and much bigger than it looks in the pictures which is always a plus. Overall really enjoyed our stay here with Roberto. Super host

Ethan’s place was perfect! 6 minute drive to a conference I was attending at McCormick. We enjoyed walking around the neighborhood exploring local restaurants. Came up on a neighborhood block party on one of our walks.
Fun times! We would definitely stay again when returning to Chicago
Good stay. Convenient and exactly what I expected.
Jeffrey was a great host. He always checked to make sure everything was alright. The neighborhood is also great and quiet.

Worst Airbnb experience I’ve ever had. The room had bugs and smelled of trash and urine; It was also tiny and looked nothing like the pictures. Instead of speaking to a person I was directed to fill out and read 5 different google docs- which made me initially believe I was staying at a well taken care of corporate hotel instead of a dirty basement.
Beautiful space! Really like the apartment and decor. Fit our needs really well. Everything worked in the apartment and bed was comfortable.
Quick walk from the green line if you plan on going downtown during your stay. Very nice place and worth the price.

Jane couldn’t have been more welcoming. She and her husband made me feel like family. Her communication was exactly what I needed, allowing me find my way while remaining available whenever I needed help. I would love to stay in Jane’s home next year when I visit Chicago.
Cool place, nice building with kind tenants. Quiet, walkable neighborhood. Daniel is a great host.

We had a very comfortable stay at Adrienne's unit. Everything looks like the photos! There were 3 of us and we had plenty of room and having 2 bathrooms is always a plus. The kitchen is modern and convenient. The neighborhood is very quiet and it's easy to walk to Roscoe Village and beyond or catch public transportation. Adrienne was very responsive to messages!

The house is not bad it’s wild but there is no ac only living room have the rest of rooms are no ac system . I am not recommending this. And  the couch is too small and old   it’s not enough for 5 guests .

Incredible stay. Irving Park neighborhood is a walkable, family neighborhood. Our family of 7 plus our dog loved having four bed/3 bath house to stretch out in. Spacious kitchen with everything we needed. The real gem was the private garage parking and fenced-in backyard!

Everything went well, quiet and good quarter, around half the way between O’Hare and Downtown Chicago. Very friendly welcome with water and snacks and a personal billboard, that welcomes you. Nice breakfast restaurant “Golden Nugget” down the street.

This cozy apt is what we needed to be close to Wrigley and the L. Bus stop is 150 ft from apt and will connect to L. The neighborhood is very safe w Trader's Joe within walking distance. The apt is clean w shared no coin washer/dryer. The ceiling is perfect for someone 5' 10'' and shorter.
Arman is very helpful and responsive! Glad we found this and will definitely come back!
Loved Eileen's place. Very charming. Considering especially that it's the families primary residence, the home was very clean and well prepared for us.

We stayed at Zhi’s place for 4 days. The location was great at the heart of Chinatown. Easy access to restaurants and public transportation.
The room was a little dusty, the bed itself is ok. The bathroom is shared and the owner keeps it clean quite regularly.
Overall is a great place to stay if you are just looking for a place to sleep and explore the city. But if you’re looking for a more high end hotel experience, look somewhere else.

Roxane was amazing. She was very friendly, responsive, and went above and beyond to accommodate us and make sure we had everything we needed. We felt safe and welcomed. We could not reccomend her more.
I sincerely recommend Allen’s  place

We were in town for a family reunion and this place felt like home! The house was spotless and all amenities listed were available and working properly. No matter the time Alexis was responsive and very friendly. Location was no more than a 15-20 minute drive to the Magnificent Miles and the Navy Pier. We would definitely rent again on future travels to Chicago.

My husband and I absolutely loved our time at the Beach House! It is beautifully decorated and very clean. Check in was a breeze. The kitchen had everything we needed and the beds were very comfortable. Of course the view of lake Michigan was awesome. We enjoyed watching the sail boats while having coffee on the porch. The neighborhood is quiet and lovely with 2 parks within a block. It is close to coffee shops, restaurants, the red line, and groceries. Having a dedicated off street parking spot was a real plus! We highly recommend the Beach House and hope to return.
Great place and great location! Place was clean and private with an awesome view
She did great, checked on us twice, was incredibly sweet
Great location, great place to stay for a group.
Host was very helpful and responsive and the place was clean.
Nicole was AMAZING
Martha was a gracious and welcoming host. Her place had exactly what we needed and was central to the folks we were visiting. We also enjoyed walking the neighborhood when we had a few minutes free.

Urszula has clearly put a lot of effort into making her home a comfortable, creative, and welcoming place for guests. The bed was comfortable and the house was well outfitted.
There is definitely a pet scent in the living room and it was a little dirty in the corners and the shower, but a good value for outside Chicago

Where to begin? Caryl clearly takes pride and joy in creating a place that is ideal, whether you are in a rush, or whether you are willing to linger and savor the details of the place and the atmosphere she has created. CERTAINLY I will try to return every time I have to go to Chicago. Each day started with a breakfast that was nourishing to body and spirit. It is an oasis, and I just hope that it'll be available the next time I need to be in town.
The bed and bedlinen are stylish and I slept so well. The communication was proactive and direct. No complaints at all!

Clean, comfortable place to stay in a nice neighborhood.  Comfortable bed, nice linens.  Good value for the busy weekend I came to Chicago.  Shower's not ideal, but it works.  Window unit AC, strong enough to cool the apartment.

My stay here was fantastic. The host is very nice and responsive, any small issues i had were resolved quickly. It was clean, safe and pleasant. The garage had its own private entrance out back and was easy to get into. The area was great, very safe to walk around in and there was a convenience store nearby for amenities.
I would highly recommend this place if any of my friends were staying in Chicago, and I wish the host good luck!

We enjoyed our stay in the Andersonville neighborhood.  Paul was responsive, clear and prompt in his communications. It was spacious and plenty of room to spread out and enjoy the house. The sunroom in the back was such a nice surprise, along with the well-appointed kitchen. Our family enjoyed our time and will plan to stay here in the future when we visit family in the area.  Worth a five-star review for sure!!
Good for a quick trip, thank you for hospitality!

It is a good place and I felt very comfortable and it is a quiet place, I definitely recommend it if you are going to visit Chicago and also the Beach is very close and Downton I also had an excellent time here. Thanks in addition to the very friendly landlord

Emeka was amazing. Picture matched the actual things inside. He had a vast amount of things for us to cook with, top of the line toiletries, and even came by when I couldn’t get in the rooms to ensure everything was in order from there on out. Great house and an even better host! Thanks, Emeka

- it is WORTH IT!
Clean. SUPER quiet. Lots of amenities nearby (bodegas, restaurants, pubs, etc.)
I can’t recommend it enough.
The balcony is a great way to have a bit of privacy, if you're travelling with others, and the set-up also allows plenty of privacy with the bedrooms on separate floors. Lots of fun places and boutiques nearby. I’d definitely stay again!! (Also gorgeous)

A had a great stay with Katie and Leandro! They were very friendly and helpful, and their place is lovely. Katie was great with communication and she even provided restaurant/tourist guides as well as a little basket of toiletries. I’d definitely recommend for a solo traveler :)
We loved our stay with Florin! They gave us all needed information to get into the airbnb so we had a super smooth check in! Loved our stay and enjoyed a quick walk to Wrigley field!
Very nice place to stay. The host I very communicative and helped with any questions that I had. Will definitely recommend for others
Diamond couldn’t have been nicer. He was prompt to respond in every way. The location was perfect for us. I would stay there again.
We had an amazing stay at Kayode’s place. We stayed for over a month and everything was perfect. Kayode was accommodating, professional, friendly and communicated well.
Absolutely wonderful! Would recommend to anyone traveling to Chicago. Everything is exactly as listed and very responsive host. 5 stars
We loved this place. We were barely in the home but it was everything we needed for this family vacation. Plenty of space and looks like the pictures. Neighbor was very friendly.i will book again
nice place and peaceful inside

The studio is really nice, we could enjoyed the garden so it’s was a plus. Santiago was very kind, he left us the opportunity to make a check in earlier than expected, it really helps us. He answers quickly and can help you if needed. The neighborhood is nice, there is a gas station nearby, places to eat, two bus stops that take you to downtown. It was a good stay !

If I could give Jeannine’s place more than 5 stars, I would! Her home is brand-new, modern architecture both inside and outside. She has a beautiful deck that is in excellent condition. You get an entire floor of the house all to yourself. The whole house has everything you could ever want- shampoo, soap, conditioner, towels. Jeannine made me coffee in the mornings. She was also really enjoyable to talk to. She is really helpful and accomodating. Definitely recommend Jeannine’s place! She went above and beyond!

My stay with Jessie was pleasurable.  She informed me that I was staying at a better location (than what was advertised) close to my check in time.  She greeted me at the door and reiterated the house rules prior to assigning my room.  My room was clean and suitable to my needs (just a place to sleep). The neighborhood may seem sketchy at first, however, it is quite safe.  If you just need the basic amenities during your travels (a clean room and bathroom) then this place is for you.
Best place I have ever stayed at Hank is a standup gentleman and a host that will Help you with all your needs. Location is great. Interior is amazing cant praise this place enough.

el departamento está hermoso y muy completo.
un lugar hermoso para quedarse en Chicago

Great appartment and really great location. The appartment was great, big and as described. The amenities and services in the building (pool, gym, security) were really a great plus. My stay was confortable and i will gladly come back.
I would have appreciated having more silverware, detergent and a card to use the in-building washing machine.
I recommend you to stay in Andrea’s place.
it was super clean and it was a quiet neighborhood sometimes the parking space was hard fine but after all everything was good I could definitely book again if I come back.
The unit was perfect! Great location and plenty of space. The kitchen had everything you would need to cook a gourmet meal.

Carol was one of the nicest people ever, she learned our names before we even arrived, and says she loves seeing people from around the world. It was such a cosy home, we felt comfortable the moment we got in. The garden was beautiful, sat outside on the solstice to see the strawberry moon. She seems to really get to know and enjoy everyone who stays here, telling us different stories (such as one previous group who named the cats that like to visit the garden). The space itself is great, lots of privacy and a peaceful enough neighbourhood. Beds were very comfortable and there's plenty of hot water for showers, and WiFi is available and works very well. Overall an amazing experience, I'd recommend to anyone who wants to stay in the area. If I ever come back to Chicago, will be trying to book this place again!
Super convenient hotel, close to everything and easy check in! Lovely location.

Angie was excellent. She was incredibly responsive and accommodating. I appreciated how proactive she was with the instructions to access the unit and all other steps along the way. Would highly recommend.
Highly recommend this house if you sre heading to Chicago. Peaceful neighborhood, close to wrigleyville snd river north, very convenient.

This was a charming house in Chicago! The furniture was comfortable, and we enjoyed both the big front porch as well as the private, fenced on back yard. While it is a ~30ish minute Uber/Lyft/drive into the city for major tourist attractions - museums, Navy Pier, Sears/Willis Tower), that’s not a big deal - as long as you don’t have little ones who need to nap on the middle of the day or something like that (we did not, so we were fine, but if you’re traveling with littles, it’s something to keep in mind). The neighborhood is quiet, safe, and walkable to local attractions. We walked to a park and several restaurants (Cafe Prague and BarTucci Italian were both AMAZING!!). Gracjan also offered us an early checkin and late checkout. Overall, a great Chicago getaway! Highly recommended!!

My family and I really enjoyed our weeklong vacation in Chicago. West Town is a vibrant and walkable neighborhood and it was so easy to get from place to place on public transit. Natalie’s apartment is perfectly located and well stocked, and she was available and responsive for our needs.

Was not a safe place
Me and my boyfriend stayed here for a concert and he walked down the road to get a snack at the family dollar and someone intentionally tried to hit him with their car and screamed at him to get out of his town as he just minded his own business. There was also a car blown up a few buildings down from us and people standing outside it with guns just sitting in their waistband. Will definitely not be back to this part of Chicago again. The apartment itself was fine.

Definitely would stay here over and over again. It’s very quiet inside and somewhat outside- usually on the weekends. Helen is very communicative. I do appreciate the notes around the house at times I forget something. The bed is super comfortable and the whole room is spacious. Recommend staying here.
Great place !

Fantastic Airbnb in a wonderful location with beautiful, artistic decor. It was like our own private gallery with one-of-a-kind artwork and plenty of old world charm. Close proximity to West Loop restaurants and a short drive to mag mile and the pier. It felt extremely private with a lovely backyard which is what we were looking for as a respite to the hustle and bustle of the city. All in all, it was such a unique place, and we’d love to stay again when we visit again.
I would warn to bring some ear plugs if you’re sensitive to street noise. We expected it so it wasn’t an issue for us. Daniel was quick to respond and clear with instructions. 10/10 would recommend. Thank you for a lovely stay, Daniel!

The space was beautiful and excellent for what we needed: a group of five cousins plus a few of their spouses and kids. The two units allowed us to gather all in one space or divide up for kids nap times. The sheets, blankets and towels were plentiful which we really appreciated.
Only issues were: 1) the six second limit on getting through two front doors with one code; 2) the "half rooms" that were not fully enclosed at the top were not ideal for sound/privacy; and 3) the wrought iron chairs in one unit were extremely uncomfortable (and dangerous for kids) so we couldn't spend much time in that unit.
However, the location allowed for easy walks to a playground, several restaurants, and (a longer walk) to Wrigley Field.
Would recommend if you're ok with 2/6 bedrooms being not fully enclosed and possibly only using one space for comfortable seating. Everything else was great.
A great, minimalist place to stay for a quick trip into the area. The apartment was clean and just as described. Comfortable for our group and love all the culture around the way.
It was perfect.
Had such a great time! Very clean, lots of space, and the pool table was most certainly a plus!
Our stay was great! Alan provided a book with instructions and other things that were very helpful. Definitely would recommend to friends.

We stayed for my bachelorette party and had an absolute blast. John’s place had lots of fun areas for gathering the group together and my favorite part was the 3 season porch with the swings. The basement is separate from the upstairs, this wasn’t an issue for my group but something to note. Additionally, there were window AC units and lots of fans, however it was still very hot even in the basement with the ACs going. We also struggled trying to use the TV to AirPlay a video my MOH made and couldn’t get ahold of John when we were trying to troubleshoot it but ended up uploading the video to YouTube and made it work. We never struggled to find a parking spot on the street even on a busy weekend. There was plenty of extra toilet paper and paper towel. The shampoo, conditioner and body wash in the showers smelt amazing! Hot water lasted for all 11 of us to shower. Overall John’s place was a bargain, and I would stay there again!

This is a beautiful location in the Bronzeville neighborhood and very close to the Hyde Park area. It's an excellent location for getting into the city or hitting the Museum Park area and Soldier Field. The neighborhood is quiet, and the condo was absolutely lovely with plenty of space for us to chill out after long days at the many museums Chicago has to offer. The hosts were wonderful - easy to contact, prompt with messages for checking and out, and provided a number of suggestions for restaurants within the area. Would definitely consider staying here again!

Joelle's place was a good price. My conference was at Navy Pier which made commuting costly by Lyft. The apartment was beautiful and spotless.  There weren't any grocery stores in the vicinity. So once I was home there was not much to do. I had a good stay.
We had a great stay in the Ravenswood area of Chicago! Would recommend her beautiful place to anyone. Very walkable and a nice spacious apartment. Thanks for a great stay!
Thank you.
Amazing view
Brian was a great host.  The loft was exactly as described. Great location in the heart of Wicker Park too!
Nicholas's place is spotless, cozy, and in a great location, walkable but not loud. Would highly recommend!

Ruth was a wonderful host, very caring and understanding. She replied very quickly and understood our needs. I would recommend this venue to anyone who wants to access the amenities of being close to downtown Chicago , yet in a quiet neighborhood nearby.

It was fine - but too expensive and I really just loathe all these management companies who jack up the price and say that the price is competitive with other places in the area (which are owned by them and a few other companies). The good: the WiFi, the amenities, the shower, the furniture and the supplies all good. The bad, the clientele of the building were all there to party, and the door or wall near the window didn’t block any of the noise from the neighbors, it was often hard to sleep. The TVs were super old so they were hard to use. But all of that is fine if it wasn’t 200 bucks a night, and I stayed over a month and got the long term discount, really sure how the price point is ever worth it
Great stay! And very smooth checkin and checkout

Naj was responsive and flexible with my friend and I since we had early flights in (giving us early check-in) and we had SUPER early flights out (understood about the odd hour check-out). His home was pristine and smelled very good, and he went the extra mile offering instructions for laundry service if we needed it. Since we had a short stay we did not need the services, but we really appreciated it and would stay in the same location again. It was peaceful and comfortable, and very walkable.
The towels were the icing on the cake, they were fluffier than any hotel we'd ever visited! Worth every penny.

What a great place to stay.. clean and was everything we needed. I would definitely come back!

This was my second stay at this location, and I hope that saying I had a repeat is an indication of what a nice, pleasant stay it was! Great amenities, a comfortable bed, with very pleasant hosts for sure. Brandon is very nice and communicative and it’s quite easy to feel at home. It’s a truly peaceful place to get work done, and is one block away from a park where I enjoyed some peaceful mornings. I don’t have any complaints at all, and I would honestly be happy to stay here again if the opportunity arises!

Tracye was a responsive and proactive host. Although she was out of town, she quickly arranged for any issues to be fixed. The place was clean and easy to find. We appreciated having a parking spot in the back to avoid street parking.
A good location and a fair price for what is provided

Great view! Beautiful place. Couldn’t ask for a better trip or experience. Really close to the city so we just used the Lyft Bikes. Everything was clean. There was a good bit of stuff to do locally too. Great location.
Place is a little dated but nothing wrong with it at all. Great location

I truly enjoyed my stay! Very clear instructions with checking in and out. David is a great communicator! There are walkable gas stations and convenient stores nearby. Also close to a few bus stops.  I love that the neighborhood is quiet and calm. I had a late check in so the lighting at the front door was very helpful. The neighborhood itself seemed very safe. The place itself is VERY CLEAN and I appreciated that so much. 10/10 recommend! The towels and linen smelled so fresh and the whole apt was well aired with AC and ceiling fans. The place is very spacious, so the air circulation is perfect for those who love staying in a cool space.
I’m so grateful for the complimentary coffee that helps my morning run more smoothly!
I can say the host, Emily and Xavier, are AWESOME!!!!!!
Great spot with easy to find parking.  Host was very proactive and helpful!

Villa Toscana was a great spot for my overnight in Chicago. I needed a budget friendly option for my stay and this was a better value than the hotels I'd looked up.
Enjoyed the front garden courtyard, which is like a little tucked away surprise gem along an otherwise busy city street. I ate my breakfast there in the morning.
I felt comfortable in my private room.
The host responded quickly ahead of time when I asked a question via message. I met staff member Brandon in the morning. He was very friendly and helpful.
My favorite part location-wise was the proximity to Lake Michigan. I enjoyed walking there and back from the Villa.
The only hard part for me was parallel parking, and I know that's just par for the course in Chicago.
I would stay here again and would recommend it as a spot for solo travel or couples traveling to Chicago.

I was traveling with my brother, sister, and father. There was room for us all, not only for each to have our own bedroom, but also many lovely places to sit and hang out—the dining room, living room, sun porch, and back porch with swings. Loved the neighborhood, which was residential but with restaurants and grocery nearby.
I love this place. Great host and a good location
Great location with beautiful people everywhere!

I stayed here for a month for work and what an incredible place.  The neighborhood was great- safe, friendly, walkable, very dog friendly.  It’s close to brown, purple, and red lines (you can get anywhere you need to be) and also has many walkable restaurants and coffee shops. Despite being near a bustling park, it’s surprisingly quiet.  The house itself is fantastic- clean, private, and has everything you need (although lots of stairs- so just be mindful).  The view of trees out the front windows is so peaceful and sets you up for a really nice sunset view.  Instructions are super clear, entry is a breeze, and owners are very responsive. Overall, just a really wonderful find.
Great value.  Very clean and happy with the stay.
We are love this place. Beautiful and clean.
great stay
These are wonderful people.  Just absolutely amazing. The property is inspiring, the neighborhood is so diverse and eclectic and I’ll be back for a writers retreat.  Excited for the next time.
Very happy!

Clean and Beautiful apartment at a very convenient location. Blue line station is just 5 mins walk away and made it easy to get around. Apartment was well stocked up on groceries and host is very friendly and responsive! We loved our stay and would highly recommend it!

Excellent accommodations. Garden is a GREAT place to have coffee or drink wine with friends. Rooms are spotless and include thoughtful touches like a makeup cloth for facewashing and a full-size hair dryer. Kitchenette has everything you need for a short trip including glasses and plates! Very cute we felt right at home. Host was gracious and responsive

I booked Roxane's place for my month-long stay in Chicago, and I am so glad I did. I can't imagine my trip any other way. Roxane and Michael are some of the warmest and most hospitable folks around. I found my accommodations clean and well-stocked -- truly a cozy sanctuary at the end of the day. Oh, and the bed was AMAZING!
The spot is in a quiet area of West Ridge, about a 12 min walk from the new Peterson/Ridge Metra train station, which was great for getting downtown. Bus stops are also nearby. If you come by car, parking will be tight--most streets are zoned parking, but I found it manageable, and Roxane provided temporary permits which helped.
If you stay when Roxane and Michael are home, you are in for a treat. The summer nights of wine, red beans and rice, story sharing, and laughter made me feel like family. Roxane is a hell of a cook! And I quickly made friends with their two sweet pups, Zephyr and Lofton.
Hands down, I'd stay with Roxane and Michael again in an instant!

I was in room #4. Good for one person. It was clean. Bed was comfortable. Great location. Restaurants and bars all around. Real nice courtyard to hang out. Didn't bring a vehicle, so I can't say anything about parking. Very affordable.
Martha was an outstanding host! We enjoyed our stay at her place very much!

Luke and Ligia were great hosts, friendly and welcoming from arrival to departure and kept the space very clean. The bedroom gets a lot of natural light and shares the bathroom with one other guest; it was easy to coordinate morning schedules. There are three rooms in total for guests with a shared kitchenette and all at basement/garden level with a separate entrance so there’s an overall good sense of privacy apart from the family’s living area upstairs. Being able to cook some of my own meals was appreciated and it was easy to share this space with the other guests who were polite and always cleaned up after themselves. A 3-minute walk to Thorndale station trains (red) or buses right there on Broadway. Nearby grocery stores and restaurants are many. Safe, friendly, residential neighborhood west of the apartment with lots of little parks and dog walkers. Recommended!

I stayed at Andy's house for seven months and I can only say good things. The location is good if you are using public transportation - Stony Island Metra is 5 minutes on foot. There are also grocery stores, gas stations, laundry facilities, food places around which makes it very convenient. Once a week we had a housekeeper who took care of the shared spaces so that was a huge plus. Last but not least, Andy was responsive at every request, always willing to offer the best option. Definitely recommend it!

Tom and Megan are amazing hosts with an amazing home! Always quick to respond, although we never had any issues. Their home is very well designed and welcoming for both us and our fur babies. Close to great restaurants and everything else you’d want to do while in Chicago!
Great place on the South Side to get to the White Sox games and the L to head downtown.
I stayed at Randy's for a month and it was absolutely fantastic. The views. The location. A beautiful and comfortable place to call home for a month. I highly recommend it.
The apartment was comfortable, clean, cheerful and felt secure.  The AC was up the unusually warm weather.
Amazing place.

option may be good for one night n Chicago.  for a long time it is really stressful.  Too many rooms in a small space and the comings and goings don't allow you to adapt. The house is dark, the windows are practically useless. The rooms are unlivable. The host is responsive but not at all available and flexible to booking changes.  The house has a dirty feeling even if the daily cleaning of the common areas is appreciable.  The neighborhood is quiet, maybe too much: you have the feeling of not being too safe not seeing people around.  The location is inconvenient for anything, far from the park, far from the metro station, far from the groceries
Good host amazing property

We booked at the very last minute, and everything met our expectations. Jonathan was very responsive and helpful throughout the trip. Very modern and clean apartment. We spent one beautiful evening on the fire escape watching the sun set over the city. Would definitely stay here again.
One thing to note is that this apartment is on the 3rd floor, and there is no elevator. We didn't mind as we were all young and able-bodied, but it was definitely bit more challenging to get our luggage in and out.
Great location, Very clean, & Friendly neighbors!

The condo was located right in River North with tons of restaurants and shopping nearby. The front door staff were friendly and helpful. The pool area was crowded and hard to get a seat. We were surprised by how dated the unit was and how small the kitchen was. The furnishings could have been nicer, the rugs were dirty and need to be replaced. The bedrooms didn’t have blackout blinds or proper curtains, just cheap metal blinds that were broken so our party didn’t sleep very well. I think we thought by renting a penthouse and paying a significantly higher rate that we would have a higher end experience. James was quite rude to me on multiple occasions when I asked a simple question. I think he needs to work on his professionalism when communicating with guests. Do not expect that you can rent out any of the amenity spaces like a pool cabana or outdoor grill. I would recommend staying at a nice hotel, they would be more flexible than these hosts and provide better hospitality.
Place was worth what was paid. Will definitely be back there to stay.

The Airbnb owner was unresponsive through the app, leaving us without any guidance despite our questions. Upon arriving at check-in, I’ve noted that the house was dusty and not well-maintained, with noticeable stains on the blanket and comforter. Several amenities promised in the listing were missing, including basic supplies and furniture. The living room lacked a table, one bedroom was missing a carpet, and the layout differed from what was shown on the photos. Additionally, the towels smelled unwashed, so we had to wash them all again, and the dishes were not clean either, requiring us to wash everything again ourselves before using any of them. The neighborhood felt unsafe, and Uber and delivery drivers were hesitant to enter. Lastly, their checkout instructions were extensive which includes us to place all linens on the floor and take out the trash, but they failed to specify where the trash should be disposed. Overall, this experience has been deeply disappointing and stressful.
Great place, Great host, no complaints!

Wow, Kelsey and Zach have an amazing space and offer lovely hospitality! From the clean, bright space to the ground coffee, this is a great accommodation. Walking distance from Logan Square and it’s many attractions, I can’t recommend this listing and these hosts highly enough.
The house was beautiful, clean, and the beds were really comfortable. Destine was a great host. I will definitely stay there again if I’m back in the Chi.

Samantha was very welcoming and nice to us. The place was exactly what it looked like on the listing. I appreciate the fact that she was very responsive when need be. There was a few things that needed some attention which she handled with quickness. Thank you again for your kindness.
Gracjan had a lovely home! A 10/10 for my group and I. Very safe neighborhood and a cute and comfy place to spend a few days.
Fantastic stay! The apartment was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. Great location. The host was friendly and responsive. Highly recommend!
I’ve stayed with Stewart multiple times bc it is a great location and great value. He is responsive and conscientious.
Good place good host
Great host, and lovely place. Would definitely stay again
Wonderful home...it was located in a fun and vibrant area of town.  Our family felt very comfortable and we would definitely return again!

Katie was great. Really helpful and hospitalble
Amazing stay & host’s felt very at home, would recommend 10 out of 10 times

Natalie’s place was good for our group. There was a mishap with the place not being cleaned upon arrival but Natalie remedied the situation quickly and communicated throughout. She also offered a partial refund for our stay.
All we needed was a safe, clean space to sleep as we were there for what seemed like a week long wedding. Most of the day we were out and about but everything was good.
We had a great and comfortable stay. The place is big and stocked with everything basic you’ll need. Our daughter loved the little toys and snacks. Thank you for hosting us!

Stayed with my mom and aunt for a family trip. Everything was clean and easy to find. Responsive host, cute and comfortable place, we would definitely stay here again! Thank you so much!
Becky was very kind and attentive during our stay!

Our stay at Yashar’s Air BnB was amazing.  We stayed there with a group of 5, and felt very comfortable in the space.  It was very simple to find and get settled into the spot.  All of the amenities were very useful throughout the stay.  Yashar is also very helpful and responsive when communicating.  I would definitely recommend this air bnb, to anyone visiting the city or needs a place to stay.  I plan to be back in the future!

This was the perfect place for our Father’s Day weekend trip! We wanted something chill but convenient to get to the big sites and attractions in Chicago. I wasn’t familiar with the Hyde Park neighborhood going in, but found it to be perfect for what we were looking for and we will definitely be going back some time! Darryl was super helpful in providing recommendations and information. If I was able to rate more than 5 stars, I definitely would!!!

Margaret’s place was perfect for our graduation weekend. Plenty of beds and given the heatwave, bedroom air conditioning unit was much appreciated (although the central air worked fabulously).  Overall enjoyed our stay!!
nice cats

This place was awesome. I wish we hadn’t had such a packed schedule while we were in Chicago because I would have loved to spend more time at Amber’s place. The rooftop and back yard were awesome! The stereo, Nintendo and arcade game kept the kids entertained and it was a safe, easy and fast walk to the blue line (even with a 4 and 1.5 year old)!
Amber is an awesome host and was flexible with our check-in since we had a long drive with small kids to get there.
The place was clean, comfy and nice! It also didn’t have any unnecessary decorative trinkets or fake plants which is a huge plus when traveling with kids. The space was easy to childproof too!

We had a wondeful stay. It was very comfortable and clean. Had everything we needed and was easy to find! Jesse responded quickly when I struggled to get the key out of the box because of my nails! I will definitely book again when I am in the area! Highly recommend.

Great and affordable place to stay in a great location. I would recommend bringing high quality earbuds since there is occasionally some noise from the other rooms. But overall, I had a great time.

Great place for a Wrigley game. Just 1/2 block from the entrance to Wrigley, this is the perfect spot to enjoy your next visit to Wrigley field.

5 stars!

Great place, good location, and very helpful team. Would recommend for a group trip particularly with combined units

Perfect location for those who are wanting to stay with a group of friends and catch a Cubs game and enjoy Wrigleyville night life. It is amazing how close the BnB is to Wrigley Field. Great place to stay and wonderful location, Brett was incredibly responsive to any questions as well.

Cool, comfortable space with a lot of places nearby and easy parking. Would highly recommend for larger groups. A stone throw away from Fulton Market and the loop.
such a cute place with lots of room ! We definitely enjoyed our stay!

This was one of the best if not the best airbnbs we’ve stayed in. From check in to check out, everything was simple and easy. The apartment is in a great location, with access to the red line. There place itself is beautiful and agree with previous reviewers that the bed is extremely comfortable.

The place was great, it felt like staying at home. Grocery stores are within walking distance, and bus stops are nearby.  Jennifer was very helpful and flexible about check in/out. I would definitely visit again!

TL;DR: Great place to stay!! If it’s available don’t think twice before booking, I would highly recommend this place.
Place: I stayed in Room D and had a private bath just across the room. Both the room and bathroom were super neat and clean. You will feel like staying at a hotel.
Owner: Patt is a great person, very proactive and responsive. She manages everything exquisitely. She is available in-person and always happy to have a conversation.
Location: You will be staying at one of the coolest street on the world. The street is full of restaurants of variety of cuisines. Some of the restaurants have even been showcased on Netflix. Transportation: Literally 30 seconds walk to Pink line station and just 5 stations (15 mins) to center of downtown. If you prefer bus, Bus (no 18) stop just below the station ~25 mins to Downtown.

Nice clean place that is well furnished and easy to access. Good price in terms of being close to the downtown and other neighborhoods. As long as you’re cool with riding the bus (or if you’re just going to Uber everywhere regardless).

Chicago we will definitely consider lodging at Jesse’s home again. To boot, not only did the house meet all of my family’s needs, but Jesse was extremely friendly and accessible before, during and after our stay.

Pasamos una estadía cómodo y agradable, el lugar tal cual las fotos publicadas, acceso a transporte super cerca, la zona muy tranquila y bonita. great place! great neighborhood.

it was a decent place to stay! I enjoyed the coffee bar and complimentary snacks. The beds were comfortable, and it was nice to have a living room space. Nice big house. It was clean and the host was responsive. Back yard was well maintained with lots of space to enjoy. Easiest exit instructions I’ve ever had. A major plus.
Great place, wonderful area.

This is a good place to stay, near to everywhere, it has a perfect location.

The house is in a lovely older neighborhood in Chicago. The yard (front and back) is pristine and nicely landscaped. There is a very comfortable front porch. Internet was easy to access and operated efficiently. The TV provided has a range of useful and fun options. Everything about the place was welcoming. I would definitely stay there again. Gracjan was attentive and easy to communicate with (there were no problem so our communication was largely him checking to make sure we had all we need and us complimenting him on the house). This is a good choice if you are comfortable in (and prefer) traditional Chicago neighborhoods and are not looking for something glitzy. Again, I would definitely stay here again.
Great place! Very quiet leafy neighborhood.

I really loved the place, Anais treated us with coffee, tea, and water, we really enjoyed that, The efficiency  was comfortable and neat, Anais's dad was so sweet, the beds and pillows were soft and with an amazing smell, for me the only thing they should improve is the entrance and some decorations inside.

Good place for me for my budget and it's close proximity to University of Chicago where I was spending most of my time for my son's graduation from grad school. Delia was very friendly and a great host.

Tetyana’s listing was just what I needed for a short trip to Chicago. Friendly host, responsive and the place was clean, private, and as advertised. Would recommend anyone on a budget to book with Tetyana

I enjoyed staying at Dean's place. The movies, the games, the books...certainly a well put-together and accommodating place for guests to stay. Perfect location for a Cub's game. Amazing space, great location and response host! Highly recommend!

thank you.
Great time in the city! Close to everything but still a quiet street at night!
Super clean. Great location. Enjoyed our stay.
Lovely stay for our daughter's UChicago graduation.  Host very responsive and helpful.
Great host and great area

Highly recommend! Spacious, great location, easy parking. Great communication with the host.
Always there is a room to improve, overall I had a place to stay for two nights. Quiet and friendly place.
Perfect stay in Wrigleyville; Tracy was easy to communicate with and our party had a lovely time!

Nice place that met our expectations.  Clean.  Great location.  As advertised

We planned a family trip to a Chicago Cubs game and the location was perfect!  There were 7 of us and felt there was plenty of space.  We would definitely stay here again!
Functional place, this was all we needed. Thanks

Perfect location for exploring Chicago! Lovely spacious apartment with view of the lake and lots of light. And great building with concierge, gym, pool etc.  Andrew is a great host - clear and fast communication. Thanks very much!

Perfect location for us - we were in for a wedding and other family members were staying and the bride and groom lived within a couple of blocks. Easy to get to restaurants. The house was very nicely decorated and worked perfectly for our family. Anny was very responsive and made sure everything was ok.

I love my stay at Allyn’s! It was accessible to public transportation, clean, stocked, and Allyn was a great host. She was super responsive and kind. I truly felt safe and at home. Judy's place was great! Very quiet and cozy and she was excellent at communicating access instructions
Extremely enjoyable stay. Beautiful apartment, great neighborhood and Neal was very responsive and friendly. Had a great time, thanks!

Milton's place was perfect for our family of four as we were visiting Chicago for a couple days. It is very spacious, comfortable, on a quiet street, near some great restaurants, and at a good price point. We would stay here again.

I had a wonderful stay at Larissa’s place. It is in a safe, walkable, and lovely Chicago neighborhood. Walking distance to coffee shops, restaurants, and about a 10-15 minute walk to the train into the city, which took about 30 minutes. Quiet and pretty neighborhood. Larissa is welcoming, friendly, and helpful. Her place is beautiful and the bedroom had a comfortable bed and working desk. There is a narrow stairway to get up to her place. I would definitely recommend Larissa’s place to others visiting Chicago.
I really recommend staying at Jeremiah’s place! It’s a great deal and if you want to visit the Loop, there is a bus right next to his place that takes you there in 20min
Very accommodating and genuinely made sure I felt comfortable in the space for the duration of my stay.

She is so amiable, enthusiastic, knowledgeable, thoughtful , and incredibly respectful. This airbnb was a short stop on moving from out of state - and I don’t think there’s a better place I could’ve chosen to stay at. The room is sunny, and very comfortable. If you’re reading these reviews, just know you can absolutely, without a doubt,
trust communicate openly with her. Seriously - stop reading and and just book the place, you won’t regret it. I called my room home within a week of staying there. Truthfully, I miss it already. Much love!
Very clean inside and instructions were easy and clear.

Pamela is very responsive and friendly. House was homey and I particularly liked that it had a fully functioning kitchen. Location was great. I stayed for 3 months. Daniel was a fantastic host. The apartment was clean, safe, had everything I needed, and conveniently located.
Location is great very friendly staffs and easy check in. If you plan a long stay in Chicago and find this place is available, just book it.
This was a great place to stay in Chicago. Nice and clean apartment with a great view!

Really enjoyed the stay and felt really comfortable at this place. Really nice and clean and was about 7-10 minutes from the United Center which is where we went to for a concert. worked out well for us, could use some simple improvements and a deep cleaning. shelf in the shower, fix the trim, window treatments, etc... all cosmetic. party environment nearby was fun to see/hear. train was super convenient... noise didn't bother us, etc. very responsive too communication, etc.

Very easy to communicate, comfortable, cosy, safe and convenient place.
Confident to recommend
Great place to stay.

Great space near Logan Square. Very walkable to Logan. Close to L line. Apartment was extremely clean. Easy to get into. Check in and out was smooth. Mimi was also very proactive before the check in day which i appreciate. Thank you Mimi!

Kelly was an amazing host this place was beautiful and it felt like home away from home.

Jonathan was a great host ! I felt safe as a woman traveller and felt I had privacy to do my own thing

This was a fantastic place to stay--in a well-established neighborhood just sound of McCormick Place.  Well-appointed suite, very welcoming, great communicartion with host.

I stayed in the appartment for two months and really enjoyed my time there. Everything was exactly as in the description. The appartment is a 5 minutes walk from a supermarket and a 10 minutes walk from a green line station. The kitchenette might be a bit small for such a long stay.
Ginneh was a great host. She replies very fast and helps if you have any problems during your stay. Check out times were also very flexible.

The unit was comfortable, clean,  and well-equipped for our extended stay. The kitchen was stocked with appliances, cookware, etc., and the linens were clean and comfortable. The hosts were super responsive and attentive to all our needs!

Great location and and large apartment near walkable travel hub in Chicago. Flat is well kitted out and large with lots of luxury touches. Absolutely fantastic place with great amenities (pool, gym, hot tub), and incredible views if you are in one of the higher floors. Great central location and excellent staff who were very helpful.

Good spot! Not too far from the Addison Blue line. Easy to park. Pretty spacious. If you plan to do a lot of cooking it might be a little sub-par pots & pans wise. Otherwise it’s a great spot to launch from especially if you have a car!

Charla was a super helpful and responsive host. We had everything we needed, and Charla worked hard to make our stay successful (we were there long term, and she worked hard to meet our needs).

Nice room, great kitchen and bathroom
Highly recommend for everyone that needs to stay for a longer time!

Steve was an exceptional host! Always accessible and incredibly helpful! The location and the accommodations are fantastic. Highly recommended!

good place

Everything was great! The lady is really Kind!

Great property in a nice, quiet part of town.  The unit is even nicer than the pictures let on. Julie is a super host. Definitely recommend booking here!
Vas is a great host and the place is in a great location. Close to the train. Easy commute to both the airport and into the city. Would definitely recommend

Nice place

I’ve stayed in 2 other airbnbs in Chicago & Patts place is by far the best one. You’ll love it!

Staff was very responsive, friendly and helpful. Location is fantastic. View from the room was exceptional! Far exceeded expectations.
I had such a great experience, I signed a 13-month lease for another unit in the same property.

Well run establishment. Clear and concise directions listed for all amenities. Comfortable space with tasteful decor!

Thank you Jose for all your prompt actions and provided well done accommodation.

Wonderful location, very clean and welcoming! We had a girls weekend and were very pleased with Allen’s place. We will definitely earmark his rental for future trips. Lovely, lovely, lovely!!

I had a great stay and if traveling to Chicago again this is where I would stay.
He is the best no more words to describe…..he responded in time…to get a safe place to stay like this is really worth and awesome
Incredibly comfortable and safe! Thank you again!

Jason's place is perfectly located to explore the city. Easy access to the blue line.. If you don't feel like going into the city. Wicker Park and Bucktown have tons to offer! I'd stay here again in a heartbeat! Thanks Jason!
Caryl’s place was wonderful! Gorgeous home, amazingly comfortable bed, and so convenient to the University of Chicago. I always enjoy staying here!

Cesar is very friendly and responsive in communication. The place was very clean and he arranged for a cleaning person to clean it for us every 2 weeks so we didn't have to worry about that.
The neighborhood is pretty nice. It is relatively quiet and there are lots of nice restaurants around within walking distance.
Reminder that there is no kitchen, washer, or dryer, so you might have to do dine in / takeout / delivery / microwaveable food if you are staying there long term. For a short term visit, it wouldn't be an issue. This place is cheaper than the average location, so I thought it was fine. There is a laundromat called Barry Coin Laundry within a 6 minute walk of the place that can do about 6 days worth of clothes for 2 people for about 7 dollars.
I never tried the bike, but the treadmill in the back is fully functional, and good to get exercise in during the cold winter months. Clean and beautiful bathroom, and overall furnished place.

The apartment is very nice and Aubrey is a great host. It’s near multiple bus/train stops, in a quiet neighborhood, and in a nice building. If you are staying mid- to long-term, there is little to no storage (like no drawers, sink space, etc.) Not a deal breaker but this proved inconvenient over my 3 month stay. Overall recommend if you are needing a nice place to stay in Chicago.
As advertised, great spot and neighborhood.  Very responsive owner.
非常不错，谢谢

Great place had everything we needed

WORTH EVERY DIME!! The view was Beautiful and unexpected. The beds were comfortable. The building is beautiful and very clean... The area had lots of restaurants. When we found out we would need to vacate our apartment for a month to have some renovations done, I looked for a place that would feel like home. This place was perfect and we didn’t want to leave! Amazing airbnb. We will be staying here again in the future

Would recommend this place for sure to anyone wanting to stay in a nice place near a lot of attractions in Chicago.
Perfect place for a mid/long term staying! I enjoyed my time so much.

This was my second time staying in this house, and I love it! It’s clean and comfortable, and exactly as pictured. The location is perfect. We parked our car in the garage for the weekend and walked everywhere.

Had a wonderful stay here! Matched the description well and felt safe and comfortable in the room. We enjoyed our room. Parking was easy and close. Great place to stay. Host is wonderful and the place is located quite well. All amenities you need.

This was a fantastic place to stay!  It was comfortable and quiet, and the kitchens had everything we needed.  My one complaint is that the water took a very long time to heat up in the mornings. Wonderful stay - highly recommend

2.5 month extended stay at a great place in a great location. Comfortable layout and nice building amenities. Apartment is situated in the heart of lots of action yet retains peace and quiet. I would certainly stay here again in the heart of Bucktown/wicker. Don’t hesitate to book!
Had a terrific 3 week stay at Jackie's condo. It was well equipped, in a great larger and even larger than it appeared in pics. Easy communication and keyless entry.

Beautiful units with very receptive and friendly hosts. Area felt safe, great location. 100% would book with Cloud9 again.

I greatly enjoyed my experience staying in this airbnb. It operates sort of like a traditional hostel, as most spaces are shared. I believe you can, however, book a private space if it’s available. All hosts were super attentive from the moment I booked the space until the day I left. I ended up having to extend my stay and it was no problem at all. They walked me through the process before I even asked!
The space itself is kept very neat and tidy. I had one roommate who was as easy to get along with as the hosts. While I didn’t typically make breakfast, there were always plenty of options for anything from a quick bowl of cereal to eggs and bacon available for cooking. I could never even really tell that I was sharing the bathroom with other people as it was always available when I needed to get ready, both in the morning and evening.

Amazing host. Had a wonderful almost 3 week stay. Definitely recommend for future stays.

host was very responsive and place was very clean. bed was comfortable, hot tub was a great amenity. easy to find parking right across the street every time.

Overall, thanks for sharing your home- it was exactly what we needed for a short drive in weekend trip!!
Jonathan is super nice, communicative and helpful. The stay was great, would recommend.

The first floor of the house is as advertised, very spacious with lots of light. There is a beach a five minute walk away, too. The common areas were clean and tidy, and the guests I did see were friendly.
My family and I loved the location! We plan on coming back, we loved it!

Another point that I really liked was privacy. We can enter and leave the house without going through the main house, which guarantees total freedom. Even with other guests, the house is very quiet, which is a super positive point. The house is a block away from the train station and the neighborhood seems very safe. It's really worth staying at their house!
Very pleased with our stay. Very clean, affordable. Thoughtful snacks. A little family noise from above but I wear earplugs so not an issue.
Great place and amazing views.

This was a great home base for us while spending the week visiting family around town, as well as taking in the sights with the kids. Joelle’s place was nice! Convenient, clean and perfect for the price!

I can’t wait to stay here again each and every time I’m back in town. Thank you for everything!
it WAS A VERY COMFORTABLE PLACE TO STAY.  ANDY WAS RESPONSIVE AND DETAILED IF I HAD ANY QUESTIONS.

Great location. Extremely walkable to Brown line as well as restaurants, bars, shops. Clean and very comfortable. Jeanne was so accommodating with my early flight. Highly recommend this lovely property in North Center!

I know this sounds trivial, but so many places have the bed pushed to one wall, and it’s harder for two people to get in and out. The kitchen had everything you could want. It truly was a home away from home. Casey and Peter were the perfect hosts, providing privacy, but immediately available when needed.  The garage parking was a huge asset also. Would definitely stay here again and highly recommend!

Our family of 3 spent nearly 4 weeks at the 2nd floor apartment of the Roscoe Village Inn. We'd highly recommend this apartment for the following reasons:
Location - Ideally situated in a quiet street. Close to groceries, restaurants, I-90 and 1.3 miles from Wriggley. Easy street parking right in front of the house.
Space and facilities - Pleasant and spacious. Large kitchen with all appliances, utensils, silverware, glasses, cleaning supplies, salt/sugar/spices, beyond our expectations. A medium and a small bedroom with comfortable queen beds, dressers, spare pillows, blankets, etc. Well-furnished living room, dining room and a study area. Well-stocked bathroom. Washer/Dryer in easily accessible basement.
Responsive and helpful host - Just a text or call away at all times.
Expect some foot noise from the apt above when occupied, but not bothersome. Very little closet space. This and the single bathroom may pose limitations for larger parties on long stays.
Overall, 2 thumbs up!
