My family felt right at home Kiana also went out of her way to make my kids feel comfortable she was an amazing person and host. My family and I had lots of fun she had games and snacks it was a wonderful experience thank you love ( Kiana) had lots of fun.

Angelica's place was absolutely perfect for our 1 month stay! It is 5mins from the blue line and even closer to bus stops. Aldi and other grocery stores were within walking distance, as well as bars and restaurants. The place itself was exactly as described and had everything we needed for long term stay, including a much appreciated washer and dryer (coin operated). Angelica was always responsive and even shared local events. She was very accommodating and offered great instructions for the house. We will definitely book here/with her next time we're in Chicago!
Excelentes anfitriones Joe & Brant.  Las camas, almohadas, sabanas y cobijas muy confortables.

Un apartamento luminoso, limpio, cáñido. Los amenities superan cualquier expectativa. El personal de conserjería atento y gentil. El personal de limpieza impecable.
Volvería siempre.
Excelent host, great communication, and fast response. Highly recommend. Would rent again.

Caroline has been a great host.
descriptions matched, house is clean and tidy.
closer to bus/train station.
Great stay.  Easy communication with host.  Incredible view.  Easy access to buses or trains.  Walk most places.  Nice TV.  Neighbors were quiet.  Friendly staff in the building.

The host and place were great! There was an issue with the home smelling like cigarettes but Yao was extremely quick to respond and apologize and offered a deep cleaning service. Location was great and house was exactly what was listed.
This is a beautiful space, it’s very upscale, super clean and luxurious. Within a 5 min walk to the L, comfy pillows and enviable bathrooms. We were very impressed and comfortable

The place was exactly what we needed. Location was easy access other parts of chicago. Olga was very responsive and helpful.  Raul was also very responsive to fix some minor issues during our stay (which was a long stay).  I would recommend and use again.

Quiet and comfortable neighborhood.  Just a short walk to Alexander's Diner for delicious and reasonably priced food.  Also the same short walk to bus service to Andersonville, a great place to eat and shop.
A great stay! Lots of shops, bars, and restaurants nearby. Would definitely visit again.
Lovely place and in the Chicago loop.
El departamento era funcional y muy bien ubicado para llegar rápidamente al centro.

Diana and James are the best hosts one could find on Airbnb. Their attention to detail, friendliness, and support were outstanding. They provided us with excellent tips about local markets and shopping areas, always ensuring our comfort, safety, and well-being. The unit we stayed in was incredibly cozy. Upon arrival, we found everything well-prepared, clean, and fully functional. We spent several wonderful months there.
The neighborhood itself is fantastic, boasting an array of parks, cafes, restaurants, pharmacies, and the convenience of public transport nearby, making it easy to explore the area and far. I highly recommend staying here, primarily because Diana and James are exceptional hosts who genuinely care about their guests' experiences.

This was one of the best places we have stayed in. The house is completely new with all the amenities to accommodate a big family. Tom and Megan were excellent hosts and provided excellent recommendations and were very proactive. We are thankful to them for letting us share their home. Thank u Tom and Megan!! You are awesome!! When we do come back to Chicago we would love to stay at your place again!!!
Jonathan is an amazing host. very helpful and friendly.  his apartment is very well maintained and has everything that we need for a stay.

Mary is a very responsive and accommodating hostess. The apt wasn't very clean when I got there. It was explained that there had been a new cleaning person, so hopefully she finds a different one after my stay. She was very quick to rectify the situation. This neighborhood is full of great restaurants, bars, and a beautiful park within walking distance. The city has been working on the rat problem so that situation improved greatly during my stay. I realize this is a city wide problem, so people should expect them everywhere. Crime has gone up in this neighborhood during my stay. Unfortunately this seems to be common in many Chicago neighborhoods. I did not personally experience any issues with crime related activity while at Mary's apt. The neighbors were friendly and quiet. The laundry is free, which was a plus, but the laundry room itself is in an old basement which is pretty much taken over by the other tenants. I always found a time when it was not being used, so that was nice.
Philips warm and concise communication seal the deal!! Space was perfect for our family and only minutes from our main obligations for the weekend. Would definitely book again!
Great place to stay in Chicago! Central location to many things and sites. Well stocked kitchen! Very pet friendly!

My bestie and I had the time of our lives! It was super cozy and felt like home. It was a wonderfully peaceful place to come back to after a full day of adventures. Nina was an EXCELLENT host, very responsive and friendly. We were given tons of recommendations for us to enjoy. Hands down one of the best places to stay in Chicago, can’t say enough great things. Looking forward to another visit soon!
We weren't able to stay at the spot we booked due to a "maintenance/issue". Luckily the property manager, Stephanie, was able to accommodate us in another listing she oversees.
Great accommodations all around.
Quick response time guess was more than accommodating space was clean would definitely book again
This was the perfect location to be close to my son’s apartment. Great walking distance to lots of local restaurants and bars. Easy parking and great amenities:).

Sezgin was a great host. Always available when we had questions.
The space was accessible to public transportation and we always felt safe.
Would definitely stay there again.

This was such a great find. It’s comfortable and cozy. Everything you need is there. The view and location is great. Plus, I loved the amenities. I had a little trouble actually finding the apartment on the first night because you have to go through a couple of doors, and at night it’s a little creepy but after one time it got easy. Also I wish there was sugar there for all the great coffee selections that were there, but that’s just me nitpicking lol. Thank you Inka for your great communication, understanding, and hospitality. You have a beautiful place. I would definitely stay here again.
Very friendly and respectful host who is always responsive if you ever need anything.

Niall & Stefanie’s home was absolutely terrific. We had eight people in for Thanksgiving. Plenty of room for socializing and everyone had comfortable sleep space.
The place was immaculate and the hosts could not have been more accommodating.
We will definitely be back when we visit Chicago again.
Five stars!

Very nice apartment. I loved the architectural features. It felt like we were visiting a relatives house. Beds were very comfortable and it was plenty of room for our family of three.  Instructions to gain entry were detailed and thorough. We checked in rather late right before Thanksgiving holiday so was glad to have the instructions. There was a great book filled with recommendations and helpful info for guests. We enjoyed the location as it was very close to friends and relatives.

The place is well located, the neighborhood is close to public transportation, nice restaurants and good surroundings
Emily and Rich always replied quickly to our doubts, and they were fast to fix some malfunctioning we had with the fire alarm on the apartment.
Although the building is old, the place is renewed, and it is pretty comfortable for a long stay.
The rooms were a bit smaller than expected from the photos, but we got used to it after a while.
Nice comfortable place

This spot is so cozy! An easy walk to local restaurants and shops.
All the finishing and bathroom looked very new. Loved the concrete flooring too. Appreciated the quick response to questions as well! We hope to stay again in future visits to Chicago.
Very spacious. Loved the modern feel and artwork . Safe neighborhood! Cornell was super responsive when we needed to get ahold of him.

I can hardly say enough good things about Greystone and our hostess.  The unit was extremely comfortable and well appointed, and our hostess communicated with us frequently enough to ensure we had what we needed!  We will return!
Chris’s place was gorgeous and perfectly located for our family Thanksgiving. Super close to El stop. Chris was very nice and let us check in at 10 am.

I found the location very convenient, close to grocery stores and public transportation. The apartment itself was very well equipped and clean. The windows light in a lot of natural light, and the Wi-Fi was great for working remotely for the month.
Ivy is very responsive and helpful. I would definitely recommend the place.

A nicely decorated apartment that has everything you would expect. Worth noting this is a basement apartment so you can hear what is happening upstairs and there is a big dog that is of course going to run around and be noisy at times. Woke me up during the night a few times but it I was able to go right back to sleep so not really an issue for me. The owners do control the temperature of the unit but when I was cold I messaged them and they immediately adjusted it. Great neighborhood, parking was never an issue and there are tons of good restaurants in the area. Walking distance to a park I was able to take my son was a huge plus.

The place was exactly like the photos and description. There was a couple minor things I believe that could be upgrade like the drawers in the bathroom was extremely loose, add more tvs, change the white curtains in the living room because of it being stained, and the pots and pans. Other than that our stay was pleasant.

El lugar es tranquilo, cómodo, tiene lo que esperábamos, es grato quedarnos en el apartamento es lo que esperábamos, todo limpio cómodo, está céntrico de la zona tiene muchas cosas para resolver cualquier gusto desde comida hasta supermercado y restaurantes, y farmacias es y 100% recomendado me queráis de nuevo en este lugar

A great apartment in a great location that was clean and decorated well. Jackie is a very considerate host, but the only thing I would have liked is for her to be more communicative during my actual stay when I had some concerns that popped up. As a former host,  I think it is important to check the messages or provide a number to reach them if they prefer that. I also wished there were hand towels for the master bath,  more paper towels for the kitchen and a water filter that was fresh and new so I could have filtered water while there. These are basic essentials. Other than that, this was a great place, decorated in style and class in a great neighborhood, that was private, very spacious, with plenty of street parking. I was able to really relax while there. I also thought the master bathroom and tub was amazing!
Great place!  Lindsay was wonderful to work with and we love Bucktown!

Daniel was a gracious host and always there to communicate with and handle any issue. The area is easy to get to Fulton Market or downtown by lyft or uber. Kitchen is spacious for long term stay. You feel very private in the space. Highly recommend for long term stay or a fun weekend!
Worked well for us with dogs, took a little to get acclimated to where we could walk them, but perfect for passing through and right off lakeshore drive!
Una estadía grandiosa, muy hermoso lugar y excelente atención, responden rápido.
All of the positive reviews hanging on the fridge are warranted - Katie’s place is the best quality/value Airbnb I’ve stayed at in Chicago! Will definitely be back.
Dan’s place was a great stay! Cozy-peaceful-great location to catch the Green Line downtown- and close to drive to restaurants bars and parks. I’d highly recommend!

I 1000% recommend staying here! It feels odd writing a review for Suzanne because she really feels like family after I stayed with her for the last three months. She made me feel so welcome and at home in my last quarter of college.
Her house is beautiful and extremely well kept as there is a housekeeper that comes every other week.
It is a convenient location in proximity to the red line (only 2-3 minute walk if you cut through the alley and the back of the Addison station). I also had so much fun living so close to Wrigley Field, especially with all of the neighborhood events that Suzanne offered us to attend with her. I had great roommates downstairs and got along with everyone well!
Suzanne is also a really great cook and included those staying with her to join her family for meals when they came over. I told my mom a couple weeks ago that I felt like I was staying with my cool aunt rather than in an Airbnb. Her dog, Lola, is also the sweetest little angel! Stay here!
Thanks Michael, that was definitely a great stay.
Yes it’s a nice place to stay and I would recommend people to stay here and specifically the host is very responsible….Thanks

The location was perfect. Near the Goodman Theatre and Christkindlmarke. Staff was wonderful and Paul's description was spot on. Bed was comfortable and bathroom was roomy and nice.
Will stay again when needed.

Thank you Jennifer for making my stay ay 166 N Aberdeen such a pleasure. The location is A+, the unit was exactly as described and the entire West Loop and Fulton Market are walkable from the location. Great building with first class amenities and wonderful staff. Nice gym and common areas with individual offices to WFH and pool table,... Thanks again for your flexibility and timely communication!

The loft looked just like the pictures. Clean and modern. It is a bit far from fancier places but it has everything necessary nearby, within a few mins walking distance, pharmacy, laundromat, grocery,  fast food… basically everything needed for an extended stay. There is also a mexican restaurant downstairs which was pretty good if you need a quick meal. My boyfriend and I stayed here for 6 weeks and I really had no complaints. Felt safe and secure. Thermostat was great, hot water was quick. Dasha was very responsive with any questions I had. I had enquired about a mirror before and they had it in the closet when I arrived! The parking garage was so convenient. Only thing was we had to get out of the car to open the garage every time but that was no biggie, it was very spacious. The bed is very soft and there are a set of stairs to get to the room, so those are things to consider. All in all, I am glad I chose dasha and owen’s place in chicago and would definitely come again!
I had a great time and so did my family I will definitely be staying there again

Had a fantastic stay! Kelly and Ricardo were exceptionally welcoming and accommodating. The place was spotless, and I appreciated the thoughtful amenities. Communication was seamless, and the host was quick to respond. Highly recommended for a great Airbnb experience!
We had a lot of fun staying at Kelly and Ricardo's house. They were so nice and helpful.
The price is very reasonable compared to other houses. If I return to Chicago, I will stay in this place again.
The most beautiful part for me is the kitchen, equipped with all the tools and supplies. Literally, the kitchen is complete for any cooking you want.

Very conveniently located, three minutes from the train station. Felt safe, felt like a neighborhood that I could walk around in. Do not let the proximity to the train tracks scare you away, the train was hardly an interruption. It was a very easy and quick walk into Chinatown. Aayah was a wonderful host.

I'm was very lucky to find this beautiful place. I had a great experience overall. I wish I had a home like that. Place has everything you need for a comfortable stay. The only thing to keep in mind is parking, cause after hours you might be browsing around a little.
other than that, this place is definitely worth it! Thank you

This was our first stay as an Airbnb guest, and Joe has set the bar high as a host. His rental is spacious, immaculate, and has all the comforts of home.  Joe left us snacks on the counter and a fridge stocked with a variety of drinks. He checked in with us to make sure we had no concerns.  His emails gave us detailed info on transpiration from airport to rental.  I also appreciated his suggestions for restaurants and sightseeing in the area.  Joe made our first visit a delight from start to finish!
Great place, wonderful location, and excellent host!

Framing goes a long way - we were really creeped out by the requirement to upload IDs for each guest, but turns out this is common practice for doormen in Chicago so they know your face in advance and also know who to stop to sign in as guests.
Also, note that this is two adjacent 2bed/2ba units, not one huge connected unit.
Otherwise was a lovely stay -- it's a great location and very nice apartments.
Great place to stay. Very comfortable, clean and decorated lovely. Will book on my next trip to Chicago.

the best place to rent and feel like at home..everything is organized, very clean..this place has it all. I recommend it..I would stay there again..Quang was very attentive and very flexible in whatever you needed...the best 👌

We really loved our two-month stay in this condo - it was easily over 1,000 sq ft with a large living room, separate well sized and well lit kitchen area, and large bedroom. The living room couch was enormous and very comfortable to work from home/lounge/even sleep on. The living room and bedroom TVs were both huge. The bathroom lighting and fixtures were a bit old but Megan let us know she is having it redone shortly. King size bed was super comfy! The location cannot be beat - it is on the top floor of the condo and we got the best of both Lakeview and Lincoln Park. The kitchen had basics all stocked and Trader Joe's and TJ Maxx are just a few blocks away if you needed anything. Megan was an incredible host - she was super responsive, proactive, friendly, and went the extra mile to check in with us and help address minor issues we had (i.e. wifi was a bit slow, so she scheduled a service technician to come in right away and it worked great after). I would definitely recommend!

What a great host ! I definitely enjoyed my first time experience in Chicago staying here ,Akiko’s is very nice and easy to get along with ,don’t see how you can not feel comfortable staying here for the weekend with the great hospitality !
Patt was a wonderful host. My room was very nice and the appartment had everything what one needs. All went very smooth and I had great time. Highly recommended.

Felt right at home! This was a very clean, quiet and comfortable garden level unit that has great access to public transportation (busses and red line). Check in/out couldn't have been easier. I would happily recommend this airbnb for anyone looking to explore northern Chicago.
This was the worst deal ever. Lost my money for the hotel over circumstances that were not at all my fault. Will never use airbnb or this hotel again. Worst companies ever.
Thank you!  We enjoyed the neighborhood and your place!
Enjoyed our stay. Easy to get to DePaul campus and surrounding area.
Couldn’t ask for a better host than Victor! Incredibly responsive and friendly. Building is also fantastic with all the amenities you need for a long term stay.
Good spot in a great location. Very helpful and responsive host.

Wanxiu was a very friendly host.
I spent there two months in a private room and it was comfy and quiet.
As it says in the description it doesn’t offer some services as a kitchen nor a fridge to store things from the supermarket so you will have to eat out often. The cleaning will be ok as long as you sweep the room or clean the bath after using it. It was a very pleasant stay. Make sure you communicate well with her about the time you would come back home cause she locks from the inside and I had to wait for her to open the door four times.

Mary is a wonderful host! Her apartment is bright, clean, and cozy! I had such an amazing experience staying here for 1.5 months. I’d definitely recommend her place if you trying to stay in Logan Square. One of the best Airbnb experiences I’ve ever had!!

Recomiendo este lugar para estancias cortas (1-2 semanas). La ubicación es buena y accesible, nunca hubo fallas en el algún servicio.  El departamento necesitaba mas limpieza (mucho polvo), remover cosas innecesarias dentro del departamento; por ejemplo: ciertos electrodomésticos, utensilios de cocina, aparatos, muebles en no tan buenas condiciones, tiene muchas cosas en todos lados. La regadera del baño es extremadamente pequeña lo cual es incómodo para tomar un baño de manera recurrente.

We loved Nicole and Vince’s place for our 2-month stay! It’s in a great location and easily walkable to other neighborhoods. Also really close to the train station. The beds were comfortable and lots of closet space! They had everything we needed for the kitchen to cook daily. There’s also a rooftop with a great view of the city! We would def book again!
Great location and everything walkable. Spent the summer there and was hard to beat. I’d recommend Marv and his place. Very proactive on communication and made sure had everything needed.
Great spot central to everything in Wicker Park!
Great place !!

Beautiful building with incredible amenities. Our room was spotless and well-maintained by cleaning service. The staff was friendly and always available to help. Great location that was walkable to best of restaurants, bars, shopping, etc.

Stayed here for nearly 3 months. It was a great stay, we felt right at home as there was everything in the house! Sadia was super responsive and resolved whenever we had some questions. The location was amazing, heart of the river north. Walkable to everything. The apartment is perfect with gorgeous views in the morning.
This unit was perfect with an amazing view!

My family and I were displaced while repairs were made on our home post flood.  Great stay, Dylans team was very attentive and made sure we were well taken care of.  I definitely recommend staying here.

I needed a place for my daughter who was traveling alone and this place was perfect for her.  Myrtle was very kind and helpful. The neighborhood was nice and safe, not far from stores and restaurants. It is convenient to public transportation. I would highly  recommend this place. If I ever need to come to Chicago would definitely book this place.

Thank you for the wonderful hospitality, comfy room and spacious closet! This is good place for a lovely vacations, very convenient location near to the city only 20 min away, comfortable stay  and excellent hospitality, every thing is clean and organized. Highly recommended
Everything was perfect. A place in a great area and enough for 4 people to fit comfortably with everything you need.

Nicole's place was exactly what I was looking for. Quiet. Clean. A stylish and cozy place to rest and rejuvenate. Especially nice to have so many great restaurants and shops close-by. Additionally, Nicole was a kind and responsive host, answering questions for me before and during my stay quickly. I'd highly recommend a stay here.
Amazing hosts , very responsive and the place is clean and spacious, and located very close to downtown , highly recommend
Maria was quick and helpful with the few questions that I had.  Looked just like the listings. Simple apartment in a convenient area, which is exactly what I needed.

This was a perfect AirBnB experience! Marty and Rob have a beautiful place full of interesting art work and collections. It is surrounded by beautiful gardens and a koi pond. It is close to a a walkable community full of restaurants and shopping, and nearby public transportation can get you downtown. Marty and Rob make it easy to share their space. They are friendly without being intrusive, and ready to help with any needs. The room, bathroom and common space are very clean. All of the amenities were thoughtfully provided, including a small in-room refrigerator, well-placed plugs, a coffee maker and tea kettle in the common area, and plenty of nightlights, for getting to the bathroom at night. I highly recommend this place and I look forward to going back.

Aayah was a great host! We were able to walk to McCormick Place for our event. The home was spacious and modern. Her communication response was fast and friendly. Definitely would recommend it! If you do rent a car, it was great that there was a parking space. If the alley is blocked, you can go inside the restaurant next door and the workers will move their cars quickly. Great Chicago stay!
Great stay and a really cool place!

I want to start off by thanking Quang and his partner for such great hospitality! Quang replied back super fast to any questions that I had and he also was extremely kind and understanding. If I could book this airbnb whenever I come back to Chicago I would do so! The rooms were comfortable, and even with this being a basement unit, it was super quiet and no loud noises from above. You will not be disappointed!

Was as described & in photos. Here with a girlfriend for the weekend. A perfect spot for the 2 but I’ll book again with my husband & daughter.
There are nice little touches like, recommendations, tea, coffee, art, guides, books, etc. & there is a deck for the warmer months.
The garden is still impressive in the late Fall, I can’t imagine how beautiful it would be in the Spring & Summer.

Joe is one of the best hosts we’ve ever had in our many years of using AirBNBs. He is so friendly, full of great suggestions, and did so much to help us feel at home, including beverages and snacks, power strips, and lots of other small touches that one doesn’t often see. The flat itself is very comfortable, quiet, clean, easy to find (a short lovely walk from a CTA station) and in a charming neighborhood. Lots of restaurants, bars, and shops nearby. We loved staying there and recommend it absolutely.
Really easy parking. Fire pit in the backyard. Just what we needed for a short weekend trip.

1st of all, we very much appreciated the host allowing us to check in early. We know that won't be the case every time, but we lucked out. Thank you.
Very convenient location; close to grocery, restaurants, drug stores, etc. Good walkability score from our group. Easy drive to downtown Chicago. House had everything we needed. Our group of four ladies found the beds, linens and pillows to be better than most. Living room was great for talking and relaxing. Big dining room table served as our eating area and game table. Neighborhood very quiet. We had a rental car and were easily able to find nearby parking. We very much enjoyed our stay and would stay there again.
As mentioned by previous reviewers, steps leading to the front door are a bit tricky.

Had a great weekend stay at this home. The unit was very spacious & beautifully decorated with all of the amenities you'd need. There are quite a few stairs leading to the unit (3 floors) but that wasn't much of an issue. Would book again!
Beautiful Studio, with zero traffic I’d say your about 30 minutes from the Loop. Very responsive as well and the studio is so clean! I’d definitely book again when I go back.
Enjoyed my stay.  Clean fresh place to relax and enjoy your visit.
It was a lovely place to stay, right down the road from where we were working. The host is amazing and very accommodating. Would gladly go back
My first time in Chicago, local market is very close. Beautiful and older neighborhood.
nice

We stayed in a different condo from the original booking, Devon had called me the day before to let me know it was going to be a different condo but it was absolutely beautiful! Perfect location, gorgeous view, very safe and clean. It was perfect for a little getaway! Thanks for hosting us Devon!
Loved the place. Great price and good night’s sleep. Thanks, Josh!
I loved my stay!

This is hands down the BEST Airbnb we have ever used. This will now be our go-to place any time we visit Chicago. Additionally, the beds were all extremely comfortable, and the bedding and pillows were top notch. I am picky about beds and linens and the bedding was so clean you could smell the laundry detergent. The neighborhood is adorable, and there are coffee shops, stores and restaurants all within walking distance. We can't recommend this place enough as it sets new standards for all other Airbnb's. Thank you for opening up your lovely apartment to us!

Amazing place to stay in Chicago!!!

Katie's place was great! It is a nice area with a lot of things to do nearby and easy places to walk to. Street parking is available all over the area so that wasn't any trouble. The house itself was clean and was as described/shown in pictures. It felt very cozy. Katie was also very friendly and responsive and all the instructions for getting into the house and just general rules and requests were made very clear and simple. I would definitely stay again and highly recommend it!
The Place Was Nice & Decorative As Photos. Would Visit Again .

the hose is big and clean, private car park and to the street as well, the neighbors are very friendly supermarkets are just minutes away I recommend the place...
when I will visit Chicago I will come back

Chad’s place was great - comfortable and easy to access. Great neighborhood, quiet and respectful neighbors in building. Chad was incredibly helpful and responsive to any minor issues we had over our month-long stay and we were really appreciative of his help.
A nice spot for a single person or couple to stay for a bit to enjoy Chicago.
All good!
great house and host.

I absolutely did not want to leave, and my months stay at Williams flew by! Beautiful people, beautiful art.

El departamento muy bonito, limpio y amplio.
su ubicación es excelente, el metro está a pocos pasos y se comunica fácilmente a las mejores atracciones de Chicago. sin duda cuando regrese a Chicago buscaré el mismo lugar para alojarme.

Was very convenient to McCormick and easy for Ubers to get to. Very clean and comfortable, and felt safe. Train station is next to bedroom and makes some noise, but honestly wasn't a bother. Great for a work trip with a cafe just feet away. Host was proactive and responsive, and very helpful. Would stay again

Idris' attention to detail was evident in every aspect of the stay, from the thoughtful amenities to the helpful local tips provided. Very clean, affordable room!

The place was just as described. Very cool home away from home. It is an older builder, so it came with a few "older building" quirks, but Inka was responsive to get things addressed. But the unit itself was very nice. Check-in instructions were clear (though there were a lot of details, lol). Nonetheless, I would definitely rebook this place.
Great location, and a responsive host.
Truly love staying here. It is a wonderful location and it is great for kids. Very spacious and it's just a great space.

Catherine's apartment was as described and shown in photos. It was comfy and spacious, a great working table in the dining room. Close to lots of restaurants and cafes. We loved our morning walk to Kosciuszko Park where we took our dog for morning runs.

The house was great and matches the description. Without a vehicle and relying on public transportation it was difficult. in many cases  you would have to take 2-3 buses or/and a train to get anywhere. Gathering groceries was difficult. I enjoyed my stay and Santiago was very communicative and replied quickly.
Had a great stay here for an entire month! I loved the location and Matthew was very responsive if I ever had a question or needed help with something.

Inka offers a delightful, impeccably clean, sunlit studio apartment, recently upgraded and thoughtfully redesigned. The unit is in an older building, in the process of refurbishing, on an elegant tree-lined boulevard.  The neighborhood is quiet and I felt safe walking around.  What makes it an exceptional  stay is your host, Inka. He is always cheerfully on call by text or phone to help you check in, answer questions and solve any issues.  (Just one note: this unit is up stairs on the third floor with no elevator.)

Something to note- the rest of the instructions for entering the building are when you enter through the front entrance, not the back entrance gate. It did not say this in the instructions, so it took us a long time to get in and figure out which codes go for which doors/padlocks. The listing also promises different amenities that were actually not included. There were no extra blankets, baking sheet, blender, rice maker, dining table or hand soap. This was a bit of a problem being that I had counted on certain things being there. Overall a nice stay.

The place was beautiful, the view amazing. It’s right there at south loop within walking distance to a lot of attractions, and busses/trains stops very close by. Free coffee in the morning, and occasional social events. If there’s one downside, I found the bed way too soft (for others I’m sure it’s a plus).
I left a day early but I wish I could’ve come to some arrangement with the host to check out sooner. Unfortunately I can’t recommend this place and I wouldn’t stay here again.
Great location! Thanks for the pizza ❤️

The place was beautiful, clean well-maintained, and spacious. The host was easy to speak with and responded on time. I most definitely recommend this place to traveling nurses and or workers. The neighborhood is quiet but I don't recommend walking at night alone according to some Uber drivers.

Absolutely loved the spot. I am often in Chicago and have stayed at different places. This was easily one of my favorites, especially good if you have kids. There are toys and it’s just a great spot for them since the room is across the hall.

Casa a las afueras de Chicago, con buena conexión al centro.
Andy es muy atento y está al al pendiente.
Great apartment. Very comfortable. Super clean and great facilities. Lovely building. Would stay here again.
Wunderschönes Appartement in einem sehr angenehmen Viertel Chicagos, Gute Anbindung an die Innerstadt, sauber, sehr schön eingerichtet. Sehr empfehlenswert
Great place to stay for a couple nights!

Daniel was very communicative & pleasant to deal with. His house is very large, clean & has plenty of street parking. House had many more supplies than most Air BnBs, including detergent, many rolls of paper towels, toilet paper, detergent, dishwashing liquid, etc.
Only drawbacks were the master bedroom has very poor lighting, and there’s only one TV in the master bedroom (in front of a platform bed.) So it wasn’t conducive for the 3 of us to watch TV
Always a pleasure to stay here, clean , affordable, responsive host , laundry, eating and cooking utensils ! I highly recommend
I’ve stayed here a few times before and it’s nice to come back to a place so warm and inviting. Eric is a lovely guy.

Nina’s place is a delightful fusion of comfort, culture, and curiosity. The full kitchen and private bathroom are stocked with everything you might need, ensuring a hassle-free stay. The location couldn’t be better, with an eclectic mix of eateries, bars, and shops within walking distance. The museum’s interactive approach, be it meeting animals or mingling with fellow explorers is thoroughly refreshing.
Look no further if you’re looking for a unique getaway that blends urban excitement with a dash of natural wonder. Highly recommend!

AJ was such an amazing host! He was very flexible with check in times and did anything and everything to make sure I was comfortable and had everything I needed. The place is very spacious and  just as shown in the pictures. It felt like home and I always felt safe! Would definitely stay here again. Location is amazing and it was a quick commute to get all over the city (downtown, the stadiums, beach/water, restaurants, grocery stores, highway, etc). There is an amazing theater-stereo system, but the only con is the walls are thin so you can hear the TV/podcasts/music from upstairs (depending on what your interested in sometimes you may find yourself getting intrigued with what’s playing). I did have to close most of the vents to minimize the noise which definitely helped but keep in mind if you can hear them, they can hear you. This was absolutely not a deal breaker, just something to be mindful of! I had amazing time staying in this airbnb and would absolutely come again!
We had a nice stay! The location is really nice and the metro is within walking distance!

Terrific location combines convenience and a quiet residential street. Safe and walkable area, including late at night. Very easy to get in and out of the apartment. Short walk to excellent coffeehouses both to the north and to the south. Gorgeous old neighborhood including “Terracotta Row.” Sharing bathrooms etc can be a tiny bit of a hassle, but it’s all clearly explained in the listing.
Great stay
It was a very nice home
An all-around great apartment. Just as pictured.

Very well appointed! Beautiful and clean apartment. Loved the location. Upstairs apartment was very noisy. Looks like there was construction or moving going. Luckily, we were out most of the day or it would have been difficult.

I am very grateful for the host’s flexibility and open communication. The property was perfect for what I needed. It looks better in person than in the photos. I felt safe and at ease. Happy to stay here again if the opportunity presents itself.

Great location and unit. Bigger inside than I anticipated. Joe is a wonderful host. He had great recommendations of things to do and was quickly responsive to all of our questions.
I highly recommend staying at this condo.
Aayah was a great host and plenty of spots around the place and short drives to anywhere that is fun there in Chicago. We had a great time!

Nice space - good location
Has everything you need
Would stay again!
This is our second time staying in this accommodation. Jb is an amazing host and the space is cozy and delightful. We highly recommend.
Warm, well stocked, clean and comfortable.

Josh’s spot was spacious and perfect for my month long stay in Chicago. Very walkable area both near the train, restaurants, and everything you could need while visiting the city. Had a great time and Josh was very easy to communicate with.

Great place to stay for the weekend.
Easy access to transit and the juicer was a plus for lemonade.

El lugar es un cinco estrellas. Apartado del loop pero cerca. Accesible a todo. Definitivamente me sentí como en casa.
Cuando vuelva a Chicago, quiero volver aquí.
Daniel es muy amable y me ha ayudado con todo! Muy agradecida.
This place was exactly what we were looking for. Nice neighborhood, clean unit, and comfortable bed. Everything was as expected and described. Thanks for a wonderful stay!

Great stay! The apartment is very cute in a decent neighborhood about 15 minutes from DT and other areas. Also, the apartment was spacious, nice bedrooms, lots of amenities and the water pressure was great in the shower. Would stay again.
Excellent host all around, thank you for everything.

Cozy and warm which was comforting with the change of seasons. It accommodated my daughter and I for the week+ that we stayed. The street is well travelled especially during school drop off and pick up. Finding parking was not too bad which made for a great experience. Unless I missed it in the description, I did not realize the unit was in the basement of this building. That was a not a big deal, it just sets expectations.
Great location and easy place to stay with our daughter

The room was very clean and matched the description. Loved the neighborhood as it was peaceful and residential with tree lined streets, but only a few minutes walk away from great restaurants and cute boutiques. Though our room faced the train tracks (as mentioned in the listing), the noise wasn’t too bad.

Tj was a great host and was quickly responsive and detailed about any questions I had before and throughout our stay. The house was great overall; very spacious, clean, and with plenty of amenities. The area was great and the house is situated in a good area with lots of things within walking distance in a safe area. The house was perfect for a large group and I would definitely stay here again if I have a large group event again in the future.

This is a wonderful place to stay in regards to both the space and the host. The bed was exceptionally comfortable - probably the best bed I've ever had in an airbnb. And somehow it felt quite spacious even though it was a studio  Inka is also incredible. Whenever I had any question he would respond so quickly - almost always in seconds! the area also felt very safe to walk my dog. I would recommend this to anyone looking for a place to stay in Chicago! you just have to make sure you are comfortable walking up two flights of stairs. I will definitely be back!
My stay there was wonderful the inside was very spacious and homey I definitely recommend booking to everyone!!!
Chris’s place was spotlessly clean and located on a quiet street in a convenient neighborhood for our trip. I would stay here again.
Nael was very accommodating of our travel schedule. The home had all we needed! We didn’t do much in the neighborhood, but it was easy to get to downtown.
The host responded quickly and made everything quite easy!

Matt's place is wonderful in every way! Very comfortable beds with silky soft sheets,well appointed kitchen with brand new top of the line GE appliances. Great quiet tree lined neighborhood, awesome location with a variety of great restaurants within walking distance. Amazing Farmers Market one block away on Sundays from mid-May to the end of October. One block from the Blue Line Logan Square station for easy transit to downtown or out to O'Hare. The icing on the cake is a one car garage for safe and secure parking.

The place was nicely decorated however most things were either wobbly or broken.  We found hairs & stains in the sheets. There were brown stains on the curtains. There were a lot of broken floor tiles. We found a house centipede in the bathroom. It's nice from a distance and then when you got closer you noticed all the little things. It also smelled like smoke the entire time. The lady in the downstairs appt. was very nice and greeted us (assuming she was the host but not sure?). The location was perfect for us because we were going into Chicago to site see and into Gary Indiana for a show so it was central to both of those areas. There was always parking available.
Very cozy

Amazing location - super well equipped kitchen and great sized apartment. Back deck was nicer than the photos and than many other walk up back decks at typical chicago apartments.
Fast WiFi and pretty easy parking on the street out front, unpermitted.
Amazing place enjoyed my stay best host you can ask for.
My stay was so relaxing! We enjoyed having our private room clean and clutter free. It felt like a small getaway. Thank you !
We had a great stay! Everything needed was close by and close to downtown! Very nice neighborhood as well! Angelica was very responsive!
This was a great flat in Bronzeville and Jason was very helpful. We had a good weekend.

Had a great stay at Roscoe Village Inn!  It was great to spend the weekend in such a great neighborhood with cute coffee shops, yummy restaurants and fun bars.  Extremely walkable and close to Brown Line Addison stop which made it easy and quick to get downtown.  We had a wonderful stay.
Spacious, great location.
Very lovely and cozy place!! Very clean!! Had everything you need. Well thought out and organized!!
Great stay! Had everything we needed and communication was excellent

This was our second time staying with Brenda and I'm so glad we chose to stay with them again! They are such a kind family and have a wonderful home. It's the perfect launching point to explore Chicago. We'll be back again!

Each time I visit Chicago, I will definitely try to stay at Larrisa’s place. The details in her space provided Zen like comfort. She has the gift of balance between guest contact and privacy. One of the most comfortable stays I’ve experienced. Well done Larrisa!
Great condo for a long weekend in Chicago. Location was great.

It was a nice space near Jefferson Park, about a 15 min walk from the blue line/Metra stop. Bus route 88 can also take you directly to the subway. The neighborhood felt safe. The loft itself was spacious enough for 2 people. The only bothersome issue was that one of the lights in the unit seemed to also be connected to one of the switches in the entryway, so our light did turn on a few times during the night when other guests would enter or exit the building.
This was exactly what we were looking for, for a multi-generation stay.  Close to restaurants, grocery stores, and other amenities such as bike rentals. Carol and Basil were extremely attentive.

We had such a great time here! This is what Airbnb is supposed to be about.
Nina's place is absolutely beautiful. I felt like I could hideaway and observe the decor for days. She's a busy lass and was out and about quite a bit, but she was very commutative and proactive so we had an easy stay with some great recommendations! The Insect Asylum is amazing and getting to tour it for free is quite the treat. The staff was so friendly and informative and would pull out critters of interest for a closer look or for us to hold. ALSO HAZEL!!!!
If you're looking for somewhere unique to stay, I really don't think this can be beat! If you're worried about staying in a shared space, this would be a great first step into it and felt very private and secure. If we stay in Chicago again I'll definitely be checking to see if there's availability to stay again :)

Wendy was very easy to book with. The street parking was plentiful, though the listing says “on-premise parking” which made us think we would have off-street parking. The surrounding area is OK, but I’m not sure I would walk at night. The train is across the street and somewhat loud inside the apartment. Overall, we were happy with our stay.
was a good time! eat food! :D
very friendly

This was the first time that we have ever used an Airbnb. I have to say it was perfect for the six of us. Lots of room and comfortable.  Our host Jeff was super. I was impressed that whenever we communicated, he ALWAYS answered right away. I appreciated that very much.  We were so close to our son's apartment and so close to the event venue. The convenience was wonderful. If we ever need and Airbnb in Chicago again, I would not hesitate to book Jeff and Jennifer's place. Many thanks to the both of you.

Jonathan’s place was great! It was very easy to get inside and upon arrival he helped us with our bags upstairs and we arrived around 9:00pm. His place was very clean and conveniently near everywhere we went the weekend we were there! I would stay here again! :)
The apartment was great, really big, spacious and confortable. Tessa is really helpful and it’s the check in is easy. Would 100% recommend
Tellys place was perfect for our  long weekend! Beautiful accommodations and neighborhood! Can’t wait to visit again!
great stay with Bianca! would stay here again on future visits

There was always parking in the street which was nice, but the apartment was dirty, worn down, had stained carpets, with broken closet shelves and doors.  Dirty mirrors in the bathrooms, leftover toiletries from previous tenants, hair in the bathrooms and in the bedsheets.  There was junk in the closets and the kitchen and bedroom/bathroom drawers.  A dirty towel and blanket in the hallway when we showed up.  I’ve never stayed in an AirBnB that was less ready for a visitor.  Kimberli communicated well, and even stayed awake to make sure I’d gotten into the place ok, so I was surprised with how dirty and unkept the place was.  I don’t mean to be harsh, but for a place with a high rating I expected better.

Large, clean room
Dependable wi-fi
Spacious bathroom with plenty of towels and good water pressure

Caroline is a very friendly person, she communicates all the time and her instructions are very clear.
The place is very clean and Caroline is a lovely person.
Thank so much for your hospitality.
The kitchen is well equipped and the beds are super comfortable. We always enjoy our stays in Roscoe Village and this house is within walking of a number of great restaurants.
Really cool place in a great location. Great host

This is the second year we have stayed here.  It is the perfect location for us.  The unit works well for how we live and where we need to go.  After last year, we left a list of things that needed to be fixed and when we got here this year, they all were.  I would ask that there be labels on the cabinets as to what is inside.  We are older and getting down on the floor to look for things can be challenging.  I would also ask, if there is an interest in being a step up from the ordinary, that there be staples in the pantry (not much) but more than a salt and pepper shaker and perhaps a stick of butter in the fridge along with milk or creamer.   That being said, we would definitely consider staying here again if we are coming back to Chicago.

Jackie’s place was great. Beds were comfy. Master shower was wonderful!!!! We went up onto the roof top and the view was amazing. The location was perfect for us to drive into the city. We felt safe walking to the restaurants nearby.

Amazing city airbnb— has everything anyone wants—great front desk staff, 24 h gym, grilling, dog friendly, great valet staff, and terrific hotel manager. Like a vertical spa hotel. Might do well with casual small restaurant with healthy great food. Thank you Sentral!!

I love the mood of this room, it was so good.
Thanks a lot for Zhi!
He was so nice too

The house was perfect for our stay in Chicago to do the marathon. It had a supermarket just down the road and some great restaurants nearby. There is a L station nearby which takes you to all the tourist attractions.
Eileen was a great host with clear instructions before we arrived and was always available if needed whilst we were staying.
We would definitely stay there again if we return to Chicago.

excelente ubicación y un lugar agradable. el lugar era muy acogedor y muy bonito. Tiene todo lo que necesitas para que tu estadía sea muy reconfortable. sin duda alguna volveria a quedarme. gracias por todo! :)
Amplia, con todas las comodidades y en un sitio muy lindo. Todo muy limpio. El único inconveniente para mi es que el acceso tiene 2 escaleras lo que hace complicado mover las maletas.
cute place with a private unit to myself. joceline was very helpful in providing info and responding fast

Joli appartement bien aménagé. Le métro est à moins de 5 minutes à pied et dessert rapidement le Loop et le centre ville.

Je recommande
Shaun was extremely helpful throughout our 2 month stay. The apartment was clean and the neighborhood felt safe. Shaun went out of his way to make our stay comfortable. Highly recommend!
Its a good place, especially if you don’t want to break the bank. I didn’t have any major issues. Upstairs was quite noisy but it was expected. The host is very responsive.

Tetyana is a superb host, the whole accommodation was perfectly as described: clean, quiet, very well equipped and supplied with hygiene essentials (towel, soap, toothbrush and toothpaste) which was much appreciated. Tetyana is always available, gives good advice and made sure I was comfortable throughout my stay in Chicago, even finding someone to go to the Bulls game with.
The location of the apartment in a neighborhood with a reputation for being dangerous may not be ideal, but don't believe everything you hear - I personally never had any problems, at any time of day. It's very easy to get to, 15 seconds from a bus station and 6-7 minutes from another bus and the subway, and Uber is the best way to get home in the evening: fast and inexpensive.
In short, I highly recommend Tetyana and her accommodation to future travelers.
I had a great time in the condo. The best part, for me, was the excellent location. I absolutely recommend it!

Die Kommunikation mit Roberto war sehr unkompliziert. Auf meine Nachrichten hat Roberto super schnell reagiert.
Die Unterkunft entsprach der Beschreibung und den Fotos und war ordentlich und sauber.
Einziger Kritikpunkt hier, die Decke ist nur ca. 185 cm hoch. Aus Deutschland bin ich Raumhöhen von mindestens 200 cm gewohnt.
Ansonsten alles in allem eine super schöne Zeit in Chicago verbracht. :)
Great location, responsive and helpful host, highly recommended!
The host was a great host, Professional and responded quickly. The location is close to everything you need. Had a great stay!
This was one of the very best places I have ever stayed! The host was amazing and very responsive! Very nice safe place! I’d book again!

Very spacious and nice house, with everything you'll need.
Easy hands free check-in and -out.
Quiet surroundings a bit outside the center, but price and especially space easily makes up for the extra transportation.
We'll gladly come back if we get to go to Chicago again.

El lugar es muy bonito y acogedor. El vecindario es tranquilo y agradable. Todo se encontraba en muy buen estado y muy limpio. Tiene todo lo necesario para poder cocinar y conservar los alimentos. Emily es muy buena anfitriona, estuvo muy atenta a todo lo que necesitáramos, respondía muy rápido.
Es fácil coger el transporte hacia el centro de Chicago.

Mariena's place is exactly as described - my husband and I stayed here with our toddler for about a week while visiting family and it perfectly fit our needs. The kitchen and bathroom are updated and well-suited for a long stay. There are a few walkable shops and restaurants in the area, it's ideal if you want to stay around Rogers Park. Rogers Park in general can feel far from downtown Chicago but if you are familiar with this neighborhood or don't mind driving downtown I definitely recommend staying here.

The Location: If you love Wicker Park as much as we do, it's 100% impossible to find a great luxury home in a more perfect location. Tom and Megan's place is on a low-traffic residential street but is also a thirty second walk to the heart of Wicker Park: Our fav stores, restaurants, and Jewel, all very short walks away.
The Home: On site parking. Super comfortable, spotlessly clean, well stocked with a great kitchen fitted with ultra high end appliances, custom cabinetry, etc. Fabulous shower and separate tub. Really comfortable beds...zero clutter but still feels like an actual home. Just the right amount of tech without being hard to figure out (fast WIFI, easy E-locks, nice and easy to use lighting/dimming options, etc.). Awesome projection TV/sound downstairs.
The Hosts: Both Tom and Megan are super pleasant, easy-going, helpful, and communicative. Had the chance to meet Tom in person. Very nice guy. Megan made booking and check-out easy w/ instant responses to messages

I would highly recommend reading the reviews of any Airbnb before you book it because it could save you a lot of headaches.
I saw this room and thought it was going to be an affordable location close to downtown, but then I realized there were many issues when I got there.,
Finding and checking in the home was a struggle, and then the three different passcodes you needed to get in was a challenge. If you stay here, you’re going to be doing that a lot.
Then when I got to my room, I noticed the smell of body odor on the bedding, and stains on the walls. It was clear that the host did not regularly have their rooms cleaned or maintained.
Bathrooms were also iffy. The shower head wobbled and took a long time to get warm. And there were many products on the shelving that I assume were from former guests that were never tossed.
I ended up having to book a room at a hotel because this space was not livable with the smell and lack of ac control.
There is also little privacy.

Literally one of the best apartments I've ever stayed in. Photos are not enough to convey the atmosphere of this place.
Jb is a very hospitable and attentive host. The apartment has everything for a comfortable stay.
The Pullman area is very cozy and quiet. There are friendly neighbors living around the house and it felt completely safe to be there. The metro, which can take you directly to the city center, is just a 5-minute walk from the house. There is a park nearby, a big store is a 20-minute walk.
I highly recommend staying in this apartment! The impressions of a trip to Chicago will not be so complete and atmospheric if not with this apartment.

I enjoyed my week's stay at this place. Located in a very nice locality with restaurants close by. The CTA station blue line is 5 minutes away. Very well maintained and quiet.  Ideal for travellers looking for value for money. Thank you.
Great Place! Great Location! Nice walk to park/Zoo.  Restaurants all around.  Couldn't find check in instructions but Jonathan was very quick with a response! thank you!

Sebastien’s place was in an excellent location to get around Chicago while also offering a bit of privacy. It had some amazing restaurants just minutes outside his front door and was right next to a bus stop to get downtown or was a 10 min walk to the metro with coffee shops along the way. I felt right at home and had an extremely comfortable stay. I travel solo a lot and it had everything I could need and at a great price! Sebastien was a wonderful host.

we had a lovely stay at Olivia's place, for about a week. The neighborhood is really nice, with restaurants, bars and supermarkets nearby. We also worked from home and had no issue with the internet. The apartment is nice and cozy and provides everything you might need for cooking, plus also a washing machine and drier. Would definitely go back.

Our stay was amazing. The loft was clean and decorated well. Everything was as described, and a walkable distance to the CTA trains.
we really enjoyed our stay.

Quartier calme, station de métro à 5 minutes à pied.

Good spot!

Truly loved this home so much. A++

I loved it! ❤️

This bedroom is great, it has a good bed for a good sleep, space for a luggage, TV and air conditioning. It's silent at night to sleep. Internet access works very well too.
The building is well located with easy access to buses and train, which you can take to go to anywhere. There is a market, a restaurant and other stores nearby from walking distance.
The check-in and check-out are very simple, you just need to read the instructions to understand how the lockers work.
Tracye and Francis are very very attentions and dedicated to their guests, it was a pleasure to meet them in person.
I definitely recommend this place and this specific room. It will be my first option when I come back.

Place nearby train station.

Very good experience, flexible check in and Cesar was so kind to allow us check out late due to our flight schedule. Very clean, coffee maker with a full fridge of water for the coffee maker was very helpful. will definitely recommend it to everyone.

Carole’s place was beautiful and perfect for our group’s stay in Chicago. We really appreciated the very well appointed kitchen and thoughtful touches throughout the home. Very welcoming hosts, helpful suggestions for things to do in the local area, and tips for spots to spectate the Chicago marathon . Definitely recommend!
great place to stay, everithing went ok

Die Wohnung war aufgeräumt und oberflächlich sauber, leider war die Toilette nicht geputzt und unter dem Tisch stand noch ein benutztes Glas. Leider gibt es nicht genug Teller, Tassen und Messer für 5 Personen.
Die Wohnung ist sehr gut erreichbar mit Bus und Train. Das Öffnen mit elektronischen Türschloss ist sehr einfach und gut von Kiana beschrieben.
Very good choice for a budget traveller!

I enjoyed my stay with Carl in Chicago. Carl was a gracious and kind host during my stay. Very easy to relax and escape the bustle of Chicago without being far away from the action. Dan's place was great place to be! Dan was friendly and very helpful. This was my first AirBnB experience, and I would definitely recommend Dan's place for everyone who travels for work or studies. The neighbourhood is quiet, and suitable for working long hours at night.

Great experience.

Adrienne se portó increíble y su casa es muy bonita y limpia.

I had a great time and would recommend to anyone traveling alone.

The home is beautiful and exactly how the pics show it. Kelsey was quick to respond when we had questions. she offered suggestions/recommendations.  We were a party of 7 adults and there was plenty of room for all of us. Quick uber ride into city for the attractions.

Super cute, loved the location. Came to Chicago for a wedding, and all the events were about 10-15 mins away which was really convenient. We had a pleasant stay,  very clear instructions. The location is in a surrounding with beach nearby. Highly recommended

Great little loft in a nice neighbourhood. The apartment was very clean and Dasha & Owen were always quick in responding whenever we needed them. There is a bus stop right in front of the building and the Mexican restaurant downstairs is very yummy! We enjoyed staying there and it felt like an authentic experience. Road noise can be a bit bothersome if you like to sleep with the window open like we do and the engine of the fridge is quite noisy but apart from that everything was just wonderful. Definitely worth the price and we wouldn't hesitate to staying there again. Thanks again, Dasha & Owen!
Great

El apartamento está muy bien situado, limpio y la cama es muy cómoda, todo tal como se ve en la foto.
Olga es muy atenta y responde rápidamente, repetiría experiencia de tener que volver a Chicago.

Hannah’s place is lovely and well located for Loyola Chicago. She also allowed me to bring my small dog Ollie which was a plus.
Hannah herself is lovely and her surroundings reflect her artistic nature and vibe.
El alojamiento está bien ubicado, tienes restaurantes y cafés cerca. Estaba todo muy limpio y la comunicación con Roseanna fue muy buena. La recomiendo
La estancia estuvo muy bien. El alojmiento corresponde con las imágenes. Solo tuvimos un problema con el código de la cerradura y la contraseña de wifi, pero de ahí en fuera, todo muy bien.
Very roomy, nice place to stay. Had everything available that we needed for our stay. Had an issue the first night with parking and the host was very quick to respond and resolve the problem.
Had a great stay! Apartment had everything we needed and was comfortable and in a great location. Would return!
It was very close amd convenient to public transportation. It was very easy to locate.  The host was very communcative and helpful.  I would stay there again if we visit Chicago in the future.

Nate’s place was clean, convenient, and made for a great weekend in Chicago! There was a lot of space inside the condo, great amenities and full kitchen. Walkable to UChicago and Hyde park. An easy train ride (station was an easy 5-10 mins walk away) to get downtown. Would recommend!

Inka is an incredible host and his thoughtful approach to designing the space was evident from the moment I walked in. The studio was very clean, recently updated, and had everything needed to feel at home. The space is filled with natural light during the day and the motorized blinds are simple to use when privacy is needed. The corner desk is perfect for remote work. The onsite laundry room is convenient and clean.
The location is a couple blocks away from a Chicago “L” station which gets to downtown Chicago in a few stops. I spent several days leisurely walking around historical Bronzeville and Kenwood neighborhoods appreciating the beautiful brick homes. Also, a Divvy bike rental is nearby and I enjoyed biking around Hyde Park and Promontory Point.
Communication with Inka was super easy and quick.  He provides detailed instructions to communicate important information about check-in and the studio and is quick to reply if any questions arise.
Highly recommend staying here!!

Judy and her home are both outstanding! She is such a kind and helpful person who you couldn’t fail to get on with. Her home in a quiet and safe  suburb is extremely clean, tidy and well furnished and she will provide everything -and more! I would recommend Judy as an excellent host.

Sharon was very proactive ensuring no surprises before my arrival in Chicago. Hank helped me with settling in and was very helpful throughout my stay. The house is within walking distance to various restaurants and amenities. The room is very clean and immaculate with everything you need during your stay. I highly recommend Sharon’s place!
Jessica was very responsive. The place was as described by the listing. Overall great value for the location.
Great host in a nice neighborhood.
Martha was a fantastic host.  Her place was very clean comfortable and quiet.  It was a convenient location and a nice neighborhood. The next time I visit Chicago I will definitely stay there again.

I had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb! The host was incredibly welcoming and accommodating.
The property was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. The location was convenient, and I had a great overall experience.
I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great place to stay.
Great place to stay near Orange line

We had a great time at William’s during out visit to Chicago for the marathon. Everything was as described and William provided very detailed instructions on how to get in - being available if we had issues though even though we were getting in super late. He was also responsive to all our questions and was very helpful on how we could best get around.
Apartment was super clean and we appreciated the coffee supplies to kick start our morning!!
Highly recommend to anyone looking to book a place in Chicago and will be back!
Safe space with a good access to public transport. Thanks to Karl for the possibility of earlier check-in!
Great spot! We had a lovely stay.
Hana was a great and welcoming host. I’m very happy with my stay and I would recommend her to anyone who wants to stay in Roger’s Park

I love Josh’s place. It’s my new go-to for visits to Chicago—affordable, easy to access and clean/fit accommodation. Devon Market next door is a grocery gem. Tacos open late a couple blocks out. Parking stays tight (like everywhere in Chicago), but I always found a spot within a couple blocks and it’s free! I love Josh’s place.

I had a wonderful stay here! Getting to and from the Blue Line train was super easy and the location was also easily accessible for Uber drop-offs. The neighborhood was pretty quiet and the apartment itself was cozy. I loved having access to a full kitchen. Jeffrey was very communicative and friendly and made sure I had everything I needed for my stay.

Andy was a very good host. He gave lots of tips and always responded immediately.  The room and house itself was like described in the pictures. The free breakfast could have been better, I ended up buying my own stuff. But it's free, so hard to complain. The area is not a particularly nice neighbourhood of Chicago and I would not stay here again. Even as a guy, I would not feel comfortable walking around after sunrise. But the train station is only 5min walk aways and brings you right to downtown. Overall I had a good stay, but would choose another neighbourhood next time.

We had a great stay. The neighbourhood is a bit scary but you can take uber. CTA trains are about 10-20 minutes walk depending on the station. There is only 1 bathroom in the airbnb. The kitchen is well equipped, a nice renovated apartment.

Stayed here to run the Chicago marathon. Location was great, a short walk from the L train. Great restaurants within walking distance, place was as described and shown on the listing. Hosts were very helpful and communicative. Will stay again if we go back to Chicago!
It was a great place to stay. Close to subway.

All of the reviews do not lie - what a gem! Such a great location, all of the amenities you need, and so so clean. It feels like you’re at your own home. Well decorated and the staff is very friendly and attentive. And similar to all of the reviews, the noise from the train was really not bad at all. I am a very light sleeper and we had our baby with us, and it didn’t both anyone. Would definitely recommend this place to Chicago visitors.
Would come back for another stay.
Die Wohnung ist wunderschön. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Kelly ist ein toller Gastgeber. Uns hat es an nichts gefehlt. Ganz großes Lob und vielen Dank.
Very nice loft! We had a comfortable stay. It was cute and quiet.
A lovely home that is a short walk to the green line. The home is clean and spacious. Ms Bobbie is very welcoming and responsive
Phillip is a great host and replies within minutes. My guest and I had a great time during the staying.

The home was very convenient and walkable to UChicago campus. The check-in process was easy and the host was available for any questions. The house felt larger than what it looked in the photos!
The kitchen was well equipped. It also had an onsite parking and ample street parking available too.
Will definitely stay here on our next visit.

Excellent Airbnb experience, our hosts were responsive and proactive for check-in, everything was ready when needed and the location is excellent. All of the utilities within kitchen and bathrooms looked great and worked well, we didn't run into any issues or have any trouble with anything in the Airbnb. The rooms were comfortable and the AC/Heat was in excellent condition, keeping the whole group comfortable of the duration of the stay.
Highly recommend this Airbnb!!
The place was as advertised. I would return. Great location.  Building is a bit tired but the inside has been renovated.
We stayed here for the Chicago marathon and it was perfect for us-conveniently located to transport. The kitchen was well equipped and amenities were provided. Overall, a very comfortable stay.

The space is so beautiful and conveniently located.  Omni checked in often to make sure everything was good, which it was.  They were highly responsive to my needs/ questions.  The neighborhood is peaceful and serene and it was a pleasure to stay there.  It’s a pity I didn’t get to enjoy all the amenities!

This place is in Chinatown, there are many Chinese restaurants just minutes away. It is close to public transportation. The room is not fancy, just what I want: an economical stay for two or three nights in Chicago.
Gracjan was a great host!  Very responsive and willing to accommodate an early check in/out.
Had an excellent stay! Barbara is always responsive if something is needed. This a great location to stay as it is very close to mass transit. 100% recommended.

숙소에 대해서는 전반적으로 매우 만족했고, 호스트의 응대 역시 너무나 완벽했습니다. 하지만, 지역 치안에 대한 우려가 있으며, 아마도 숙소위치에 대한 정보를 좀 더 숙지했더라면 선택에 있어서 좀 더 고려를 했을 것 같습니다.

Nice place to stay in couple. Excellent bed!
Todo bien, lugar acogedor. Me gustó.

Had such a lovely stay! Angelica was extremely responsive and accommodating from the very beginning. I appreciated that she helped me add guests to the listing when I couldn’t do it, and she was kind enough to let us do an early check-in. Everything went smoothly, instructions were clear, and it was very clean. Would recommend and stay here again!

non ci ha dato alcuna disponibilità per lasciare 1 zaino abbiamo dovuto attendere le 15,00 per check in , poi la camera non aveva serratura, c'era un ospite imprevisto a dormire su un sofa , nessuna disponibilità a mediare se non polemiche tardive sulla messaggeria del sito e contraddittorie con quanto parlato telefonicamente il giorno stesso del check in . I had the pleasure to stay at Glenda's House during my visit to run the Chicago Marathon. It was a very good choice!
Glenda is very friendly and always ready to provide help! We had forgotten our phone chargers and she immediately responded by lending us one!
Although the decoration is a bit "heavy" with many stuff around it is very cosy and warm and gives a sense of locality and uniqueness. The wooden floors are a bit noisy but not a deal breaker.
The house is in a great location. It is in a quite road and we did not feel at any point unsafe. Although it doesn't have nearby access to a train station the bus stop is just 3' away and is very convenient, just a 20' ride to downtown.
Also the cost of taking a taxi to/from downtown is not very big.
I would definitely recommend staying here for a family or group of friends!

A friend and I stayed at Zhi's place for the Chicago marathon. Zhi messaged us well in advance with access codes, so we had no trouble getting in flexibly. The room was well arranged and met our needs well. Overall, while the property is no frills, it is clean, in a decent location near the L, and got the job done for a price that was much more affordable than area hotels during the marathon. We would definitely consider staying here again under similar circumstances!

Nina’s place was a great find and immediately felt at home. Nina is a great host and made lots of recommendations for things to do and places to eat.
The CTA Blue line stops 5min walk to Nina’s place and goes straight into the loop area, there are several bus routes nearby for alternative travel.

As someone who was running the Chicago Marathon, this was a very great place to stay if you’re looking for a bit more space for family! Beds were VERY comfy. SO easy to hop on the train to get to the start line too!
Anna’s house is in a nice neighborhood Ana was very comfortable to stay in. Anna was very responsive to any communication we had with her.

Joe was a great host providing a comfortable and welcoming place to stay. He provided us with some nice general recommendations to let us explore the neighborhood. It's in a great location within in a vibrant neighborhood with easy access to public transportation.
Very good place to be, transport very near, train and buses, clean place, Tracy very nice person, always pending and checking all. I recomend if anyone want to visit Chicago!
Very good for the price👍🏼

I had a great experience here. Check-in was pretty seamless and the apartment was located within an easy walking distance from the Logan Square subway station (less than a mile away) and places like Lula's Cafe. Highly recommend!
great place, for the price. the high of the celining is 6 ' 1" .

We went to Chicago for a quick weekend trip and this was exactly what we needed. The room was clean and the host provided lots of little things to make the stay more comfortable like toiletries. The neighborhood was quiet with good food in walking distance and it was easy to find parking.
Everything was great . Nice clean home ❤️

It was what we expected. It is a room in a house. Parking is tough… they came and helped with bags to get us in the room. It is in the city. Being alert while walking is important. That said, we walked everywhere. If we had another event near there, I would stay here again.

Had a great weekend and stay in chicago. the apartment was very spacious with plenty of room to sleep and did not feel crowded. living room and kitchen where quite large and comfortable. plenty of towels in the bathrooms as well as other small toiletries that are needed. being on the first floor was convenient for easily getting in and out of the building. Definitely would recommend, and would stay there again for sure!
This is a fantastic way to stay in Chicago! We had such a lovely time staying at Shannon’s, and loved the area that this place is located in. 10/10 would stay again, this was worth it 100%.
Angelica was a great host! A wonderful, peaceful, comfortable space.

Mi estadía en el alojamiento de Guillermo fue muy buena. Me quedé 5 días y fueron muy tranquilos en donde pude descansar muy bien.
