Nice and clean place. Communication was great
Very comfortable and close to our daughter’s home. Walkable to transportation. It was a great value on Marathon weekend. Upstairs neighbors were a little loud but didn’t bother us.
Good place!

Katie’s place is gorgeous and Katie herself is absolutely delightful. The room was perfect and was close to everything in the city.  The decor is so comfortable and comforting and a perfect home away from home. This is where you want to stay in Chicago❤️
Great location, neighborhood is cute and super walkable. The little nook in the living room with exposed brick was a great place to hangout in each morning. Would stay here again!
Carl, был дружелюбный и отзывчивым. Подсказывал и помогал по необходимым вещам. Мне было приятно оставаться у него дома.
great location and a gorgeous view!
Elizabeth was so accommodating and kind, I had a wonderful time!

Emilia was super responsive. She answered all my questions. She accommodated to our additional needs. She was flexible able with us checking in before 3pm.
The space was small but not bad since my group was not there most of the time. The space looked just like the pictures and it felt like home. We had utensils, plates, pots and pans if we needed to cook anything.
I would definitely recommend this place if you like to stay outside of Chicago, but still be close enough to travel in. We rode the blue line at Cumberland. Very convenient.

Carl is a very good person! Of course, it means that his household is also very good! I think, it’s one of the best airbnb places in Chicago as it’s very cheap, very close to the downtown while the neighbourhood is very quiet!
All the best to Carl and his wife!

Great location. Donna was also a responsive host and very nice! She made street parking easy and provided parking passes. We had no issues finding parking really close to the place. Bed was comfy and linens were clean. The only thing to note is there are several signs on furniture giving rules of the space which felt unwelcoming. While I understand this is a private home being shared, it still made it feel less welcoming to have notes on so many things.

Very good place! I haven’t met Karen but her husband was really helpful and responsive. I stayed for the marathon, it is a bit far away from the start line but easy to get there through public transportation! I would highly recommend this place!!
Host offered free shuttle to the start line of chicago marathon and wait me and other runners at finish line .. highly recommended place
Good place overall

We absolutely loved our stay at Dawn’s rental. The location, neighborhood, access to the train, parking, comfort, cleanliness, and space (so much room) were all top notch! We will definitely stay here again when in Chicago!! Dawn was a great host- quick to respond and keep us updated on info we needed. Highly recommend!

Great location, we loved getting to explore Roscoe Village and it’s not far from Lakeview and Wrigleyville. Fantastic food within walking distance and multiple grocery options in under a 20 minute walk.
We were there for a month. The apartment had great wifi and a pretty reasonable kitchen setup.
Parking was ridiculously easy, but keep an eye out for street cleaning in the summer (temporary signs go up a few days before). We brought our bikes and biking in the area was very accessible - a good number of bike lanes and an easy straight shot to the lakefront.

This was a great deal in a central space in Chicago. The space is well described - simple, but safe and great for conferences or other single travelers. Juanita made sure I had everything I needed and gave me great restaurant and parking suggestions. Would absolutely stay again! Thank you for everything.

Inka is a wonderful host and I am sure he will do his best to make you feel comfortable during your stay!
I love how he has tastefully decorated the apartment, it is very cozy and comfy! This was my first experience living abroad by myself, I felt very welcome and safe. Inka is very respectful, proactive in explaining things and will provide you with all the support you need, because he helped me many times whenever I needed it. I am a Brazilian coffeeholic and I appreciate him giving me a bunch of coffees to drink!
I loved living in the Black Metropolis. The location of the apartment in Bronzeville is such a nice area, close to public transportation, has history, beautiful parks and boulevards, architecture and restaurants.
I highly recommend you to stay here!

Solid spot, nice neighborhood, and quiet space inside.  Most are ok with it, but FYI there are 3+ air fresheners, which got intense but not a big deal.  Super comfy couch and loved the bed, easy street parking (outside of 4pm when school lets out).

We had an amazing stay at this Airbnb! The location was perfect, with easy access to attractions. The apartment was spacious and well-designed, and the rooftop was absolutely stunning. The host was friendly and provided great recommendations. Highly recommend this Airbnb for a memorable experience. Thank you!

The pictures don’t do this place justice. The view of the lake is amazing! Additionally, the location is just perfect - we walked everywhere. Lastly, Leah was a phenomenal host. If we ever had any questions/issues, she was very responsive and quick to help us find a solution. Highly recommend!
Me encantó, en el alojamiento hay de todo, si se te olvida algo ahí está, es súper cómodo, es accesible al transporte tanto bus como tren, la cocina lo tiene todo. 100 de 100.

Kayode was a wonderful Host. First impression was that the place was extremely clean and well-equipped. He was always responsive and made my stay easy. I will definitely go back there when I’m around. I stayed there for more than a month and was helped whenever I needed help. Amazing home.
Nice, cozy place to stay. Friendly hosts. Helpful instructions. And will work with you if you need to leave stuff behind for a few hours before your flight.

Our 6 week stay was AMAZING!!! The accommodations were comfortable and clean. The unit was perfect - tons of space for the 2 of us and enough room to entertain friends on the weekends.
The building is outrageous! The amenities are like no other - the pool, sundeck, grills, business center, gym, theater, entertainment room are beautiful and attention to detail is a priority. The property is so well managed and the staf is incredible. Maintenance men are so attentive and the doormen are excellent. Always felt safe and welcomed. Levell (the best!) knew our names in minutes and always greeted us with a smile and nice conversation!
The location is the BEST! 10 min walk to the beach, loads of restaurants/bars within minutes (walking), Michigan ave is 2 blocks away, tons of shopping, 1/2 block to subway, 10 min ride to west loop - literally everything is at your fingertips!!!
Thank you, Ping, for an awesome 6 weeks - it was one of the best experiences of our lives!!!
Pretty accurate description and the location was great. Only downside was that the closest place to potty dogs was two blocks away.
Great apartment in a very nice neighbourhood. The view from the rooftop was fantastic. David was a great host, very responsive and helpful. I highly recommend this place.

Great and affordable place to stay for a visit to Chicago! House was clean and the neighborhood is safe and beautiful. About 45 minutes into downtown but it's easy with the train station nearby. Great beach access and lots to do closer by, too. The bedroom was small but who cares when you're out and about all day. Would book again.

Place was nice, communication with Ginneh was good (e.g: she kept an eye to the temperature and the remote lock batteries). Also the apartment and convenient near red and green line. And we could always find parking in front of the place. We stayed for almost 2 months so the kitchenette and cleaning tools weren't ideal for such a long stay. It was something we knew in advance so overall worth the price.
The penthouse was beautiful. The views are amazing! Will definitely book again when we come back next year!

Very comfortable apartment. Good space, comfortable bed, and phenomenal views of the city! Loved the balcony and enjoyed spending time out there. Very convenient to grocery shopping and many restaurants, as well as public transit. Multiple buses stop on the corner there, and trains are just a couple blocks away. There wasn’t parking available at the building (they do have a garage, but no spots available at the time I stayed), but since transit is SO convenient, I really didn’t need my car much, so I just used Spot Hero to find a garage a few minutes walk from there and got a monthly pass. Would love to book here again!

Luke and Ligia's place was the ideal place to land when I moved to Chicago. It was clean, comfortable, and Ligia has amazing taste in décor. The hosts were friendly and responsive. Their place is very close to the train and on a peaceful tree-lined street. I never had to park more than a block away even when there were construction or street sweeping closures. Thank you guys for everything!

Maria was such a helpful host. She made sure we were comfortable all the time. If we had a problem, she was sure to help us out and be there as much as possible. The place was lovely. It had all the things we needed for a comfortable long term stay. Bonuses were the beautiful decor and a huge collection of books that I loved.

Thank you very much for the hospitality and that you helped with my needs getting to your housing. Tracye helped with the information how to get to places I wanted to see and was very responsive and friendly. I recommend her place!!!

Good place to sleep and relax, Bed was comfortable, spacious common area, one of the bathroom is nicely updated and house close to downtown.
Just was a lil bummed about not having fruits both mornings.. BUT otherwise no complaints! Felt safe and like at home!

This place was amazing!
Location. Location. Location. The train to downtown was a short walk away. The lake was a 10 min walk away. Bars, shops, restaurants, and Wrigley Field were just steps away.
The apartment was huge! And had everything we needed and more. The beds were so comfy. The rooftop (also huge and completely private) had views that were outstanding.
Tim super responsive, friendly and helpful.
We’re definitely going to rebook on our next trip.

Ants, ants, and more ants. Loud plumbing noises every 20 minutes or so. And I could hear every word of the other basement apartments.
listing said 2nd floor with a picture of the front of the house. It's actually part of a basement in the back of the house. Sketchy neighborhood.

I can't say enough about how much I enjoyed staying at Judy's for 2 months. It was a perfect fit for me! Judy was a wonderful host that made me feel right at home. I loved getting to know Judy, as well as Matt and Patrick, and having nice opportunities for some community. My room was comfortable and I enjoyed my privacy as well. The home is very clean and beautifully decorated. The front room is a great place for a cup of coffee, glass of wine or to just simply enjoy all the natural light/lovely windows in the house.
Jefferson Park is a lovely residential Chicago neighborhood and Judy's home is just a few blocks from Milwaukee Ave making it easy to get to some main streets as well as public transportation.
I highly recommend staying with Judy! She is a superhost and genuinely cares that you have a wonderful place to stay while you are visiting Chicago.

the home was very clean and well-organized. Most of the guests were students and friendly. Andy was friendly and responsive to inquiries, always trying to help his guests. I  also appreciated the fact that disposable plates and cups were provided, making things easier. Additionally, breakfast was offered as part of the stay. he also provided me with which places should  I visit in Chicago. Overall It was an excellent experience
Santiago and the co-hosts were honest and very nice hosts. I'd recommend them as airbnb hosts.
The check-in informations were clear. The place was really nice and the host was very friendly. Overall, we enjoyed our stay there.
Great place
It was a safe and clean space. Would highly recommend

I was in town for a conference at McCormick Place. Very convenient to bus and El lines and not too far walk to convention center. Coffee place next door is great. Lots of families and people walking and jogging.  Comfortable, spacious, and clean place.
Nice and tidy
Best hosts I’ve ever had. They taking care of the place and your staying. The place is great and well connected to downtown near to red and green line.
Great place ... thank you

Brett’s place is fantastic!! Very clean and efficient studio in a great area of Chicago. Kitchen is stocked with everything you could need and I had no issues with appliances, wifi, A/C. Brett’s place felt like a home away from home and I can’t wait to stay again the next time I’m in Chicago. Close to the L, very accessible. I felt very safe staying here and exploring the neighborhood alone as a young female. Long term parking under the L was $75/month and multiple free street parking spots. Brett was very responsive and got back to me within minutes anytime I had a question. 10/10 experience!!

Perfect place in the Loop. Everything was great.
Thank you!
Very convenient place if you need a quick spot to stay and don’t mind a communal space. Owners were very communicative.

The hosts are really nice , considreste people which I highly appreciate. They keep the place very clean including the common areas. Bed was comfy and bathroom had all what you need . Location is not bad cause it’s pretty accessible. They are very fair with the price . I would definitely book again when I’m back to Chicago !
Great place
Private and peaceful stay. The place matched the description perfectly and Andy is always responsive quickly.

There is no address marker on the house. Safety concern.
the picture of the door to the unit was not the door I arrived to, and was alone wandering in someone's backyard late at night (turned out to be the right place. had to knock on door upstairs. he wasnt too happy) . I wasn't told to go through the laundry area to find the unit

ants everywhere

I was told by every single person I spoke with that I shouldn't be out that way. If you're a woman alone, dont
Great location and super walkable

I love Roseanna's place. It is close to the blue line for a quick ride to downtown, but lots of great restaurants in walking distance, target around the corner, and lots of shops close by in both the Maxwell neighborhood or Greek town.

I want to come back to Chicago just to stay here again.
The beds and furniture were very comfortable. The apartment had a great layout and was excellently decorated. There were blankets and games and areas that facilitated conversations.
The kitchen was fully-equipped and came with the best snacks in AirBnB history. I wished I had more time to just hang out in the apartment!
The location was convenient: it was only a couple minutes walk to the nearest Brown Line station and only a 30 minute car ride to downtown. I didn’t need parking but noted that free parking was offered and the instructions were easy.
Many times throughout the weekend my friends and I remarked that this was one of the best AirBnBs we had ever stayed in. Had a wonderful experience and highly recommend this place.

This was a perfect location and situation for my travel group of 9 adults attending a weekend event. The keypad entry made it easy for everyone to come and go. For being a place in the city, it was reasonably quiet.
Great place, will recommend any day

If you want a nice place to stay while visiting Chicago I would definitely recommend this house. The host answered any request immediately. The house was in a great location, on a quiet street. It is close enough to all of Chicago but far away enough that you feel safe. I would strongly suggest that you stay at this location. We had an amazing time and never one did I feel unwanted, or unsafe while at the home.
My stay was great wish I could’ve stayed longer. Aiste is a great host. Place is exactly as she describes. Centric, close to downtown. Would recommend if you’re in Chicago.
